ayahs.clear: “You will surely know upon whom will come a torment that will abase him, and upon whom will fall a lasting torment.”
ayahs.kemenag: Kelak kamu akan mengetahui siapa yang akan ditimpa oleh azab yang menghinakannya dan yang akan ditimpa azab yang kekal".

ayahs.arabic: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا جَآءَ أَمْرُنَا وَفَارَ ٱلتَّنُّورُ قُلْنَا ٱحْمِلْ فِيهَا مِن كُلٍّۢ زَوْجَيْنِ ٱثْنَيْنِ وَأَهْلَكَ إِلَّا مَن سَبَقَ عَلَيْهِ ٱلْقَوْلُ وَمَنْ ءَامَنَ ۚ وَمَآ ءَامَنَ مَعَهُۥٓ إِلَّا قَلِيلٌۭ
ayahs.sahih: [So it was], until when Our command came and the oven overflowed, We said, "Load upon the ship of each [creature] two mates and your family, except those about whom the word has preceded, and [include] whoever has believed." But none had believed with him, except a few.
ayahs.clear: Until, when Our command came, and the volcano erupted, We said, “Board into it a pair of every kind, and your family—except those against whom the sentence has already been passed—and those who have believed.” But those who believed with him were only a few.
ayahs.kemenag: Hingga apabila perintah Kami datang dan dapur telah memancarkan air, Kami berfirman: "Muatkanlah ke dalam bahtera itu dari masing-masing binatang sepasang (jantan dan betina), dan keluargamu kecuali orang yang telah terdahulu ketetapan terhadapnya dan (muatkan pula) orang-orang yang beriman". Dan tidak beriman bersama dengan Nuh itu kecuali sedikit.

ayahs.arabic: ۞ وَقَالَ ٱرْكَبُوا۟ فِيهَا بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ مَجْر۪ىٰهَا وَمُرْسَىٰهَآ ۚ إِنَّ رَبِّى لَغَفُورٌۭ رَّحِيمٌۭ
ayahs.sahih: And [Noah] said, "Embark therein; in the name of Allah is its course and its anchorage. Indeed, my Lord is Forgiving and Merciful."
ayahs.clear: He said, “Embark in it. In the name of God shall be its sailing and its anchorage. My Lord is indeed Forgiving and Merciful.”
ayahs.kemenag: Dan Nuh berkata: "Naiklah kamu sekalian ke dalamnya dengan menyebut nama Allah di waktu berlayar dan berlabuhnya". Sesungguhnya Tuhanku benar-benar Maha Pengampun lagi Maha Penyayang.

ayahs.arabic: وَهِىَ تَجْرِى بِهِمْ فِى مَوْجٍۢ كَٱلْجِبَالِ وَنَادَىٰ نُوحٌ ٱبْنَهُۥ وَكَانَ فِى مَعْزِلٍۢ يَٰبُنَىَّ ٱرْكَب مَّعَنَا وَلَا تَكُن مَّعَ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ
ayahs.sahih: And it sailed with them through waves like mountains, and Noah called to his son who was apart [from them], "O my son, come aboard with us and be not with the disbelievers."
ayahs.clear: And so it sailed with them amidst waves like hills. And Noah called to his son, who had kept away, “On my son! Embark with us, and do not be with the disbelievers.”
ayahs.kemenag: Dan bahtera itu berlayar membawa mereka dalam gelombang laksana gunung. Dan Nuh memanggil anaknya, sedang anak itu berada di tempat yang jauh terpencil: "Hai anakku, naiklah (ke kapal) bersama kami dan janganlah kamu berada bersama orang-orang yang kafir".

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ سَـَٔاوِىٓ إِلَىٰ جَبَلٍۢ يَعْصِمُنِى مِنَ ٱلْمَآءِ ۚ قَالَ لَا عَاصِمَ ٱلْيَوْمَ مِنْ أَمْرِ ٱللَّهِ إِلَّا مَن رَّحِمَ ۚ وَحَالَ بَيْنَهُمَا ٱلْمَوْجُ فَكَانَ مِنَ ٱلْمُغْرَقِينَ
ayahs.sahih: [But] he said, "I will take refuge on a mountain to protect me from the water." [Noah] said, "There is no protector today from the decree of Allah, except for whom He gives mercy." And the waves came between them, and he was among the drowned.
ayahs.clear: He said, “I will take refuge on a mountain—it will protect me from the water.” He said, “There is no protection from God’s decree today, except for him on whom He has mercy.” And the waves surged between them, and he was among the drowned.
ayahs.kemenag: Anaknya menjawab: "Aku akan mencari perlindungan ke gunung yang dapat memeliharaku dari air bah!" Nuh berkata: "Tidak ada yang melindungi hari ini dari azab Allah selain Allah (saja) Yang Maha Penyayang". Dan gelombang menjadi penghalang antara keduanya; maka jadilah anak itu termasuk orang-orang yang ditenggelamkan.

ayahs.arabic: وَقِيلَ يَٰٓأَرْضُ ٱبْلَعِى مَآءَكِ وَيَٰسَمَآءُ أَقْلِعِى وَغِيضَ ٱلْمَآءُ وَقُضِىَ ٱلْأَمْرُ وَٱسْتَوَتْ عَلَى ٱلْجُودِىِّ ۖ وَقِيلَ بُعْدًۭا لِّلْقَوْمِ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ
ayahs.sahih: And it was said, "O earth, swallow your water, and O sky, withhold [your rain]." And the water subsided, and the matter was accomplished, and the ship came to rest on the [mountain of] Judiyy. And it was said, "Away with the wrongdoing people."
ayahs.clear: And it was said, “O earth, swallow your waters,” and “O heaven, clear up.” And the waters receded, and the event was concluded, and it settled on Judi, and it was proclaimed: “Away with the wicked people.”
ayahs.kemenag: Dan difirmankan: "Hai bumi telanlah airmu, dan hai langit (hujan) berhentilah," dan airpun disurutkan, perintahpun diselesaikan dan bahtera itupun berlabuh di atas bukit Judi, dan dikatakan: "Binasalah orang-orang yang zalim".

ayahs.arabic: وَنَادَىٰ نُوحٌۭ رَّبَّهُۥ فَقَالَ رَبِّ إِنَّ ٱبْنِى مِنْ أَهْلِى وَإِنَّ وَعْدَكَ ٱلْحَقُّ وَأَنتَ أَحْكَمُ ٱلْحَٰكِمِينَ
ayahs.sahih: And Noah called to his Lord and said, "My Lord, indeed my son is of my family; and indeed, Your promise is true; and You are the most just of judges!"
ayahs.clear: And Noah called to his Lord. He said, “O My Lord, my son is of my family, and Your promise is true, and You are the Wisest of the wise.”
ayahs.kemenag: Dan Nuh berseru kepada Tuhannya sambil berkata: "Ya Tuhanku, sesungguhnya anakku termasuk keluargaku, dan sesungguhnya janji Engkau itulah yang benar. Dan Engkau adalah Hakim yang seadil-adilnya".

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ يَٰنُوحُ إِنَّهُۥ لَيْسَ مِنْ أَهْلِكَ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ عَمَلٌ غَيْرُ صَٰلِحٍۢ ۖ فَلَا تَسْـَٔلْنِ مَا لَيْسَ لَكَ بِهِۦ عِلْمٌ ۖ إِنِّىٓ أَعِظُكَ أَن تَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلْجَٰهِلِينَ
ayahs.sahih: He said, "O Noah, indeed he is not of your family; indeed, he is [one whose] work was other than righteous, so ask Me not for that about which you have no knowledge. Indeed, I advise you, lest you be among the ignorant."
ayahs.clear: He said, “O Noah, he is not of your family. It is an unrighteous deed. So do not ask Me about something you know nothing about. I admonish you, lest you be one of the ignorant.”
ayahs.kemenag: Allah berfirman: "Hai Nuh, sesungguhnya dia bukanlah termasuk keluargamu (yang dijanjikan akan diselamatkan), sesungguhnya (perbuatan)nya perbuatan yang tidak baik. Sebab itu janganlah kamu memohon kepada-Ku sesuatu yang kamu tidak mengetahui (hakekat)nya. Sesungguhnya Aku memperingatkan kepadamu supaya kamu jangan termasuk orang-orang yang tidak berpengetahuan".

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ إِنِّىٓ أَعُوذُ بِكَ أَنْ أَسْـَٔلَكَ مَا لَيْسَ لِى بِهِۦ عِلْمٌۭ ۖ وَإِلَّا تَغْفِرْ لِى وَتَرْحَمْنِىٓ أَكُن مِّنَ ٱلْخَٰسِرِينَ
ayahs.sahih: [Noah] said, "My Lord, I seek refuge in You from asking that of which I have no knowledge. And unless You forgive me and have mercy upon me, I will be among the losers."
ayahs.clear: He said, “O My Lord, I seek refuge with You, from asking You about what I have no knowledge of. Unless You forgive me, and have mercy on me, I will be one of the losers.”
ayahs.kemenag: Nuh berkata: Ya Tuhanku, sesungguhnya aku berlindung kepada Engkau dari memohon kepada Engkau sesuatu yang aku tiada mengetahui (hakekat)nya. Dan sekiranya Engkau tidak memberi ampun kepadaku, dan (tidak) menaruh belas kasihan kepadaku, niscaya aku akan termasuk orang-orang yang merugi".

ayahs.arabic: قِيلَ يَٰنُوحُ ٱهْبِطْ بِسَلَٰمٍۢ مِّنَّا وَبَرَكَٰتٍ عَلَيْكَ وَعَلَىٰٓ أُمَمٍۢ مِّمَّن مَّعَكَ ۚ وَأُمَمٌۭ سَنُمَتِّعُهُمْ ثُمَّ يَمَسُّهُم مِّنَّا عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌۭ
ayahs.sahih: It was said, "O Noah, disembark in security from Us and blessings upon you and upon nations [descending] from those with you. But other nations [of them] We will grant enjoyment; then there will touch them from Us a painful punishment."
ayahs.clear: It was said, “O Noah, disembark with peace from Us; and with blessings upon you, and upon communities from those with you. And other communities We will grant prosperity, and then a painful torment from Us will befall them.”
ayahs.kemenag: Difirmankan: "Hai Nuh, turunlah dengan selamat sejahtera dan penuh keberkatan dari Kami atasmu dan atas umat-umat (yang mukmin) dari orang-orang yang bersamamu. Dan ada (pula) umat-umat yang Kami beri kesenangan pada mereka (dalam kehidupan dunia), kemudian mereka akan ditimpa azab yang pedih dari Kami".

ayahs.arabic: تِلْكَ مِنْ أَنۢبَآءِ ٱلْغَيْبِ نُوحِيهَآ إِلَيْكَ ۖ مَا كُنتَ تَعْلَمُهَآ أَنتَ وَلَا قَوْمُكَ مِن قَبْلِ هَٰذَا ۖ فَٱصْبِرْ ۖ إِنَّ ٱلْعَٰقِبَةَ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ
ayahs.sahih: That is from the news of the unseen which We reveal to you, [O Muhammad]. You knew it not, neither you nor your people, before this. So be patient; indeed, the [best] outcome is for the righteous.
ayahs.clear: These are some stories from the past that we reveal to you. Neither you, nor your people knew them before this. So be patient. The future belongs to the pious.
ayahs.kemenag: Itu adalah di antara berita-berita penting tentang yang ghaib yang Kami wahyukan kepadamu (Muhammad); tidak pernah kamu mengetahuinya dan tidak (pula) kaummu sebelum ini. Maka bersabarlah; sesungguhnya kesudahan yang baik adalah bagi orang-orang yang bertakwa.

ayahs.arabic: وَإِلَىٰ عَادٍ أَخَاهُمْ هُودًۭا ۚ قَالَ يَٰقَوْمِ ٱعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ مَا لَكُم مِّنْ إِلَٰهٍ غَيْرُهُۥٓ ۖ إِنْ أَنتُمْ إِلَّا مُفْتَرُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And to 'Aad [We sent] their brother Hud. He said, "O my people, worship Allah; you have no deity other than Him. You are not but inventors [of falsehood].
ayahs.clear: And to Aad, their brother Hud. He said, “O my people, worship God, you have no other god besides Him. You do nothing but invent lies.”
ayahs.kemenag: Dan kepada kaum 'Ad (Kami utus) saudara mereka, Huud. Ia berkata: "Hai kaumku, sembahlah Allah, sekali-kali tidak ada bagimu Tuhan selain Dia. Kamu hanyalah mengada-adakan saja.

ayahs.arabic: يَٰقَوْمِ لَآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ أَجْرًا ۖ إِنْ أَجْرِىَ إِلَّا عَلَى ٱلَّذِى فَطَرَنِىٓ ۚ أَفَلَا تَعْقِلُونَ
ayahs.sahih: O my people, I do not ask you for it any reward. My reward is only from the one who created me. Then will you not reason?
ayahs.clear: “O my people, I ask you no wage for it; my wage lies with Him who originated me. Do you not understand?”
ayahs.kemenag: Hai kaumku, aku tidak meminta upah kepadamu bagi seruanku ini. Upahku tidak lain hanyalah dari Allah yang telah menciptakanku. Maka tidakkah kamu memikirkan(nya)?"

ayahs.arabic: وَيَٰقَوْمِ ٱسْتَغْفِرُوا۟ رَبَّكُمْ ثُمَّ تُوبُوٓا۟ إِلَيْهِ يُرْسِلِ ٱلسَّمَآءَ عَلَيْكُم مِّدْرَارًۭا وَيَزِدْكُمْ قُوَّةً إِلَىٰ قُوَّتِكُمْ وَلَا تَتَوَلَّوْا۟ مُجْرِمِينَ
ayahs.sahih: And O my people, ask forgiveness of your Lord and then repent to Him. He will send [rain from] the sky upon you in showers and increase you in strength [added] to your strength. And do not turn away, [being] criminals."
ayahs.clear: “O my people, ask forgiveness from your Lord, and repent to Him. He will release the sky pouring down upon you, and will add strength to your strength. And do not turn away and be wicked.”
ayahs.kemenag: Dan (dia berkata): "Hai kaumku, mohonlah ampun kepada Tuhanmu lalu bertobatlah kepada-Nya, niscaya Dia menurunkan hujan yang sangat deras atasmu, dan Dia akan menambahkan kekuatan kepada kekuatanmu, dan janganlah kamu berpaling dengan berbuat dosa".

ayahs.arabic: قَالُوا۟ يَٰهُودُ مَا جِئْتَنَا بِبَيِّنَةٍۢ وَمَا نَحْنُ بِتَارِكِىٓ ءَالِهَتِنَا عَن قَوْلِكَ وَمَا نَحْنُ لَكَ بِمُؤْمِنِينَ
ayahs.sahih: They said, "O Hud, you have not brought us clear evidence, and we are not ones to leave our gods on your say-so. Nor are we believers in you.
ayahs.clear: They said, “O Hud, you did not bring us any evidence, and we are not about to abandon our gods at your word, and we are not believers in you.”
ayahs.kemenag: Kaum 'Ad berkata: "Hai Huud, kamu tidak mendatangkan kepada kami suatu bukti yang nyata, dan kami sekali-kali tidak akan meninggalkan sembahan-sembahan kami karena perkataanmu, dan kami sekali-kali tidak akan mempercayai kamu.

ayahs.arabic: إِن نَّقُولُ إِلَّا ٱعْتَرَىٰكَ بَعْضُ ءَالِهَتِنَا بِسُوٓءٍۢ ۗ قَالَ إِنِّىٓ أُشْهِدُ ٱللَّهَ وَٱشْهَدُوٓا۟ أَنِّى بَرِىٓءٌۭ مِّمَّا تُشْرِكُونَ
ayahs.sahih: We only say that some of our gods have possessed you with evil." He said, "Indeed, I call Allah to witness, and witness [yourselves] that I am free from whatever you associate with Allah
ayahs.clear: “We only say that some of our gods have possessed you with evil.” He said, “I call God to witness, and you to witness, that I am innocent of what you associate.
ayahs.kemenag: Kami tidak mengatakan melainkan bahwa sebagian sembahan kami telah menimpakan penyakit gila atas dirimu". Huud menjawab: "Sesungguhnya aku bersaksi kepada Allah dan saksikanlah olehmu sekalian bahwa sesungguhnya aku berlepas diri dari apa yang kamu persekutukan,

ayahs.arabic: مِن دُونِهِۦ ۖ فَكِيدُونِى جَمِيعًۭا ثُمَّ لَا تُنظِرُونِ
ayahs.sahih: Other than Him. So plot against me all together; then do not give me respite.
ayahs.clear: Besides Him. So scheme against me, all of you, and do not hesitate.
ayahs.kemenag: dari selain-Nya, sebab itu jalankanlah tipu dayamu semuanya terhadapku dan janganlah kamu memberi tangguh kepadaku.

ayahs.arabic: إِنِّى تَوَكَّلْتُ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ رَبِّى وَرَبِّكُم ۚ مَّا مِن دَآبَّةٍ إِلَّا هُوَ ءَاخِذٌۢ بِنَاصِيَتِهَآ ۚ إِنَّ رَبِّى عَلَىٰ صِرَٰطٍۢ مُّسْتَقِيمٍۢ
ayahs.sahih: Indeed, I have relied upon Allah, my Lord and your Lord. There is no creature but that He holds its forelock. Indeed, my Lord is on a path [that is] straight."
ayahs.clear: I have placed my trust in God, my Lord and your Lord. There is not a creature but He holds it by the forelock. My Lord is on a straight path.
ayahs.kemenag: Sesungguhnya aku bertawakkal kepada Allah Tuhanku dan Tuhanmu. Tidak ada suatu binatang melatapun melainkan Dialah yang memegang ubun-ubunnya. Sesungguhnya Tuhanku di atas jalan yang lurus".

ayahs.arabic: فَإِن تَوَلَّوْا۟ فَقَدْ أَبْلَغْتُكُم مَّآ أُرْسِلْتُ بِهِۦٓ إِلَيْكُمْ ۚ وَيَسْتَخْلِفُ رَبِّى قَوْمًا غَيْرَكُمْ وَلَا تَضُرُّونَهُۥ شَيْـًٔا ۚ إِنَّ رَبِّى عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ حَفِيظٌۭ
ayahs.sahih: But if they turn away, [say], "I have already conveyed that with which I was sent to you. My Lord will give succession to a people other than you, and you will not harm Him at all. Indeed my Lord is, over all things, Guardian."
ayahs.clear: If you turn away, I have conveyed to you what I was sent to you with; and my Lord will replace you with another people, and you will not cause Him any harm. My Lord is Guardian over all things.”
ayahs.kemenag: Jika kamu berpaling, maka sesungguhnya aku telah menyampaikan kepadamu apa (amanat) yang aku diutus (untuk menyampaikan)nya kepadamu. Dan Tuhanku akan mengganti (kamu) dengan kaum yang lain (dari) kamu; dan kamu tidak dapat membuat mudharat kepada-Nya sedikitpun. Sesungguhnya Tuhanku adalah Maha Pemelihara segala sesuatu.

ayahs.arabic: وَلَمَّا جَآءَ أَمْرُنَا نَجَّيْنَا هُودًۭا وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مَعَهُۥ بِرَحْمَةٍۢ مِّنَّا وَنَجَّيْنَٰهُم مِّنْ عَذَابٍ غَلِيظٍۢ
ayahs.sahih: And when Our command came, We saved Hud and those who believed with him, by mercy from Us; and We saved them from a harsh punishment.
ayahs.clear: And when Our decree came, We saved Hud and those who believed with him, by a mercy from Us, and We delivered them from a harsh punishment.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan tatkala datang azab Kami, Kami selamatkan Huud dan orang-orang yang beriman bersama dia dengan rahmat dari Kami; dan Kami selamatkan (pula) mereka (di akhirat) dari azab yang berat.

ayahs.arabic: وَتِلْكَ عَادٌۭ ۖ جَحَدُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِ رَبِّهِمْ وَعَصَوْا۟ رُسُلَهُۥ وَٱتَّبَعُوٓا۟ أَمْرَ كُلِّ جَبَّارٍ عَنِيدٍۢ
ayahs.sahih: And that was 'Aad, who rejected the signs of their Lord and disobeyed His messengers and followed the order of every obstinate tyrant.
ayahs.clear: That was Aad; they denied the signs of their Lord, and defied His messengers, and followed the lead of every stubborn tyrant.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan itulah (kisah) kaum 'Ad yang mengingkari tanda-tanda kekuasaan Tuhan mereka, dan mendurhakai rasul-rasul Allah dan mereka menuruti perintah semua penguasa yang sewenang-wenang lagi menentang (kebenaran).

ayahs.arabic: وَأُتْبِعُوا۟ فِى هَٰذِهِ ٱلدُّنْيَا لَعْنَةًۭ وَيَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ ۗ أَلَآ إِنَّ عَادًۭا كَفَرُوا۟ رَبَّهُمْ ۗ أَلَا بُعْدًۭا لِّعَادٍۢ قَوْمِ هُودٍۢ
ayahs.sahih: And they were [therefore] followed in this world with a curse and [as well] on the Day of Resurrection. Unquestionably, 'Aad denied their Lord; then away with 'Aad, the people of Hud.
ayahs.clear: And they were pursued by a curse in this world, and on the Day of Resurrection. Indeed, Aad blasphemed against their Lord—so away with Aad, the people of Hud.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan mereka selalu diikuti dengan kutukan di dunia ini dan (begitu pula) di hari kiamat. Ingatlah, sesungguhnya kaum 'Ad itu kafir kepada Tuhan mereka. Ingatlah kebinasaanlah bagi kaum 'Ad (yaitu) kaum Huud itu.

ayahs.arabic: ۞ وَإِلَىٰ ثَمُودَ أَخَاهُمْ صَٰلِحًۭا ۚ قَالَ يَٰقَوْمِ ٱعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ مَا لَكُم مِّنْ إِلَٰهٍ غَيْرُهُۥ ۖ هُوَ أَنشَأَكُم مِّنَ ٱلْأَرْضِ وَٱسْتَعْمَرَكُمْ فِيهَا فَٱسْتَغْفِرُوهُ ثُمَّ تُوبُوٓا۟ إِلَيْهِ ۚ إِنَّ رَبِّى قَرِيبٌۭ مُّجِيبٌۭ
ayahs.sahih: And to Thamud [We sent] their brother Salih. He said, "O my people, worship Allah; you have no deity other than Him. He has produced you from the earth and settled you in it, so ask forgiveness of Him and then repent to Him. Indeed, my Lord is near and responsive."
ayahs.clear: And to Thamood, their brother Saleh. He said, “O my people, worship God, you have no god other than Him. He initiated you from the earth, and settled you in it. So seek His forgiveness, and repent to Him. My Lord is Near and Responsive.”
ayahs.kemenag: Dan kepada Tsamud (Kami utus) saudara mereka Shaleh. Shaleh berkata: "Hai kaumku, sembahlah Allah, sekali-kali tidak ada bagimu Tuhan selain Dia. Dia telah menciptakan kamu dari bumi (tanah) dan menjadikan kamu pemakmurnya, karena itu mohonlah ampunan-Nya, kemudian bertobatlah kepada-Nya, Sesungguhnya Tuhanku amat dekat (rahmat-Nya) lagi memperkenankan (doa hamba-Nya)".

ayahs.arabic: قَالُوا۟ يَٰصَٰلِحُ قَدْ كُنتَ فِينَا مَرْجُوًّۭا قَبْلَ هَٰذَآ ۖ أَتَنْهَىٰنَآ أَن نَّعْبُدَ مَا يَعْبُدُ ءَابَآؤُنَا وَإِنَّنَا لَفِى شَكٍّۢ مِّمَّا تَدْعُونَآ إِلَيْهِ مُرِيبٍۢ
ayahs.sahih: They said, "O Salih, you were among us a man of promise before this. Do you forbid us to worship what our fathers worshipped? And indeed we are, about that to which you invite us, in disquieting doubt."
ayahs.clear: They said, “O Saleh, we had hopes in you before this. Are you trying to prevent us from worshiping what our parents worship? We are in serious doubt regarding what you are calling us to.”
ayahs.kemenag: Kaum Tsamud berkata: "Hai Shaleh, sesungguhnya kamu sebelum ini adalah seorang di antara kami yang kami harapkan, apakah kamu melarang kami untuk menyembah apa yang disembah oleh bapak-bapak kami? dan sesungguhnya kami betul-betul dalam keraguan yang menggelisahkan terhadap agama yang kamu serukan kepada kami".

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ يَٰقَوْمِ أَرَءَيْتُمْ إِن كُنتُ عَلَىٰ بَيِّنَةٍۢ مِّن رَّبِّى وَءَاتَىٰنِى مِنْهُ رَحْمَةًۭ فَمَن يَنصُرُنِى مِنَ ٱللَّهِ إِنْ عَصَيْتُهُۥ ۖ فَمَا تَزِيدُونَنِى غَيْرَ تَخْسِيرٍۢ
ayahs.sahih: He said, "O my people, have you considered: if I should be upon clear evidence from my Lord and He has given me mercy from Himself, who would protect me from Allah if I disobeyed Him? So you would not increase me except in loss.
ayahs.clear: He said, “O my people, have you considered? If I stand upon clear evidence from my Lord, and He has given me mercy from Him, who would protect me from God, if I disobeyed Him? You add nothing for me except loss.”
ayahs.kemenag: Shaleh berkata: "Hai kaumku, bagaimana pikiranmu jika aku mempunyai bukti yang nyata dari Tuhanku dan diberi-Nya aku rahmat (kenabian) dari-Nya, maka siapakah yang akan menolong aku dari (azab) Allah jika aku mendurhakai-Nya. Sebab itu kamu tidak menambah apapun kepadaku selain daripada kerugian.

ayahs.arabic: وَيَٰقَوْمِ هَٰذِهِۦ نَاقَةُ ٱللَّهِ لَكُمْ ءَايَةًۭ فَذَرُوهَا تَأْكُلْ فِىٓ أَرْضِ ٱللَّهِ وَلَا تَمَسُّوهَا بِسُوٓءٍۢ فَيَأْخُذَكُمْ عَذَابٌۭ قَرِيبٌۭ
ayahs.sahih: And O my people, this is the she-camel of Allah - [she is] to you a sign. So let her feed upon Allah 's earth and do not touch her with harm, or you will be taken by an impending punishment."
ayahs.clear: “O my people, this is the she-camel of God, a sign for you. Let her graze on God’s land, and do not harm her, lest an imminent punishment overtakes you.”
ayahs.kemenag: Hai kaumku, inilah unta betina dari Allah, sebagai mukjizat (yang menunjukkan kebenaran) untukmu, sebab itu biarkanlah dia makan di bumi Allah, dan janganlah kamu mengganggunya dengan gangguan apapun yang akan menyebabkan kamu ditimpa azab yang dekat".

ayahs.arabic: فَعَقَرُوهَا فَقَالَ تَمَتَّعُوا۟ فِى دَارِكُمْ ثَلَٰثَةَ أَيَّامٍۢ ۖ ذَٰلِكَ وَعْدٌ غَيْرُ مَكْذُوبٍۢ
ayahs.sahih: But they hamstrung her, so he said, "Enjoy yourselves in your homes for three days. That is a promise not to be denied."
ayahs.clear: But they hamstrung her, and so He said, “Enjoy yourselves in your homes for three days. This is a prophecy that is infallible.”
ayahs.kemenag: Mereka membunuh unta itu, maka berkata Shaleh: "Bersukarialah kamu sekalian di rumahmu selama tiga hari, itu adalah janji yang tidak dapat didustakan".

ayahs.arabic: فَلَمَّا جَآءَ أَمْرُنَا نَجَّيْنَا صَٰلِحًۭا وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مَعَهُۥ بِرَحْمَةٍۢ مِّنَّا وَمِنْ خِزْىِ يَوْمِئِذٍ ۗ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ ٱلْقَوِىُّ ٱلْعَزِيزُ
ayahs.sahih: So when Our command came, We saved Salih and those who believed with him, by mercy from Us, and [saved them] from the disgrace of that day. Indeed, it is your Lord who is the Powerful, the Exalted in Might.
ayahs.clear: Then, when Our command came, We saved Saleh and those who believed with him, by a mercy from Us, from the disgrace of that day. Your Lord is the Strong, the Mighty.
ayahs.kemenag: Maka tatkala datang azab Kami, Kami selamatkan Shaleh beserta orang-orang yang beriman bersama dia dengan rahmat dari Kami dan dari kehinaan di hari itu. Sesungguhnya Tuhanmu Dia-Lah yang Maha Kuat lagi Maha Perkasa.

ayahs.arabic: وَأَخَذَ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ ٱلصَّيْحَةُ فَأَصْبَحُوا۟ فِى دِيَٰرِهِمْ جَٰثِمِينَ
ayahs.sahih: And the shriek seized those who had wronged, and they became within their homes [corpses] fallen prone
ayahs.clear: And the Scream struck those who transgressed, and they became motionless bodies in their homes.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan satu suara keras yang mengguntur menimpa orang-orang yang zalim itu, lalu mereka mati bergelimpangan di rumahnya,

ayahs.arabic: كَأَن لَّمْ يَغْنَوْا۟ فِيهَآ ۗ أَلَآ إِنَّ ثَمُودَا۟ كَفَرُوا۟ رَبَّهُمْ ۗ أَلَا بُعْدًۭا لِّثَمُودَ
ayahs.sahih: As if they had never prospered therein. Unquestionably, Thamud denied their Lord; then, away with Thamud.
ayahs.clear: As if they had never prospered therein. Indeed, Thamood rejected their Lord, so away with Thamood.
ayahs.kemenag: seolah-olah mereka belum pernah berdiam di tempat itu. Ingatlah, sesungguhnya kaum Tsamud mengingkari Tuhan mereka. Ingatlah, kebinasaanlah bagi kaum Tsamud.

ayahs.arabic: وَلَقَدْ جَآءَتْ رُسُلُنَآ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ بِٱلْبُشْرَىٰ قَالُوا۟ سَلَٰمًۭا ۖ قَالَ سَلَٰمٌۭ ۖ فَمَا لَبِثَ أَن جَآءَ بِعِجْلٍ حَنِيذٍۢ
ayahs.sahih: And certainly did Our messengers come to Abraham with good tidings; they said, "Peace." He said, "Peace," and did not delay in bringing [them] a roasted calf.
ayahs.clear: Our messengers came to Abraham with good news. They said, “Peace.” He said, “Peace.” Soon after, he came with a roasted calf.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan sesungguhnya utusan-utusan Kami (malaikat-malaikat) telah datang kepada lbrahim dengan membawa kabar gembira, mereka mengucapkan: "Selamat". Ibrahim menjawab: "Selamatlah," maka tidak lama kemudian Ibrahim menyuguhkan daging anak sapi yang dipanggang.

ayahs.arabic: فَلَمَّا رَءَآ أَيْدِيَهُمْ لَا تَصِلُ إِلَيْهِ نَكِرَهُمْ وَأَوْجَسَ مِنْهُمْ خِيفَةًۭ ۚ قَالُوا۟ لَا تَخَفْ إِنَّآ أُرْسِلْنَآ إِلَىٰ قَوْمِ لُوطٍۢ
ayahs.sahih: But when he saw their hands not reaching for it, he distrusted them and felt from them apprehension. They said, "Fear not. We have been sent to the people of Lot."
ayahs.clear: But when he saw their hands not reaching towards it, he became suspicious of them, and conceived a fear of them. They said, “Do not fear, we were sent to the people of Lot.”
ayahs.kemenag: Maka tatkala dilihatnya tangan mereka tidak menjamahnya, Ibrahim memandang aneh perbuatan mereka, dan merasa takut kepada mereka. Malaikat itu berkata: "Jangan kamu takut, sesungguhnya kami adalah (malaikat-ma]aikat) yang diutus kepada kaum Luth".

ayahs.arabic: وَٱمْرَأَتُهُۥ قَآئِمَةٌۭ فَضَحِكَتْ فَبَشَّرْنَٰهَا بِإِسْحَٰقَ وَمِن وَرَآءِ إِسْحَٰقَ يَعْقُوبَ
ayahs.sahih: And his Wife was standing, and she smiled. Then We gave her good tidings of Isaac and after Isaac, Jacob.
ayahs.clear: His wife was standing by, so she laughed. And We gave her good news of Isaac; and after Isaac, Jacob.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan isterinya berdiri (dibalik tirai) lalu dia tersenyum, maka Kami sampaikan kepadanya berita gembira tentang (kelahiran) Ishak dan dari Ishak (akan lahir puteranya) Ya'qub.

ayahs.arabic: قَالَتْ يَٰوَيْلَتَىٰٓ ءَأَلِدُ وَأَنَا۠ عَجُوزٌۭ وَهَٰذَا بَعْلِى شَيْخًا ۖ إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَشَىْءٌ عَجِيبٌۭ
ayahs.sahih: She said, "Woe to me! Shall I give birth while I am an old woman and this, my husband, is an old man? Indeed, this is an amazing thing!"
ayahs.clear: She said, “Alas for me. Shall I give birth, when I am an old woman, and this, my husband, is an old man? This is truly a strange thing.”
ayahs.kemenag: Isterinya berkata: "Sungguh mengherankan, apakah aku akan melahirkan anak padahal aku adalah seorang perempuan tua, dan ini suamikupun dalam keadaan yang sudah tua pula?. Sesungguhnya ini benar-benar suatu yang sangat aneh".

ayahs.arabic: قَالُوٓا۟ أَتَعْجَبِينَ مِنْ أَمْرِ ٱللَّهِ ۖ رَحْمَتُ ٱللَّهِ وَبَرَكَٰتُهُۥ عَلَيْكُمْ أَهْلَ ٱلْبَيْتِ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ حَمِيدٌۭ مَّجِيدٌۭ
ayahs.sahih: They said, "Are you amazed at the decree of Allah? May the mercy of Allah and His blessings be upon you, people of the house. Indeed, He is Praiseworthy and Honorable."
ayahs.clear: They said, “Do you marvel at the decree of God? The mercy and blessings of God are upon you, O people of the house. He is Praiseworthy and Glorious.”
ayahs.kemenag: Para malaikat itu berkata: "Apakah kamu merasa heran tentang ketetapan Allah? (Itu adalah) rahmat Allah dan keberkatan-Nya, dicurahkan atas kamu, hai ahlulbait! Sesungguhnya Allah Maha Terpuji lagi Maha Pemurah".

ayahs.arabic: فَلَمَّا ذَهَبَ عَنْ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ ٱلرَّوْعُ وَجَآءَتْهُ ٱلْبُشْرَىٰ يُجَٰدِلُنَا فِى قَوْمِ لُوطٍ
ayahs.sahih: And when the fright had left Abraham and the good tidings had reached him, he began to argue with Us concerning the people of Lot.
ayahs.clear: When Abraham's fear subsided, and the good news had reached him, he started pleading with Us concerning the people of Lot.
ayahs.kemenag: Maka tatkala rasa takut hilang dari Ibrahim dan berita gembira telah datang kepadanya, diapun bersoal jawab dengan (malaikat-malaikat) Kami tentang kaum Luth.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ لَحَلِيمٌ أَوَّٰهٌۭ مُّنِيبٌۭ
ayahs.sahih: Indeed, Abraham was forbearing, grieving and [frequently] returning [to Allah].
ayahs.clear: Abraham was gentle, kind, penitent.
ayahs.kemenag: Sesungguhnya Ibrahim itu benar-benar seorang yang penyantun lagi penghiba dan suka kembali kepada Allah.

ayahs.arabic: يَٰٓإِبْرَٰهِيمُ أَعْرِضْ عَنْ هَٰذَآ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ قَدْ جَآءَ أَمْرُ رَبِّكَ ۖ وَإِنَّهُمْ ءَاتِيهِمْ عَذَابٌ غَيْرُ مَرْدُودٍۢ
ayahs.sahih: [The angels said], "O Abraham, give up this [plea]. Indeed, the command of your Lord has come, and indeed, there will reach them a punishment that cannot be repelled."
ayahs.clear: “O Abraham, refrain from this. The command of your Lord has come; they have incurred an irreversible punishment.”
ayahs.kemenag: Hai Ibrahim, tinggalkanlah soal jawab ini, sesungguhnya telah datang ketetapan Tuhanmu, dan sesungguhnya mereka itu akan didatangi azab yang tidak dapat ditolak.

ayahs.arabic: وَلَمَّا جَآءَتْ رُسُلُنَا لُوطًۭا سِىٓءَ بِهِمْ وَضَاقَ بِهِمْ ذَرْعًۭا وَقَالَ هَٰذَا يَوْمٌ عَصِيبٌۭ
ayahs.sahih: And when Our messengers, [the angels], came to Lot, he was anguished for them and felt for them great discomfort and said, "This is a trying day."
ayahs.clear: And when Our envoys came to Lot, he was anxious for them, and concerned for them. He said, “This is a dreadful day.”
ayahs.kemenag: Dan tatkala datang utusan-utusan Kami (para malaikat) itu kepada Luth, dia merasa susah dan merasa sempit dadanya karena kedatangan mereka, dan dia berkata: "Ini adalah hari yang amat sulit".

ayahs.arabic: وَجَآءَهُۥ قَوْمُهُۥ يُهْرَعُونَ إِلَيْهِ وَمِن قَبْلُ كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ ٱلسَّيِّـَٔاتِ ۚ قَالَ يَٰقَوْمِ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ بَنَاتِى هُنَّ أَطْهَرُ لَكُمْ ۖ فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَلَا تُخْزُونِ فِى ضَيْفِىٓ ۖ أَلَيْسَ مِنكُمْ رَجُلٌۭ رَّشِيدٌۭ
ayahs.sahih: And his people came hastening to him, and before [this] they had been doing evil deeds. He said, "O my people, these are my daughters; they are purer for you. So fear Allah and do not disgrace me concerning my guests. Is there not among you a man of reason?"
ayahs.clear: And his people came rushing towards him—they were in the habit of committing sins. He said, “O my people, these are my daughters; they are purer for you. So fear God, and do not embarrass me before my guests. Is there not one reasonable man among you?”
ayahs.kemenag: Dan datanglah kepadanya kaumnya dengan bergegas-gegas. Dan sejak dahulu mereka selalu melakukan perbuatan-perbuatan yang keji. Luth berkata: "Hai kaumku, inilah puteri-puteriku, mereka lebih suci bagimu, maka bertakwalah kepada Allah dan janganlah kamu mencemarkan (nama)ku terhadap tamuku ini. Tidak adakah di antaramu seorang yang berakal?"

ayahs.arabic: قَالُوا۟ لَقَدْ عَلِمْتَ مَا لَنَا فِى بَنَاتِكَ مِنْ حَقٍّۢ وَإِنَّكَ لَتَعْلَمُ مَا نُرِيدُ
ayahs.sahih: They said, "You have already known that we have not concerning your daughters any claim, and indeed, you know what we want."
ayahs.clear: They said, “You know well that we have no right to your daughters, and you know well what we want.”
ayahs.kemenag: Mereka menjawab: "Sesungguhnya kamu telah tahu bahwa kami tidak mempunyai keinginan terhadap puteri-puterimu; dan sesungguhnya kamu tentu mengetahui apa yang sebenarnya kami kehendaki".

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ لَوْ أَنَّ لِى بِكُمْ قُوَّةً أَوْ ءَاوِىٓ إِلَىٰ رُكْنٍۢ شَدِيدٍۢ
ayahs.sahih: He said, "If only I had against you some power or could take refuge in a strong support."
ayahs.clear: He said, “If only I had the strength to stop you, or could rely on some strong support.”
ayahs.kemenag: Luth berkata: "Seandainya aku ada mempunyai kekuatan (untuk menolakmu) atau kalau aku dapat berlindung kepada keluarga yang kuat (tentu aku lakukan)".

ayahs.arabic: قَالُوا۟ يَٰلُوطُ إِنَّا رُسُلُ رَبِّكَ لَن يَصِلُوٓا۟ إِلَيْكَ ۖ فَأَسْرِ بِأَهْلِكَ بِقِطْعٍۢ مِّنَ ٱلَّيْلِ وَلَا يَلْتَفِتْ مِنكُمْ أَحَدٌ إِلَّا ٱمْرَأَتَكَ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ مُصِيبُهَا مَآ أَصَابَهُمْ ۚ إِنَّ مَوْعِدَهُمُ ٱلصُّبْحُ ۚ أَلَيْسَ ٱلصُّبْحُ بِقَرِيبٍۢ
ayahs.sahih: The angels said, "O Lot, indeed we are messengers of your Lord; [therefore], they will never reach you. So set out with your family during a portion of the night and let not any among you look back - except your wife; indeed, she will be struck by that which strikes them. Indeed, their appointment is [for] the morning. Is not the morning near?"
ayahs.clear: They said, “O Lot, we are the envoys of your Lord; they will not reach you. So set out with your family during the cover of the night, and let none of you look back, except for your wife. She will be struck by what will strike them. Their appointed time is the morning. Is not the morning near?”
ayahs.kemenag: Para utusan (malaikat) berkata: "Hai Luth, sesungguhnya kami adalah utusan-utusan Tuhanmu, sekali-kali mereka tidak akan dapat mengganggu kamu, sebab itu pergilah dengan membawa keluarga dan pengikut-pengikut kamu di akhir malam dan janganlah ada seorangpun di antara kamu yang tertinggal, kecuali isterimu. Sesungguhnya dia akan ditimpa azab yang menimpa mereka karena sesungguhnya saat jatuhnya azab kepada mereka ialah di waktu subuh; bukankah subuh itu sudah dekat?".

ayahs.arabic: فَلَمَّا جَآءَ أَمْرُنَا جَعَلْنَا عَٰلِيَهَا سَافِلَهَا وَأَمْطَرْنَا عَلَيْهَا حِجَارَةًۭ مِّن سِجِّيلٍۢ مَّنضُودٍۢ
ayahs.sahih: So when Our command came, We made the highest part [of the city] its lowest and rained upon them stones of layered hard clay, [which were]
ayahs.clear: And when Our command came about, We turned it upside down, and We rained down on it stones of baked clay.
ayahs.kemenag: Maka tatkala datang azab Kami, Kami jadikan negeri kaum Luth itu yang di atas ke bawah (Kami balikkan), dan Kami hujani mereka dengan batu dari tanah yang terbakar dengan bertubi-tubi,

ayahs.arabic: مُّسَوَّمَةً عِندَ رَبِّكَ ۖ وَمَا هِىَ مِنَ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ بِبَعِيدٍۢ
ayahs.sahih: Marked from your Lord. And Allah 's punishment is not from the wrongdoers [very] far.
ayahs.clear: Marked from your Lord, and never far from the wrongdoers.
ayahs.kemenag: Yang diberi tanda oleh Tuhanmu, dan siksaan itu tiadalah jauh dari orang-orang yang zalim.

ayahs.arabic: ۞ وَإِلَىٰ مَدْيَنَ أَخَاهُمْ شُعَيْبًۭا ۚ قَالَ يَٰقَوْمِ ٱعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ مَا لَكُم مِّنْ إِلَٰهٍ غَيْرُهُۥ ۖ وَلَا تَنقُصُوا۟ ٱلْمِكْيَالَ وَٱلْمِيزَانَ ۚ إِنِّىٓ أَرَىٰكُم بِخَيْرٍۢ وَإِنِّىٓ أَخَافُ عَلَيْكُمْ عَذَابَ يَوْمٍۢ مُّحِيطٍۢ
ayahs.sahih: And to Madyan [We sent] their brother Shu'ayb. He said, "O my people, worship Allah; you have no deity other than Him. And do not decrease from the measure and the scale. Indeed, I see you in prosperity, but indeed, I fear for you the punishment of an all-encompassing Day.
ayahs.clear: And to Median, their brother Shuaib. He said, “O my people, worship God; you have no god other than Him. And do not short measure or short weight. I see you in good circumstances, but I fear for you the agony of an encompassing Day.”
ayahs.kemenag: Dan kepada (penduduk) Mad-yan (Kami utus) saudara mereka, Syu'aib. Ia berkata: "Hai kaumku, sembahlah Allah, sekali-kali tiada Tuhan bagimu selain Dia. Dan janganlah kamu kurangi takaran dan timbangan, sesungguhnya aku melihat kamu dalam keadaan yang baik (mampu) dan sesungguhnya aku khawatir terhadapmu akan azab hari yang membinasakan (kiamat)".

ayahs.arabic: وَيَٰقَوْمِ أَوْفُوا۟ ٱلْمِكْيَالَ وَٱلْمِيزَانَ بِٱلْقِسْطِ ۖ وَلَا تَبْخَسُوا۟ ٱلنَّاسَ أَشْيَآءَهُمْ وَلَا تَعْثَوْا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ مُفْسِدِينَ
ayahs.sahih: And O my people, give full measure and weight in justice and do not deprive the people of their due and do not commit abuse on the earth, spreading corruption.
ayahs.clear: “O my people! Give full measure and full weight, in all fairness, and do not cheat the people out of their rights, and do not spread corruption in the land.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan Syu'aib berkata: "Hai kaumku, cukupkanlah takaran dan timbangan dengan adil, dan janganlah kamu merugikan manusia terhadap hak-hak mereka dan janganlah kamu membuat kejahatan di muka bumi dengan membuat kerusakan.

ayahs.arabic: بَقِيَّتُ ٱللَّهِ خَيْرٌۭ لَّكُمْ إِن كُنتُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ ۚ وَمَآ أَنَا۠ عَلَيْكُم بِحَفِيظٍۢ
ayahs.sahih: What remains [lawful] from Allah is best for you, if you would be believers. But I am not a guardian over you."
ayahs.clear: What is left by God is best for you, if you are believers. And I am not a guardian over you.”
ayahs.kemenag: Sisa (keuntungan) dari Allah adalah lebih baik bagimu jika kamu orang-orang yang beriman. Dan aku bukanlah seorang penjaga atas dirimu"

ayahs.arabic: قَالُوا۟ يَٰشُعَيْبُ أَصَلَوٰتُكَ تَأْمُرُكَ أَن نَّتْرُكَ مَا يَعْبُدُ ءَابَآؤُنَآ أَوْ أَن نَّفْعَلَ فِىٓ أَمْوَٰلِنَا مَا نَشَٰٓؤُا۟ ۖ إِنَّكَ لَأَنتَ ٱلْحَلِيمُ ٱلرَّشِيدُ
ayahs.sahih: They said, "O Shu'ayb, does your prayer command you that we should leave what our fathers worship or not do with our wealth what we please? Indeed, you are the forbearing, the discerning!"
ayahs.clear: They said, “O Shuaib, does your prayer command you that we abandon what our ancestors worshiped, or doing with our wealth what we want? You are the one who is intelligent and wise.”
ayahs.kemenag: Mereka berkata: "Hai Syu'aib, apakah sembahyangmu menyuruh kamu agar kami meninggalkan apa yang disembah oleh bapak-bapak kami atau melarang kami memperbuat apa yang kami kehendaki tentang harta kami. Sesungguhnya kamu adalah orang yang sangat penyantun lagi berakal".

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ يَٰقَوْمِ أَرَءَيْتُمْ إِن كُنتُ عَلَىٰ بَيِّنَةٍۢ مِّن رَّبِّى وَرَزَقَنِى مِنْهُ رِزْقًا حَسَنًۭا ۚ وَمَآ أُرِيدُ أَنْ أُخَالِفَكُمْ إِلَىٰ مَآ أَنْهَىٰكُمْ عَنْهُ ۚ إِنْ أُرِيدُ إِلَّا ٱلْإِصْلَٰحَ مَا ٱسْتَطَعْتُ ۚ وَمَا تَوْفِيقِىٓ إِلَّا بِٱللَّهِ ۚ عَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ وَإِلَيْهِ أُنِيبُ
ayahs.sahih: He said, "O my people, have you considered: if I am upon clear evidence from my Lord and He has provided me with a good provision from Him...? And I do not intend to differ from you in that which I have forbidden you; I only intend reform as much as I am able. And my success is not but through Allah. Upon him I have relied, and to Him I return.
ayahs.clear: He said, “O my people, have you considered? What if I have clear evidence from my Lord, and He has given me good livelihood from Himself? I have no desire to do what I forbid you from doing. I desire nothing but reform, as far as I can. My success lies only with God. In Him I trust, and to Him I turn.”
ayahs.kemenag: Syu'aib berkata: "Hai kaumku, bagaimana pikiranmu jika aku mempunyai bukti yang nyata dari Tuhanku dan dianugerahi-Nya aku dari pada-Nya rezeki yang baik (patutkah aku menyalahi perintah-Nya)? Dan aku tidak berkehendak menyalahi kamu (dengan mengerjakan) apa yang aku larang. Aku tidak bermaksud kecuali (mendatangkan) perbaikan selama aku masih berkesanggupan. Dan tidak ada taufik bagiku melainkan dengan (pertolongan) Allah. Hanya kepada Allah aku bertawakkal dan hanya kepada-Nya-lah aku kembali.

ayahs.arabic: وَيَٰقَوْمِ لَا يَجْرِمَنَّكُمْ شِقَاقِىٓ أَن يُصِيبَكُم مِّثْلُ مَآ أَصَابَ قَوْمَ نُوحٍ أَوْ قَوْمَ هُودٍ أَوْ قَوْمَ صَٰلِحٍۢ ۚ وَمَا قَوْمُ لُوطٍۢ مِّنكُم بِبَعِيدٍۢ
ayahs.sahih: And O my people, let not [your] dissension from me cause you to be struck by that similar to what struck the people of Noah or the people of Hud or the people of Salih. And the people of Lot are not from you far away.
ayahs.clear: “O my people, let not your hostility towards me cause you to suffer what was suffered by the people of Noah, or the people of Hud, or the people of Saleh. The people of Lot are not far away from you.”
ayahs.kemenag: Hai kaumku, janganlah hendaknya pertentangan antara aku (dengan kamu) menyebabkan kamu menjadi jahat hingga kamu ditimpa azab seperti yang menimpa kaum Nuh atau kaum Hud atau kaum Shaleh, sedang kaum Luth tidak (pula) jauh (tempatnya) dari kamu.

ayahs.arabic: وَٱسْتَغْفِرُوا۟ رَبَّكُمْ ثُمَّ تُوبُوٓا۟ إِلَيْهِ ۚ إِنَّ رَبِّى رَحِيمٌۭ وَدُودٌۭ
ayahs.sahih: And ask forgiveness of your Lord and then repent to Him. Indeed, my Lord is Merciful and Affectionate."
ayahs.clear: “And ask your Lord for forgiveness, and repent to Him. My Lord is Merciful and Loving.”
ayahs.kemenag: Dan mohonlah ampun kepada Tuhanmu kemudian bertaubatlah kepada-Nya. Sesungguhnya Tuhanku Maha Penyayang lagi Maha Pengasih.

ayahs.arabic: قَالُوا۟ يَٰشُعَيْبُ مَا نَفْقَهُ كَثِيرًۭا مِّمَّا تَقُولُ وَإِنَّا لَنَرَىٰكَ فِينَا ضَعِيفًۭا ۖ وَلَوْلَا رَهْطُكَ لَرَجَمْنَٰكَ ۖ وَمَآ أَنتَ عَلَيْنَا بِعَزِيزٍۢ
ayahs.sahih: They said, "O Shu'ayb, we do not understand much of what you say, and indeed, we consider you among us as weak. And if not for your family, we would have stoned you [to death]; and you are not to us one respected."
ayahs.clear: They said, “O Shuaib, we do not understand much of what you say, and we see that you are weak among us. Were it not for your tribe, we would have stoned you. You are of no value to us.”
ayahs.kemenag: Mereka berkata: "Hai Syu'aib, kami tidak banyak mengerti tentang apa yang kamu katakan itu dan sesungguhnya kami benar-benar melihat kamu seorang yang lemah di antara kami; kalau tidaklah karena keluargamu tentulah kami telah merajam kamu, sedang kamupun bukanlah seorang yang berwibawa di sisi kami".

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ يَٰقَوْمِ أَرَهْطِىٓ أَعَزُّ عَلَيْكُم مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ وَٱتَّخَذْتُمُوهُ وَرَآءَكُمْ ظِهْرِيًّا ۖ إِنَّ رَبِّى بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ مُحِيطٌۭ
ayahs.sahih: He said, "O my people, is my family more respected for power by you than Allah? But you put Him behind your backs [in neglect]. Indeed, my Lord is encompassing of what you do.
ayahs.clear: He said, “O my people, is my tribe more important to you than God? And you have turned your backs on Him? My Lord comprehends everything you do.”
ayahs.kemenag: Syu'aib menjawab: "Hai kaumku, apakah keluargaku lebih terhormat menurut pandanganmu daripada Allah, sedang Allah kamu jadikan sesuatu yang terbuang di belakangmu?. Sesungguhnya (pengetahuan) Tuhanku meliputi apa yang kamu kerjakan".

ayahs.arabic: وَيَٰقَوْمِ ٱعْمَلُوا۟ عَلَىٰ مَكَانَتِكُمْ إِنِّى عَٰمِلٌۭ ۖ سَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ مَن يَأْتِيهِ عَذَابٌۭ يُخْزِيهِ وَمَنْ هُوَ كَٰذِبٌۭ ۖ وَٱرْتَقِبُوٓا۟ إِنِّى مَعَكُمْ رَقِيبٌۭ
ayahs.sahih: And O my people, work according to your position; indeed, I am working. You are going to know to whom will come a punishment that will disgrace him and who is a liar. So watch; indeed, I am with you a watcher, [awaiting the outcome]."
ayahs.clear: “O my people, do as you may, and so will I. You will know to whom will come a punishment that will shame him, and who is a liar. So look out; I am on the lookout with you.”
ayahs.kemenag: Dan (dia berkata): "Hai kaumku, berbuatlah menurut kemampuanmu, sesungguhnya akupun berbuat (pula). Kelak kamu akan mengetahui siapa yang akan ditimpa azab yang menghinakannya dan siapa yang berdusta. Dan tunggulah azab (Tuhan), sesungguhnya akupun menunggu bersama kamu".

ayahs.arabic: وَلَمَّا جَآءَ أَمْرُنَا نَجَّيْنَا شُعَيْبًۭا وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مَعَهُۥ بِرَحْمَةٍۢ مِّنَّا وَأَخَذَتِ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ ٱلصَّيْحَةُ فَأَصْبَحُوا۟ فِى دِيَٰرِهِمْ جَٰثِمِينَ
ayahs.sahih: And when Our command came, We saved Shu'ayb and those who believed with him, by mercy from Us. And the shriek seized those who had wronged, and they became within their homes [corpses] fallen prone
ayahs.clear: And when Our command came, We saved Shuaib and those who believed with him, by mercy from Us, and the Blast struck the wrongdoers, and they became motionless bodies in their homes.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan tatkala datang azab Kami, Kami selamatkan Syu'aib dan orang-orang yang beriman bersama-sama dengan dia dengan rahmat dari Kami, dan orang-orang yang zalim dibinasakan oleh satu suara yang mengguntur, lalu jadilah mereka mati bergelimpangan di rumahnya.

ayahs.arabic: كَأَن لَّمْ يَغْنَوْا۟ فِيهَآ ۗ أَلَا بُعْدًۭا لِّمَدْيَنَ كَمَا بَعِدَتْ ثَمُودُ
ayahs.sahih: As if they had never prospered therein. Then, away with Madyan as Thamud was taken away.
ayahs.clear: As though they never flourished therein. Away with Median, as was done away with Thamood.
ayahs.kemenag: Seolah-olah mereka belum pernah berdiam di tempat itu. Ingatlah, kebinasaanlah bagi penduduk Mad-yan sebagaimana kaum Tsamud telah binasa.

ayahs.arabic: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا مُوسَىٰ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا وَسُلْطَٰنٍۢ مُّبِينٍ
ayahs.sahih: And We did certainly send Moses with Our signs and a clear authority
ayahs.clear: And We sent Moses with Our signs and a clear mandate.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan sesungguhnya Kami telah mengutus Musa dengan tanda-tanda (kekuasaan) Kami dan mukjizat yang nyata,

ayahs.arabic: إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ وَمَلَإِي۟هِۦ فَٱتَّبَعُوٓا۟ أَمْرَ فِرْعَوْنَ ۖ وَمَآ أَمْرُ فِرْعَوْنَ بِرَشِيدٍۢ
ayahs.sahih: To Pharaoh and his establishment, but they followed the command of Pharaoh, and the command of Pharaoh was not [at all] discerning.
ayahs.clear: To Pharaoh and his nobles, but they followed the command of Pharaoh, and the command of Pharaoh was not wise.
ayahs.kemenag: kepada Fir'aun dan pemimpin-pemimpin kaumnya, tetapi mereka mengikut perintah Fir'aun, padahal perintah Fir'aun sekali-kali bukanlah (perintah) yang benar.

ayahs.arabic: يَقْدُمُ قَوْمَهُۥ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ فَأَوْرَدَهُمُ ٱلنَّارَ ۖ وَبِئْسَ ٱلْوِرْدُ ٱلْمَوْرُودُ
ayahs.sahih: He will precede his people on the Day of Resurrection and lead them into the Fire; and wretched is the place to which they are led.
ayahs.clear: He will precede his people on the Day of Resurrection, and will lead them into the Fire. Miserable is the place he placed them in.
ayahs.kemenag: Ia berjalan di muka kaumnya di hari kiamat lalu memasukkan mereka ke dalam neraka. Neraka itu seburuk-buruk tempat yang didatangi.

ayahs.arabic: وَأُتْبِعُوا۟ فِى هَٰذِهِۦ لَعْنَةًۭ وَيَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ ۚ بِئْسَ ٱلرِّفْدُ ٱلْمَرْفُودُ
ayahs.sahih: And they were followed in this [world] with a curse and on the Day of Resurrection. And wretched is the gift which is given.
ayahs.clear: They were followed by a curse in this, and on the Day of Resurrection. Miserable is the path they followed.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan mereka selalu diikuti dengan kutukan di dunia ini dan (begitu pula) di hari kiamat. La'nat itu seburuk-buruk pemberian yang diberikan.

ayahs.arabic: ذَٰلِكَ مِنْ أَنۢبَآءِ ٱلْقُرَىٰ نَقُصُّهُۥ عَلَيْكَ ۖ مِنْهَا قَآئِمٌۭ وَحَصِيدٌۭ
ayahs.sahih: That is from the news of the cities, which We relate to you; of them, some are [still] standing and some are [as] a harvest [mowed down].
ayahs.clear: These are of the reports of the towns—We relate them to you. Some are still standing, and some have withered away.
ayahs.kemenag: Itu adalah sebahagian dan berita-berita negeri (yang telah dibinasakan) yang Kami ceritakan kepadamu (Muhammad); di antara negeri-negeri itu ada yang masih kedapatan bekas-bekasnya dan ada (pula) yang telah musnah.

ayahs.arabic: وَمَا ظَلَمْنَٰهُمْ وَلَٰكِن ظَلَمُوٓا۟ أَنفُسَهُمْ ۖ فَمَآ أَغْنَتْ عَنْهُمْ ءَالِهَتُهُمُ ٱلَّتِى يَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ مِن شَىْءٍۢ لَّمَّا جَآءَ أَمْرُ رَبِّكَ ۖ وَمَا زَادُوهُمْ غَيْرَ تَتْبِيبٍۢ
ayahs.sahih: And We did not wrong them, but they wronged themselves. And they were not availed at all by their gods which they invoked other than Allah when there came the command of your Lord. And they did not increase them in other than ruin.
ayahs.clear: We did not wrong them, but they wronged themselves. Their gods, whom they invoked besides God, availed them nothing when the command of your Lord arrived. In fact, they added only to their ruin.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan Kami tidaklah menganiaya mereka tetapi merekalah yang menganiaya diri mereka sendiri, karena itu tiadalah bermanfaat sedikitpun kepada mereka sembahan-sembahan yang mereka seru selain Allah, di waktu azab Tuhanmu datang. Dan sembahan-sembahan itu tidaklah menambah kepada mereka kecuali kebinasaan belaka.

ayahs.arabic: وَكَذَٰلِكَ أَخْذُ رَبِّكَ إِذَآ أَخَذَ ٱلْقُرَىٰ وَهِىَ ظَٰلِمَةٌ ۚ إِنَّ أَخْذَهُۥٓ أَلِيمٌۭ شَدِيدٌ
ayahs.sahih: And thus is the seizure of your Lord when He seizes the cities while they are committing wrong. Indeed, His seizure is painful and severe.
ayahs.clear: Such is the grip of your Lord when He seizes the towns in the midst of their sins. His grip is most painful, most severe.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan begitulah azab Tuhanmu, apabila Dia mengazab penduduk negeri-negeri yang berbuat zalim. Sesungguhnya azab-Nya itu adalah sangat pedih lagi keras.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَةًۭ لِّمَنْ خَافَ عَذَابَ ٱلْءَاخِرَةِ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ يَوْمٌۭ مَّجْمُوعٌۭ لَّهُ ٱلنَّاسُ وَذَٰلِكَ يَوْمٌۭ مَّشْهُودٌۭ
ayahs.sahih: Indeed in that is a sign for those who fear the punishment of the Hereafter. That is a Day for which the people will be collected, and that is a Day [which will be] witnessed.
ayahs.clear: In that is a sign for whoever fears the punishment of the Hereafter. That is a Day for which humanity will be gathered together—that is a Day to be witnessed.
ayahs.kemenag: Sesungguhnya pada yang demikian itu benar-benar terdapat pelajaran bagi orang-orang yang takut kepada azab akhirat. Hari kiamat itu adalah suatu hari yang semua manusia dikumpulkan untuk (menghadapi)nya, dan hari itu adalah suatu hari yang disaksikan (oleh segala makhluk).

ayahs.arabic: وَمَا نُؤَخِّرُهُۥٓ إِلَّا لِأَجَلٍۢ مَّعْدُودٍۢ
ayahs.sahih: And We do not delay it except for a limited term.
ayahs.clear: We only postpone it until a predetermined time.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan Kami tiadalah mengundurkannya, melainkan sampai waktu yang tertentu.

ayahs.arabic: يَوْمَ يَأْتِ لَا تَكَلَّمُ نَفْسٌ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِهِۦ ۚ فَمِنْهُمْ شَقِىٌّۭ وَسَعِيدٌۭ
ayahs.sahih: The Day it comes no soul will speak except by His permission. And among them will be the wretched and the prosperous.
ayahs.clear: On the Day when it arrives, no soul will speak without His permission. Some will be miserable, and some will be happy.
ayahs.kemenag: Di kala datang hari itu, tidak ada seorangun yang berbicara, melainkan dengan izin-Nya; maka di antara mereka ada yang celaka dan ada yang berbahagia.

ayahs.arabic: فَأَمَّا ٱلَّذِينَ شَقُوا۟ فَفِى ٱلنَّارِ لَهُمْ فِيهَا زَفِيرٌۭ وَشَهِيقٌ
ayahs.sahih: As for those who were [destined to be] wretched, they will be in the Fire. For them therein is [violent] exhaling and inhaling.
ayahs.clear: As for those who are miserable, they will be in the Fire. They will have therein sighing and wailing.
ayahs.kemenag: Adapun orang-orang yang celaka, maka (tempatnya) di dalam neraka, di dalamnya mereka mengeluarkan dan menarik nafas (dengan merintih),

ayahs.arabic: خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَا مَا دَامَتِ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتُ وَٱلْأَرْضُ إِلَّا مَا شَآءَ رَبُّكَ ۚ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ فَعَّالٌۭ لِّمَا يُرِيدُ
ayahs.sahih: [They will be] abiding therein as long as the heavens and the earth endure, except what your Lord should will. Indeed, your Lord is an effecter of what He intends.
ayahs.clear: Remaining therein for as long as the heavens and the earth endure, except as your Lord wills. Your Lord is Doer of whatever He wills.
ayahs.kemenag: mereka kekal di dalamnya selama ada langit dan bumi, kecuali jika Tuhanmu menghendaki (yang lain). Sesungguhnya Tuhanmu Maha Pelaksana terhadap apa yang Dia kehendaki.

ayahs.arabic: ۞ وَأَمَّا ٱلَّذِينَ سُعِدُوا۟ فَفِى ٱلْجَنَّةِ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَا مَا دَامَتِ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتُ وَٱلْأَرْضُ إِلَّا مَا شَآءَ رَبُّكَ ۖ عَطَآءً غَيْرَ مَجْذُوذٍۢ
ayahs.sahih: And as for those who were [destined to be] prosperous, they will be in Paradise, abiding therein as long as the heavens and the earth endure, except what your Lord should will - a bestowal uninterrupted.
ayahs.clear: And as for those who are happy, they will be in Paradise, remaining therein for as long as the heavens and the earth endure, except as your Lord wills—a reward without end.
ayahs.kemenag: Adapun orang-orang yang berbahagia, maka tempatnya di dalam surga, mereka kekal di dalamnya selama ada langit dan bumi, kecuali jika Tuhanmu menghendaki (yang lain); sebagai karunia yang tiada putus-putusnya.

ayahs.arabic: فَلَا تَكُ فِى مِرْيَةٍۢ مِّمَّا يَعْبُدُ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ ۚ مَا يَعْبُدُونَ إِلَّا كَمَا يَعْبُدُ ءَابَآؤُهُم مِّن قَبْلُ ۚ وَإِنَّا لَمُوَفُّوهُمْ نَصِيبَهُمْ غَيْرَ مَنقُوصٍۢ
ayahs.sahih: So do not be in doubt, [O Muhammad], as to what these [polytheists] are worshipping. They worship not except as their fathers worshipped before. And indeed, We will give them their share undiminished.
ayahs.clear: So be not in doubt regarding what these people worship. They worship only as their ancestors worshiped before. We will pay them their due in full, without any reduction.
ayahs.kemenag: Maka janganlah kamu berada dalam keragu-raguan tentang apa yang disembah oleh mereka. Mereka tidak menyembah melainkan sebagaimana nenek moyang mereka menyembah dahulu. Dan sesungguhnya Kami pasti akan menyempurnakan dengan secukup-cukupnya pembalasan (terhadap) mereka dengan tidak dikurangi sedikitpun.

ayahs.arabic: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا مُوسَى ٱلْكِتَٰبَ فَٱخْتُلِفَ فِيهِ ۚ وَلَوْلَا كَلِمَةٌۭ سَبَقَتْ مِن رَّبِّكَ لَقُضِىَ بَيْنَهُمْ ۚ وَإِنَّهُمْ لَفِى شَكٍّۢ مِّنْهُ مُرِيبٍۢ
ayahs.sahih: And We had certainly given Moses the Scripture, but it came under disagreement. And if not for a word that preceded from your Lord, it would have been judged between them. And indeed they are, concerning the Qur'an, in disquieting doubt.
ayahs.clear: We gave Moses the Scripture, but it was disputed. Were it not for a prior word from your Lord, it would have been settled between them. They are in serious doubt concerning it.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan sesungguhnya Kami telah memberikan Kitab (Taurat) kepada Musa, lalu diperselisihkan tentang Kitab itu. Dan seandainya tidak ada ketetapan yang telah terdahulu dari Tuhanmu, niscaya telah ditetapkan hukuman di antara mereka. Dan sesungguhnya mereka (orang-orang kafir Mekah) dalam keraguan yang menggelisahkan terhadap Al Quran.

ayahs.arabic: وَإِنَّ كُلًّۭا لَّمَّا لَيُوَفِّيَنَّهُمْ رَبُّكَ أَعْمَٰلَهُمْ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ بِمَا يَعْمَلُونَ خَبِيرٌۭ
ayahs.sahih: And indeed, each [of the believers and disbelievers] - your Lord will fully compensate them for their deeds. Indeed, He is Acquainted with what they do.
ayahs.clear: Your Lord will repay each one of them in full for their deeds. He is Aware of everything they do.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan sesungguhnya kepada masing-masing (mereka yang berselisih itu) pasti Tuhanmu akan menyempurnakan dengan cukup, (balasan) pekerjaan mereka. Sesungguhnya Dia Maha Mengetahui apa yang mereka kerjakan.

ayahs.arabic: فَٱسْتَقِمْ كَمَآ أُمِرْتَ وَمَن تَابَ مَعَكَ وَلَا تَطْغَوْا۟ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ بَصِيرٌۭ
ayahs.sahih: So remain on a right course as you have been commanded, [you] and those who have turned back with you [to Allah], and do not transgress. Indeed, He is Seeing of what you do.
ayahs.clear: So be upright, as you are commanded, along with those who repented with you, and do not transgress. He is Seeing of everything you do.
ayahs.kemenag: Maka tetaplah kamu pada jalan yang benar, sebagaimana diperintahkan kepadamu dan (juga) orang yang telah taubat beserta kamu dan janganlah kamu melampaui batas. Sesungguhnya Dia Maha Melihat apa yang kamu kerjakan.

ayahs.arabic: وَلَا تَرْكَنُوٓا۟ إِلَى ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ فَتَمَسَّكُمُ ٱلنَّارُ وَمَا لَكُم مِّن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ مِنْ أَوْلِيَآءَ ثُمَّ لَا تُنصَرُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And do not incline toward those who do wrong, lest you be touched by the Fire, and you would not have other than Allah any protectors; then you would not be helped.
ayahs.clear: And do not incline towards those who do wrong, or the Fire may touch you; and you will have no protectors besides God, and you will not be saved.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan janganlah kamu cenderung kepada orang-orang yang zalim yang menyebabkan kamu disentuh api neraka, dan sekali-kali kamu tiada mempunyai seorang penolongpun selain daripada Allah, kemudian kamu tidak akan diberi pertolongan.

ayahs.arabic: وَأَقِمِ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ طَرَفَىِ ٱلنَّهَارِ وَزُلَفًۭا مِّنَ ٱلَّيْلِ ۚ إِنَّ ٱلْحَسَنَٰتِ يُذْهِبْنَ ٱلسَّيِّـَٔاتِ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ ذِكْرَىٰ لِلذَّٰكِرِينَ
ayahs.sahih: And establish prayer at the two ends of the day and at the approach of the night. Indeed, good deeds do away with misdeeds. That is a reminder for those who remember.
ayahs.clear: Perform the prayer at the borders of the day, and during the approaches of the night. The good deeds take away the bad deeds. This is a reminder for those who remember.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan dirikanlah sembahyang itu pada kedua tepi siang (pagi dan petang) dan pada bahagian permulaan daripada malam. Sesungguhnya perbuatan-perbuatan yang baik itu menghapuskan (dosa) perbuatan-perbuatan yang buruk. Itulah peringatan bagi orang-orang yang ingat.

ayahs.arabic: وَٱصْبِرْ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يُضِيعُ أَجْرَ ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
ayahs.sahih: And be patient, for indeed, Allah does not allow to be lost the reward of those who do good.
ayahs.clear: And be patient. God will not waste the reward of the virtuous.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan bersabarlah, karena sesungguhnya Allah tiada menyia-nyiakan pahala orang-orang yang berbuat kebaikan.

ayahs.arabic: فَلَوْلَا كَانَ مِنَ ٱلْقُرُونِ مِن قَبْلِكُمْ أُو۟لُوا۟ بَقِيَّةٍۢ يَنْهَوْنَ عَنِ ٱلْفَسَادِ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ إِلَّا قَلِيلًۭا مِّمَّنْ أَنجَيْنَا مِنْهُمْ ۗ وَٱتَّبَعَ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ مَآ أُتْرِفُوا۟ فِيهِ وَكَانُوا۟ مُجْرِمِينَ
ayahs.sahih: So why were there not among the generations before you those of enduring discrimination forbidding corruption on earth - except a few of those We saved from among them? But those who wronged pursued what luxury they were given therein, and they were criminals.
ayahs.clear: If only there were, among the generations before you, people with wisdom, who spoke against corruption on earth—except for the few whom We saved. But the wrongdoers pursued the luxuries they were indulged in, and thus became guilty.
ayahs.kemenag: Maka mengapa tidak ada dari umat-umat yang sebelum kamu orang-orang yang mempunyai keutamaan yang melarang daripada (mengerjakan) kerusakan di muka bumi, kecuali sebahagian kecil di antara orang-orang yang telah Kami selamatkan di antara mereka, dan orang-orang yang zalim hanya mementingkan kenikmatan yang mewah yang ada pada mereka, dan mereka adalah orang-orang yang berdosa.

ayahs.arabic: وَمَا كَانَ رَبُّكَ لِيُهْلِكَ ٱلْقُرَىٰ بِظُلْمٍۢ وَأَهْلُهَا مُصْلِحُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And your Lord would not have destroyed the cities unjustly while their people were reformers.
ayahs.clear: Your Lord would never destroy the towns wrongfully, while their inhabitants are righteous.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan Tuhanmu sekali-kali tidak akan membinasakan negeri-negeri secara zalim, sedang penduduknya orang-orang yang berbuat kebaikan.

ayahs.arabic: وَلَوْ شَآءَ رَبُّكَ لَجَعَلَ ٱلنَّاسَ أُمَّةًۭ وَٰحِدَةًۭ ۖ وَلَا يَزَالُونَ مُخْتَلِفِينَ
ayahs.sahih: And if your Lord had willed, He could have made mankind one community; but they will not cease to differ.
ayahs.clear: Had your Lord willed, He could have made humanity one community, but they continue to differ.
ayahs.kemenag: Jikalau Tuhanmu menghendaki, tentu Dia menjadikan manusia umat yang satu, tetapi mereka senantiasa berselisih pendapat,

ayahs.arabic: إِلَّا مَن رَّحِمَ رَبُّكَ ۚ وَلِذَٰلِكَ خَلَقَهُمْ ۗ وَتَمَّتْ كَلِمَةُ رَبِّكَ لَأَمْلَأَنَّ جَهَنَّمَ مِنَ ٱلْجِنَّةِ وَٱلنَّاسِ أَجْمَعِينَ
ayahs.sahih: Except whom your Lord has given mercy, and for that He created them. But the word of your Lord is to be fulfilled that, "I will surely fill Hell with jinn and men all together."
ayahs.clear: Except those on whom your Lord has mercy—for that reason He created them. The Word of your Lord is final: “I will fill Hell with jinn and humans, altogether.”
ayahs.kemenag: kecuali orang-orang yang diberi rahmat oleh Tuhanmu. Dan untuk itulah Allah menciptakan mereka. Kalimat Tuhanmu (keputusan-Nya) telah ditetapkan: sesungguhnya Aku akan memenuhi neraka Jahannam dengan jin dan manusia (yang durhaka) semuanya.

ayahs.arabic: وَكُلًّۭا نَّقُصُّ عَلَيْكَ مِنْ أَنۢبَآءِ ٱلرُّسُلِ مَا نُثَبِّتُ بِهِۦ فُؤَادَكَ ۚ وَجَآءَكَ فِى هَٰذِهِ ٱلْحَقُّ وَمَوْعِظَةٌۭ وَذِكْرَىٰ لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
ayahs.sahih: And each [story] We relate to you from the news of the messengers is that by which We make firm your heart. And there has come to you, in this, the truth and an instruction and a reminder for the believers.
ayahs.clear: Everything We narrate to you of the history of the messengers is to strengthen your heart therewith. The truth has come to you in this, and a lesson, and a reminder for the believers.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan semua kisah dari rasul-rasul Kami ceritakan kepadamu, ialah kisah-kisah yang dengannya Kami teguhkan hatimu; dan dalam surat ini telah datang kepadamu kebenaran serta pengajaran dan peringatan bagi orang-orang yang beriman.

ayahs.arabic: وَقُل لِّلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ ٱعْمَلُوا۟ عَلَىٰ مَكَانَتِكُمْ إِنَّا عَٰمِلُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And say to those who do not believe, "Work according to your position; indeed, we are working.
ayahs.clear: And say to those who do not believe, “Act according to your ability; and so will we.”
ayahs.kemenag: Dan katakanlah kepada orang-orang yang tidak beriman: "Berbuatlah menurut kemampuanmu; sesungguhnya Kami-pun berbuat (pula)".

ayahs.arabic: وَٱنتَظِرُوٓا۟ إِنَّا مُنتَظِرُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And wait, indeed, we are waiting."
ayahs.clear: “And wait; we too are waiting.”
ayahs.kemenag: Dan tunggulah (akibat perbuatanmu); sesungguhnya kamipun menunggu (pula)".

ayahs.arabic: وَلِلَّهِ غَيْبُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَإِلَيْهِ يُرْجَعُ ٱلْأَمْرُ كُلُّهُۥ فَٱعْبُدْهُ وَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَيْهِ ۚ وَمَا رَبُّكَ بِغَٰفِلٍ عَمَّا تَعْمَلُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And to Allah belong the unseen [aspects] of the heavens and the earth and to Him will be returned the matter, all of it, so worship Him and rely upon Him. And your Lord is not unaware of that which you do.
ayahs.clear: To God belongs the future of the heavens and the earth, and to Him all authority goes back. So worship Him, and rely on Him. Your Lord is never unaware of what you do.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan kepunyaan Allah-lah apa yang ghaib di langit dan di bumi dan kepada-Nya-lah dikembalikan urusan-urusan semuanya, maka sembahlah Dia, dan bertawakkallah kepada-Nya. Dan sekali-kali Tuhanmu tidak lalai dari apa yang kamu kerjakan.

ayahs.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ الٓر ۚ تِلْكَ ءَايَٰتُ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ ٱلْمُبِينِ
ayahs.sahih: Alif, Lam, Ra. These are the verses of the clear Book.
ayahs.clear: Alif, Lam, Ra. These are the Verses of the Clear Book.
ayahs.kemenag: Alif, laam, raa. Ini adalah ayat-ayat Kitab (Al Quran) yang nyata (dari Allah).

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّآ أَنزَلْنَٰهُ قُرْءَٰنًا عَرَبِيًّۭا لَّعَلَّكُمْ تَعْقِلُونَ
ayahs.sahih: Indeed, We have sent it down as an Arabic Qur'an that you might understand.
ayahs.clear: We have revealed it an Arabic Quran, so that you may understand.
ayahs.kemenag: Sesungguhnya Kami menurunkannya berupa Al Quran dengan berbahasa Arab, agar kamu memahaminya.

ayahs.arabic: نَحْنُ نَقُصُّ عَلَيْكَ أَحْسَنَ ٱلْقَصَصِ بِمَآ أَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَيْكَ هَٰذَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ وَإِن كُنتَ مِن قَبْلِهِۦ لَمِنَ ٱلْغَٰفِلِينَ
ayahs.sahih: We relate to you, [O Muhammad], the best of stories in what We have revealed to you of this Qur'an although you were, before it, among the unaware.
ayahs.clear: We narrate to you the most accurate history, by revealing to you this Quran. Although, prior to it, you were of the unaware.
ayahs.kemenag: Kami menceritakan kepadamu kisah yang paling baik dengan mewahyukan Al Quran ini kepadamu, dan sesungguhnya kamu sebelum (Kami mewahyukan)nya adalah termasuk orang-orang yang belum mengetahui.

ayahs.arabic: إِذْ قَالَ يُوسُفُ لِأَبِيهِ يَٰٓأَبَتِ إِنِّى رَأَيْتُ أَحَدَ عَشَرَ كَوْكَبًۭا وَٱلشَّمْسَ وَٱلْقَمَرَ رَأَيْتُهُمْ لِى سَٰجِدِينَ
ayahs.sahih: [Of these stories mention] when Joseph said to his father, "O my father, indeed I have seen [in a dream] eleven stars and the sun and the moon; I saw them prostrating to me."
ayahs.clear: When Joseph said to his father, “O my father, I saw eleven planets, and the sun, and the moon; I saw them bowing down to me.”
ayahs.kemenag: (Ingatlah), ketika Yusuf berkata kepada ayahnya: "Wahai ayahku, sesungguhnya aku bermimpi melihat sebelas bintang, matahari dan bulan; kulihat semuanya sujud kepadaku".

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ يَٰبُنَىَّ لَا تَقْصُصْ رُءْيَاكَ عَلَىٰٓ إِخْوَتِكَ فَيَكِيدُوا۟ لَكَ كَيْدًا ۖ إِنَّ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنَ لِلْإِنسَٰنِ عَدُوٌّۭ مُّبِينٌۭ
ayahs.sahih: He said, "O my son, do not relate your vision to your brothers or they will contrive against you a plan. Indeed Satan, to man, is a manifest enemy.
ayahs.clear: He said, “O my son, do not relate your vision to your brothers, lest they plot and scheme against you. Satan is man's sworn enemy.
ayahs.kemenag: Ayahnya berkata: "Hai anakku, janganlah kamu ceritakan mimpimu itu kepada saudara-saudaramu, maka mereka membuat makar (untuk membinasakan)mu. Sesungguhnya syaitan itu adalah musuh yang nyata bagi manusia".

ayahs.arabic: وَكَذَٰلِكَ يَجْتَبِيكَ رَبُّكَ وَيُعَلِّمُكَ مِن تَأْوِيلِ ٱلْأَحَادِيثِ وَيُتِمُّ نِعْمَتَهُۥ عَلَيْكَ وَعَلَىٰٓ ءَالِ يَعْقُوبَ كَمَآ أَتَمَّهَا عَلَىٰٓ أَبَوَيْكَ مِن قَبْلُ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ وَإِسْحَٰقَ ۚ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ عَلِيمٌ حَكِيمٌۭ
ayahs.sahih: And thus will your Lord choose you and teach you the interpretation of narratives and complete His favor upon you and upon the family of Jacob, as He completed it upon your fathers before, Abraham and Isaac. Indeed, your Lord is Knowing and Wise."
ayahs.clear: And thus your Lord will choose you, and will teach you the interpretation of events, and will complete His blessing upon you and upon the family of Jacob, as He has completed it before upon your forefathers Abraham and Isaac. Your Lord is Knowing and Wise.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan demikianlah Tuhanmu, memilih kamu (untuk menjadi Nabi) dan diajarkan-Nya kepadamu sebahagian dari ta'bir mimpi-mimpi dan disempurnakan-Nya nikmat-Nya kepadamu dan kepada keluarga Ya'qub, sebagaimana Dia telah menyempurnakan nikmat-Nya kepada dua orang bapakmu sebelum itu, (yaitu) Ibrahim dan Ishak. Sesungguhnya Tuhanmu Maha Mengetahui lagi Maha Bijaksana.

ayahs.arabic: ۞ لَّقَدْ كَانَ فِى يُوسُفَ وَإِخْوَتِهِۦٓ ءَايَٰتٌۭ لِّلسَّآئِلِينَ
ayahs.sahih: Certainly were there in Joseph and his brothers signs for those who ask,
ayahs.clear: In Joseph and his brothers are lessons for the seekers.
ayahs.kemenag: Sesungguhnya ada beberapa tanda-tanda kekuasaan Allah pada (kisah) Yusuf dan saudara-saudaranya bagi orang-orang yang bertanya.

ayahs.arabic: إِذْ قَالُوا۟ لَيُوسُفُ وَأَخُوهُ أَحَبُّ إِلَىٰٓ أَبِينَا مِنَّا وَنَحْنُ عُصْبَةٌ إِنَّ أَبَانَا لَفِى ضَلَٰلٍۢ مُّبِينٍ
ayahs.sahih: When they said, "Joseph and his brother are more beloved to our father than we, while we are a clan. Indeed, our father is in clear error.
ayahs.clear: When they said, “Joseph and his brother are dearer to our father than we are, although we are a whole group. Our father is obviously in the wrong.
ayahs.kemenag: (Yaitu) ketika mereka berkata: "Sesungguhnya Yusuf dan saudara kandungnya (Bunyamin) lebih dicintai oleh ayah kita dari pada kita sendiri, padahal kita (ini) adalah satu golongan (yang kuat). Sesungguhnya ayah kita adalah dalam kekeliruan yang nyata.

ayahs.arabic: ٱقْتُلُوا۟ يُوسُفَ أَوِ ٱطْرَحُوهُ أَرْضًۭا يَخْلُ لَكُمْ وَجْهُ أَبِيكُمْ وَتَكُونُوا۟ مِنۢ بَعْدِهِۦ قَوْمًۭا صَٰلِحِينَ
ayahs.sahih: Kill Joseph or cast him out to [another] land; the countenance of your father will [then] be only for you, and you will be after that a righteous people."
ayahs.clear: “Kill Joseph, or throw him somewhere in the land, and your father‘s attention will be yours. Afterwards, you will be decent people.”
ayahs.kemenag: Bunuhlah Yusuf atau buanglah dia kesuatu daerah (yang tak dikenal) supaya perhatian ayahmu tertumpah kepadamu saja, dan sesudah itu hendaklah kamu menjadi orang-orang yang baik".

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ قَآئِلٌۭ مِّنْهُمْ لَا تَقْتُلُوا۟ يُوسُفَ وَأَلْقُوهُ فِى غَيَٰبَتِ ٱلْجُبِّ يَلْتَقِطْهُ بَعْضُ ٱلسَّيَّارَةِ إِن كُنتُمْ فَٰعِلِينَ
ayahs.sahih: Said a speaker among them, "Do not kill Joseph but throw him into the bottom of the well; some travelers will pick him up - if you would do [something]."
ayahs.clear: One of them said, “Do not kill Joseph, but throw him into the bottom of the well; some caravan may pick him up—if you must do something.”
ayahs.kemenag: Seorang diantara mereka berkata: "Janganlah kamu bunuh Yusuf, tetapi masukkanlah dia ke dasar sumur supaya dia dipungut oleh beberapa orang musafir, jika kamu hendak berbuat".

ayahs.arabic: قَالُوا۟ يَٰٓأَبَانَا مَا لَكَ لَا تَأْمَ۫نَّا عَلَىٰ يُوسُفَ وَإِنَّا لَهُۥ لَنَٰصِحُونَ
ayahs.sahih: They said, "O our father, why do you not entrust us with Joseph while indeed, we are to him sincere counselors?
ayahs.clear: They said, “Father, why do you not trust us with Joseph, although we care for him?”
ayahs.kemenag: Mereka berkata: "Wahai ayah kami, apa sebabnya kamu tidak mempercayai kami terhadap Yusuf, padahal sesungguhnya kami adalah orang-orang yang mengingini kebaikan baginya.

ayahs.arabic: أَرْسِلْهُ مَعَنَا غَدًۭا يَرْتَعْ وَيَلْعَبْ وَإِنَّا لَهُۥ لَحَٰفِظُونَ
ayahs.sahih: Send him with us tomorrow that he may eat well and play. And indeed, we will be his guardians.
ayahs.clear: “Send him with us tomorrow, that he may roam and play; we will take care of him.”
ayahs.kemenag: Biarkanlah dia pergi bersama kami besok pagi, agar dia (dapat) bersenang-senang dan (dapat) bermain-main, dan sesungguhnya kami pasti menjaganya".

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ إِنِّى لَيَحْزُنُنِىٓ أَن تَذْهَبُوا۟ بِهِۦ وَأَخَافُ أَن يَأْكُلَهُ ٱلذِّئْبُ وَأَنتُمْ عَنْهُ غَٰفِلُونَ
ayahs.sahih: [Jacob] said, "Indeed, it saddens me that you should take him, and I fear that a wolf would eat him while you are of him unaware."
ayahs.clear: He said, “It worries me that you would take him away. And I fear the wolf may eat him while you are careless of him.”
ayahs.kemenag: Berkata Ya'qub: "Sesungguhnya kepergian kamu bersama Yusuf amat menyedihkanku dan aku khawatir kalau-kalau dia dimakan serigala, sedang kamu lengah dari padanya".

ayahs.arabic: قَالُوا۟ لَئِنْ أَكَلَهُ ٱلذِّئْبُ وَنَحْنُ عُصْبَةٌ إِنَّآ إِذًۭا لَّخَٰسِرُونَ
ayahs.sahih: They said, "If a wolf should eat him while we are a [strong] clan, indeed, we would then be losers."
ayahs.clear: They said, “If the wolf ate him, and we are many, we would be good for nothing.”
ayahs.kemenag: Mereka berkata: "Jika ia benar-benar dimakan serigala, sedang kami golongan (yang kuat), sesungguhnya kami kalau demikian adalah orang-orang yang merugi".

ayahs.arabic: فَلَمَّا ذَهَبُوا۟ بِهِۦ وَأَجْمَعُوٓا۟ أَن يَجْعَلُوهُ فِى غَيَٰبَتِ ٱلْجُبِّ ۚ وَأَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَيْهِ لَتُنَبِّئَنَّهُم بِأَمْرِهِمْ هَٰذَا وَهُمْ لَا يَشْعُرُونَ
ayahs.sahih: So when they took him [out] and agreed to put him into the bottom of the well... But We inspired to him, "You will surely inform them [someday] about this affair of theirs while they do not perceive [your identity]."
ayahs.clear: So they went away with him, and agreed to put him at the bottom of the well. And We inspired him, “You will inform them of this deed of theirs when they are unaware.”
ayahs.kemenag: Maka tatkala mereka membawanya dan sepakat memasukkannya ke dasar sumur (lalu mereka masukkan dia), dan (di waktu dia sudah dalam sumur) Kami wahyukan kepada Yusuf: "Sesungguhnya kamu akan menceritakan kepada mereka perbuatan mereka ini, sedang mereka tiada ingat lagi".

ayahs.arabic: وَجَآءُوٓ أَبَاهُمْ عِشَآءًۭ يَبْكُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And they came to their father at night, weeping.
ayahs.clear: And they came to their father in the evening weeping.
ayahs.kemenag: Kemudian mereka datang kepada ayah mereka di sore hari sambil menangis.

ayahs.arabic: قَالُوا۟ يَٰٓأَبَانَآ إِنَّا ذَهَبْنَا نَسْتَبِقُ وَتَرَكْنَا يُوسُفَ عِندَ مَتَٰعِنَا فَأَكَلَهُ ٱلذِّئْبُ ۖ وَمَآ أَنتَ بِمُؤْمِنٍۢ لَّنَا وَلَوْ كُنَّا صَٰدِقِينَ
ayahs.sahih: They said, "O our father, indeed we went racing each other and left Joseph with our possessions, and a wolf ate him. But you would not believe us, even if we were truthful."
ayahs.clear: They said, “O father, we went off racing one another, and left Joseph by our belongings; and the wolf ate him. But you will not believe us, even though we are being truthful.”
ayahs.kemenag: Mereka berkata: "Wahai ayah kami, sesungguhnya kami pergi berlomba-lomba dan kami tinggalkan Yusuf di dekat barang-barang kami, lalu dia dimakan serigala; dan kamu sekali-kali tidak akan percaya kepada kami, sekalipun kami adalah orang-orang yang benar".

ayahs.arabic: وَجَآءُو عَلَىٰ قَمِيصِهِۦ بِدَمٍۢ كَذِبٍۢ ۚ قَالَ بَلْ سَوَّلَتْ لَكُمْ أَنفُسُكُمْ أَمْرًۭا ۖ فَصَبْرٌۭ جَمِيلٌۭ ۖ وَٱللَّهُ ٱلْمُسْتَعَانُ عَلَىٰ مَا تَصِفُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And they brought upon his shirt false blood. [Jacob] said, "Rather, your souls have enticed you to something, so patience is most fitting. And Allah is the one sought for help against that which you describe."
ayahs.clear: And they brought his shirt, with fake blood on it. He said, “Your souls enticed you to do something. But patience is beautiful, and God is my Help against what you describe.”
ayahs.kemenag: Mereka datang membawa baju gamisnya (yang berlumuran) dengan darah palsu. Ya'qub berkata: "Sebenarnya dirimu sendirilah yang memandang baik perbuatan (yang buruk) itu; maka kesabaran yang baik itulah (kesabaranku). Dan Allah sajalah yang dimohon pertolongan-Nya terhadap apa yang kamu ceritakan".

ayahs.arabic: وَجَآءَتْ سَيَّارَةٌۭ فَأَرْسَلُوا۟ وَارِدَهُمْ فَأَدْلَىٰ دَلْوَهُۥ ۖ قَالَ يَٰبُشْرَىٰ هَٰذَا غُلَٰمٌۭ ۚ وَأَسَرُّوهُ بِضَٰعَةًۭ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ عَلِيمٌۢ بِمَا يَعْمَلُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And there came a company of travelers; then they sent their water drawer, and he let down his bucket. He said, "Good news! Here is a boy." And they concealed him, [taking him] as merchandise; and Allah was knowing of what they did.
ayahs.clear: A caravan passed by, and they sent their water-carrier. He lowered his bucket, and said, “Good news. Here is a boy.” And they hid him as merchandise. But God was aware of what they did.
ayahs.kemenag: Kemudian datanglah kelompok orang-orang musafir, lalu mereka menyuruh seorang pengambil air, maka dia menurunkan timbanya, dia berkata: "Oh; kabar gembira, ini seorang anak muda!" Kemudian mereka menyembunyikan dia sebagai barang dagangan. Dan Allah Maha Mengetahui apa yang mereka kerjakan.

ayahs.arabic: وَشَرَوْهُ بِثَمَنٍۭ بَخْسٍۢ دَرَٰهِمَ مَعْدُودَةٍۢ وَكَانُوا۟ فِيهِ مِنَ ٱلزَّٰهِدِينَ
ayahs.sahih: And they sold him for a reduced price - a few dirhams - and they were, concerning him, of those content with little.
ayahs.clear: And they sold him for a cheap price—a few coins—they considered him to be of little value.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan mereka menjual Yusuf dengan harga yang murah, yaitu beberapa dirham saja, dan mereka merasa tidak tertarik hatinya kepada Yusuf.

ayahs.arabic: وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِى ٱشْتَرَىٰهُ مِن مِّصْرَ لِٱمْرَأَتِهِۦٓ أَكْرِمِى مَثْوَىٰهُ عَسَىٰٓ أَن يَنفَعَنَآ أَوْ نَتَّخِذَهُۥ وَلَدًۭا ۚ وَكَذَٰلِكَ مَكَّنَّا لِيُوسُفَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلِنُعَلِّمَهُۥ مِن تَأْوِيلِ ٱلْأَحَادِيثِ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ غَالِبٌ عَلَىٰٓ أَمْرِهِۦ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَ ٱلنَّاسِ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And the one from Egypt who bought him said to his wife, "Make his residence comfortable. Perhaps he will benefit us, or we will adopt him as a son." And thus, We established Joseph in the land that We might teach him the interpretation of events. And Allah is predominant over His affair, but most of the people do not know.
ayahs.clear: The Egyptian who bought him said to his wife, “Take good care of him; he may be useful to us, or we may adopt him as a son.” We thus established Joseph in the land, to teach him the interpretation of events. God has control over His affairs, but most people do not know.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan orang Mesir yang membelinya berkata kepada isterinya: "Berikanlah kepadanya tempat (dan layanan) yang baik, boleh jadi dia bermanfaat kepada kita atau kita pungut dia sebagai anak". Dan demikian pulalah Kami memberikan kedudukan yang baik kepada Yusuf di muka bumi (Mesir), dan agar Kami ajarkan kepadanya ta'bir mimpi. Dan Allah berkuasa terhadap urusan-Nya, tetapi kebanyakan manusia tiada mengetahuinya.

ayahs.arabic: وَلَمَّا بَلَغَ أَشُدَّهُۥٓ ءَاتَيْنَٰهُ حُكْمًۭا وَعِلْمًۭا ۚ وَكَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
ayahs.sahih: And when Joseph reached maturity, We gave him judgment and knowledge. And thus We reward the doers of good.
ayahs.clear: When he reached his maturity, We gave him wisdom and knowledge. We thus reward the righteous.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan tatkala dia cukup dewasa Kami berikan kepadanya hikmah dan ilmu. Demikianlah Kami memberi balasan kepada orang-orang yang berbuat baik.

ayahs.arabic: وَرَٰوَدَتْهُ ٱلَّتِى هُوَ فِى بَيْتِهَا عَن نَّفْسِهِۦ وَغَلَّقَتِ ٱلْأَبْوَٰبَ وَقَالَتْ هَيْتَ لَكَ ۚ قَالَ مَعَاذَ ٱللَّهِ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ رَبِّىٓ أَحْسَنَ مَثْوَاىَ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ لَا يُفْلِحُ ٱلظَّٰلِمُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And she, in whose house he was, sought to seduce him. She closed the doors and said, "Come, you." He said, "[I seek] the refuge of Allah. Indeed, he is my master, who has made good my residence. Indeed, wrongdoers will not succeed."
ayahs.clear: She in whose house he was living tried to seduce him. She shut the doors, and said, “I am yours.” He said, “God forbid! He is my Lord. He has given me a good home. Sinners never succeed.”
ayahs.kemenag: Dan wanita (Zulaikha) yang Yusuf tinggal di rumahnya menggoda Yusuf untuk menundukkan dirinya (kepadanya) dan dia menutup pintu-pintu, seraya berkata: "Marilah ke sini". Yusuf berkata: "Aku berlindung kepada Allah, sungguh tuanku telah memperlakukan aku dengan baik". Sesungguhnya orang-orang yang zalim tiada akan beruntung.

ayahs.arabic: وَلَقَدْ هَمَّتْ بِهِۦ ۖ وَهَمَّ بِهَا لَوْلَآ أَن رَّءَا بُرْهَٰنَ رَبِّهِۦ ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ لِنَصْرِفَ عَنْهُ ٱلسُّوٓءَ وَٱلْفَحْشَآءَ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا ٱلْمُخْلَصِينَ
ayahs.sahih: And she certainly determined [to seduce] him, and he would have inclined to her had he not seen the proof of his Lord. And thus [it was] that We should avert from him evil and immorality. Indeed, he was of Our chosen servants.
ayahs.clear: She desired him, and he desired her, had he not seen the proof of his Lord. It was thus that We diverted evil and indecency away from him. He was one of Our loyal servants.
ayahs.kemenag: Sesungguhnya wanita itu telah bermaksud (melakukan perbuatan itu) dengan Yusuf, dan Yusufpun bermaksud (melakukan pula) dengan wanita itu andaikata dia tidak melihat tanda (dari) Tuhannya. Demikianlah, agar Kami memalingkan dari padanya kemungkaran dan kekejian. Sesungguhnya Yusuf itu termasuk hamba-hamba Kami yang terpilih.

ayahs.arabic: وَٱسْتَبَقَا ٱلْبَابَ وَقَدَّتْ قَمِيصَهُۥ مِن دُبُرٍۢ وَأَلْفَيَا سَيِّدَهَا لَدَا ٱلْبَابِ ۚ قَالَتْ مَا جَزَآءُ مَنْ أَرَادَ بِأَهْلِكَ سُوٓءًا إِلَّآ أَن يُسْجَنَ أَوْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌۭ
ayahs.sahih: And they both raced to the door, and she tore his shirt from the back, and they found her husband at the door. She said, "What is the recompense of one who intended evil for your wife but that he be imprisoned or a painful punishment?"
ayahs.clear: As they raced towards the door, she tore his shirt from behind. At the door, they ran into her husband. She said, “What is the penalty for him who desired to dishonor your wife, except imprisonment or a painful punishment?”
ayahs.kemenag: Dan keduanya berlomba-lomba menuju pintu dan wanita itu menarik baju gamis Yusuf dari belakang hingga koyak dan kedua-duanya mendapati suami wanita itu di muka pintu. Wanita itu berkata: "Apakah pembalasan terhadap orang yang bermaksud berbuat serong dengan isterimu, selain dipenjarakan atau (dihukum) dengan azab yang pedih?"

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ هِىَ رَٰوَدَتْنِى عَن نَّفْسِى ۚ وَشَهِدَ شَاهِدٌۭ مِّنْ أَهْلِهَآ إِن كَانَ قَمِيصُهُۥ قُدَّ مِن قُبُلٍۢ فَصَدَقَتْ وَهُوَ مِنَ ٱلْكَٰذِبِينَ
ayahs.sahih: [Joseph] said, "It was she who sought to seduce me." And a witness from her family testified. "If his shirt is torn from the front, then she has told the truth, and he is of the liars.
ayahs.clear: He said, “It was she who tried to seduce me.” A witness from her household suggested: “If his shirt is torn from the front: then she has told the truth, and he is the liar.
ayahs.kemenag: Yusuf berkata: "Dia menggodaku untuk menundukkan diriku (kepadanya)", dan seorang saksi dari keluarga wanita itu memberikan kesaksiannya: "Jika baju gamisnya koyak di muka, maka wanita itu benar dan Yusuf termasuk orang-orang yang dusta.

ayahs.arabic: وَإِن كَانَ قَمِيصُهُۥ قُدَّ مِن دُبُرٍۢ فَكَذَبَتْ وَهُوَ مِنَ ٱلصَّٰدِقِينَ
ayahs.sahih: But if his shirt is torn from the back, then she has lied, and he is of the truthful."
ayahs.clear: But if his shirt is torn from the back: then she has lied, and he is the truthful.”
ayahs.kemenag: Dan jika baju gamisnya koyak di belakang, maka wanita itulah yang dusta, dan Yusuf termasuk orang-orang yang benar".
