ayahs.arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ بِمَآ أَغْوَيْتَنِى لَأُزَيِّنَنَّ لَهُمْ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَأُغْوِيَنَّهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
ayahs.sahih: [Iblees] said, "My Lord, because You have put me in error, I will surely make [disobedience] attractive to them on earth, and I will mislead them all
ayahs.clear: He said, “My Lord, since You have lured me away, I will glamorize for them on earth, and I will lure them all away.”
ayahs.kemenag: Iblis berkata: "Ya Tuhanku, oleh sebab Engkau telah memutuskan bahwa aku sesat, pasti aku akan menjadikan mereka memandang baik (perbuatan maksiat) di muka bumi, dan pasti aku akan menyesatkan mereka semuanya,

ayahs.arabic: إِلَّا عِبَادَكَ مِنْهُمُ ٱلْمُخْلَصِينَ
ayahs.sahih: Except, among them, Your chosen servants."
ayahs.clear: “Except for Your sincere servants among them.”
ayahs.kemenag: kecuali hamba-hamba Engkau yang mukhlis di antara mereka".

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ هَٰذَا صِرَٰطٌ عَلَىَّ مُسْتَقِيمٌ
ayahs.sahih: [Allah] said, "This is a path [of return] to Me [that is] straight.
ayahs.clear: He said, “This is a right way with Me.”
ayahs.kemenag: Allah berfirman: "Ini adalah jalan yang lurus, kewajiban Aku-lah (menjaganya).

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ عِبَادِى لَيْسَ لَكَ عَلَيْهِمْ سُلْطَٰنٌ إِلَّا مَنِ ٱتَّبَعَكَ مِنَ ٱلْغَاوِينَ
ayahs.sahih: Indeed, My servants - no authority will you have over them, except those who follow you of the deviators.
ayahs.clear: “Over My servants you have no authority, except for the sinners who follow you.”
ayahs.kemenag: Sesungguhnya hamba-hamba-Ku tidak ada kekuasaan bagimu terhadap mereka, kecuali orang-orang yang mengikut kamu, yaitu orang-orang yang sesat.

ayahs.arabic: وَإِنَّ جَهَنَّمَ لَمَوْعِدُهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
ayahs.sahih: And indeed, Hell is the promised place for them all.
ayahs.clear: And Hell is the meeting-place for them all.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan sesungguhnya Jahannam itu benar-benar tempat yang telah diancamkan kepada mereka (pengikut-pengikut syaitan) semuanya.

ayahs.arabic: لَهَا سَبْعَةُ أَبْوَٰبٍۢ لِّكُلِّ بَابٍۢ مِّنْهُمْ جُزْءٌۭ مَّقْسُومٌ
ayahs.sahih: It has seven gates; for every gate is of them a portion designated."
ayahs.clear: “It has seven doors; for each door is an assigned class.”
ayahs.kemenag: Jahannam itu mempunyai tujuh pintu. Tiap-tiap pintu (telah ditetapkan) untuk golongan yang tertentu dari mereka.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِى جَنَّٰتٍۢ وَعُيُونٍ
ayahs.sahih: Indeed, the righteous will be within gardens and springs.
ayahs.clear: But the righteous will be in gardens with springs.
ayahs.kemenag: Sesungguhnya orang-orang yang bertakwa itu berada dalam surga (taman-taman) dan (di dekat) mata air-mata air (yang mengalir).

ayahs.arabic: ٱدْخُلُوهَا بِسَلَٰمٍ ءَامِنِينَ
ayahs.sahih: [Having been told], "Enter it in peace, safe [and secure]."
ayahs.clear: “Enter it in peace and security.”
ayahs.kemenag: (Dikatakan kepada mereka): "Masuklah ke dalamnya dengan sejahtera lagi aman"

ayahs.arabic: وَنَزَعْنَا مَا فِى صُدُورِهِم مِّنْ غِلٍّ إِخْوَٰنًا عَلَىٰ سُرُرٍۢ مُّتَقَٰبِلِينَ
ayahs.sahih: And We will remove whatever is in their breasts of resentment, [so they will be] brothers, on thrones facing each other.
ayahs.clear: And We will remove all ill-feelings from their hearts—brothers and sisters, on couches facing one another.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan Kami lenyapkan segala rasa dendam yang berada dalam hati mereka, sedang mereka merasa bersaudara duduk berhadap-hadapan di atas dipan-dipan.

ayahs.arabic: لَا يَمَسُّهُمْ فِيهَا نَصَبٌۭ وَمَا هُم مِّنْهَا بِمُخْرَجِينَ
ayahs.sahih: No fatigue will touch them therein, nor from it will they [ever] be removed.
ayahs.clear: No fatigue will ever touch them therein, nor will they be asked to leave it.
ayahs.kemenag: Mereka tidak merasa lelah di dalamnya dan mereka sekali-kali tidak akan dikeluarkan daripadanya.

ayahs.arabic: ۞ نَبِّئْ عِبَادِىٓ أَنِّىٓ أَنَا ٱلْغَفُورُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
ayahs.sahih: [O Muhammad], inform My servants that it is I who am the Forgiving, the Merciful.
ayahs.clear: Inform My servants that I am the Forgiver, the Merciful.
ayahs.kemenag: Kabarkanlah kepada hamba-hamba-Ku, bahwa sesungguhnya Aku-lah Yang Maha Pengampun lagi Maha Penyayang,

ayahs.arabic: وَأَنَّ عَذَابِى هُوَ ٱلْعَذَابُ ٱلْأَلِيمُ
ayahs.sahih: And that it is My punishment which is the painful punishment.
ayahs.clear: And that My punishment is the painful punishment.
ayahs.kemenag: dan bahwa sesungguhnya azab-Ku adalah azab yang sangat pedih.

ayahs.arabic: وَنَبِّئْهُمْ عَن ضَيْفِ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ
ayahs.sahih: And inform them about the guests of Abraham,
ayahs.clear: And inform them of the guests of Abraham.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan kabarkanlah kepada mereka tentang tamu-tamu Ibrahim.

ayahs.arabic: إِذْ دَخَلُوا۟ عَلَيْهِ فَقَالُوا۟ سَلَٰمًۭا قَالَ إِنَّا مِنكُمْ وَجِلُونَ
ayahs.sahih: When they entered upon him and said, "Peace." [Abraham] said, "Indeed, we are fearful of you."
ayahs.clear: When they entered upon him, and said, “Peace.” He said, “We are wary of you.”
ayahs.kemenag: Ketika mereka masuk ke tempatnya, lalu mereka mengucapkan: "Salaam". Berkata Ibrahim: "Sesungguhnya kami merasa takut kepadamu".

ayahs.arabic: قَالُوا۟ لَا تَوْجَلْ إِنَّا نُبَشِّرُكَ بِغُلَٰمٍ عَلِيمٍۢ
ayahs.sahih: [The angels] said, "Fear not. Indeed, we give you good tidings of a learned boy."
ayahs.clear: They said, “Do not fear; we bring you good news of a boy endowed with knowledge.”
ayahs.kemenag: Mereka berkata: "Janganlah kamu merasa takut, sesungguhnya kami memberi kabar gembira kepadamu dengan (kelahiran seorang) anak laki-laki (yang akan menjadi) orang yang alim".

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ أَبَشَّرْتُمُونِى عَلَىٰٓ أَن مَّسَّنِىَ ٱلْكِبَرُ فَبِمَ تُبَشِّرُونَ
ayahs.sahih: He said, "Have you given me good tidings although old age has come upon me? Then of what [wonder] do you inform?"
ayahs.clear: He said, “Do you bring me good news, when old age has overtaken me? What good news do you bring?”
ayahs.kemenag: Berkata Ibrahim: "Apakah kamu memberi kabar gembira kepadaku padahal usiaku telah lanjut, maka dengan cara bagaimanakah (terlaksananya) berita gembira yang kamu kabarkan ini?"

ayahs.arabic: قَالُوا۟ بَشَّرْنَٰكَ بِٱلْحَقِّ فَلَا تَكُن مِّنَ ٱلْقَٰنِطِينَ
ayahs.sahih: They said, "We have given you good tidings in truth, so do not be of the despairing."
ayahs.clear: They said, “We bring you good news in truth, so do not despair.”
ayahs.kemenag: Mereka menjawab: "Kami menyampaikan kabar gembira kepadamu dengan benar, maka janganlah kamu termasuk orang-orang yang berputus asa".

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ وَمَن يَقْنَطُ مِن رَّحْمَةِ رَبِّهِۦٓ إِلَّا ٱلضَّآلُّونَ
ayahs.sahih: He said, "And who despairs of the mercy of his Lord except for those astray?"
ayahs.clear: He said, “And who despairs of his Lord’s mercy but the lost?”
ayahs.kemenag: Ibrahim berkata: "Tidak ada orang yang berputus asa dari rahmat Tuhan-nya, kecuali orang-orang yang sesat".

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ فَمَا خَطْبُكُمْ أَيُّهَا ٱلْمُرْسَلُونَ
ayahs.sahih: [Abraham] said, "Then what is your business [here], O messengers?"
ayahs.clear: He said, “So what is your business, O envoys?”
ayahs.kemenag: Berkata (pula) Ibrahim: "Apakah urusanmu yang penting (selain itu), hai para utusan?"

ayahs.arabic: قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّآ أُرْسِلْنَآ إِلَىٰ قَوْمٍۢ مُّجْرِمِينَ
ayahs.sahih: They said, "Indeed, we have been sent to a people of criminals,
ayahs.clear: They said, “We were sent to a sinful people.”
ayahs.kemenag: Mereka menjawab: "Kami sesungguhnya diutus kepada kaum yang berdosa,

ayahs.arabic: إِلَّآ ءَالَ لُوطٍ إِنَّا لَمُنَجُّوهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
ayahs.sahih: Except the family of Lot; indeed, we will save them all
ayahs.clear: “Except for the family of Lot; we will save them all.”
ayahs.kemenag: kecuali Luth beserta pengikut-pengikutnya. Sesungguhnya Kami akan menyelamatkan mereka semuanya,

ayahs.arabic: إِلَّا ٱمْرَأَتَهُۥ قَدَّرْنَآ ۙ إِنَّهَا لَمِنَ ٱلْغَٰبِرِينَ
ayahs.sahih: Except his wife." Allah decreed that she is of those who remain behind.
ayahs.clear: “Except for his wife.” We have determined that she will be of those who lag behind.
ayahs.kemenag: kecuali istrinya. Kami telah menentukan, bahwa sesungguhnya ia itu termasuk orang-orang yang tertinggal (bersama-sama dengan orang kafir lainnya)".

ayahs.arabic: فَلَمَّا جَآءَ ءَالَ لُوطٍ ٱلْمُرْسَلُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And when the messengers came to the family of Lot,
ayahs.clear: And when the envoys came to the family of Lot.
ayahs.kemenag: Maka tatkala para utusan itu datang kepada kaum Luth, beserta pengikut pengikutnya,

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ إِنَّكُمْ قَوْمٌۭ مُّنكَرُونَ
ayahs.sahih: He said, "Indeed, you are people unknown."
ayahs.clear: He said, “You are a people unknown to me.”
ayahs.kemenag: ia berkata: "Sesungguhnya kamu adalah orang-orang yang tidak dikenal".

ayahs.arabic: قَالُوا۟ بَلْ جِئْنَٰكَ بِمَا كَانُوا۟ فِيهِ يَمْتَرُونَ
ayahs.sahih: They said, "But we have come to you with that about which they were disputing,
ayahs.clear: They said, “We bring you what they have doubts about.”
ayahs.kemenag: Para utusan menjawab: "Sebenarnya kami ini datang kepadamu dengan membawa azab yang selalu mereka dustakan.

ayahs.arabic: وَأَتَيْنَٰكَ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَإِنَّا لَصَٰدِقُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And we have come to you with truth, and indeed, we are truthful.
ayahs.clear: “We bring you the truth, and we are truthful.”
ayahs.kemenag: Dan kami datang kepadamu membawa kebenaran dan sesungguhnya kami betul-betul orang-orang benar.

ayahs.arabic: فَأَسْرِ بِأَهْلِكَ بِقِطْعٍۢ مِّنَ ٱلَّيْلِ وَٱتَّبِعْ أَدْبَٰرَهُمْ وَلَا يَلْتَفِتْ مِنكُمْ أَحَدٌۭ وَٱمْضُوا۟ حَيْثُ تُؤْمَرُونَ
ayahs.sahih: So set out with your family during a portion of the night and follow behind them and let not anyone among you look back and continue on to where you are commanded."
ayahs.clear: “Travel with your family at the dead of the night, and follow up behind them, and let none of you look back, and proceed as commanded.”
ayahs.kemenag: Maka pergilah kamu di akhir malam dengan membawa keluargamu, dan ikutlah mereka dari belakang dan janganlah seorangpun di antara kamu menoleh kebelakang dan teruskanlah perjalanan ke tempat yang di perintahkan kepadamu".

ayahs.arabic: وَقَضَيْنَآ إِلَيْهِ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْأَمْرَ أَنَّ دَابِرَ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ مَقْطُوعٌۭ مُّصْبِحِينَ
ayahs.sahih: And We conveyed to him [the decree] of that matter: that those [sinners] would be eliminated by early morning.
ayahs.clear: And We informed him of Our decree: the last remnant of these will be uprooted by early morning.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan telah Kami wahyukan kepadanya (Luth) perkara itu, yaitu bahwa mereka akan ditumpas habis di waktu subuh.

ayahs.arabic: وَجَآءَ أَهْلُ ٱلْمَدِينَةِ يَسْتَبْشِرُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And the people of the city came rejoicing.
ayahs.clear: And the people of the town came joyfully.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan datanglah penduduk kota itu (ke rumah Luth) dengan gembira (karena) kedatangan tamu-tamu itu.

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ إِنَّ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ ضَيْفِى فَلَا تَفْضَحُونِ
ayahs.sahih: [Lot] said, "Indeed, these are my guests, so do not shame me.
ayahs.clear: He said, “These are my guests, so do not embarrass me.”
ayahs.kemenag: Luth berkata: "Sesungguhnya mereka adalah tamuku; maka janganlah kamu memberi malu (kepadaku),

ayahs.arabic: وَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَلَا تُخْزُونِ
ayahs.sahih: And fear Allah and do not disgrace me."
ayahs.clear: “And fear God, and do not disgrace me.”
ayahs.kemenag: dan bertakwalah kepada Allah dan janganlah kamu membuat aku terhina".

ayahs.arabic: قَالُوٓا۟ أَوَلَمْ نَنْهَكَ عَنِ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
ayahs.sahih: They said, "Have we not forbidden you from [protecting] people?"
ayahs.clear: They said, “Did we not forbid you from strangers?”
ayahs.kemenag: Mereka berkata: "Dan bukankah kami telah melarangmu dari (melindungi) manusia?"

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ بَنَاتِىٓ إِن كُنتُمْ فَٰعِلِينَ
ayahs.sahih: [Lot] said, "These are my daughters - if you would be doers [of lawful marriage]."
ayahs.clear: He said, “These are my daughters, if you must.”
ayahs.kemenag: Luth berkata: "Inilah puteri-puteriku (kawinlah dengan mereka), jika kamu hendak berbuat (secara yang halal)".

ayahs.arabic: لَعَمْرُكَ إِنَّهُمْ لَفِى سَكْرَتِهِمْ يَعْمَهُونَ
ayahs.sahih: By your life, [O Muhammad], indeed they were, in their intoxication, wandering blindly.
ayahs.clear: By your life, they were blundering in their drunkenness.
ayahs.kemenag: (Allah berfirman): "Demi umurmu (Muhammad), sesungguhnya mereka terombang-ambing di dalam kemabukan (kesesatan)".

ayahs.arabic: فَأَخَذَتْهُمُ ٱلصَّيْحَةُ مُشْرِقِينَ
ayahs.sahih: So the shriek seized them at sunrise.
ayahs.clear: So the Blast struck them at sunrise.
ayahs.kemenag: Maka mereka dibinasakan oleh suara keras yang mengguntur, ketika matahari akan terbit.

ayahs.arabic: فَجَعَلْنَا عَٰلِيَهَا سَافِلَهَا وَأَمْطَرْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ حِجَارَةًۭ مِّن سِجِّيلٍ
ayahs.sahih: And We made the highest part [of the city] its lowest and rained upon them stones of hard clay.
ayahs.clear: And We turned it upside down, and rained down upon them stones of baked clay.
ayahs.kemenag: Maka Kami jadikan bahagian atas kota itu terbalik ke bawah dan Kami hujani mereka dengan batu dari tanah yang keras.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَٰتٍۢ لِّلْمُتَوَسِّمِينَ
ayahs.sahih: Indeed in that are signs for those who discern.
ayahs.clear: Surely in that are lessons for those who read signs.
ayahs.kemenag: Sesungguhnya pada yang demikian itu benar-benar terdapat tanda-tanda (kekuasaan Allah) bagi orang-orang yang memperhatikan tanda-tanda.

ayahs.arabic: وَإِنَّهَا لَبِسَبِيلٍۢ مُّقِيمٍ
ayahs.sahih: And indeed, those cities are [situated] on an established road.
ayahs.clear: And it is on an existing road.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan sesungguhnya kota itu benar-benar terletak di jalan yang masih tetap (dilalui manusia).

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَةًۭ لِّلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
ayahs.sahih: Indeed in that is a sign for the believers.
ayahs.clear: Surely in that is a sign for the believers.
ayahs.kemenag: Sesungguhnya pada yang demikian itu benar-benar terdapat tanda-tanda (kekuasaan Allah) bagi orang-orang yang beriman.

ayahs.arabic: وَإِن كَانَ أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلْأَيْكَةِ لَظَٰلِمِينَ
ayahs.sahih: And the companions of the thicket were [also] wrongdoers.
ayahs.clear: The people of the Woods were also wrongdoers.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan sesungguhnya adalah penduduk Aikah itu benar-benar kaum yang zalim,

ayahs.arabic: فَٱنتَقَمْنَا مِنْهُمْ وَإِنَّهُمَا لَبِإِمَامٍۢ مُّبِينٍۢ
ayahs.sahih: So We took retribution from them, and indeed, both [cities] are on a clear highway.
ayahs.clear: So We took revenge upon them. Both are clearly documented.
ayahs.kemenag: maka Kami membinasakan mereka. Dan sesungguhnya kedua kota itu benar-benar terletak di jalan umum yang terang.

ayahs.arabic: وَلَقَدْ كَذَّبَ أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلْحِجْرِ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
ayahs.sahih: And certainly did the companions of Thamud deny the messengers.
ayahs.clear: The people of the Rock also rejected the messengers.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan sesungguhnya penduduk-penduduk kota Al Hijr telah mendustakan rasul-rasul,

ayahs.arabic: وَءَاتَيْنَٰهُمْ ءَايَٰتِنَا فَكَانُوا۟ عَنْهَا مُعْرِضِينَ
ayahs.sahih: And We gave them Our signs, but from them they were turning away.
ayahs.clear: We gave them Our revelations, but they turned away from them.
ayahs.kemenag: dan Kami telah mendatangkan kepada mereka tanda-tanda (kekuasaan) Kami, tetapi mereka selalu berpaling daripadanya,

ayahs.arabic: وَكَانُوا۟ يَنْحِتُونَ مِنَ ٱلْجِبَالِ بُيُوتًا ءَامِنِينَ
ayahs.sahih: And they used to carve from the mountains, houses, feeling secure.
ayahs.clear: They used to carve homes in the mountains, feeling secure.
ayahs.kemenag: dan mereka memahat rumah-rumah dari gunung-gunung batu (yang didiami) dengan aman.

ayahs.arabic: فَأَخَذَتْهُمُ ٱلصَّيْحَةُ مُصْبِحِينَ
ayahs.sahih: But the shriek seized them at early morning.
ayahs.clear: But the Blast struck them in the morning.
ayahs.kemenag: Maka mereka dibinasakan oleh suara keras yang mengguntur di waktu pagi,

ayahs.arabic: فَمَآ أَغْنَىٰ عَنْهُم مَّا كَانُوا۟ يَكْسِبُونَ
ayahs.sahih: So nothing availed them [from] what they used to earn.
ayahs.clear: All they had acquired was of no avail to them.
ayahs.kemenag: maka tak dapat menolong mereka, apa yang telah mereka usahakan.

ayahs.arabic: وَمَا خَلَقْنَا ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَآ إِلَّا بِٱلْحَقِّ ۗ وَإِنَّ ٱلسَّاعَةَ لَءَاتِيَةٌۭ ۖ فَٱصْفَحِ ٱلصَّفْحَ ٱلْجَمِيلَ
ayahs.sahih: And We have not created the heavens and earth and that between them except in truth. And indeed, the Hour is coming; so forgive with gracious forgiveness.
ayahs.clear: We did not create the heavens and the earth, and what lies between them, except with truth. The Hour is coming, so forgive with gracious forgiveness.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan tidaklah Kami ciptakan langit dan bumi dan apa yang ada di antara keduanya, melainkan dengan benar. Dan sesungguhnya saat (kiamat) itu pasti akan datang, maka maafkanlah (mereka) dengan cara yang baik.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ ٱلْخَلَّٰقُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
ayahs.sahih: Indeed, your Lord - He is the Knowing Creator.
ayahs.clear: Your Lord is the All-Knowing Creator.
ayahs.kemenag: Sesungguhnya Tuhanmu, Dialah Yang Maha Pencipta lagi Maha Mengetahui.

ayahs.arabic: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَٰكَ سَبْعًۭا مِّنَ ٱلْمَثَانِى وَٱلْقُرْءَانَ ٱلْعَظِيمَ
ayahs.sahih: And We have certainly given you, [O Muhammad], seven of the often repeated [verses] and the great Qur'an.
ayahs.clear: We have given you seven of the pairs, and the Grand Quran.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan sesungguhnya Kami telah berikan kepadamu tujuh ayat yang dibaca berulang-ulang dan Al Quran yang agung.

ayahs.arabic: لَا تَمُدَّنَّ عَيْنَيْكَ إِلَىٰ مَا مَتَّعْنَا بِهِۦٓ أَزْوَٰجًۭا مِّنْهُمْ وَلَا تَحْزَنْ عَلَيْهِمْ وَٱخْفِضْ جَنَاحَكَ لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
ayahs.sahih: Do not extend your eyes toward that by which We have given enjoyment to [certain] categories of the disbelievers, and do not grieve over them. And lower your wing to the believers
ayahs.clear: Do not extend your eyes towards what We have bestowed on some couples of them to enjoy, and do not grieve over them, and lower your wing to the believers.
ayahs.kemenag: Janganlah sekali-kali kamu menunjukkan pandanganmu kepada kenikmatan hidup yang telah Kami berikan kepada beberapa golongan di antara mereka (orang-orang kafir itu), dan janganlah kamu bersedih hati terhadap mereka dan berendah dirilah kamu terhadap orang-orang yang beriman.

ayahs.arabic: وَقُلْ إِنِّىٓ أَنَا ٱلنَّذِيرُ ٱلْمُبِينُ
ayahs.sahih: And say, "Indeed, I am the clear warner" -
ayahs.clear: And say, “I am the clear warner.”
ayahs.kemenag: Dan katakanlah: "Sesungguhnya aku adalah pemberi peringatan yang menjelaskan".

ayahs.arabic: كَمَآ أَنزَلْنَا عَلَى ٱلْمُقْتَسِمِينَ
ayahs.sahih: Just as We had revealed [scriptures] to the separators
ayahs.clear: Just as We sent down to the separatists.
ayahs.kemenag: Sebagaimana (Kami telah memberi peringatan), Kami telah menurunkan (azab) kepada orang-orang yang membagi-bagi (Kitab Allah),

ayahs.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ جَعَلُوا۟ ٱلْقُرْءَانَ عِضِينَ
ayahs.sahih: Who have made the Qur'an into portions.
ayahs.clear: Those who made the Quran obsolete.
ayahs.kemenag: (yaitu) orang-orang yang telah menjadikan Al Quran itu terbagi-bagi.

ayahs.arabic: فَوَرَبِّكَ لَنَسْـَٔلَنَّهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
ayahs.sahih: So by your Lord, We will surely question them all
ayahs.clear: By your Lord, we will question them all.
ayahs.kemenag: Maka demi Tuhanmu, Kami pasti akan menanyai mereka semua,

ayahs.arabic: عَمَّا كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ
ayahs.sahih: About what they used to do.
ayahs.clear: About what they used to do.
ayahs.kemenag: tentang apa yang telah mereka kerjakan dahulu.

ayahs.arabic: فَٱصْدَعْ بِمَا تُؤْمَرُ وَأَعْرِضْ عَنِ ٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ
ayahs.sahih: Then declare what you are commanded and turn away from the polytheists.
ayahs.clear: So proclaim openly what you are commanded, and turn away from the polytheists.
ayahs.kemenag: Maka sampaikanlah olehmu secara terang-terangan segala apa yang diperintahkan (kepadamu) dan berpalinglah dari orang-orang yang musyrik.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّا كَفَيْنَٰكَ ٱلْمُسْتَهْزِءِينَ
ayahs.sahih: Indeed, We are sufficient for you against the mockers
ayahs.clear: We are enough for you against the mockers.
ayahs.kemenag: Sesungguhnya Kami memelihara kamu daripada (kejahatan) orang-orang yang memperolok-olokkan (kamu),

ayahs.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ يَجْعَلُونَ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَٰهًا ءَاخَرَ ۚ فَسَوْفَ يَعْلَمُونَ
ayahs.sahih: Who make [equal] with Allah another deity. But they are going to know.
ayahs.clear: Those who set up another god with God. They will come to know.
ayahs.kemenag: (Yaitu) orang-orang yang menganggap adanya tuhan yang lain di samping Allah; maka mereka kelak akan mengetahui (akibat-akibatnya).

ayahs.arabic: وَلَقَدْ نَعْلَمُ أَنَّكَ يَضِيقُ صَدْرُكَ بِمَا يَقُولُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And We already know that your breast is constrained by what they say.
ayahs.clear: We are aware that your heart is strained by what they say.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan Kami sungguh-sungguh mengetahui, bahwa dadamu menjadi sempit disebabkan apa yang mereka ucapkan,

ayahs.arabic: فَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ وَكُن مِّنَ ٱلسَّٰجِدِينَ
ayahs.sahih: So exalt [Allah] with praise of your Lord and be of those who prostrate [to Him].
ayahs.clear: So glorify the praise of your Lord, and be among those who bow down.
ayahs.kemenag: maka bertasbihlah dengan memuji Tuhanmu dan jadilah kamu di antara orang-orang yang bersujud (shalat),

ayahs.arabic: وَٱعْبُدْ رَبَّكَ حَتَّىٰ يَأْتِيَكَ ٱلْيَقِينُ
ayahs.sahih: And worship your Lord until there comes to you the certainty (death).
ayahs.clear: And worship your Lord in order to attain certainty.
ayahs.kemenag: dan sembahlah Tuhanmu sampai datang kepadamu yang diyakini (ajal).

ayahs.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ أَتَىٰٓ أَمْرُ ٱللَّهِ فَلَا تَسْتَعْجِلُوهُ ۚ سُبْحَٰنَهُۥ وَتَعَٰلَىٰ عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ
ayahs.sahih: The command of Allah is coming, so be not impatient for it. Exalted is He and high above what they associate with Him.
ayahs.clear: The command of God has come, so do not rush it. Glory be to Him; exalted above what they associate.
ayahs.kemenag: Telah pasti datangnya ketetapan Allah maka janganlah kamu meminta agar disegerakan (datang)nya. Maha Suci Allah dan Maha Tinggi dari apa yang mereka persekutukan.

ayahs.arabic: يُنَزِّلُ ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةَ بِٱلرُّوحِ مِنْ أَمْرِهِۦ عَلَىٰ مَن يَشَآءُ مِنْ عِبَادِهِۦٓ أَنْ أَنذِرُوٓا۟ أَنَّهُۥ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّآ أَنَا۠ فَٱتَّقُونِ
ayahs.sahih: He sends down the angels, with the inspiration of His command, upon whom He wills of His servants, [telling them], "Warn that there is no deity except Me; so fear Me."
ayahs.clear: He sends down the angels with the Spirit by His command, upon whom He wills of His servants: “Give warning that there is no god but Me, and fear Me.”
ayahs.kemenag: Dia menurunkan para malaikat dengan (membawa) wahyu dengan perintah-Nya kepada siapa yang Dia kehendaki di antara hamba-hamba-Nya, yaitu: "Peringatkanlah olehmu sekalian, bahwasanya tidak ada Tuhan (yang hak) melainkan Aku, maka hendaklah kamu bertakwa kepada-Ku".

ayahs.arabic: خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ بِٱلْحَقِّ ۚ تَعَٰلَىٰ عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ
ayahs.sahih: He created the heavens and earth in truth. High is He above what they associate with Him.
ayahs.clear: He created the heavens and the earth with justice. He is exalted above the associations they attribute.
ayahs.kemenag: Dia menciptakan langit dan bumi dengan hak. Maha Tinggi Allah daripada apa yang mereka persekutukan.

ayahs.arabic: خَلَقَ ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ مِن نُّطْفَةٍۢ فَإِذَا هُوَ خَصِيمٌۭ مُّبِينٌۭ
ayahs.sahih: He created man from a sperm-drop; then at once, he is a clear adversary.
ayahs.clear: He created the human being from a drop of fluid, yet he becomes an open adversary.
ayahs.kemenag: Dia telah menciptakan manusia dari mani, tiba-tiba ia menjadi pembantah yang nyata.

ayahs.arabic: وَٱلْأَنْعَٰمَ خَلَقَهَا ۗ لَكُمْ فِيهَا دِفْءٌۭ وَمَنَٰفِعُ وَمِنْهَا تَأْكُلُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And the grazing livestock He has created for you; in them is warmth and [numerous] benefits, and from them you eat.
ayahs.clear: And the livestock—He created them for you. In them are warmth and benefits for you, and of them you eat.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan Dia telah menciptakan binatang ternak untuk kamu; padanya ada (bulu) yang menghangatkan dan berbagai-bagai manfaat, dan sebahagiannya kamu makan.

ayahs.arabic: وَلَكُمْ فِيهَا جَمَالٌ حِينَ تُرِيحُونَ وَحِينَ تَسْرَحُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And for you in them is [the enjoyment of] beauty when you bring them in [for the evening] and when you send them out [to pasture].
ayahs.clear: And there is beauty in them for you, when you bring them home, and when you drive them to pasture.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan kamu memperoleh pandangan yang indah padanya, ketika kamu membawanya kembali ke kandang dan ketika kamu melepaskannya ke tempat penggembalaan.

ayahs.arabic: وَتَحْمِلُ أَثْقَالَكُمْ إِلَىٰ بَلَدٍۢ لَّمْ تَكُونُوا۟ بَٰلِغِيهِ إِلَّا بِشِقِّ ٱلْأَنفُسِ ۚ إِنَّ رَبَّكُمْ لَرَءُوفٌۭ رَّحِيمٌۭ
ayahs.sahih: And they carry your loads to a land you could not have reached except with difficulty to yourselves. Indeed, your Lord is Kind and Merciful.
ayahs.clear: And they carry your loads to territory you could not have reached without great hardship. Your Lord is Clement and Merciful.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan ia memikul beban-bebanmu ke suatu negeri yang kamu tidak sanggup sampai kepadanya, melainkan dengan kesukaran-kesukaran (yang memayahkan) diri. Sesungguhnya Tuhanmu benar-benar Maha Pengasih lagi Maha Penyayang,

ayahs.arabic: وَٱلْخَيْلَ وَٱلْبِغَالَ وَٱلْحَمِيرَ لِتَرْكَبُوهَا وَزِينَةًۭ ۚ وَيَخْلُقُ مَا لَا تَعْلَمُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And [He created] the horses, mules and donkeys for you to ride and [as] adornment. And He creates that which you do not know.
ayahs.clear: And the horses, and the mules, and the donkeys—for you to ride, and for luxury. And He creates what you do not know.
ayahs.kemenag: dan (Dia telah menciptakan) kuda, bagal dan keledai, agar kamu menungganginya dan (menjadikannya) perhiasan. Dan Allah menciptakan apa yang kamu tidak mengetahuinya.

ayahs.arabic: وَعَلَى ٱللَّهِ قَصْدُ ٱلسَّبِيلِ وَمِنْهَا جَآئِرٌۭ ۚ وَلَوْ شَآءَ لَهَدَىٰكُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
ayahs.sahih: And upon Allah is the direction of the [right] way, and among the various paths are those deviating. And if He willed, He could have guided you all.
ayahs.clear: It is for God to point out the paths, but some of them are flawed. Had He willed, He could have guided you all.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan hak bagi Allah (menerangkan) jalan yang lurus, dan di antara jalan-jalan ada yang bengkok. Dan jikalau Dia menghendaki, tentulah Dia memimpin kamu semuanya (kepada jalan yang benar).

ayahs.arabic: هُوَ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَنزَلَ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءًۭ ۖ لَّكُم مِّنْهُ شَرَابٌۭ وَمِنْهُ شَجَرٌۭ فِيهِ تُسِيمُونَ
ayahs.sahih: It is He who sends down rain from the sky; from it is drink and from it is foliage in which you pasture [animals].
ayahs.clear: It is He Who sends down for you from the sky water. From it is drink, and with it grows vegetation for grazing.
ayahs.kemenag: Dialah, Yang telah menurunkan air hujan dari langit untuk kamu, sebahagiannya menjadi minuman dan sebahagiannya (menyuburkan) tumbuh-tumbuhan, yang pada (tempat tumbuhnya) kamu menggembalakan ternakmu.

ayahs.arabic: يُنۢبِتُ لَكُم بِهِ ٱلزَّرْعَ وَٱلزَّيْتُونَ وَٱلنَّخِيلَ وَٱلْأَعْنَٰبَ وَمِن كُلِّ ٱلثَّمَرَٰتِ ۗ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَةًۭ لِّقَوْمٍۢ يَتَفَكَّرُونَ
ayahs.sahih: He causes to grow for you thereby the crops, olives, palm trees, grapevines, and from all the fruits. Indeed in that is a sign for a people who give thought.
ayahs.clear: And He produces for you grains with it, and olives, and date-palms, and grapes, and all kinds of fruits. Surely in that is a sign for people who think.
ayahs.kemenag: Dia menumbuhkan bagi kamu dengan air hujan itu tanam-tanaman; zaitun, korma, anggur dan segala macam buah-buahan. Sesungguhnya pada yang demikian itu benar-benar ada tanda (kekuasaan Allah) bagi kaum yang memikirkan.

ayahs.arabic: وَسَخَّرَ لَكُمُ ٱلَّيْلَ وَٱلنَّهَارَ وَٱلشَّمْسَ وَٱلْقَمَرَ ۖ وَٱلنُّجُومُ مُسَخَّرَٰتٌۢ بِأَمْرِهِۦٓ ۗ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَٰتٍۢ لِّقَوْمٍۢ يَعْقِلُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And He has subjected for you the night and day and the sun and moon, and the stars are subjected by His command. Indeed in that are signs for a people who reason.
ayahs.clear: And He regulated for you the night and the day; and the sun, and the moon, and the stars are disposed by His command. Surely in that are signs for people who ponder.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan Dia menundukkan malam dan siang, matahari dan bulan untukmu. Dan bintang-bintang itu ditundukkan (untukmu) dengan perintah-Nya. Sesungguhnya pada yang demikian itu benar-benar ada tanda-tanda (kekuasaan Allah) bagi kaum yang memahami(nya),

ayahs.arabic: وَمَا ذَرَأَ لَكُمْ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ مُخْتَلِفًا أَلْوَٰنُهُۥٓ ۗ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَةًۭ لِّقَوْمٍۢ يَذَّكَّرُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And [He has subjected] whatever He multiplied for you on the earth of varying colors. Indeed in that is a sign for a people who remember.
ayahs.clear: And whatsoever He created for you on earth is of diverse colors. Surely in that is a sign for people who are mindful.
ayahs.kemenag: dan Dia (menundukkan pula) apa yang Dia ciptakan untuk kamu di bumi ini dengan berlain-lainan macamnya. Sesungguhnya pada yang demikian itu benar-benar terdapat tanda (kekuasaan Allah) bagi kaum yang mengambil pelajaran.

ayahs.arabic: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِى سَخَّرَ ٱلْبَحْرَ لِتَأْكُلُوا۟ مِنْهُ لَحْمًۭا طَرِيًّۭا وَتَسْتَخْرِجُوا۟ مِنْهُ حِلْيَةًۭ تَلْبَسُونَهَا وَتَرَى ٱلْفُلْكَ مَوَاخِرَ فِيهِ وَلِتَبْتَغُوا۟ مِن فَضْلِهِۦ وَلَعَلَّكُمْ تَشْكُرُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And it is He who subjected the sea for you to eat from it tender meat and to extract from it ornaments which you wear. And you see the ships plowing through it, and [He subjected it] that you may seek of His bounty; and perhaps you will be grateful.
ayahs.clear: And it is He who made the sea to serve you, that you may eat from it tender meat, and extract from it ornaments that you wear. And you see the ships plowing through it, as you seek His bounties, so that you may give thanks.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan Dialah, Allah yang menundukkan lautan (untukmu), agar kamu dapat memakan daripadanya daging yang segar (ikan), dan kamu mengeluarkan dari lautan itu perhiasan yang kamu pakai; dan kamu melihat bahtera berlayar padanya, dan supaya kamu mencari (keuntungan) dari karunia-Nya, dan supaya kamu bersyukur.

ayahs.arabic: وَأَلْقَىٰ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ رَوَٰسِىَ أَن تَمِيدَ بِكُمْ وَأَنْهَٰرًۭا وَسُبُلًۭا لَّعَلَّكُمْ تَهْتَدُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And He has cast into the earth firmly set mountains, lest it shift with you, and [made] rivers and roads, that you may be guided,
ayahs.clear: And he cast mountains on the earth, lest it shifts with you; and rivers, and roads, so that you may be guided.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan Dia menancapkan gunung-gunung di bumi supaya bumi itu tidak goncang bersama kamu, (dan Dia menciptakan) sungai-sungai dan jalan-jalan agar kamu mendapat petunjuk,

ayahs.arabic: وَعَلَٰمَٰتٍۢ ۚ وَبِٱلنَّجْمِ هُمْ يَهْتَدُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And landmarks. And by the stars they are [also] guided.
ayahs.clear: And landmarks. And by the stars they guide themselves.
ayahs.kemenag: dan (Dia ciptakan) tanda-tanda (penunjuk jalan). Dan dengan bintang-bintang itulah mereka mendapat petunjuk.

ayahs.arabic: أَفَمَن يَخْلُقُ كَمَن لَّا يَخْلُقُ ۗ أَفَلَا تَذَكَّرُونَ
ayahs.sahih: Then is He who creates like one who does not create? So will you not be reminded?
ayahs.clear: Is He who creates like him who does not create? Will you not take a lesson?
ayahs.kemenag: Maka apakah (Allah) yang menciptakan itu sama dengan yang tidak dapat menciptakan (apa-apa)?. Maka mengapa kamu tidak mengambil pelajaran.

ayahs.arabic: وَإِن تَعُدُّوا۟ نِعْمَةَ ٱللَّهِ لَا تُحْصُوهَآ ۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَغَفُورٌۭ رَّحِيمٌۭ
ayahs.sahih: And if you should count the favors of Allah, you could not enumerate them. Indeed, Allah is Forgiving and Merciful.
ayahs.clear: And if you tried to enumerate the favors of God, you will not be able to count them. God is Forgiving and Merciful.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan jika kamu menghitung-hitung nikmat Allah, niscaya kamu tak dapat menentukan jumlahnya. Sesungguhnya Allah benar-benar Maha Pengampun lagi Maha Penyayang.

ayahs.arabic: وَٱللَّهُ يَعْلَمُ مَا تُسِرُّونَ وَمَا تُعْلِنُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And Allah knows what you conceal and what you declare.
ayahs.clear: And God knows what you hide and what you disclose.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan Allah mengetahui apa yang kamu rahasiakan dan apa yang kamu lahirkan.

ayahs.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ يَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ لَا يَخْلُقُونَ شَيْـًۭٔا وَهُمْ يُخْلَقُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And those they invoke other than Allah create nothing, and they [themselves] are created.
ayahs.clear: Those they invoke besides God create nothing, but are themselves created.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan berhala-berhala yang mereka seru selain Allah, tidak dapat membuat sesuatu apapun, sedang berhala-berhala itu (sendiri) dibuat orang.

ayahs.arabic: أَمْوَٰتٌ غَيْرُ أَحْيَآءٍۢ ۖ وَمَا يَشْعُرُونَ أَيَّانَ يُبْعَثُونَ
ayahs.sahih: They are, [in fact], dead, not alive, and they do not perceive when they will be resurrected.
ayahs.clear: They are dead, not alive; and they do not know when they will be resurrected.
ayahs.kemenag: (Berhala-berhala itu) benda mati tidak hidup, dan berhala-berhala tidak mengetahui bilakah penyembah-penyembahnya akan dibangkitkan.

ayahs.arabic: إِلَٰهُكُمْ إِلَٰهٌۭ وَٰحِدٌۭ ۚ فَٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱلْءَاخِرَةِ قُلُوبُهُم مُّنكِرَةٌۭ وَهُم مُّسْتَكْبِرُونَ
ayahs.sahih: Your god is one God. But those who do not believe in the Hereafter - their hearts are disapproving, and they are arrogant.
ayahs.clear: Your God is one God. As for those who do not believe in the Hereafter, their hearts are in denial, and they are arrogant.
ayahs.kemenag: Tuhan kamu adalah Tuhan Yang Maha Esa. Maka orang-orang yang tidak beriman kepada akhirat, hati mereka mengingkari (keesaaan Allah), sedangkan mereka sendiri adalah orang-orang yang sombong.

ayahs.arabic: لَا جَرَمَ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَعْلَمُ مَا يُسِرُّونَ وَمَا يُعْلِنُونَ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ لَا يُحِبُّ ٱلْمُسْتَكْبِرِينَ
ayahs.sahih: Assuredly, Allah knows what they conceal and what they declare. Indeed, He does not like the arrogant.
ayahs.clear: Without a doubt, God knows what they conceal and what they reveal. He does not like the arrogant.
ayahs.kemenag: Tidak diragukan lagi bahwa sesungguhnya Allah mengetahui apa yang mereka rahasiakan dan apa yang mereka lahirkan. Sesungguhnya Allah tidak menyukai orang-orang yang sombong.

ayahs.arabic: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُم مَّاذَآ أَنزَلَ رَبُّكُمْ ۙ قَالُوٓا۟ أَسَٰطِيرُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
ayahs.sahih: And when it is said to them, "What has your Lord sent down?" They say, "Legends of the former peoples,"
ayahs.clear: And when it is said to them, “What has your Lord sent down?” They say, “Legends of the ancients.”
ayahs.kemenag: Dan apabila dikatakan kepada mereka "Apakah yang telah diturunkan Tuhanmu?" Mereka menjawab: "Dongeng-dongengan orang-orang dahulu",

ayahs.arabic: لِيَحْمِلُوٓا۟ أَوْزَارَهُمْ كَامِلَةًۭ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ ۙ وَمِنْ أَوْزَارِ ٱلَّذِينَ يُضِلُّونَهُم بِغَيْرِ عِلْمٍ ۗ أَلَا سَآءَ مَا يَزِرُونَ
ayahs.sahih: That they may bear their own burdens in full on the Day of Resurrection and some of the burdens of those whom they misguide without knowledge. Unquestionably, evil is that which they bear.
ayahs.clear: So let them carry their loads complete on the Day of Resurrection, and some of the loads of those they misguided without knowledge. Evil is what they carry.
ayahs.kemenag: (ucapan mereka) menyebabkan mereka memikul dosa-dosanya dengan sepenuh-penuhnya pada hari kiamat, dan sebahagian dosa-dosa orang yang mereka sesatkan yang tidak mengetahui sedikitpun (bahwa mereka disesatkan). Ingatlah, amat buruklah dosa yang mereka pikul itu.

ayahs.arabic: قَدْ مَكَرَ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ فَأَتَى ٱللَّهُ بُنْيَٰنَهُم مِّنَ ٱلْقَوَاعِدِ فَخَرَّ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلسَّقْفُ مِن فَوْقِهِمْ وَأَتَىٰهُمُ ٱلْعَذَابُ مِنْ حَيْثُ لَا يَشْعُرُونَ
ayahs.sahih: Those before them had already plotted, but Allah came at their building from the foundations, so the roof fell upon them from above them, and the punishment came to them from where they did not perceive.
ayahs.clear: Those before them also schemed, but God took their structures from the foundations, and the roof caved in on them. The punishment came at them from where they did not perceive.
ayahs.kemenag: Sesungguhnya orang-orang yang sebelum mereka telah mengadakan makar, maka Allah menghancurkan rumah-rumah mereka dari fondasinya, lalu atap (rumah itu) jatuh menimpa mereka dari atas, dan datanglah azab itu kepada mereka dari tempat yang tidak mereka sadari.

ayahs.arabic: ثُمَّ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ يُخْزِيهِمْ وَيَقُولُ أَيْنَ شُرَكَآءِىَ ٱلَّذِينَ كُنتُمْ تُشَٰٓقُّونَ فِيهِمْ ۚ قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْعِلْمَ إِنَّ ٱلْخِزْىَ ٱلْيَوْمَ وَٱلسُّوٓءَ عَلَى ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ
ayahs.sahih: Then on the Day of Resurrection He will disgrace them and say, "Where are My 'partners' for whom you used to oppose [the believers]?" Those who were given knowledge will say, "Indeed disgrace, this Day, and evil are upon the disbelievers" -
ayahs.clear: Then, on the Day of Resurrection, He will disgrace them, and say, “Where are My associates for whose sake you used to dispute?” Those who were given knowledge will say, “Today shame and misery are upon the disbelievers.”
ayahs.kemenag: Kemudian Allah menghinakan mereka di hari kiamat, dan berfirman: "Di manakah sekutu-sekutu-Ku itu (yang karena membelanya) kamu selalu memusuhi mereka (nabi-nabi dan orang-orang mukmin)?" Berkatalah orang-orang yang telah diberi ilmu: "Sesungguhnya kehinaan dan azab hari ini ditimpakan atas orang-orang yang kafir",

ayahs.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ تَتَوَفَّىٰهُمُ ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ ظَالِمِىٓ أَنفُسِهِمْ ۖ فَأَلْقَوُا۟ ٱلسَّلَمَ مَا كُنَّا نَعْمَلُ مِن سُوٓءٍۭ ۚ بَلَىٰٓ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلِيمٌۢ بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
ayahs.sahih: The ones whom the angels take in death [while] wronging themselves, and [who] then offer submission, [saying], "We were not doing any evil." But, yes! Indeed, Allah is Knowing of what you used to do.
ayahs.clear: Those wronging their souls while the angels are taking them away—they will propose peace: “We did no wrong.” Yes you did. God is aware of what you used to do.”
ayahs.kemenag: (yaitu) orang-orang yang dimatikan oleh para malaikat dalam keadaan berbuat zalim kepada diri mereka sendiri, lalu mereka menyerah diri (sambil berkata); "Kami sekali-kali tidak ada mengerjakan sesuatu kejahatanpun". (Malaikat menjawab): "Ada, sesungguhnya Allah Maha Mengetahui apa yang telah kamu kerjakan".

ayahs.arabic: فَٱدْخُلُوٓا۟ أَبْوَٰبَ جَهَنَّمَ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَا ۖ فَلَبِئْسَ مَثْوَى ٱلْمُتَكَبِّرِينَ
ayahs.sahih: So enter the gates of Hell to abide eternally therein, and how wretched is the residence of the arrogant.
ayahs.clear: Enter the gates of Hell, to dwell therein forever. Miserable is the residence of the arrogant.
ayahs.kemenag: Maka masukilah pintu-pintu neraka Jahannam, kamu kekal di dalamnya. Maka amat buruklah tempat orang-orang yang menyombongkan diri itu.

ayahs.arabic: ۞ وَقِيلَ لِلَّذِينَ ٱتَّقَوْا۟ مَاذَآ أَنزَلَ رَبُّكُمْ ۚ قَالُوا۟ خَيْرًۭا ۗ لِّلَّذِينَ أَحْسَنُوا۟ فِى هَٰذِهِ ٱلدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةٌۭ ۚ وَلَدَارُ ٱلْءَاخِرَةِ خَيْرٌۭ ۚ وَلَنِعْمَ دَارُ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ
ayahs.sahih: And it will be said to those who feared Allah, "What did your Lord send down?" They will say, "[That which is] good." For those who do good in this world is good; and the home of the Hereafter is better. And how excellent is the home of the righteous -
ayahs.clear: And it will be said to those who maintained piety, “What has your Lord revealed?” They will say, “Goodness.” To those who do good in this world is goodness, and the Home of the Hereafter is even better. How wonderful is the residence of the pious.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan dikatakan kepada orang-orang yang bertakwa: "Apakah yang telah diturunkan oleh Tuhanmu?" Mereka menjawab: "(Allah telah menurunkan) kebaikan". Orang-orang yang berbuat baik di dunia ini mendapat (pembalasan) yang baik. Dan sesungguhnya kampung akhirat adalah lebih baik dan itulah sebaik-baik tempat bagi orang yang bertakwa,

ayahs.arabic: جَنَّٰتُ عَدْنٍۢ يَدْخُلُونَهَا تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَٰرُ ۖ لَهُمْ فِيهَا مَا يَشَآءُونَ ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ يَجْزِى ٱللَّهُ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ
ayahs.sahih: Gardens of perpetual residence, which they will enter, beneath which rivers flow. They will have therein whatever they wish. Thus does Allah reward the righteous -
ayahs.clear: The Gardens of Perpetuity, which they will enter, beneath which rivers flow, where they will have whatever they desire. Thus God rewards the pious.
ayahs.kemenag: (yaitu) surga 'Adn yang mereka masuk ke dalamnya, mengalir di bawahnya sungai-sungai, di dalam surga itu mereka mendapat segala apa yang mereka kehendaki. Demikianlah Allah memberi balasan kepada orang-orang yang bertakwa,

ayahs.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ تَتَوَفَّىٰهُمُ ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ طَيِّبِينَ ۙ يَقُولُونَ سَلَٰمٌ عَلَيْكُمُ ٱدْخُلُوا۟ ٱلْجَنَّةَ بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
ayahs.sahih: The ones whom the angels take in death, [being] good and pure; [the angels] will say, "Peace be upon you. Enter Paradise for what you used to do."
ayahs.clear: Those who are in a wholesome state when the angels take them—will say, “Peace be upon you; enter Paradise, for what you used to do.”
ayahs.kemenag: (yaitu) orang-orang yang diwafatkan dalam keadaan baik oleh para malaikat dengan mengatakan (kepada mereka): "Salaamun'alaikum, masuklah kamu ke dalam surga itu disebabkan apa yang telah kamu kerjakan".

ayahs.arabic: هَلْ يَنظُرُونَ إِلَّآ أَن تَأْتِيَهُمُ ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ أَوْ يَأْتِىَ أَمْرُ رَبِّكَ ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ فَعَلَ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ ۚ وَمَا ظَلَمَهُمُ ٱللَّهُ وَلَٰكِن كَانُوٓا۟ أَنفُسَهُمْ يَظْلِمُونَ
ayahs.sahih: Do the disbelievers await [anything] except that the angels should come to them or there comes the command of your Lord? Thus did those do before them. And Allah wronged them not, but they had been wronging themselves.
ayahs.clear: Are they but waiting for the angels to come to them, or for the command of your Lord to arrive? Those before them did likewise. God did not wrong them, but they used to wrong their own souls.
ayahs.kemenag: Tidak ada yang ditunggu-tunggu orang kafir selain dari datangnya para malaikat kepada mereka atau datangnya perintah Tuhanmu. Demikianlah yang telah diperbuat oleh orang-orang (kafir) sebelum mereka. Dan Allah tidak menganiaya mereka, akan tetapi merekalah yang selalu menganiaya diri mereka sendiri,

ayahs.arabic: فَأَصَابَهُمْ سَيِّـَٔاتُ مَا عَمِلُوا۟ وَحَاقَ بِهِم مَّا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ
ayahs.sahih: So they were struck by the evil consequences of what they did and were enveloped by what they used to ridicule.
ayahs.clear: So the evils of their deeds assailed them, and what they used to ridicule engulfed them.
ayahs.kemenag: Maka mereka ditimpa oleh (akibat) kejahatan perbuatan mereka dan mereka diliputi oleh azab yang selalu mereka perolok-olokan.

ayahs.arabic: وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَشْرَكُوا۟ لَوْ شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ مَا عَبَدْنَا مِن دُونِهِۦ مِن شَىْءٍۢ نَّحْنُ وَلَآ ءَابَآؤُنَا وَلَا حَرَّمْنَا مِن دُونِهِۦ مِن شَىْءٍۢ ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ فَعَلَ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ ۚ فَهَلْ عَلَى ٱلرُّسُلِ إِلَّا ٱلْبَلَٰغُ ٱلْمُبِينُ
ayahs.sahih: And those who associate others with Allah say, "If Allah had willed, we would not have worshipped anything other than Him, neither we nor our fathers, nor would we have forbidden anything through other than Him." Thus did those do before them. So is there upon the messengers except [the duty of] clear notification?
ayahs.clear: The idolaters say, “Had God willed, we would not have worshiped anything besides Him, neither us, nor our ancestors, nor would we have prohibited anything besides His prohibitions.” Those before them did likewise. Are the messengers responsible for anything but clear communication?
ayahs.kemenag: Dan berkatalah orang-orang musyrik: "Jika Allah menghendaki, niscaya kami tidak akan menyembah sesuatu apapun selain Dia, baik kami maupun bapak-bapak kami, dan tidak pula kami mengharamkan sesuatupun tanpa (izin)-Nya". Demikianlah yang diperbuat orang-orang sebelum mereka; maka tidak ada kewajiban atas para rasul, selain dari menyampaikan (amanat Allah) dengan terang.

ayahs.arabic: وَلَقَدْ بَعَثْنَا فِى كُلِّ أُمَّةٍۢ رَّسُولًا أَنِ ٱعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَٱجْتَنِبُوا۟ ٱلطَّٰغُوتَ ۖ فَمِنْهُم مَّنْ هَدَى ٱللَّهُ وَمِنْهُم مَّنْ حَقَّتْ عَلَيْهِ ٱلضَّلَٰلَةُ ۚ فَسِيرُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَٱنظُرُوا۟ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَٰقِبَةُ ٱلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
ayahs.sahih: And We certainly sent into every nation a messenger, [saying], "Worship Allah and avoid Taghut." And among them were those whom Allah guided, and among them were those upon whom error was [deservedly] decreed. So proceed through the earth and observe how was the end of the deniers.
ayahs.clear: To every community We sent a messenger: “Worship God, and avoid idolatry.” Some of them God guided, while others deserved misguidance. So travel through the earth, and see what the fate of the deniers was.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan sungguhnya Kami telah mengutus rasul pada tiap-tiap umat (untuk menyerukan): "Sembahlah Allah (saja), dan jauhilah Thaghut itu", maka di antara umat itu ada orang-orang yang diberi petunjuk oleh Allah dan ada pula di antaranya orang-orang yang telah pasti kesesatan baginya. Maka berjalanlah kamu dimuka bumi dan perhatikanlah bagaimana kesudahan orang-orang yang mendustakan (rasul-rasul).

ayahs.arabic: إِن تَحْرِصْ عَلَىٰ هُدَىٰهُمْ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يَهْدِى مَن يُضِلُّ ۖ وَمَا لَهُم مِّن نَّٰصِرِينَ
ayahs.sahih: [Even] if you should strive for their guidance, [O Muhammad], indeed, Allah does not guide those He sends astray, and they will have no helpers.
ayahs.clear: Even though you may be concerned about their guidance, God does not guide those who misguide. And they will have no saviors.
ayahs.kemenag: Jika kamu sangat mengharapkan agar mereka dapat petunjuk, maka sesungguhnya Allah tiada memberi petunjuk kepada orang yang disesatkan-Nya, dan sekali-kali mereka tiada mempunyai penolong.

ayahs.arabic: وَأَقْسَمُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ جَهْدَ أَيْمَٰنِهِمْ ۙ لَا يَبْعَثُ ٱللَّهُ مَن يَمُوتُ ۚ بَلَىٰ وَعْدًا عَلَيْهِ حَقًّۭا وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَ ٱلنَّاسِ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And they swear by Allah their strongest oaths [that] Allah will not resurrect one who dies. But yes - [it is] a true promise [binding] upon Him, but most of the people do not know.
ayahs.clear: And they swear by God with their most solemn oaths, “God will not resurrect anyone who dies.” Yes indeed, it is a promise binding on Him, but most people do not know.
ayahs.kemenag: Mereka bersumpah dengan nama Allah dengan sumpahnya yang sungguh-sungguh: "Allah tidak akan akan membangkitkan orang yang mati". (Tidak demikian), bahkan (pasti Allah akan membangkitnya), sebagai suatu janji yang benar dari Allah, akan tetapi kebanyakan manusia tiada mengetahui,

ayahs.arabic: لِيُبَيِّنَ لَهُمُ ٱلَّذِى يَخْتَلِفُونَ فِيهِ وَلِيَعْلَمَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓا۟ أَنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ كَٰذِبِينَ
ayahs.sahih: [It is] so He will make clear to them [the truth of] that wherein they differ and so those who have disbelieved may know that they were liars.
ayahs.clear: To clarify for them what they differed about, and for the faithless to know that they were liars.
ayahs.kemenag: agar Allah menjelaskan kepada mereka apa yang mereka perselisihkan itu, agar orang-orang kafir itu mengetahui bahwasanya mereka adalah orang-orang yang berdusta.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّمَا قَوْلُنَا لِشَىْءٍ إِذَآ أَرَدْنَٰهُ أَن نَّقُولَ لَهُۥ كُن فَيَكُونُ
ayahs.sahih: Indeed, Our word to a thing when We intend it is but that We say to it, "Be," and it is.
ayahs.clear: When We intend for something to happen, We say to it, “Be,” and it becomes.
ayahs.kemenag: Sesungguhnya perkataan Kami terhadap sesuatu apabila Kami menghendakinya, Kami hanya mengatakan kepadanya: "kun (jadilah)", maka jadilah ia.

ayahs.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ هَاجَرُوا۟ فِى ٱللَّهِ مِنۢ بَعْدِ مَا ظُلِمُوا۟ لَنُبَوِّئَنَّهُمْ فِى ٱلدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةًۭ ۖ وَلَأَجْرُ ٱلْءَاخِرَةِ أَكْبَرُ ۚ لَوْ كَانُوا۟ يَعْلَمُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And those who emigrated for [the cause of] Allah after they had been wronged - We will surely settle them in this world in a good place; but the reward of the Hereafter is greater, if only they could know.
ayahs.clear: Those who emigrate for God’s sake after being persecuted, We will settle them in a good place in this world; but the reward of the Hereafter is greater, if they only knew.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan orang-orang yang berhijrah karena Allah sesudah mereka dianiaya, pasti Kami akan memberikan tempat yang bagus kepada mereka di dunia. Dan sesungguhnya pahala di akhirat adalah lebih besar, kalau mereka mengetahui,

ayahs.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ صَبَرُوا۟ وَعَلَىٰ رَبِّهِمْ يَتَوَكَّلُونَ
ayahs.sahih: [They are] those who endured patiently and upon their Lord relied.
ayahs.clear: Those who endure patiently, and in their Lord they put their trust.
ayahs.kemenag: (yaitu) orang-orang yang sabar dan hanya kepada Tuhan saja mereka bertawakkal.

ayahs.arabic: وَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَا مِن قَبْلِكَ إِلَّا رِجَالًۭا نُّوحِىٓ إِلَيْهِمْ ۚ فَسْـَٔلُوٓا۟ أَهْلَ ٱلذِّكْرِ إِن كُنتُمْ لَا تَعْلَمُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And We sent not before you except men to whom We revealed [Our message]. So ask the people of the message if you do not know.
ayahs.clear: We did not send before you except men whom We inspired. So ask the people of knowledge, if you do not know.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan Kami tidak mengutus sebelum kamu, kecuali orang-orang lelaki yang Kami beri wahyu kepada mereka; maka bertanyalah kepada orang yang mempunyai pengetahuan jika kamu tidak mengetahui,

ayahs.arabic: بِٱلْبَيِّنَٰتِ وَٱلزُّبُرِ ۗ وَأَنزَلْنَآ إِلَيْكَ ٱلذِّكْرَ لِتُبَيِّنَ لِلنَّاسِ مَا نُزِّلَ إِلَيْهِمْ وَلَعَلَّهُمْ يَتَفَكَّرُونَ
ayahs.sahih: [We sent them] with clear proofs and written ordinances. And We revealed to you the message that you may make clear to the people what was sent down to them and that they might give thought.
ayahs.clear: With the clarifications and the scriptures. And We revealed to you the Reminder, that you may clarify to the people what was revealed to them, and that they may reflect.
ayahs.kemenag: keterangan-keterangan (mukjizat) dan kitab-kitab. Dan Kami turunkan kepadamu Al Quran, agar kamu menerangkan pada umat manusia apa yang telah diturunkan kepada mereka dan supaya mereka memikirkan,

ayahs.arabic: أَفَأَمِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ مَكَرُوا۟ ٱلسَّيِّـَٔاتِ أَن يَخْسِفَ ٱللَّهُ بِهِمُ ٱلْأَرْضَ أَوْ يَأْتِيَهُمُ ٱلْعَذَابُ مِنْ حَيْثُ لَا يَشْعُرُونَ
ayahs.sahih: Then, do those who have planned evil deeds feel secure that Allah will not cause the earth to swallow them or that the punishment will not come upon them from where they do not perceive?
ayahs.clear: Do those who scheme evils feel secure that God will not cause the earth to cave in with them, or that the punishment will not come upon them from where they do not perceive?
ayahs.kemenag: maka apakah orang-orang yang membuat makar yang jahat itu, merasa aman (dari bencana) ditenggelamkannya bumi oleh Allah bersama mereka, atau datangnya azab kepada mereka dari tempat yang tidak mereka sadari,

ayahs.arabic: أَوْ يَأْخُذَهُمْ فِى تَقَلُّبِهِمْ فَمَا هُم بِمُعْجِزِينَ
ayahs.sahih: Or that He would not seize them during their [usual] activity, and they could not cause failure?
ayahs.clear: Or that He will not seize them during their activities? And they will not be able to prevent it.
ayahs.kemenag: atau Allah mengazab mereka diwaktu mereka dalam perjalanan, maka sekali-kali mereka tidak dapat menolak (azab itu),

ayahs.arabic: أَوْ يَأْخُذَهُمْ عَلَىٰ تَخَوُّفٍۢ فَإِنَّ رَبَّكُمْ لَرَءُوفٌۭ رَّحِيمٌ
ayahs.sahih: Or that He would not seize them gradually [in a state of dread]? But indeed, your Lord is Kind and Merciful.
ayahs.clear: Or that He will not seize them while in dread? Your Lord is Gentle and Merciful.
ayahs.kemenag: atau Allah mengazab mereka dengan berangsur-angsur (sampai binasa). Maka sesungguhnya Tuhanmu adalah Maha Pengasih lagi Maha Penyayang.

ayahs.arabic: أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ إِلَىٰ مَا خَلَقَ ٱللَّهُ مِن شَىْءٍۢ يَتَفَيَّؤُا۟ ظِلَٰلُهُۥ عَنِ ٱلْيَمِينِ وَٱلشَّمَآئِلِ سُجَّدًۭا لِّلَّهِ وَهُمْ دَٰخِرُونَ
ayahs.sahih: Have they not considered what things Allah has created? Their shadows incline to the right and to the left, prostrating to Allah, while they are humble.
ayahs.clear: Have they not observed what God has created? Their shadows revolve from the right and the left, bowing to God as they shrink away.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan apakah mereka tidak memperhatikan segala sesuatu yang telah diciptakan Allah yang bayangannya berbolak-balik ke kanan dan ke kiri dalam keadaan sujud kepada Allah, sedang mereka berendah diri?

ayahs.arabic: وَلِلَّهِ يَسْجُدُ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ مِن دَآبَّةٍۢ وَٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ وَهُمْ لَا يَسْتَكْبِرُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And to Allah prostrates whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth of creatures, and the angels [as well], and they are not arrogant.
ayahs.clear: To God bows down everything in the heavens and everything on earth—every living creature, and the angels, and without being proud.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan kepada Allah sajalah bersujud segala apa yang berada di langit dan semua makhluk yang melata di bumi dan (juga) para ma]aikat, sedang mereka (malaikat) tidak menyombongkan diri.

ayahs.arabic: يَخَافُونَ رَبَّهُم مِّن فَوْقِهِمْ وَيَفْعَلُونَ مَا يُؤْمَرُونَ ۩
ayahs.sahih: They fear their Lord above them, and they do what they are commanded.
ayahs.clear: They fear their Lord above them, and they do what they are commanded.
ayahs.kemenag: Mereka takut kepada Tuhan mereka yang di atas mereka dan melaksanakan apa yang diperintahkan (kepada mereka).

ayahs.arabic: ۞ وَقَالَ ٱللَّهُ لَا تَتَّخِذُوٓا۟ إِلَٰهَيْنِ ٱثْنَيْنِ ۖ إِنَّمَا هُوَ إِلَٰهٌۭ وَٰحِدٌۭ ۖ فَإِيَّٰىَ فَٱرْهَبُونِ
ayahs.sahih: And Allah has said, "Do not take for yourselves two deities. He is but one God, so fear only Me."
ayahs.clear: God has said: “Do not take two gods; He is only One God; so fear only Me.”
ayahs.kemenag: Allah berfirman: "Janganlah kamu menyembah dua tuhan; sesungguhnya Dialah Tuhan Yang Maha Esa, maka hendaklah kepada-Ku saja kamu takut".

ayahs.arabic: وَلَهُۥ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَهُ ٱلدِّينُ وَاصِبًا ۚ أَفَغَيْرَ ٱللَّهِ تَتَّقُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And to Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and the earth, and to Him is [due] worship constantly. Then is it other than Allah that you fear?
ayahs.clear: To Him belongs everything in the heavens and the earth; and to Him obedience is due always. Do you, then, fear anyone other than God?
ayahs.kemenag: Dan kepunyaan-Nya-lah segala apa yang ada di langit dan di bumi, dan untuk-Nya-lah ketaatan itu selama-lamanya. Maka mengapa kamu bertakwa kepada selain Allah?

ayahs.arabic: وَمَا بِكُم مِّن نِّعْمَةٍۢ فَمِنَ ٱللَّهِ ۖ ثُمَّ إِذَا مَسَّكُمُ ٱلضُّرُّ فَإِلَيْهِ تَجْـَٔرُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And whatever you have of favor - it is from Allah. Then when adversity touches you, to Him you cry for help.
ayahs.clear: Whatever blessing you have is from God. And when harm touches you, it is to Him that you groan.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan apa saja nikmat yang ada pada kamu, maka dari Allah-lah (datangnya), dan bila kamu ditimpa oleh kemudharatan, maka hanya kepada-Nya-lah kamu meminta pertolongan.

ayahs.arabic: ثُمَّ إِذَا كَشَفَ ٱلضُّرَّ عَنكُمْ إِذَا فَرِيقٌۭ مِّنكُم بِرَبِّهِمْ يُشْرِكُونَ
ayahs.sahih: Then when He removes the adversity from you, at once a party of you associates others with their Lord
ayahs.clear: But when He lifts the harm from you, some of you associate others with their Lord.
ayahs.kemenag: Kemudian apabila Dia telah menghilangkan kemudharatan itu dari pada kamu, tiba-tiba sebahagian dari pada kamu mempersekutukan Tuhannya dengan (yang lain),

ayahs.arabic: لِيَكْفُرُوا۟ بِمَآ ءَاتَيْنَٰهُمْ ۚ فَتَمَتَّعُوا۟ ۖ فَسَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ
ayahs.sahih: So they will deny what We have given them. Then enjoy yourselves, for you are going to know.
ayahs.clear: To show ingratitude for what We have given them. Enjoy yourselves. You will soon know.
ayahs.kemenag: Biarlah mereka mengingkari nikmat yang telah Kami berikan kepada mereka; maka bersenang-senanglah kamu. Kelak kamu akan mengetahui (akibatnya).

ayahs.arabic: وَيَجْعَلُونَ لِمَا لَا يَعْلَمُونَ نَصِيبًۭا مِّمَّا رَزَقْنَٰهُمْ ۗ تَٱللَّهِ لَتُسْـَٔلُنَّ عَمَّا كُنتُمْ تَفْتَرُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And they assign to what they do not know a portion of that which We have provided them. By Allah, you will surely be questioned about what you used to invent.
ayahs.clear: And they allocate, to something they do not know, a share of what We have provided for them. By God, you will be questioned about what you have been inventing.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan mereka sediakan untuk berhala-berhala yang mereka tiada mengetahui (kekuasaannya), satu bahagian dari rezeki yang telah Kami berikan kepada mereka. Demi Allah, sesungguhnya kamu akan ditanyai tentang apa yang telah kamu ada-adakan.

ayahs.arabic: وَيَجْعَلُونَ لِلَّهِ ٱلْبَنَٰتِ سُبْحَٰنَهُۥ ۙ وَلَهُم مَّا يَشْتَهُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And they attribute to Allah daughters - exalted is He - and for them is what they desire.
ayahs.clear: And they attribute to God daughters—exalted is He—and for themselves what they desire.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan mereka menetapkan bagi Allah anak-anak perempuan. Maha Suci Allah, sedang untuk mereka sendiri (mereka tetapkan) apa yang mereka sukai (yaitu anak-anak laki-laki).

ayahs.arabic: وَإِذَا بُشِّرَ أَحَدُهُم بِٱلْأُنثَىٰ ظَلَّ وَجْهُهُۥ مُسْوَدًّۭا وَهُوَ كَظِيمٌۭ
ayahs.sahih: And when one of them is informed of [the birth of] a female, his face becomes dark, and he suppresses grief.
ayahs.clear: And when one of them is given news of a female infant, his face darkens, and he chokes with grief.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan apabila seseorang dari mereka diberi kabar dengan (kelahiran) anak perempuan, hitamlah (merah padamlah) mukanya, dan dia sangat marah.

ayahs.arabic: يَتَوَٰرَىٰ مِنَ ٱلْقَوْمِ مِن سُوٓءِ مَا بُشِّرَ بِهِۦٓ ۚ أَيُمْسِكُهُۥ عَلَىٰ هُونٍ أَمْ يَدُسُّهُۥ فِى ٱلتُّرَابِ ۗ أَلَا سَآءَ مَا يَحْكُمُونَ
ayahs.sahih: He hides himself from the people because of the ill of which he has been informed. Should he keep it in humiliation or bury it in the ground? Unquestionably, evil is what they decide.
ayahs.clear: He hides from the people because of the bad news given to him. Shall he keep it in humiliation, or bury it in the dust? Evil is the decision they make.
ayahs.kemenag: Ia menyembunyikan dirinya dari orang banyak, disebabkan buruknya berita yang disampaikan kepadanya. Apakah dia akan memeliharanya dengan menanggung kehinaan ataukah akan menguburkannya ke dalam tanah (hidup-hidup)?. Ketahuilah, alangkah buruknya apa yang mereka tetapkan itu.

ayahs.arabic: لِلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱلْءَاخِرَةِ مَثَلُ ٱلسَّوْءِ ۖ وَلِلَّهِ ٱلْمَثَلُ ٱلْأَعْلَىٰ ۚ وَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ
ayahs.sahih: For those who do not believe in the Hereafter is the description of evil; and for Allah is the highest attribute. And He is Exalted in Might, the Wise.
ayahs.clear: Those who do not believe in the Hereafter set a bad example, while God sets the Highest Example. He is the Mighty, the Wise.
ayahs.kemenag: Orang-orang yang tidak beriman kepada kehidupan akhirat, mempunyai sifat yang buruk; dan Allah mempunyai sifat yang Maha Tinggi; dan Dialah Yang Maha Perkasa lagi Maha Bijaksana.

ayahs.arabic: وَلَوْ يُؤَاخِذُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلنَّاسَ بِظُلْمِهِم مَّا تَرَكَ عَلَيْهَا مِن دَآبَّةٍۢ وَلَٰكِن يُؤَخِّرُهُمْ إِلَىٰٓ أَجَلٍۢ مُّسَمًّۭى ۖ فَإِذَا جَآءَ أَجَلُهُمْ لَا يَسْتَـْٔخِرُونَ سَاعَةًۭ ۖ وَلَا يَسْتَقْدِمُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And if Allah were to impose blame on the people for their wrongdoing, He would not have left upon the earth any creature, but He defers them for a specified term. And when their term has come, they will not remain behind an hour, nor will they precede [it].
ayahs.clear: If God were to hold mankind for their injustices, He would not leave upon it a single creature, but He postpones them until an appointed time. Then, when their time arrives, they will not delay it by one hour, nor will they advance it.
ayahs.kemenag: Jikalau Allah menghukum manusia karena kezalimannya, niscaya tidak akan ditinggalkan-Nya di muka bumi sesuatupun dari makhluk yang melata, tetapi Allah menangguhkan mereka sampai kepada waktu yang ditentukan. Maka apabila telah tiba waktunya (yang ditentukan) bagi mereka, tidaklah mereka dapat mengundurkannya barang sesaatpun dan tidak (pula) mendahulukannya.

ayahs.arabic: وَيَجْعَلُونَ لِلَّهِ مَا يَكْرَهُونَ وَتَصِفُ أَلْسِنَتُهُمُ ٱلْكَذِبَ أَنَّ لَهُمُ ٱلْحُسْنَىٰ ۖ لَا جَرَمَ أَنَّ لَهُمُ ٱلنَّارَ وَأَنَّهُم مُّفْرَطُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And they attribute to Allah that which they dislike, and their tongues assert the lie that they will have the best [from Him]. Assuredly, they will have the Fire, and they will be [therein] neglected.
ayahs.clear: And they attribute to God what they themselves dislike, while their tongues utter the lie that theirs is the goodness. Without a doubt, for them is the Fire, and they will be neglected.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan mereka menetapkan bagi Allah apa yang mereka sendiri membencinya, dan lidah mereka mengucapkan kedustaan, yaitu bahwa sesungguhnya merekalah yang akan mendapat kebaikan. Tiadalah diragukan bahwa nerakalah bagi mereka, dan sesungguhnya mereka segera dimasukkan (ke dalamnya).

ayahs.arabic: تَٱللَّهِ لَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَىٰٓ أُمَمٍۢ مِّن قَبْلِكَ فَزَيَّنَ لَهُمُ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنُ أَعْمَٰلَهُمْ فَهُوَ وَلِيُّهُمُ ٱلْيَوْمَ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌۭ
ayahs.sahih: By Allah, We did certainly send [messengers] to nations before you, but Satan made their deeds attractive to them. And he is the disbelievers' ally today [as well], and they will have a painful punishment.
ayahs.clear: By God, We sent messengers to communities before you, but Satan made their deeds appear alluring to them. He is their master today, and they will have a painful punishment.
ayahs.kemenag: Demi Allah, sesungguhnya Kami telah mengutus rasul-rasul Kami kepada umat-umat sebelum kamu, tetapi syaitan menjadikan umat-umat itu memandang baik perbuatan mereka (yang buruk), maka syaitan menjadi pemimpin mereka di hari itu dan bagi mereka azab yang sangat pedih.

ayahs.arabic: وَمَآ أَنزَلْنَا عَلَيْكَ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ إِلَّا لِتُبَيِّنَ لَهُمُ ٱلَّذِى ٱخْتَلَفُوا۟ فِيهِ ۙ وَهُدًۭى وَرَحْمَةًۭ لِّقَوْمٍۢ يُؤْمِنُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And We have not revealed to you the Book, [O Muhammad], except for you to make clear to them that wherein they have differed and as guidance and mercy for a people who believe.
ayahs.clear: We revealed to you the Scripture only to clarify for them what they differ about, and guidance and mercy for people who believe.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan Kami tidak menurunkan kepadamu Al-Kitab (Al Quran) ini, melainkan agar kamu dapat menjelaskan kepada mereka apa yang mereka perselisihkan itu dan menjadi petunjuk dan rahmat bagi kaum yang beriman.

ayahs.arabic: وَٱللَّهُ أَنزَلَ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءًۭ فَأَحْيَا بِهِ ٱلْأَرْضَ بَعْدَ مَوْتِهَآ ۚ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَةًۭ لِّقَوْمٍۢ يَسْمَعُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And Allah has sent down rain from the sky and given life thereby to the earth after its lifelessness. Indeed in that is a sign for a people who listen.
ayahs.clear: God sends down water from the sky, with which He revives the earth after its death. In this is a sign for people who listen.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan Allah menurunkan dari langit air (hujan) dan dengan air itu dihidupkan-Nya bumi sesudah matinya. Sesungguhnya pada yang demikian itu benar-benar terdapat tanda-tanda (kebesaran Tuhan) bagi orang-orang yang mendengarkan (pelajaran).

ayahs.arabic: وَإِنَّ لَكُمْ فِى ٱلْأَنْعَٰمِ لَعِبْرَةًۭ ۖ نُّسْقِيكُم مِّمَّا فِى بُطُونِهِۦ مِنۢ بَيْنِ فَرْثٍۢ وَدَمٍۢ لَّبَنًا خَالِصًۭا سَآئِغًۭا لِّلشَّٰرِبِينَ
ayahs.sahih: And indeed, for you in grazing livestock is a lesson. We give you drink from what is in their bellies - between excretion and blood - pure milk, palatable to drinkers.
ayahs.clear: And there is a lesson for you in cattle: We give you a drink from their bellies, from between waste and blood, pure milk, refreshing to the drinkers.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan sesungguhnya pada binatang ternak itu benar-benar terdapat pelajaran bagi kamu. Kami memberimu minum dari pada apa yang berada dalam perutnya (berupa) susu yang bersih antara tahi dan darah, yang mudah ditelan bagi orang-orang yang meminumnya.

ayahs.arabic: وَمِن ثَمَرَٰتِ ٱلنَّخِيلِ وَٱلْأَعْنَٰبِ تَتَّخِذُونَ مِنْهُ سَكَرًۭا وَرِزْقًا حَسَنًا ۗ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَةًۭ لِّقَوْمٍۢ يَعْقِلُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And from the fruits of the palm trees and grapevines you take intoxicant and good provision. Indeed in that is a sign for a people who reason.
ayahs.clear: And from the fruits of date-palms and grapevines, you derive sugar and wholesome food. In this is a sign for people who understand.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan dari buah korma dan anggur, kamu buat minimuman yang memabukkan dan rezeki yang baik. Sesunggguhnya pada yang demikian itu benar-benar terdapat tanda (kebesaran Allah) bagi orang yang memikirkan.

ayahs.arabic: وَأَوْحَىٰ رَبُّكَ إِلَى ٱلنَّحْلِ أَنِ ٱتَّخِذِى مِنَ ٱلْجِبَالِ بُيُوتًۭا وَمِنَ ٱلشَّجَرِ وَمِمَّا يَعْرِشُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And your Lord inspired to the bee, "Take for yourself among the mountains, houses, and among the trees and [in] that which they construct.
ayahs.clear: And your Lord inspired the bee: “Set up hives in the mountains, and in the trees, and in what they construct.”
ayahs.kemenag: Dan Tuhanmu mewahyukan kepada lebah: "Buatlah sarang-sarang di bukit-bukit, di pohon-pohon kayu, dan di tempat-tempat yang dibikin manusia",

ayahs.arabic: ثُمَّ كُلِى مِن كُلِّ ٱلثَّمَرَٰتِ فَٱسْلُكِى سُبُلَ رَبِّكِ ذُلُلًۭا ۚ يَخْرُجُ مِنۢ بُطُونِهَا شَرَابٌۭ مُّخْتَلِفٌ أَلْوَٰنُهُۥ فِيهِ شِفَآءٌۭ لِّلنَّاسِ ۗ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَةًۭ لِّقَوْمٍۢ يَتَفَكَّرُونَ
ayahs.sahih: Then eat from all the fruits and follow the ways of your Lord laid down [for you]." There emerges from their bellies a drink, varying in colors, in which there is healing for people. Indeed in that is a sign for a people who give thought.
ayahs.clear: Then eat of all the fruits, and go along the pathways of your Lord, with precision. From their bellies emerges a fluid of diverse colors, containing healing for the people. Surely in this is a sign for people who reflect.
ayahs.kemenag: kemudian makanlah dari tiap-tiap (macam) buah-buahan dan tempuhlah jalan Tuhanmu yang telah dimudahkan (bagimu). Dari perut lebah itu ke luar minuman (madu) yang bermacam-macam warnanya, di dalamnya terdapat obat yang menyembuhkan bagi manusia. Sesungguhnya pada yang demikian itu benar-benar terdapat tanda (kebesaran Tuhan) bagi orang-orang yang memikirkan.

ayahs.arabic: وَٱللَّهُ خَلَقَكُمْ ثُمَّ يَتَوَفَّىٰكُمْ ۚ وَمِنكُم مَّن يُرَدُّ إِلَىٰٓ أَرْذَلِ ٱلْعُمُرِ لِكَىْ لَا يَعْلَمَ بَعْدَ عِلْمٍۢ شَيْـًٔا ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلِيمٌۭ قَدِيرٌۭ
ayahs.sahih: And Allah created you; then He will take you in death. And among you is he who is reversed to the most decrepit [old] age so that he will not know, after [having had] knowledge, a thing. Indeed, Allah is Knowing and Competent.
ayahs.clear: God created you; then He takes you away. Some of you will be brought back to the worst age, so that he will no longer know anything, after having acquired knowledge. God is Omniscient and Omnipotent.
ayahs.kemenag: Allah menciptakan kamu, kemudian mewafatkan kamu; dan di antara kamu ada yang dikembalikan kepada umur yang paling lemah (pikun), supaya dia tidak mengetahui lagi sesuatupun yang pernah diketahuinya. Sesungguhnya Allah Maha Mengetahui lagi Maha Kuasa.

ayahs.arabic: وَٱللَّهُ فَضَّلَ بَعْضَكُمْ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍۢ فِى ٱلرِّزْقِ ۚ فَمَا ٱلَّذِينَ فُضِّلُوا۟ بِرَآدِّى رِزْقِهِمْ عَلَىٰ مَا مَلَكَتْ أَيْمَٰنُهُمْ فَهُمْ فِيهِ سَوَآءٌ ۚ أَفَبِنِعْمَةِ ٱللَّهِ يَجْحَدُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And Allah has favored some of you over others in provision. But those who were favored would not hand over their provision to those whom their right hands possess so they would be equal to them therein. Then is it the favor of Allah they reject?
ayahs.clear: God has favored some of you over others in livelihood. Those who are favored would not give their properties to their servants, to the extent of making them partners in it. Will they then renounce God’s blessings?
ayahs.kemenag: Dan Allah melebihkan sebahagian kamu dari sebagian yang lain dalam hal rezeki, tetapi orang-orang yang dilebihkan (rezekinya itu) tidak mau memberikan rezeki mereka kepada budak-budak yang mereka miliki, agar mereka sama (merasakan) rezeki itu. Maka mengapa mereka mengingkari nikmat Allah?.

ayahs.arabic: وَٱللَّهُ جَعَلَ لَكُم مِّنْ أَنفُسِكُمْ أَزْوَٰجًۭا وَجَعَلَ لَكُم مِّنْ أَزْوَٰجِكُم بَنِينَ وَحَفَدَةًۭ وَرَزَقَكُم مِّنَ ٱلطَّيِّبَٰتِ ۚ أَفَبِٱلْبَٰطِلِ يُؤْمِنُونَ وَبِنِعْمَتِ ٱللَّهِ هُمْ يَكْفُرُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And Allah has made for you from yourselves mates and has made for you from your mates sons and grandchildren and has provided for you from the good things. Then in falsehood do they believe and in the favor of Allah they disbelieve?
ayahs.clear: God has given you mates from among yourselves; and has produced for you, from your mates, children and grandchildren; and has provided you with good things. Will they then believe in falsehood, and refuse God’s favors?
ayahs.kemenag: Allah menjadikan bagi kamu isteri-isteri dari jenis kamu sendiri dan menjadikan bagimu dari isteri-isteri kamu itu, anak-anak dan cucu-cucu, dan memberimu rezeki dari yang baik-baik. Maka mengapakah mereka beriman kepada yang bathil dan mengingkari nikmat Allah?"

ayahs.arabic: وَيَعْبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ مَا لَا يَمْلِكُ لَهُمْ رِزْقًۭا مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ شَيْـًۭٔا وَلَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And they worship besides Allah that which does not possess for them [the power of] provision from the heavens and the earth at all, and [in fact], they are unable.
ayahs.clear: And yet they serve besides God what possesses no provisions for them in the heavens, nor on earth, nor are they capable.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan mereka menyembah selain Allah, sesuatu yang tidak dapat memberikan rezeki kepada mereka sedikitpun dari langit dan bumi, dan tidak berkuasa (sedikit juapun).

ayahs.arabic: فَلَا تَضْرِبُوا۟ لِلَّهِ ٱلْأَمْثَالَ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَعْلَمُ وَأَنتُمْ لَا تَعْلَمُونَ
ayahs.sahih: So do not assert similarities to Allah. Indeed, Allah knows and you do not know.
ayahs.clear: So do not cite the examples for God. God knows, and you do not know.
ayahs.kemenag: Maka janganlah kamu mengadakan sekutu-sekutu bagi Allah. Sesungguhnya Allah mengetahui, sedang kamu tidak mengetahui.

ayahs.arabic: ۞ ضَرَبَ ٱللَّهُ مَثَلًا عَبْدًۭا مَّمْلُوكًۭا لَّا يَقْدِرُ عَلَىٰ شَىْءٍۢ وَمَن رَّزَقْنَٰهُ مِنَّا رِزْقًا حَسَنًۭا فَهُوَ يُنفِقُ مِنْهُ سِرًّۭا وَجَهْرًا ۖ هَلْ يَسْتَوُۥنَ ۚ ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ ۚ بَلْ أَكْثَرُهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
ayahs.sahih: Allah presents an example: a slave [who is] owned and unable to do a thing and he to whom We have provided from Us good provision, so he spends from it secretly and publicly. Can they be equal? Praise to Allah! But most of them do not know.
ayahs.clear: God cites the example of a bonded slave, who has no power over anything; and someone to whom We have given plentiful provision, from which he gives secretly and openly. Are they equal in comparison? All praise belongs to God, but most of them do not know.
ayahs.kemenag: Allah membuat perumpamaan dengan seorang hamba sahaya yang dimiliki yang tidak dapat bertindak terhadap sesuatupun dan seorang yang Kami beri rezeki yang baik dari Kami, lalu dia menafkahkan sebagian dari rezeki itu secara sembunyi dan secara terang-terangan, adakah mereka itu sama? Segala puji hanya bagi Allah, tetapi kebanyakan mereka tiada mengetahui.

ayahs.arabic: وَضَرَبَ ٱللَّهُ مَثَلًۭا رَّجُلَيْنِ أَحَدُهُمَآ أَبْكَمُ لَا يَقْدِرُ عَلَىٰ شَىْءٍۢ وَهُوَ كَلٌّ عَلَىٰ مَوْلَىٰهُ أَيْنَمَا يُوَجِّههُّ لَا يَأْتِ بِخَيْرٍ ۖ هَلْ يَسْتَوِى هُوَ وَمَن يَأْمُرُ بِٱلْعَدْلِ ۙ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ صِرَٰطٍۢ مُّسْتَقِيمٍۢ
ayahs.sahih: And Allah presents an example of two men, one of them dumb and unable to do a thing, while he is a burden to his guardian. Wherever he directs him, he brings no good. Is he equal to one who commands justice, while he is on a straight path?
ayahs.clear: And God cites the example of two men: one of them dumb, unable to do anything, and is a burden on his master; whichever way he directs him, he achieves nothing good. Is he equal to him who commands justice, and is on a straight path?
ayahs.kemenag: Dan Allah membuat (pula) perumpamaan: dua orang lelaki yang seorang bisu, tidak dapat berbuat sesuatupun dan dia menjadi beban atas penanggungnya, ke mana saja dia disuruh oleh penanggungnya itu, dia tidak dapat mendatangkan suatu kebajikanpun. Samakah orang itu dengan orang yang menyuruh berbuat keadilan, dan dia berada pula di atas jalan yang lurus?

ayahs.arabic: وَلِلَّهِ غَيْبُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ وَمَآ أَمْرُ ٱلسَّاعَةِ إِلَّا كَلَمْحِ ٱلْبَصَرِ أَوْ هُوَ أَقْرَبُ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ قَدِيرٌۭ
ayahs.sahih: And to Allah belongs the unseen [aspects] of the heavens and the earth. And the command for the Hour is not but as a glance of the eye or even nearer. Indeed, Allah is over all things competent.
ayahs.clear: To God belongs the unseen of the heavens and the earth. The coming of the Hour is only as the twinkling of the eye, or even nearer. God has power over everything.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan kepunyaan Allah-lah segala apa yang tersembunyi di langit dan di bumi. Tidak adalah kejadian kiamat itu, melainkan seperti sekejap mata atau lebih cepat (lagi). Sesungguhnya Allah Maha Kuasa atas segala sesuatu.

ayahs.arabic: وَٱللَّهُ أَخْرَجَكُم مِّنۢ بُطُونِ أُمَّهَٰتِكُمْ لَا تَعْلَمُونَ شَيْـًۭٔا وَجَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلسَّمْعَ وَٱلْأَبْصَٰرَ وَٱلْأَفْـِٔدَةَ ۙ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَشْكُرُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And Allah has extracted you from the wombs of your mothers not knowing a thing, and He made for you hearing and vision and intellect that perhaps you would be grateful.
ayahs.clear: God brought you out of your mothers’ wombs, not knowing anything; and He gave you the hearing, and the eyesight, and the brains; that you may give thanks.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan Allah mengeluarkan kamu dari perut ibumu dalam keadaan tidak mengetahui sesuatupun, dan Dia memberi kamu pendengaran, penglihatan dan hati, agar kamu bersyukur.

ayahs.arabic: أَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ إِلَى ٱلطَّيْرِ مُسَخَّرَٰتٍۢ فِى جَوِّ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَا يُمْسِكُهُنَّ إِلَّا ٱللَّهُ ۗ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَٰتٍۢ لِّقَوْمٍۢ يُؤْمِنُونَ
ayahs.sahih: Do they not see the birds controlled in the atmosphere of the sky? None holds them up except Allah. Indeed in that are signs for a people who believe.
ayahs.clear: Have they not seen the birds, flying in the midst of the sky? None sustains them except God. In this are signs for people who believe.
ayahs.kemenag: Tidakkah mereka memperhatikan burung-burung yang dimudahkan terbang diangkasa bebas. Tidak ada yang menahannya selain daripada Allah. Sesungguhnya pada yang demikian itu benar-benar terdapat tanda-tanda (kebesaran Tuhan) bagi orang-orang yang beriman.

ayahs.arabic: وَٱللَّهُ جَعَلَ لَكُم مِّنۢ بُيُوتِكُمْ سَكَنًۭا وَجَعَلَ لَكُم مِّن جُلُودِ ٱلْأَنْعَٰمِ بُيُوتًۭا تَسْتَخِفُّونَهَا يَوْمَ ظَعْنِكُمْ وَيَوْمَ إِقَامَتِكُمْ ۙ وَمِنْ أَصْوَافِهَا وَأَوْبَارِهَا وَأَشْعَارِهَآ أَثَٰثًۭا وَمَتَٰعًا إِلَىٰ حِينٍۢ
ayahs.sahih: And Allah has made for you from your homes a place of rest and made for you from the hides of the animals tents which you find light on your day of travel and your day of encampment; and from their wool, fur and hair is furnishing and enjoyment for a time.
ayahs.clear: And God has given you in your homes habitats for you, and has provided for you out of the hides of livestock portable homes for you, so you can use them when you travel, and when you camp; and from their wool, and fur, and hair, furnishings and comfort for a while.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan Allah menjadikan bagimu rumah-rumahmu sebagai tempat tinggal dan Dia menjadikan bagi kamu rumah-rumah (kemah-kemah) dari kulit binatang ternak yang kamu merasa ringan (membawa)nya di waktu kamu berjalan dan waktu kamu bermukim dan (dijadikan-Nya pula) dari bulu domba, bulu unta dan bulu kambing, alat-alat rumah tangga dan perhiasan (yang kamu pakai) sampai waktu (tertentu).

ayahs.arabic: وَٱللَّهُ جَعَلَ لَكُم مِّمَّا خَلَقَ ظِلَٰلًۭا وَجَعَلَ لَكُم مِّنَ ٱلْجِبَالِ أَكْنَٰنًۭا وَجَعَلَ لَكُمْ سَرَٰبِيلَ تَقِيكُمُ ٱلْحَرَّ وَسَرَٰبِيلَ تَقِيكُم بَأْسَكُمْ ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ يُتِمُّ نِعْمَتَهُۥ عَلَيْكُمْ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُسْلِمُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And Allah has made for you, from that which He has created, shadows and has made for you from the mountains, shelters and has made for you garments which protect you from the heat and garments which protect you from your [enemy in] battle. Thus does He complete His favor upon you that you might submit [to Him].
ayahs.clear: And God has made for you shade out of what He has created, and has given you resorts in the mountains, and has given you garments to protect you from the heat, and garments to protect you from your violence. Thus He completes His blessings upon you, so that you may submit.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan Allah menjadikan bagimu tempat bernaung dari apa yang telah Dia ciptakan, dan Dia jadikan bagimu tempat-tempat tinggal di gunung-gunung, dan Dia jadikan bagimu pakaian yang memeliharamu dari panas dan pakaian (baju besi) yang memelihara kamu dalam peperangan. Demikianlah Allah menyempurnakan nikmat-Nya atasmu agar kamu berserah diri (kepada-Nya).

ayahs.arabic: فَإِن تَوَلَّوْا۟ فَإِنَّمَا عَلَيْكَ ٱلْبَلَٰغُ ٱلْمُبِينُ
ayahs.sahih: But if they turn away, [O Muhammad] - then only upon you is [responsibility for] clear notification.
ayahs.clear: But if they turn away, your only duty is clear communication.
ayahs.kemenag: Jika mereka tetap berpaling, maka sesungguhnya kewajiban yang dibebankan atasmu (Muhammad) hanyalah menyampaikan (amanat Allah) dengan terang.

ayahs.arabic: يَعْرِفُونَ نِعْمَتَ ٱللَّهِ ثُمَّ يُنكِرُونَهَا وَأَكْثَرُهُمُ ٱلْكَٰفِرُونَ
ayahs.sahih: They recognize the favor of Allah; then they deny it. And most of them are disbelievers.
ayahs.clear: They recognize God’s blessing, but then deny it, as most of them are ungrateful.
ayahs.kemenag: Mereka mengetahui nikmat Allah, kemudian mereka mengingkarinya dan kebanyakan mereka adalah orang-orang yang kafir.

ayahs.arabic: وَيَوْمَ نَبْعَثُ مِن كُلِّ أُمَّةٍۢ شَهِيدًۭا ثُمَّ لَا يُؤْذَنُ لِلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ وَلَا هُمْ يُسْتَعْتَبُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And [mention] the Day when We will resurrect from every nation a witness. Then it will not be permitted to the disbelievers [to apologize or make excuses], nor will they be asked to appease [Allah].
ayahs.clear: On the Day when We raise up a witness from every community—those who disbelieved will not be permitted, nor will they be excused.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan (ingatlah) akan hari (ketika) Kami bangkitkan dari tiap-tiap umat seorang saksi (rasul), kemudian tidak diizinkan kepada orang-orang yang kafir (untuk membela diri) dan tidak (pula) mereka dibolehkan meminta maaf.

ayahs.arabic: وَإِذَا رَءَا ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ ٱلْعَذَابَ فَلَا يُخَفَّفُ عَنْهُمْ وَلَا هُمْ يُنظَرُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And when those who wronged see the punishment, it will not be lightened for them, nor will they be reprieved.
ayahs.clear: When those who did wrong see the punishment, it will not be lightened for them, nor will they be reprieved.
