ayahs.kemenag: Dia berkata: "Jika kamu mengikutiku, maka janganlah kamu menanyakan kepadaku tentang sesuatu apapun, sampai aku sendiri menerangkannya kepadamu".

ayahs.arabic: فَٱنطَلَقَا حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا رَكِبَا فِى ٱلسَّفِينَةِ خَرَقَهَا ۖ قَالَ أَخَرَقْتَهَا لِتُغْرِقَ أَهْلَهَا لَقَدْ جِئْتَ شَيْـًٔا إِمْرًۭا
ayahs.sahih: So they set out, until when they had embarked on the ship, al-Khidh r tore it open. [Moses] said, "Have you torn it open to drown its people? You have certainly done a grave thing."
ayahs.clear: So they set out. Until, when they had boarded the boat, he holed it. He said, “Did you hole it, to drown its passengers? You have done something awful.”
ayahs.kemenag: Maka berjalanlah keduanya, hingga tatkala keduanya menaiki perahu lalu Khidhr melobanginya. Musa berkata: "Mengapa kamu melobangi perahu itu akibatnya kamu menenggelamkan penumpangnya?" Sesungguhnya kamu telah berbuat sesuatu kesalahan yang besar.

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ أَلَمْ أَقُلْ إِنَّكَ لَن تَسْتَطِيعَ مَعِىَ صَبْرًۭا
ayahs.sahih: [Al-Khidh r] said, "Did I not say that with me you would never be able to have patience?"
ayahs.clear: He said, “Did I not tell you that you will not be able to endure with me?”
ayahs.kemenag: Dia (Khidhr) berkata: "Bukankah aku telah berkata: "Sesungguhnya kamu sekali-kali tidak akan sabar bersama dengan aku".

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ لَا تُؤَاخِذْنِى بِمَا نَسِيتُ وَلَا تُرْهِقْنِى مِنْ أَمْرِى عُسْرًۭا
ayahs.sahih: [Moses] said, "Do not blame me for what I forgot and do not cover me in my matter with difficulty."
ayahs.clear: He said, “Do not rebuke me for forgetting, and do not make my course difficult for me.”
ayahs.kemenag: Musa berkata: "Janganlah kamu menghukum aku karena kelupaanku dan janganlah kamu membebani aku dengan sesuatu kesulitan dalam urusanku".

ayahs.arabic: فَٱنطَلَقَا حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا لَقِيَا غُلَٰمًۭا فَقَتَلَهُۥ قَالَ أَقَتَلْتَ نَفْسًۭا زَكِيَّةًۢ بِغَيْرِ نَفْسٍۢ لَّقَدْ جِئْتَ شَيْـًۭٔا نُّكْرًۭا
ayahs.sahih: So they set out, until when they met a boy, al-Khidh r killed him. [Moses] said, "Have you killed a pure soul for other than [having killed] a soul? You have certainly done a deplorable thing."
ayahs.clear: Then they set out. Until, when they encountered a boy, he killed him. He said, “Did you kill a pure soul, who killed no one? You have done something terrible.”
ayahs.kemenag: Maka berjalanlah keduanya; hingga tatkala keduanya berjumpa dengan seorang anak, maka Khidhr membunuhnya. Musa berkata: "Mengapa kamu membunuh jiwa yang bersih, bukan karena dia membunuh orang lain? Sesungguhnya kamu telah melakukan suatu yang mungkar".

ayahs.arabic: ۞ قَالَ أَلَمْ أَقُل لَّكَ إِنَّكَ لَن تَسْتَطِيعَ مَعِىَ صَبْرًۭا
ayahs.sahih: [Al-Khidh r] said, "Did I not tell you that with me you would never be able to have patience?"
ayahs.clear: He said, “Did I not tell you that you will not be able to endure with me?”
ayahs.kemenag: Khidhr berkata: "Bukankah sudah kukatakan kepadamu, bahwa sesungguhnya kamu tidak akan dapat sabar bersamaku?"

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ إِن سَأَلْتُكَ عَن شَىْءٍۭ بَعْدَهَا فَلَا تُصَٰحِبْنِى ۖ قَدْ بَلَغْتَ مِن لَّدُنِّى عُذْرًۭا
ayahs.sahih: [Moses] said, "If I should ask you about anything after this, then do not keep me as a companion. You have obtained from me an excuse."
ayahs.clear: He said, “If I ask you about anything after this, then do not keep company with me. You have received excuses from me.”
ayahs.kemenag: Musa berkata: "Jika aku bertanya kepadamu tentang sesuatu sesudah (kali) ini, maka janganlah kamu memperbolehkan aku menyertaimu, sesungguhnya kamu sudah cukup memberikan uzur padaku".

ayahs.arabic: فَٱنطَلَقَا حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَآ أَتَيَآ أَهْلَ قَرْيَةٍ ٱسْتَطْعَمَآ أَهْلَهَا فَأَبَوْا۟ أَن يُضَيِّفُوهُمَا فَوَجَدَا فِيهَا جِدَارًۭا يُرِيدُ أَن يَنقَضَّ فَأَقَامَهُۥ ۖ قَالَ لَوْ شِئْتَ لَتَّخَذْتَ عَلَيْهِ أَجْرًۭا
ayahs.sahih: So they set out, until when they came to the people of a town, they asked its people for food, but they refused to offer them hospitality. And they found therein a wall about to collapse, so al-Khidh r restored it. [Moses] said, "If you wished, you could have taken for it a payment."
ayahs.clear: So they set out. Until, when they reached the people of a town, they asked them for food, but they refused to offer them hospitality. There they found a wall about to collapse, and he repaired it. He said, “If you wanted, you could have obtained a payment for it.”
ayahs.kemenag: Maka keduanya berjalan; hingga tatkala keduanya sampai kepada penduduk suatu negeri, mereka minta dijamu kepada penduduk negeri itu, tetapi penduduk negeri itu tidak mau menjamu mereka, kemudian keduanya mendapatkan dalam negeri itu dinding rumah yang hampir roboh, maka Khidhr menegakkan dinding itu. Musa berkata: "Jikalau kamu mau, niscaya kamu mengambil upah untuk itu".

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ هَٰذَا فِرَاقُ بَيْنِى وَبَيْنِكَ ۚ سَأُنَبِّئُكَ بِتَأْوِيلِ مَا لَمْ تَسْتَطِع عَّلَيْهِ صَبْرًا
ayahs.sahih: [Al-Khidh r] said, "This is parting between me and you. I will inform you of the interpretation of that about which you could not have patience.
ayahs.clear: He said, “This is the parting between you and me. I will tell you the interpretation of what you were unable to endure.
ayahs.kemenag: Khidhr berkata: "Inilah perpisahan antara aku dengan kamu; kelak akan kuberitahukan kepadamu tujuan perbuatan-perbuatan yang kamu tidak dapat sabar terhadapnya.

ayahs.arabic: أَمَّا ٱلسَّفِينَةُ فَكَانَتْ لِمَسَٰكِينَ يَعْمَلُونَ فِى ٱلْبَحْرِ فَأَرَدتُّ أَنْ أَعِيبَهَا وَكَانَ وَرَآءَهُم مَّلِكٌۭ يَأْخُذُ كُلَّ سَفِينَةٍ غَصْبًۭا
ayahs.sahih: As for the ship, it belonged to poor people working at sea. So I intended to cause defect in it as there was after them a king who seized every [good] ship by force.
ayahs.clear: As for the boat, it belonged to paupers working at sea. I wanted to damage it because there was a king coming after them seizing every boat by force.
ayahs.kemenag: Adapun bahtera itu adalah kepunyaan orang-orang miskin yang bekerja di laut, dan aku bertujuan merusakkan bahtera itu, karena di hadapan mereka ada seorang raja yang merampas tiap-tiap bahtera.

ayahs.arabic: وَأَمَّا ٱلْغُلَٰمُ فَكَانَ أَبَوَاهُ مُؤْمِنَيْنِ فَخَشِينَآ أَن يُرْهِقَهُمَا طُغْيَٰنًۭا وَكُفْرًۭا
ayahs.sahih: And as for the boy, his parents were believers, and we feared that he would overburden them by transgression and disbelief.
ayahs.clear: As for the boy, his parents were believers, and we feared he would overwhelm them with oppression and disbelief.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan adapun anak muda itu, maka keduanya adalah orang-orang mukmin, dan kami khawatir bahwa dia akan mendorong kedua orang tuanya itu kepada kesesatan dan kekafiran.

ayahs.arabic: فَأَرَدْنَآ أَن يُبْدِلَهُمَا رَبُّهُمَا خَيْرًۭا مِّنْهُ زَكَوٰةًۭ وَأَقْرَبَ رُحْمًۭا
ayahs.sahih: So we intended that their Lord should substitute for them one better than him in purity and nearer to mercy.
ayahs.clear: So we wanted their Lord to replace him with someone better in purity, and closer to mercy.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan kami menghendaki, supaya Tuhan mereka mengganti bagi mereka dengan anak lain yang lebih baik kesuciannya dari anaknya itu dan lebih dalam kasih sayangnya (kepada ibu bapaknya).

ayahs.arabic: وَأَمَّا ٱلْجِدَارُ فَكَانَ لِغُلَٰمَيْنِ يَتِيمَيْنِ فِى ٱلْمَدِينَةِ وَكَانَ تَحْتَهُۥ كَنزٌۭ لَّهُمَا وَكَانَ أَبُوهُمَا صَٰلِحًۭا فَأَرَادَ رَبُّكَ أَن يَبْلُغَآ أَشُدَّهُمَا وَيَسْتَخْرِجَا كَنزَهُمَا رَحْمَةًۭ مِّن رَّبِّكَ ۚ وَمَا فَعَلْتُهُۥ عَنْ أَمْرِى ۚ ذَٰلِكَ تَأْوِيلُ مَا لَمْ تَسْطِع عَّلَيْهِ صَبْرًۭا
ayahs.sahih: And as for the wall, it belonged to two orphan boys in the city, and there was beneath it a treasure for them, and their father had been righteous. So your Lord intended that they reach maturity and extract their treasure, as a mercy from your Lord. And I did it not of my own accord. That is the interpretation of that about which you could not have patience."
ayahs.clear: And as for the wall, it belonged to two orphaned boys in the town. Beneath it was a treasure that belonged to them. Their father was a righteous man. Your Lord wanted them to reach their maturity, and then extract their treasure—as a mercy from your Lord. I did not do it of my own accord. This is the interpretation of what you were unable to endure.”
ayahs.kemenag: Adapun dinding rumah adalah kepunyaan dua orang anak yatim di kota itu, dan di bawahnya ada harta benda simpanan bagi mereka berdua, sedang ayahnya adalah seorang yang saleh, maka Tuhanmu menghendaki agar supaya mereka sampai kepada kedewasaannya dan mengeluarkan simpanannya itu, sebagai rahmat dari Tuhanmu; dan bukanlah aku melakukannya itu menurut kemauanku sendiri. Demikian itu adalah tujuan perbuatan-perbuatan yang kamu tidak dapat sabar terhadapnya".

ayahs.arabic: وَيَسْـَٔلُونَكَ عَن ذِى ٱلْقَرْنَيْنِ ۖ قُلْ سَأَتْلُوا۟ عَلَيْكُم مِّنْهُ ذِكْرًا
ayahs.sahih: And they ask you, [O Muhammad], about Dhul-Qarnayn. Say, "I will recite to you about him a report."
ayahs.clear: And they ask you about Zul-Qarnain. Say, “I will tell you something about him.”
ayahs.kemenag: Mereka akan bertanya kepadamu (Muhammad) tentang Dzulkarnain. Katakanlah: "Aku akan bacakan kepadamu cerita tantangnya".

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّا مَكَّنَّا لَهُۥ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَءَاتَيْنَٰهُ مِن كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ سَبَبًۭا
ayahs.sahih: Indeed We established him upon the earth, and We gave him to everything a way.
ayahs.clear: We established him on earth, and gave him all kinds of means.
ayahs.kemenag: Sesungguhnya Kami telah memberi kekuasaan kepadanya di (muka) bumi, dan Kami telah memberikan kepadanya jalan (untuk mencapai) segala sesuatu,

ayahs.arabic: فَأَتْبَعَ سَبَبًا
ayahs.sahih: So he followed a way
ayahs.clear: He pursued a certain course.
ayahs.kemenag: maka diapun menempuh suatu jalan.

ayahs.arabic: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا بَلَغَ مَغْرِبَ ٱلشَّمْسِ وَجَدَهَا تَغْرُبُ فِى عَيْنٍ حَمِئَةٍۢ وَوَجَدَ عِندَهَا قَوْمًۭا ۗ قُلْنَا يَٰذَا ٱلْقَرْنَيْنِ إِمَّآ أَن تُعَذِّبَ وَإِمَّآ أَن تَتَّخِذَ فِيهِمْ حُسْنًۭا
ayahs.sahih: Until, when he reached the setting of the sun, he found it [as if] setting in a spring of dark mud, and he found near it a people. Allah said, "O Dhul-Qarnayn, either you punish [them] or else adopt among them [a way of] goodness."
ayahs.clear: Until, when he reached the setting of the sun, he found it setting in a murky spring, and found a people in its vicinity. We said, “O Zul-Qarnain, you may either inflict a penalty, or else treat them kindly.”
ayahs.kemenag: Hingga apabila dia telah sampai ketempat terbenam matahari, dia melihat matahari terbenam di dalam laut yang berlumpur hitam, dan dia mendapati di situ segolongan umat. Kami berkata: "Hai Dzulkarnain, kamu boleh menyiksa atau boleh berbuat kebaikan terhadap mereka.

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ أَمَّا مَن ظَلَمَ فَسَوْفَ نُعَذِّبُهُۥ ثُمَّ يُرَدُّ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ فَيُعَذِّبُهُۥ عَذَابًۭا نُّكْرًۭا
ayahs.sahih: He said, "As for one who wrongs, we will punish him. Then he will be returned to his Lord, and He will punish him with a terrible punishment.
ayahs.clear: He said, “As for him who does wrong, we will penalize him, then he will be returned to his Lord, and He will punish him with an unheard-of torment.
ayahs.kemenag: Berkata Dzulkarnain: "Adapun orang yang aniaya, maka kami kelak akan mengazabnya, kemudian dia kembalikan kepada Tuhannya, lalu Tuhan mengazabnya dengan azab yang tidak ada taranya.

ayahs.arabic: وَأَمَّا مَنْ ءَامَنَ وَعَمِلَ صَٰلِحًۭا فَلَهُۥ جَزَآءً ٱلْحُسْنَىٰ ۖ وَسَنَقُولُ لَهُۥ مِنْ أَمْرِنَا يُسْرًۭا
ayahs.sahih: But as for one who believes and does righteousness, he will have a reward of Paradise, and we will speak to him from our command with ease."
ayahs.clear: “But as for him who believes and acts righteously, he will have the finest reward, and We will speak to him of Our command with ease.”
ayahs.kemenag: Adapun orang-orang yang beriman dan beramal saleh, maka baginya pahala yang terbaik sebagai balasan, dan akan kami titahkan kepadanya (perintah) yang mudah dari perintah-perintah kami".

ayahs.arabic: ثُمَّ أَتْبَعَ سَبَبًا
ayahs.sahih: Then he followed a way
ayahs.clear: Then he pursued a course.
ayahs.kemenag: Kemudian dia menempuh jalan (yang lain).

ayahs.arabic: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا بَلَغَ مَطْلِعَ ٱلشَّمْسِ وَجَدَهَا تَطْلُعُ عَلَىٰ قَوْمٍۢ لَّمْ نَجْعَل لَّهُم مِّن دُونِهَا سِتْرًۭا
ayahs.sahih: Until, when he came to the rising of the sun, he found it rising on a people for whom We had not made against it any shield.
ayahs.clear: Until, when he reached the rising of the sun, he found it rising on a people for whom We had provided no shelter from it.
ayahs.kemenag: Hingga apabila dia telah sampai ke tempat terbit matahari (sebelah Timur) dia mendapati matahari itu menyinari segolongan umat yang Kami tidak menjadikan bagi mereka sesuatu yang melindunginya dari (cahaya) matahari itu,

ayahs.arabic: كَذَٰلِكَ وَقَدْ أَحَطْنَا بِمَا لَدَيْهِ خُبْرًۭا
ayahs.sahih: Thus. And We had encompassed [all] that he had in knowledge.
ayahs.clear: And so it was. We had full knowledge of what he had.
ayahs.kemenag: demikianlah. dan sesungguhnya ilmu Kami meliputi segala apa yang ada padanya.

ayahs.arabic: ثُمَّ أَتْبَعَ سَبَبًا
ayahs.sahih: Then he followed a way
ayahs.clear: Then he pursued a course.
ayahs.kemenag: Kemudian dia menempuh suatu jalan (yang lain lagi).

ayahs.arabic: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا بَلَغَ بَيْنَ ٱلسَّدَّيْنِ وَجَدَ مِن دُونِهِمَا قَوْمًۭا لَّا يَكَادُونَ يَفْقَهُونَ قَوْلًۭا
ayahs.sahih: Until, when he reached [a pass] between two mountains, he found beside them a people who could hardly understand [his] speech.
ayahs.clear: Until, when he reached the point separating the two barriers, he found beside them a people who could barely understand what is said.
ayahs.kemenag: Hingga apabila dia telah sampai di antara dua buah gunung, dia mendapati di hadapan kedua bukit itu suatu kaum yang hampir tidak mengerti pembicaraan.

ayahs.arabic: قَالُوا۟ يَٰذَا ٱلْقَرْنَيْنِ إِنَّ يَأْجُوجَ وَمَأْجُوجَ مُفْسِدُونَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَهَلْ نَجْعَلُ لَكَ خَرْجًا عَلَىٰٓ أَن تَجْعَلَ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَهُمْ سَدًّۭا
ayahs.sahih: They said, "O Dhul-Qarnayn, indeed Gog and Magog are [great] corrupters in the land. So may we assign for you an expenditure that you might make between us and them a barrier?"
ayahs.clear: They said, “O Zul-Qarnain, the Gog and Magog are spreading chaos in the land. Can we pay you, to build between us and them a wall?”
ayahs.kemenag: Mereka berkata: "Hai Dzulkarnain, sesungguhnya Ya'juj dan Ma'juj itu orang-orang yang membuat kerusakan di muka bumi, maka dapatkah kami memberikan sesuatu pembayaran kepadamu, supaya kamu membuat dinding antara kami dan mereka?"

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ مَا مَكَّنِّى فِيهِ رَبِّى خَيْرٌۭ فَأَعِينُونِى بِقُوَّةٍ أَجْعَلْ بَيْنَكُمْ وَبَيْنَهُمْ رَدْمًا
ayahs.sahih: He said, "That in which my Lord has established me is better [than what you offer], but assist me with strength; I will make between you and them a dam.
ayahs.clear: He said, “What my Lord has empowered me with is better. But assist me with strength, and I will build between you and them a dam.”
ayahs.kemenag: Dzulkarnain berkata: "Apa yang telah dikuasakan oleh Tuhanku kepadaku terhadapnya adalah lebih baik, maka tolonglah aku dengan kekuatan (manusia dan alat-alat), agar aku membuatkan dinding antara kamu dan mereka,

ayahs.arabic: ءَاتُونِى زُبَرَ ٱلْحَدِيدِ ۖ حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا سَاوَىٰ بَيْنَ ٱلصَّدَفَيْنِ قَالَ ٱنفُخُوا۟ ۖ حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا جَعَلَهُۥ نَارًۭا قَالَ ءَاتُونِىٓ أُفْرِغْ عَلَيْهِ قِطْرًۭا
ayahs.sahih: Bring me sheets of iron" - until, when he had leveled [them] between the two mountain walls, he said, "Blow [with bellows]," until when he had made it [like] fire, he said, "Bring me, that I may pour over it molten copper."
ayahs.clear: “Bring me blocks of iron.” So that, when he had leveled up between the two cliffs, he said, “Blow.” And having turned it into a fire, he said, “Bring me tar to pour over it.”
ayahs.kemenag: berilah aku potongan-potongan besi". Hingga apabila besi itu telah sama rata dengan kedua (puncak) gunung itu, berkatalah Dzulkarnain: "Tiuplah (api itu)". Hingga apabila besi itu sudah menjadi (merah seperti) api, diapun berkata: "Berilah aku tembaga (yang mendidih) agar aku kutuangkan ke atas besi panas itu".

ayahs.arabic: فَمَا ٱسْطَٰعُوٓا۟ أَن يَظْهَرُوهُ وَمَا ٱسْتَطَٰعُوا۟ لَهُۥ نَقْبًۭا
ayahs.sahih: So Gog and Magog were unable to pass over it, nor were they able [to effect] in it any penetration.
ayahs.clear: So they were unable to climb it, and they could not penetrate it.
ayahs.kemenag: Maka mereka tidak bisa mendakinya dan mereka tidak bisa (pula) melobanginya.

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ هَٰذَا رَحْمَةٌۭ مِّن رَّبِّى ۖ فَإِذَا جَآءَ وَعْدُ رَبِّى جَعَلَهُۥ دَكَّآءَ ۖ وَكَانَ وَعْدُ رَبِّى حَقًّۭا
ayahs.sahih: [Dhul-Qarnayn] said, "This is a mercy from my Lord; but when the promise of my Lord comes, He will make it level, and ever is the promise of my Lord true."
ayahs.clear: He said, “This is a mercy from my Lord. But when the promise of my Lord comes true, He will turn it into rubble, and the promise of my Lord is always true.”
ayahs.kemenag: Dzulkarnain berkata: "Ini (dinding) adalah rahmat dari Tuhanku, maka apabila sudah datang janji Tuhanku, Dia akan menjadikannya hancur luluh; dan janji Tuhanku itu adalah benar".

ayahs.arabic: ۞ وَتَرَكْنَا بَعْضَهُمْ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ يَمُوجُ فِى بَعْضٍۢ ۖ وَنُفِخَ فِى ٱلصُّورِ فَجَمَعْنَٰهُمْ جَمْعًۭا
ayahs.sahih: And We will leave them that day surging over each other, and [then] the Horn will be blown, and We will assemble them in [one] assembly.
ayahs.clear: On that Day, We will leave them surging upon one another. And the Trumpet will be blown, and We will gather them together.
ayahs.kemenag: Kami biarkan mereka di hari itu bercampur aduk antara satu dengan yang lain, kemudian ditiup lagi sangkakala, lalu Kami kumpulkan mereka itu semuanya,

ayahs.arabic: وَعَرَضْنَا جَهَنَّمَ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ لِّلْكَٰفِرِينَ عَرْضًا
ayahs.sahih: And We will present Hell that Day to the Disbelievers, on display -
ayahs.clear: On that Day, We will present the disbelievers to Hell, all displayed.
ayahs.kemenag: dan Kami nampakkan Jahannam pada hari itu kepada orang-orang kafir dengan jelas,

ayahs.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ كَانَتْ أَعْيُنُهُمْ فِى غِطَآءٍ عَن ذِكْرِى وَكَانُوا۟ لَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ سَمْعًا
ayahs.sahih: Those whose eyes had been within a cover [removed] from My remembrance, and they were not able to hear.
ayahs.clear: Those whose eyes were screened to My message, and were unable to hear.
ayahs.kemenag: yaitu orang-orang yang matanya dalam keadaan tertutup dari memperhatikan tanda-tanda kebesaran-Ku, dan adalah mereka tidak sanggup mendengar.

ayahs.arabic: أَفَحَسِبَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓا۟ أَن يَتَّخِذُوا۟ عِبَادِى مِن دُونِىٓ أَوْلِيَآءَ ۚ إِنَّآ أَعْتَدْنَا جَهَنَّمَ لِلْكَٰفِرِينَ نُزُلًۭا
ayahs.sahih: Then do those who disbelieve think that they can take My servants instead of Me as allies? Indeed, We have prepared Hell for the disbelievers as a lodging.
ayahs.clear: Do those who disbelieve think that they can take My servants for masters instead of Me? We have prepared Hell for the hospitality of the faithless.
ayahs.kemenag: maka apakah orang-orang kafir menyangka bahwa mereka (dapat) mengambil hamba-hamba-Ku menjadi penolong selain Aku? Sesungguhnya Kami telah menyediakan neraka Jahannam tempat tinggal bagi orang-orang kafir.

ayahs.arabic: قُلْ هَلْ نُنَبِّئُكُم بِٱلْأَخْسَرِينَ أَعْمَٰلًا
ayahs.sahih: Say, [O Muhammad], "Shall we [believers] inform you of the greatest losers as to [their] deeds?
ayahs.clear: Say, “Shall We inform you of the greatest losers in their works?”
ayahs.kemenag: Katakanlah: "Apakah akan Kami beritahukan kepadamu tentang orang-orang yang paling merugi perbuatannya?"

ayahs.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ ضَلَّ سَعْيُهُمْ فِى ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا وَهُمْ يَحْسَبُونَ أَنَّهُمْ يُحْسِنُونَ صُنْعًا
ayahs.sahih: [They are] those whose effort is lost in worldly life, while they think that they are doing well in work."
ayahs.clear: “Those whose efforts in this world are misguided, while they assume that they are doing well.”
ayahs.kemenag: Yaitu orang-orang yang telah sia-sia perbuatannya dalam kehidupan dunia ini, sedangkan mereka menyangka bahwa mereka berbuat sebaik-baiknya.

ayahs.arabic: أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِ رَبِّهِمْ وَلِقَآئِهِۦ فَحَبِطَتْ أَعْمَٰلُهُمْ فَلَا نُقِيمُ لَهُمْ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ وَزْنًۭا
ayahs.sahih: Those are the ones who disbelieve in the verses of their Lord and in [their] meeting Him, so their deeds have become worthless; and We will not assign to them on the Day of Resurrection any importance.
ayahs.clear: It is they who rejected the communications of their Lord, and the encounter with Him. So their works are in vain. And on the Day of Resurrection, We will consider them of no weight.
ayahs.kemenag: Mereka itu orang-orang yang telah kufur terhadap ayat-ayat Tuhan mereka dan (kufur terhadap) perjumpaan dengan Dia, maka hapuslah amalan-amalan mereka, dan Kami tidak mengadakan suatu penilaian bagi (amalan) mereka pada hari kiamat.

ayahs.arabic: ذَٰلِكَ جَزَآؤُهُمْ جَهَنَّمُ بِمَا كَفَرُوا۟ وَٱتَّخَذُوٓا۟ ءَايَٰتِى وَرُسُلِى هُزُوًا
ayahs.sahih: That is their recompense - Hell - for what they denied and [because] they took My signs and My messengers in ridicule.
ayahs.clear: That is their requital—Hell—on account of their disbelief, and their taking My revelations and My messengers in mockery.
ayahs.kemenag: Demikianlah balasan mereka itu neraka Jahannam, disebabkan kekafiran mereka dan disebabkan mereka menjadikan ayat-ayat-Ku dan rasul-rasul-Ku sebagai olok-olok.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ كَانَتْ لَهُمْ جَنَّٰتُ ٱلْفِرْدَوْسِ نُزُلًا
ayahs.sahih: Indeed, those who have believed and done righteous deeds - they will have the Gardens of Paradise as a lodging,
ayahs.clear: As for those who believe and do righteous deeds, they will have the Gardens of Paradise for hospitality.
ayahs.kemenag: Sesungguhnya orang-orang yang beriman dan beramal saleh, bagi mereka adalah surga Firdaus menjadi tempat tinggal,

ayahs.arabic: خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَا لَا يَبْغُونَ عَنْهَا حِوَلًۭا
ayahs.sahih: Wherein they abide eternally. They will not desire from it any transfer.
ayahs.clear: Abiding therein forever, without desiring any change therefrom.
ayahs.kemenag: mereka kekal di dalamnya, mereka tidak ingin berpindah dari padanya.

ayahs.arabic: قُل لَّوْ كَانَ ٱلْبَحْرُ مِدَادًۭا لِّكَلِمَٰتِ رَبِّى لَنَفِدَ ٱلْبَحْرُ قَبْلَ أَن تَنفَدَ كَلِمَٰتُ رَبِّى وَلَوْ جِئْنَا بِمِثْلِهِۦ مَدَدًۭا
ayahs.sahih: Say, "If the sea were ink for [writing] the words of my Lord, the sea would be exhausted before the words of my Lord were exhausted, even if We brought the like of it as a supplement."
ayahs.clear: Say, “If the ocean were ink for the words of my Lord, the ocean would run out, before the words of my Lord run out,” even if We were to bring the like of it in addition to it.
ayahs.kemenag: Katakanlah: Sekiranya lautan menjadi tinta untuk (menulis) kalimat-kalimat Tuhanku, sungguh habislah lautan itu sebelum habis (ditulis) kalimat-kalimat Tuhanku, meskipun Kami datangkan tambahan sebanyak itu (pula)".

ayahs.arabic: قُلْ إِنَّمَآ أَنَا۠ بَشَرٌۭ مِّثْلُكُمْ يُوحَىٰٓ إِلَىَّ أَنَّمَآ إِلَٰهُكُمْ إِلَٰهٌۭ وَٰحِدٌۭ ۖ فَمَن كَانَ يَرْجُوا۟ لِقَآءَ رَبِّهِۦ فَلْيَعْمَلْ عَمَلًۭا صَٰلِحًۭا وَلَا يُشْرِكْ بِعِبَادَةِ رَبِّهِۦٓ أَحَدًۢا
ayahs.sahih: Say, "I am only a man like you, to whom has been revealed that your god is one God. So whoever would hope for the meeting with his Lord - let him do righteous work and not associate in the worship of his Lord anyone."
ayahs.clear: Say, “I am only a human being like you, being inspired that your god is One God. Whoever hopes to meet his Lord, let him work righteousness, and never associate anyone with the service of his Lord.”
ayahs.kemenag: Katakanlah: Sesungguhnya aku ini manusia biasa seperti kamu, yang diwahyukan kepadaku: "Bahwa sesungguhnya Tuhan kamu itu adalah Tuhan yang Esa". Barangsiapa mengharap perjumpaan dengan Tuhannya, maka hendaklah ia mengerjakan amal yang saleh dan janganlah ia mempersekutukan seorangpun dalam beribadat kepada Tuhannya".

ayahs.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ كٓهيعٓصٓ
ayahs.sahih: Kaf, Ha, Ya, 'Ayn, Sad.
ayahs.clear: Kaf, Ha, Ya, Ayn, Saad.
ayahs.kemenag: Kaaf Haa Yaa 'Ain Shaad.

ayahs.arabic: ذِكْرُ رَحْمَتِ رَبِّكَ عَبْدَهُۥ زَكَرِيَّآ
ayahs.sahih: [This is] a mention of the mercy of your Lord to His servant Zechariah
ayahs.clear: A mention of the mercy of your Lord towards His servant Zechariah.
ayahs.kemenag: (Yang dibacakan ini adalah) penjelasan tentang rahmat Tuhan kamu kepada hamba-Nya, Zakaria,

ayahs.arabic: إِذْ نَادَىٰ رَبَّهُۥ نِدَآءً خَفِيًّۭا
ayahs.sahih: When he called to his Lord a private supplication.
ayahs.clear: When he called on his Lord, a call in seclusion.
ayahs.kemenag: yaitu tatkala ia berdoa kepada Tuhannya dengan suara yang lembut.

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ إِنِّى وَهَنَ ٱلْعَظْمُ مِنِّى وَٱشْتَعَلَ ٱلرَّأْسُ شَيْبًۭا وَلَمْ أَكُنۢ بِدُعَآئِكَ رَبِّ شَقِيًّۭا
ayahs.sahih: He said, "My Lord, indeed my bones have weakened, and my head has filled with white, and never have I been in my supplication to You, my Lord, unhappy.
ayahs.clear: He said, “My Lord, my bones have become feeble, and my hair is aflame with gray, and never, Lord, have I been disappointed in my prayer to you.
ayahs.kemenag: Ia berkata "Ya Tuhanku, sesungguhnya tulangku telah lemah dan kepalaku telah ditumbuhi uban, dan aku belum pernah kecewa dalam berdoa kepada Engkau, ya Tuhanku.

ayahs.arabic: وَإِنِّى خِفْتُ ٱلْمَوَٰلِىَ مِن وَرَآءِى وَكَانَتِ ٱمْرَأَتِى عَاقِرًۭا فَهَبْ لِى مِن لَّدُنكَ وَلِيًّۭا
ayahs.sahih: And indeed, I fear the successors after me, and my wife has been barren, so give me from Yourself an heir
ayahs.clear: “And I fear for my dependents after me, and my wife is barren. So grant me, from Yourself, an heir.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan sesungguhnya aku khawatir terhadap mawaliku sepeninggalku, sedang isteriku adalah seorang yang mandul, maka anugerahilah aku dari sisi Engkau seorang putera,

ayahs.arabic: يَرِثُنِى وَيَرِثُ مِنْ ءَالِ يَعْقُوبَ ۖ وَٱجْعَلْهُ رَبِّ رَضِيًّۭا
ayahs.sahih: Who will inherit me and inherit from the family of Jacob. And make him, my Lord, pleasing [to You]."
ayahs.clear: To inherit me, and inherit from the House of Jacob, and make him, my Lord, pleasing.”
ayahs.kemenag: yang akan mewarisi aku dan mewarisi sebahagian keluarga Ya'qub; dan jadikanlah ia, ya Tuhanku, seorang yang diridhai".

ayahs.arabic: يَٰزَكَرِيَّآ إِنَّا نُبَشِّرُكَ بِغُلَٰمٍ ٱسْمُهُۥ يَحْيَىٰ لَمْ نَجْعَل لَّهُۥ مِن قَبْلُ سَمِيًّۭا
ayahs.sahih: [He was told], "O Zechariah, indeed We give you good tidings of a boy whose name will be John. We have not assigned to any before [this] name."
ayahs.clear: “O Zechariah, We give you good news of a son, whose name is John, a name We have never given before.”
ayahs.kemenag: Hai Zakaria, sesungguhnya Kami memberi kabar gembira kepadamu akan (beroleh) seorang anak yang namanya Yahya, yang sebelumnya Kami belum pernah menciptakan orang yang serupa dengan dia.

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ أَنَّىٰ يَكُونُ لِى غُلَٰمٌۭ وَكَانَتِ ٱمْرَأَتِى عَاقِرًۭا وَقَدْ بَلَغْتُ مِنَ ٱلْكِبَرِ عِتِيًّۭا
ayahs.sahih: He said, "My Lord, how will I have a boy when my wife has been barren and I have reached extreme old age?"
ayahs.clear: He said, “My Lord, how can I have a son, when my wife is barren, and I have become decrepit with old age?”
ayahs.kemenag: Zakaria berkata: "Ya Tuhanku, bagaimana akan ada anak bagiku, padahal isteriku adalah seorang yang mandul dan aku (sendiri) sesungguhnya sudah mencapai umur yang sangat tua".

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ كَذَٰلِكَ قَالَ رَبُّكَ هُوَ عَلَىَّ هَيِّنٌۭ وَقَدْ خَلَقْتُكَ مِن قَبْلُ وَلَمْ تَكُ شَيْـًۭٔا
ayahs.sahih: [An angel] said, "Thus [it will be]; your Lord says, 'It is easy for Me, for I created you before, while you were nothing.' "
ayahs.clear: He said, “It will be so, your Lord says, ‘it is easy for me, and I created you before, when you were nothing.’”
ayahs.kemenag: Tuhan berfirman: "Demikianlah". Tuhan berfirman: "Hal itu adalah mudah bagi-Ku; dan sesunguhnya telah Aku ciptakan kamu sebelum itu, padahal kamu (di waktu itu) belum ada sama sekali".

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ ٱجْعَل لِّىٓ ءَايَةًۭ ۚ قَالَ ءَايَتُكَ أَلَّا تُكَلِّمَ ٱلنَّاسَ ثَلَٰثَ لَيَالٍۢ سَوِيًّۭا
ayahs.sahih: [Zechariah] said, "My Lord, make for me a sign." He said, "Your sign is that you will not speak to the people for three nights, [being] sound."
ayahs.clear: He said, “My Lord, give me a sign.” He said, “Your sign is that you will not speak to the people for three nights straight.”
ayahs.kemenag: Zakaria berkata: "Ya Tuhanku, berilah aku suatu tanda". Tuhan berfirman: "Tanda bagimu ialah bahwa kamu tidak dapat bercakap-cakap dengan manusia selama tiga malam, padahal kamu sehat".

ayahs.arabic: فَخَرَجَ عَلَىٰ قَوْمِهِۦ مِنَ ٱلْمِحْرَابِ فَأَوْحَىٰٓ إِلَيْهِمْ أَن سَبِّحُوا۟ بُكْرَةًۭ وَعَشِيًّۭا
ayahs.sahih: So he came out to his people from the prayer chamber and signaled to them to exalt [Allah] in the morning and afternoon.
ayahs.clear: And he came out to his people, from the sanctuary, and signaled to them to praise morning and evening.
ayahs.kemenag: Maka ia keluar dari mihrab menuju kaumnya, lalu ia memberi isyarat kepada mereka; hendaklah kamu bertasbih di waktu pagi dan petang.

ayahs.arabic: يَٰيَحْيَىٰ خُذِ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ بِقُوَّةٍۢ ۖ وَءَاتَيْنَٰهُ ٱلْحُكْمَ صَبِيًّۭا
ayahs.sahih: [Allah] said, "O John, take the Scripture with determination." And We gave him judgement [while yet] a boy
ayahs.clear: “O John, hold on to the Scripture firmly,” and We gave him wisdom in his youth.
ayahs.kemenag: Hai Yahya, ambillah Al Kitab (Taurat) itu dengan sungguh-sungguh. Dan kami berikan kepadanya hikmah selagi ia masih kanak-kanak,

ayahs.arabic: وَحَنَانًۭا مِّن لَّدُنَّا وَزَكَوٰةًۭ ۖ وَكَانَ تَقِيًّۭا
ayahs.sahih: And affection from Us and purity, and he was fearing of Allah
ayahs.clear: And tenderness from Us, and innocence. He was devout.
ayahs.kemenag: dan rasa belas kasihan yang mendalam dari sisi Kami dan kesucian (dan dosa). Dan ia adalah seorang yang bertakwa,

ayahs.arabic: وَبَرًّۢا بِوَٰلِدَيْهِ وَلَمْ يَكُن جَبَّارًا عَصِيًّۭا
ayahs.sahih: And dutiful to his parents, and he was not a disobedient tyrant.
ayahs.clear: And kind to his parents; and he was not a disobedient tyrant.
ayahs.kemenag: dan seorang yang berbakti kepada kedua orang tuanya, dan bukanlah ia orang yang sombong lagi durhaka.

ayahs.arabic: وَسَلَٰمٌ عَلَيْهِ يَوْمَ وُلِدَ وَيَوْمَ يَمُوتُ وَيَوْمَ يُبْعَثُ حَيًّۭا
ayahs.sahih: And peace be upon him the day he was born and the day he dies and the day he is raised alive.
ayahs.clear: And peace be upon him the day he was born, and the day he dies, and the Day he is raised alive.
ayahs.kemenag: Kesejahteraan atas dirinya pada hari ia dilahirkan dan pada hari ia meninggal dan pada hari ia dibangkitkan hidup kembali.

ayahs.arabic: وَٱذْكُرْ فِى ٱلْكِتَٰبِ مَرْيَمَ إِذِ ٱنتَبَذَتْ مِنْ أَهْلِهَا مَكَانًۭا شَرْقِيًّۭا
ayahs.sahih: And mention, [O Muhammad], in the Book [the story of] Mary, when she withdrew from her family to a place toward the east.
ayahs.clear: And mention in the Scripture Mary, when she withdrew from her people to an eastern location.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan ceritakanlah (kisah) Maryam di dalam Al Quran, yaitu ketika ia menjauhkan diri dari keluarganya ke suatu tempat di sebelah timur,

ayahs.arabic: فَٱتَّخَذَتْ مِن دُونِهِمْ حِجَابًۭا فَأَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَيْهَا رُوحَنَا فَتَمَثَّلَ لَهَا بَشَرًۭا سَوِيًّۭا
ayahs.sahih: And she took, in seclusion from them, a screen. Then We sent to her Our Angel, and he represented himself to her as a well-proportioned man.
ayahs.clear: She screened herself away from them, and We sent to her Our spirit, and He appeared to her as an immaculate human.
ayahs.kemenag: maka ia mengadakan tabir (yang melindunginya) dari mereka; lalu Kami mengutus roh Kami kepadanya, maka ia menjelma di hadapannya (dalam bentuk) manusia yang sempurna.

ayahs.arabic: قَالَتْ إِنِّىٓ أَعُوذُ بِٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ مِنكَ إِن كُنتَ تَقِيًّۭا
ayahs.sahih: She said, "Indeed, I seek refuge in the Most Merciful from you, [so leave me], if you should be fearing of Allah."
ayahs.clear: She said, “I take refuge from you in the Most Merciful, should you be righteous.”
ayahs.kemenag: Maryam berkata: "Sesungguhnya aku berlindung dari padamu kepada Tuhan Yang Maha pemurah, jika kamu seorang yang bertakwa".

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ إِنَّمَآ أَنَا۠ رَسُولُ رَبِّكِ لِأَهَبَ لَكِ غُلَٰمًۭا زَكِيًّۭا
ayahs.sahih: He said, "I am only the messenger of your Lord to give you [news of] a pure boy."
ayahs.clear: He said, “I am only the messenger of your Lord, to give you the gift of a pure son.”
ayahs.kemenag: Ia (jibril) berkata: "Sesungguhnya aku ini hanyalah seorang utusan Tuhanmu, untuk memberimu seorang anak laki-laki yang suci".

ayahs.arabic: قَالَتْ أَنَّىٰ يَكُونُ لِى غُلَٰمٌۭ وَلَمْ يَمْسَسْنِى بَشَرٌۭ وَلَمْ أَكُ بَغِيًّۭا
ayahs.sahih: She said, "How can I have a boy while no man has touched me and I have not been unchaste?"
ayahs.clear: She said, “How can I have a son, when no man has touched me, and I was never unchaste?”
ayahs.kemenag: Maryam berkata: "Bagaimana akan ada bagiku seorang anak laki-laki, sedang tidak pernah seorang manusiapun menyentuhku dan aku bukan (pula) seorang pezina!"

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ كَذَٰلِكِ قَالَ رَبُّكِ هُوَ عَلَىَّ هَيِّنٌۭ ۖ وَلِنَجْعَلَهُۥٓ ءَايَةًۭ لِّلنَّاسِ وَرَحْمَةًۭ مِّنَّا ۚ وَكَانَ أَمْرًۭا مَّقْضِيًّۭا
ayahs.sahih: He said, "Thus [it will be]; your Lord says, 'It is easy for Me, and We will make him a sign to the people and a mercy from Us. And it is a matter [already] decreed.' "
ayahs.clear: He said, “Thus said your Lord, `It is easy for Me, and We will make him a sign for humanity, and a mercy from Us. It is a matter already decided.'“
ayahs.kemenag: Jibril berkata: "Demikianlah". Tuhanmu berfirman: "Hal itu adalah mudah bagi-Ku; dan agar dapat Kami menjadikannya suatu tanda bagi manusia dan sebagai rahmat dari Kami; dan hal itu adalah suatu perkara yang sudah diputuskan".

ayahs.arabic: ۞ فَحَمَلَتْهُ فَٱنتَبَذَتْ بِهِۦ مَكَانًۭا قَصِيًّۭا
ayahs.sahih: So she conceived him, and she withdrew with him to a remote place.
ayahs.clear: So she carried him, and secluded herself with him in a remote place.
ayahs.kemenag: Maka Maryam mengandungnya, lalu ia menyisihkan diri dengan kandungannya itu ke tempat yang jauh.

ayahs.arabic: فَأَجَآءَهَا ٱلْمَخَاضُ إِلَىٰ جِذْعِ ٱلنَّخْلَةِ قَالَتْ يَٰلَيْتَنِى مِتُّ قَبْلَ هَٰذَا وَكُنتُ نَسْيًۭا مَّنسِيًّۭا
ayahs.sahih: And the pains of childbirth drove her to the trunk of a palm tree. She said, "Oh, I wish I had died before this and was in oblivion, forgotten."
ayahs.clear: The labor-pains came upon her, by the trunk of a palm-tree. She said, “I wish I had died before this, and been completely forgotten.”
ayahs.kemenag: Maka rasa sakit akan melahirkan anak memaksa ia (bersandar) pada pangkal pohon kurma, dia berkata: "Aduhai, alangkah baiknya aku mati sebelum ini, dan aku menjadi barang yang tidak berarti, lagi dilupakan".

ayahs.arabic: فَنَادَىٰهَا مِن تَحْتِهَآ أَلَّا تَحْزَنِى قَدْ جَعَلَ رَبُّكِ تَحْتَكِ سَرِيًّۭا
ayahs.sahih: But he called her from below her, "Do not grieve; your Lord has provided beneath you a stream.
ayahs.clear: Whereupon he called her from beneath her: “Do not worry; your Lord has placed a stream beneath you.
ayahs.kemenag: Maka Jibril menyerunya dari tempat yang rendah: "Janganlah kamu bersedih hati, sesungguhnya Tuhanmu telah menjadikan anak sungai di bawahmu.

ayahs.arabic: وَهُزِّىٓ إِلَيْكِ بِجِذْعِ ٱلنَّخْلَةِ تُسَٰقِطْ عَلَيْكِ رُطَبًۭا جَنِيًّۭا
ayahs.sahih: And shake toward you the trunk of the palm tree; it will drop upon you ripe, fresh dates.
ayahs.clear: And shake the trunk of the palm-tree towards you, and it will drop ripe dates by you.”
ayahs.kemenag: Dan goyanglah pangkal pohon kurma itu ke arahmu, niscaya pohon itu akan menggugurkan buah kurma yang masak kepadamu,

ayahs.arabic: فَكُلِى وَٱشْرَبِى وَقَرِّى عَيْنًۭا ۖ فَإِمَّا تَرَيِنَّ مِنَ ٱلْبَشَرِ أَحَدًۭا فَقُولِىٓ إِنِّى نَذَرْتُ لِلرَّحْمَٰنِ صَوْمًۭا فَلَنْ أُكَلِّمَ ٱلْيَوْمَ إِنسِيًّۭا
ayahs.sahih: So eat and drink and be contented. And if you see from among humanity anyone, say, 'Indeed, I have vowed to the Most Merciful abstention, so I will not speak today to [any] man.' "
ayahs.clear: “So eat, and drink, and be consoled. And if you see any human, say, ‘I have vowed a fast to the Most Gracious, so I will not speak to any human today.'“
ayahs.kemenag: maka makan, minum dan bersenang hatilah kamu. Jika kamu melihat seorang manusia, maka katakanlah: "Sesungguhnya aku telah bernazar berpuasa untuk Tuhan Yang Maha Pemurah, maka aku tidak akan berbicara dengan seorang manusiapun pada hari ini".

ayahs.arabic: فَأَتَتْ بِهِۦ قَوْمَهَا تَحْمِلُهُۥ ۖ قَالُوا۟ يَٰمَرْيَمُ لَقَدْ جِئْتِ شَيْـًۭٔا فَرِيًّۭا
ayahs.sahih: Then she brought him to her people, carrying him. They said, "O Mary, you have certainly done a thing unprecedented.
ayahs.clear: Then she came to her people, carrying him. They said, “O Mary, you have done something terrible.
ayahs.kemenag: Maka Maryam membawa anak itu kepada kaumnya dengan menggendongnya. Kaumnya berkata: "Hai Maryam, sesungguhnya kamu telah melakukan sesuatu yang amat mungkar.

ayahs.arabic: يَٰٓأُخْتَ هَٰرُونَ مَا كَانَ أَبُوكِ ٱمْرَأَ سَوْءٍۢ وَمَا كَانَتْ أُمُّكِ بَغِيًّۭا
ayahs.sahih: O sister of Aaron, your father was not a man of evil, nor was your mother unchaste."
ayahs.clear: O sister of Aaron, your father was not an evil man, and your mother was not a whore.”
ayahs.kemenag: Hai saudara perempuan Harun, ayahmu sekali-kali bukanlah seorang yang jahat dan ibumu sekali-kali bukanlah seorang pezina",

ayahs.arabic: فَأَشَارَتْ إِلَيْهِ ۖ قَالُوا۟ كَيْفَ نُكَلِّمُ مَن كَانَ فِى ٱلْمَهْدِ صَبِيًّۭا
ayahs.sahih: So she pointed to him. They said, "How can we speak to one who is in the cradle a child?"
ayahs.clear: So she pointed to him. They said, “How can we speak to an infant in the crib?”
ayahs.kemenag: maka Maryam menunjuk kepada anaknya. Mereka berkata: "Bagaimana kami akan berbicara dengan anak kecil yang masih di dalam ayunan?"

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ إِنِّى عَبْدُ ٱللَّهِ ءَاتَىٰنِىَ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ وَجَعَلَنِى نَبِيًّۭا
ayahs.sahih: [Jesus] said, "Indeed, I am the servant of Allah. He has given me the Scripture and made me a prophet.
ayahs.clear: He said, “I am the servant of God. He has given me the Scripture, and made me a prophet.
ayahs.kemenag: Berkata Isa: "Sesungguhnya aku ini hamba Allah, Dia memberiku Al Kitab (Injil) dan Dia menjadikan aku seorang nabi,

ayahs.arabic: وَجَعَلَنِى مُبَارَكًا أَيْنَ مَا كُنتُ وَأَوْصَٰنِى بِٱلصَّلَوٰةِ وَٱلزَّكَوٰةِ مَا دُمْتُ حَيًّۭا
ayahs.sahih: And He has made me blessed wherever I am and has enjoined upon me prayer and zakah as long as I remain alive
ayahs.clear: And has made me blessed wherever I may be; and has enjoined on me prayer and charity, so long as I live.
ayahs.kemenag: dan Dia menjadikan aku seorang yang diberkati di mana saja aku berada, dan Dia memerintahkan kepadaku (mendirikan) shalat dan (menunaikan) zakat selama aku hidup;

ayahs.arabic: وَبَرًّۢا بِوَٰلِدَتِى وَلَمْ يَجْعَلْنِى جَبَّارًۭا شَقِيًّۭا
ayahs.sahih: And [made me] dutiful to my mother, and He has not made me a wretched tyrant.
ayahs.clear: And kind to my mother, and He did not make me a disobedient rebel.
ayahs.kemenag: dan berbakti kepada ibuku, dan Dia tidak menjadikan aku seorang yang sombong lagi celaka.

ayahs.arabic: وَٱلسَّلَٰمُ عَلَىَّ يَوْمَ وُلِدتُّ وَيَوْمَ أَمُوتُ وَيَوْمَ أُبْعَثُ حَيًّۭا
ayahs.sahih: And peace is on me the day I was born and the day I will die and the day I am raised alive."
ayahs.clear: So Peace is upon me the day I was born, and the day I die, and the Day I get resurrected alive.”
ayahs.kemenag: Dan kesejahteraan semoga dilimpahkan kepadaku, pada hari aku dilahirkan, pada hari aku meninggal dan pada hari aku dibangkitkan hidup kembali".

ayahs.arabic: ذَٰلِكَ عِيسَى ٱبْنُ مَرْيَمَ ۚ قَوْلَ ٱلْحَقِّ ٱلَّذِى فِيهِ يَمْتَرُونَ
ayahs.sahih: That is Jesus, the son of Mary - the word of truth about which they are in dispute.
ayahs.clear: That is Jesus son of Mary—the Word of truth about which they doubt.
ayahs.kemenag: Itulah Isa putera Maryam, yang mengatakan perkataan yang benar, yang mereka berbantah-bantahan tentang kebenarannya.

ayahs.arabic: مَا كَانَ لِلَّهِ أَن يَتَّخِذَ مِن وَلَدٍۢ ۖ سُبْحَٰنَهُۥٓ ۚ إِذَا قَضَىٰٓ أَمْرًۭا فَإِنَّمَا يَقُولُ لَهُۥ كُن فَيَكُونُ
ayahs.sahih: It is not [befitting] for Allah to take a son; exalted is He! When He decrees an affair, He only says to it, "Be," and it is.
ayahs.clear: It is not for God to have a child—glory be to Him. To have anything done, He says to it, “Be,” and it becomes.
ayahs.kemenag: Tidak layak bagi Allah mempunyai anak, Maha Suci Dia. Apabila Dia telah menetapkan sesuatu, maka Dia hanya berkata kepadanya: "Jadilah", maka jadilah ia.

ayahs.arabic: وَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ رَبِّى وَرَبُّكُمْ فَٱعْبُدُوهُ ۚ هَٰذَا صِرَٰطٌۭ مُّسْتَقِيمٌۭ
ayahs.sahih: [Jesus said], "And indeed, Allah is my Lord and your Lord, so worship Him. That is a straight path."
ayahs.clear: “God is my Lord and your Lord, so worship Him. That is a straight path.”
ayahs.kemenag: Sesungguhnya Allah adalah Tuhanku dan Tuhanmu, maka sembahIah Dia oleh kamu sekalian. Ini adalah jalan yang lurus.

ayahs.arabic: فَٱخْتَلَفَ ٱلْأَحْزَابُ مِنۢ بَيْنِهِمْ ۖ فَوَيْلٌۭ لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِن مَّشْهَدِ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ
ayahs.sahih: Then the factions differed [concerning Jesus] from among them, so woe to those who disbelieved - from the scene of a tremendous Day.
ayahs.clear: But the various factions differed among themselves. So woe to those who disbelieve from the scene of a tremendous Day.
ayahs.kemenag: Maka berselisihlah golongan-golongan (yang ada) di antara mereka. Maka kecelakaanlah bagi orang-orang kafir pada waktu menyaksikan hari yang besar.

ayahs.arabic: أَسْمِعْ بِهِمْ وَأَبْصِرْ يَوْمَ يَأْتُونَنَا ۖ لَٰكِنِ ٱلظَّٰلِمُونَ ٱلْيَوْمَ فِى ضَلَٰلٍۢ مُّبِينٍۢ
ayahs.sahih: How [clearly] they will hear and see the Day they come to Us, but the wrongdoers today are in clear error.
ayahs.clear: Listen to them and watch for them the Day they come to Us. But the wrongdoers today are completely lost.
ayahs.kemenag: Alangkah terangnya pendengaran mereka dan alangkah tajamnya penglihatan mereka pada hari mereka datang kepada Kami. Tetapi orang-orang yang zalim pada hari ini (di dunia) berada dalam kesesatan yang nyata.

ayahs.arabic: وَأَنذِرْهُمْ يَوْمَ ٱلْحَسْرَةِ إِذْ قُضِىَ ٱلْأَمْرُ وَهُمْ فِى غَفْلَةٍۢ وَهُمْ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And warn them, [O Muhammad], of the Day of Regret, when the matter will be concluded; and [yet], they are in [a state of] heedlessness, and they do not believe.
ayahs.clear: And warn them of the Day of Regret, when the matter will be concluded. Yet they are heedless, and they do not believe.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan berilah mereka peringatan tentang hari penyesalan, (yaitu) ketika segala perkara telah diputus. Dan mereka dalam kelalaian dan mereka tidak (pula) beriman.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّا نَحْنُ نَرِثُ ٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَنْ عَلَيْهَا وَإِلَيْنَا يُرْجَعُونَ
ayahs.sahih: Indeed, it is We who will inherit the earth and whoever is on it, and to Us they will be returned.
ayahs.clear: It is We who will inherit the earth and everyone on it, and to Us they will be returned.
ayahs.kemenag: Sesungguhnya Kami mewarisi bumi dan semua orang-orang yang ada di atasnya, dan hanya kepada Kamilah mereka dikembalikan.

ayahs.arabic: وَٱذْكُرْ فِى ٱلْكِتَٰبِ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ صِدِّيقًۭا نَّبِيًّا
ayahs.sahih: And mention in the Book [the story of] Abraham. Indeed, he was a man of truth and a prophet.
ayahs.clear: And mention in the Scripture Abraham. He was a man of truth, a prophet.
ayahs.kemenag: Ceritakanlah (Hai Muhammad) kisah Ibrahim di dalam Al Kitab (Al Quran) ini. Sesungguhnya ia adalah seorang yang sangat membenarkan lagi seorang Nabi.

ayahs.arabic: إِذْ قَالَ لِأَبِيهِ يَٰٓأَبَتِ لِمَ تَعْبُدُ مَا لَا يَسْمَعُ وَلَا يُبْصِرُ وَلَا يُغْنِى عَنكَ شَيْـًۭٔا
ayahs.sahih: [Mention] when he said to his father, "O my father, why do you worship that which does not hear and does not see and will not benefit you at all?
ayahs.clear: He said to his father, “O my father, why do you worship what can neither hear, nor see, nor benefit you in any way?
ayahs.kemenag: Ingatlah ketika ia berkata kepada bapaknya; "Wahai bapakku, mengapa kamu menyembah sesuatu yang tidak mendengar, tidak melihat dan tidak dapat menolong kamu sedikitpun?

ayahs.arabic: يَٰٓأَبَتِ إِنِّى قَدْ جَآءَنِى مِنَ ٱلْعِلْمِ مَا لَمْ يَأْتِكَ فَٱتَّبِعْنِىٓ أَهْدِكَ صِرَٰطًۭا سَوِيًّۭا
ayahs.sahih: O my father, indeed there has come to me of knowledge that which has not come to you, so follow me; I will guide you to an even path.
ayahs.clear: O my father, there has come to me knowledge that never came to you. So follow me, and I will guide you along a straight way.
ayahs.kemenag: Wahai bapakku, sesungguhnya telah datang kepadaku sebahagian ilmu pengetahuan yang tidak datang kepadamu, maka ikutilah aku, niscaya aku akan menunjukkan kepadamu jalan yang lurus.

ayahs.arabic: يَٰٓأَبَتِ لَا تَعْبُدِ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنَ ۖ إِنَّ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنَ كَانَ لِلرَّحْمَٰنِ عَصِيًّۭا
ayahs.sahih: O my father, do not worship Satan. Indeed Satan has ever been, to the Most Merciful, disobedient.
ayahs.clear: O my father, do not worship the devil. The devil is disobedient to the Most Gracious.
ayahs.kemenag: Wahai bapakku, janganlah kamu menyembah syaitan. Sesungguhnya syaitan itu durhaka kepada Tuhan Yang Maha Pemurah.

ayahs.arabic: يَٰٓأَبَتِ إِنِّىٓ أَخَافُ أَن يَمَسَّكَ عَذَابٌۭ مِّنَ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ فَتَكُونَ لِلشَّيْطَٰنِ وَلِيًّۭا
ayahs.sahih: O my father, indeed I fear that there will touch you a punishment from the Most Merciful so you would be to Satan a companion [in Hellfire]."
ayahs.clear: O my father, I fear that a punishment from the Most Gracious will afflict you, and you become an ally of the devil.”
ayahs.kemenag: Wahai bapakku, sesungguhnya aku khawatir bahwa kamu akan ditimpa azab dari Tuhan Yang Maha Pemurah, maka kamu menjadi kawan bagi syaitan".

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ أَرَاغِبٌ أَنتَ عَنْ ءَالِهَتِى يَٰٓإِبْرَٰهِيمُ ۖ لَئِن لَّمْ تَنتَهِ لَأَرْجُمَنَّكَ ۖ وَٱهْجُرْنِى مَلِيًّۭا
ayahs.sahih: [His father] said, "Have you no desire for my gods, O Abraham? If you do not desist, I will surely stone you, so avoid me a prolonged time."
ayahs.clear: He said, “Are you renouncing my gods, O Abraham? If you do not desist, I will stone you. So leave me alone for a while.”
ayahs.kemenag: Berkata bapaknya: "Bencikah kamu kepada tuhan-tuhanku, hai Ibrahim? Jika kamu tidak berhenti, maka niscaya kamu akan kurajam, dan tinggalkanlah aku buat waktu yang lama".

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ سَلَٰمٌ عَلَيْكَ ۖ سَأَسْتَغْفِرُ لَكَ رَبِّىٓ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ بِى حَفِيًّۭا
ayahs.sahih: [Abraham] said, "Peace will be upon you. I will ask forgiveness for you of my Lord. Indeed, He is ever gracious to me.
ayahs.clear: He said, “Peace be upon you. I will ask my Lord to forgive you; He has been Kind to me.
ayahs.kemenag: Berkata Ibrahim: "Semoga keselamatan dilimpahkan kepadamu, aku akan memintakan ampun bagimu kepada Tuhanku. Sesungguhnya Dia sangat baik kepadaku.

ayahs.arabic: وَأَعْتَزِلُكُمْ وَمَا تَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ وَأَدْعُوا۟ رَبِّى عَسَىٰٓ أَلَّآ أَكُونَ بِدُعَآءِ رَبِّى شَقِيًّۭا
ayahs.sahih: And I will leave you and those you invoke other than Allah and will invoke my Lord. I expect that I will not be in invocation to my Lord unhappy."
ayahs.clear: And I will withdraw from you, and from what you pray to instead of God. And I will pray to my Lord, and I hope I will not be disappointed in my prayer to my Lord.”
ayahs.kemenag: Dan aku akan menjauhkan diri darimu dan dari apa yang kamu seru selain Allah, dan aku akan berdoa kepada Tuhanku, mudah-mudahan aku tidak akan kecewa dengan berdoa kepada Tuhanku".

ayahs.arabic: فَلَمَّا ٱعْتَزَلَهُمْ وَمَا يَعْبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ وَهَبْنَا لَهُۥٓ إِسْحَٰقَ وَيَعْقُوبَ ۖ وَكُلًّۭا جَعَلْنَا نَبِيًّۭا
ayahs.sahih: So when he had left them and those they worshipped other than Allah, We gave him Isaac and Jacob, and each [of them] We made a prophet.
ayahs.clear: When he withdrew from them, and from what they worship besides God, We granted him Isaac and Jacob. And each We made a prophet.
ayahs.kemenag: Maka ketika Ibrahim sudah menjauhkan diri dari mereka dan dari apa yang mereka sembah selain Allah, Kami anugerahkan kepadanya Ishak, dan Ya'qub. Dan masing-masingnya Kami angkat menjadi nabi.

ayahs.arabic: وَوَهَبْنَا لَهُم مِّن رَّحْمَتِنَا وَجَعَلْنَا لَهُمْ لِسَانَ صِدْقٍ عَلِيًّۭا
ayahs.sahih: And We gave them of Our mercy, and we made for them a reputation of high honor.
ayahs.clear: And We gave them freely of Our mercy, and gave them a noble reputation of truth.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan Kami anugerahkan kepada mereka sebagian dari rahmat Kami dan Kami jadikan mereka buah tutur yang baik lagi tinggi.

ayahs.arabic: وَٱذْكُرْ فِى ٱلْكِتَٰبِ مُوسَىٰٓ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ مُخْلَصًۭا وَكَانَ رَسُولًۭا نَّبِيًّۭا
ayahs.sahih: And mention in the Book, Moses. Indeed, he was chosen, and he was a messenger and a prophet.
ayahs.clear: And mention in the Scripture Moses. He was dedicated. He was a messenger and a prophet.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan ceritakanlah (hai Muhammad kepada mereka), kisah Musa di dalam Al Kitab (Al Quran) ini. Sesungguhnya ia adalah seorang yang dipilih dan seorang rasul dan nabi.

ayahs.arabic: وَنَٰدَيْنَٰهُ مِن جَانِبِ ٱلطُّورِ ٱلْأَيْمَنِ وَقَرَّبْنَٰهُ نَجِيًّۭا
ayahs.sahih: And We called him from the side of the mount at [his] right and brought him near, confiding [to him].
ayahs.clear: And We called him from the right side of the Mount, and brought him near in communion.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan Kami telah memanggilnya dari sebelah kanan gunung Thur dan Kami telah mendekatkannya kepada Kami di waktu dia munajat (kepada Kami).

ayahs.arabic: وَوَهَبْنَا لَهُۥ مِن رَّحْمَتِنَآ أَخَاهُ هَٰرُونَ نَبِيًّۭا
ayahs.sahih: And We gave him out of Our mercy his brother Aaron as a prophet.
ayahs.clear: And We granted him, out of Our mercy, his brother Aaron, a prophet.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan Kami telah menganugerahkan kepadanya sebagian rahmat Kami, yaitu saudaranya, Harun menjadi seorang nabi.

ayahs.arabic: وَٱذْكُرْ فِى ٱلْكِتَٰبِ إِسْمَٰعِيلَ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ صَادِقَ ٱلْوَعْدِ وَكَانَ رَسُولًۭا نَّبِيًّۭا
ayahs.sahih: And mention in the Book, Ishmael. Indeed, he was true to his promise, and he was a messenger and a prophet.
ayahs.clear: And mention in the Scripture Ishmael. He was true to his promise, and was a messenger, a prophet.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan ceritakanlah (hai Muhammad kepada mereka) kisah Ismail (yang tersebut) di dalam Al Quran. Sesungguhnya ia adalah seorang yang benar janjinya, dan dia adalah seorang rasul dan nabi.

ayahs.arabic: وَكَانَ يَأْمُرُ أَهْلَهُۥ بِٱلصَّلَوٰةِ وَٱلزَّكَوٰةِ وَكَانَ عِندَ رَبِّهِۦ مَرْضِيًّۭا
ayahs.sahih: And he used to enjoin on his people prayer and zakah and was to his Lord pleasing.
ayahs.clear: And he used to enjoin on his people prayer and charity, and he was pleasing to his Lord.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan ia menyuruh ahlinya untuk bersembahyang dan menunaikan zakat, dan ia adalah seorang yang diridhai di sisi Tuhannya.

ayahs.arabic: وَٱذْكُرْ فِى ٱلْكِتَٰبِ إِدْرِيسَ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ صِدِّيقًۭا نَّبِيًّۭا
ayahs.sahih: And mention in the Book, Idrees. Indeed, he was a man of truth and a prophet.
ayahs.clear: And mention in the Scripture Enoch. He was a man of truth, a prophet.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan ceritakanlah (hai Muhammad kepada mereka, kisah) Idris (yang tersebut) di dalam Al Quran. Sesungguhnya ia adalah seorang yang sangat membenarkan dan seorang nabi.

ayahs.arabic: وَرَفَعْنَٰهُ مَكَانًا عَلِيًّا
ayahs.sahih: And We raised him to a high station.
ayahs.clear: And We raised him to a high position.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan Kami telah mengangkatnya ke martabat yang tinggi.

ayahs.arabic: أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَنْعَمَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِم مِّنَ ٱلنَّبِيِّۦنَ مِن ذُرِّيَّةِ ءَادَمَ وَمِمَّنْ حَمَلْنَا مَعَ نُوحٍۢ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّةِ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ وَإِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ وَمِمَّنْ هَدَيْنَا وَٱجْتَبَيْنَآ ۚ إِذَا تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِمْ ءَايَٰتُ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ خَرُّوا۟ سُجَّدًۭا وَبُكِيًّۭا ۩
ayahs.sahih: Those were the ones upon whom Allah bestowed favor from among the prophets of the descendants of Adam and of those We carried [in the ship] with Noah, and of the descendants of Abraham and Israel, and of those whom We guided and chose. When the verses of the Most Merciful were recited to them, they fell in prostration and weeping.
ayahs.clear: These are some of the prophets God has blessed, from the descendants of Adam, and from those We carried with Noah, and from the descendants of Abraham and Israel, and from those We guided and selected. Whenever the revelations of the Most Gracious are recited to them, they would fall down, prostrating and weeping.
ayahs.kemenag: Mereka itu adalah orang-orang yang telah diberi nikmat oleh Allah, yaitu para nabi dari keturunan Adam, dan dari orang-orang yang Kami angkat bersama Nuh, dan dari keturunan Ibrahim dan Israil, dan dari orang-orang yang telah Kami beri petunjuk dan telah Kami pilih. Apabila dibacakan ayat-ayat Allah Yang Maha Pemurah kepada mereka, maka mereka menyungkur dengan bersujud dan menangis.

ayahs.arabic: ۞ فَخَلَفَ مِنۢ بَعْدِهِمْ خَلْفٌ أَضَاعُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَٱتَّبَعُوا۟ ٱلشَّهَوَٰتِ ۖ فَسَوْفَ يَلْقَوْنَ غَيًّا
ayahs.sahih: But there came after them successors who neglected prayer and pursued desires; so they are going to meet evil -
ayahs.clear: But they were succeeded by generations who lost the prayers and followed their appetites. They will meet perdition.
ayahs.kemenag: Maka datanglah sesudah mereka, pengganti (yang jelek) yang menyia-nyiakan shalat dan memperturutkan hawa nafsunya, maka mereka kelak akan menemui kesesatan,

ayahs.arabic: إِلَّا مَن تَابَ وَءَامَنَ وَعَمِلَ صَٰلِحًۭا فَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ يَدْخُلُونَ ٱلْجَنَّةَ وَلَا يُظْلَمُونَ شَيْـًۭٔا
ayahs.sahih: Except those who repent, believe and do righteousness; for those will enter Paradise and will not be wronged at all.
ayahs.clear: Except for those who repent, and believe, and act righteously. These will enter Paradise, and will not be wronged in the least.
ayahs.kemenag: kecuali orang yang bertaubat, beriman dan beramal saleh, maka mereka itu akan masuk surga dan tidak dianiaya (dirugikan) sedikitpun,

ayahs.arabic: جَنَّٰتِ عَدْنٍ ٱلَّتِى وَعَدَ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ عِبَادَهُۥ بِٱلْغَيْبِ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ وَعْدُهُۥ مَأْتِيًّۭا
ayahs.sahih: [Therein are] gardens of perpetual residence which the Most Merciful has promised His servants in the unseen. Indeed, His promise has ever been coming.
ayahs.clear: The Gardens of Eden, promised by the Most Merciful to His servants in the Unseen. His promise will certainly come true.
ayahs.kemenag: yaitu surga 'Adn yang telah dijanjikan oleh Tuhan Yang Maha Pemurah kepada hamba-hamba-Nya, sekalipun (surga itu) tidak nampak. Sesungguhnya janji Allah itu pasti akan ditepati.

ayahs.arabic: لَّا يَسْمَعُونَ فِيهَا لَغْوًا إِلَّا سَلَٰمًۭا ۖ وَلَهُمْ رِزْقُهُمْ فِيهَا بُكْرَةًۭ وَعَشِيًّۭا
ayahs.sahih: They will not hear therein any ill speech - only [greetings of] peace - and they will have their provision therein, morning and afternoon.
ayahs.clear: They will hear no nonsense therein, but only peace. And they will have their provision therein, morning and evening.
ayahs.kemenag: Mereka tidak mendengar perkataan yang tak berguna di dalam surga, kecuali ucapan salam. Bagi mereka rezekinya di surga itu tiap-tiap pagi dan petang.

ayahs.arabic: تِلْكَ ٱلْجَنَّةُ ٱلَّتِى نُورِثُ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا مَن كَانَ تَقِيًّۭا
ayahs.sahih: That is Paradise, which We give as inheritance to those of Our servants who were fearing of Allah.
ayahs.clear: Such is Paradise which We will give as inheritance to those of Our servants who are devout.
ayahs.kemenag: Itulah surga yang akan Kami wariskan kepada hamba-hamba Kami yang selalu bertakwa.

ayahs.arabic: وَمَا نَتَنَزَّلُ إِلَّا بِأَمْرِ رَبِّكَ ۖ لَهُۥ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِينَا وَمَا خَلْفَنَا وَمَا بَيْنَ ذَٰلِكَ ۚ وَمَا كَانَ رَبُّكَ نَسِيًّۭا
ayahs.sahih: [Gabriel said], "And we [angels] descend not except by the order of your Lord. To Him belongs that before us and that behind us and what is in between. And never is your Lord forgetful -
ayahs.clear: “We do not descend except by the command of your Lord. His is what is before us, and what is behind us, and what is between them. Your Lord is never forgetful.”
ayahs.kemenag: Dan tidaklah kami (Jibril) turun, kecuali dengan perintah Tuhanmu. Kepunyaan-Nya-lah apa-apa yang ada di hadapan kita, apa-apa yang ada di belakang kita dan apa-apa yang ada di antara keduanya, dan tidaklah Tuhanmu lupa.

ayahs.arabic: رَّبُّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا فَٱعْبُدْهُ وَٱصْطَبِرْ لِعِبَٰدَتِهِۦ ۚ هَلْ تَعْلَمُ لَهُۥ سَمِيًّۭا
ayahs.sahih: Lord of the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them - so worship Him and have patience for His worship. Do you know of any similarity to Him?"
ayahs.clear: Lord of the heavens and the earth and what is between them. So worship Him, and persevere in His service. Do you know of anyone equal to Him?
ayahs.kemenag: Tuhan (yang menguasai) langit dan bumi dan apa-apa yang ada di antara keduanya, maka sembahlah Dia dan berteguh hatilah dalam beribadat kepada-Nya. Apakah kamu mengetahui ada seorang yang sama dengan Dia (yang patut disembah)?

ayahs.arabic: وَيَقُولُ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ أَءِذَا مَا مِتُّ لَسَوْفَ أُخْرَجُ حَيًّا
ayahs.sahih: And the disbeliever says, "When I have died, am I going to be brought forth alive?"
ayahs.clear: And the human being says, “When I am dead, will I be brought back alive?”
ayahs.kemenag: Dan berkata manusia: "Betulkah apabila aku telah mati, bahwa aku sungguh-sungguh akan dibangkitkan menjadi hidup kembali?"

ayahs.arabic: أَوَلَا يَذْكُرُ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ أَنَّا خَلَقْنَٰهُ مِن قَبْلُ وَلَمْ يَكُ شَيْـًۭٔا
ayahs.sahih: Does man not remember that We created him before, while he was nothing?
ayahs.clear: Does the human being not remember that We created him before, when he was nothing?
ayahs.kemenag: Dan tidakkah manusia itu memikirkan bahwa sesungguhnya Kami telah menciptakannya dahulu, sedang ia tidak ada sama sekali?

ayahs.arabic: فَوَرَبِّكَ لَنَحْشُرَنَّهُمْ وَٱلشَّيَٰطِينَ ثُمَّ لَنُحْضِرَنَّهُمْ حَوْلَ جَهَنَّمَ جِثِيًّۭا
ayahs.sahih: So by your Lord, We will surely gather them and the devils; then We will bring them to be present around Hell upon their knees.
ayahs.clear: By your Lord, We will round them up, and the devils, then We will bring them around Hell, on their knees.
ayahs.kemenag: Demi Tuhanmu, sesungguhnya akan Kami bangkitkan mereka bersama syaitan, kemudian akan Kami datangkan mereka ke sekeliling Jahannam dengan berlutut.

ayahs.arabic: ثُمَّ لَنَنزِعَنَّ مِن كُلِّ شِيعَةٍ أَيُّهُمْ أَشَدُّ عَلَى ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ عِتِيًّۭا
ayahs.sahih: Then We will surely extract from every sect those of them who were worst against the Most Merciful in insolence.
ayahs.clear: Then, out of every sect, We will snatch those most defiant to the Most Merciful.
ayahs.kemenag: Kemudian pasti akan Kami tarik dari tiap-tiap golongan siapa di antara mereka yang sangat durhaka kepada Tuhan Yang Maha Pemurah.

ayahs.arabic: ثُمَّ لَنَحْنُ أَعْلَمُ بِٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ أَوْلَىٰ بِهَا صِلِيًّۭا
ayahs.sahih: Then, surely it is We who are most knowing of those most worthy of burning therein.
ayahs.clear: We are fully aware of those most deserving to scorch in it.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan kemudian Kami sungguh lebih mengetahui orang-orang yang seharusnya dimasukkan ke dalam neraka.

ayahs.arabic: وَإِن مِّنكُمْ إِلَّا وَارِدُهَا ۚ كَانَ عَلَىٰ رَبِّكَ حَتْمًۭا مَّقْضِيًّۭا
ayahs.sahih: And there is none of you except he will come to it. This is upon your Lord an inevitability decreed.
ayahs.clear: There is not one of you but will go down to it. This has been an unavoidable decree of your Lord.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan tidak ada seorangpun dari padamu, melainkan mendatangi neraka itu. Hal itu bagi Tuhanmu adalah suatu kemestian yang sudah ditetapkan.

ayahs.arabic: ثُمَّ نُنَجِّى ٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّقَوا۟ وَّنَذَرُ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ فِيهَا جِثِيًّۭا
ayahs.sahih: Then We will save those who feared Allah and leave the wrongdoers within it, on their knees.
ayahs.clear: Then We will rescue those who were devout, and leave the wrongdoers in it, on their knees.
ayahs.kemenag: Kemudian Kami akan menyelamatkan orang-orang yang bertakwa dan membiarkan orang-orang yang zalim di dalam neraka dalam keadaan berlutut.

ayahs.arabic: وَإِذَا تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِمْ ءَايَٰتُنَا بَيِّنَٰتٍۢ قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لِلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ أَىُّ ٱلْفَرِيقَيْنِ خَيْرٌۭ مَّقَامًۭا وَأَحْسَنُ نَدِيًّۭا
ayahs.sahih: And when Our verses are recited to them as clear evidences, those who disbelieve say to those who believe, "Which of [our] two parties is best in position and best in association?"
ayahs.clear: When Our clear revelations are recited to them, those who disbelieve say to those who believe, “Which of the two parties is better in position, and superior in influence?”
ayahs.kemenag: Dan apabila dibacakan kepada mereka ayat-ayat Kami yang terang (maksudnya), niscaya orang-orang yang kafir berkata kepada orang-orang yang beriman: "Manakah di antara kedua golongan (kafir dan mukmin) yang lebih baik tempat tinggalnya dan lebih indah tempat pertemuan(nya)?"

ayahs.arabic: وَكَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا قَبْلَهُم مِّن قَرْنٍ هُمْ أَحْسَنُ أَثَٰثًۭا وَرِءْيًۭا
ayahs.sahih: And how many a generation have We destroyed before them who were better in possessions and [outward] appearance?
ayahs.clear: How many a generation have We destroyed before them, who surpassed them in riches and splendor?
ayahs.kemenag: Berapa banyak umat yang telah Kami binasakan sebelum mereka, sedang mereka adalah lebih bagus alat rumah tangganya dan lebih sedap di pandang mata.

ayahs.arabic: قُلْ مَن كَانَ فِى ٱلضَّلَٰلَةِ فَلْيَمْدُدْ لَهُ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ مَدًّا ۚ حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا رَأَوْا۟ مَا يُوعَدُونَ إِمَّا ٱلْعَذَابَ وَإِمَّا ٱلسَّاعَةَ فَسَيَعْلَمُونَ مَنْ هُوَ شَرٌّۭ مَّكَانًۭا وَأَضْعَفُ جُندًۭا
ayahs.sahih: Say, "Whoever is in error - let the Most Merciful extend for him an extension [in wealth and time] until, when they see that which they were promised - either punishment [in this world] or the Hour [of resurrection] - they will come to know who is worst in position and weaker in soldiers."
ayahs.clear: Say, “Whoever is in error, the Most Merciful will lead him on.” Until, when they see what they were promised—either the punishment, or the Hour. Then they will know who was in worse position and weaker in forces.
ayahs.kemenag: Katakanlah: "Barang siapa yang berada di dalam kesesatan, maka biarlah Tuhan yang Maha Pemurah memperpanjang tempo baginya; sehingga apabila mereka telah melihat apa yang diancamkan kepadanya, baik siksa maupun kiamat, maka mereka akan mengetahui siapa yang lebih jelek kedudukannya dan lebih lemah penolong-penolongnya".

ayahs.arabic: وَيَزِيدُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱهْتَدَوْا۟ هُدًۭى ۗ وَٱلْبَٰقِيَٰتُ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتُ خَيْرٌ عِندَ رَبِّكَ ثَوَابًۭا وَخَيْرٌۭ مَّرَدًّا
ayahs.sahih: And Allah increases those who were guided, in guidance, and the enduring good deeds are better to your Lord for reward and better for recourse.
ayahs.clear: God increases in guidance those who accept guidance. And the things that endure—the righteous deeds—have the best reward with your Lord, and the best outcome.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan Allah akan menambah petunjuk kepada mereka yang telah mendapat petunjuk. Dan amal-amal saleh yang kekal itu lebih baik pahalanya di sisi Tuhanmu dan lebih baik kesudahannya.

ayahs.arabic: أَفَرَءَيْتَ ٱلَّذِى كَفَرَ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا وَقَالَ لَأُوتَيَنَّ مَالًۭا وَوَلَدًا
ayahs.sahih: Then, have you seen he who disbelieved in Our verses and said, "I will surely be given wealth and children [in the next life]?"
ayahs.clear: Have you seen him who denied Our revelations, and said, “I will be given wealth and children”?
ayahs.kemenag: Maka apakah kamu telah melihat orang yang kafir kepada ayat-ayat Kami dan ia mengatakan: "Pasti aku akan diberi harta dan anak".

ayahs.arabic: أَطَّلَعَ ٱلْغَيْبَ أَمِ ٱتَّخَذَ عِندَ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ عَهْدًۭا
ayahs.sahih: Has he looked into the unseen, or has he taken from the Most Merciful a promise?
ayahs.clear: Did he look into the future, or did he receive a promise from the Most Merciful?
ayahs.kemenag: Adakah ia melihat yang ghaib atau ia telah membuat perjanjian di sisi Tuhan Yang Maha Pemurah?,

ayahs.arabic: كَلَّا ۚ سَنَكْتُبُ مَا يَقُولُ وَنَمُدُّ لَهُۥ مِنَ ٱلْعَذَابِ مَدًّۭا
ayahs.sahih: No! We will record what he says and extend for him from the punishment extensively.
ayahs.clear: No indeed! We will write what he says, and will keep extending the agony for him.
ayahs.kemenag: sekali-kali tidak, Kami akan menulis apa yang ia katakan, dan benar-benar Kami akan memperpanjang azab untuknya,

ayahs.arabic: وَنَرِثُهُۥ مَا يَقُولُ وَيَأْتِينَا فَرْدًۭا
ayahs.sahih: And We will inherit him [in] what he mentions, and he will come to Us alone.
ayahs.clear: Then We will inherit from him what he speaks of, and he will come to Us alone.
ayahs.kemenag: dan Kami akan mewarisi apa yang ia katakan itu, dan ia akan datang kepada Kami dengan seorang diri.

ayahs.arabic: وَٱتَّخَذُوا۟ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ ءَالِهَةًۭ لِّيَكُونُوا۟ لَهُمْ عِزًّۭا
ayahs.sahih: And they have taken besides Allah [false] deities that they would be for them [a source of] honor.
ayahs.clear: And they took, besides God, other gods, to be for them a source of strength.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan mereka telah mengambil sembahan-sembahan selain Allah, agar sembahan-sembahan itu menjadi pelindung bagi mereka,

ayahs.arabic: كَلَّا ۚ سَيَكْفُرُونَ بِعِبَادَتِهِمْ وَيَكُونُونَ عَلَيْهِمْ ضِدًّا
ayahs.sahih: No! Those "gods" will deny their worship of them and will be against them opponents [on the Day of Judgement].
ayahs.clear: By no means! They will reject their worship of them, and become opponents to them.
ayahs.kemenag: sekali-kali tidak. Kelak mereka (sembahan-sembahan) itu akan mengingkari penyembahan (pengikut-pengikutnya) terhadapnya, dan mereka (sembahan-sembahan) itu akan menjadi musuh bagi mereka.

ayahs.arabic: أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا ٱلشَّيَٰطِينَ عَلَى ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ تَؤُزُّهُمْ أَزًّۭا
ayahs.sahih: Do you not see that We have sent the devils upon the disbelievers, inciting them to [evil] with [constant] incitement?
ayahs.clear: Have you not considered how We dispatch the devils against the disbelievers, exciting them with incitement?
ayahs.kemenag: Tidakkah kamu lihat, bahwasanya Kami telah mengirim syaitan-syaitan itu kepada orang-orang kafir untuk menghasung mereka berbuat maksiat dengan sungguh-sungguh?,

ayahs.arabic: فَلَا تَعْجَلْ عَلَيْهِمْ ۖ إِنَّمَا نَعُدُّ لَهُمْ عَدًّۭا
ayahs.sahih: So be not impatient over them. We only count out to them a [limited] number.
ayahs.clear: So do not hurry against them. We are counting for them a countdown.
ayahs.kemenag: maka janganlah kamu tergesa-gesa memintakan siksa terhadap mereka, karena sesungguhnya Kami hanya menghitung datangnya (hari siksaan) untuk mereka dengan perhitungan yang teliti.

ayahs.arabic: يَوْمَ نَحْشُرُ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ إِلَى ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ وَفْدًۭا
ayahs.sahih: On the Day We will gather the righteous to the Most Merciful as a delegation
ayahs.clear: On the Day when We will gather the righteous to the Most Merciful, as guests.
ayahs.kemenag: (Ingatlah) hari (ketika) Kami mengumpulkan orang-orang yang takwa kepada Tuhan Yang Maha Pemurah sebagai perutusan yang terhormat,

ayahs.arabic: وَنَسُوقُ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ إِلَىٰ جَهَنَّمَ وِرْدًۭا
ayahs.sahih: And will drive the criminals to Hell in thirst
ayahs.clear: And herd the sinners into hell, like animals to water.
ayahs.kemenag: dan Kami akan menghalau orang-orang yang durhaka ke neraka Jahannam dalam keadaan dahaga.

ayahs.arabic: لَّا يَمْلِكُونَ ٱلشَّفَٰعَةَ إِلَّا مَنِ ٱتَّخَذَ عِندَ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ عَهْدًۭا
ayahs.sahih: None will have [power of] intercession except he who had taken from the Most Merciful a covenant.
ayahs.clear: They will have no power of intercession, except for someone who has an agreement with the Most Merciful.
ayahs.kemenag: Mereka tidak berhak mendapat syafa'at kecuali orang yang telah mengadakan perjanjian di sisi Tuhan Yang Maha Pemurah.

ayahs.arabic: وَقَالُوا۟ ٱتَّخَذَ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ وَلَدًۭا
ayahs.sahih: And they say, "The Most Merciful has taken [for Himself] a son."
ayahs.clear: And they say, “The Most Merciful has begotten a son.”
ayahs.kemenag: Dan mereka berkata: "Tuhan Yang Maha Pemurah mengambil (mempunyai) anak".

ayahs.arabic: لَّقَدْ جِئْتُمْ شَيْـًٔا إِدًّۭا
ayahs.sahih: You have done an atrocious thing.
ayahs.clear: You have come up with something monstrous.
ayahs.kemenag: Sesungguhnya kamu telah mendatangkan sesuatu perkara yang sangat mungkar,

ayahs.arabic: تَكَادُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتُ يَتَفَطَّرْنَ مِنْهُ وَتَنشَقُّ ٱلْأَرْضُ وَتَخِرُّ ٱلْجِبَالُ هَدًّا
ayahs.sahih: The heavens almost rupture therefrom and the earth splits open and the mountains collapse in devastation
ayahs.clear: At which the heavens almost rupture, and the earth splits, and the mountains fall and crumble.
ayahs.kemenag: hampir-hampir langit pecah karena ucapan itu, dan bumi belah, dan gunung-gunung runtuh,

ayahs.arabic: أَن دَعَوْا۟ لِلرَّحْمَٰنِ وَلَدًۭا
ayahs.sahih: That they attribute to the Most Merciful a son.
ayahs.clear: Because they attribute a son to the Most Merciful.
ayahs.kemenag: karena mereka mendakwakan Allah Yang Maha Pemurah mempunyai anak.

ayahs.arabic: وَمَا يَنۢبَغِى لِلرَّحْمَٰنِ أَن يَتَّخِذَ وَلَدًا
ayahs.sahih: And it is not appropriate for the Most Merciful that He should take a son.
ayahs.clear: It is not fitting for the Most Merciful to have a son.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan tidak layak bagi Tuhan Yang Maha Pemurah mengambil (mempunyai) anak.

ayahs.arabic: إِن كُلُّ مَن فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ إِلَّآ ءَاتِى ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ عَبْدًۭا
ayahs.sahih: There is no one in the heavens and earth but that he comes to the Most Merciful as a servant.
ayahs.clear: There is none in the heavens and the earth but will come to the Most Merciful as a servant.
ayahs.kemenag: Tidak ada seorangpun di langit dan di bumi, kecuali akan datang kepada Tuhan Yang Maha Pemurah selaku seorang hamba.

ayahs.arabic: لَّقَدْ أَحْصَىٰهُمْ وَعَدَّهُمْ عَدًّۭا
ayahs.sahih: He has enumerated them and counted them a [full] counting.
ayahs.clear: He has enumerated them, and counted them one by one.
ayahs.kemenag: Sesungguhnya Allah telah menentukan jumlah mereka dan menghitung mereka dengan hitungan yang teliti.

ayahs.arabic: وَكُلُّهُمْ ءَاتِيهِ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ فَرْدًا
ayahs.sahih: And all of them are coming to Him on the Day of Resurrection alone.
ayahs.clear: And each one of them will come to Him on the Day of Resurrection alone.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan tiap-tiap mereka akan datang kepada Allah pada hari kiamat dengan sendiri-sendiri.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ سَيَجْعَلُ لَهُمُ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ وُدًّۭا
ayahs.sahih: Indeed, those who have believed and done righteous deeds - the Most Merciful will appoint for them affection.
ayahs.clear: Those who believe and do righteous deeds, the Most Merciful will give them love.
ayahs.kemenag: Sesungguhnya orang-orang yang beriman dan beramal saleh, kelak Allah Yang Maha Pemurah akan menanamkan dalam (hati) mereka rasa kasih sayang.

ayahs.arabic: فَإِنَّمَا يَسَّرْنَٰهُ بِلِسَانِكَ لِتُبَشِّرَ بِهِ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ وَتُنذِرَ بِهِۦ قَوْمًۭا لُّدًّۭا
ayahs.sahih: So, [O Muhammad], We have only made Qur'an easy in the Arabic language that you may give good tidings thereby to the righteous and warn thereby a hostile people.
ayahs.clear: We made it easy in your tongue, in order to deliver good news to the righteous, and to warn with it a hostile people.
ayahs.kemenag: Maka sesungguhnya telah Kami mudahkan Al Quran itu dengan bahasamu, agar kamu dapat memberi kabar gembira dengan Al Quran itu kepada orang-orang yang bertakwa, dan agar kamu memberi peringatan dengannya kepada kaum yang membangkang.

ayahs.arabic: وَكَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا قَبْلَهُم مِّن قَرْنٍ هَلْ تُحِسُّ مِنْهُم مِّنْ أَحَدٍ أَوْ تَسْمَعُ لَهُمْ رِكْزًۢا
ayahs.sahih: And how many have We destroyed before them of generations? Do you perceive of them anyone or hear from them a sound?
ayahs.clear: How many a generation have We destroyed before them? Can you feel a single one of them, or hear from them the slightest whisper?
ayahs.kemenag: Dan berapa banyak telah Kami binasakan umat-umat sebelum mereka. Adakah kamu melihat seorangpun dari mereka atau kamu dengar suara mereka yang samar-samar?

ayahs.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ طه
ayahs.sahih: Ta, Ha.
ayahs.clear: Ta, Ha.
ayahs.kemenag: Thaahaa.

ayahs.arabic: مَآ أَنزَلْنَا عَلَيْكَ ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لِتَشْقَىٰٓ
ayahs.sahih: We have not sent down to you the Qur'an that you be distressed
ayahs.clear: We did not reveal the Quran to you to make you suffer.
ayahs.kemenag: Kami tidak menurunkan Al Quran ini kepadamu agar kamu menjadi susah;

ayahs.arabic: إِلَّا تَذْكِرَةًۭ لِّمَن يَخْشَىٰ
ayahs.sahih: But only as a reminder for those who fear [Allah] -
ayahs.clear: But only as a reminder for him who fears.
ayahs.kemenag: tetapi sebagai peringatan bagi orang yang takut (kepada Allah),

ayahs.arabic: تَنزِيلًۭا مِّمَّنْ خَلَقَ ٱلْأَرْضَ وَٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ ٱلْعُلَى
ayahs.sahih: A revelation from He who created the earth and highest heavens,
ayahs.clear: A revelation from He who created the earth and the high heavens.
ayahs.kemenag: yaitu diturunkan dari Allah yang menciptakan bumi dan langit yang tinggi.

ayahs.arabic: ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ عَلَى ٱلْعَرْشِ ٱسْتَوَىٰ
ayahs.sahih: The Most Merciful [who is] above the Throne established.
ayahs.clear: The Most Merciful; on the Throne He settled.
ayahs.kemenag: (Yaitu) Tuhan Yang Maha Pemurah. Yang bersemayam di atas 'Arsy.

ayahs.arabic: لَهُۥ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا وَمَا تَحْتَ ٱلثَّرَىٰ
ayahs.sahih: To Him belongs what is in the heavens and what is on the earth and what is between them and what is under the soil.
ayahs.clear: To Him belongs everything in the heavens and the earth, and everything between them, and everything beneath the soil.
ayahs.kemenag: Kepunyaan-Nya-lah semua yang ada di langit, semua yang di bumi, semua yang di antara keduanya dan semua yang di bawah tanah.

ayahs.arabic: وَإِن تَجْهَرْ بِٱلْقَوْلِ فَإِنَّهُۥ يَعْلَمُ ٱلسِّرَّ وَأَخْفَى
ayahs.sahih: And if you speak aloud - then indeed, He knows the secret and what is [even] more hidden.
ayahs.clear: If you speak aloud—He knows the secret, and the most hidden.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan jika kamu mengeraskan ucapanmu, maka sesungguhnya Dia mengetahui rahasia dan yang lebih tersembunyi.

ayahs.arabic: ٱللَّهُ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ۖ لَهُ ٱلْأَسْمَآءُ ٱلْحُسْنَىٰ
ayahs.sahih: Allah - there is no deity except Him. To Him belong the best names.
ayahs.clear: God, there is no god but He, His are the Most Beautiful Names.
ayahs.kemenag: Dialah Allah, tidak ada Tuhan (yang berhak disembah) melainkan Dia. Dia mempunyai al asmaaul husna (nama-nama yang baik),

ayahs.arabic: وَهَلْ أَتَىٰكَ حَدِيثُ مُوسَىٰٓ
ayahs.sahih: And has the story of Moses reached you? -
ayahs.clear: Has the story of Moses reached you?
ayahs.kemenag: Apakah telah sampai kepadamu kisah Musa?

ayahs.arabic: إِذْ رَءَا نَارًۭا فَقَالَ لِأَهْلِهِ ٱمْكُثُوٓا۟ إِنِّىٓ ءَانَسْتُ نَارًۭا لَّعَلِّىٓ ءَاتِيكُم مِّنْهَا بِقَبَسٍ أَوْ أَجِدُ عَلَى ٱلنَّارِ هُدًۭى
ayahs.sahih: When he saw a fire and said to his family, "Stay here; indeed, I have perceived a fire; perhaps I can bring you a torch or find at the fire some guidance."
ayahs.clear: When he saw a fire, he said to his family, “Stay; I have noticed a fire; Perhaps I can bring you a torch therefrom, or find some guidance by the fire.”
ayahs.kemenag: Ketika ia melihat api, lalu berkatalah ia kepada keluarganya: "Tinggallah kamu (di sini), sesungguhnya aku melihat api, mudah-mudahan aku dapat membawa sedikit daripadanya kepadamu atau aku akan mendapat petunjuk di tempat api itu".

ayahs.arabic: فَلَمَّآ أَتَىٰهَا نُودِىَ يَٰمُوسَىٰٓ
ayahs.sahih: And when he came to it, he was called, "O Moses,
ayahs.clear: Then, when he reached it, he was called, “O Moses.
ayahs.kemenag: Maka ketika ia datang ke tempat api itu ia dipanggil: "Hai Musa.

ayahs.arabic: إِنِّىٓ أَنَا۠ رَبُّكَ فَٱخْلَعْ نَعْلَيْكَ ۖ إِنَّكَ بِٱلْوَادِ ٱلْمُقَدَّسِ طُوًۭى
ayahs.sahih: Indeed, I am your Lord, so remove your sandals. Indeed, you are in the sacred valley of Tuwa.
ayahs.clear: I—I am your Lord. Take off your shoes. You are in the sacred valley of Tuwa.
ayahs.kemenag: Sesungguhnya Aku inilah Tuhanmu, maka tanggalkanlah kedua terompahmu; sesungguhnya kamu berada dilembah yang suci, Thuwa.

ayahs.arabic: وَأَنَا ٱخْتَرْتُكَ فَٱسْتَمِعْ لِمَا يُوحَىٰٓ
ayahs.sahih: And I have chosen you, so listen to what is revealed [to you].
ayahs.clear: I have chosen you, so listen to what is revealed.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan Aku telah memilih kamu, maka dengarkanlah apa yang akan diwahyukan (kepadamu).

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّنِىٓ أَنَا ٱللَّهُ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّآ أَنَا۠ فَٱعْبُدْنِى وَأَقِمِ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ لِذِكْرِىٓ
ayahs.sahih: Indeed, I am Allah. There is no deity except Me, so worship Me and establish prayer for My remembrance.
ayahs.clear: I—I am God. There is no God but I. So serve Me, and practice the prayer for My remembrance.
ayahs.kemenag: Sesungguhnya Aku ini adalah Allah, tidak ada Tuhan (yang hak) selain Aku, maka sembahlah Aku dan dirikanlah shalat untuk mengingat Aku.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلسَّاعَةَ ءَاتِيَةٌ أَكَادُ أُخْفِيهَا لِتُجْزَىٰ كُلُّ نَفْسٍۭ بِمَا تَسْعَىٰ
ayahs.sahih: Indeed, the Hour is coming - I almost conceal it - so that every soul may be recompensed according to that for which it strives.
ayahs.clear: The Hour is coming—but I keep it almost hidden—so that each soul will be paid for what it endeavors.
ayahs.kemenag: Segungguhnya hari kiamat itu akan datang Aku merahasiakan (waktunya) agar supaya tiap-tiap diri itu dibalas dengan apa yang ia usahakan.

ayahs.arabic: فَلَا يَصُدَّنَّكَ عَنْهَا مَن لَّا يُؤْمِنُ بِهَا وَٱتَّبَعَ هَوَىٰهُ فَتَرْدَىٰ
ayahs.sahih: So do not let one avert you from it who does not believe in it and follows his desire, for you [then] would perish.
ayahs.clear: And do not let him who denies it and follows his desire turn you away from it, lest you fall.
ayahs.kemenag: Maka sekali-kali janganlah kamu dipalingkan daripadanya oleh orang yang tidak beriman kepadanya dan oleh orang yang mengikuti hawa nafsunya, yang menyebabkan kamu jadi binasa".

ayahs.arabic: وَمَا تِلْكَ بِيَمِينِكَ يَٰمُوسَىٰ
ayahs.sahih: And what is that in your right hand, O Moses?"
ayahs.clear: And what is that in your right-hand, O Moses?”
ayahs.kemenag: Apakah itu yang di tangan kananmu, hai Musa?

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ هِىَ عَصَاىَ أَتَوَكَّؤُا۟ عَلَيْهَا وَأَهُشُّ بِهَا عَلَىٰ غَنَمِى وَلِىَ فِيهَا مَـَٔارِبُ أُخْرَىٰ
ayahs.sahih: He said, "It is my staff; I lean upon it, and I bring down leaves for my sheep and I have therein other uses."
ayahs.clear: He said, “This is my staff. I lean on it, and herd my sheep with it, and I have other uses for it.”
ayahs.kemenag: Berkata Musa: "Ini adalah tongkatku, aku bertelekan padanya, dan aku pukul (daun) dengannya untuk kambingku, dan bagiku ada lagi keperluan yang lain padanya".

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ أَلْقِهَا يَٰمُوسَىٰ
ayahs.sahih: [Allah] said, "Throw it down, O Moses."
ayahs.clear: He said, “Throw it, O Moses.”
ayahs.kemenag: Allah berfirman: "Lemparkanlah ia, hai Musa!"

ayahs.arabic: فَأَلْقَىٰهَا فَإِذَا هِىَ حَيَّةٌۭ تَسْعَىٰ
ayahs.sahih: So he threw it down, and thereupon it was a snake, moving swiftly.
ayahs.clear: So he threw it—thereupon it became a moving serpent.
