ayahs.kemenag: Lalu dilemparkannyalah tongkat itu, maka tiba-tiba ia menjadi seekor ular yang merayap dengan cepat.

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ خُذْهَا وَلَا تَخَفْ ۖ سَنُعِيدُهَا سِيرَتَهَا ٱلْأُولَىٰ
ayahs.sahih: [Allah] said, "Seize it and fear not; We will return it to its former condition.
ayahs.clear: He said, “Take hold of it, and do not fear. We will restore it to its original condition.
ayahs.kemenag: Allah berfirman: "Peganglah ia dan jangan takut, Kami akan mengembalikannya kepada keadaannya semula,

ayahs.arabic: وَٱضْمُمْ يَدَكَ إِلَىٰ جَنَاحِكَ تَخْرُجْ بَيْضَآءَ مِنْ غَيْرِ سُوٓءٍ ءَايَةً أُخْرَىٰ
ayahs.sahih: And draw in your hand to your side; it will come out white without disease - another sign,
ayahs.clear: And press your hand to your side; it will come out white, without a blemish—another sign.
ayahs.kemenag: dan kepitkanlah tanganmu ke ketiakmu, niscaya ia ke luar menjadi putih cemerlang tanpa cacad, sebagai mukjizat yang lain (pula),

ayahs.arabic: لِنُرِيَكَ مِنْ ءَايَٰتِنَا ٱلْكُبْرَى
ayahs.sahih: That We may show you [some] of Our greater signs.
ayahs.clear: That We may show you some of Our greatest signs.
ayahs.kemenag: untuk Kami perlihatkan kepadamu sebahagian dari tanda-tanda kekuasaan Kami yang sangat besar,

ayahs.arabic: ٱذْهَبْ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ إِنَّهُۥ طَغَىٰ
ayahs.sahih: Go to Pharaoh. Indeed, he has transgressed."
ayahs.clear: Go to Pharaoh; He has transgressed.”
ayahs.kemenag: Pergilah kepada Fir'aun; sesungguhnya ia telah melampaui batas".

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ ٱشْرَحْ لِى صَدْرِى
ayahs.sahih: [Moses] said, "My Lord, expand for me my breast [with assurance]
ayahs.clear: He said, “My Lord, put my heart at peace for me.
ayahs.kemenag: Berkata Musa: "Ya Tuhanku, lapangkanlah untukku dadaku,

ayahs.arabic: وَيَسِّرْ لِىٓ أَمْرِى
ayahs.sahih: And ease for me my task
ayahs.clear: And ease my task for me.
ayahs.kemenag: dan mudahkanlah untukku urusanku,

ayahs.arabic: وَٱحْلُلْ عُقْدَةًۭ مِّن لِّسَانِى
ayahs.sahih: And untie the knot from my tongue
ayahs.clear: And untie the knot from my tongue.
ayahs.kemenag: dan lepaskanlah kekakuan dari lidahku,

ayahs.arabic: يَفْقَهُوا۟ قَوْلِى
ayahs.sahih: That they may understand my speech.
ayahs.clear: So they can understand my speech.
ayahs.kemenag: supaya mereka mengerti perkataanku,

ayahs.arabic: وَٱجْعَل لِّى وَزِيرًۭا مِّنْ أَهْلِى
ayahs.sahih: And appoint for me a minister from my family -
ayahs.clear: And appoint an assistant for me, from my family.
ayahs.kemenag: dan jadikanlah untukku seorang pembantu dari keluargaku,

ayahs.arabic: هَٰرُونَ أَخِى
ayahs.sahih: Aaron, my brother.
ayahs.clear: Aaron, my brother.
ayahs.kemenag: (yaitu) Harun, saudaraku,

ayahs.arabic: ٱشْدُدْ بِهِۦٓ أَزْرِى
ayahs.sahih: Increase through him my strength
ayahs.clear: Strengthen me with him.
ayahs.kemenag: teguhkanlah dengan dia kekuatanku,

ayahs.arabic: وَأَشْرِكْهُ فِىٓ أَمْرِى
ayahs.sahih: And let him share my task
ayahs.clear: And have him share in my mission.
ayahs.kemenag: dan jadikankanlah dia sekutu dalam urusanku,

ayahs.arabic: كَىْ نُسَبِّحَكَ كَثِيرًۭا
ayahs.sahih: That we may exalt You much
ayahs.clear: That we may glorify You much.
ayahs.kemenag: supaya kami banyak bertasbih kepada Engkau,

ayahs.arabic: وَنَذْكُرَكَ كَثِيرًا
ayahs.sahih: And remember You much.
ayahs.clear: And remember You much.
ayahs.kemenag: dan banyak mengingat Engkau.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّكَ كُنتَ بِنَا بَصِيرًۭا
ayahs.sahih: Indeed, You are of us ever Seeing."
ayahs.clear: You are always watching over us.”
ayahs.kemenag: Sesungguhnya Engkau adalah Maha Melihat (keadaan) kami".

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ قَدْ أُوتِيتَ سُؤْلَكَ يَٰمُوسَىٰ
ayahs.sahih: [Allah] said, "You have been granted your request, O Moses.
ayahs.clear: He said, “You are granted your request, O Moses.
ayahs.kemenag: Allah berfirman: "Sesungguhnya telah diperkenankan permintaanmu, hai Musa".

ayahs.arabic: وَلَقَدْ مَنَنَّا عَلَيْكَ مَرَّةً أُخْرَىٰٓ
ayahs.sahih: And We had already conferred favor upon you another time,
ayahs.clear: We had favored you another time.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan sesungguhnya Kami telah memberi nikmat kepadamu pada kali yang lain,

ayahs.arabic: إِذْ أَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَىٰٓ أُمِّكَ مَا يُوحَىٰٓ
ayahs.sahih: When We inspired to your mother what We inspired,
ayahs.clear: When We inspired your mother with the inspiration.
ayahs.kemenag: yaitu ketika Kami mengilhamkan kepada ibumu suatu yang diilhamkan,

ayahs.arabic: أَنِ ٱقْذِفِيهِ فِى ٱلتَّابُوتِ فَٱقْذِفِيهِ فِى ٱلْيَمِّ فَلْيُلْقِهِ ٱلْيَمُّ بِٱلسَّاحِلِ يَأْخُذْهُ عَدُوٌّۭ لِّى وَعَدُوٌّۭ لَّهُۥ ۚ وَأَلْقَيْتُ عَلَيْكَ مَحَبَّةًۭ مِّنِّى وَلِتُصْنَعَ عَلَىٰ عَيْنِىٓ
ayahs.sahih: [Saying], 'Cast him into the chest and cast it into the river, and the river will throw it onto the bank; there will take him an enemy to Me and an enemy to him.' And I bestowed upon you love from Me that you would be brought up under My eye.
ayahs.clear: `Put him in the chest; then cast him into the river. The river will wash him to shore, where an enemy of Mine and an enemy of his will pick him up. And I have bestowed upon you love from Me, so that you may be reared before My eye.
ayahs.kemenag: Yaitu: "Letakkanlah ia (Musa) didalam peti, kemudian lemparkanlah ia ke sungai (Nil), maka pasti sungai itu membawanya ke tepi, supaya diambil oleh (Fir'aun) musuh-Ku dan musuhnya. Dan Aku telah melimpahkan kepadamu kasih sayang yang datang dari-Ku; dan supaya kamu diasuh di bawah pengawasan-Ku,

ayahs.arabic: إِذْ تَمْشِىٓ أُخْتُكَ فَتَقُولُ هَلْ أَدُلُّكُمْ عَلَىٰ مَن يَكْفُلُهُۥ ۖ فَرَجَعْنَٰكَ إِلَىٰٓ أُمِّكَ كَىْ تَقَرَّ عَيْنُهَا وَلَا تَحْزَنَ ۚ وَقَتَلْتَ نَفْسًۭا فَنَجَّيْنَٰكَ مِنَ ٱلْغَمِّ وَفَتَنَّٰكَ فُتُونًۭا ۚ فَلَبِثْتَ سِنِينَ فِىٓ أَهْلِ مَدْيَنَ ثُمَّ جِئْتَ عَلَىٰ قَدَرٍۢ يَٰمُوسَىٰ
ayahs.sahih: [And We favored you] when your sister went and said, 'Shall I direct you to someone who will be responsible for him?' So We restored you to your mother that she might be content and not grieve. And you killed someone, but We saved you from retaliation and tried you with a [severe] trial. And you remained [some] years among the people of Madyan. Then you came [here] at the decreed time, O Moses.
ayahs.clear: When your sister walked along, and said, ‘Shall I tell you about someone who will take care of him?' So We returned you to your mother, that she may be comforted, and not sorrow. And you killed a person, but We saved you from stress; and We tested you thoroughly. And you stayed years among the people of Median. Then you came back, as ordained, O Moses.
ayahs.kemenag: (yaitu) ketika saudaramu yang perempuan berjalan, lalu ia berkata kepada (keluarga Fir'aun): "Bolehkah saya menunjukkan kepadamu orang yang akan memeliharanya?" Maka Kami mengembalikanmu kepada ibumu, agar senang hatinya dan tidak berduka cita. Dan kamu pernah membunuh seorang manusia, lalu Kami selamatkan kamu dari kesusahan dan Kami telah mencobamu dengan beberapa cobaan; maka kamu tinggal beberapa tahun diantara penduduk Madyan, kemudian kamu datang menurut waktu yang ditetapkan hai Musa,

ayahs.arabic: وَٱصْطَنَعْتُكَ لِنَفْسِى
ayahs.sahih: And I produced you for Myself.
ayahs.clear: And I made you for Myself.
ayahs.kemenag: dan Aku telah memilihmu untuk diri-Ku.

ayahs.arabic: ٱذْهَبْ أَنتَ وَأَخُوكَ بِـَٔايَٰتِى وَلَا تَنِيَا فِى ذِكْرِى
ayahs.sahih: Go, you and your brother, with My signs and do not slacken in My remembrance.
ayahs.clear: Go, you and your brother, with My signs, and do not neglect My remembrance.
ayahs.kemenag: Pergilah kamu beserta saudaramu dengan membawa ayat-ayat-Ku, dan janganlah kamu berdua lalai dalam mengingat-Ku;

ayahs.arabic: ٱذْهَبَآ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ إِنَّهُۥ طَغَىٰ
ayahs.sahih: Go, both of you, to Pharaoh. Indeed, he has transgressed.
ayahs.clear: Go to Pharaoh. He has tyrannized.
ayahs.kemenag: Pergilah kamu berdua kepada Fir'aun, sesungguhnya dia telah melampaui batas;

ayahs.arabic: فَقُولَا لَهُۥ قَوْلًۭا لَّيِّنًۭا لَّعَلَّهُۥ يَتَذَكَّرُ أَوْ يَخْشَىٰ
ayahs.sahih: And speak to him with gentle speech that perhaps he may be reminded or fear [Allah]."
ayahs.clear: But speak to him nicely. Perhaps he will remember, or have some fear.”
ayahs.kemenag: maka berbicaralah kamu berdua kepadanya dengan kata-kata yang lemah lembut, mudah-mudahan ia ingat atau takut".

ayahs.arabic: قَالَا رَبَّنَآ إِنَّنَا نَخَافُ أَن يَفْرُطَ عَلَيْنَآ أَوْ أَن يَطْغَىٰ
ayahs.sahih: They said, "Our Lord, indeed we are afraid that he will hasten [punishment] against us or that he will transgress."
ayahs.clear: They said, “Lord, we fear he may persecute us, or become violent.”
ayahs.kemenag: Berkatalah mereka berdua: "Ya Tuhan kami, sesungguhnya kami khawatir bahwa ia segera menyiksa kami atau akan bertambah melampaui batas".

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ لَا تَخَافَآ ۖ إِنَّنِى مَعَكُمَآ أَسْمَعُ وَأَرَىٰ
ayahs.sahih: [Allah] said, "Fear not. Indeed, I am with you both; I hear and I see.
ayahs.clear: He said, “Do not fear, I am with you, I hear and I see.
ayahs.kemenag: Allah berfirman: "Janganlah kamu berdua khawatir, sesungguhnya Aku beserta kamu berdua, Aku mendengar dan melihat".

ayahs.arabic: فَأْتِيَاهُ فَقُولَآ إِنَّا رَسُولَا رَبِّكَ فَأَرْسِلْ مَعَنَا بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ وَلَا تُعَذِّبْهُمْ ۖ قَدْ جِئْنَٰكَ بِـَٔايَةٍۢ مِّن رَّبِّكَ ۖ وَٱلسَّلَٰمُ عَلَىٰ مَنِ ٱتَّبَعَ ٱلْهُدَىٰٓ
ayahs.sahih: So go to him and say, 'Indeed, we are messengers of your Lord, so send with us the Children of Israel and do not torment them. We have come to you with a sign from your Lord. And peace will be upon he who follows the guidance.
ayahs.clear: Approach him and say, `We are the messengers of your Lord; so let the Children of Israel go with us, and do not torment them. We bring you a sign from your Lord, and peace be upon him who follows guidance.
ayahs.kemenag: Maka datanglah kamu berdua kepadanya (Fir'aun) dan katakanlah: "Sesungguhnya kami berdua adalah utusan Tuhanmu, maka lepaskanlah Bani Israil bersama kami dan janganlah kamu menyiksa mereka. Sesungguhnya kami telah datang kepadamu dengan membawa bukti (atas kerasulan kami) dari Tuhanmu. Dan keselamatan itu dilimpahkan kepada orang yang mengikuti petunjuk.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّا قَدْ أُوحِىَ إِلَيْنَآ أَنَّ ٱلْعَذَابَ عَلَىٰ مَن كَذَّبَ وَتَوَلَّىٰ
ayahs.sahih: Indeed, it has been revealed to us that the punishment will be upon whoever denies and turns away.' "
ayahs.clear: It was revealed to us that the punishment falls upon him who disbelieves and turns away.'“
ayahs.kemenag: Sesungguhnya telah diwahyukan kepada kami bahwa siksa itu (ditimpakan) atas orang-orang yang mendustakan dan berpaling.

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ فَمَن رَّبُّكُمَا يَٰمُوسَىٰ
ayahs.sahih: [Pharaoh] said, "So who is the Lord of you two, O Moses?"
ayahs.clear: He said, “Who is your Lord, O Moses.”
ayahs.kemenag: Berkata Fir'aun: "Maka siapakah Tuhanmu berdua, hai Musa?.

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ رَبُّنَا ٱلَّذِىٓ أَعْطَىٰ كُلَّ شَىْءٍ خَلْقَهُۥ ثُمَّ هَدَىٰ
ayahs.sahih: He said, "Our Lord is He who gave each thing its form and then guided [it]."
ayahs.clear: He said, “Our Lord is He who gave everything its existence, then guided it.”
ayahs.kemenag: Musa berkata: "Tuhan kami ialah (Tuhan) yang telah memberikan kepada tiap-tiap sesuatu bentuk kejadiannya, kemudian memberinya petunjuk.

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ فَمَا بَالُ ٱلْقُرُونِ ٱلْأُولَىٰ
ayahs.sahih: [Pharaoh] said, "Then what is the case of the former generations?"
ayahs.clear: He said, “What about the first generations?”
ayahs.kemenag: Berkata Fir'aun: "Maka bagaimanakah keadaan umat-umat yang dahulu?"

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ عِلْمُهَا عِندَ رَبِّى فِى كِتَٰبٍۢ ۖ لَّا يَضِلُّ رَبِّى وَلَا يَنسَى
ayahs.sahih: [Moses] said, "The knowledge thereof is with my Lord in a record. My Lord neither errs nor forgets."
ayahs.clear: He said, “Knowledge thereof is with my Lord, in a Book. My Lord never errs, nor does He forget.”
ayahs.kemenag: Musa menjawab: "Pengetahuan tentang itu ada di sisi Tuhanku, di dalam sebuah kitab, Tuhan kami tidak akan salah dan tidak (pula) lupa;

ayahs.arabic: ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلْأَرْضَ مَهْدًۭا وَسَلَكَ لَكُمْ فِيهَا سُبُلًۭا وَأَنزَلَ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءًۭ فَأَخْرَجْنَا بِهِۦٓ أَزْوَٰجًۭا مِّن نَّبَاتٍۢ شَتَّىٰ
ayahs.sahih: [It is He] who has made for you the earth as a bed [spread out] and inserted therein for you roadways and sent down from the sky, rain and produced thereby categories of various plants.
ayahs.clear: He who made the earth a habitat for you; and traced in it routes for you; and sent down water from the sky, with which We produce pairs of diverse plants.
ayahs.kemenag: Yang telah menjadikan bagimu bumi sebagai hamparan dan Yang telah menjadikan bagimu di bumi itu jalan-ja]an, dan menurunkan dari langit air hujan. Maka Kami tumbuhkan dengan air hujan itu berjenis-jenis dari tumbuh-tumbuhan yang bermacam-macam.

ayahs.arabic: كُلُوا۟ وَٱرْعَوْا۟ أَنْعَٰمَكُمْ ۗ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَٰتٍۢ لِّأُو۟لِى ٱلنُّهَىٰ
ayahs.sahih: Eat [therefrom] and pasture your livestock. Indeed, in that are signs for those of intelligence.
ayahs.clear: Eat and pasture your livestock. In that are signs for those with understanding.
ayahs.kemenag: Makanlah dan gembalakanlah binatang-binatangmu. Sesungguhnya pada yang demikian itu, terdapat tanda-tanda kekuasaan Allah bagi orang-orang yang berakal.

ayahs.arabic: ۞ مِنْهَا خَلَقْنَٰكُمْ وَفِيهَا نُعِيدُكُمْ وَمِنْهَا نُخْرِجُكُمْ تَارَةً أُخْرَىٰ
ayahs.sahih: From the earth We created you, and into it We will return you, and from it We will extract you another time.
ayahs.clear: From it We created you, and into it We will return you, and from it We will bring you out another time.
ayahs.kemenag: Dari bumi (tanah) itulah Kami menjadikan kamu dan kepadanya Kami akan mengembalikan kamu dan daripadanya Kami akan mengeluarkan kamu pada kali yang lain,

ayahs.arabic: وَلَقَدْ أَرَيْنَٰهُ ءَايَٰتِنَا كُلَّهَا فَكَذَّبَ وَأَبَىٰ
ayahs.sahih: And We certainly showed Pharaoh Our signs - all of them - but he denied and refused.
ayahs.clear: We showed him Our signs, all of them, but he denied and refused.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan sesungguhnya Kami telah perlihatkan kepadanya (Fir'aun) tanda-tanda kekuasaan Kami semuanya maka ia mendustakan dan enggan (menerima kebenaran).

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ أَجِئْتَنَا لِتُخْرِجَنَا مِنْ أَرْضِنَا بِسِحْرِكَ يَٰمُوسَىٰ
ayahs.sahih: He said, "Have you come to us to drive us out of our land with your magic, O Moses?
ayahs.clear: He said, “Did you come to us to drive us out of our land with your magic, O Moses?
ayahs.kemenag: Berkata Fir'aun: "Adakah kamu datang kepada kami untuk mengusir kami dari negeri kami (ini) dengan sihirmu, hai Musa?

ayahs.arabic: فَلَنَأْتِيَنَّكَ بِسِحْرٍۢ مِّثْلِهِۦ فَٱجْعَلْ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَكَ مَوْعِدًۭا لَّا نُخْلِفُهُۥ نَحْنُ وَلَآ أَنتَ مَكَانًۭا سُوًۭى
ayahs.sahih: Then we will surely bring you magic like it, so make between us and you an appointment, which we will not fail to keep and neither will you, in a place assigned."
ayahs.clear: We will produce for you magic like it; so make an appointment between us and you, which we will not miss—neither us, nor you—in a central place.”
ayahs.kemenag: Dan kamipun pasti akan mendatangkan (pula) kepadamu sihir semacam itu, maka buatlah suatu waktu untuk pertemuan antara kami dan kamu, yang kami tidak akan menyalahinya dan tidak (pula) kamu di suatu tempat yang pertengahan (letaknya).

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ مَوْعِدُكُمْ يَوْمُ ٱلزِّينَةِ وَأَن يُحْشَرَ ٱلنَّاسُ ضُحًۭى
ayahs.sahih: [Moses] said, "Your appointment is on the day of the festival when the people assemble at mid-morning."
ayahs.clear: He said, “Your appointment is the day of the festival, so let the people be gathered together at mid-morning.”
ayahs.kemenag: Berkata Musa: "Waktu untuk pertemuan (kami dengan) kamu itu ialah di hari raya dan hendaklah dikumpulkan manusia pada waktu matahari sepenggalahan naik".

ayahs.arabic: فَتَوَلَّىٰ فِرْعَوْنُ فَجَمَعَ كَيْدَهُۥ ثُمَّ أَتَىٰ
ayahs.sahih: So Pharaoh went away, put together his plan, and then came [to Moses].
ayahs.clear: Pharaoh turned away, put together his plan, and then came back.
ayahs.kemenag: Maka Fir'aun meninggalkan (tempat itu), lalu mengatur tipu dayanya, kemudian dia datang.

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ لَهُم مُّوسَىٰ وَيْلَكُمْ لَا تَفْتَرُوا۟ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ كَذِبًۭا فَيُسْحِتَكُم بِعَذَابٍۢ ۖ وَقَدْ خَابَ مَنِ ٱفْتَرَىٰ
ayahs.sahih: Moses said to the magicians summoned by Pharaoh, "Woe to you! Do not invent a lie against Allah or He will exterminate you with a punishment; and he has failed who invents [such falsehood]."
ayahs.clear: Moses said to them, “Woe to you. Do not fabricate lies against God, or He will destroy you with a punishment. He who invents lies will fail.”
ayahs.kemenag: Berkata Musa kepada mereka: "Celakalah kamu, janganlah kamu mengada-adakan kedustaan terhadap Allah, maka Dia membinasakan kamu dengan siksa". Dan sesungguhnya telah merugi orang yang mengada-adakan kedustaan.

ayahs.arabic: فَتَنَٰزَعُوٓا۟ أَمْرَهُم بَيْنَهُمْ وَأَسَرُّوا۟ ٱلنَّجْوَىٰ
ayahs.sahih: So they disputed over their affair among themselves and concealed their private conversation.
ayahs.clear: They disagreed among themselves over their affair, and conferred secretly.
ayahs.kemenag: Maka mereka berbantah-bantahan tentang urusan mereka di antara mereka dan mereka merahasiakan percakapan (mereka).

ayahs.arabic: قَالُوٓا۟ إِنْ هَٰذَٰنِ لَسَٰحِرَٰنِ يُرِيدَانِ أَن يُخْرِجَاكُم مِّنْ أَرْضِكُم بِسِحْرِهِمَا وَيَذْهَبَا بِطَرِيقَتِكُمُ ٱلْمُثْلَىٰ
ayahs.sahih: They said, "Indeed, these are two magicians who want to drive you out of your land with their magic and do away with your most exemplary way.
ayahs.clear: They said, “These two are magicians who want to drive you out of your land with their magic, and to abolish your exemplary way of life.
ayahs.kemenag: Mereka berkata: "Sesungguhnya dua orang ini adalah benar-benar ahli sihir yang hendak mengusir kamu dari negeri kamu dengan sihirnya dan hendak melenyapkan kedudukan kamu yang utama.

ayahs.arabic: فَأَجْمِعُوا۟ كَيْدَكُمْ ثُمَّ ٱئْتُوا۟ صَفًّۭا ۚ وَقَدْ أَفْلَحَ ٱلْيَوْمَ مَنِ ٱسْتَعْلَىٰ
ayahs.sahih: So resolve upon your plan and then come [forward] in line. And he has succeeded today who overcomes."
ayahs.clear: So settle your plan, and come as one front. Today, whoever gains the upper hand will succeed.”
ayahs.kemenag: Maka himpunkanlah segala daya (sihir) kamu sekalian, kemudian datanglah dengan berbaris. dan sesungguhnya beruntunglah oran yang menang pada hari ini.

ayahs.arabic: قَالُوا۟ يَٰمُوسَىٰٓ إِمَّآ أَن تُلْقِىَ وَإِمَّآ أَن نَّكُونَ أَوَّلَ مَنْ أَلْقَىٰ
ayahs.sahih: They said, "O Moses, either you throw or we will be the first to throw."
ayahs.clear: They said, “O Moses, either you throw, or we will be the first to throw.”
ayahs.kemenag: (Setelah mereka berkumpul) mereka berkata: "Hai Musa (pilihlah), apakah kamu yang melemparkan (dahulu) atau kamikah orang yang mula-mula melemparkan?"

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ بَلْ أَلْقُوا۟ ۖ فَإِذَا حِبَالُهُمْ وَعِصِيُّهُمْ يُخَيَّلُ إِلَيْهِ مِن سِحْرِهِمْ أَنَّهَا تَسْعَىٰ
ayahs.sahih: He said, "Rather, you throw." And suddenly their ropes and staffs seemed to him from their magic that they were moving [like snakes].
ayahs.clear: He said, “You throw.” And suddenly, their ropes and sticks appeared to him, because of their magic, to be crawling swiftly.
ayahs.kemenag: Berkata Musa: "Silahkan kamu sekalian melemparkan". Maka tiba-tiba tali-tali dan tongkat-tongkat mereka, terbayang kepada Musa seakan-akan ia merayap cepat, lantaran sihir mereka.

ayahs.arabic: فَأَوْجَسَ فِى نَفْسِهِۦ خِيفَةًۭ مُّوسَىٰ
ayahs.sahih: And he sensed within himself apprehension, did Moses.
ayahs.clear: So Moses felt apprehensive within himself.
ayahs.kemenag: Maka Musa merasa takut dalam hatinya.

ayahs.arabic: قُلْنَا لَا تَخَفْ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلْأَعْلَىٰ
ayahs.sahih: Allah said, "Fear not. Indeed, it is you who are superior.
ayahs.clear: We said, “Do not be afraid, you are the uppermost.
ayahs.kemenag: Kami berkata: "janganlah kamu takut, sesungguhnya kamulah yang paling unggul (menang).

ayahs.arabic: وَأَلْقِ مَا فِى يَمِينِكَ تَلْقَفْ مَا صَنَعُوٓا۟ ۖ إِنَّمَا صَنَعُوا۟ كَيْدُ سَٰحِرٍۢ ۖ وَلَا يُفْلِحُ ٱلسَّاحِرُ حَيْثُ أَتَىٰ
ayahs.sahih: And throw what is in your right hand; it will swallow up what they have crafted. What they have crafted is but the trick of a magician, and the magician will not succeed wherever he is."
ayahs.clear: Now throw down what is in your right hand—it will swallow what they have crafted. What they have crafted is only a magician’s trickery. But the magician will not succeed, no matter what he does.”
ayahs.kemenag: Dan lemparkanlah apa yang ada ditangan kananmu, niscaya ia akan menelan apa yang mereka perbuat. "Sesungguhnya apa yang mereka perbuat itu adalah tipu daya tukang sihir (belaka). Dan tidak akan menang tukang sihir itu, dari mana saja ia datang".

ayahs.arabic: فَأُلْقِىَ ٱلسَّحَرَةُ سُجَّدًۭا قَالُوٓا۟ ءَامَنَّا بِرَبِّ هَٰرُونَ وَمُوسَىٰ
ayahs.sahih: So the magicians fell down in prostration. They said, "We have believed in the Lord of Aaron and Moses."
ayahs.clear: And the magicians fell down prostrate. They said, “We have believed in the Lord of Aaron and Moses.”
ayahs.kemenag: Lalu tukang-tukang sihir itu tersungkur dengan bersujud, seraya berkata: "Kami telah percaya kepada Tuhan Harun dan Musa".

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ ءَامَنتُمْ لَهُۥ قَبْلَ أَنْ ءَاذَنَ لَكُمْ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ لَكَبِيرُكُمُ ٱلَّذِى عَلَّمَكُمُ ٱلسِّحْرَ ۖ فَلَأُقَطِّعَنَّ أَيْدِيَكُمْ وَأَرْجُلَكُم مِّنْ خِلَٰفٍۢ وَلَأُصَلِّبَنَّكُمْ فِى جُذُوعِ ٱلنَّخْلِ وَلَتَعْلَمُنَّ أَيُّنَآ أَشَدُّ عَذَابًۭا وَأَبْقَىٰ
ayahs.sahih: [Pharaoh] said, "You believed him before I gave you permission. Indeed, he is your leader who has taught you magic. So I will surely cut off your hands and your feet on opposite sides, and I will crucify you on the trunks of palm trees, and you will surely know which of us is more severe in [giving] punishment and more enduring."
ayahs.clear: He said, “Did you believe in him before I have given you permission? He must be your chief, who has taught you magic. I will cut off your hands and your feet on alternate sides, and I will crucify you on the trunks of the palm-trees. Then you will know which of us is more severe in punishment, and more lasting.”
ayahs.kemenag: Berkata Fir'aun: "Apakah kamu telah beriman kepadanya (Musa) sebelum aku memberi izin kepadamu sekalian. Sesungguhnya ia adalah pemimpinmu yang mengajarkan sihir kepadamu sekalian. Maka sesungguhnya aku akan memotong tangan dan kaki kamu sekalian dengan bersilang secara bertimbal balik, dan sesungguhnya aku akan menyalib kamu sekalian pada pangkal pohon kurma dan sesungguhnya kamu akan mengetahui siapa di antara kita yang lebih pedih dan lebih kekal siksanya".

ayahs.arabic: قَالُوا۟ لَن نُّؤْثِرَكَ عَلَىٰ مَا جَآءَنَا مِنَ ٱلْبَيِّنَٰتِ وَٱلَّذِى فَطَرَنَا ۖ فَٱقْضِ مَآ أَنتَ قَاضٍ ۖ إِنَّمَا تَقْضِى هَٰذِهِ ٱلْحَيَوٰةَ ٱلدُّنْيَآ
ayahs.sahih: They said, "Never will we prefer you over what has come to us of clear proofs and [over] He who created us. So decree whatever you are to decree. You can only decree for this worldly life.
ayahs.clear: They said, “We will not prefer you to the proofs that have come to us, and Him who created us. So issue whatever judgment you wish to issue. You can only rule in this lowly life.
ayahs.kemenag: Mereka berkata: "Kami sekali-kali tidak akan mengutamakan kamu daripada bukti-bukti yang nyata (mukjizat), yang telah datang kepada kami dan daripada Tuhan yang telah menciptakan kami; maka putuskanlah apa yang hendak kamu putuskan. Sesungguhnya kamu hanya akan dapat memutuskan pada kehidupan di dunia ini saja.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّآ ءَامَنَّا بِرَبِّنَا لِيَغْفِرَ لَنَا خَطَٰيَٰنَا وَمَآ أَكْرَهْتَنَا عَلَيْهِ مِنَ ٱلسِّحْرِ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ خَيْرٌۭ وَأَبْقَىٰٓ
ayahs.sahih: Indeed, we have believed in our Lord that He may forgive us our sins and what you compelled us [to do] of magic. And Allah is better and more enduring."
ayahs.clear: We have believed in our Lord, so that He may forgive us our sins, and the magic you have compelled us to practice. God is Better, and more Lasting.”
ayahs.kemenag: Sesungguhnya kami telah beriman kepada Tuhan kami, agar Dia mengampuni kesalahan-kesalahan kami dan sihir yang telah kamu paksakan kepada kami melakukannya. Dan Allah lebih baik (pahala-Nya) dan lebih kekal (azab-Nya)".

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّهُۥ مَن يَأْتِ رَبَّهُۥ مُجْرِمًۭا فَإِنَّ لَهُۥ جَهَنَّمَ لَا يَمُوتُ فِيهَا وَلَا يَحْيَىٰ
ayahs.sahih: Indeed, whoever comes to his Lord as a criminal - indeed, for him is Hell; he will neither die therein nor live.
ayahs.clear: Whoever comes to his Lord guilty, for him is Hell, where he neither dies nor lives.
ayahs.kemenag: Sesungguhnya barangsiapa datang kepada Tuhannya dalam keadaan berdosa, maka sesungguhnya baginya neraka Jahannam. Ia tidak mati di dalamnya dan tidak (pula) hidup.

ayahs.arabic: وَمَن يَأْتِهِۦ مُؤْمِنًۭا قَدْ عَمِلَ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ فَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ لَهُمُ ٱلدَّرَجَٰتُ ٱلْعُلَىٰ
ayahs.sahih: But whoever comes to Him as a believer having done righteous deeds - for those will be the highest degrees [in position]:
ayahs.clear: But whoever comes to Him a believer, having worked righteousness—these will have the highest ranks.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan barangsiapa datang kepada Tuhannya dalam keadaan beriman, lagi sungguh-sungguh telah beramal saleh, maka mereka itulah orang-orang yang memperoleh tempat-tempat yang tinggi (mulia),

ayahs.arabic: جَنَّٰتُ عَدْنٍۢ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَٰرُ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَا ۚ وَذَٰلِكَ جَزَآءُ مَن تَزَكَّىٰ
ayahs.sahih: Gardens of perpetual residence beneath which rivers flow, wherein they abide eternally. And that is the reward of one who purifies himself.
ayahs.clear: The Gardens of Perpetuity, beneath which rivers flow, dwelling therein forever. That is the reward for him who purifies himself.
ayahs.kemenag: (yaitu) surga 'Adn yang mengalir sungai-sungai di bawahnya, mereka kekal di dalamnya. Dan itu adalah balasan bagi orang yang bersih (dari kekafiran dan kemaksiatan).

ayahs.arabic: وَلَقَدْ أَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَىٰ مُوسَىٰٓ أَنْ أَسْرِ بِعِبَادِى فَٱضْرِبْ لَهُمْ طَرِيقًۭا فِى ٱلْبَحْرِ يَبَسًۭا لَّا تَخَٰفُ دَرَكًۭا وَلَا تَخْشَىٰ
ayahs.sahih: And We had inspired to Moses, "Travel by night with My servants and strike for them a dry path through the sea; you will not fear being overtaken [by Pharaoh] nor be afraid [of drowning]."
ayahs.clear: And We inspired Moses: “Travel by night with My servants, and strike for them a dry path across the sea, not fearing being overtaken, nor worrying.”
ayahs.kemenag: Dan sesungguhnya telah Kami wahyukan kepada Musa: "Pergilah kamu dengan hamba-hamba-Ku (Bani Israil) di malam hari, maka buatlah untuk mereka jalan yang kering dilaut itu, kamu tak usah khawatir akan tersusul dan tidak usah takut (akan tenggelam)".

ayahs.arabic: فَأَتْبَعَهُمْ فِرْعَوْنُ بِجُنُودِهِۦ فَغَشِيَهُم مِّنَ ٱلْيَمِّ مَا غَشِيَهُمْ
ayahs.sahih: So Pharaoh pursued them with his soldiers, and there covered them from the sea that which covered them,
ayahs.clear: Pharaoh pursued them with his troops, but the sea overwhelmed them, and completely engulfed them.
ayahs.kemenag: Maka Fir'aun dengan bala tentaranya mengejar mereka, lalu mereka ditutup oleh laut yang menenggelamkan mereka.

ayahs.arabic: وَأَضَلَّ فِرْعَوْنُ قَوْمَهُۥ وَمَا هَدَىٰ
ayahs.sahih: And Pharaoh led his people astray and did not guide [them].
ayahs.clear: Pharaoh misled his people, and did not guide them.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan Fir'aun telah menyesatkan kaumnya dan tidak memberi petunjuk.

ayahs.arabic: يَٰبَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ قَدْ أَنجَيْنَٰكُم مِّنْ عَدُوِّكُمْ وَوَٰعَدْنَٰكُمْ جَانِبَ ٱلطُّورِ ٱلْأَيْمَنَ وَنَزَّلْنَا عَلَيْكُمُ ٱلْمَنَّ وَٱلسَّلْوَىٰ
ayahs.sahih: O Children of Israel, We delivered you from your enemy, and We made an appointment with you at the right side of the mount, and We sent down to you manna and quails,
ayahs.clear: O Children of Israel! We have delivered you from your enemy, and promised you by the right side of the Mount, and sent down to you manna and quails.
ayahs.kemenag: Hai Bani Israil, sesungguhnya Kami telah menyelamatkan kamu sekalian dari musuhmu, dan Kami telah mengadakan perjanjian dengan kamu sekalian (untuk munajat) di sebelah kanan gunung itu dan Kami telah menurunkan kepada kamu sekalian manna dan salwa.

ayahs.arabic: كُلُوا۟ مِن طَيِّبَٰتِ مَا رَزَقْنَٰكُمْ وَلَا تَطْغَوْا۟ فِيهِ فَيَحِلَّ عَلَيْكُمْ غَضَبِى ۖ وَمَن يَحْلِلْ عَلَيْهِ غَضَبِى فَقَدْ هَوَىٰ
ayahs.sahih: [Saying], "Eat from the good things with which We have provided you and do not transgress [or oppress others] therein, lest My anger should descend upon you. And he upon whom My anger descends has certainly fallen."
ayahs.clear: Eat of the good things We have provided for you, but do not be excessive therein, lest My wrath descends upon you. He upon whom My wrath descends has fallen.
ayahs.kemenag: Makanlah di antara rezeki yang baik yang telah Kami berikan kepadamu, dan janganlah melampaui batas padanya, yang menyebabkan kemurkaan-Ku menimpamu. Dan barangsiapa ditimpa oleh kemurkaan-Ku, maka sesungguhnya binasalah ia.

ayahs.arabic: وَإِنِّى لَغَفَّارٌۭ لِّمَن تَابَ وَءَامَنَ وَعَمِلَ صَٰلِحًۭا ثُمَّ ٱهْتَدَىٰ
ayahs.sahih: But indeed, I am the Perpetual Forgiver of whoever repents and believes and does righteousness and then continues in guidance.
ayahs.clear: And I am Forgiving towards him who repents, believes, acts righteously, and then remains guided.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan sesungguhnya Aku Maha Pengampun bagi orang yang bertaubat, beriman, beramal saleh, kemudian tetap di jalan yang benar.

ayahs.arabic: ۞ وَمَآ أَعْجَلَكَ عَن قَوْمِكَ يَٰمُوسَىٰ
ayahs.sahih: [Allah] said, "And what made you hasten from your people, O Moses?"
ayahs.clear: “And what made you rush ahead of your people, O Moses?”
ayahs.kemenag: Mengapa kamu datang lebih cepat daripada kaummu, hai Musa?

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ هُمْ أُو۟لَآءِ عَلَىٰٓ أَثَرِى وَعَجِلْتُ إِلَيْكَ رَبِّ لِتَرْضَىٰ
ayahs.sahih: He said, "They are close upon my tracks, and I hastened to You, my Lord, that You be pleased."
ayahs.clear: He said, “They are following in my footsteps; and I hurried on to You, my Lord, that you may be pleased.”
ayahs.kemenag: Berkata, Musa: "Itulah mereka sedang menyusuli aku dan aku bersegera kepada-Mu. Ya Tuhanku, agar supaya Engkau ridha (kepadaku)".

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ فَإِنَّا قَدْ فَتَنَّا قَوْمَكَ مِنۢ بَعْدِكَ وَأَضَلَّهُمُ ٱلسَّامِرِىُّ
ayahs.sahih: [Allah] said, "But indeed, We have tried your people after you [departed], and the Samiri has led them astray."
ayahs.clear: He said, “We have tested your people in your absence, and the Samarian misled them.”
ayahs.kemenag: Allah berfirman: "Maka sesungguhnya Kami telah menguji kaummu sesudah kamu tinggalkan, dan mereka telah disesatkan oleh Samiri.

ayahs.arabic: فَرَجَعَ مُوسَىٰٓ إِلَىٰ قَوْمِهِۦ غَضْبَٰنَ أَسِفًۭا ۚ قَالَ يَٰقَوْمِ أَلَمْ يَعِدْكُمْ رَبُّكُمْ وَعْدًا حَسَنًا ۚ أَفَطَالَ عَلَيْكُمُ ٱلْعَهْدُ أَمْ أَرَدتُّمْ أَن يَحِلَّ عَلَيْكُمْ غَضَبٌۭ مِّن رَّبِّكُمْ فَأَخْلَفْتُم مَّوْعِدِى
ayahs.sahih: So Moses returned to his people, angry and grieved. He said, "O my people, did your Lord not make you a good promise? Then, was the time [of its fulfillment] too long for you, or did you wish that wrath from your Lord descend upon you, so you broke your promise [of obedience] to me?"
ayahs.clear: So Moses returned to his people, angry and disappointed. He said, “O my people, did your Lord not promise you a good promise? Was the time too long for you? Or did you want wrath from your Lord to descend upon you, so you broke your promise to me?”
ayahs.kemenag: Kemudian Musa kembali kepada kaumnya dengan marah dan bersedih hati. Berkata Musa: "Hai kaumku, bukankah Tuhanmu telah menjanjikan kepadamu suatu janji yang baik? Maka apakah terasa lama masa yang berlalu itu bagimu atau kamu menghendaki agar kemurkaan dari Tuhanmu menimpamu, dan kamu melanggar perjanjianmu dengan aku?".

ayahs.arabic: قَالُوا۟ مَآ أَخْلَفْنَا مَوْعِدَكَ بِمَلْكِنَا وَلَٰكِنَّا حُمِّلْنَآ أَوْزَارًۭا مِّن زِينَةِ ٱلْقَوْمِ فَقَذَفْنَٰهَا فَكَذَٰلِكَ أَلْقَى ٱلسَّامِرِىُّ
ayahs.sahih: They said, "We did not break our promise to you by our will, but we were made to carry burdens from the ornaments of the people [of Pharaoh], so we threw them [into the fire], and thus did the Samiri throw."
ayahs.clear: They said, “We did not break our promise to you by our choice, but we were made to carry loads of the people’s ornaments, and we cast them in. That was what the Samarian suggested.”
ayahs.kemenag: Mereka berkata: "Kami sekali-kali tidak melanggar perjanjianmu dengan kemauan kami sendiri, tetapi kami disuruh membawa beban-beban dari perhiasan kaum itu, maka kami telah melemparkannya, dan demikian pula Samiri melemparkannya",

ayahs.arabic: فَأَخْرَجَ لَهُمْ عِجْلًۭا جَسَدًۭا لَّهُۥ خُوَارٌۭ فَقَالُوا۟ هَٰذَآ إِلَٰهُكُمْ وَإِلَٰهُ مُوسَىٰ فَنَسِىَ
ayahs.sahih: And he extracted for them [the statue of] a calf which had a lowing sound, and they said, "This is your god and the god of Moses, but he forgot."
ayahs.clear: So he produced for them a calf—a mere body which lowed. And they said, “This is your god, and the god of Moses, but he has forgotten.”
ayahs.kemenag: kemudian Samiri mengeluarkan untuk mereka (dari lobang itu) anak lembu yang bertubuh dan bersuara, maka mereka berkata: "Inilah Tuhanmu dan Tuhan Musa, tetapi Musa telah lupa".

ayahs.arabic: أَفَلَا يَرَوْنَ أَلَّا يَرْجِعُ إِلَيْهِمْ قَوْلًۭا وَلَا يَمْلِكُ لَهُمْ ضَرًّۭا وَلَا نَفْعًۭا
ayahs.sahih: Did they not see that it could not return to them any speech and that it did not possess for them any harm or benefit?
ayahs.clear: Did they not see that it cannot return a word to them, and has no power to harm them or benefit them?
ayahs.kemenag: Maka apakah mereka tidak memperhatikan bahwa patung anak lembu itu tidak dapat memberi jawaban kepada mereka, dan tidak dapat memberi kemudharatan kepada mereka dan tidak (pula) kemanfaatan?

ayahs.arabic: وَلَقَدْ قَالَ لَهُمْ هَٰرُونُ مِن قَبْلُ يَٰقَوْمِ إِنَّمَا فُتِنتُم بِهِۦ ۖ وَإِنَّ رَبَّكُمُ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ فَٱتَّبِعُونِى وَأَطِيعُوٓا۟ أَمْرِى
ayahs.sahih: And Aaron had already told them before [the return of Moses], "O my people, you are only being tested by it, and indeed, your Lord is the Most Merciful, so follow me and obey my order."
ayahs.clear: Aaron had said to them before, “O my people, you are being tested by this. And your Lord is the Merciful, so follow me, and obey my command.”
ayahs.kemenag: Dan sesungguhnya Harun telah berkata kepada mereka sebelumnya: "Hai kaumku, sesungguhnya kamu hanya diberi cobaan dengan anak lembu. itu dan sesungguhnya Tuhanmu ialah (Tuhan) Yang Maha Pemurah, maka ikutilah aku dan taatilah perintahku".

ayahs.arabic: قَالُوا۟ لَن نَّبْرَحَ عَلَيْهِ عَٰكِفِينَ حَتَّىٰ يَرْجِعَ إِلَيْنَا مُوسَىٰ
ayahs.sahih: They said, "We will never cease being devoted to the calf until Moses returns to us."
ayahs.clear: They said, “We will not give up our devotion to it, until Moses returns to us.”
ayahs.kemenag: Mereka menjawab: "Kami akan tetap menyembah patung anak lembu ini, hingga Musa kembali kepada kami".

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ يَٰهَٰرُونُ مَا مَنَعَكَ إِذْ رَأَيْتَهُمْ ضَلُّوٓا۟
ayahs.sahih: [Moses] said, "O Aaron, what prevented you, when you saw them going astray,
ayahs.clear: He said, “O Aaron, what prevented you, when you saw them going astray.
ayahs.kemenag: Berkata Musa: "Hai Harun, apa yang menghalangi kamu ketika kamu melihat mereka telah sesat,

ayahs.arabic: أَلَّا تَتَّبِعَنِ ۖ أَفَعَصَيْتَ أَمْرِى
ayahs.sahih: From following me? Then have you disobeyed my order?"
ayahs.clear: From following me? Did you disobey my command?”
ayahs.kemenag: (sehingga) kamu tidak mengikuti aku? Maka apakah kamu telah (sengaja) mendurhakai perintahku?"

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ يَبْنَؤُمَّ لَا تَأْخُذْ بِلِحْيَتِى وَلَا بِرَأْسِىٓ ۖ إِنِّى خَشِيتُ أَن تَقُولَ فَرَّقْتَ بَيْنَ بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ وَلَمْ تَرْقُبْ قَوْلِى
ayahs.sahih: [Aaron] said, "O son of my mother, do not seize [me] by my beard or by my head. Indeed, I feared that you would say, 'You caused division among the Children of Israel, and you did not observe [or await] my word.' "
ayahs.clear: He said, “Son of my mother, do not seize me by my beard or my head. I feared you would say, `You have caused division among the Children of Israel, and did not regard my word.'“
ayahs.kemenag: Harun menjawab' "Hai putera ibuku, janganlah kamu pegang janggutku dan jangan (pula) kepalaku; sesungguhnya aku khawatir bahwa kamu akan berkata (kepadaku): "Kamu telah memecah antara Bani Israil dan kamu tidak memelihara amanatku".

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ فَمَا خَطْبُكَ يَٰسَٰمِرِىُّ
ayahs.sahih: [Moses] said, "And what is your case, O Samiri?"
ayahs.clear: He said, “What do you have to say, O Samarian?”
ayahs.kemenag: Berkata Musa: "Apakah yang mendorongmu (berbuat demikian) hai Samiri?"

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ بَصُرْتُ بِمَا لَمْ يَبْصُرُوا۟ بِهِۦ فَقَبَضْتُ قَبْضَةًۭ مِّنْ أَثَرِ ٱلرَّسُولِ فَنَبَذْتُهَا وَكَذَٰلِكَ سَوَّلَتْ لِى نَفْسِى
ayahs.sahih: He said, "I saw what they did not see, so I took a handful [of dust] from the track of the messenger and threw it, and thus did my soul entice me."
ayahs.clear: He said, “I saw what they did not see, so I grasped a handful from the Messenger’s traces, and I flung it away. Thus my soul prompted me.”
ayahs.kemenag: Samiri menjawab: "Aku mengetahui sesuatu yang mereka tidak mengetahuinya, maka aku ambil segenggam dari jejak rasul lalu aku melemparkannya, dan demikianlah nafsuku membujukku".

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ فَٱذْهَبْ فَإِنَّ لَكَ فِى ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ أَن تَقُولَ لَا مِسَاسَ ۖ وَإِنَّ لَكَ مَوْعِدًۭا لَّن تُخْلَفَهُۥ ۖ وَٱنظُرْ إِلَىٰٓ إِلَٰهِكَ ٱلَّذِى ظَلْتَ عَلَيْهِ عَاكِفًۭا ۖ لَّنُحَرِّقَنَّهُۥ ثُمَّ لَنَنسِفَنَّهُۥ فِى ٱلْيَمِّ نَسْفًا
ayahs.sahih: [Moses] said, "Then go. And indeed, it is [decreed] for you in [this] life to say, 'No contact.' And indeed, you have an appointment [in the Hereafter] you will not fail to keep. And look at your 'god' to which you remained devoted. We will surely burn it and blow it into the sea with a blast.
ayahs.clear: He said, “Begone! Your lot in this life is to say, ‘No contact.’ And you have an appointment that you will not miss. Now look at your god that you remained devoted to—we will burn it up, and then blow it away into the sea, as powder.”
ayahs.kemenag: Berkata Musa: "Pergilah kamu, maka sesungguhnya bagimu di dalam kehidupan di dunia ini (hanya dapat) mengatakan: "Janganlah menyentuh (aku)". Dan sesungguhnya bagimu hukuman (di akhirat) yang kamu sekali-kali tidak dapat menghindarinya, dan lihatlah tuhanmu itu yang kamu tetap menyembahnya. Sesungguhnya kami akan membakarnya, kemudian kami sungguh-sungguh akan menghamburkannya ke dalam laut (berupa abu yang berserakan).

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّمَآ إِلَٰهُكُمُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِى لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ۚ وَسِعَ كُلَّ شَىْءٍ عِلْمًۭا
ayahs.sahih: Your god is only Allah, except for whom there is no deity. He has encompassed all things in knowledge."
ayahs.clear: Surely your god is God, the One besides whom there is no other god. He comprehends everything in knowledge.
ayahs.kemenag: Sesungguhnya Tuhanmu hanyalah Allah, yang tidak ada Tuhan selain Dia. Pengetahuan-Nya meliputi segala sesuatu".

ayahs.arabic: كَذَٰلِكَ نَقُصُّ عَلَيْكَ مِنْ أَنۢبَآءِ مَا قَدْ سَبَقَ ۚ وَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَٰكَ مِن لَّدُنَّا ذِكْرًۭا
ayahs.sahih: Thus, [O Muhammad], We relate to you from the news of what has preceded. And We have certainly given you from Us the Qur'an.
ayahs.clear: Thus We narrate to you reports of times gone by; and We have given you a message from Our Presence.
ayahs.kemenag: Demikianlah kami kisahkan kepadamu (Muhammad) sebagian kisah umat yang telah lalu, dan sesungguhnya telah Kami berikan kepadamu dari sisi Kami suatu peringatan (Al Quran).

ayahs.arabic: مَّنْ أَعْرَضَ عَنْهُ فَإِنَّهُۥ يَحْمِلُ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ وِزْرًا
ayahs.sahih: Whoever turns away from it - then indeed, he will bear on the Day of Resurrection a burden,
ayahs.clear: Whoever turns away from it will carry on the Day of Resurrection a burden.
ayahs.kemenag: Barangsiapa berpaling dari pada Al qur'an maka sesungguhnya ia akan memikul dosa yang besar di hari kiamat,

ayahs.arabic: خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهِ ۖ وَسَآءَ لَهُمْ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ حِمْلًۭا
ayahs.sahih: [Abiding] eternally therein, and evil it is for them on the Day of Resurrection as a load -
ayahs.clear: Abiding therein forever. And wretched is their burden on the Day of Resurrection.
ayahs.kemenag: mereka kekal di dalam keadaan itu. Dan amat buruklah dosa itu sebagai beban bagi mereka di hari kiamat,

ayahs.arabic: يَوْمَ يُنفَخُ فِى ٱلصُّورِ ۚ وَنَحْشُرُ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ زُرْقًۭا
ayahs.sahih: The Day the Horn will be blown. And We will gather the criminals, that Day, blue-eyed.
ayahs.clear: On the Day when the Trumpet is blown—We will gather the sinners on that Day, blue.
ayahs.kemenag: (yaitu) di hari (yang di waktu itu) ditiup sangkakala dan Kami akan mengumpulkan pada hari itu orang-orang yang berdosa dengan muka yang biru muram;

ayahs.arabic: يَتَخَٰفَتُونَ بَيْنَهُمْ إِن لَّبِثْتُمْ إِلَّا عَشْرًۭا
ayahs.sahih: They will murmur among themselves, "You remained not but ten [days in the world]."
ayahs.clear: Murmuring among themselves: “You have lingered only for ten.”
ayahs.kemenag: mereka berbisik-bisik di antara mereka: "Kamu tidak berdiam (di dunia) melainkan hanyalah sepuluh (hari)"

ayahs.arabic: نَّحْنُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا يَقُولُونَ إِذْ يَقُولُ أَمْثَلُهُمْ طَرِيقَةً إِن لَّبِثْتُمْ إِلَّا يَوْمًۭا
ayahs.sahih: We are most knowing of what they say when the best of them in manner will say, "You remained not but one day."
ayahs.clear: We are fully aware of what they say, when the most exemplary of them in conduct will say, “You have lingered only a day.”
ayahs.kemenag: Kami lebih mengetahui apa yang mereka katakan, ketika berkata orang yang paling lurus jalannya di antara mereka: "Kamu tidak berdiam (di dunia), melainkan hanyalah sehari saja".

ayahs.arabic: وَيَسْـَٔلُونَكَ عَنِ ٱلْجِبَالِ فَقُلْ يَنسِفُهَا رَبِّى نَسْفًۭا
ayahs.sahih: And they ask you about the mountains, so say, "My Lord will blow them away with a blast.
ayahs.clear: And they ask you about the mountains. Say, “My Lord will crumble them utterly.”
ayahs.kemenag: Dan mereka bertanya kepadamu tentang gunung-gunung, maka katakanlah: "Tuhanku akan menghancurkannya (di hari kiamat) sehancur-hancurnya,

ayahs.arabic: فَيَذَرُهَا قَاعًۭا صَفْصَفًۭا
ayahs.sahih: And He will leave the earth a level plain;
ayahs.clear: And leave them desolate waste.
ayahs.kemenag: maka Dia akan menjadikan (bekas) gunung-gunung itu datar sama sekali,

ayahs.arabic: لَّا تَرَىٰ فِيهَا عِوَجًۭا وَلَآ أَمْتًۭا
ayahs.sahih: You will not see therein a depression or an elevation."
ayahs.clear: You will see in them neither crookedness, nor deviation.”
ayahs.kemenag: tidak ada sedikitpun kamu lihat padanya tempat yang rendah dan yang tinggi-tinggi.

ayahs.arabic: يَوْمَئِذٍۢ يَتَّبِعُونَ ٱلدَّاعِىَ لَا عِوَجَ لَهُۥ ۖ وَخَشَعَتِ ٱلْأَصْوَاتُ لِلرَّحْمَٰنِ فَلَا تَسْمَعُ إِلَّا هَمْسًۭا
ayahs.sahih: That Day, everyone will follow [the call of] the Caller [with] no deviation therefrom, and [all] voices will be stilled before the Most Merciful, so you will not hear except a whisper [of footsteps].
ayahs.clear: On that Day, they will follow the caller, without any deviation. Voices will be hushed before the Merciful, and you will hear nothing but murmur.
ayahs.kemenag: Pada hari itu manusia mengikuti (menuju kepada suara) penyeru dengan tidak berbelok-belok; dan merendahlah semua suara kepada Tuhan Yang Maha Pemurah, maka kamu tidak mendengar kecuali bisikan saja.

ayahs.arabic: يَوْمَئِذٍۢ لَّا تَنفَعُ ٱلشَّفَٰعَةُ إِلَّا مَنْ أَذِنَ لَهُ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ وَرَضِىَ لَهُۥ قَوْلًۭا
ayahs.sahih: That Day, no intercession will benefit except [that of] one to whom the Most Merciful has given permission and has accepted his word.
ayahs.clear: On that Day, intercession will not avail, except for him permitted by the Merciful, and whose words He has approved.
ayahs.kemenag: Pada hari itu tidak berguna syafa'at, kecuali (syafa'at) orang yang Allah Maha Pemurah telah memberi izin kepadanya, dan Dia telah meridhai perkataannya.

ayahs.arabic: يَعْلَمُ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ وَلَا يُحِيطُونَ بِهِۦ عِلْمًۭا
ayahs.sahih: Allah knows what is [presently] before them and what will be after them, but they do not encompass it in knowledge.
ayahs.clear: He knows what is before them and what is behind them, and they cannot comprehend Him in their knowledge.
ayahs.kemenag: Dia mengetahui apa yang ada di hadapan mereka dan apa yang ada di belakang mereka, sedang ilmu mereka tidak dapat meliputi ilmu-Nya.

ayahs.arabic: ۞ وَعَنَتِ ٱلْوُجُوهُ لِلْحَىِّ ٱلْقَيُّومِ ۖ وَقَدْ خَابَ مَنْ حَمَلَ ظُلْمًۭا
ayahs.sahih: And [all] faces will be humbled before the Ever-Living, the Sustainer of existence. And he will have failed who carries injustice.
ayahs.clear: Faces will be humbled before the Living, the Eternal. Whoever carries injustice will despair.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan tunduklah semua muka (dengan berendah diri) kepada Tuhan Yang Hidup Kekal lagi senantiasa mengurus (makhluk-Nya). Dan sesungguhnya telah merugilah orang yang melakukan kezaliman.

ayahs.arabic: وَمَن يَعْمَلْ مِنَ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ وَهُوَ مُؤْمِنٌۭ فَلَا يَخَافُ ظُلْمًۭا وَلَا هَضْمًۭا
ayahs.sahih: But he who does of righteous deeds while he is a believer - he will neither fear injustice nor deprivation.
ayahs.clear: But whoever has done righteous deeds, while being a believer—will fear neither injustice, nor grievance.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan barangsiapa mengerjakan amal-amal yang saleh dan ia dalam keadaan beriman, maka ia tidak khawatir akan perlakuan yang tidak adil (terhadapnya) dan tidak (pula) akan pengurangan haknya.

ayahs.arabic: وَكَذَٰلِكَ أَنزَلْنَٰهُ قُرْءَانًا عَرَبِيًّۭا وَصَرَّفْنَا فِيهِ مِنَ ٱلْوَعِيدِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَتَّقُونَ أَوْ يُحْدِثُ لَهُمْ ذِكْرًۭا
ayahs.sahih: And thus We have sent it down as an Arabic Qur'an and have diversified therein the warnings that perhaps they will avoid [sin] or it would cause them remembrance.
ayahs.clear: Thus We have revealed it an Arabic Quran, and We have diversified the warnings in it, that perhaps they would become righteous, or it may produce a lesson for them.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan demikianlah Kami menurunkan Al Quran dalam bahasa Arab, dan Kami telah menerangkan dengan berulang kali, di dalamnya sebahagian dari ancaman, agar mereka bertakwa atau (agar) Al Quran itu menimbulkan pengajaran bagi mereka.

ayahs.arabic: فَتَعَٰلَى ٱللَّهُ ٱلْمَلِكُ ٱلْحَقُّ ۗ وَلَا تَعْجَلْ بِٱلْقُرْءَانِ مِن قَبْلِ أَن يُقْضَىٰٓ إِلَيْكَ وَحْيُهُۥ ۖ وَقُل رَّبِّ زِدْنِى عِلْمًۭا
ayahs.sahih: So high [above all] is Allah, the Sovereign, the Truth. And, [O Muhammad], do not hasten with [recitation of] the Qur'an before its revelation is completed to you, and say, "My Lord, increase me in knowledge."
ayahs.clear: Exalted is God, the True King. Do not be hasty with the Quran before its inspiration to you is concluded, and say, “My Lord, increase me in knowledge.”
ayahs.kemenag: Maka Maha Tinggi Allah Raja Yang sebenar-benarnya, dan janganlah kamu tergesa-gesa membaca Al qur'an sebelum disempurnakan mewahyukannya kepadamu, dan katakanlah: "Ya Tuhanku, tambahkanlah kepadaku ilmu pengetahuan".

ayahs.arabic: وَلَقَدْ عَهِدْنَآ إِلَىٰٓ ءَادَمَ مِن قَبْلُ فَنَسِىَ وَلَمْ نَجِدْ لَهُۥ عَزْمًۭا
ayahs.sahih: And We had already taken a promise from Adam before, but he forgot; and We found not in him determination.
ayahs.clear: And We covenanted with Adam before, but he forgot, and We found in him no resolve.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan sesungguhnya telah Kami perintahkan kepada Adam dahulu, maka ia lupa (akan perintah itu), dan tidak Kami dapati padanya kemauan yang kuat.

ayahs.arabic: وَإِذْ قُلْنَا لِلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةِ ٱسْجُدُوا۟ لِءَادَمَ فَسَجَدُوٓا۟ إِلَّآ إِبْلِيسَ أَبَىٰ
ayahs.sahih: And [mention] when We said to the angels, "Prostrate to Adam," and they prostrated, except Iblees; he refused.
ayahs.clear: And when We said to the angels, “Bow down to Adam.” They bowed down, except for Satan; he refused.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan (ingatlah) ketika Kami berkata kepada malaikat: "Sujudlah kamu kepada Adam", maka mereka sujud kecuali iblis. Ia membangkang.

ayahs.arabic: فَقُلْنَا يَٰٓـَٔادَمُ إِنَّ هَٰذَا عَدُوٌّۭ لَّكَ وَلِزَوْجِكَ فَلَا يُخْرِجَنَّكُمَا مِنَ ٱلْجَنَّةِ فَتَشْقَىٰٓ
ayahs.sahih: So We said, "O Adam, indeed this is an enemy to you and to your wife. Then let him not remove you from Paradise so you would suffer.
ayahs.clear: We said, “O Adam, this is an enemy to you and to your wife. So do not let him make you leave the Garden, for then you will suffer.
ayahs.kemenag: Maka Kami berkata: "Hai Adam, sesungguhnya ini (iblis) adalah musuh bagimu dan bagi isterimu, maka sekali-kali janganlah sampai ia mengeluarkan kamu berdua dari surga, yang menyebabkan kamu menjadi celaka.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ لَكَ أَلَّا تَجُوعَ فِيهَا وَلَا تَعْرَىٰ
ayahs.sahih: Indeed, it is [promised] for you not to be hungry therein or be unclothed.
ayahs.clear: In it you will never go hungry, nor be naked.
ayahs.kemenag: Sesungguhnya kamu tidak akan kelaparan di dalamnya dan tidak akan telanjang,

ayahs.arabic: وَأَنَّكَ لَا تَظْمَؤُا۟ فِيهَا وَلَا تَضْحَىٰ
ayahs.sahih: And indeed, you will not be thirsty therein or be hot from the sun."
ayahs.clear: Nor will you be thirsty in it, nor will you swelter.”
ayahs.kemenag: dan sesungguhnya kamu tidak akan merasa dahaga dan tidak (pula) akan ditimpa panas matahari di dalamnya".

ayahs.arabic: فَوَسْوَسَ إِلَيْهِ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنُ قَالَ يَٰٓـَٔادَمُ هَلْ أَدُلُّكَ عَلَىٰ شَجَرَةِ ٱلْخُلْدِ وَمُلْكٍۢ لَّا يَبْلَىٰ
ayahs.sahih: Then Satan whispered to him; he said, "O Adam, shall I direct you to the tree of eternity and possession that will not deteriorate?"
ayahs.clear: But Satan whispered to him. He said, “O Adam, shall I show you the Tree of Immortality, and a kingdom that never decays?”
ayahs.kemenag: Kemudian syaitan membisikkan pikiran jahat kepadanya, dengan berkata: "Hai Adam, maukah saya tunjukkan kepada kamu pohon khuldi dan kerajaan yang tidak akan binasa?"

ayahs.arabic: فَأَكَلَا مِنْهَا فَبَدَتْ لَهُمَا سَوْءَٰتُهُمَا وَطَفِقَا يَخْصِفَانِ عَلَيْهِمَا مِن وَرَقِ ٱلْجَنَّةِ ۚ وَعَصَىٰٓ ءَادَمُ رَبَّهُۥ فَغَوَىٰ
ayahs.sahih: And Adam and his wife ate of it, and their private parts became apparent to them, and they began to fasten over themselves from the leaves of Paradise. And Adam disobeyed his Lord and erred.
ayahs.clear: And so they ate from it; whereupon their bodies became visible to them, and they started covering themselves with the leaves of the Garden. Thus Adam disobeyed his Lord, and fell.
ayahs.kemenag: Maka keduanya memakan dari buah pohon itu, lalu nampaklah bagi keduanya aurat-auratnya dan mulailah keduanya menutupinya dengan daun-daun (yang ada di) surga, dan durhakalah Adam kepada Tuhan dan sesatlah ia.

ayahs.arabic: ثُمَّ ٱجْتَبَٰهُ رَبُّهُۥ فَتَابَ عَلَيْهِ وَهَدَىٰ
ayahs.sahih: Then his Lord chose him and turned to him in forgiveness and guided [him].
ayahs.clear: But then his Lord recalled him, and pardoned him, and guided him.
ayahs.kemenag: Kemudian Tuhannya memilihnya maka Dia menerima taubatnya dan memberinya petunjuk.

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ ٱهْبِطَا مِنْهَا جَمِيعًۢا ۖ بَعْضُكُمْ لِبَعْضٍ عَدُوٌّۭ ۖ فَإِمَّا يَأْتِيَنَّكُم مِّنِّى هُدًۭى فَمَنِ ٱتَّبَعَ هُدَاىَ فَلَا يَضِلُّ وَلَا يَشْقَىٰ
ayahs.sahih: [Allah] said, "Descend from Paradise - all, [your descendants] being enemies to one another. And if there should come to you guidance from Me - then whoever follows My guidance will neither go astray [in the world] nor suffer [in the Hereafter].
ayahs.clear: He said, “Go down from it, altogether; some of you enemies of some others. But whenever guidance comes to you from Me, whoever follows My guidance, will not go astray, nor suffer.
ayahs.kemenag: Allah berfirman: "Turunlah kamu berdua dari surga bersama-sama, sebagian kamu menjadi musuh bagi sebagian yang lain. Maka jika datang kepadamu petunjuk daripada-Ku, lalu barangsiapa yang mengikut petunjuk-Ku, ia tidak akan sesat dan tidak akan celaka.

ayahs.arabic: وَمَنْ أَعْرَضَ عَن ذِكْرِى فَإِنَّ لَهُۥ مَعِيشَةًۭ ضَنكًۭا وَنَحْشُرُهُۥ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ أَعْمَىٰ
ayahs.sahih: And whoever turns away from My remembrance - indeed, he will have a depressed life, and We will gather him on the Day of Resurrection blind."
ayahs.clear: But whoever turns away from My Reminder, for him is a confined life. And We will raise him on the Day of Resurrection blind.”
ayahs.kemenag: Dan barangsiapa berpaling dari peringatan-Ku, maka sesungguhnya baginya penghidupan yang sempit, dan Kami akan menghimpunkannya pada hari kiamat dalam keadaan buta".

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ لِمَ حَشَرْتَنِىٓ أَعْمَىٰ وَقَدْ كُنتُ بَصِيرًۭا
ayahs.sahih: He will say, "My Lord, why have you raised me blind while I was [once] seeing?"
ayahs.clear: He will say, “My Lord, why did You raise me blind, though I was seeing?”
ayahs.kemenag: Berkatalah ia: "Ya Tuhanku, mengapa Engkau menghimpunkan aku dalam keadaan buta, padahal aku dahulunya adalah seorang yang melihat?"

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ كَذَٰلِكَ أَتَتْكَ ءَايَٰتُنَا فَنَسِيتَهَا ۖ وَكَذَٰلِكَ ٱلْيَوْمَ تُنسَىٰ
ayahs.sahih: [Allah] will say, "Thus did Our signs come to you, and you forgot them; and thus will you this Day be forgotten."
ayahs.clear: He will say, “Just as Our revelations came to you, and you forgot them, today you will be forgotten.”
ayahs.kemenag: Allah berfirman: "Demikianlah, telah datang kepadamu ayat-ayat Kami, maka kamu melupakannya, dan begitu (pula) pada hari ini kamupun dilupakan".

ayahs.arabic: وَكَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى مَنْ أَسْرَفَ وَلَمْ يُؤْمِنۢ بِـَٔايَٰتِ رَبِّهِۦ ۚ وَلَعَذَابُ ٱلْءَاخِرَةِ أَشَدُّ وَأَبْقَىٰٓ
ayahs.sahih: And thus do We recompense he who transgressed and did not believe in the signs of his Lord. And the punishment of the Hereafter is more severe and more enduring.
ayahs.clear: Thus We recompense him who transgresses and does not believe in the revelations of his Lord. The punishment of the Hereafter is more severe, and more lasting.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan demikianlah Kami membalas orang yang melampaui batas dan tidak percaya kepada ayat-ayat Tuhannya. Dan sesungguhnya azab di akhirat itu lebih berat dan lebih kekal.

ayahs.arabic: أَفَلَمْ يَهْدِ لَهُمْ كَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا قَبْلَهُم مِّنَ ٱلْقُرُونِ يَمْشُونَ فِى مَسَٰكِنِهِمْ ۗ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَٰتٍۢ لِّأُو۟لِى ٱلنُّهَىٰ
ayahs.sahih: Then, has it not become clear to them how many generations We destroyed before them as they walk among their dwellings? Indeed in that are signs for those of intelligence.
ayahs.clear: Is it not instructive to them, how many generations before them We destroyed, in whose settlements they walk? Surely in that are signs for people of understanding.
ayahs.kemenag: Maka tidakkah menjadi petunjuk bagi mereka (kaum musyrikin) berapa banyaknya Kami membinasakan umat-umat sebelum mereka, padahal mereka berjalan (di bekas-bekas) tempat tinggal umat-umat itu? Sesungguhnya pada yang demikian itu terdapat tanda-tanda bagi orang yang berakal.

ayahs.arabic: وَلَوْلَا كَلِمَةٌۭ سَبَقَتْ مِن رَّبِّكَ لَكَانَ لِزَامًۭا وَأَجَلٌۭ مُّسَمًّۭى
ayahs.sahih: And if not for a word that preceded from your Lord, punishment would have been an obligation [due immediately], and [if not for] a specified term [decreed].
ayahs.clear: Were it not for a word that issued from your Lord, the inevitable would have happened, but there is an appointed term.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan sekiranya tidak ada suatu ketetapan dari Allah yang telah terdahulu atau tidak ada ajal yang telah ditentukan, pasti (azab itu) menimpa mereka.

ayahs.arabic: فَٱصْبِرْ عَلَىٰ مَا يَقُولُونَ وَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ قَبْلَ طُلُوعِ ٱلشَّمْسِ وَقَبْلَ غُرُوبِهَا ۖ وَمِنْ ءَانَآئِ ٱلَّيْلِ فَسَبِّحْ وَأَطْرَافَ ٱلنَّهَارِ لَعَلَّكَ تَرْضَىٰ
ayahs.sahih: So be patient over what they say and exalt [Allah] with praise of your Lord before the rising of the sun and before its setting; and during periods of the night [exalt Him] and at the ends of the day, that you may be satisfied.
ayahs.clear: So bear patiently what they say, and celebrate the praises of your Lord before the rising of the sun, and before its setting. And during the hours of the night glorify Him, and at the borders of the day, that you may be satisfied.
ayahs.kemenag: Maka sabarlah kamu atas apa yang mereka katakan, dan bertasbihlah dengan memuji Tuhanmu, sebelum terbit matahari dan sebelum terbenamnya dan bertasbih pulalah pada waktu-waktu di malam hari dan pada waktu-waktu di siang hari, supaya kamu merasa senang,

ayahs.arabic: وَلَا تَمُدَّنَّ عَيْنَيْكَ إِلَىٰ مَا مَتَّعْنَا بِهِۦٓ أَزْوَٰجًۭا مِّنْهُمْ زَهْرَةَ ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا لِنَفْتِنَهُمْ فِيهِ ۚ وَرِزْقُ رَبِّكَ خَيْرٌۭ وَأَبْقَىٰ
ayahs.sahih: And do not extend your eyes toward that by which We have given enjoyment to [some] categories of them, [its being but] the splendor of worldly life by which We test them. And the provision of your Lord is better and more enduring.
ayahs.clear: And do not extend your glance towards what We have given some classes of them to enjoy—the splendor of the life of this world—that We may test them thereby. Your Lord’s provision is better, and more lasting.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan janganlah kamu tujukan kedua matamu kepada apa yang telah Kami berikan kepada golongan-golongan dari mereka, sebagai bunga kehidupan dunia untuk Kami cobai mereka dengannya. Dan karunia Tuhan kamu adalah lebih baik dan lebih kekal.

ayahs.arabic: وَأْمُرْ أَهْلَكَ بِٱلصَّلَوٰةِ وَٱصْطَبِرْ عَلَيْهَا ۖ لَا نَسْـَٔلُكَ رِزْقًۭا ۖ نَّحْنُ نَرْزُقُكَ ۗ وَٱلْعَٰقِبَةُ لِلتَّقْوَىٰ
ayahs.sahih: And enjoin prayer upon your family [and people] and be steadfast therein. We ask you not for provision; We provide for you, and the [best] outcome is for [those of] righteousness.
ayahs.clear: And exhort your people to pray, and patiently adhere to it. We ask of you no sustenance, but it is We who sustain you. The good ending is that for righteousness.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan perintahkanlah kepada keluargamu mendirikan shalat dan bersabarlah kamu dalam mengerjakannya. Kami tidak meminta rezeki kepadamu, Kamilah yang memberi rezeki kepadamu. Dan akibat (yang baik) itu adalah bagi orang yang bertakwa.

ayahs.arabic: وَقَالُوا۟ لَوْلَا يَأْتِينَا بِـَٔايَةٍۢ مِّن رَّبِّهِۦٓ ۚ أَوَلَمْ تَأْتِهِم بَيِّنَةُ مَا فِى ٱلصُّحُفِ ٱلْأُولَىٰ
ayahs.sahih: And they say, "Why does he not bring us a sign from his Lord?" Has there not come to them evidence of what was in the former scriptures?
ayahs.clear: And they say, “Why does he not bring us a miracle from his Lord?” Were they not given enough miracles in the former scriptures?
ayahs.kemenag: Dan mereka berkata: "Mengapa ia tidak membawa bukti kepada kami dari Tuhannya?" Dan apakah belum datang kepada mereka bukti yang nyata dari apa yang tersebut di dalam kitab-kitab yang dahulu?

ayahs.arabic: وَلَوْ أَنَّآ أَهْلَكْنَٰهُم بِعَذَابٍۢ مِّن قَبْلِهِۦ لَقَالُوا۟ رَبَّنَا لَوْلَآ أَرْسَلْتَ إِلَيْنَا رَسُولًۭا فَنَتَّبِعَ ءَايَٰتِكَ مِن قَبْلِ أَن نَّذِلَّ وَنَخْزَىٰ
ayahs.sahih: And if We had destroyed them with a punishment before him, they would have said, "Our Lord, why did You not send to us a messenger so we could have followed Your verses before we were humiliated and disgraced?"
ayahs.clear: Had We destroyed them with a punishment before him, they would have said, “Our Lord, if only You had sent us a messenger, we would have followed Your revelations before we were humiliated and disgraced.”
ayahs.kemenag: Dan sekiranya Kami binasakan mereka dengan suatu azab sebelum Al Quran itu (diturunkan), tentulah mereka berkata: "Ya Tuhan kami, mengapa tidak Engkau utus seorang rasul kepada kami, lalu kami mengikuti ayat-ayat Engkau sebelum kami menjadi hina dan rendah?"

ayahs.arabic: قُلْ كُلٌّۭ مُّتَرَبِّصٌۭ فَتَرَبَّصُوا۟ ۖ فَسَتَعْلَمُونَ مَنْ أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلصِّرَٰطِ ٱلسَّوِىِّ وَمَنِ ٱهْتَدَىٰ
ayahs.sahih: Say, "Each [of us] is waiting; so wait. For you will know who are the companions of the sound path and who is guided."
ayahs.clear: Say, “Everybody is waiting, so wait. You will know who the people of the straight path are, and who is rightly-guided.
ayahs.kemenag: Katakanlah: "Masing-masing (kita) menanti, maka nantikanlah oleh kamu sekalian! Maka kamu kelak akan mengetahui, siapa yang menempuh jalan yang lurus dan siapa yang telah mendapat petunjuk".

ayahs.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ ٱقْتَرَبَ لِلنَّاسِ حِسَابُهُمْ وَهُمْ فِى غَفْلَةٍۢ مُّعْرِضُونَ
ayahs.sahih: [The time of] their account has approached for the people, while they are in heedlessness turning away.
ayahs.clear: Mankind’s reckoning has drawn near, but they turn away heedlessly.
ayahs.kemenag: Telah dekat kepada manusia hari menghisab segala amalan mereka, sedang mereka berada dalam kelalaian lagi berpaling (daripadanya).

ayahs.arabic: مَا يَأْتِيهِم مِّن ذِكْرٍۢ مِّن رَّبِّهِم مُّحْدَثٍ إِلَّا ٱسْتَمَعُوهُ وَهُمْ يَلْعَبُونَ
ayahs.sahih: No mention comes to them anew from their Lord except that they listen to it while they are at play
ayahs.clear: No fresh reminder comes to them from their Lord, but they listen to it playfully.
ayahs.kemenag: Tidak datang kepada mereka suatu ayat Al Quran pun yang baru (di-turunkan) dari Tuhan mereka, melainkan mereka mendengarnya, sedang mereka bermain-main,

ayahs.arabic: لَاهِيَةًۭ قُلُوبُهُمْ ۗ وَأَسَرُّوا۟ ٱلنَّجْوَى ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ هَلْ هَٰذَآ إِلَّا بَشَرٌۭ مِّثْلُكُمْ ۖ أَفَتَأْتُونَ ٱلسِّحْرَ وَأَنتُمْ تُبْصِرُونَ
ayahs.sahih: With their hearts distracted. And those who do wrong conceal their private conversation, [saying], "Is this [Prophet] except a human being like you? So would you approach magic while you are aware [of it]?"
ayahs.clear: Their hearts distracted, the wrongdoers confer secretly, “Is this anything but a mortal like you? Will you take to sorcery, with open-eyes?”
ayahs.kemenag: (lagi) hati mereka dalam keadaan lalai. Dan mereka yang zalim itu merahasiakan pembicaraan mereka: "Orang ini tidak lain hanyalah seorang manusia (jua) seperti kamu, maka apakah kamu menerima sihir itu, padahal kamu menyaksikannya?"

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ رَبِّى يَعْلَمُ ٱلْقَوْلَ فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۖ وَهُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
ayahs.sahih: The Prophet said, "My Lord knows whatever is said throughout the heaven and earth, and He is the Hearing, the Knowing."
ayahs.clear: He said, “My Lord knows what is said in the heaven and the earth; and He is the Hearer, the Knower.”
ayahs.kemenag: Berkatalah Muhammad (kepada mereka): "Tuhanku mengetahui semua perkataan di langit dan di bumi dan Dialah Yang Maha Mendengar lagi Maha Mengetahui".

ayahs.arabic: بَلْ قَالُوٓا۟ أَضْغَٰثُ أَحْلَٰمٍۭ بَلِ ٱفْتَرَىٰهُ بَلْ هُوَ شَاعِرٌۭ فَلْيَأْتِنَا بِـَٔايَةٍۢ كَمَآ أُرْسِلَ ٱلْأَوَّلُونَ
ayahs.sahih: But they say, "[The revelation is but] a mixture of false dreams; rather, he has invented it; rather, he is a poet. So let him bring us a sign just as the previous [messengers] were sent [with miracles]."
ayahs.clear: And they said, “A jumble of dreams,” and, “He made it up,” and, “He is a poet,” “let him bring us a sign, like those sent to the ancients.”
ayahs.kemenag: Bahkan mereka berkata (pula): "(Al Quran itu adalah) mimpi-mimpi yang kalut, malah diada-adakannya, bahkan dia sendiri seorang penyair, maka hendaknya ia mendatangkan kepada kita suatu mukjizat, sebagai-mana rasul-rasul yang telah lalu di-utus".

ayahs.arabic: مَآ ءَامَنَتْ قَبْلَهُم مِّن قَرْيَةٍ أَهْلَكْنَٰهَآ ۖ أَفَهُمْ يُؤْمِنُونَ
ayahs.sahih: Not a [single] city which We destroyed believed before them, so will they believe?
ayahs.clear: None of the towns We destroyed before them had believed. Will they, then, believe?
ayahs.kemenag: Tidak ada (penduduk) suatu negeripun yang beriman yang Kami telah membinasakannya sebeIum mereka; maka apakah mereka akan beriman?

ayahs.arabic: وَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَا قَبْلَكَ إِلَّا رِجَالًۭا نُّوحِىٓ إِلَيْهِمْ ۖ فَسْـَٔلُوٓا۟ أَهْلَ ٱلذِّكْرِ إِن كُنتُمْ لَا تَعْلَمُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And We sent not before you, [O Muhammad], except men to whom We revealed [the message], so ask the people of the message if you do not know.
ayahs.clear: We did not send before you except men, whom We inspired. Ask the people of knowledge, if you do not know.
ayahs.kemenag: Kami tiada mengutus rasul rasul sebelum kamu (Muhammad), melainkan beberapa orang-laki-laki yang Kami beri wahyu kepada mereka, maka tanyakanlah olehmu kepada orang-orang yang berilmu, jika kamu tiada mengetahui.

ayahs.arabic: وَمَا جَعَلْنَٰهُمْ جَسَدًۭا لَّا يَأْكُلُونَ ٱلطَّعَامَ وَمَا كَانُوا۟ خَٰلِدِينَ
ayahs.sahih: And We did not make the prophets forms not eating food, nor were they immortal [on earth].
ayahs.clear: We did not make them mere bodies that ate no food, nor were they immortal.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan tidaklah Kami jadikan mereka tubuh-tubuh yang tiada memakan makanan, dan tidak (pula) mereka itu orang-orang yang kekal.

ayahs.arabic: ثُمَّ صَدَقْنَٰهُمُ ٱلْوَعْدَ فَأَنجَيْنَٰهُمْ وَمَن نَّشَآءُ وَأَهْلَكْنَا ٱلْمُسْرِفِينَ
ayahs.sahih: Then We fulfilled for them the promise, and We saved them and whom We willed and destroyed the transgressors.
ayahs.clear: Then We fulfilled Our promise to them, and We saved them together with whomever We willed, and We destroyed the extravagant.
ayahs.kemenag: Kemudian Kami tepati janji (yang telah Kami janjikan) kepada mereka. Maka Kami selamatkan mereka dan orang-orang yang Kami kehendaki dan Kami binasakan orang-orang yang melampaui batas.

ayahs.arabic: لَقَدْ أَنزَلْنَآ إِلَيْكُمْ كِتَٰبًۭا فِيهِ ذِكْرُكُمْ ۖ أَفَلَا تَعْقِلُونَ
ayahs.sahih: We have certainly sent down to you a Book in which is your mention. Then will you not reason?
ayahs.clear: We have sent down to you a Book, containing your message. Do you not understand?
ayahs.kemenag: Sesungguhnya telah Kami turunkan kepada kamu sebuah kitab yang di dalamnya terdapat sebab-sebab kemuliaan bagimu. Maka apakah kamu tiada memahaminya?

ayahs.arabic: وَكَمْ قَصَمْنَا مِن قَرْيَةٍۢ كَانَتْ ظَالِمَةًۭ وَأَنشَأْنَا بَعْدَهَا قَوْمًا ءَاخَرِينَ
ayahs.sahih: And how many a city which was unjust have We shattered and produced after it another people.
ayahs.clear: How many a guilty town have We crushed, and established thereafter another people?
ayahs.kemenag: Dan berapa banyaknya (penduduk) negeri yang zalim yang teIah Kami binasakan, dan Kami adakan sesudah mereka itu kaum yang lain (sebagai penggantinya).

ayahs.arabic: فَلَمَّآ أَحَسُّوا۟ بَأْسَنَآ إِذَا هُم مِّنْهَا يَرْكُضُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And when its inhabitants perceived Our punishment, at once they fled from it.
ayahs.clear: Then, when they sensed Our might, they started running away from it.
ayahs.kemenag: Maka tatkala mereka merasakan azab Kami, tiba-tiba mereka melarikan diri dari negerinya.

ayahs.arabic: لَا تَرْكُضُوا۟ وَٱرْجِعُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰ مَآ أُتْرِفْتُمْ فِيهِ وَمَسَٰكِنِكُمْ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُسْـَٔلُونَ
ayahs.sahih: [Some angels said], "Do not flee but return to where you were given luxury and to your homes - perhaps you will be questioned."
ayahs.clear: Do not run, but come back to your luxuries, and to your homes, that you may be questioned.
ayahs.kemenag: Janganlah kamu lari tergesa-gesa; kembalilah kamu kepada nikmat yang telah kamu rasakan dan kepada tempat-tempat kediamanmu (yang baik), supaya kamu ditanya.

ayahs.arabic: قَالُوا۟ يَٰوَيْلَنَآ إِنَّا كُنَّا ظَٰلِمِينَ
ayahs.sahih: They said, "O woe to us! Indeed, we were wrongdoers."
ayahs.clear: They said, “Woe to us; we were unfair.”
ayahs.kemenag: Mereka berkata: "Aduhai, celaka kami, sesungguhnya kami adalah orang-orang yang zaIim".

ayahs.arabic: فَمَا زَالَت تِّلْكَ دَعْوَىٰهُمْ حَتَّىٰ جَعَلْنَٰهُمْ حَصِيدًا خَٰمِدِينَ
ayahs.sahih: And that declaration of theirs did not cease until We made them [as] a harvest [mowed down], extinguished [like a fire].
ayahs.clear: This continued to be their cry, until We made them silent ashes.
ayahs.kemenag: Maka tetaplah demikian keluhan mereka, sehingga Kami jadikan mereka sebagai tanaman yang telah dituai, yang tidak dapat hidup lagi.

ayahs.arabic: وَمَا خَلَقْنَا ٱلسَّمَآءَ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا لَٰعِبِينَ
ayahs.sahih: And We did not create the heaven and earth and that between them in play.
ayahs.clear: We did not create the sky and the earth and what is between them for amusement.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan tidaklah Kami ciptakan Iangit dan bumi dan segala yang ada di antara keduanya dengan bermain-main.

ayahs.arabic: لَوْ أَرَدْنَآ أَن نَّتَّخِذَ لَهْوًۭا لَّٱتَّخَذْنَٰهُ مِن لَّدُنَّآ إِن كُنَّا فَٰعِلِينَ
ayahs.sahih: Had We intended to take a diversion, We could have taken it from [what is] with Us - if [indeed] We were to do so.
ayahs.clear: If We wanted amusement, We could have found it within Us, were We to do so.
ayahs.kemenag: Sekiranya Kami hendak membuat sesuatu permainan, (isteri dan anak), tentulah Kami membuatnya dari sisi Kami. Jika Kami menghendaki berbuat demikian, (tentulah Kami telah melakukannya).

ayahs.arabic: بَلْ نَقْذِفُ بِٱلْحَقِّ عَلَى ٱلْبَٰطِلِ فَيَدْمَغُهُۥ فَإِذَا هُوَ زَاهِقٌۭ ۚ وَلَكُمُ ٱلْوَيْلُ مِمَّا تَصِفُونَ
ayahs.sahih: Rather, We dash the truth upon falsehood, and it destroys it, and thereupon it departs. And for you is destruction from that which you describe.
ayahs.clear: In fact, We hurl the truth against falsehood, and it crushes it, so it vanishes. Woe unto you, for what you describe.
ayahs.kemenag: Sebenarya Kami melontarkan yang hak kepada yang batil lalu yang hak itu menghancurkannya, maka dengan serta merta yang batil itu lenyap. Dan kecelakaanlah bagimu disebabkan kamu mensifati (Allah dengan sifat-sifat yang tidak layak bagi-Nya).

ayahs.arabic: وَلَهُۥ مَن فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ وَمَنْ عِندَهُۥ لَا يَسْتَكْبِرُونَ عَنْ عِبَادَتِهِۦ وَلَا يَسْتَحْسِرُونَ
ayahs.sahih: To Him belongs whoever is in the heavens and the earth. And those near Him are not prevented by arrogance from His worship, nor do they tire.
ayahs.clear: To Him belongs everyone in the heavens and the earth. Those near Him are not too proud to worship Him, nor do they waver.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan kepunyaan-Nya-lah segala yang di langit dan di bumi. Dan malaikat-malaikat yang di sisi-Nya, mereka tiada mempunyai rasa angkuh untuk menyembah-Nya dan tiada (pula) merasa letih.

ayahs.arabic: يُسَبِّحُونَ ٱلَّيْلَ وَٱلنَّهَارَ لَا يَفْتُرُونَ
ayahs.sahih: They exalt [Him] night and day [and] do not slacken.
ayahs.clear: They praise night and day, without ever tiring.
ayahs.kemenag: Mereka selalu bertasbih malam dan siang tiada henti-hentinya.

ayahs.arabic: أَمِ ٱتَّخَذُوٓا۟ ءَالِهَةًۭ مِّنَ ٱلْأَرْضِ هُمْ يُنشِرُونَ
ayahs.sahih: Or have men taken for themselves gods from the earth who resurrect [the dead]?
ayahs.clear: Or have they taken to themselves gods from the earth who resurrect?
ayahs.kemenag: Apakah mereka mengambil tuhan-tuhan dari bumi, yang dapat menghidupkan (orang-orang mati)?

ayahs.arabic: لَوْ كَانَ فِيهِمَآ ءَالِهَةٌ إِلَّا ٱللَّهُ لَفَسَدَتَا ۚ فَسُبْحَٰنَ ٱللَّهِ رَبِّ ٱلْعَرْشِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ
ayahs.sahih: Had there been within the heavens and earth gods besides Allah, they both would have been ruined. So exalted is Allah, Lord of the Throne, above what they describe.
ayahs.clear: If there were in them gods other than God, they would have gone to ruin. So glory be to God, Lord of the Throne, beyond what they allege.
ayahs.kemenag: Sekiranya ada di langit dan di bumi tuhan-tuhan selain Allah, tentulah keduanya itu telah rusak binasa. Maka Maha Suci Allah yang mempunyai 'Arsy daripada apa yang mereka sifatkan.

ayahs.arabic: لَا يُسْـَٔلُ عَمَّا يَفْعَلُ وَهُمْ يُسْـَٔلُونَ
ayahs.sahih: He is not questioned about what He does, but they will be questioned.
ayahs.clear: He will not be questioned about what He does, but they will be questioned.
ayahs.kemenag: Dia tidak ditanya tentang apa yang diperbuat-Nya dan merekalah yang akan ditanyai.

ayahs.arabic: أَمِ ٱتَّخَذُوا۟ مِن دُونِهِۦٓ ءَالِهَةًۭ ۖ قُلْ هَاتُوا۟ بُرْهَٰنَكُمْ ۖ هَٰذَا ذِكْرُ مَن مَّعِىَ وَذِكْرُ مَن قَبْلِى ۗ بَلْ أَكْثَرُهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ ٱلْحَقَّ ۖ فَهُم مُّعْرِضُونَ
ayahs.sahih: Or have they taken gods besides Him? Say, [O Muhammad], "Produce your proof. This [Qur'an] is the message for those with me and the message of those before me." But most of them do not know the truth, so they are turning away.
ayahs.clear: Or have they taken, besides Him, other gods? Say, “Bring your proof. This is a message for those with me, and a message of those before me.” But most of them do not know the truth, so they turn away.
ayahs.kemenag: Apakah mereka mengambil tuhan-tuhan selain-Nya? Katakanlah: "Unjukkanlah hujjahmu! (Al Quran) ini adalah peringatan bagi orang-orang yang bersamaku, dan peringatan bagi orang-orang yang sebelumku". Sebenarnya kebanyakan mereka tiada mengetahui yang hak, karena itu mereka berpaling.

ayahs.arabic: وَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَا مِن قَبْلِكَ مِن رَّسُولٍ إِلَّا نُوحِىٓ إِلَيْهِ أَنَّهُۥ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّآ أَنَا۠ فَٱعْبُدُونِ
ayahs.sahih: And We sent not before you any messenger except that We revealed to him that, "There is no deity except Me, so worship Me."
ayahs.clear: We never sent a messenger before you without inspiring him that: “There is no god but I, so worship Me.”
ayahs.kemenag: Dan Kami tidak mengutus seorang rasulpun sebelum kamu melainkan Kami wahyukan kepadanya: "Bahwasanya tidak ada Tuhan (yang hak) melainkan Aku, maka sembahlah olehmu sekalian akan Aku".

ayahs.arabic: وَقَالُوا۟ ٱتَّخَذَ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ وَلَدًۭا ۗ سُبْحَٰنَهُۥ ۚ بَلْ عِبَادٌۭ مُّكْرَمُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And they say, "The Most Merciful has taken a son." Exalted is He! Rather, they are [but] honored servants.
ayahs.clear: And they say, “The Most Merciful has taken to himself a son.” Be He glorified; they are but honored servants.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan mereka berkata: "Tuhan Yang Maha Pemurah telah mengambil (mempunyai) anak", Maha Suci Allah. Sebenarnya (malaikat-malaikat itu), adalah hamba-hamba yang dimuliakan,

ayahs.arabic: لَا يَسْبِقُونَهُۥ بِٱلْقَوْلِ وَهُم بِأَمْرِهِۦ يَعْمَلُونَ
ayahs.sahih: They cannot precede Him in word, and they act by His command.
ayahs.clear: They never speak before He has spoken, and they only act on His command.
ayahs.kemenag: mereka itu tidak mendahului-Nya dengan perkataan dan mereka mengerjakan perintah-perintah-Nya.

ayahs.arabic: يَعْلَمُ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ وَلَا يَشْفَعُونَ إِلَّا لِمَنِ ٱرْتَضَىٰ وَهُم مِّنْ خَشْيَتِهِۦ مُشْفِقُونَ
ayahs.sahih: He knows what is [presently] before them and what will be after them, and they cannot intercede except on behalf of one whom He approves. And they, from fear of Him, are apprehensive.
ayahs.clear: He knows what is before them, and what is behind them; and they do not intercede except for him whom He approves; and they tremble in awe of Him.
ayahs.kemenag: Allah mengetahui segala sesuatu yang dihadapan mereka (malaikat) dan yang di belakang mereka, dan mereka tiada memberi syafa'at melainkan kepada orang yang diridhai Allah, dan mereka itu selalu berhati-hati karena takut kepada-Nya.

ayahs.arabic: ۞ وَمَن يَقُلْ مِنْهُمْ إِنِّىٓ إِلَٰهٌۭ مِّن دُونِهِۦ فَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِيهِ جَهَنَّمَ ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ
ayahs.sahih: And whoever of them should say, "Indeed, I am a god besides Him"- that one We would recompense with Hell. Thus do We recompense the wrongdoers.
ayahs.clear: And whoever of them says, “I am a god besides Him,” We will reward him with Hell. Thus We reward the wrongdoers.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan barangsiapa di antara mereka, mengatakan: "Sesungguhnya Aku adalah tuhan selain daripada Allah", maka orang itu Kami beri balasan dengan Jahannam, demikian Kami memberikan pembalasan kepada orang-orang zalim.

ayahs.arabic: أَوَلَمْ يَرَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓا۟ أَنَّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ كَانَتَا رَتْقًۭا فَفَتَقْنَٰهُمَا ۖ وَجَعَلْنَا مِنَ ٱلْمَآءِ كُلَّ شَىْءٍ حَىٍّ ۖ أَفَلَا يُؤْمِنُونَ
ayahs.sahih: Have those who disbelieved not considered that the heavens and the earth were a joined entity, and We separated them and made from water every living thing? Then will they not believe?
ayahs.clear: Do the disbelievers not see that the heavens and the earth were one mass, and We tore them apart? And We made from water every living thing. Will they not believe?
ayahs.kemenag: Dan apakah orang-orang yang kafir tidak mengetahui bahwasanya langit dan bumi itu keduanya dahulu adalah suatu yang padu, kemudian Kami pisahkan antara keduanya. Dan dari air Kami jadikan segala sesuatu yang hidup. Maka mengapakah mereka tiada juga beriman?

ayahs.arabic: وَجَعَلْنَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ رَوَٰسِىَ أَن تَمِيدَ بِهِمْ وَجَعَلْنَا فِيهَا فِجَاجًۭا سُبُلًۭا لَّعَلَّهُمْ يَهْتَدُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And We placed within the earth firmly set mountains, lest it should shift with them, and We made therein [mountain] passes [as] roads that they might be guided.
ayahs.clear: And We placed on earth stabilizers, lest it sways with them, and We placed therein signposts and passages, that they may be guided.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan telah Kami jadikan di bumi ini gunung-gunung yang kokoh supaya bumi itu (tidak) goncang bersama mereka dan telah Kami jadikan (pula) di bumi itu jalan-jalan yang luas, agar mereka mendapat petunjuk.

ayahs.arabic: وَجَعَلْنَا ٱلسَّمَآءَ سَقْفًۭا مَّحْفُوظًۭا ۖ وَهُمْ عَنْ ءَايَٰتِهَا مُعْرِضُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And We made the sky a protected ceiling, but they, from its signs, are turning away.
ayahs.clear: And We made the sky a protected ceiling; yet they turn away from its wonders.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan Kami menjadikan langit itu sebagai atap yang terpelihara, sedang mereka berpaling dari segala tanda-tanda (kekuasaan Allah) yang terdapat padanya.

ayahs.arabic: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلَّيْلَ وَٱلنَّهَارَ وَٱلشَّمْسَ وَٱلْقَمَرَ ۖ كُلٌّۭ فِى فَلَكٍۢ يَسْبَحُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And it is He who created the night and the day and the sun and the moon; all [heavenly bodies] in an orbit are swimming.
ayahs.clear: It is He who created the night and the day, and the sun and the moon; each floating in an orbit.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan Dialah yang telah menciptakan malam dan siang, matahari dan bulan. Masing-masing dari keduanya itu beredar di dalam garis edarnya.

ayahs.arabic: وَمَا جَعَلْنَا لِبَشَرٍۢ مِّن قَبْلِكَ ٱلْخُلْدَ ۖ أَفَإِي۟ن مِّتَّ فَهُمُ ٱلْخَٰلِدُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And We did not grant to any man before you eternity [on earth]; so if you die - would they be eternal?
ayahs.clear: We did not grant immortality to any human being before you. Should you die, are they then the immortal?
ayahs.kemenag: Kami tidak menjadikan hidup abadi bagi seorang manusiapun sebelum kamu (Muhammad); maka jikalau kamu mati, apakah mereka akan kekal?

ayahs.arabic: كُلُّ نَفْسٍۢ ذَآئِقَةُ ٱلْمَوْتِ ۗ وَنَبْلُوكُم بِٱلشَّرِّ وَٱلْخَيْرِ فِتْنَةًۭ ۖ وَإِلَيْنَا تُرْجَعُونَ
ayahs.sahih: Every soul will taste death. And We test you with evil and with good as trial; and to Us you will be returned.
ayahs.clear: Every soul will taste death. We burden you with adversity and prosperity—a test. And to Us you will be returned.
ayahs.kemenag: Tiap-tiap yang berjiwa akan merasakan mati. Kami akan menguji kamu dengan keburukan dan kebaikan sebagai cobaan (yang sebenar-benarnya). Dan hanya kepada Kamilah kamu dikembalikan.

ayahs.arabic: وَإِذَا رَءَاكَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓا۟ إِن يَتَّخِذُونَكَ إِلَّا هُزُوًا أَهَٰذَا ٱلَّذِى يَذْكُرُ ءَالِهَتَكُمْ وَهُم بِذِكْرِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ هُمْ كَٰفِرُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And when those who disbelieve see you, [O Muhammad], they take you not except in ridicule, [saying], "Is this the one who insults your gods?" And they are, at the mention of the Most Merciful, disbelievers.
ayahs.clear: When those who disbelieve see you, they treat you only with ridicule: “Is this the one who mentions your gods?” And they reject the mention of the Merciful.
