ayahs.clear: We never sent a messenger before you, or a prophet, but when he had a desire Satan interfered in his wishes. But God nullifies what Satan interjects, and God affirms His revelations. God is Omniscient and Wise.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan Kami tidak mengutus sebelum kamu seorang rasulpun dan tidak (pula) seorang nabi, melainkan apabila ia mempunyai sesuatu keinginan, syaitanpun memasukkan godaan-godaan terhadap keinginan itu, Allah menghilangkan apa yang dimasukkan oleh syaitan itu, dan Allah menguatkan ayat-ayat-Nya. Dan Allah Maha Mengetahui lagi Maha Bijaksana,

ayahs.arabic: لِّيَجْعَلَ مَا يُلْقِى ٱلشَّيْطَٰنُ فِتْنَةًۭ لِّلَّذِينَ فِى قُلُوبِهِم مَّرَضٌۭ وَٱلْقَاسِيَةِ قُلُوبُهُمْ ۗ وَإِنَّ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ لَفِى شِقَاقٍۭ بَعِيدٍۢ
ayahs.sahih: [That is] so He may make what Satan throws in a trial for those within whose hearts is disease and those hard of heart. And indeed, the wrongdoers are in extreme dissension.
ayahs.clear: In order to make Satan’s suggestions a trial for those whose hearts are diseased, and those whose hearts are hardened. The wrongdoers are in profound discord.
ayahs.kemenag: agar Dia menjadikan apa yang dimasukkan oleh syaitan itu, sebagai cobaan bagi orang-orang yang di dalam hatinya ada penyakit dan yang kasar hatinya. Dan sesungguhnya orang-orang yang zalim itu, benar-benar dalam permusuhan yang sangat,

ayahs.arabic: وَلِيَعْلَمَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْعِلْمَ أَنَّهُ ٱلْحَقُّ مِن رَّبِّكَ فَيُؤْمِنُوا۟ بِهِۦ فَتُخْبِتَ لَهُۥ قُلُوبُهُمْ ۗ وَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَهَادِ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰ صِرَٰطٍۢ مُّسْتَقِيمٍۢ
ayahs.sahih: And so those who were given knowledge may know that it is the truth from your Lord and [therefore] believe in it, and their hearts humbly submit to it. And indeed is Allah the Guide of those who have believed to a straight path.
ayahs.clear: And so that those endowed with knowledge may know that it is the truth from your Lord, and so believe in it, and their hearts soften to it. God guides those who believe to a straight path.
ayahs.kemenag: dan agar orang-orang yang telah diberi ilmu, meyakini bahwasanya Al Quran itulah yang hak dari Tuhan-mu lalu mereka beriman dan tunduk hati mereka kepadanya dan sesungguhnya Allah adalah Pemberi Petunjuk bagi orang-orang yang beriman kepada jalan yang lurus.

ayahs.arabic: وَلَا يَزَالُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ فِى مِرْيَةٍۢ مِّنْهُ حَتَّىٰ تَأْتِيَهُمُ ٱلسَّاعَةُ بَغْتَةً أَوْ يَأْتِيَهُمْ عَذَابُ يَوْمٍ عَقِيمٍ
ayahs.sahih: But those who disbelieve will not cease to be in doubt of it until the Hour comes upon them unexpectedly or there comes to them the punishment of a barren Day.
ayahs.clear: Those who disbelieve will continue to be hesitant about it, until the Hour comes upon them suddenly, or there comes to them the torment of a desolate Day.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan senantiasalah orang-orang kafir itu berada dalam keragu-raguan terhadap Al Quran, hingga datang kepada mereka saat (kematiannya) dengan tiba-tiba atau datang kepada mereka azab hari kiamat.

ayahs.arabic: ٱلْمُلْكُ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ لِّلَّهِ يَحْكُمُ بَيْنَهُمْ ۚ فَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ فِى جَنَّٰتِ ٱلنَّعِيمِ
ayahs.sahih: [All] sovereignty that Day is for Allah; He will judge between them. So they who believed and did righteous deeds will be in the Gardens of Pleasure.
ayahs.clear: Sovereignty on that Day belongs to God; He will judge between them. Those who believe and do good deeds will be in the Gardens of Bliss.
ayahs.kemenag: Kekuasaan di hari itu ada pada Allah, Dia memberi keputusan di antara mereka. Maka orang-orang yang beriman dan beramal saleh adalah di dalam surga yang penuh kenikmatan.

ayahs.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ وَكَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا فَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌۭ مُّهِينٌۭ
ayahs.sahih: And they who disbelieved and denied Our signs - for those there will be a humiliating punishment.
ayahs.clear: But those who disbelieve and reject Our revelations—these will have a humiliating punishment.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan orang-orang yang kafir dan mendustakan ayat-ayat Kami, maka bagi mereka azab yang menghinakan.

ayahs.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ هَاجَرُوا۟ فِى سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ ثُمَّ قُتِلُوٓا۟ أَوْ مَاتُوا۟ لَيَرْزُقَنَّهُمُ ٱللَّهُ رِزْقًا حَسَنًۭا ۚ وَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَهُوَ خَيْرُ ٱلرَّٰزِقِينَ
ayahs.sahih: And those who emigrated for the cause of Allah and then were killed or died - Allah will surely provide for them a good provision. And indeed, it is Allah who is the best of providers.
ayahs.clear: Those who emigrate in God’s cause, then get killed, or die, God will provide them with fine provisions. God is the Best of Providers.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan orang-orang yang berhijrah di jalan Allah, kemudian mereka di bunuh atau mati, benar-benar Allah akan memberikan kepada mereka rezeki yang baik (surga). Dan sesungguhnya Allah adalah sebaik-baik pemberi rezeki.

ayahs.arabic: لَيُدْخِلَنَّهُم مُّدْخَلًۭا يَرْضَوْنَهُۥ ۗ وَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَعَلِيمٌ حَلِيمٌۭ
ayahs.sahih: He will surely cause them to enter an entrance with which they will be pleased, and indeed, Allah is Knowing and Forbearing.
ayahs.clear: He will admit them an admittance that will please them. God is Knowing and Clement.
ayahs.kemenag: Sesungguhnya Allah akan memasukkan mereka ke dalam suatu tempat (surga) yang mereka menyukainya. Dan sesungguhnya Allah Maha mengetahui lagi Maha Penyantun.

ayahs.arabic: ۞ ذَٰلِكَ وَمَنْ عَاقَبَ بِمِثْلِ مَا عُوقِبَ بِهِۦ ثُمَّ بُغِىَ عَلَيْهِ لَيَنصُرَنَّهُ ٱللَّهُ ۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَعَفُوٌّ غَفُورٌۭ
ayahs.sahih: That [is so]. And whoever responds [to injustice] with the equivalent of that with which he was harmed and then is tyrannized - Allah will surely aid him. Indeed, Allah is Pardoning and Forgiving.
ayahs.clear: That is so! Whoever retaliates similarly to the affliction he was made to suffer, and then he is wronged again, God will definitely assist him. God is Pardoning and Forgiving.
ayahs.kemenag: Demikianlah, dan barangsiapa membalas seimbang dengan penganiayaan yang pernah ia derita kemudian ia dianiaya (lagi), pasti Allah akan menolongnya. Sesungguhnya Allah benar-benar Maha Pemaaf lagi Maha Pengampun.

ayahs.arabic: ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُولِجُ ٱلَّيْلَ فِى ٱلنَّهَارِ وَيُولِجُ ٱلنَّهَارَ فِى ٱلَّيْلِ وَأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ سَمِيعٌۢ بَصِيرٌۭ
ayahs.sahih: That is because Allah causes the night to enter the day and causes the day to enter the night and because Allah is Hearing and Seeing.
ayahs.clear: That is because God merges the night into the day, and He merges the day into the night, and because God is Hearing and Seeing.
ayahs.kemenag: Yang demikian itu, adalah karena sesungguhnya Allah (kuasa) memasukkan malam ke dalam siang dan memasukkan siang ke dalam malam dan bahwasanya Allah Maha Mendengar lagi Maha Melihat.

ayahs.arabic: ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ ٱلْحَقُّ وَأَنَّ مَا يَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِهِۦ هُوَ ٱلْبَٰطِلُ وَأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ ٱلْعَلِىُّ ٱلْكَبِيرُ
ayahs.sahih: That is because Allah is the Truth, and that which they call upon other than Him is falsehood, and because Allah is the Most High, the Grand.
ayahs.clear: That is because God is the Reality, and what they invoke besides Him is vanity, and because God is the Sublime, the Grand.
ayahs.kemenag: (Kuasa Allah) yang demikian itu, adalah karena sesungguhnya Allah, Dialah (Tuhan) Yang Haq dan sesungguhnya apa saja yang mereka seru selain dari Allah, itulah yang batil, dan sesungguhnya Allah, Dialah Yang Maha Tinggi lagi Maha Besar.

ayahs.arabic: أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ أَنزَلَ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءًۭ فَتُصْبِحُ ٱلْأَرْضُ مُخْضَرَّةً ۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَطِيفٌ خَبِيرٌۭ
ayahs.sahih: Do you not see that Allah has sent down rain from the sky and the earth becomes green? Indeed, Allah is Subtle and Acquainted.
ayahs.clear: Do you not see that God sends down water from the sky, and the land becomes green? God is Kind and Aware.
ayahs.kemenag: Apakah kamu tiada melihat, bahwasanya Allah menurunkan air dari langit, lalu jadilah bumi itu hijau? Sesungguhnya Allah Maha Halus lagi Maha Mengetahui.

ayahs.arabic: لَّهُۥ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ۗ وَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَهُوَ ٱلْغَنِىُّ ٱلْحَمِيدُ
ayahs.sahih: To Him belongs what is in the heavens and what is on the earth. And indeed, Allah is the Free of need, the Praiseworthy.
ayahs.clear: To Him belongs everything in the heavens and everything on earth. God is the Rich, the Praised.
ayahs.kemenag: Kepunyaan Allah-lah segala yang ada di langit dan segala yang ada di bumi. Dan sesungguhnya Allah benar-benar Maha Kaya lagi Maha Terpuji.

ayahs.arabic: أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ سَخَّرَ لَكُم مَّا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَٱلْفُلْكَ تَجْرِى فِى ٱلْبَحْرِ بِأَمْرِهِۦ وَيُمْسِكُ ٱلسَّمَآءَ أَن تَقَعَ عَلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِهِۦٓ ۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ بِٱلنَّاسِ لَرَءُوفٌۭ رَّحِيمٌۭ
ayahs.sahih: Do you not see that Allah has subjected to you whatever is on the earth and the ships which run through the sea by His command? And He restrains the sky from falling upon the earth, unless by His permission. Indeed Allah, to the people, is Kind and Merciful.
ayahs.clear: Do you not see that God made everything on earth subservient to you? How the ships sail at sea by His command? That He holds up the sky lest it falls on earth—except by His permission? God is Gracious towards the people, Most Merciful.
ayahs.kemenag: Apakah kamu tiada melihat bahwasanya Allah menundukkan bagimu apa yang ada di bumi dan bahtera yang berlayar di lautan dengan perintah-Nya. Dan Dia menahan (benda-benda) langit jatuh ke bumi, melainkan dengan izin-Nya? Sesungguhnya Allah benar-benar Maha Pengasih lagi Maha Penyayang kepada Manusia.

ayahs.arabic: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَحْيَاكُمْ ثُمَّ يُمِيتُكُمْ ثُمَّ يُحْيِيكُمْ ۗ إِنَّ ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ لَكَفُورٌۭ
ayahs.sahih: And He is the one who gave you life; then He causes you to die and then will [again] give you life. Indeed, mankind is ungrateful.
ayahs.clear: And it is He who gives you life, then makes you die, then revives you. The human being is unappreciative.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan Dialah Allah yang telah menghidupkan kamu, kemudian mematikan kamu, kemudian menghidupkan kamu (lagi), sesungguhnya manusia itu, benar-benar sangat mengingkari nikmat.

ayahs.arabic: لِّكُلِّ أُمَّةٍۢ جَعَلْنَا مَنسَكًا هُمْ نَاسِكُوهُ ۖ فَلَا يُنَٰزِعُنَّكَ فِى ٱلْأَمْرِ ۚ وَٱدْعُ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ ۖ إِنَّكَ لَعَلَىٰ هُدًۭى مُّسْتَقِيمٍۢ
ayahs.sahih: For every religion We have appointed rites which they perform. So, [O Muhammad], let the disbelievers not contend with you over the matter but invite them to your Lord. Indeed, you are upon straight guidance.
ayahs.clear: For every congregation We have appointed acts of devotion, which they observe. So do not let them dispute with you in this matter. And invite to your Lord; you are upon a straight guidance.
ayahs.kemenag: Bagi tiap-tiap umat telah Kami tetapkan syari'at tertentu yang mereka lakukan, maka janganlah sekali-kali mereka membantah kamu dalam urusan (syari'at) ini dan serulah kepada (agama) Tuhanmu. Sesungguhnya kamu benar-benar berada pada jalan yang lurus.

ayahs.arabic: وَإِن جَٰدَلُوكَ فَقُلِ ٱللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And if they dispute with you, then say, "Allah is most knowing of what you do.
ayahs.clear: But if they dispute with you, say, “God is fully aware of what you do.”
ayahs.kemenag: Dan jika mereka membantah kamu, maka katakanlah: "Allah lebih mengetahui tentang apa yang kamu kerjakan".

ayahs.arabic: ٱللَّهُ يَحْكُمُ بَيْنَكُمْ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ فِيمَا كُنتُمْ فِيهِ تَخْتَلِفُونَ
ayahs.sahih: Allah will judge between you on the Day of Resurrection concerning that over which you used to differ."
ayahs.clear: God will judge between you on the Day of Resurrection regarding what you disagree about.
ayahs.kemenag: Allah akan mengadili di antara kamu pada hari kiamat tentang apa yang kamu dahulu selalu berselisih padanya.

ayahs.arabic: أَلَمْ تَعْلَمْ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَعْلَمُ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۗ إِنَّ ذَٰلِكَ فِى كِتَٰبٍ ۚ إِنَّ ذَٰلِكَ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ يَسِيرٌۭ
ayahs.sahih: Do you not know that Allah knows what is in the heaven and earth? Indeed, that is in a Record. Indeed that, for Allah, is easy.
ayahs.clear: Do you not know that God knows everything in the heavens and the earth? This is in a book. That is easy for God.
ayahs.kemenag: Apakah kamu tidak mengetahui bahwa sesungguhnya Allah mengetahui apa saja yang ada di langit dan di bumi?; bahwasanya yang demikian itu terdapat dalam sebuah kitab (Lauh Mahfuzh). Sesungguhnya yang demikian itu amat mudah bagi Allah.

ayahs.arabic: وَيَعْبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ مَا لَمْ يُنَزِّلْ بِهِۦ سُلْطَٰنًۭا وَمَا لَيْسَ لَهُم بِهِۦ عِلْمٌۭ ۗ وَمَا لِلظَّٰلِمِينَ مِن نَّصِيرٍۢ
ayahs.sahih: And they worship besides Allah that for which He has not sent down authority and that of which they have no knowledge. And there will not be for the wrongdoers any helper.
ayahs.clear: Yet they worship, besides God, things for which He sent down no warrant, and what they have no knowledge of. There is no savior for the transgressors.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan mereka menyembah selain Allah, apa yang Allah tidak menurunkan keterangan tentang itu, dan apa yang mereka sendiri tiada mempunyai pengetahuan terhadapnya. Dan bagi orang-orang yang zalim sekali-kali tidak ada seorang penolongpun.

ayahs.arabic: وَإِذَا تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِمْ ءَايَٰتُنَا بَيِّنَٰتٍۢ تَعْرِفُ فِى وُجُوهِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ ٱلْمُنكَرَ ۖ يَكَادُونَ يَسْطُونَ بِٱلَّذِينَ يَتْلُونَ عَلَيْهِمْ ءَايَٰتِنَا ۗ قُلْ أَفَأُنَبِّئُكُم بِشَرٍّۢ مِّن ذَٰلِكُمُ ۗ ٱلنَّارُ وَعَدَهَا ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ ۖ وَبِئْسَ ٱلْمَصِيرُ
ayahs.sahih: And when Our verses are recited to them as clear evidences, you recognize in the faces of those who disbelieve disapproval. They are almost on the verge of assaulting those who recite to them Our verses. Say, "Then shall I inform you of [what is] worse than that? [It is] the Fire which Allah has promised those who disbelieve, and wretched is the destination."
ayahs.clear: And when Our Clear Verses are recited to them, you will recognize disgust on the faces of those who disbelieve. They nearly assault those who recite to them Our Verses. Say, “Shall I inform you of something worse than that? The Fire! God has promised it to those who disbelieve. And what a wretched outcome!”
ayahs.kemenag: Dan apabila dibacakan di hadapan mereka ayat-ayat Kami yang terang, niscaya kamu melihat tanda-tanda keingkaran pada muka orang-orang yang kafir itu. Hampir-hampir mereka menyerang orang-orang yang membacakan ayat-ayat Kami di hadapan mereka. Katakanlah: "Apakah akan aku kabarkan kepadamu yang lebih buruk daripada itu, yaitu neraka?" Allah telah mengancamkannya kepada orang-orang yang kafir. Dan neraka itu adalah seburuk-buruknya tempat kembali.

ayahs.arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّاسُ ضُرِبَ مَثَلٌۭ فَٱسْتَمِعُوا۟ لَهُۥٓ ۚ إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ تَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ لَن يَخْلُقُوا۟ ذُبَابًۭا وَلَوِ ٱجْتَمَعُوا۟ لَهُۥ ۖ وَإِن يَسْلُبْهُمُ ٱلذُّبَابُ شَيْـًۭٔا لَّا يَسْتَنقِذُوهُ مِنْهُ ۚ ضَعُفَ ٱلطَّالِبُ وَٱلْمَطْلُوبُ
ayahs.sahih: O people, an example is presented, so listen to it. Indeed, those you invoke besides Allah will never create [as much as] a fly, even if they gathered together for that purpose. And if the fly should steal away from them a [tiny] thing, they could not recover it from him. Weak are the pursuer and pursued.
ayahs.clear: O people! A parable is presented, so listen to it: Those you invoke besides God will never create a fly, even if they banded together for that purpose. And if the fly steals anything from them, they cannot recover it from it. Weak are the pursuer and the pursued.
ayahs.kemenag: Hai manusia, telah dibuat perumpamaan, maka dengarkanlah olehmu perumpamaan itu. Sesungguhnya segala yang kamu seru selain Allah sekali-kali tidak dapat menciptakan seekor lalatpun, walaupun mereka bersatu menciptakannya. Dan jika lalat itu merampas sesuatu dari mereka, tiadalah mereka dapat merebutnya kembali dari lalat itu. Amat lemahlah yang menyembah dan amat lemah (pulalah) yang disembah.

ayahs.arabic: مَا قَدَرُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ حَقَّ قَدْرِهِۦٓ ۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَقَوِىٌّ عَزِيزٌ
ayahs.sahih: They have not appraised Allah with true appraisal. Indeed, Allah is Powerful and Exalted in Might.
ayahs.clear: They do not value God as He should be valued. God is Strong and Powerful.
ayahs.kemenag: Mereka tidak mengenal Allah dengan sebenar-benarnya. Sesungguhnya Allah benar-benar Maha Kuat lagi Maha Perkasa.

ayahs.arabic: ٱللَّهُ يَصْطَفِى مِنَ ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةِ رُسُلًۭا وَمِنَ ٱلنَّاسِ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ سَمِيعٌۢ بَصِيرٌۭ
ayahs.sahih: Allah chooses from the angels messengers and from the people. Indeed, Allah is Hearing and Seeing.
ayahs.clear: God chooses messengers from among the angels, and from among the people. God is Hearing and Seeing.
ayahs.kemenag: Allah memilih utusan-utusan-(Nya) dari malaikat dan dari manusia; sesungguhnya Allah Maha Mendengar lagi Maha Melihat.

ayahs.arabic: يَعْلَمُ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ ۗ وَإِلَى ٱللَّهِ تُرْجَعُ ٱلْأُمُورُ
ayahs.sahih: He knows what is [presently] before them and what will be after them. And to Allah will be returned [all] matters.
ayahs.clear: He knows what is before them, and what is behind them. To God all matters are referred.
ayahs.kemenag: Allah mengetahui apa yang di hadapan mereka dan apa yang di belakang mereka. Dan hanya kepada Allah dikembalikan semua urusan.

ayahs.arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ٱرْكَعُوا۟ وَٱسْجُدُوا۟ وَٱعْبُدُوا۟ رَبَّكُمْ وَٱفْعَلُوا۟ ٱلْخَيْرَ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُفْلِحُونَ ۩
ayahs.sahih: O you who have believed, bow and prostrate and worship your Lord and do good - that you may succeed.
ayahs.clear: O you who believe! Kneel, and prostrate, and worship your Lord, and do good deeds, so that you may succeed.
ayahs.kemenag: Hai orang-orang yang beriman, ruku'lah kamu, sujudlah kamu, sembahlah Tuhanmu dan perbuatlah kebajikan, supaya kamu mendapat kemenangan.

ayahs.arabic: وَجَٰهِدُوا۟ فِى ٱللَّهِ حَقَّ جِهَادِهِۦ ۚ هُوَ ٱجْتَبَىٰكُمْ وَمَا جَعَلَ عَلَيْكُمْ فِى ٱلدِّينِ مِنْ حَرَجٍۢ ۚ مِّلَّةَ أَبِيكُمْ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ ۚ هُوَ سَمَّىٰكُمُ ٱلْمُسْلِمِينَ مِن قَبْلُ وَفِى هَٰذَا لِيَكُونَ ٱلرَّسُولُ شَهِيدًا عَلَيْكُمْ وَتَكُونُوا۟ شُهَدَآءَ عَلَى ٱلنَّاسِ ۚ فَأَقِيمُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَءَاتُوا۟ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ وَٱعْتَصِمُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ هُوَ مَوْلَىٰكُمْ ۖ فَنِعْمَ ٱلْمَوْلَىٰ وَنِعْمَ ٱلنَّصِيرُ
ayahs.sahih: And strive for Allah with the striving due to Him. He has chosen you and has not placed upon you in the religion any difficulty. [It is] the religion of your father, Abraham. Allah named you "Muslims" before [in former scriptures] and in this [revelation] that the Messenger may be a witness over you and you may be witnesses over the people. So establish prayer and give zakah and hold fast to Allah. He is your protector; and excellent is the protector, and excellent is the helper.
ayahs.clear: And strive for God, with the striving due to Him. He has chosen you, and has not burdened you in religion—the faith of your father Abraham. It is he who named you Muslims before, and in this. So that the Messenger may be a witness over you, and you may be witnesses over the people. So pray regularly, and give regular charity, and cleave to God. He is your Protector. What an excellent Protector, and what an excellent Helper.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan berjihadlah kamu pada jalan Allah dengan jihad yang sebenar-benarnya. Dia telah memilih kamu dan Dia sekali-kali tidak menjadikan untuk kamu dalam agama suatu kesempitan. (Ikutilah) agama orang tuamu Ibrahim. Dia (Allah) telah menamai kamu sekalian orang-orang muslim dari dahulu, dan (begitu pula) dalam (Al Quran) ini, supaya Rasul itu menjadi saksi atas dirimu dan supaya kamu semua menjadi saksi atas segenap manusia, maka dirikanlah sembahyang, tunaikanlah zakat dan berpeganglah kamu pada tali Allah. Dia adalah Pelindungmu, maka Dialah sebaik-baik Pelindung dan sebaik-baik Penolong.

ayahs.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ قَدْ أَفْلَحَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ
ayahs.sahih: Certainly will the believers have succeeded:
ayahs.clear: Successful are the believers.
ayahs.kemenag: Sesungguhnya beruntunglah orang-orang yang beriman,

ayahs.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ فِى صَلَاتِهِمْ خَٰشِعُونَ
ayahs.sahih: They who are during their prayer humbly submissive
ayahs.clear: Those who are humble in their prayers.
ayahs.kemenag: (yaitu) orang-orang yang khusyu' dalam sembahyangnya,

ayahs.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ عَنِ ٱللَّغْوِ مُعْرِضُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And they who turn away from ill speech
ayahs.clear: Those who avoid nonsense.
ayahs.kemenag: dan orang-orang yang menjauhkan diri dari (perbuatan dan perkataan) yang tiada berguna,

ayahs.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ لِلزَّكَوٰةِ فَٰعِلُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And they who are observant of zakah
ayahs.clear: Those who work for charity.
ayahs.kemenag: dan orang-orang yang menunaikan zakat,

ayahs.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ لِفُرُوجِهِمْ حَٰفِظُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And they who guard their private parts
ayahs.clear: Those who safeguard their chastity.
ayahs.kemenag: dan orang-orang yang menjaga kemaluannya,

ayahs.arabic: إِلَّا عَلَىٰٓ أَزْوَٰجِهِمْ أَوْ مَا مَلَكَتْ أَيْمَٰنُهُمْ فَإِنَّهُمْ غَيْرُ مَلُومِينَ
ayahs.sahih: Except from their wives or those their right hands possess, for indeed, they will not be blamed -
ayahs.clear: Except from their spouses, or their dependents—for then they are free from blame.
ayahs.kemenag: kecuali terhadap isteri-isteri mereka atau budak yang mereka miliki; maka sesungguhnya mereka dalam hal ini tiada tercela.

ayahs.arabic: فَمَنِ ٱبْتَغَىٰ وَرَآءَ ذَٰلِكَ فَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْعَادُونَ
ayahs.sahih: But whoever seeks beyond that, then those are the transgressors -
ayahs.clear: But whoever seeks anything beyond that—these are the transgressors.
ayahs.kemenag: Barangsiapa mencari yang di balik itu maka mereka itulah orang-orang yang melampaui batas.

ayahs.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ لِأَمَٰنَٰتِهِمْ وَعَهْدِهِمْ رَٰعُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And they who are to their trusts and their promises attentive
ayahs.clear: Those who are faithful to their trusts and pledges.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan orang-orang yang memelihara amanat-amanat (yang dipikulnya) dan janjinya.

ayahs.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ عَلَىٰ صَلَوَٰتِهِمْ يُحَافِظُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And they who carefully maintain their prayers -
ayahs.clear: Those who safeguard their prayers.
ayahs.kemenag: dan orang-orang yang memelihara sembahyangnya.

ayahs.arabic: أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْوَٰرِثُونَ
ayahs.sahih: Those are the inheritors
ayahs.clear: These are the inheritors.
ayahs.kemenag: Mereka itulah orang-orang yang akan mewarisi,

ayahs.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ يَرِثُونَ ٱلْفِرْدَوْسَ هُمْ فِيهَا خَٰلِدُونَ
ayahs.sahih: Who will inherit al-Firdaus. They will abide therein eternally.
ayahs.clear: Who will inherit Paradise, wherein they will dwell forever.
ayahs.kemenag: (yakni) yang akan mewarisi surga Firdaus. Mereka kekal di dalamnya.

ayahs.arabic: وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ مِن سُلَٰلَةٍۢ مِّن طِينٍۢ
ayahs.sahih: And certainly did We create man from an extract of clay.
ayahs.clear: We created man from an extract of clay.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan sesungguhnya Kami telah menciptakan manusia dari suatu saripati (berasal) dari tanah.

ayahs.arabic: ثُمَّ جَعَلْنَٰهُ نُطْفَةًۭ فِى قَرَارٍۢ مَّكِينٍۢ
ayahs.sahih: Then We placed him as a sperm-drop in a firm lodging.
ayahs.clear: Then We made him a seed, in a secure repository.
ayahs.kemenag: Kemudian Kami jadikan saripati itu air mani (yang disimpan) dalam tempat yang kokoh (rahim).

ayahs.arabic: ثُمَّ خَلَقْنَا ٱلنُّطْفَةَ عَلَقَةًۭ فَخَلَقْنَا ٱلْعَلَقَةَ مُضْغَةًۭ فَخَلَقْنَا ٱلْمُضْغَةَ عِظَٰمًۭا فَكَسَوْنَا ٱلْعِظَٰمَ لَحْمًۭا ثُمَّ أَنشَأْنَٰهُ خَلْقًا ءَاخَرَ ۚ فَتَبَارَكَ ٱللَّهُ أَحْسَنُ ٱلْخَٰلِقِينَ
ayahs.sahih: Then We made the sperm-drop into a clinging clot, and We made the clot into a lump [of flesh], and We made [from] the lump, bones, and We covered the bones with flesh; then We developed him into another creation. So blessed is Allah, the best of creators.
ayahs.clear: Then We developed the seed into a clot. Then We developed the clot into a lump. Then We developed the lump into bones. Then We clothed the bones with flesh. Then We produced it into another creature. Most Blessed is God, the Best of Creators.
ayahs.kemenag: Kemudian air mani itu Kami jadikan segumpal darah, lalu segumpal darah itu Kami jadikan segumpal daging, dan segumpal daging itu Kami jadikan tulang belulang, lalu tulang belulang itu Kami bungkus dengan daging. Kemudian Kami jadikan dia makhluk yang (berbentuk) lain. Maka Maha sucilah Allah, Pencipta Yang Paling Baik.

ayahs.arabic: ثُمَّ إِنَّكُم بَعْدَ ذَٰلِكَ لَمَيِّتُونَ
ayahs.sahih: Then indeed, after that you are to die.
ayahs.clear: Then, after that, you will die.
ayahs.kemenag: Kemudian, sesudah itu, sesungguhnya kamu sekalian benar-benar akan mati.

ayahs.arabic: ثُمَّ إِنَّكُمْ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ تُبْعَثُونَ
ayahs.sahih: Then indeed you, on the Day of Resurrection, will be resurrected.
ayahs.clear: Then, on the Day of Resurrection, you will be resurrected.
ayahs.kemenag: Kemudian, sesungguhnya kamu sekalian akan dibangkitkan (dari kuburmu) di hari kiamat.

ayahs.arabic: وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا فَوْقَكُمْ سَبْعَ طَرَآئِقَ وَمَا كُنَّا عَنِ ٱلْخَلْقِ غَٰفِلِينَ
ayahs.sahih: And We have created above you seven layered heavens, and never have We been of [Our] creation unaware.
ayahs.clear: We created above you seven pathways, and We are never heedless of the creation.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan sesungguhnya Kami telah menciptakan di atas kamu tujuh buah jalan (tujuh buah langit); dan Kami tidaklah lengah terhadap ciptaan (Kami).

ayahs.arabic: وَأَنزَلْنَا مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءًۢ بِقَدَرٍۢ فَأَسْكَنَّٰهُ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ۖ وَإِنَّا عَلَىٰ ذَهَابٍۭ بِهِۦ لَقَٰدِرُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And We have sent down rain from the sky in a measured amount and settled it in the earth. And indeed, We are Able to take it away.
ayahs.clear: And We sent down water from the sky in proper quantity, and settled it in the ground, and We are Able to take it away.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan Kami turunkan air dari langit menurut suatu ukuran; lalu Kami jadikan air itu menetap di bumi, dan sesungguhnya Kami benar-benar berkuasa menghilangkannya.

ayahs.arabic: فَأَنشَأْنَا لَكُم بِهِۦ جَنَّٰتٍۢ مِّن نَّخِيلٍۢ وَأَعْنَٰبٍۢ لَّكُمْ فِيهَا فَوَٰكِهُ كَثِيرَةٌۭ وَمِنْهَا تَأْكُلُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And We brought forth for you thereby gardens of palm trees and grapevines in which for you are abundant fruits and from which you eat.
ayahs.clear: With it We produce for you gardens of palms and vines, yielding abundant fruit for you to eat.
ayahs.kemenag: Lalu dengan air itu, Kami tumbuhkan untuk kamu kebun-kebun kurma dan anggur; di dalam kebun-kebun itu kamu peroleh buah-buahan yang banyak dan sebahagian dari buah-buahan itu kamu makan,

ayahs.arabic: وَشَجَرَةًۭ تَخْرُجُ مِن طُورِ سَيْنَآءَ تَنۢبُتُ بِٱلدُّهْنِ وَصِبْغٍۢ لِّلْءَاكِلِينَ
ayahs.sahih: And [We brought forth] a tree issuing from Mount Sinai which produces oil and food for those who eat.
ayahs.clear: And a tree springing out of Mount Sinai, producing oil, and seasoning for those who eat.
ayahs.kemenag: dan pohon kayu keluar dari Thursina (pohon zaitun), yang menghasilkan minyak, dan pemakan makanan bagi orang-orang yang makan.

ayahs.arabic: وَإِنَّ لَكُمْ فِى ٱلْأَنْعَٰمِ لَعِبْرَةًۭ ۖ نُّسْقِيكُم مِّمَّا فِى بُطُونِهَا وَلَكُمْ فِيهَا مَنَٰفِعُ كَثِيرَةٌۭ وَمِنْهَا تَأْكُلُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And indeed, for you in livestock is a lesson. We give you drink from that which is in their bellies, and for you in them are numerous benefits, and from them you eat.
ayahs.clear: And there is a lesson for you in livestock: We give you to drink from what is in their bellies, and you have many benefits in them, and from them you eat.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan sesungguhnya pada binatang-binatang ternak, benar-benar terdapat pelajaran yang penting bagi kamu, Kami memberi minum kamu dari air susu yang ada dalam perutnya, dan (juga) pada binatang-binatang ternak itu terdapat faedah yang banyak untuk kamu, dan sebagian daripadanya kamu makan,

ayahs.arabic: وَعَلَيْهَا وَعَلَى ٱلْفُلْكِ تُحْمَلُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And upon them and on ships you are carried.
ayahs.clear: And on them, and on the ships, you are transported.
ayahs.kemenag: dan di atas punggung binatang-binatang ternak itu dan (juga) di atas perahu-perahu kamu diangkut.

ayahs.arabic: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا نُوحًا إِلَىٰ قَوْمِهِۦ فَقَالَ يَٰقَوْمِ ٱعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ مَا لَكُم مِّنْ إِلَٰهٍ غَيْرُهُۥٓ ۖ أَفَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And We had certainly sent Noah to his people, and he said, "O my people, worship Allah; you have no deity other than Him; then will you not fear Him?"
ayahs.clear: We sent Noah to his people. He said, “O my people, worship God, you have no deity other than Him. Will you not take heed?”
ayahs.kemenag: Dan sesungguhnya Kami telah mengutus Nuh kepada kaumnya, lalu ia berkata: "Hai kaumku, sembahlah oleh kamu Allah, (karena) sekali-kali tidak ada Tuhan bagimu selain Dia. Maka mengapa kamu tidak bertakwa (kepada-Nya)?"

ayahs.arabic: فَقَالَ ٱلْمَلَؤُا۟ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِن قَوْمِهِۦ مَا هَٰذَآ إِلَّا بَشَرٌۭ مِّثْلُكُمْ يُرِيدُ أَن يَتَفَضَّلَ عَلَيْكُمْ وَلَوْ شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ لَأَنزَلَ مَلَٰٓئِكَةًۭ مَّا سَمِعْنَا بِهَٰذَا فِىٓ ءَابَآئِنَا ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
ayahs.sahih: But the eminent among those who disbelieved from his people said, "This is not but a man like yourselves who wishes to take precedence over you; and if Allah had willed [to send a messenger], He would have sent down angels. We have not heard of this among our forefathers.
ayahs.clear: But the notables of his people, who disbelieved, said, “This is nothing but a human like you, who wants to gain superiority over you. Had God willed, He would have sent down angels. We never heard of this from our forefathers of old.
ayahs.kemenag: Maka pemuka-pemuka orang yang kafir di antara kaumnya menjawab: "Orang ini tidak lain hanyalah manusia seperti kamu, yang bermaksud hendak menjadi seorang yang lebih tinggi dari kamu. Dan kalau Allah menghendaki, tentu Dia mengutus beberapa orang malaikat. Belum pernah kami mendengar (seruan yang seperti) ini pada masa nenek moyang kami yang dahulu.

ayahs.arabic: إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا رَجُلٌۢ بِهِۦ جِنَّةٌۭ فَتَرَبَّصُوا۟ بِهِۦ حَتَّىٰ حِينٍۢ
ayahs.sahih: He is not but a man possessed with madness, so wait concerning him for a time."
ayahs.clear: He is nothing but a man possessed. Just ignore him for a while.”
ayahs.kemenag: la tidak lain hanyalah seorang laki-laki yang berpenyakit gila, maka tunggulah (sabarlah) terhadapnya sampai suatu waktu".

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ ٱنصُرْنِى بِمَا كَذَّبُونِ
ayahs.sahih: [Noah] said, "My Lord, support me because they have denied me."
ayahs.clear: He said, “My Lord, help me, for they have rejected me.”
ayahs.kemenag: Nuh berdoa: "Ya Tuhanku, tolonglah aku, karena mereka mendustakan aku".

ayahs.arabic: فَأَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَيْهِ أَنِ ٱصْنَعِ ٱلْفُلْكَ بِأَعْيُنِنَا وَوَحْيِنَا فَإِذَا جَآءَ أَمْرُنَا وَفَارَ ٱلتَّنُّورُ ۙ فَٱسْلُكْ فِيهَا مِن كُلٍّۢ زَوْجَيْنِ ٱثْنَيْنِ وَأَهْلَكَ إِلَّا مَن سَبَقَ عَلَيْهِ ٱلْقَوْلُ مِنْهُمْ ۖ وَلَا تُخَٰطِبْنِى فِى ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوٓا۟ ۖ إِنَّهُم مُّغْرَقُونَ
ayahs.sahih: So We inspired to him, "Construct the ship under Our observation, and Our inspiration, and when Our command comes and the oven overflows, put into the ship from each [creature] two mates and your family, except those for whom the decree [of destruction] has proceeded. And do not address Me concerning those who have wronged; indeed, they are to be drowned.
ayahs.clear: So We inspired him: “Build the Ark under Our observation and by Our inspiration. And when Our decree comes to pass, and the oven boils over, load into it two pairs of every kind, together with your family, except those of them against whom the word has already been pronounced. And do not speak to me concerning those who did wrong; for they are to be drowned.”
ayahs.kemenag: Lalu Kami wahyukan kepadanya: "Buatlah bahtera di bawah penilikan dan petunjuk Kami, maka apabila perintah Kami telah datang dan tanur telah memancarkan air, maka masukkanlah ke dalam bahtera itu sepasang dari tiap-tiap (jenis), dan (juga) keluargamu, kecuali orang yang telah lebih dahulu ditetapkan (akan ditimpa azab) di antara mereka. Dan janganlah kamu bicarakan dengan Aku tentang orang-orang yang zalim, karena sesungguhnya mereka itu akan ditenggelamkan.

ayahs.arabic: فَإِذَا ٱسْتَوَيْتَ أَنتَ وَمَن مَّعَكَ عَلَى ٱلْفُلْكِ فَقُلِ ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِى نَجَّىٰنَا مِنَ ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ
ayahs.sahih: And when you have boarded the ship, you and those with you, then say, 'Praise to Allah who has saved us from the wrongdoing people.'
ayahs.clear: Then, when you and those with you are settled in the Ark, say, “Praise be to God, who has saved us from the wrongdoing people.”
ayahs.kemenag: Apabila kamu dan orang-orang yang bersamamu telah berada di atas bahtera itu, maka ucapkanlah: "Segala puji bagi Allah yang telah menyelamatkan kami dari orang-orang yang zalim".

ayahs.arabic: وَقُل رَّبِّ أَنزِلْنِى مُنزَلًۭا مُّبَارَكًۭا وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ ٱلْمُنزِلِينَ
ayahs.sahih: And say, 'My Lord, let me land at a blessed landing place, and You are the best to accommodate [us].' "
ayahs.clear: And say, “My Lord, land me with a blessed landing, as you are the best of transporters.”
ayahs.kemenag: Dan berdoalah: Ya Tuhanku, tempatkanlah aku pada tempat yang diberkati, dan Engkau adalah sebaik-baik Yang memberi tempat".

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَٰتٍۢ وَإِن كُنَّا لَمُبْتَلِينَ
ayahs.sahih: Indeed in that are signs, and indeed, We are ever testing [Our servants].
ayahs.clear: Surely in that are signs. We are always testing.
ayahs.kemenag: Sesungguhnya pada (kejadian) itu benar-benar terdapat beberapa tanda (kebesaran Allah), dan sesungguhnya Kami menimpakan azab (kepada kaum Nuh itu).

ayahs.arabic: ثُمَّ أَنشَأْنَا مِنۢ بَعْدِهِمْ قَرْنًا ءَاخَرِينَ
ayahs.sahih: Then We produced after them a generation of others.
ayahs.clear: Then, after them, We established another generation.
ayahs.kemenag: Kemudian, Kami jadikan sesudah mereka umat yang lain.

ayahs.arabic: فَأَرْسَلْنَا فِيهِمْ رَسُولًۭا مِّنْهُمْ أَنِ ٱعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ مَا لَكُم مِّنْ إِلَٰهٍ غَيْرُهُۥٓ ۖ أَفَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And We sent among them a messenger from themselves, [saying], "Worship Allah; you have no deity other than Him; then will you not fear Him?"
ayahs.clear: And We sent among them a messenger from themselves: “Serve God. You have no god other than Him. Will you not be cautious?”
ayahs.kemenag: Lalu Kami utus kepada mereka, seorang rasul dari kalangan mereka sendiri (yang berkata): "Sembahlah Allah oleh kamu sekalian, sekali-kali tidak ada Tuhan selain daripada-Nya. Maka mengapa kamu tidak bertakwa (kepada-Nya).

ayahs.arabic: وَقَالَ ٱلْمَلَأُ مِن قَوْمِهِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ وَكَذَّبُوا۟ بِلِقَآءِ ٱلْءَاخِرَةِ وَأَتْرَفْنَٰهُمْ فِى ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا مَا هَٰذَآ إِلَّا بَشَرٌۭ مِّثْلُكُمْ يَأْكُلُ مِمَّا تَأْكُلُونَ مِنْهُ وَيَشْرَبُ مِمَّا تَشْرَبُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And the eminent among his people who disbelieved and denied the meeting of the Hereafter while We had given them luxury in the worldly life said, "This is not but a man like yourselves. He eats of that from which you eat and drinks of what you drink.
ayahs.clear: But the dignitaries of his people, those who disbelieved and denied the meeting of the Hereafter, and We had indulged them in the present life, said, “This is nothing but a human like you; he eats what you eat, and he drinks what you drink.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan berkatalah pemuka-pemuka yang kafir di antara kaumnya dan yang mendustakan akan menemui hari akhirat (kelak) dan yang telah Kami mewahkan mereka dalam kehidupan di dunia: "(Orang) ini tidak lain hanyalah manusia seperti kamu, dia makan dari apa yang kamu makan, dan meminum dari apa yang kamu minum.

ayahs.arabic: وَلَئِنْ أَطَعْتُم بَشَرًۭا مِّثْلَكُمْ إِنَّكُمْ إِذًۭا لَّخَٰسِرُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And if you should obey a man like yourselves, indeed, you would then be losers.
ayahs.clear: If you obey a human being like yourselves, then you will be losers.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan sesungguhnya jika kamu sekalian mentaati manusia yang seperti kamu, niscaya bila demikian, kamu benar-benar (menjadi) orang-orang yang merugi.

ayahs.arabic: أَيَعِدُكُمْ أَنَّكُمْ إِذَا مِتُّمْ وَكُنتُمْ تُرَابًۭا وَعِظَٰمًا أَنَّكُم مُّخْرَجُونَ
ayahs.sahih: Does he promise you that when you have died and become dust and bones that you will be brought forth [once more]?
ayahs.clear: Does he promise you that when you have died and become dust and bones, you will be brought out?
ayahs.kemenag: Apakah ia menjanjikan kepada kamu sekalian, bahwa bila kamu telah mati dan telah menjadi tanah dan tulang belulang, kamu sesungguhnya akan dikeluarkan (dari kuburmu)?

ayahs.arabic: ۞ هَيْهَاتَ هَيْهَاتَ لِمَا تُوعَدُونَ
ayahs.sahih: How far, how far, is that which you are promised.
ayahs.clear: Farfetched, farfetched is what you are promised.
ayahs.kemenag: jauh, jauh sekali (dari kebenaran) apa yang diancamkan kepada kamu itu,

ayahs.arabic: إِنْ هِىَ إِلَّا حَيَاتُنَا ٱلدُّنْيَا نَمُوتُ وَنَحْيَا وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمَبْعُوثِينَ
ayahs.sahih: Life is not but our worldly life - we die and live, but we will not be resurrected.
ayahs.clear: There is nothing but our life in this world. We die, and we live, and we are not resurrected.
ayahs.kemenag: kehidupan itu tidak lain hanyalah kehidupan kita di dunia ini, kita mati dan kita hidup dan sekali-kali tidak akan dibangkitkan lagi,

ayahs.arabic: إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا رَجُلٌ ٱفْتَرَىٰ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ كَذِبًۭا وَمَا نَحْنُ لَهُۥ بِمُؤْمِنِينَ
ayahs.sahih: He is not but a man who has invented a lie about Allah, and we will not believe him."
ayahs.clear: He is nothing but a man, making up lies about God. We have no faith in him.”
ayahs.kemenag: Ia tidak lain hanyalah seorang yang mengada-adakan kebohongan terhadap Allah, dan kami sekali-kali tidak akan beriman kepadanya".

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ ٱنصُرْنِى بِمَا كَذَّبُونِ
ayahs.sahih: He said, "My Lord, support me because they have denied me."
ayahs.clear: He said, “My Lord, help me, for they have rejected me.”
ayahs.kemenag: Rasul itu berdoa: "Ya Tuhanku, tolonglah aku karena mereka mendustakanku".

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ عَمَّا قَلِيلٍۢ لَّيُصْبِحُنَّ نَٰدِمِينَ
ayahs.sahih: [Allah] said, "After a little, they will surely become regretful."
ayahs.clear: He said, “Soon they will be filled with regret.”
ayahs.kemenag: Allah berfirman: "Dalam sedikit waktu lagi pasti mereka akan menjadi orang-orang yang menyesal".

ayahs.arabic: فَأَخَذَتْهُمُ ٱلصَّيْحَةُ بِٱلْحَقِّ فَجَعَلْنَٰهُمْ غُثَآءًۭ ۚ فَبُعْدًۭا لِّلْقَوْمِ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ
ayahs.sahih: So the shriek seized them in truth, and We made them as [plant] stubble. Then away with the wrongdoing people.
ayahs.clear: Then the Blast struck them, justifiably, and We turned them into scum. So away with the wicked people.
ayahs.kemenag: Maka dimusnahkanlah mereka oleh suara yang mengguntur dengan hak dan Kami jadikan mereka (sebagai) sampah banjir maka kebinasaanlah bagi orang-orang yang zalim itu.

ayahs.arabic: ثُمَّ أَنشَأْنَا مِنۢ بَعْدِهِمْ قُرُونًا ءَاخَرِينَ
ayahs.sahih: Then We produced after them other generations.
ayahs.clear: Then, after them, We raised other generations.
ayahs.kemenag: Kemudian Kami ciptakan sesudah mereka umat-umat yang lain.

ayahs.arabic: مَا تَسْبِقُ مِنْ أُمَّةٍ أَجَلَهَا وَمَا يَسْتَـْٔخِرُونَ
ayahs.sahih: No nation will precede its time [of termination], nor will they remain [thereafter].
ayahs.clear: No nation can advance its time, nor can they postpone it.
ayahs.kemenag: Tidak (dapat) sesuatu umatpun mendahului ajalnya, dan tidak (dapat pula) mereka terlambat (dari ajalnya itu).

ayahs.arabic: ثُمَّ أَرْسَلْنَا رُسُلَنَا تَتْرَا ۖ كُلَّ مَا جَآءَ أُمَّةًۭ رَّسُولُهَا كَذَّبُوهُ ۚ فَأَتْبَعْنَا بَعْضَهُم بَعْضًۭا وَجَعَلْنَٰهُمْ أَحَادِيثَ ۚ فَبُعْدًۭا لِّقَوْمٍۢ لَّا يُؤْمِنُونَ
ayahs.sahih: Then We sent Our messengers in succession. Every time there came to a nation its messenger, they denied him, so We made them follow one another [to destruction], and We made them narrations. So away with a people who do not believe.
ayahs.clear: Then We sent Our messengers in succession. Every time a messenger came to his community, they called him a liar. So We made them follow one another, and made them history. So away with a people who do not believe.
ayahs.kemenag: Kemudian Kami utus (kepada umat-umat itu) rasul-rasul Kami berturut-turut. Tiap-tiap seorang rasul datang kepada umatnya, umat itu mendustakannya, maka Kami perikutkan sebagian mereka dengan sebagian yang lain. Dan Kami jadikan mereka buah tutur (manusia), maka kebinasaanlah bagi orang-orang yang tidak beriman.

ayahs.arabic: ثُمَّ أَرْسَلْنَا مُوسَىٰ وَأَخَاهُ هَٰرُونَ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا وَسُلْطَٰنٍۢ مُّبِينٍ
ayahs.sahih: Then We sent Moses and his brother Aaron with Our signs and a clear authority
ayahs.clear: Then We sent Moses and his brother Aaron, with Our signs and a clear authority.
ayahs.kemenag: Kemudian Kami utus Musa dan saudaranya Harun dengan membawa tanda-tanda (Kebesaran) Kami, dan bukti yang nyata,

ayahs.arabic: إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ وَمَلَإِي۟هِۦ فَٱسْتَكْبَرُوا۟ وَكَانُوا۟ قَوْمًا عَالِينَ
ayahs.sahih: To Pharaoh and his establishment, but they were arrogant and were a haughty people.
ayahs.clear: To Pharaoh and his nobles, but they turned arrogant. They were oppressive people.
ayahs.kemenag: kepada Fir'aun dan pembesar-pembesar kaumnya, maka mereka ini takbur dan mereka adalah orang-orang yang sombong.

ayahs.arabic: فَقَالُوٓا۟ أَنُؤْمِنُ لِبَشَرَيْنِ مِثْلِنَا وَقَوْمُهُمَا لَنَا عَٰبِدُونَ
ayahs.sahih: They said, "Should we believe two men like ourselves while their people are for us in servitude?"
ayahs.clear: They said, “Are we to believe in two mortals like us, and their people are our slaves?”
ayahs.kemenag: Dan mereka berkata: "Apakah (patut) kita percaya kepada dua orang manusia seperti kita (juga), padahal kaum mereka (Bani Israil) adalah orang-orang yang menghambakan diri kepada kita?"

ayahs.arabic: فَكَذَّبُوهُمَا فَكَانُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلْمُهْلَكِينَ
ayahs.sahih: So they denied them and were of those destroyed.
ayahs.clear: So they called them liars, and thus were among those destroyed.
ayahs.kemenag: Maka (tetaplah) mereka mendustakan keduanya, sebab itu mereka adalah termasuk orang-orang yang dibinasakan.

ayahs.arabic: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا مُوسَى ٱلْكِتَٰبَ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَهْتَدُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And We certainly gave Moses the Scripture that perhaps they would be guided.
ayahs.clear: And We gave Moses the Scripture, that they may be guided.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan sesungguhnya telah Kami berikan Al Kitab (Taurat) kepada Musa, agar mereka (Bani Israil) mendapat petunjuk.

ayahs.arabic: وَجَعَلْنَا ٱبْنَ مَرْيَمَ وَأُمَّهُۥٓ ءَايَةًۭ وَءَاوَيْنَٰهُمَآ إِلَىٰ رَبْوَةٍۢ ذَاتِ قَرَارٍۢ وَمَعِينٍۢ
ayahs.sahih: And We made the son of Mary and his mother a sign and sheltered them within a high ground having level [areas] and flowing water.
ayahs.clear: And We made Mary’s son and his mother a sign, and We sheltered them on high ground with security and flowing springs.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan telah Kami jadikan (Isa) putera Maryam beserta ibunya suatu bukti yang nyata bagi (kekuasaan Kami), dan Kami melindungi mereka di suatu tanah tinggi yang datar yang banyak terdapat padang-padang rumput dan sumber-sumber air bersih yang mengalir.

ayahs.arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلرُّسُلُ كُلُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلطَّيِّبَٰتِ وَٱعْمَلُوا۟ صَٰلِحًا ۖ إِنِّى بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ عَلِيمٌۭ
ayahs.sahih: [Allah said], "O messengers, eat from the good foods and work righteousness. Indeed, I, of what you do, am Knowing.
ayahs.clear: O messengers, eat of the good things, and act with integrity. I am aware of what you do.
ayahs.kemenag: Hai rasul-rasul, makanlah dari makanan yang baik-baik, dan kerjakanlah amal yang saleh. Sesungguhnya Aku Maha Mengetahui apa yang kamu kerjakan.

ayahs.arabic: وَإِنَّ هَٰذِهِۦٓ أُمَّتُكُمْ أُمَّةًۭ وَٰحِدَةًۭ وَأَنَا۠ رَبُّكُمْ فَٱتَّقُونِ
ayahs.sahih: And indeed this, your religion, is one religion, and I am your Lord, so fear Me."
ayahs.clear: This nation of yours is one nation, and I am your Lord, so fear Me.
ayahs.kemenag: Sesungguhnya (agama tauhid) ini, adalah agama kamu semua, agama yang satu, dan Aku adalah Tuhanmu, maka bertakwalah kepada-Ku.

ayahs.arabic: فَتَقَطَّعُوٓا۟ أَمْرَهُم بَيْنَهُمْ زُبُرًۭا ۖ كُلُّ حِزْبٍۭ بِمَا لَدَيْهِمْ فَرِحُونَ
ayahs.sahih: But the people divided their religion among them into sects - each faction, in what it has, rejoicing.
ayahs.clear: But they tore themselves into sects; each party happy with what they have.
ayahs.kemenag: Kemudian mereka (pengikut-pengikut rasul itu) menjadikan agama mereka terpecah belah menjadi beberapa pecahan. Tiap-tiap golongan merasa bangga dengan apa yang ada pada sisi mereka (masing-masing).

ayahs.arabic: فَذَرْهُمْ فِى غَمْرَتِهِمْ حَتَّىٰ حِينٍ
ayahs.sahih: So leave them in their confusion for a time.
ayahs.clear: So leave them in their bewilderment until a time.
ayahs.kemenag: Maka biarkanlah mereka dalam kesesatannya sampai suatu waktu.

ayahs.arabic: أَيَحْسَبُونَ أَنَّمَا نُمِدُّهُم بِهِۦ مِن مَّالٍۢ وَبَنِينَ
ayahs.sahih: Do they think that what We extend to them of wealth and children
ayahs.clear: Do they assume that, in furnishing them with wealth and children.
ayahs.kemenag: Apakah mereka mengira bahwa harta dan anak-anak yang Kami berikan kepada mereka itu (berarti bahwa),

ayahs.arabic: نُسَارِعُ لَهُمْ فِى ٱلْخَيْرَٰتِ ۚ بَل لَّا يَشْعُرُونَ
ayahs.sahih: Is [because] We hasten for them good things? Rather, they do not perceive.
ayahs.clear: We race to give them the good things? In fact, they have no idea.
ayahs.kemenag: Kami bersegera memberikan kebaikan-kebaikan kepada mereka? Tidak, sebenarnya mereka tidak sadar.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ هُم مِّنْ خَشْيَةِ رَبِّهِم مُّشْفِقُونَ
ayahs.sahih: Indeed, they who are apprehensive from fear of their Lord
ayahs.clear: Those who, from awe of their Lord, are fearful.
ayahs.kemenag: Sesungguhnya orang-orang yang berhati-hati karena takut akan (azab) Tuhan mereka,

ayahs.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُم بِـَٔايَٰتِ رَبِّهِمْ يُؤْمِنُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And they who believe in the signs of their Lord
ayahs.clear: And those who believe in their Lord’s Verses.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan orang-orang yang beriman dengan ayat-ayat Tuhan mereka,

ayahs.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُم بِرَبِّهِمْ لَا يُشْرِكُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And they who do not associate anything with their Lord
ayahs.clear: And those who associate no partners with their Lord.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan orang-orang yang tidak mempersekutukan dengan Tuhan mereka (sesuatu apapun),

ayahs.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ يُؤْتُونَ مَآ ءَاتَوا۟ وَّقُلُوبُهُمْ وَجِلَةٌ أَنَّهُمْ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِمْ رَٰجِعُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And they who give what they give while their hearts are fearful because they will be returning to their Lord -
ayahs.clear: And those who give what they give, while their hearts quake, knowing that to their Lord they will return.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan orang-orang yang memberikan apa yang telah mereka berikan, dengan hati yang takut, (karena mereka tahu bahwa) sesungguhnya mereka akan kembali kepada Tuhan mereka,

ayahs.arabic: أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ يُسَٰرِعُونَ فِى ٱلْخَيْرَٰتِ وَهُمْ لَهَا سَٰبِقُونَ
ayahs.sahih: It is those who hasten to good deeds, and they outstrip [others] therein.
ayahs.clear: It is they who race towards goodness. It is they who will reach it first.
ayahs.kemenag: mereka itu bersegera untuk mendapat kebaikan-kebaikan, dan merekalah orang-orang yang segera memperolehnya.

ayahs.arabic: وَلَا نُكَلِّفُ نَفْسًا إِلَّا وُسْعَهَا ۖ وَلَدَيْنَا كِتَٰبٌۭ يَنطِقُ بِٱلْحَقِّ ۚ وَهُمْ لَا يُظْلَمُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And We charge no soul except [with that within] its capacity, and with Us is a record which speaks with truth; and they will not be wronged.
ayahs.clear: We never burden any soul beyond its capacity. And with Us is a record that tells the truth, and they will not be wronged.
ayahs.kemenag: Kami tiada membebani seseorang melainkan menurut kesanggupannya, dan pada sisi Kami ada suatu kitab yang membicarakan kebenaran, dan mereka tidak dianiaya.

ayahs.arabic: بَلْ قُلُوبُهُمْ فِى غَمْرَةٍۢ مِّنْ هَٰذَا وَلَهُمْ أَعْمَٰلٌۭ مِّن دُونِ ذَٰلِكَ هُمْ لَهَا عَٰمِلُونَ
ayahs.sahih: But their hearts are covered with confusion over this, and they have [evil] deeds besides disbelief which they are doing,
ayahs.clear: But their hearts are puzzled because of this; and they have deeds that do not conform to this, which they continue to perpetrate.
ayahs.kemenag: Tetapi hati orang-orang kafir itu dalam kesesatan dari (memahami kenyataan) ini, dan mereka banyak mengerjakan perbuatan-perbuatan (buruk) selain daripada itu, mereka tetap mengerjakannya.

ayahs.arabic: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَآ أَخَذْنَا مُتْرَفِيهِم بِٱلْعَذَابِ إِذَا هُمْ يَجْـَٔرُونَ
ayahs.sahih: Until when We seize their affluent ones with punishment, at once they are crying [to Allah] for help.
ayahs.clear: Until, when We seize the decadent among them with torment, they begin to groan.
ayahs.kemenag: Hingga apabila Kami timpakan azab, kepada orang-orang yang hidup mewah di antara mereka, dengan serta merta mereka memekik minta tolong.

ayahs.arabic: لَا تَجْـَٔرُوا۟ ٱلْيَوْمَ ۖ إِنَّكُم مِّنَّا لَا تُنصَرُونَ
ayahs.sahih: Do not cry out today. Indeed, by Us you will not be helped.
ayahs.clear: Do not groan today. You will receive no help from Us.
ayahs.kemenag: Janganlah kamu memekik minta tolong pada hari ini. Sesungguhnya kamu tiada akan mendapat pertolongan dari Kami.

ayahs.arabic: قَدْ كَانَتْ ءَايَٰتِى تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْكُمْ فَكُنتُمْ عَلَىٰٓ أَعْقَٰبِكُمْ تَنكِصُونَ
ayahs.sahih: My verses had already been recited to you, but you were turning back on your heels
ayahs.clear: My Verses were recited to you, but you turned back on your heels.
ayahs.kemenag: Sesungguhnya ayat-ayat-Ku (Al Quran) selalu dibacakan kepada kamu sekalian, maka kamu selalu berpaling ke belakang,

ayahs.arabic: مُسْتَكْبِرِينَ بِهِۦ سَٰمِرًۭا تَهْجُرُونَ
ayahs.sahih: In arrogance regarding it, conversing by night, speaking evil.
ayahs.clear: Arrogant towards it—talked nonsense about it—disregarded it.
ayahs.kemenag: dengan menyombongkan diri terhadap Al Quran itu dan mengucapkan perkataan-perkataan keji terhadapnya di waktu kamu bercakap-cakap di malam hari.

ayahs.arabic: أَفَلَمْ يَدَّبَّرُوا۟ ٱلْقَوْلَ أَمْ جَآءَهُم مَّا لَمْ يَأْتِ ءَابَآءَهُمُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
ayahs.sahih: Then have they not reflected over the Qur'an, or has there come to them that which had not come to their forefathers?
ayahs.clear: Have they not pondered the Word? Or has there come to them what came not to their forefathers of old?
ayahs.kemenag: Maka apakah mereka tidak memperhatikan perkataan (Kami), atau apakah telah datang kepada mereka apa yang tidak pernah datang kepada nenek moyang mereka dahulu?

ayahs.arabic: أَمْ لَمْ يَعْرِفُوا۟ رَسُولَهُمْ فَهُمْ لَهُۥ مُنكِرُونَ
ayahs.sahih: Or did they not know their Messenger, so they are toward him disacknowledging?
ayahs.clear: Or is it that they did not recognize their messenger, so they are denying him?
ayahs.kemenag: Ataukah mereka tidak mengenal rasul mereka, karena itu mereka memungkirinya?

ayahs.arabic: أَمْ يَقُولُونَ بِهِۦ جِنَّةٌۢ ۚ بَلْ جَآءَهُم بِٱلْحَقِّ وَأَكْثَرُهُمْ لِلْحَقِّ كَٰرِهُونَ
ayahs.sahih: Or do they say, "In him is madness?" Rather, he brought them the truth, but most of them, to the truth, are averse.
ayahs.clear: Or do they say, “He is possessed?” In fact, he brought them the truth, but most of them hate the truth.
ayahs.kemenag: Atau (apakah patut) mereka berkata: "Padanya (Muhammad) ada penyakit gila". Sebenarnya dia telah membawa kebenaran kepada mereka, dan kebanyakan mereka benci kepada kebenaran itu.

ayahs.arabic: وَلَوِ ٱتَّبَعَ ٱلْحَقُّ أَهْوَآءَهُمْ لَفَسَدَتِ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتُ وَٱلْأَرْضُ وَمَن فِيهِنَّ ۚ بَلْ أَتَيْنَٰهُم بِذِكْرِهِمْ فَهُمْ عَن ذِكْرِهِم مُّعْرِضُونَ
ayahs.sahih: But if the Truth had followed their inclinations, the heavens and the earth and whoever is in them would have been ruined. Rather, We have brought them their message, but they, from their message, are turning away.
ayahs.clear: If the truth conformed to their desires, the heavens, the earth, and everyone in them would have gone to ruin. In fact, We have given them their message, but they keep avoiding their message.
ayahs.kemenag: Andaikata kebenaran itu menuruti hawa nafsu mereka, pasti binasalah langit dan bumi ini, dan semua yang ada di dalamnya. Sebenarnya Kami telah mendatangkan kepada mereka kebanggaan (Al Quran) mereka tetapi mereka berpaling dari kebanggaan itu.

ayahs.arabic: أَمْ تَسْـَٔلُهُمْ خَرْجًۭا فَخَرَاجُ رَبِّكَ خَيْرٌۭ ۖ وَهُوَ خَيْرُ ٱلرَّٰزِقِينَ
ayahs.sahih: Or do you, [O Muhammad], ask them for payment? But the reward of your Lord is best, and He is the best of providers.
ayahs.clear: Or are you asking them for a payment? The revenue from your Lord is better, and He is the Best of providers.
ayahs.kemenag: Atau kamu meminta upah kepada mereka?", maka upah dari Tuhanmu adalah lebih baik, dan Dia adalah Pemberi rezeki Yang Paling Baik.

ayahs.arabic: وَإِنَّكَ لَتَدْعُوهُمْ إِلَىٰ صِرَٰطٍۢ مُّسْتَقِيمٍۢ
ayahs.sahih: And indeed, you invite them to a straight path.
ayahs.clear: You are inviting them to a straight path.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan sesungguhnya kamu benar-benar menyeru mereka kepada jalan yang lurus.

ayahs.arabic: وَإِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱلْءَاخِرَةِ عَنِ ٱلصِّرَٰطِ لَنَٰكِبُونَ
ayahs.sahih: But indeed, those who do not believe in the Hereafter are deviating from the path.
ayahs.clear: But those who do not believe in the Hereafter are swerving from the path.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan sesungguhnya orang-orang yang tidak beriman kepada negeri akhirat benar-benar menyimpang dari jalan (yang lurus).

ayahs.arabic: ۞ وَلَوْ رَحِمْنَٰهُمْ وَكَشَفْنَا مَا بِهِم مِّن ضُرٍّۢ لَّلَجُّوا۟ فِى طُغْيَٰنِهِمْ يَعْمَهُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And even if We gave them mercy and removed what was upon them of affliction, they would persist in their transgression, wandering blindly.
ayahs.clear: Even if We had mercy on them, and relieved their problems, they would still blindly persist in their defiance.
ayahs.kemenag: Andaikata mereka Kami belas kasihani, dan Kami lenyapkan kemudharatan yang mereka alami, benar-benar mereka akan terus menerus terombang-ambing dalam keterlaluan mereka.

ayahs.arabic: وَلَقَدْ أَخَذْنَٰهُم بِٱلْعَذَابِ فَمَا ٱسْتَكَانُوا۟ لِرَبِّهِمْ وَمَا يَتَضَرَّعُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And We had gripped them with suffering [as a warning], but they did not yield to their Lord, nor did they humbly supplicate, [and will continue thus]
ayahs.clear: We have already gripped them with suffering, but they did not surrender to their Lord, nor did they humble themselves.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan sesungguhnya Kami telah pernah menimpakan azab kepada mereka, maka mereka tidak tunduk kepada Tuhan mereka, dan (juga) tidak memohon (kepada-Nya) dengan merendahkan diri.

ayahs.arabic: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا فَتَحْنَا عَلَيْهِم بَابًۭا ذَا عَذَابٍۢ شَدِيدٍ إِذَا هُمْ فِيهِ مُبْلِسُونَ
ayahs.sahih: Until when We have opened before them a door of severe punishment, immediately they will be therein in despair.
ayahs.clear: Until, when We have opened before them a gate of intense agony, at once they will despair.
ayahs.kemenag: Hingga apabila Kami bukakan untuk mereka suatu pintu tempat azab yang amat sangat (di waktu itulah) tiba-tiba mereka menjadi putus asa.

ayahs.arabic: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَنشَأَ لَكُمُ ٱلسَّمْعَ وَٱلْأَبْصَٰرَ وَٱلْأَفْـِٔدَةَ ۚ قَلِيلًۭا مَّا تَشْكُرُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And it is He who produced for you hearing and vision and hearts; little are you grateful.
ayahs.clear: It is He who produced for you the hearing, and the eyesight, and the feelings. But little gratitude you show.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan Dialah yang telah menciptakan bagi kamu sekalian, pendengaran, penglihatan dan hati. Amat sedikitlah kamu bersyukur.

ayahs.arabic: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِى ذَرَأَكُمْ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَإِلَيْهِ تُحْشَرُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And it is He who has multiplied you throughout the earth, and to Him you will be gathered.
ayahs.clear: And it is He who multiplied you on earth, and to Him you will be gathered.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan Dialah yang menciptakan serta mengembang biakkan kamu di bumi ini dan kepada-Nya-lah kamu akan dihimpunkan.

ayahs.arabic: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِى يُحْىِۦ وَيُمِيتُ وَلَهُ ٱخْتِلَٰفُ ٱلَّيْلِ وَٱلنَّهَارِ ۚ أَفَلَا تَعْقِلُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And it is He who gives life and causes death, and His is the alternation of the night and the day. Then will you not reason?
ayahs.clear: And it is He who gives life and brings death, and to Him is the alternation of night and day. Do you not understand?
ayahs.kemenag: Dan Dialah yang menghidupkan dan mematikan, dan Dialah yang (mengatur) pertukaran malam dan siang. Maka apakah kamu tidak memahaminya?

ayahs.arabic: بَلْ قَالُوا۟ مِثْلَ مَا قَالَ ٱلْأَوَّلُونَ
ayahs.sahih: Rather, they say like what the former peoples said.
ayahs.clear: But they say the like of what the ancients said.
ayahs.kemenag: Sebenarnya mereka mengucapkan perkataan yang serupa dengan perkataan yang diucapkan oleh orang-orang dahulu kala.

ayahs.arabic: قَالُوٓا۟ أَءِذَا مِتْنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابًۭا وَعِظَٰمًا أَءِنَّا لَمَبْعُوثُونَ
ayahs.sahih: They said, "When we have died and become dust and bones, are we indeed to be resurrected?
ayahs.clear: They say, “After we have died, and become dust and bones, will we be resurrected?
ayahs.kemenag: Mereka berkata: "Apakah betul, apabila kami telah mati dan kami telah menjadi tanah dan tulang belulang, apakah sesungguhnya kami benar-benar akan dibangkitkan?

ayahs.arabic: لَقَدْ وُعِدْنَا نَحْنُ وَءَابَآؤُنَا هَٰذَا مِن قَبْلُ إِنْ هَٰذَآ إِلَّآ أَسَٰطِيرُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
ayahs.sahih: We have been promised this, we and our forefathers, before; this is not but legends of the former peoples."
ayahs.clear: We were promised this before—we and our ancestors—these are nothing but legends of the ancients.”
ayahs.kemenag: Sesungguhnya kami dan bapak-bapak kami telah diberi ancaman (dengan) ini dahulu, ini tidak lain hanyalah dongengan orang-orang dahulu kala!".

ayahs.arabic: قُل لِّمَنِ ٱلْأَرْضُ وَمَن فِيهَآ إِن كُنتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ
ayahs.sahih: Say, [O Muhammad], "To whom belongs the earth and whoever is in it, if you should know?"
ayahs.clear: Say, “To whom does the earth belong, and everyone in it, if you happen to know?”
ayahs.kemenag: Katakanlah: "Kepunyaan siapakah bumi ini, dan semua yang ada padanya, jika kamu mengetahui?"

ayahs.arabic: سَيَقُولُونَ لِلَّهِ ۚ قُلْ أَفَلَا تَذَكَّرُونَ
ayahs.sahih: They will say, "To Allah." Say, "Then will you not remember?"
ayahs.clear: They will say, “To God.” Say, “Will you not reflect?”
ayahs.kemenag: Mereka akan menjawab: "Kepunyaan Allah". Katakanlah: "Maka apakah kamu tidak ingat?"

ayahs.arabic: قُلْ مَن رَّبُّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ ٱلسَّبْعِ وَرَبُّ ٱلْعَرْشِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
ayahs.sahih: Say, "Who is Lord of the seven heavens and Lord of the Great Throne?"
ayahs.clear: Say, “Who is the Lord of the seven heavens, and Lord of the Splendid Throne?”
ayahs.kemenag: Katakanlah: "Siapakah Yang Empunya langit yang tujuh dan Yang Empunya 'Arsy yang besar?"

ayahs.arabic: سَيَقُولُونَ لِلَّهِ ۚ قُلْ أَفَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
ayahs.sahih: They will say, "[They belong] to Allah." Say, "Then will you not fear Him?"
ayahs.clear: They will say, “To God.” Say, “Will you not become righteous?”
ayahs.kemenag: Mereka akan menjawab: "Kepunyaan Allah". Katakanlah: "Maka apakah kamu tidak bertakwa?"

ayahs.arabic: قُلْ مَنۢ بِيَدِهِۦ مَلَكُوتُ كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ وَهُوَ يُجِيرُ وَلَا يُجَارُ عَلَيْهِ إِن كُنتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ
ayahs.sahih: Say, "In whose hand is the realm of all things - and He protects while none can protect against Him - if you should know?"
ayahs.clear: Say, “In whose hand is the dominion of all things, and He protects and cannot be protected from, if you happen to know?”
ayahs.kemenag: Katakanlah: "Siapakah yang di tangan-Nya berada kekuasaan atas segala sesuatu sedang Dia melindungi, tetapi tidak ada yang dapat dilindungi dari (azab)-Nya, jika kamu mengetahui?"

ayahs.arabic: سَيَقُولُونَ لِلَّهِ ۚ قُلْ فَأَنَّىٰ تُسْحَرُونَ
ayahs.sahih: They will say, "[All belongs] to Allah." Say, "Then how are you deluded?"
ayahs.clear: They will say, “To God.” Say, “Then are you bewitched?”
ayahs.kemenag: Mereka akan menjawab: "Kepunyaan Allah". Katakanlah: "(Kalau demikian), maka dari jalan manakah kamu ditipu?"

ayahs.arabic: بَلْ أَتَيْنَٰهُم بِٱلْحَقِّ وَإِنَّهُمْ لَكَٰذِبُونَ
ayahs.sahih: Rather, We have brought them the truth, and indeed they are liars.
ayahs.clear: In fact, We have given them the truth, and they are liars.
ayahs.kemenag: Sebenarnya Kami telah membawa kebenaran kepada mereka, dan sesungguhnya mereka benar-benar orang-orang yang berdusta.

ayahs.arabic: مَا ٱتَّخَذَ ٱللَّهُ مِن وَلَدٍۢ وَمَا كَانَ مَعَهُۥ مِنْ إِلَٰهٍ ۚ إِذًۭا لَّذَهَبَ كُلُّ إِلَٰهٍۭ بِمَا خَلَقَ وَلَعَلَا بَعْضُهُمْ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍۢ ۚ سُبْحَٰنَ ٱللَّهِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ
ayahs.sahih: Allah has not taken any son, nor has there ever been with Him any deity. [If there had been], then each deity would have taken what it created, and some of them would have sought to overcome others. Exalted is Allah above what they describe [concerning Him].
ayahs.clear: God has never begotten a son, nor is there any god besides Him. Otherwise, each god would have taken away what it has created, and some of them would have gained supremacy over others. Glory be to God, far beyond what they describe.
ayahs.kemenag: Allah sekali-kali tidak mempunyai anak, dan sekali-kali tidak ada tuhan (yang lain) beserta-Nya, kalau ada tuhan beserta-Nya, masing-masing tuhan itu akan membawa makhluk yang diciptakannya, dan sebagian dari tuhan-tuhan itu akan mengalahkan sebagian yang lain. Maha Suci Allah dari apa yang mereka sifatkan itu,

ayahs.arabic: عَٰلِمِ ٱلْغَيْبِ وَٱلشَّهَٰدَةِ فَتَعَٰلَىٰ عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ
ayahs.sahih: [He is] Knower of the unseen and the witnessed, so high is He above what they associate [with Him].
ayahs.clear: The Knower of the hidden and the manifest. He is exalted, far above what they associate.
ayahs.kemenag: Yang mengetahui semua yang ghaib dan semua yang nampak, maka Maha Tinggilah Dia dari apa yang mereka persekutukan.

ayahs.arabic: قُل رَّبِّ إِمَّا تُرِيَنِّى مَا يُوعَدُونَ
ayahs.sahih: Say, [O Muhammad], "My Lord, if You should show me that which they are promised,
ayahs.clear: Say, “My Lord, if You would show me what they are promised.
ayahs.kemenag: Katakanlah: "Ya Tuhanku, jika Engkau sungguh-sungguh hendak memperlihatkan kepadaku azab yang diancamkan kepada mereka,

ayahs.arabic: رَبِّ فَلَا تَجْعَلْنِى فِى ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ
ayahs.sahih: My Lord, then do not place me among the wrongdoing people."
ayahs.clear: My Lord, do not place me among the wicked people.”
ayahs.kemenag: ya Tuhanku, maka janganlah Engkau jadikan aku berada di antara orang-orang yang zalim".

ayahs.arabic: وَإِنَّا عَلَىٰٓ أَن نُّرِيَكَ مَا نَعِدُهُمْ لَقَٰدِرُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And indeed, We are able to show you what We have promised them.
ayahs.clear: We are surely Able to show you what We promise them.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan sesungguhnya Kami benar-benar kuasa untuk memperlihatkan kepadamu apa yang Kami ancamkan kepada mereka.

ayahs.arabic: ٱدْفَعْ بِٱلَّتِى هِىَ أَحْسَنُ ٱلسَّيِّئَةَ ۚ نَحْنُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا يَصِفُونَ
ayahs.sahih: Repel, by [means of] what is best, [their] evil. We are most knowing of what they describe.
ayahs.clear: Repel evil by what is better. We are aware of what they describe.
ayahs.kemenag: Tolaklah perbuatan buruk mereka dengan yang lebih baik. Kami lebih mengetahui apa yang mereka sifatkan.

ayahs.arabic: وَقُل رَّبِّ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ هَمَزَٰتِ ٱلشَّيَٰطِينِ
ayahs.sahih: And say, "My Lord, I seek refuge in You from the incitements of the devils,
ayahs.clear: And say, “My Lord, I seek refuge with You from the urgings of the devils.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan katakanlah: "Ya Tuhanku aku berlindung kepada Engkau dari bisikan-bisikan syaitan.

ayahs.arabic: وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ رَبِّ أَن يَحْضُرُونِ
ayahs.sahih: And I seek refuge in You, my Lord, lest they be present with me."
ayahs.clear: And I seek refuge with You, my Lord, lest they become present.”
ayahs.kemenag: Dan aku berlindung (pula) kepada Engkau ya Tuhanku, dari kedatangan mereka kepadaku".

ayahs.arabic: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا جَآءَ أَحَدَهُمُ ٱلْمَوْتُ قَالَ رَبِّ ٱرْجِعُونِ
ayahs.sahih: [For such is the state of the disbelievers], until, when death comes to one of them, he says, "My Lord, send me back
ayahs.clear: Until, when death comes to one of them, he says, “My Lord, send me back.
ayahs.kemenag: (Demikianlah keadaan orang-orang kafir itu), hingga apabila datang kematian kepada seseorang dari mereka, dia berkata: "Ya Tuhanku kembalikanlah aku (ke dunia),

ayahs.arabic: لَعَلِّىٓ أَعْمَلُ صَٰلِحًۭا فِيمَا تَرَكْتُ ۚ كَلَّآ ۚ إِنَّهَا كَلِمَةٌ هُوَ قَآئِلُهَا ۖ وَمِن وَرَآئِهِم بَرْزَخٌ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ يُبْعَثُونَ
ayahs.sahih: That I might do righteousness in that which I left behind." No! It is only a word he is saying; and behind them is a barrier until the Day they are resurrected.
ayahs.clear: That I may do right in what I have neglected.” By no means! It is just a word that he utters. And behind them is a barrier, until the Day they are resurrected.
ayahs.kemenag: agar aku berbuat amal yang saleh terhadap yang telah aku tinggalkan. Sekali-kali tidak. Sesungguhnya itu adalah perkataan yang diucapkannya saja. Dan di hadapan mereka ada dinding sampal hari mereka dibangkitkan.

ayahs.arabic: فَإِذَا نُفِخَ فِى ٱلصُّورِ فَلَآ أَنسَابَ بَيْنَهُمْ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ وَلَا يَتَسَآءَلُونَ
ayahs.sahih: So when the Horn is blown, no relationship will there be among them that Day, nor will they ask about one another.
ayahs.clear: When the Horn is blown, no relations between them will exist on that Day, and they will not ask after one another.
ayahs.kemenag: Apabila sangkakala ditiup maka tidaklah ada lagi pertalian nasab di antara mereka pada hari itu, dan tidak ada pula mereka saling bertanya.

ayahs.arabic: فَمَن ثَقُلَتْ مَوَٰزِينُهُۥ فَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْمُفْلِحُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And those whose scales are heavy [with good deeds] - it is they who are the successful.
ayahs.clear: Those whose scales are heavy—those are the successful.
ayahs.kemenag: Barangsiapa yang berat timbangan (kebaikan)nya, maka mereka itulah orang-orang yang dapat keberuntungan.

ayahs.arabic: وَمَنْ خَفَّتْ مَوَٰزِينُهُۥ فَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ خَسِرُوٓا۟ أَنفُسَهُمْ فِى جَهَنَّمَ خَٰلِدُونَ
ayahs.sahih: But those whose scales are light - those are the ones who have lost their souls, [being] in Hell, abiding eternally.
ayahs.clear: But those whose scales are light—those are they who have lost their souls; in Hell they will dwell forever.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan barangsiapa yang ringan timbangannya, maka mereka itulah orang-orang yang merugikan dirinya sendiri, mereka kekal di dalam neraka Jahannam.

ayahs.arabic: تَلْفَحُ وُجُوهَهُمُ ٱلنَّارُ وَهُمْ فِيهَا كَٰلِحُونَ
ayahs.sahih: The Fire will sear their faces, and they therein will have taut smiles.
ayahs.clear: The Fire lashes their faces, and therein they grimace.
ayahs.kemenag: Muka mereka dibakar api neraka, dan mereka di dalam neraka itu dalam keadaan cacat.

ayahs.arabic: أَلَمْ تَكُنْ ءَايَٰتِى تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْكُمْ فَكُنتُم بِهَا تُكَذِّبُونَ
ayahs.sahih: [It will be said]. "Were not My verses recited to you and you used to deny them?"
ayahs.clear: “Were not My revelations recited to you, and you kept on rejecting them?”
ayahs.kemenag: Bukankah ayat-ayat-Ku telah dibacakan kepadamu sekalian, tetapi kamu selalu mendustakannya?

ayahs.arabic: قَالُوا۟ رَبَّنَا غَلَبَتْ عَلَيْنَا شِقْوَتُنَا وَكُنَّا قَوْمًۭا ضَآلِّينَ
ayahs.sahih: They will say, "Our Lord, our wretchedness overcame us, and we were a people astray.
ayahs.clear: They will say, “Our Lord, our wretchedness prevailed over us, and we were a people astray.
ayahs.kemenag: Mereka berkata: "Ya Tuhan kami, kami telah dikuasai oleh kejahatan kami, dan adalah kami orang-orang yang sesat.

ayahs.arabic: رَبَّنَآ أَخْرِجْنَا مِنْهَا فَإِنْ عُدْنَا فَإِنَّا ظَٰلِمُونَ
ayahs.sahih: Our Lord, remove us from it, and if we were to return [to evil], we would indeed be wrongdoers."
ayahs.clear: Our Lord! Bring us out of this. If we ever returned, we would truly be evil.”
ayahs.kemenag: Ya Tuhan kami, keluarkanlah kami daripadanya (dan kembalikanlah kami ke dunia), maka jika kami kembali (juga kepada kekafiran), sesungguhnya kami adalah orang-orang yang zalim".

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ ٱخْسَـُٔوا۟ فِيهَا وَلَا تُكَلِّمُونِ
ayahs.sahih: He will say, "Remain despised therein and do not speak to Me.
ayahs.clear: He will say, “Be despised therein, and do not speak to Me.
ayahs.kemenag: Allah berfirman: "Tinggallah dengan hina di dalamnya, dan janganlah kamu berbicara dengan Aku.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ فَرِيقٌۭ مِّنْ عِبَادِى يَقُولُونَ رَبَّنَآ ءَامَنَّا فَٱغْفِرْ لَنَا وَٱرْحَمْنَا وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ ٱلرَّٰحِمِينَ
ayahs.sahih: Indeed, there was a party of My servants who said, 'Our Lord, we have believed, so forgive us and have mercy upon us, and You are the best of the merciful.'
ayahs.clear: There was a group of My servants who would say, `Our Lord, we have believed, so forgive us, and have mercy on us; You are the Best of the merciful.'
ayahs.kemenag: Sesungguhnya, ada segolongan dari hamba-hamba-Ku berdoa (di dunia): "Ya Tuhan kami, kami telah beriman, maka ampunilah kami dan berilah kami rahmat dan Engkau adalah Pemberi rahmat Yang Paling Baik.

ayahs.arabic: فَٱتَّخَذْتُمُوهُمْ سِخْرِيًّا حَتَّىٰٓ أَنسَوْكُمْ ذِكْرِى وَكُنتُم مِّنْهُمْ تَضْحَكُونَ
ayahs.sahih: But you took them in mockery to the point that they made you forget My remembrance, and you used to laugh at them.
ayahs.clear: But you made then a target of ridicule, until they made you forget My remembrance; and you used to laugh at them.
ayahs.kemenag: Lalu kamu menjadikan mereka buah ejekan, sehingga (kesibukan) kamu mengejek mereka, menjadikan kamu lupa mengingat Aku, dan adalah kamu selalu mentertawakan mereka,

ayahs.arabic: إِنِّى جَزَيْتُهُمُ ٱلْيَوْمَ بِمَا صَبَرُوٓا۟ أَنَّهُمْ هُمُ ٱلْفَآئِزُونَ
ayahs.sahih: Indeed, I have rewarded them this Day for their patient endurance - that they are the attainers [of success]."
ayahs.clear: Today, I have rewarded them for their endurance. They are the ones who are the triumphant.”
ayahs.kemenag: Sesungguhnya Aku memberi balasan kepada mereka di hari ini, karena kesabaran mereka; sesungguhnya mereka itulah orang-orang yang menang".

ayahs.arabic: قَٰلَ كَمْ لَبِثْتُمْ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ عَدَدَ سِنِينَ
ayahs.sahih: [Allah] will say, "How long did you remain on earth in number of years?"
ayahs.clear: He will say, “How many years did you remain on earth?”
ayahs.kemenag: Allah bertanya: "Berapa tahunkah lamanya kamu tinggal di bumi?"

ayahs.arabic: قَالُوا۟ لَبِثْنَا يَوْمًا أَوْ بَعْضَ يَوْمٍۢ فَسْـَٔلِ ٱلْعَآدِّينَ
ayahs.sahih: They will say, "We remained a day or part of a day; ask those who enumerate."
ayahs.clear: They will say, “We remained a day, or part of a day; but ask those who keep count.”
ayahs.kemenag: Mereka menjawab: "Kami tinggal (di bumi) sehari atau setengah hari, maka tanyakanlah kepada orang-orang yang menghitung".

ayahs.arabic: قَٰلَ إِن لَّبِثْتُمْ إِلَّا قَلِيلًۭا ۖ لَّوْ أَنَّكُمْ كُنتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ
ayahs.sahih: He will say, "You stayed not but a little - if only you had known.
ayahs.clear: He will say, “You remained only for a little while, if you only knew.
ayahs.kemenag: Allah berfirman: "Kamu tidak tinggal (di bumi) melainkan sebentar saja, kalau kamu sesungguhnya mengetahui"

ayahs.arabic: أَفَحَسِبْتُمْ أَنَّمَا خَلَقْنَٰكُمْ عَبَثًۭا وَأَنَّكُمْ إِلَيْنَا لَا تُرْجَعُونَ
ayahs.sahih: Then did you think that We created you uselessly and that to Us you would not be returned?"
ayahs.clear: Did you think that We created you in vain, and that to Us you will not be returned?”
ayahs.kemenag: Maka apakah kamu mengira, bahwa sesungguhnya Kami menciptakan kamu secara main-main (saja), dan bahwa kamu tidak akan dikembalikan kepada Kami?

ayahs.arabic: فَتَعَٰلَى ٱللَّهُ ٱلْمَلِكُ ٱلْحَقُّ ۖ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ رَبُّ ٱلْعَرْشِ ٱلْكَرِيمِ
ayahs.sahih: So exalted is Allah, the Sovereign, the Truth; there is no deity except Him, Lord of the Noble Throne.
ayahs.clear: So Exalted is God, the Ruler, the Real. There is no god except He, the Lord of the Noble Throne.
ayahs.kemenag: Maka Maha Tinggi Allah, Raja Yang Sebenarnya; tidak ada Tuhan selain Dia, Tuhan (Yang mempunyai) 'Arsy yang mulia.

ayahs.arabic: وَمَن يَدْعُ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَٰهًا ءَاخَرَ لَا بُرْهَٰنَ لَهُۥ بِهِۦ فَإِنَّمَا حِسَابُهُۥ عِندَ رَبِّهِۦٓ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ لَا يُفْلِحُ ٱلْكَٰفِرُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And whoever invokes besides Allah another deity for which he has no proof - then his account is only with his Lord. Indeed, the disbelievers will not succeed.
ayahs.clear: Whoever invokes another god besides God—he has no proof thereof—his reckoning rests with his Lord. The disbelievers will not succeed.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan barangsiapa menyembah tuhan yang lain di samping Allah, padahal tidak ada suatu dalilpun baginya tentang itu, maka sesungguhnya perhitungannya di sisi Tuhannya. Sesungguhnya orang-orang yang kafir itu tiada beruntung.

ayahs.arabic: وَقُل رَّبِّ ٱغْفِرْ وَٱرْحَمْ وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ ٱلرَّٰحِمِينَ
ayahs.sahih: And, [O Muhammad], say, "My Lord, forgive and have mercy, and You are the best of the merciful."
ayahs.clear: And say, “My Lord, forgive and have mercy, for You are the Best of the merciful.”
ayahs.kemenag: Dan katakanlah: "Ya Tuhanku berilah ampun dan berilah rahmat, dan Engkau adalah Pemberi rahmat Yang Paling baik".

ayahs.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ سُورَةٌ أَنزَلْنَٰهَا وَفَرَضْنَٰهَا وَأَنزَلْنَا فِيهَآ ءَايَٰتٍۭ بَيِّنَٰتٍۢ لَّعَلَّكُمْ تَذَكَّرُونَ
ayahs.sahih: [This is] a surah which We have sent down and made [that within it] obligatory and revealed therein verses of clear evidence that you might remember.
ayahs.clear: A chapter that We have revealed, and made obligatory, and revealed in it clear Verses, that you may take heed.
ayahs.kemenag: (Ini adalah) satu surat yang Kami turunkan dan Kami wajibkan (menjalankan hukum-hukum yang ada di dalam)nya, dan Kami turunkan di dalamnya ayat ayat yang jelas, agar kamu selalu mengingatinya.

ayahs.arabic: ٱلزَّانِيَةُ وَٱلزَّانِى فَٱجْلِدُوا۟ كُلَّ وَٰحِدٍۢ مِّنْهُمَا مِا۟ئَةَ جَلْدَةٍۢ ۖ وَلَا تَأْخُذْكُم بِهِمَا رَأْفَةٌۭ فِى دِينِ ٱللَّهِ إِن كُنتُمْ تُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱللَّهِ وَٱلْيَوْمِ ٱلْءَاخِرِ ۖ وَلْيَشْهَدْ عَذَابَهُمَا طَآئِفَةٌۭ مِّنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
ayahs.sahih: The [unmarried] woman or [unmarried] man found guilty of sexual intercourse - lash each one of them with a hundred lashes, and do not be taken by pity for them in the religion of Allah, if you should believe in Allah and the Last Day. And let a group of the believers witness their punishment.
ayahs.clear: The adulteress and the adulterer—whip each one of them a hundred lashes, and let no pity towards them overcome you regarding God’s Law, if you believe in God and the Last Day. And let a group of believers witness their punishment.
ayahs.kemenag: Perempuan yang berzina dan laki-laki yang berzina, maka deralah tiap-tiap seorang dari keduanya seratus dali dera, dan janganlah belas kasihan kepada keduanya mencegah kamu untuk (menjalankan) agama Allah, jika kamu beriman kepada Allah, dan hari akhirat, dan hendaklah (pelaksanaan) hukuman mereka disaksikan oleh sekumpulan orang-orang yang beriman.

ayahs.arabic: ٱلزَّانِى لَا يَنكِحُ إِلَّا زَانِيَةً أَوْ مُشْرِكَةًۭ وَٱلزَّانِيَةُ لَا يَنكِحُهَآ إِلَّا زَانٍ أَوْ مُشْرِكٌۭ ۚ وَحُرِّمَ ذَٰلِكَ عَلَى ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
ayahs.sahih: The fornicator does not marry except a [female] fornicator or polytheist, and none marries her except a fornicator or a polytheist, and that has been made unlawful to the believers.
ayahs.clear: The adulterer shall marry none but an adulteress or an idolatress; and the adulteress shall marry none but an adulterer or an idolater. That has been prohibited for the believers.
ayahs.kemenag: Laki-laki yang berzina tidak mengawini melainkan perempuan yang berzina, atau perempuan yang musyrik; dan perempuan yang berzina tidak dikawini melainkan oleh laki-laki yang berzina atau laki-laki musyrik, dan yang demikian itu diharamkan atas oran-orang yang mukmin.

ayahs.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ يَرْمُونَ ٱلْمُحْصَنَٰتِ ثُمَّ لَمْ يَأْتُوا۟ بِأَرْبَعَةِ شُهَدَآءَ فَٱجْلِدُوهُمْ ثَمَٰنِينَ جَلْدَةًۭ وَلَا تَقْبَلُوا۟ لَهُمْ شَهَٰدَةً أَبَدًۭا ۚ وَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْفَٰسِقُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And those who accuse chaste women and then do not produce four witnesses - lash them with eighty lashes and do not accept from them testimony ever after. And those are the defiantly disobedient,
ayahs.clear: Those who accuse chaste women, then cannot bring four witnesses, whip them eighty lashes, and do not ever accept their testimony. For these are the immoral.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan orang-orang yang menuduh wanita-wanita yang baik-baik (berbuat zina) dan mereka tidak mendatangkan empat orang saksi, maka deralah mereka (yang menuduh itu) delapan puluh kali dera, dan janganlah kamu terima kesaksian mereka buat selama-lamanya. Dan mereka itulah orang-orang yang fasik.

ayahs.arabic: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ تَابُوا۟ مِنۢ بَعْدِ ذَٰلِكَ وَأَصْلَحُوا۟ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَفُورٌۭ رَّحِيمٌۭ
ayahs.sahih: Except for those who repent thereafter and reform, for indeed, Allah is Forgiving and Merciful.
ayahs.clear: Except for those who repent afterwards, and reform; for God is Forgiving and Merciful.
ayahs.kemenag: kecuali orang-orang yang bertaubat sesudah itu dan memperbaiki (dirinya), maka sesungguhnya Allah Maha Pengampun lagi Maha Penyayang.

ayahs.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ يَرْمُونَ أَزْوَٰجَهُمْ وَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُمْ شُهَدَآءُ إِلَّآ أَنفُسُهُمْ فَشَهَٰدَةُ أَحَدِهِمْ أَرْبَعُ شَهَٰدَٰتٍۭ بِٱللَّهِ ۙ إِنَّهُۥ لَمِنَ ٱلصَّٰدِقِينَ
ayahs.sahih: And those who accuse their wives [of adultery] and have no witnesses except themselves - then the witness of one of them [shall be] four testimonies [swearing] by Allah that indeed, he is of the truthful.
ayahs.clear: As for those who accuse their own spouses, but have no witnesses except themselves, the testimony of one of them is equivalent to four testimonies, if he swears by God that he is truthful.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan orang-orang yang menuduh isterinya (berzina), padahal mereka tidak ada mempunyai saksi-saksi selain diri mereka sendiri, maka persaksian orang itu ialah empat kali bersumpah dengan nama Allah, sesungguhnya dia adalah termasuk orang-orang yang benar.

ayahs.arabic: وَٱلْخَٰمِسَةُ أَنَّ لَعْنَتَ ٱللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ إِن كَانَ مِنَ ٱلْكَٰذِبِينَ
ayahs.sahih: And the fifth [oath will be] that the curse of Allah be upon him if he should be among the liars.
ayahs.clear: And the fifth time, that God’s curse be upon him, if he is a liar.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan (sumpah) yang kelima: bahwa laknat Allah atasnya, jika dia termasuk orang-orang yang berdusta.

ayahs.arabic: وَيَدْرَؤُا۟ عَنْهَا ٱلْعَذَابَ أَن تَشْهَدَ أَرْبَعَ شَهَٰدَٰتٍۭ بِٱللَّهِ ۙ إِنَّهُۥ لَمِنَ ٱلْكَٰذِبِينَ
ayahs.sahih: But it will prevent punishment from her if she gives four testimonies [swearing] by Allah that indeed, he is of the liars.
ayahs.clear: But punishment shall be averted from her, if she swears four times by God, that he is a liar.
ayahs.kemenag: Istrinya itu dihindarkan dari hukuman oleh sumpahnya empat kali atas nama Allah sesungguhnya suaminya itu benar-benar termasuk orang-orang yang dusta.

ayahs.arabic: وَٱلْخَٰمِسَةَ أَنَّ غَضَبَ ٱللَّهِ عَلَيْهَآ إِن كَانَ مِنَ ٱلصَّٰدِقِينَ
ayahs.sahih: And the fifth [oath will be] that the wrath of Allah be upon her if he was of the truthful.
ayahs.clear: And the fifth time, that God’s wrath be upon her, if he is truthful.
ayahs.kemenag: dan (sumpah) yang kelima: bahwa laknat Allah atasnya jika suaminya itu termasuk orang-orang yang benar.
