ayahs.arabic: إِن كَادَ لَيُضِلُّنَا عَنْ ءَالِهَتِنَا لَوْلَآ أَن صَبَرْنَا عَلَيْهَا ۚ وَسَوْفَ يَعْلَمُونَ حِينَ يَرَوْنَ ٱلْعَذَابَ مَنْ أَضَلُّ سَبِيلًا
ayahs.sahih: He almost would have misled us from our gods had we not been steadfast in [worship of] them." But they are going to know, when they see the punishment, who is farthest astray in [his] way.
ayahs.clear: “He nearly led us away from our gods, had we not patiently adhered to them.” But they will know, when they witness the torment, who is further away from the way.
ayahs.kemenag: Sesungguhnya hampirlah ia menyesatkan kita dari sembahan-sembahan kita, seandainya kita tidak sabar(menyembah)nya" dan mereka kelak akan mengetahui di saat mereka melihat azab, siapa yang paling sesat jalannya.

ayahs.arabic: أَرَءَيْتَ مَنِ ٱتَّخَذَ إِلَٰهَهُۥ هَوَىٰهُ أَفَأَنتَ تَكُونُ عَلَيْهِ وَكِيلًا
ayahs.sahih: Have you seen the one who takes as his god his own desire? Then would you be responsible for him?
ayahs.clear: Have you seen him who chose his desire as his god? Would you be an agent for him?
ayahs.kemenag: Terangkanlah kepadaku tentang orang yang menjadikan hawa nafsunya sebagai tuhannya. Maka apakah kamu dapat menjadi pemelihara atasnya?,

ayahs.arabic: أَمْ تَحْسَبُ أَنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ يَسْمَعُونَ أَوْ يَعْقِلُونَ ۚ إِنْ هُمْ إِلَّا كَٱلْأَنْعَٰمِ ۖ بَلْ هُمْ أَضَلُّ سَبِيلًا
ayahs.sahih: Or do you think that most of them hear or reason? They are not except like livestock. Rather, they are [even] more astray in [their] way.
ayahs.clear: Or do you assume that most of them hear or understand? They are just like cattle, but even more errant in their way.
ayahs.kemenag: atau apakah kamu mengira bahwa kebanyakan mereka itu mendengar atau memahami. Mereka itu tidak lain, hanyalah seperti binatang ternak, bahkan mereka lebih sesat jalannya (dari binatang ternak itu).

ayahs.arabic: أَلَمْ تَرَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ كَيْفَ مَدَّ ٱلظِّلَّ وَلَوْ شَآءَ لَجَعَلَهُۥ سَاكِنًۭا ثُمَّ جَعَلْنَا ٱلشَّمْسَ عَلَيْهِ دَلِيلًۭا
ayahs.sahih: Have you not considered your Lord - how He extends the shadow, and if He willed, He could have made it stationary? Then We made the sun for it an indication.
ayahs.clear: Do you not see how your Lord extends the shadow? Had He willed, He could have made it still. And We made the sun a pointer to it.
ayahs.kemenag: Apakah kamu tidak memperhatikan (penciptaan) Tuhanmu, bagaimana Dia memanjangkan (dan memendekkan) bayang-bayang dan kalau Dia menghendaki niscaya Dia menjadikan tetap bayang-bayang itu, kemudian Kami jadikan matahari sebagai petunjuk atas bayang-bayang itu,

ayahs.arabic: ثُمَّ قَبَضْنَٰهُ إِلَيْنَا قَبْضًۭا يَسِيرًۭا
ayahs.sahih: Then We hold it in hand for a brief grasp.
ayahs.clear: Then We withdraw it towards Us gradually.
ayahs.kemenag: kemudian Kami menarik bayang-bayang itu kepada kami dengan tarikan yang perlahan-lahan.

ayahs.arabic: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلَّيْلَ لِبَاسًۭا وَٱلنَّوْمَ سُبَاتًۭا وَجَعَلَ ٱلنَّهَارَ نُشُورًۭا
ayahs.sahih: And it is He who has made the night for you as clothing and sleep [a means for] rest and has made the day a resurrection.
ayahs.clear: And it is He who made the night a covering for you, and sleep for rest; and He made the day a revival.
ayahs.kemenag: Dialah yang menjadikan untukmu malam (sebagai) pakaian, dan tidur untuk istirahat, dan Dia menjadikan siang untuk bangun berusaha.

ayahs.arabic: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَرْسَلَ ٱلرِّيَٰحَ بُشْرًۢا بَيْنَ يَدَىْ رَحْمَتِهِۦ ۚ وَأَنزَلْنَا مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءًۭ طَهُورًۭا
ayahs.sahih: And it is He who sends the winds as good tidings before His mercy, and We send down from the sky pure water
ayahs.clear: And it is He who sends the winds, bringing advance news of His mercy; and We send down from the sky pure water.
ayahs.kemenag: Dialah yang meniupkan angin (sebagai) pembawa kabar gembira dekat sebelum kedatangan rahmat-nya (hujan); dan Kami turunkan dari langit air yang amat bersih,

ayahs.arabic: لِّنُحْۦِىَ بِهِۦ بَلْدَةًۭ مَّيْتًۭا وَنُسْقِيَهُۥ مِمَّا خَلَقْنَآ أَنْعَٰمًۭا وَأَنَاسِىَّ كَثِيرًۭا
ayahs.sahih: That We may bring to life thereby a dead land and give it as drink to those We created of numerous livestock and men.
ayahs.clear: To revive dead lands thereby, and to provide drink for the multitude of animals and humans We created.
ayahs.kemenag: agar Kami menghidupkan dengan air itu negeri (tanah) yang mati, dan agar Kami memberi minum dengan air itu sebagian besar dari makhluk Kami, binatang-binatang ternak dan manusia yang banyak.

ayahs.arabic: وَلَقَدْ صَرَّفْنَٰهُ بَيْنَهُمْ لِيَذَّكَّرُوا۟ فَأَبَىٰٓ أَكْثَرُ ٱلنَّاسِ إِلَّا كُفُورًۭا
ayahs.sahih: And We have certainly distributed it among them that they might be reminded, but most of the people refuse except disbelief.
ayahs.clear: We have circulated it among them, that they may reflect, but most people persist in thanklessness.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan sesungguhnya Kami telah mempergilirkan hujan itu diantara manusia supaya mereka mengambil pelajaran (dari padanya); maka kebanyakan manusia itu tidak mau kecuali mengingkari (nikmat).

ayahs.arabic: وَلَوْ شِئْنَا لَبَعَثْنَا فِى كُلِّ قَرْيَةٍۢ نَّذِيرًۭا
ayahs.sahih: And if We had willed, We could have sent into every city a warner.
ayahs.clear: Had We willed, We could have sent to every town a warner.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan andaikata Kami menghendaki benar-benarlah Kami utus pada tiap-tiap negeri seorang yang memberi peringatan (rasul).

ayahs.arabic: فَلَا تُطِعِ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ وَجَٰهِدْهُم بِهِۦ جِهَادًۭا كَبِيرًۭا
ayahs.sahih: So do not obey the disbelievers, and strive against them with the Qur'an a great striving.
ayahs.clear: So do not obey the disbelievers, but strive against them with it, a mighty struggle.
ayahs.kemenag: Maka janganlah kamu mengikuti orang-orang kafir, dan berjihadlah terhadap mereka dengan Al Quran dengan jihad yang besar.

ayahs.arabic: ۞ وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِى مَرَجَ ٱلْبَحْرَيْنِ هَٰذَا عَذْبٌۭ فُرَاتٌۭ وَهَٰذَا مِلْحٌ أُجَاجٌۭ وَجَعَلَ بَيْنَهُمَا بَرْزَخًۭا وَحِجْرًۭا مَّحْجُورًۭا
ayahs.sahih: And it is He who has released [simultaneously] the two seas, one fresh and sweet and one salty and bitter, and He placed between them a barrier and prohibiting partition.
ayahs.clear: And it is He who merged the two seas; this one fresh and sweet, and that one salty and bitter; and He placed between them a barrier, and an impassable boundary.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan Dialah yang membiarkan dua laut yang mengalir (berdampingan); yang ini tawar lagi segar dan yang lain asin lagi pahit; dan Dia jadikan antara keduanya dinding dan batas yang menghalangi.

ayahs.arabic: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ مِنَ ٱلْمَآءِ بَشَرًۭا فَجَعَلَهُۥ نَسَبًۭا وَصِهْرًۭا ۗ وَكَانَ رَبُّكَ قَدِيرًۭا
ayahs.sahih: And it is He who has created from water a human being and made him [a relative by] lineage and marriage. And ever is your Lord competent [concerning creation].
ayahs.clear: And it is He who, from fluid, created the human being. Then He made relationships through marriage and mating. Your Lord is Omnipotent.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan Dia (pula) yang menciptakan manusia dari air lalu dia jadikan manusia itu (punya) keturunan dan mushaharah dan adalah Tuhanmu Maha Kuasa.

ayahs.arabic: وَيَعْبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ مَا لَا يَنفَعُهُمْ وَلَا يَضُرُّهُمْ ۗ وَكَانَ ٱلْكَافِرُ عَلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ ظَهِيرًۭا
ayahs.sahih: But they worship rather than Allah that which does not benefit them or harm them, and the disbeliever is ever, against his Lord, an assistant [to Satan].
ayahs.clear: And yet, instead of God, they serve what neither profits them nor harms them. The disbeliever has always turned his back on his Lord.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan mereka menyembah selain Allah apa yang tidak memberi manfaat kepada mereka dan tidak (pula) memberi mudharat kepada mereka. Adalah orang-orang kafir itu penolong (syaitan untuk berbuat durhaka) terhadap Tuhannya.

ayahs.arabic: وَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَٰكَ إِلَّا مُبَشِّرًۭا وَنَذِيرًۭا
ayahs.sahih: And We have not sent you, [O Muhammad], except as a bringer of good tidings and a warner.
ayahs.clear: We sent you only as a herald of good news and a warner.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan tidaklah Kami mengutus kamu melainkan hanya sebagai pembawa kabar gembira dan pemberi peringatan.

ayahs.arabic: قُلْ مَآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ إِلَّا مَن شَآءَ أَن يَتَّخِذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ سَبِيلًۭا
ayahs.sahih: Say, "I do not ask of you for it any payment - only that whoever wills might take to his Lord a way."
ayahs.clear: Say, “I ask of you no payment for this—only that whoever wills may take a path to his Lord.”
ayahs.kemenag: Katakanlah: "Aku tidak meminta upah sedikitpun kepada kamu dalam menyampaikan risalah itu, melainkan (mengharapkan kepatuhan) orang-orang yang mau mengambil jalan kepada Tuhan nya.

ayahs.arabic: وَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى ٱلْحَىِّ ٱلَّذِى لَا يَمُوتُ وَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِهِۦ ۚ وَكَفَىٰ بِهِۦ بِذُنُوبِ عِبَادِهِۦ خَبِيرًا
ayahs.sahih: And rely upon the Ever-Living who does not die, and exalt [Allah] with His praise. And sufficient is He to be, with the sins of His servants, Acquainted -
ayahs.clear: And put your trust in the Living, the One who never dies; and celebrate His praise. He suffices as the All-Informed Knower of the faults of His creatures.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan bertawakkallah kepada Allah yang hidup (kekal) Yang tidak mati, dan bertasbihlah dengan memuji-Nya. Dan cukuplah Dia Maha Mengetahui dosa-dosa hamba-hamba-Nya.

ayahs.arabic: ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا فِى سِتَّةِ أَيَّامٍۢ ثُمَّ ٱسْتَوَىٰ عَلَى ٱلْعَرْشِ ۚ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ فَسْـَٔلْ بِهِۦ خَبِيرًۭا
ayahs.sahih: He who created the heavens and the earth and what is between them in six days and then established Himself above the Throne - the Most Merciful, so ask about Him one well informed.
ayahs.clear: He who created the heavens and the earth and everything between them in six days, then settled on the Throne. The Most Merciful. Ask about Him a well-informed.
ayahs.kemenag: Yang menciptakan langit dan bumi dan apa yang ada antara keduanya dalam enam masa, kemudian dia bersemayam di atas 'Arsy, (Dialah) Yang Maha Pemurah, maka tanyakanlah (tentang Allah) kepada yang lebih mengetahui (Muhammad) tentang Dia.

ayahs.arabic: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمُ ٱسْجُدُوا۟ لِلرَّحْمَٰنِ قَالُوا۟ وَمَا ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ أَنَسْجُدُ لِمَا تَأْمُرُنَا وَزَادَهُمْ نُفُورًۭا ۩
ayahs.sahih: And when it is said to them, "Prostrate to the Most Merciful," they say, "And what is the Most Merciful? Should we prostrate to that which you order us?" And it increases them in aversion.
ayahs.clear: And when it is said to them, “Bow down to the Merciful,” they say, “And what is the Merciful? Are we to bow down to whatever you command us?” And it increases their aversion.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan apabila dikatakan kepada mereka: "Sujudlah kamu sekalian kepada yang Maha Penyayang", mereka menjawab: "Siapakah yang Maha Penyayang itu? Apakah kami akan sujud kepada Tuhan Yang kamu perintahkan kami(bersujud kepada-Nya)?", dan (perintah sujud itu) menambah mereka jauh (dari iman).

ayahs.arabic: تَبَارَكَ ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَ فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ بُرُوجًۭا وَجَعَلَ فِيهَا سِرَٰجًۭا وَقَمَرًۭا مُّنِيرًۭا
ayahs.sahih: Blessed is He who has placed in the sky great stars and placed therein a [burning] lamp and luminous moon.
ayahs.clear: Blessed is He who placed constellations in the sky, and placed in it a lamp, and an illuminating moon.
ayahs.kemenag: Maha Suci Allah yang menjadikan di langit gugusan-gugusan bintang dan Dia menjadikan juga padanya matahari dan bulan yang bercahaya.

ayahs.arabic: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَ ٱلَّيْلَ وَٱلنَّهَارَ خِلْفَةًۭ لِّمَنْ أَرَادَ أَن يَذَّكَّرَ أَوْ أَرَادَ شُكُورًۭا
ayahs.sahih: And it is He who has made the night and the day in succession for whoever desires to remember or desires gratitude.
ayahs.clear: And it is He who made the night and the day alternate—for whoever desires to reflect, or desires to show gratitude.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan Dia (pula) yang menjadikan malam dan siang silih berganti bagi orang yang ingin mengambil pelajaran atau orang yang ingin bersyukur.

ayahs.arabic: وَعِبَادُ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلَّذِينَ يَمْشُونَ عَلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ هَوْنًۭا وَإِذَا خَاطَبَهُمُ ٱلْجَٰهِلُونَ قَالُوا۟ سَلَٰمًۭا
ayahs.sahih: And the servants of the Most Merciful are those who walk upon the earth easily, and when the ignorant address them [harshly], they say [words of] peace,
ayahs.clear: The servants of the Merciful are those who walk the earth in humility, and when the ignorant address them, they say, “Peace.”
ayahs.kemenag: Dan hamba-hamba Tuhan yang Maha Penyayang itu (ialah) orang-orang yang berjalan di atas bumi dengan rendah hati dan apabila orang-orang jahil menyapa mereka, mereka mengucapkan kata-kata (yang mengandung) keselamatan.

ayahs.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ يَبِيتُونَ لِرَبِّهِمْ سُجَّدًۭا وَقِيَٰمًۭا
ayahs.sahih: And those who spend [part of] the night to their Lord prostrating and standing [in prayer]
ayahs.clear: And those who pass the night prostrating themselves to their Lord and standing up.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan orang yang melalui malam hari dengan bersujud dan berdiri untuk Tuhan mereka.

ayahs.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ يَقُولُونَ رَبَّنَا ٱصْرِفْ عَنَّا عَذَابَ جَهَنَّمَ ۖ إِنَّ عَذَابَهَا كَانَ غَرَامًا
ayahs.sahih: And those who say, "Our Lord, avert from us the punishment of Hell. Indeed, its punishment is ever adhering;
ayahs.clear: And those who say, ‘‘Our Lord, avert from us the suffering of Hell, for its suffering is continuous.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan orang-orang yang berkata: "Ya Tuhan kami, jauhkan azab jahannam dari kami, sesungguhnya azabnya itu adalah kebinasaan yang kekal".

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّهَا سَآءَتْ مُسْتَقَرًّۭا وَمُقَامًۭا
ayahs.sahih: Indeed, it is evil as a settlement and residence."
ayahs.clear: It is indeed a miserable residence and destination.”
ayahs.kemenag: Sesungguhnya jahannam itu seburuk-buruk tempat menetap dan tempat kediaman.

ayahs.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ إِذَآ أَنفَقُوا۟ لَمْ يُسْرِفُوا۟ وَلَمْ يَقْتُرُوا۟ وَكَانَ بَيْنَ ذَٰلِكَ قَوَامًۭا
ayahs.sahih: And [they are] those who, when they spend, do so not excessively or sparingly but are ever, between that, [justly] moderate
ayahs.clear: And those who, when they spend, are neither wasteful nor stingy, but choose a middle course between that.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan orang-orang yang apabila membelanjakan (harta), mereka tidak berlebihan, dan tidak (pula) kikir, dan adalah (pembelanjaan itu) di tengah-tengah antara yang demikian.

ayahs.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ لَا يَدْعُونَ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَٰهًا ءَاخَرَ وَلَا يَقْتُلُونَ ٱلنَّفْسَ ٱلَّتِى حَرَّمَ ٱللَّهُ إِلَّا بِٱلْحَقِّ وَلَا يَزْنُونَ ۚ وَمَن يَفْعَلْ ذَٰلِكَ يَلْقَ أَثَامًۭا
ayahs.sahih: And those who do not invoke with Allah another deity or kill the soul which Allah has forbidden [to be killed], except by right, and do not commit unlawful sexual intercourse. And whoever should do that will meet a penalty.
ayahs.clear: And those who do not implore besides God any other god, and do not kill the soul which God has made sacred—except in the pursuit of justice—and do not commit adultery. Whoever does that will face penalties.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan orang-orang yang tidak menyembah tuhan yang lain beserta Allah dan tidak membunuh jiwa yang diharamkan Allah (membunuhnya) kecuali dengan (alasan) yang benar, dan tidak berzina, barang siapa yang melakukan yang demikian itu, niscaya dia mendapat (pembalasan) dosa(nya),

ayahs.arabic: يُضَٰعَفْ لَهُ ٱلْعَذَابُ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ وَيَخْلُدْ فِيهِۦ مُهَانًا
ayahs.sahih: Multiplied for him is the punishment on the Day of Resurrection, and he will abide therein humiliated -
ayahs.clear: The punishment will be doubled for him on the Day of Resurrection, and he will dwell therein in humiliation forever.
ayahs.kemenag: (yakni) akan dilipat gandakan azab untuknya pada hari kiamat dan dia akan kekal dalam azab itu, dalam keadaan terhina,

ayahs.arabic: إِلَّا مَن تَابَ وَءَامَنَ وَعَمِلَ عَمَلًۭا صَٰلِحًۭا فَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ يُبَدِّلُ ٱللَّهُ سَيِّـَٔاتِهِمْ حَسَنَٰتٍۢ ۗ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ غَفُورًۭا رَّحِيمًۭا
ayahs.sahih: Except for those who repent, believe and do righteous work. For them Allah will replace their evil deeds with good. And ever is Allah Forgiving and Merciful.
ayahs.clear: Except for those who repent, and believe, and do good deeds. These—God will replace their bad deeds with good deeds. God is ever Forgiving and Merciful.
ayahs.kemenag: kecuali orang-orang yang bertaubat, beriman dan mengerjakan amal saleh; maka itu kejahatan mereka diganti Allah dengan kebajikan. Dan adalah Allah maha Pengampun lagi Maha Penyayang.

ayahs.arabic: وَمَن تَابَ وَعَمِلَ صَٰلِحًۭا فَإِنَّهُۥ يَتُوبُ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ مَتَابًۭا
ayahs.sahih: And he who repents and does righteousness does indeed turn to Allah with [accepted] repentance.
ayahs.clear: Whoever repents and acts righteously—has inclined towards God with repentance.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan orang-orang yang bertaubat dan mengerjakan amal saleh, maka sesungguhnya dia bertaubat kepada Allah dengan taubat yang sebenar-benarnya.

ayahs.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ لَا يَشْهَدُونَ ٱلزُّورَ وَإِذَا مَرُّوا۟ بِٱللَّغْوِ مَرُّوا۟ كِرَامًۭا
ayahs.sahih: And [they are] those who do not testify to falsehood, and when they pass near ill speech, they pass by with dignity.
ayahs.clear: And those who do not bear false witness; and when they come across indecencies, they pass by with dignity.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan orang-orang yang tidak memberikan persaksian palsu, dan apabila mereka bertemu dengan (orang-orang) yang mengerjakan perbuatan-perbuatan yang tidak berfaedah, mereka lalui (saja) dengan menjaga kehormatan dirinya.

ayahs.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ إِذَا ذُكِّرُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِ رَبِّهِمْ لَمْ يَخِرُّوا۟ عَلَيْهَا صُمًّۭا وَعُمْيَانًۭا
ayahs.sahih: And those who, when reminded of the verses of their Lord, do not fall upon them deaf and blind.
ayahs.clear: And those who, when reminded of the revelations of their Lord, do not fall before them deaf and blind.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan orang-orang yang apabila diberi peringatan dengan ayat-ayat Tuhan mereka, mereka tidaklah menghadapinya sebagai orang-orang yang tuli dan buta.

ayahs.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ يَقُولُونَ رَبَّنَا هَبْ لَنَا مِنْ أَزْوَٰجِنَا وَذُرِّيَّٰتِنَا قُرَّةَ أَعْيُنٍۢ وَٱجْعَلْنَا لِلْمُتَّقِينَ إِمَامًا
ayahs.sahih: And those who say, "Our Lord, grant us from among our wives and offspring comfort to our eyes and make us an example for the righteous."
ayahs.clear: And those who say, “Our Lord, grant us delight in our spouses and our children, and make us a good example for the righteous.”
ayahs.kemenag: Dan orang orang yang berkata: "Ya Tuhan kami, anugrahkanlah kepada kami isteri-isteri kami dan keturunan kami sebagai penyenang hati (kami), dan jadikanlah kami imam bagi orang-orang yang bertakwa.

ayahs.arabic: أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ يُجْزَوْنَ ٱلْغُرْفَةَ بِمَا صَبَرُوا۟ وَيُلَقَّوْنَ فِيهَا تَحِيَّةًۭ وَسَلَٰمًا
ayahs.sahih: Those will be awarded the Chamber for what they patiently endured, and they will be received therein with greetings and [words of] peace.
ayahs.clear: Those will be awarded the Chamber for their patience, and will be greeted therein with greetings and peace.
ayahs.kemenag: Mereka itulah orang yang dibalasi dengan martabat yang tinggi (dalam surga) karena kesabaran mereka dan mereka disambut dengan penghormatan dan ucapan selamat di dalamnya,

ayahs.arabic: خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَا ۚ حَسُنَتْ مُسْتَقَرًّۭا وَمُقَامًۭا
ayahs.sahih: Abiding eternally therein. Good is the settlement and residence.
ayahs.clear: Abiding therein forever—it is an excellent residence and destination.
ayahs.kemenag: mereka kekal di dalamnya. Surga itu sebaik-baik tempat menetap dan tempat kediaman.

ayahs.arabic: قُلْ مَا يَعْبَؤُا۟ بِكُمْ رَبِّى لَوْلَا دُعَآؤُكُمْ ۖ فَقَدْ كَذَّبْتُمْ فَسَوْفَ يَكُونُ لِزَامًۢا
ayahs.sahih: Say, "What would my Lord care for you if not for your supplication?" For you [disbelievers] have denied, so your denial is going to be adherent.
ayahs.clear: Say, “What are you to my Lord without your prayers? You have denied the truth, and the inevitable will happen.”
ayahs.kemenag: Katakanlah (kepada orang-orang musyrik): "Tuhanku tidak mengindahkan kamu, melainkan kalau ada ibadatmu. (Tetapi bagaimana kamu beribadat kepada-Nya), padahal kamu sungguh telah mendustakan-Nya? karena itu kelak (azab) pasti (menimpamu)".

ayahs.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ طسٓمٓ
ayahs.sahih: Ta, Seen, Meem.
ayahs.clear: Ta, Seen, Meem.
ayahs.kemenag: Thaa Siim Miim

ayahs.arabic: تِلْكَ ءَايَٰتُ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ ٱلْمُبِينِ
ayahs.sahih: These are the verses of the clear Book.
ayahs.clear: These are the Verses of the Clarifying Book.
ayahs.kemenag: Inilah ayat-ayat Al Quran yang menerangkan.

ayahs.arabic: لَعَلَّكَ بَٰخِعٌۭ نَّفْسَكَ أَلَّا يَكُونُوا۟ مُؤْمِنِينَ
ayahs.sahih: Perhaps, [O Muhammad], you would kill yourself with grief that they will not be believers.
ayahs.clear: Perhaps you will destroy yourself with grief, because they do not become believers.
ayahs.kemenag: Boleh jadi kamu (Muhammad) akan membinasakan dirimu, karena mereka tidak beriman.

ayahs.arabic: إِن نَّشَأْ نُنَزِّلْ عَلَيْهِم مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ ءَايَةًۭ فَظَلَّتْ أَعْنَٰقُهُمْ لَهَا خَٰضِعِينَ
ayahs.sahih: If We willed, We could send down to them from the sky a sign for which their necks would remain humbled.
ayahs.clear: If We will, We can send down upon them a sign from heaven, at which their necks will stay bent in humility.
ayahs.kemenag: Jika kami kehendaki niscaya Kami menurunkan kepada mereka mukjizat dari langit, maka senantiasa kuduk-kuduk mereka tunduk kepadanya.

ayahs.arabic: وَمَا يَأْتِيهِم مِّن ذِكْرٍۢ مِّنَ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ مُحْدَثٍ إِلَّا كَانُوا۟ عَنْهُ مُعْرِضِينَ
ayahs.sahih: And no revelation comes to them anew from the Most Merciful except that they turn away from it.
ayahs.clear: No fresh reminder comes to them from the Most Merciful, but they turn their backs at it.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan sekali-kali tidak datang kepada mereka suatu peringatan baru dari Tuhan Yang Maha Pemurah, melainkan mereka selalu berpaling daripadanya.

ayahs.arabic: فَقَدْ كَذَّبُوا۟ فَسَيَأْتِيهِمْ أَنۢبَٰٓؤُا۟ مَا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ
ayahs.sahih: For they have already denied, but there will come to them the news of that which they used to ridicule.
ayahs.clear: They have denied the truth, but soon will come to them the news of what they ridiculed.
ayahs.kemenag: Sungguh mereka telah mendustakan (Al Quran), maka kelak akan datang kepada mereka (kenyataan dari) berita-berita yang selalu mereka perolok-olokkan.

ayahs.arabic: أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ إِلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ كَمْ أَنۢبَتْنَا فِيهَا مِن كُلِّ زَوْجٍۢ كَرِيمٍ
ayahs.sahih: Did they not look at the earth - how much We have produced therein from every noble kind?
ayahs.clear: Have they not seen the earth, and how many beautiful pairs We produced therein?
ayahs.kemenag: Dan apakah mereka tidak memperhatikan bumi, berapakah banyaknya Kami tumbuhkan di bumi itu pelbagai macam tumbuh-tumbuhan yang baik?

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَةًۭ ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
ayahs.sahih: Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.
ayahs.clear: Surely in this is a sign, but most of them are not believers.
ayahs.kemenag: Sesungguhnya pada yang demikian itu benar-benar terdapat suatu tanda kekuasaan Allah. Dan kebanyakan mereka tidak beriman.

ayahs.arabic: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
ayahs.sahih: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.
ayahs.clear: Most surely, your Lord is the Almighty, the Merciful.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan sesungguhnya Tuhanmu benar-benar Dialah Yang Maha Perkasa lagi Maha Penyayang.

ayahs.arabic: وَإِذْ نَادَىٰ رَبُّكَ مُوسَىٰٓ أَنِ ٱئْتِ ٱلْقَوْمَ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ
ayahs.sahih: And [mention] when your Lord called Moses, [saying], "Go to the wrongdoing people -
ayahs.clear: Your Lord called to Moses, “Go to the tyrannical people.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan (ingatlah) ketika Tuhanmu menyeru Musa (dengan firman-Nya): "Datangilah kaum yang zalim itu,

ayahs.arabic: قَوْمَ فِرْعَوْنَ ۚ أَلَا يَتَّقُونَ
ayahs.sahih: The people of Pharaoh. Will they not fear Allah?"
ayahs.clear: The people of Pharaoh. Will they not fear?”
ayahs.kemenag: (yaitu) kaum Fir'aun. Mengapa mereka tidak bertakwa?"

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ إِنِّىٓ أَخَافُ أَن يُكَذِّبُونِ
ayahs.sahih: He said, "My Lord, indeed I fear that they will deny me
ayahs.clear: He said, “My Lord, I fear they will reject me.
ayahs.kemenag: Berkata Musa: "Ya Tuhanku, sesungguhnya aku takut bahwa mereka akan mendustakan aku.

ayahs.arabic: وَيَضِيقُ صَدْرِى وَلَا يَنطَلِقُ لِسَانِى فَأَرْسِلْ إِلَىٰ هَٰرُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And that my breast will tighten and my tongue will not be fluent, so send for Aaron.
ayahs.clear: And I become stressed, and my tongue is not fluent, so send Aaron too.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan (karenanya) sempitlah dadaku dan tidak lancar lidahku maka utuslah (Jibril) kepada Harun.

ayahs.arabic: وَلَهُمْ عَلَىَّ ذَنۢبٌۭ فَأَخَافُ أَن يَقْتُلُونِ
ayahs.sahih: And they have upon me a [claim due to] sin, so I fear that they will kill me."
ayahs.clear: And they have a charge against me, so I fear they will kill me.”
ayahs.kemenag: Dan aku berdosa terhadap mereka, maka aku takut mereka akan membunuhku".

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ كَلَّا ۖ فَٱذْهَبَا بِـَٔايَٰتِنَآ ۖ إِنَّا مَعَكُم مُّسْتَمِعُونَ
ayahs.sahih: [Allah] said, "No. Go both of you with Our signs; indeed, We are with you, listening.
ayahs.clear: He said, “No. Go, both of you, with Our proofs. We will be with you, listening.
ayahs.kemenag: Allah berfirman: "Jangan takut (mereka tidak akan dapat membunuhmu), maka pergilah kamu berdua dengan membawa ayat-ayat Kami (mukjizat-mukjizat); sesungguhnya Kami bersamamu mendengarkan (apa-apa yang mereka katakan),

ayahs.arabic: فَأْتِيَا فِرْعَوْنَ فَقُولَآ إِنَّا رَسُولُ رَبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
ayahs.sahih: Go to Pharaoh and say, 'We are the messengers of the Lord of the worlds,
ayahs.clear: Go to Pharaoh, and say, ‘We are the Messengers of the Lord of the Worlds.
ayahs.kemenag: Maka datanglah kamu berdua kepada Fir'aun dan katakanlah olehmu: "Sesungguhnya Kami adalah Rasul Tuhan semesta alam,

ayahs.arabic: أَنْ أَرْسِلْ مَعَنَا بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ
ayahs.sahih: [Commanded to say], "Send with us the Children of Israel."'"
ayahs.clear: Let the Children of Israel go with us.'“
ayahs.kemenag: lepaskanlah Bani Israil (pergi) beserta kami".

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ أَلَمْ نُرَبِّكَ فِينَا وَلِيدًۭا وَلَبِثْتَ فِينَا مِنْ عُمُرِكَ سِنِينَ
ayahs.sahih: [Pharaoh] said, "Did we not raise you among us as a child, and you remained among us for years of your life?
ayahs.clear: He said, “Did we not raise you among us as a child, and you stayed among us for many of your years?
ayahs.kemenag: Fir'aun menjawab: "Bukankah kami telah mengasuhmu di antara (keluarga) kami, waktu kamu masih kanak-kanak dan kamu tinggal bersama kami beberapa tahun dari umurmu.

ayahs.arabic: وَفَعَلْتَ فَعْلَتَكَ ٱلَّتِى فَعَلْتَ وَأَنتَ مِنَ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ
ayahs.sahih: And [then] you did your deed which you did, and you were of the ungrateful."
ayahs.clear: And you committed that deed you committed, and you were ungrateful.”
ayahs.kemenag: dan kamu telah berbuat suatu perbuatan yang telah kamu lakukan itu dan kamu termasuk golongan orang-orang yang tidak membalas guna.

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ فَعَلْتُهَآ إِذًۭا وَأَنَا۠ مِنَ ٱلضَّآلِّينَ
ayahs.sahih: [Moses] said, "I did it, then, while I was of those astray.
ayahs.clear: He said, “I did it then, when I was of those astray.
ayahs.kemenag: Berkata Musa: "Aku telah melakukannya, sedang aku di waktu itu termasuk orang-orang yang khilaf.

ayahs.arabic: فَفَرَرْتُ مِنكُمْ لَمَّا خِفْتُكُمْ فَوَهَبَ لِى رَبِّى حُكْمًۭا وَجَعَلَنِى مِنَ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
ayahs.sahih: So I fled from you when I feared you. Then my Lord granted me wisdom and prophethood and appointed me [as one] of the messengers.
ayahs.clear: And I fled from you when I feared you; but my Lord gave me wisdom, and made me one of the messengers.
ayahs.kemenag: Lalu aku lari meninggalkan kamu ketika aku takut kepadamu, kemudian Tuhanku memberikan kepadaku ilmu serta Dia menjadikanku salah seorang di antara rasul-rasul.

ayahs.arabic: وَتِلْكَ نِعْمَةٌۭ تَمُنُّهَا عَلَىَّ أَنْ عَبَّدتَّ بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ
ayahs.sahih: And is this a favor of which you remind me - that you have enslaved the Children of Israel?"
ayahs.clear: Is that the favor you taunt me with, although you have enslaved the Children of Israel?”
ayahs.kemenag: Budi yang kamu limpahkan kepadaku itu adalah (disebabkan) kamu telah memperbudak Bani Israil".

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ فِرْعَوْنُ وَمَا رَبُّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
ayahs.sahih: Said Pharaoh, "And what is the Lord of the worlds?"
ayahs.clear: Pharaoh said, “And what is the Lord of the Worlds?”
ayahs.kemenag: Fir'aun bertanya: "Siapa Tuhan semesta alam itu?"

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ رَبُّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَآ ۖ إِن كُنتُم مُّوقِنِينَ
ayahs.sahih: [Moses] said, "The Lord of the heavens and earth and that between them, if you should be convinced."
ayahs.clear: He said, “The Lord of the heavens and the earth, and everything between them, if you are aware.”
ayahs.kemenag: Musa menjawab: "Tuhan Pencipta langit dan bumi dan apa-apa yang di antara keduanya (Itulah Tuhanmu), jika kamu sekalian (orang-orang) mempercayai-Nya".

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ لِمَنْ حَوْلَهُۥٓ أَلَا تَسْتَمِعُونَ
ayahs.sahih: [Pharaoh] said to those around him, "Do you not hear?"
ayahs.clear: He said to those around him, “Do you not hear?”
ayahs.kemenag: Berkata Fir'aun kepada orang-orang sekelilingnya: "Apakah kamu tidak mendengarkan?"

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ رَبُّكُمْ وَرَبُّ ءَابَآئِكُمُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
ayahs.sahih: [Moses] said, "Your Lord and the Lord of your first forefathers."
ayahs.clear: He said, “Your Lord and the Lord of your ancestors of old.”
ayahs.kemenag: Musa berkata (pula): "Tuhan kamu dan Tuhan nenek-nenek moyang kamu yang dahulu".

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ إِنَّ رَسُولَكُمُ ٱلَّذِىٓ أُرْسِلَ إِلَيْكُمْ لَمَجْنُونٌۭ
ayahs.sahih: [Pharaoh] said, "Indeed, your 'messenger' who has been sent to you is mad."
ayahs.clear: He said, “This messenger of yours, who is sent to you, is crazy.”
ayahs.kemenag: Fir'aun berkata: "Sesungguhnya Rasulmu yang diutus kepada kamu sekalian benar-benar orang gila".

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ رَبُّ ٱلْمَشْرِقِ وَٱلْمَغْرِبِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَآ ۖ إِن كُنتُمْ تَعْقِلُونَ
ayahs.sahih: [Moses] said, "Lord of the east and the west and that between them, if you were to reason."
ayahs.clear: He said, “Lord of the East and the West, and everything between them, if you understand.”
ayahs.kemenag: Musa berkata: "Tuhan yang menguasai timur dan barat dan apa yang ada di antara keduanya: (Itulah Tuhanmu) jika kamu mempergunakan akal".

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ لَئِنِ ٱتَّخَذْتَ إِلَٰهًا غَيْرِى لَأَجْعَلَنَّكَ مِنَ ٱلْمَسْجُونِينَ
ayahs.sahih: [Pharaoh] said, "If you take a god other than me, I will surely place you among those imprisoned."
ayahs.clear: He said, “If you accept any god other than me, I will make you a prisoner.”
ayahs.kemenag: Fir'aun berkata: "Sungguh jika kamu menyembah Tuhan selain aku, benar-benar aku akan menjadikan kamu salah seorang yang dipenjarakan".

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ أَوَلَوْ جِئْتُكَ بِشَىْءٍۢ مُّبِينٍۢ
ayahs.sahih: [Moses] said, "Even if I brought you proof manifest?"
ayahs.clear: He said, “What if I bring you something convincing?”
ayahs.kemenag: Musa berkata: "Dan apakah (kamu akan melakukan itu) kendatipun aku tunjukkan kepadamu sesuatu (keterangan) yang nyata?"

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ فَأْتِ بِهِۦٓ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلصَّٰدِقِينَ
ayahs.sahih: [Pharaoh] said, "Then bring it, if you should be of the truthful."
ayahs.clear: He said, “Bring it, if you are being truthful.”
ayahs.kemenag: Fir'aun berkata: "Datangkanlah sesuatu (keterangan) yang nyata itu, jika kamu adalah termasuk orang-orang yang benar".

ayahs.arabic: فَأَلْقَىٰ عَصَاهُ فَإِذَا هِىَ ثُعْبَانٌۭ مُّبِينٌۭ
ayahs.sahih: So [Moses] threw his staff, and suddenly it was a serpent manifest.
ayahs.clear: So he cast his staff; and it was a serpent, plain to see.
ayahs.kemenag: Maka Musa melemparkan tongkatnya, lalu tiba-tiba tongkat itu (menjadi) ular yang nyata.

ayahs.arabic: وَنَزَعَ يَدَهُۥ فَإِذَا هِىَ بَيْضَآءُ لِلنَّٰظِرِينَ
ayahs.sahih: And he drew out his hand; thereupon it was white for the observers.
ayahs.clear: And he pulled his hand; and it was white, for all to see.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan ia menarik tangannya (dari dalam bajunya), maka tiba-tiba tangan itu jadi putih (bersinar) bagi orang-orang yang melihatnya.

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ لِلْمَلَإِ حَوْلَهُۥٓ إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَسَٰحِرٌ عَلِيمٌۭ
ayahs.sahih: [Pharaoh] said to the eminent ones around him, "Indeed, this is a learned magician.
ayahs.clear: He said to the dignitaries around him, “This is a skilled magician.
ayahs.kemenag: Fir'aun berkata kepada pembesar-pembesar yang berada sekelilingnya: Sesungguhnya Musa ini benar-benar seorang ahli sihir yang pandai,

ayahs.arabic: يُرِيدُ أَن يُخْرِجَكُم مِّنْ أَرْضِكُم بِسِحْرِهِۦ فَمَاذَا تَأْمُرُونَ
ayahs.sahih: He wants to drive you out of your land by his magic, so what do you advise?"
ayahs.clear: He intends to drive you out of your land with his magic, so what do you recommend?”
ayahs.kemenag: ia hendak mengusir kamu dari negerimu sendiri dengan sihirnya; maka karena itu apakah yang kamu anjurkan?"

ayahs.arabic: قَالُوٓا۟ أَرْجِهْ وَأَخَاهُ وَٱبْعَثْ فِى ٱلْمَدَآئِنِ حَٰشِرِينَ
ayahs.sahih: They said, "Postpone [the matter of] him and his brother and send among the cities gatherers
ayahs.clear: They said, “Delay him and his brother, and send recruiters to the cities.
ayahs.kemenag: Mereka menjawab: "Tundalah (urusan) dia dan saudaranya dan kirimkanlah ke seluruh negeri orang-orang yang akan mengumpulkan (ahli sihir),

ayahs.arabic: يَأْتُوكَ بِكُلِّ سَحَّارٍ عَلِيمٍۢ
ayahs.sahih: Who will bring you every learned, skilled magician."
ayahs.clear: To bring you every experienced magician.”
ayahs.kemenag: niscaya mereka akan mendatangkan semua ahli sihir yang pandai kepadamu".

ayahs.arabic: فَجُمِعَ ٱلسَّحَرَةُ لِمِيقَٰتِ يَوْمٍۢ مَّعْلُومٍۢ
ayahs.sahih: So the magicians were assembled for the appointment of a well-known day.
ayahs.clear: So the magicians were gathered for the appointment on a specified day.
ayahs.kemenag: Lalu dikumpulkan ahli-ahli sihir pada waktu yang ditetapkan di hari yang maklum,

ayahs.arabic: وَقِيلَ لِلنَّاسِ هَلْ أَنتُم مُّجْتَمِعُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And it was said to the people, "Will you congregate
ayahs.clear: And it was said to the people, “Are you all gathered?
ayahs.kemenag: dan dikatakan kepada orang banyak: "Berkumpullah kamu sekalian.

ayahs.arabic: لَعَلَّنَا نَتَّبِعُ ٱلسَّحَرَةَ إِن كَانُوا۟ هُمُ ٱلْغَٰلِبِينَ
ayahs.sahih: That we might follow the magicians if they are the predominant?"
ayahs.clear: That we may follow the magicians, if they are the winners.”
ayahs.kemenag: semoga kita mengikuti ahli-ahli sihir jika mereka adalah orang-orang yang menang"

ayahs.arabic: فَلَمَّا جَآءَ ٱلسَّحَرَةُ قَالُوا۟ لِفِرْعَوْنَ أَئِنَّ لَنَا لَأَجْرًا إِن كُنَّا نَحْنُ ٱلْغَٰلِبِينَ
ayahs.sahih: And when the magicians arrived, they said to Pharaoh, "Is there indeed for us a reward if we are the predominant?"
ayahs.clear: When the magicians arrived, they said to Pharaoh, “Is there a reward for us, if we are the winners?”
ayahs.kemenag: Maka tatkala ahli-ahli sihir datang, merekapun bertanya kepada Fir'aun: "Apakah kami sungguh-sungguh mendapat upah yang besar jika kami adalah orang-orang yang menang?"

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ نَعَمْ وَإِنَّكُمْ إِذًۭا لَّمِنَ ٱلْمُقَرَّبِينَ
ayahs.sahih: He said, "Yes, and indeed, you will then be of those near [to me]."
ayahs.clear: He said, “Yes, and you will be among those favored.”
ayahs.kemenag: Fir'aun menjawab: "Ya, kalau demikian, sesungguhnya kamu sekalian benar-benar akan menjadi orang yang didekatkan (kepadaku)".

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ لَهُم مُّوسَىٰٓ أَلْقُوا۟ مَآ أَنتُم مُّلْقُونَ
ayahs.sahih: Moses said to them, "Throw whatever you will throw."
ayahs.clear: Moses said to them, “Present what you intend to present.”
ayahs.kemenag: Berkatalah Musa kepada mereka: "Lemparkanlah apa yang hendak kamu lemparkan".

ayahs.arabic: فَأَلْقَوْا۟ حِبَالَهُمْ وَعِصِيَّهُمْ وَقَالُوا۟ بِعِزَّةِ فِرْعَوْنَ إِنَّا لَنَحْنُ ٱلْغَٰلِبُونَ
ayahs.sahih: So they threw their ropes and their staffs and said, "By the might of Pharaoh, indeed it is we who are predominant."
ayahs.clear: So they threw their ropes and their sticks, and said, “By the majesty of Pharaoh, we will be the winners.”
ayahs.kemenag: Lalu mereka melemparkan tali temali dan tongkat-tongkat mereka dan berkata: "Demi kekuasaan Fir'aun, sesungguhnya kami benar-benar akan menang".

ayahs.arabic: فَأَلْقَىٰ مُوسَىٰ عَصَاهُ فَإِذَا هِىَ تَلْقَفُ مَا يَأْفِكُونَ
ayahs.sahih: Then Moses threw his staff, and at once it devoured what they falsified.
ayahs.clear: Then Moses threw his staff, and behold, it began swallowing their trickery.
ayahs.kemenag: Kemudian Musa menjatuhkan tongkatnya maka tiba-tiba ia menelan benda-benda palsu yang mereka ada-adakan itu.

ayahs.arabic: فَأُلْقِىَ ٱلسَّحَرَةُ سَٰجِدِينَ
ayahs.sahih: So the magicians fell down in prostration [to Allah].
ayahs.clear: And the magicians fell down prostrating.
ayahs.kemenag: Maka tersungkurlah ahli-ahli sihir sambil bersujud (kepada Allah),

ayahs.arabic: قَالُوٓا۟ ءَامَنَّا بِرَبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
ayahs.sahih: They said, "We have believed in the Lord of the worlds,
ayahs.clear: They said, “We have believed in the Lord of the Worlds.
ayahs.kemenag: mereka berkata: "Kami beriman kepada Tuhan semesta alam,

ayahs.arabic: رَبِّ مُوسَىٰ وَهَٰرُونَ
ayahs.sahih: The Lord of Moses and Aaron."
ayahs.clear: The Lord of Moses and Aaron.”
ayahs.kemenag: (yaitu) Tuhan Musa dan Harun".

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ ءَامَنتُمْ لَهُۥ قَبْلَ أَنْ ءَاذَنَ لَكُمْ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ لَكَبِيرُكُمُ ٱلَّذِى عَلَّمَكُمُ ٱلسِّحْرَ فَلَسَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ ۚ لَأُقَطِّعَنَّ أَيْدِيَكُمْ وَأَرْجُلَكُم مِّنْ خِلَٰفٍۢ وَلَأُصَلِّبَنَّكُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
ayahs.sahih: [Pharaoh] said, "You believed Moses before I gave you permission. Indeed, he is your leader who has taught you magic, but you are going to know. I will surely cut off your hands and your feet on opposite sides, and I will surely crucify you all."
ayahs.clear: He said, “Did you believe in Him before I have given you permission? He must be your chief, who taught you magic. You will soon know. I will cut off your hands and feet on opposite sides, and I will crucify you all.”
ayahs.kemenag: Fir'aun berkata: "Apakah kamu sekalian beriman kepada Musa sebelum aku memberi izin kepadamu? Sesungguhnya dia benar-benar pemimpinmu yang mengajarkan sihir kepadamu maka kamu nanti pasti benar-benar akan mengetahui (akibat perbuatanmu); sesungguhnya aku akan memotong tanganmu dan kakimu dengan bersilangan dan aku akan menyalibmu semuanya".

ayahs.arabic: قَالُوا۟ لَا ضَيْرَ ۖ إِنَّآ إِلَىٰ رَبِّنَا مُنقَلِبُونَ
ayahs.sahih: They said, "No harm. Indeed, to our Lord we will return.
ayahs.clear: They said, “No problem. To our Lord we will return.
ayahs.kemenag: Mereka berkata: "Tidak ada kemudharatan (bagi kami); sesungguhnya kami akan kembali kepada Tuhan kami,

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّا نَطْمَعُ أَن يَغْفِرَ لَنَا رَبُّنَا خَطَٰيَٰنَآ أَن كُنَّآ أَوَّلَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
ayahs.sahih: Indeed, we aspire that our Lord will forgive us our sins because we were the first of the believers."
ayahs.clear: We are eager for our Lord to forgive us our sins, since we are the first of the believers.”
ayahs.kemenag: sesungguhnya kami amat menginginkan bahwa Tuhan kami akan mengampuni kesalahan kami, karena kami adalah orang-orang yang pertama-tama beriman".

ayahs.arabic: ۞ وَأَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَىٰ مُوسَىٰٓ أَنْ أَسْرِ بِعِبَادِىٓ إِنَّكُم مُّتَّبَعُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And We inspired to Moses, "Travel by night with My servants; indeed, you will be pursued."
ayahs.clear: And We inspired Moses: “Travel with My servants by night. You will be followed.”
ayahs.kemenag: Dan Kami wahyukan (perintahkan) kepada Musa: "Pergilah di malam hari dengan membawa hamba-hamba-Ku (Bani Israil), karena sesungguhnya kamu sekalian akan disusuli".

ayahs.arabic: فَأَرْسَلَ فِرْعَوْنُ فِى ٱلْمَدَآئِنِ حَٰشِرِينَ
ayahs.sahih: Then Pharaoh sent among the cities gatherers
ayahs.clear: Pharaoh sent heralds to the cities.
ayahs.kemenag: Kemudian Fir'aun mengirimkan orang yang mengumpulkan (tentaranya) ke kota-kota.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ لَشِرْذِمَةٌۭ قَلِيلُونَ
ayahs.sahih: [And said], "Indeed, those are but a small band,
ayahs.clear: “These are a small gang.
ayahs.kemenag: (Fir'aun berkata): "Sesungguhnya mereka (Bani Israil) benar-benar golongan kecil,

ayahs.arabic: وَإِنَّهُمْ لَنَا لَغَآئِظُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And indeed, they are enraging us,
ayahs.clear: And they are enraging us.
ayahs.kemenag: dan sesungguhnya mereka membuat hal-hal yang menimbulkan amarah kita,

ayahs.arabic: وَإِنَّا لَجَمِيعٌ حَٰذِرُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And indeed, we are a cautious society... "
ayahs.clear: But we are a vigilant multitude.”
ayahs.kemenag: dan sesungguhnya kita benar-benar golongan yang selalu berjaga-jaga".

ayahs.arabic: فَأَخْرَجْنَٰهُم مِّن جَنَّٰتٍۢ وَعُيُونٍۢ
ayahs.sahih: So We removed them from gardens and springs
ayahs.clear: So We drove them out of gardens and springs.
ayahs.kemenag: Maka Kami keluarkan Fir'aun dan kaumnya dari taman-taman dan mata air,

ayahs.arabic: وَكُنُوزٍۢ وَمَقَامٍۢ كَرِيمٍۢ
ayahs.sahih: And treasures and honorable station -
ayahs.clear: And treasures and noble dwellings.
ayahs.kemenag: dan (dari) perbendaharaan dan kedudukan yang mulia,

ayahs.arabic: كَذَٰلِكَ وَأَوْرَثْنَٰهَا بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ
ayahs.sahih: Thus. And We caused to inherit it the Children of Israel.
ayahs.clear: So it was. And We made the Children of Israel inherit them.
ayahs.kemenag: demikianlah halnya dan Kami anugerahkan semuanya (itu) kepada Bani Israil.

ayahs.arabic: فَأَتْبَعُوهُم مُّشْرِقِينَ
ayahs.sahih: So they pursued them at sunrise.
ayahs.clear: And they pursued them at sunrise.
ayahs.kemenag: Maka Fir'aun dan bala tentaranya dapat menyusuli mereka di waktu matahari terbit.

ayahs.arabic: فَلَمَّا تَرَٰٓءَا ٱلْجَمْعَانِ قَالَ أَصْحَٰبُ مُوسَىٰٓ إِنَّا لَمُدْرَكُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And when the two companies saw one another, the companions of Moses said, "Indeed, we are to be overtaken!"
ayahs.clear: When the two groups sighted each other, the followers of Moses said, “We are being overtaken.”
ayahs.kemenag: Maka setelah kedua golongan itu saling melihat, berkatalah pengikut-pengikut Musa: "Sesungguhnya kita benar-benar akan tersusul".

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ كَلَّآ ۖ إِنَّ مَعِىَ رَبِّى سَيَهْدِينِ
ayahs.sahih: [Moses] said, "No! Indeed, with me is my Lord; He will guide me."
ayahs.clear: He said, “No; my Lord is with me, He will guide me.”
ayahs.kemenag: Musa menjawab: "Sekali-kali tidak akan tersusul; sesungguhnya Tuhanku besertaku, kelak Dia akan memberi petunjuk kepadaku".

ayahs.arabic: فَأَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَىٰ مُوسَىٰٓ أَنِ ٱضْرِب بِّعَصَاكَ ٱلْبَحْرَ ۖ فَٱنفَلَقَ فَكَانَ كُلُّ فِرْقٍۢ كَٱلطَّوْدِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
ayahs.sahih: Then We inspired to Moses, "Strike with your staff the sea," and it parted, and each portion was like a great towering mountain.
ayahs.clear: We inspired Moses: “Strike the sea with your staff.” Whereupon it parted, and each part was like a huge hill.
ayahs.kemenag: Lalu Kami wahyukan kepada Musa: "Pukullah lautan itu dengan tongkatmu". Maka terbelahlah lautan itu dan tiap-tiap belahan adalah seperti gunung yang besar.

ayahs.arabic: وَأَزْلَفْنَا ثَمَّ ٱلْءَاخَرِينَ
ayahs.sahih: And We advanced thereto the pursuers.
ayahs.clear: And there We brought the others near.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan di sanalah Kami dekatkan golongan yang lain.

ayahs.arabic: وَأَنجَيْنَا مُوسَىٰ وَمَن مَّعَهُۥٓ أَجْمَعِينَ
ayahs.sahih: And We saved Moses and those with him, all together.
ayahs.clear: And We saved Moses and those with him, all together.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan Kami selamatkan Musa dan orang-orang yang besertanya semuanya.

ayahs.arabic: ثُمَّ أَغْرَقْنَا ٱلْءَاخَرِينَ
ayahs.sahih: Then We drowned the others.
ayahs.clear: Then We drowned the others.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan Kami tenggelamkan golongan yang lain itu.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَةًۭ ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
ayahs.sahih: Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.
ayahs.clear: In that there is a sign, but most of them are not believers.
ayahs.kemenag: Sesungguhnya pada yang demikian itu benar-benar merupakan suatu tanda yang besar (mukjizat) dan tetapi adalah kebanyakan mereka tidak beriman.

ayahs.arabic: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
ayahs.sahih: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.
ayahs.clear: Surely, your Lord is the Almighty, the Merciful.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan sesungguhnya Tuhanmu benar-benar Dialah Yang Maha Perkasa lagi Maha Penyayang.

ayahs.arabic: وَٱتْلُ عَلَيْهِمْ نَبَأَ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ
ayahs.sahih: And recite to them the news of Abraham,
ayahs.clear: And relate to them the story of Abraham.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan bacakanlah kepada mereka kisah Ibrahim.

ayahs.arabic: إِذْ قَالَ لِأَبِيهِ وَقَوْمِهِۦ مَا تَعْبُدُونَ
ayahs.sahih: When he said to his father and his people, "What do you worship?"
ayahs.clear: When he said to his father and his people, “What do you worship?”
ayahs.kemenag: Ketika ia berkata kepada bapaknya dan kaumnya: "Apakah yang kamu sembah?"

ayahs.arabic: قَالُوا۟ نَعْبُدُ أَصْنَامًۭا فَنَظَلُّ لَهَا عَٰكِفِينَ
ayahs.sahih: They said, "We worship idols and remain to them devoted."
ayahs.clear: They said, “We worship idols, and we remain devoted to them.”
ayahs.kemenag: Mereka menjawab: "Kami menyembah berhala-berhala dan kami senantiasa tekun menyembahnya".

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ هَلْ يَسْمَعُونَكُمْ إِذْ تَدْعُونَ
ayahs.sahih: He said, "Do they hear you when you supplicate?
ayahs.clear: He said, “Do they hear you when you pray?
ayahs.kemenag: Berkata Ibrahim: "Apakah berhala-berhala itu mendengar (doa)mu sewaktu kamu berdoa (kepadanya)?,

ayahs.arabic: أَوْ يَنفَعُونَكُمْ أَوْ يَضُرُّونَ
ayahs.sahih: Or do they benefit you, or do they harm?"
ayahs.clear: Or do they benefit you, or harm you?”
ayahs.kemenag: atau (dapatkah) mereka memberi manfaat kepadamu atau memberi mudharat?"

ayahs.arabic: قَالُوا۟ بَلْ وَجَدْنَآ ءَابَآءَنَا كَذَٰلِكَ يَفْعَلُونَ
ayahs.sahih: They said, "But we found our fathers doing thus."
ayahs.clear: They said, “But we found our ancestors doing so.”
ayahs.kemenag: Mereka menjawab: "(Bukan karena itu) sebenarnya kami mendapati nenek moyang kami berbuat demikian".

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ أَفَرَءَيْتُم مَّا كُنتُمْ تَعْبُدُونَ
ayahs.sahih: He said, "Then do you see what you have been worshipping,
ayahs.clear: He said, “Have you considered what you worship.
ayahs.kemenag: Ibrahim berkata: "Maka apakah kamu telah memperhatikan apa yang selalu kamu sembah,

ayahs.arabic: أَنتُمْ وَءَابَآؤُكُمُ ٱلْأَقْدَمُونَ
ayahs.sahih: You and your ancient forefathers?
ayahs.clear: You and your ancient ancestors?
ayahs.kemenag: kamu dan nenek moyang kamu yang dahulu?,

ayahs.arabic: فَإِنَّهُمْ عَدُوٌّۭ لِّىٓ إِلَّا رَبَّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
ayahs.sahih: Indeed, they are enemies to me, except the Lord of the worlds,
ayahs.clear: They are enemies to me, but not so the Lord of the Worlds.
ayahs.kemenag: karena sesungguhnya apa yang kamu sembah itu adalah musuhku, kecuali Tuhan Semesta Alam,

ayahs.arabic: ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَنِى فَهُوَ يَهْدِينِ
ayahs.sahih: Who created me, and He [it is who] guides me.
ayahs.clear: He who created me, and guides me.
ayahs.kemenag: (yaitu Tuhan) Yang telah menciptakan aku, maka Dialah yang menunjuki aku,

ayahs.arabic: وَٱلَّذِى هُوَ يُطْعِمُنِى وَيَسْقِينِ
ayahs.sahih: And it is He who feeds me and gives me drink.
ayahs.clear: He who feeds me, and waters me.
ayahs.kemenag: dan Tuhanku, Yang Dia memberi makan dan minum kepadaku,

ayahs.arabic: وَإِذَا مَرِضْتُ فَهُوَ يَشْفِينِ
ayahs.sahih: And when I am ill, it is He who cures me
ayahs.clear: And when I get sick, He heals me.
ayahs.kemenag: dan apabila aku sakit, Dialah Yang menyembuhkan aku,

ayahs.arabic: وَٱلَّذِى يُمِيتُنِى ثُمَّ يُحْيِينِ
ayahs.sahih: And who will cause me to die and then bring me to life
ayahs.clear: He who makes me die, and then revives me.
ayahs.kemenag: dan Yang akan mematikan aku, kemudian akan menghidupkan aku (kembali),

ayahs.arabic: وَٱلَّذِىٓ أَطْمَعُ أَن يَغْفِرَ لِى خَطِيٓـَٔتِى يَوْمَ ٱلدِّينِ
ayahs.sahih: And who I aspire that He will forgive me my sin on the Day of Recompense."
ayahs.clear: He who, I hope, will forgive my sins on the Day of the Reckoning.”
ayahs.kemenag: dan Yang amat kuinginkan akan mengampuni kesalahanku pada hari kiamat".

ayahs.arabic: رَبِّ هَبْ لِى حُكْمًۭا وَأَلْحِقْنِى بِٱلصَّٰلِحِينَ
ayahs.sahih: [And he said], "My Lord, grant me authority and join me with the righteous.
ayahs.clear: “My Lord! Grant me wisdom, and include me with the righteous.
ayahs.kemenag: (Ibrahim berdoa): "Ya Tuhanku, berikanlah kepadaku hikmah dan masukkanlah aku ke dalam golongan orang-orang yang saleh,

ayahs.arabic: وَٱجْعَل لِّى لِسَانَ صِدْقٍۢ فِى ٱلْءَاخِرِينَ
ayahs.sahih: And grant me a reputation of honor among later generations.
ayahs.clear: And give me a reputation of truth among the others.
ayahs.kemenag: dan jadikanlah aku buah tutur yang baik bagi orang-orang (yang datang) kemudian,

ayahs.arabic: وَٱجْعَلْنِى مِن وَرَثَةِ جَنَّةِ ٱلنَّعِيمِ
ayahs.sahih: And place me among the inheritors of the Garden of Pleasure.
ayahs.clear: And make me of the inheritors of the Garden of Bliss.
ayahs.kemenag: dan jadikanlah aku termasuk orang-orang yang mempusakai surga yang penuh kenikmatan,

ayahs.arabic: وَٱغْفِرْ لِأَبِىٓ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ مِنَ ٱلضَّآلِّينَ
ayahs.sahih: And forgive my father. Indeed, he has been of those astray.
ayahs.clear: And forgive my father—he was one of the misguided.
ayahs.kemenag: dan ampunilah bapakku, karena sesungguhnya ia adalah termasuk golongan orang-orang yang sesat,

ayahs.arabic: وَلَا تُخْزِنِى يَوْمَ يُبْعَثُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And do not disgrace me on the Day they are [all] resurrected -
ayahs.clear: And do not disgrace me on the Day they are resurrected.
ayahs.kemenag: dan janganlah Engkau hinakan aku pada hari mereka dibangkitkan,

ayahs.arabic: يَوْمَ لَا يَنفَعُ مَالٌۭ وَلَا بَنُونَ
ayahs.sahih: The Day when there will not benefit [anyone] wealth or children
ayahs.clear: The Day when neither wealth nor children will help.
ayahs.kemenag: (yaitu) di hari harta dan anak-anak laki-laki tidak berguna,

ayahs.arabic: إِلَّا مَنْ أَتَى ٱللَّهَ بِقَلْبٍۢ سَلِيمٍۢ
ayahs.sahih: But only one who comes to Allah with a sound heart."
ayahs.clear: Except for him who comes to God with a sound heart.”
ayahs.kemenag: kecuali orang-orang yang menghadap Allah dengan hati yang bersih,

ayahs.arabic: وَأُزْلِفَتِ ٱلْجَنَّةُ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ
ayahs.sahih: And Paradise will be brought near [that Day] to the righteous.
ayahs.clear: And Paradise will be brought near for the righteous.
ayahs.kemenag: dan (di hari itu) didekatkanlah surga kepada orang-orang yang bertakwa,

ayahs.arabic: وَبُرِّزَتِ ٱلْجَحِيمُ لِلْغَاوِينَ
ayahs.sahih: And Hellfire will be brought forth for the deviators,
ayahs.clear: And the Blaze will be displayed to the deviators.
ayahs.kemenag: dan diperlihatkan dengan jelas neraka Jahim kepada orang-orang yang sesat",

ayahs.arabic: وَقِيلَ لَهُمْ أَيْنَ مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْبُدُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And it will be said to them, "Where are those you used to worship
ayahs.clear: And it will be said to them, “Where are those you used to worship?”
ayahs.kemenag: dan dikatakan kepada mereka: "Dimanakah berhala-berhala yang dahulu kamu selalu menyembah(nya)

ayahs.arabic: مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ هَلْ يَنصُرُونَكُمْ أَوْ يَنتَصِرُونَ
ayahs.sahih: Other than Allah? Can they help you or help themselves?"
ayahs.clear: Besides God? Can they help you, or help themselves?”
ayahs.kemenag: selain dari Allah? Dapatkah mereka menolong kamu atau menolong diri mereka sendiri?"

ayahs.arabic: فَكُبْكِبُوا۟ فِيهَا هُمْ وَٱلْغَاوُۥنَ
ayahs.sahih: So they will be overturned into Hellfire, they and the deviators
ayahs.clear: Then they will be toppled into it, together with the seducers.
ayahs.kemenag: Maka mereka (sembahan-sembahan itu) dijungkirkan ke dalam neraka bersama-sama orang-orang yang sesat,

ayahs.arabic: وَجُنُودُ إِبْلِيسَ أَجْمَعُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And the soldiers of Iblees, all together.
ayahs.clear: And the soldiers of Satan, all of them.
ayahs.kemenag: dan bala tentara iblis semuanya.

ayahs.arabic: قَالُوا۟ وَهُمْ فِيهَا يَخْتَصِمُونَ
ayahs.sahih: They will say while they dispute therein,
ayahs.clear: They will say, as they feud in it.
ayahs.kemenag: Mereka berkata sedang mereka bertengkar di dalam neraka:

ayahs.arabic: تَٱللَّهِ إِن كُنَّا لَفِى ضَلَٰلٍۢ مُّبِينٍ
ayahs.sahih: "By Allah, we were indeed in manifest error
ayahs.clear: “By God, We were in evident error.
ayahs.kemenag: "demi Allah: sungguh kita dahulu (di dunia) dalam kesesatan yang nyata,

ayahs.arabic: إِذْ نُسَوِّيكُم بِرَبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
ayahs.sahih: When we equated you with the Lord of the worlds.
ayahs.clear: For equating you with the Lord of the Worlds.
ayahs.kemenag: karena kita mempersamakan kamu dengan Tuhan semesta alam".

ayahs.arabic: وَمَآ أَضَلَّنَآ إِلَّا ٱلْمُجْرِمُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And no one misguided us except the criminals.
ayahs.clear: No one misled us except the sinners.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan tiadalah yang menyesatkan kami kecuali orang-orang yang berdosa.

ayahs.arabic: فَمَا لَنَا مِن شَٰفِعِينَ
ayahs.sahih: So now we have no intercessors
ayahs.clear: Now we have no intercessors.
ayahs.kemenag: Maka kami tidak mempunyai pemberi syafa'at seorangpun,

ayahs.arabic: وَلَا صَدِيقٍ حَمِيمٍۢ
ayahs.sahih: And not a devoted friend.
ayahs.clear: And no sincere friend.
ayahs.kemenag: dan tidak pula mempunyai teman yang akrab,

ayahs.arabic: فَلَوْ أَنَّ لَنَا كَرَّةًۭ فَنَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
ayahs.sahih: Then if we only had a return [to the world] and could be of the believers... "
ayahs.clear: If only we could have another chance, we would be among the faithful.”
ayahs.kemenag: maka sekiranya kita dapat kembali sekali lagi (ke dunia) niscaya kami menjadi orang-orang yang beriman".

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَةًۭ ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
ayahs.sahih: Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.
ayahs.clear: Surely in this is a sign, but most of them are not believers.
ayahs.kemenag: Sesungguhnya pada yang demikian itu benar-benar terdapat tanda-tanda (kekuasaan Allah), tetapi kebanyakan mereka tidak beriman.

ayahs.arabic: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
ayahs.sahih: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.
ayahs.clear: Your Lord is the Almighty, the Merciful.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan sesungguhnya Tuhanmu benar-benar Dialah Yang Maha Perkasa lagi Maha Penyayang.

ayahs.arabic: كَذَّبَتْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
ayahs.sahih: The people of Noah denied the messengers
ayahs.clear: The people of Noah disbelieved the messengers.
ayahs.kemenag: Kaum Nuh telah mendustakan para rasul.

ayahs.arabic: إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ أَخُوهُمْ نُوحٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
ayahs.sahih: When their brother Noah said to them, "Will you not fear Allah?
ayahs.clear: Their brother Noah said to them, “Do you not fear?
ayahs.kemenag: Ketika saudara mereka (Nuh) berkata kepada mereka: "Mengapa kamu tidak bertakwa?

ayahs.arabic: إِنِّى لَكُمْ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٌۭ
ayahs.sahih: Indeed, I am to you a trustworthy messenger.
ayahs.clear: I am to you a faithful messenger.
ayahs.kemenag: Sesungguhnya aku adalah seorang rasul kepercayaan (yang diutus) kepadamu,

ayahs.arabic: فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
ayahs.sahih: So fear Allah and obey me.
ayahs.clear: So fear God, and obey me.
ayahs.kemenag: maka bertakwalah kepada Allah dan taatlah kepadaku.

ayahs.arabic: وَمَآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ ۖ إِنْ أَجْرِىَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
ayahs.sahih: And I do not ask you for it any payment. My payment is only from the Lord of the worlds.
ayahs.clear: I ask of you no payment for this. My payment is only from the Lord of the Worlds.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan aku sekali-kali tidak minta upah kepadamu atas ajakan-ajakan itu; upahku tidak lain hanyalah dari Tuhan semesta alam.

ayahs.arabic: فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
ayahs.sahih: So fear Allah and obey me."
ayahs.clear: So fear God, and obey me.”
ayahs.kemenag: Maka bertakwalah kepada Allah dan taatlah kepadaku".

ayahs.arabic: ۞ قَالُوٓا۟ أَنُؤْمِنُ لَكَ وَٱتَّبَعَكَ ٱلْأَرْذَلُونَ
ayahs.sahih: They said, "Should we believe you while you are followed by the lowest [class of people]?"
ayahs.clear: They said, “Shall we believe in you, when it is the lowliest who follow you?”
ayahs.kemenag: Mereka berkata: "Apakah kami akan beriman kepadamu, padahal yang mengikuti kamu ialah orang-orang yang hina?".

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ وَمَا عِلْمِى بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ
ayahs.sahih: He said, "And what is my knowledge of what they used to do?
ayahs.clear: He said, “What do I know about what they do?
ayahs.kemenag: Nuh menjawab: "Bagaimana aku mengetahui apa yang telah mereka kerjakan?

ayahs.arabic: إِنْ حِسَابُهُمْ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّى ۖ لَوْ تَشْعُرُونَ
ayahs.sahih: Their account is only upon my Lord, if you [could] perceive.
ayahs.clear: Their account rests only with my Lord, if you have sense.
ayahs.kemenag: Perhitungan (amal perbuatan) mereka tidak lain hanyalah kepada Tuhanku, kalau kamu menyadari.

ayahs.arabic: وَمَآ أَنَا۠ بِطَارِدِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
ayahs.sahih: And I am not one to drive away the believers.
ayahs.clear: And I am not about to drive away the believers.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan aku sekali-kali tidak akan mengusir orang-orang yang beriman.

ayahs.arabic: إِنْ أَنَا۠ إِلَّا نَذِيرٌۭ مُّبِينٌۭ
ayahs.sahih: I am only a clear warner."
ayahs.clear: I am only a clear warner.”
ayahs.kemenag: Aku (ini) tidak lain melainkan pemberi peringatan yang menjelaskan".

ayahs.arabic: قَالُوا۟ لَئِن لَّمْ تَنتَهِ يَٰنُوحُ لَتَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلْمَرْجُومِينَ
ayahs.sahih: They said, "If you do not desist, O Noah, you will surely be of those who are stoned."
ayahs.clear: They said, “If you do not refrain, O Noah, you will be stoned.”
ayahs.kemenag: Mereka berkata: "Sungguh jika kamu tidak (mau) berhenti hai Nuh, niscaya benar-benar kamu akan termasuk orang-orang yang dirajam".

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ إِنَّ قَوْمِى كَذَّبُونِ
ayahs.sahih: He said, "My Lord, indeed my people have denied me.
ayahs.clear: He said, “My Lord, my people have denied me.
ayahs.kemenag: Nuh berkata: "Ya Tuhanku, sesungguhnya kaumku telah mendustakan aku;

ayahs.arabic: فَٱفْتَحْ بَيْنِى وَبَيْنَهُمْ فَتْحًۭا وَنَجِّنِى وَمَن مَّعِىَ مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
ayahs.sahih: Then judge between me and them with decisive judgement and save me and those with me of the believers."
ayahs.clear: So judge between me and them decisively, and deliver me and the believers who are with me.
ayahs.kemenag: maka itu adakanlah suatu keputusan antaraku dan antara mereka, dan selamatkanlah aku dan orang-orang yang mukmin besertaku".

ayahs.arabic: فَأَنجَيْنَٰهُ وَمَن مَّعَهُۥ فِى ٱلْفُلْكِ ٱلْمَشْحُونِ
ayahs.sahih: So We saved him and those with him in the laden ship.
ayahs.clear: So We delivered him and those with him in the laden Ark.
ayahs.kemenag: Maka Kami selamatkan Nuh dan orang-orang yang besertanya di dalam kapal yang penuh muatan.

ayahs.arabic: ثُمَّ أَغْرَقْنَا بَعْدُ ٱلْبَاقِينَ
ayahs.sahih: Then We drowned thereafter the remaining ones.
ayahs.clear: Then We drowned the rest.
ayahs.kemenag: Kemudian sesudah itu Kami tenggelamkan orang-orang yang tinggal.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَةًۭ ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
ayahs.sahih: Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.
ayahs.clear: In that is a sign, but most of them are not believers.
ayahs.kemenag: Sesungguhnya pada yang demikian itu benar-benar terdapat tanda (kekuasaan Allah), tetapi kebanyakan mereka tidak beriman.

ayahs.arabic: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
ayahs.sahih: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.
ayahs.clear: Your Lord is the Almighty, the Merciful.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan sesungguhnya Tuhanmu Dialah Yang Maha Perkasa lagi Maha Penyayang.

ayahs.arabic: كَذَّبَتْ عَادٌ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
ayahs.sahih: 'Aad denied the messengers
ayahs.clear: Aad disbelieved the messengers.
ayahs.kemenag: Kaum 'Aad telah mendustakan para rasul.

ayahs.arabic: إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ أَخُوهُمْ هُودٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
ayahs.sahih: When their brother Hud said to them, "Will you not fear Allah?
ayahs.clear: When their brother Hud said to them, “Do you not fear?
ayahs.kemenag: Ketika saudara mereka Hud berkata kepada mereka: "Mengapa kamu tidak bertakwa?

ayahs.arabic: إِنِّى لَكُمْ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٌۭ
ayahs.sahih: Indeed, I am to you a trustworthy messenger.
ayahs.clear: I am to you a faithful messenger.
ayahs.kemenag: Sesungguhnya aku adalah seorang rasul kepercayaan (yang diutus) kepadamu,

ayahs.arabic: فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
ayahs.sahih: So fear Allah and obey me.
ayahs.clear: So fear God, and obey me.
ayahs.kemenag: maka bertakwalah kepada Allah dan taatlah kepadaku.

ayahs.arabic: وَمَآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ ۖ إِنْ أَجْرِىَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
ayahs.sahih: And I do not ask you for it any payment. My payment is only from the Lord of the worlds.
ayahs.clear: I ask of you no payment for this. My payment is only from the Lord of the Worlds.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan sekali-kali aku tidak minta upah kepadamu atas ajakan itu; upahku tidak lain hanyalah dari Tuhan semesta alam.

ayahs.arabic: أَتَبْنُونَ بِكُلِّ رِيعٍ ءَايَةًۭ تَعْبَثُونَ
ayahs.sahih: Do you construct on every elevation a sign, amusing yourselves,
ayahs.clear: Do you build a monument on every height for vanity's sake?
ayahs.kemenag: Apakah kamu mendirikan pada tiap-tiap tanah tinggi bangunan untuk bermain-main,

ayahs.arabic: وَتَتَّخِذُونَ مَصَانِعَ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَخْلُدُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And take for yourselves palaces and fortresses that you might abide eternally?
ayahs.clear: And you set up fortresses, hoping to live forever?
ayahs.kemenag: dan kamu membuat benteng-benteng dengan maksud supaya kamu kekal (di dunia)?

ayahs.arabic: وَإِذَا بَطَشْتُم بَطَشْتُمْ جَبَّارِينَ
ayahs.sahih: And when you strike, you strike as tyrants.
ayahs.clear: And when you strike, you strike mercilessly?
ayahs.kemenag: Dan apabila kamu menyiksa, maka kamu menyiksa sebagai orang-orang kejam dan bengis.

ayahs.arabic: فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
ayahs.sahih: So fear Allah and obey me.
ayahs.clear: So fear God, and obey me.
ayahs.kemenag: Maka bertakwalah kepada Allah dan taatlah kepadaku.

ayahs.arabic: وَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَمَدَّكُم بِمَا تَعْلَمُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And fear He who provided you with that which you know,
ayahs.clear: And reverence Him, who supplied you with everything you know.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan bertakwalah kepada Allah yang telah menganugerahkan kepadamu apa yang kamu ketahui.

ayahs.arabic: أَمَدَّكُم بِأَنْعَٰمٍۢ وَبَنِينَ
ayahs.sahih: Provided you with grazing livestock and children
ayahs.clear: He supplied you with livestock and children.
ayahs.kemenag: Dia telah menganugerahkan kepadamu binatang-binatang ternak, dan anak-anak,

ayahs.arabic: وَجَنَّٰتٍۢ وَعُيُونٍ
ayahs.sahih: And gardens and springs.
ayahs.clear: And gardens and springs.
ayahs.kemenag: dan kebun-kebun dan mata air,

ayahs.arabic: إِنِّىٓ أَخَافُ عَلَيْكُمْ عَذَابَ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍۢ
ayahs.sahih: Indeed, I fear for you the punishment of a terrible day."
ayahs.clear: I fear for you the punishment of an awesome Day.”
ayahs.kemenag: sesungguhnya aku takut kamu akan ditimpa azab hari yang besar".

ayahs.arabic: قَالُوا۟ سَوَآءٌ عَلَيْنَآ أَوَعَظْتَ أَمْ لَمْ تَكُن مِّنَ ٱلْوَٰعِظِينَ
ayahs.sahih: They said, "It is all the same to us whether you advise or are not of the advisors.
ayahs.clear: They said, “It is the same for us, whether you lecture us, or do not lecture.
ayahs.kemenag: Mereka menjawab: "Adalah sama saja bagi kami, apakah kamu memberi nasehat atau tidak memberi nasehat,

ayahs.arabic: إِنْ هَٰذَآ إِلَّا خُلُقُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
ayahs.sahih: This is not but the custom of the former peoples,
ayahs.clear: This is nothing but morals of the ancients.
ayahs.kemenag: (agama kami) ini tidak lain hanyalah adat kebiasaan orang dahulu.

ayahs.arabic: وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمُعَذَّبِينَ
ayahs.sahih: And we are not to be punished."
ayahs.clear: And we will not be punished.”
ayahs.kemenag: dan kami sekali-kali tidak akan di "azab".

ayahs.arabic: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَأَهْلَكْنَٰهُمْ ۗ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَةًۭ ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
ayahs.sahih: And they denied him, so We destroyed them. Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.
ayahs.clear: So they denied him, and We destroyed them. Surely in this is a sign, but most of them are not believers.
ayahs.kemenag: Maka mereka mendustakan Hud, lalu Kami binasakan mereka. Sesungguhnya pada yang demikian itu benar-benar terdapat tanda (kekuasaan Allah), tetapi kebanyakan mereka tidak beriman.

ayahs.arabic: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
ayahs.sahih: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.
ayahs.clear: Your Lord is the Almighty, the Merciful.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan sesungguhnya Tuhanmu, Dialah Yang Maha Perkasa lagi Maha Penyayang.

ayahs.arabic: كَذَّبَتْ ثَمُودُ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
ayahs.sahih: Thamud denied the messengers
ayahs.clear: Thamood disbelieved the messengers.
ayahs.kemenag: Kaum Tsamud telah mendustakan rasul-rasul.

ayahs.arabic: إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ أَخُوهُمْ صَٰلِحٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
ayahs.sahih: When their brother Salih said to them, "Will you not fear Allah?
ayahs.clear: When their brother Saleh said to them, “Do you not fear?
ayahs.kemenag: Ketika saudara mereka, Shaleh, berkata kepada mereka: "Mengapa kamu tidak bertakwa?

ayahs.arabic: إِنِّى لَكُمْ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٌۭ
ayahs.sahih: Indeed, I am to you a trustworthy messenger.
ayahs.clear: I am to you a faithful messenger.
ayahs.kemenag: Sesungguhnya aku adalah seorang rasul kepercayaan (yang diutus) kepadamu,

ayahs.arabic: فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
ayahs.sahih: So fear Allah and obey me.
ayahs.clear: So fear God, and obey me.
ayahs.kemenag: maka bertakwalah kepada Allah dan taatlah kepadaku.

ayahs.arabic: وَمَآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ ۖ إِنْ أَجْرِىَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
ayahs.sahih: And I do not ask you for it any payment. My payment is only from the Lord of the worlds.
ayahs.clear: I ask of you no payment for it. My payment is only from the Lord of the Worlds.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan aku sekali-kali tidak minta upah kepadamu atas ajakan itu, upahku tidak lain hanyalah dari Tuhan semesta alam.

ayahs.arabic: أَتُتْرَكُونَ فِى مَا هَٰهُنَآ ءَامِنِينَ
ayahs.sahih: Will you be left in what is here, secure [from death],
ayahs.clear: Will you be left secure in what is here?
ayahs.kemenag: Adakah kamu akan dibiarkan tinggal disini (di negeri kamu ini) dengan aman,

ayahs.arabic: فِى جَنَّٰتٍۢ وَعُيُونٍۢ
ayahs.sahih: Within gardens and springs
ayahs.clear: In gardens and springs?
ayahs.kemenag: di dalam kebun-kebun serta mata air,

ayahs.arabic: وَزُرُوعٍۢ وَنَخْلٍۢ طَلْعُهَا هَضِيمٌۭ
ayahs.sahih: And fields of crops and palm trees with softened fruit?
ayahs.clear: And fields, and palm-trees whose fruits are delicious?
ayahs.kemenag: dan tanam-tanaman dan pohon-pohon korma yang mayangnya lembut.

ayahs.arabic: وَتَنْحِتُونَ مِنَ ٱلْجِبَالِ بُيُوتًۭا فَٰرِهِينَ
ayahs.sahih: And you carve out of the mountains, homes, with skill.
ayahs.clear: And you skillfully carve houses in the mountains?
ayahs.kemenag: Dan kamu pahat sebagian dari gunung-gunung untuk dijadikan rumah-rumah dengan rajin;

ayahs.arabic: فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
ayahs.sahih: So fear Allah and obey me.
ayahs.clear: So fear God, and obey me.
ayahs.kemenag: maka bertakwalah kepada Allah dan taatlah kepadaku;

ayahs.arabic: وَلَا تُطِيعُوٓا۟ أَمْرَ ٱلْمُسْرِفِينَ
ayahs.sahih: And do not obey the order of the transgressors,
ayahs.clear: And do not obey the command of the extravagant.
ayahs.kemenag: dan janganlah kamu mentaati perintah orang-orang yang melewati batas,

ayahs.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ يُفْسِدُونَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَا يُصْلِحُونَ
ayahs.sahih: Who cause corruption in the land and do not amend."
ayahs.clear: Who spread turmoil on earth, and do not reform.”
ayahs.kemenag: yang membuat kerusakan di muka bumi dan tidak mengadakan perbaikan".

ayahs.arabic: قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّمَآ أَنتَ مِنَ ٱلْمُسَحَّرِينَ
ayahs.sahih: They said, "You are only of those affected by magic.
ayahs.clear: They said, “You are surely one of the bewitched.
ayahs.kemenag: Mereka berkata: "Sesungguhnya kamu adalah salah seorang dari orang-orang yang kena sihir;

ayahs.arabic: مَآ أَنتَ إِلَّا بَشَرٌۭ مِّثْلُنَا فَأْتِ بِـَٔايَةٍ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلصَّٰدِقِينَ
ayahs.sahih: You are but a man like ourselves, so bring a sign, if you should be of the truthful."
ayahs.clear: You are nothing but a man like us. So bring us a sign, if you are truthful.
ayahs.kemenag: Kamu tidak lain melainkan seorang manusia seperti kami; maka datangkanlah sesuatu mukjizat, jika kamu memang termasuk orang-orang yang benar".

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ هَٰذِهِۦ نَاقَةٌۭ لَّهَا شِرْبٌۭ وَلَكُمْ شِرْبُ يَوْمٍۢ مَّعْلُومٍۢ
ayahs.sahih: He said, "This is a she-camel. For her is a [time of] drink, and for you is a [time of] drink, [each] on a known day.
ayahs.clear: He said, “This is a she-camel; she has her turn of drinking, and you have your turn of drinking—on a specified day.
ayahs.kemenag: Shaleh menjawab: "Ini seekor unta betina, ia mempunyai giliran untuk mendapatkan air, dan kamu mempunyai giliran pula untuk mendapatkan air di hari yang tertentu.

ayahs.arabic: وَلَا تَمَسُّوهَا بِسُوٓءٍۢ فَيَأْخُذَكُمْ عَذَابُ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍۢ
ayahs.sahih: And do not touch her with harm, lest you be seized by the punishment of a terrible day."
ayahs.clear: And do not touch her with harm, lest the punishment of a great day seizes you.”
ayahs.kemenag: Dan janganlah kamu sentuh unta betina itu dengan sesuatu kejahatan, yang menyebabkan kamu akan ditimpa oleh azab hari yang besar".

ayahs.arabic: فَعَقَرُوهَا فَأَصْبَحُوا۟ نَٰدِمِينَ
ayahs.sahih: But they hamstrung her and so became regretful.
ayahs.clear: But they slaughtered her, and became full of remorse.
ayahs.kemenag: Kemudian mereka membunuhnya, lalu mereka menjadi menyesal,

ayahs.arabic: فَأَخَذَهُمُ ٱلْعَذَابُ ۗ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَةًۭ ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
ayahs.sahih: And the punishment seized them. Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.
ayahs.clear: So the punishment overtook them. Surely in this is a sign, but most of them are not believers.
ayahs.kemenag: maka mereka ditimpa azab. Sesungguhnya pada yang demikian itu benar-benar terdapat bukti yang nyata. Dan adalah kebanyakan mereka tidak beriman.

ayahs.arabic: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
ayahs.sahih: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.
ayahs.clear: Your Lord is the Almighty, the Merciful.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan sesungguhnya Tuhanmu benar-benar Dialah Yang Maha Perkasa lagi Maha Penyayang.

ayahs.arabic: كَذَّبَتْ قَوْمُ لُوطٍ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
ayahs.sahih: The people of Lot denied the messengers
ayahs.clear: The people of Lot disbelieved the messengers.
ayahs.kemenag: Kaum Luth telah mendustakan rasul-rasul,

ayahs.arabic: إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ أَخُوهُمْ لُوطٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
ayahs.sahih: When their brother Lot said to them, "Will you not fear Allah?
ayahs.clear: When their brother Lot said to them, “Do you not fear?
ayahs.kemenag: ketika saudara mereka, Luth, berkata kepada mereka: mengapa kamu tidak bertakwa?"

ayahs.arabic: إِنِّى لَكُمْ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٌۭ
ayahs.sahih: Indeed, I am to you a trustworthy messenger.
ayahs.clear: I am to you a faithful messenger.
ayahs.kemenag: Sesungguhnya aku adalah seorang rasul kepercayaan (yang diutus) kepadamu,

ayahs.arabic: فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
ayahs.sahih: So fear Allah and obey me.
ayahs.clear: So fear God, and obey me.
ayahs.kemenag: maka bertakwalah kepada Allah dan taatlah kepadaku.

ayahs.arabic: وَمَآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ ۖ إِنْ أَجْرِىَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
ayahs.sahih: And I do not ask you for it any payment. My payment is only from the Lord of the worlds.
ayahs.clear: I ask of you no payment for it. My payment is only from the Lord of the Worlds.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan aku sekali-kali tidak minta upah kepadamu atas ajakan itu; upahku tidak lain hanyalah dari Tuhan semeta alam.

ayahs.arabic: أَتَأْتُونَ ٱلذُّكْرَانَ مِنَ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
ayahs.sahih: Do you approach males among the worlds
ayahs.clear: Do you approach the males of the world?
ayahs.kemenag: Mengapa kamu mendatangi jenis lelaki di antara manusia,

ayahs.arabic: وَتَذَرُونَ مَا خَلَقَ لَكُمْ رَبُّكُم مِّنْ أَزْوَٰجِكُم ۚ بَلْ أَنتُمْ قَوْمٌ عَادُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And leave what your Lord has created for you as mates? But you are a people transgressing."
ayahs.clear: And forsake the wives your Lord created for you? Indeed, you are intrusive people.”
ayahs.kemenag: dan kamu tinggalkan isteri-isteri yang dijadikan oleh Tuhanmu untukmu, bahkan kamu adalah orang-orang yang melampaui batas".

ayahs.arabic: قَالُوا۟ لَئِن لَّمْ تَنتَهِ يَٰلُوطُ لَتَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلْمُخْرَجِينَ
ayahs.sahih: They said, "If you do not desist, O Lot, you will surely be of those evicted."
ayahs.clear: They said, “Unless you refrain, O Lot, you will be expelled.”
ayahs.kemenag: Mereka menjawab: "Hai Luth, sesungguhnya jika kamu tidak berhenti, benar-benar kamu termasuk orang-orang yang diusir"

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ إِنِّى لِعَمَلِكُم مِّنَ ٱلْقَالِينَ
ayahs.sahih: He said, "Indeed, I am, toward your deed, of those who detest [it].
ayahs.clear: He said, “I certainly deplore your conduct.”
ayahs.kemenag: Luth berkata: "Sesungguhnya aku sangat benci kepada perbuatanmu".

ayahs.arabic: رَبِّ نَجِّنِى وَأَهْلِى مِمَّا يَعْمَلُونَ
ayahs.sahih: My Lord, save me and my family from [the consequence of] what they do."
ayahs.clear: “My Lord, save me and my family from what they do.”
ayahs.kemenag: (Luth berdoa): "Ya Tuhanku selamatkanlah aku beserta keluargaku dari (akibat) perbuatan yang mereka kerjakan".

ayahs.arabic: فَنَجَّيْنَٰهُ وَأَهْلَهُۥٓ أَجْمَعِينَ
ayahs.sahih: So We saved him and his family, all,
ayahs.clear: So We saved him and his family, altogether.
ayahs.kemenag: Lalu Kami selamatkan ia beserta keluarganya semua,

ayahs.arabic: إِلَّا عَجُوزًۭا فِى ٱلْغَٰبِرِينَ
ayahs.sahih: Except an old woman among those who remained behind.
ayahs.clear: Except for an old woman among those who tarried.
ayahs.kemenag: kecuali seorang perempuan tua (isterinya), yang termasuk dalam golongan yang tinggal.

ayahs.arabic: ثُمَّ دَمَّرْنَا ٱلْءَاخَرِينَ
ayahs.sahih: Then We destroyed the others.
ayahs.clear: Then We destroyed the others.
ayahs.kemenag: Kemudian Kami binasakan yang lain.

ayahs.arabic: وَأَمْطَرْنَا عَلَيْهِم مَّطَرًۭا ۖ فَسَآءَ مَطَرُ ٱلْمُنذَرِينَ
ayahs.sahih: And We rained upon them a rain [of stones], and evil was the rain of those who were warned.
ayahs.clear: And We rained down on them a rain. Dreadful is the rain of those forewarned.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan Kami hujani mereka dengan hujan (batu) maka amat jeleklah hujan yang menimpa orang-orang yang telah diberi peringatan itu.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَةًۭ ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
ayahs.sahih: Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.
ayahs.clear: Surely in this is a sign, but most of them are not believers.
ayahs.kemenag: Sesunguhnya pada yang demikian itu benar-benar terdapat bukti-bukti yang nyata. Dan adalah kebanyakan mereka tidak beriman.

ayahs.arabic: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
ayahs.sahih: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.
ayahs.clear: Your Lord is the Almighty, the Merciful.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan sesungguhnya Tuhanmu, benar-benar Dialah Yang Maha Perkasa lagi Maha Penyayang.

ayahs.arabic: كَذَّبَ أَصْحَٰبُ لْـَٔيْكَةِ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
ayahs.sahih: The companions of the thicket denied the messengers
ayahs.clear: The People of the Woods disbelieved the messengers.
ayahs.kemenag: Penduduk Aikah telah mendustakan rasul-rasul;

ayahs.arabic: إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ شُعَيْبٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
ayahs.sahih: When Shu'ayb said to them, "Will you not fear Allah?
ayahs.clear: When Shuaib said to them, “Do you not fear?
ayahs.kemenag: ketika Syu'aib berkata kepada mereka: "Mengapa kamu tidak bertakwa?,

ayahs.arabic: إِنِّى لَكُمْ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٌۭ
ayahs.sahih: Indeed, I am to you a trustworthy messenger.
ayahs.clear: I am to you a trustworthy messenger.
ayahs.kemenag: Sesungguhnya aku adalah seorang rasul kepercayaan (yang diutus) kepadamu.

ayahs.arabic: فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
ayahs.sahih: So fear Allah and obey me.
ayahs.clear: So fear God, and obey me.
ayahs.kemenag: maka bertakwalah kepada Allah dan taatlah kepadaku;

ayahs.arabic: وَمَآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ ۖ إِنْ أَجْرِىَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
ayahs.sahih: And I do not ask you for it any payment. My payment is only from the Lord of the worlds.
ayahs.clear: I ask of you no payment for it. My payment is only from the Lord of the Worlds.
ayahs.kemenag: dan aku sekali-kali tidak minta upah kepadamu atas ajakan itu; upahku tidak lain hanyalah dari Tuhan semesta alam.

ayahs.arabic: ۞ أَوْفُوا۟ ٱلْكَيْلَ وَلَا تَكُونُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلْمُخْسِرِينَ
ayahs.sahih: Give full measure and do not be of those who cause loss.
ayahs.clear: Give full measure, and do not cheat.
ayahs.kemenag: Sempurnakanlah takaran dan janganlah kamu termasuk orang-orang yang merugikan;

ayahs.arabic: وَزِنُوا۟ بِٱلْقِسْطَاسِ ٱلْمُسْتَقِيمِ
ayahs.sahih: And weigh with an even balance.
ayahs.clear: And weigh with accurate scales.
ayahs.kemenag: dan timbanglah dengan timbangan yang lurus.

ayahs.arabic: وَلَا تَبْخَسُوا۟ ٱلنَّاسَ أَشْيَآءَهُمْ وَلَا تَعْثَوْا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ مُفْسِدِينَ
ayahs.sahih: And do not deprive people of their due and do not commit abuse on earth, spreading corruption.
ayahs.clear: And do not defraud people of their belongings, and do not work corruption in the land.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan janganlah kamu merugikan manusia pada hak-haknya dan janganlah kamu merajalela di muka bumi dengan membuat kerusakan;

ayahs.arabic: وَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَكُمْ وَٱلْجِبِلَّةَ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
ayahs.sahih: And fear He who created you and the former creation."
ayahs.clear: And fear Him who created you and the masses of old.”
ayahs.kemenag: dan bertakwalah kepada Allah yang telah menciptakan kamu dan umat-umat yang dahulu".

ayahs.arabic: قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّمَآ أَنتَ مِنَ ٱلْمُسَحَّرِينَ
ayahs.sahih: They said, "You are only of those affected by magic.
ayahs.clear: They said, “You are one of those bewitched.
ayahs.kemenag: Mereka berkata: "Sesungguhnya kamu adalah salah seorang dari orang-orang yang kena sihir,

ayahs.arabic: وَمَآ أَنتَ إِلَّا بَشَرٌۭ مِّثْلُنَا وَإِن نَّظُنُّكَ لَمِنَ ٱلْكَٰذِبِينَ
ayahs.sahih: You are but a man like ourselves, and indeed, we think you are among the liars.
ayahs.clear: And you are nothing but a man like us; and we think that you are a liar.
ayahs.kemenag: dan kamu tidak lain melainkan seorang manusia seperti kami, dan sesungguhnya kami yakin bahwa kamu benar-benar termasuk orang-orang yang berdusta.

ayahs.arabic: فَأَسْقِطْ عَلَيْنَا كِسَفًۭا مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلصَّٰدِقِينَ
ayahs.sahih: So cause to fall upon us fragments of the sky, if you should be of the truthful."
ayahs.clear: So bring down on us pieces from the sky, if you are truthful.”
ayahs.kemenag: Maka jatuhkanlah atas kami gumpalan dari langit, jika kamu termasuk orang-orang yang benar.

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ رَبِّىٓ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ
ayahs.sahih: He said, "My Lord is most knowing of what you do."
ayahs.clear: He said, “My Lord is Well Aware of what you do.”
