ayahs.kemenag: Syu'aib berkata: "Tuhanku lebih mengetahui apa yang kamu kerjakan".

ayahs.arabic: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَأَخَذَهُمْ عَذَابُ يَوْمِ ٱلظُّلَّةِ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ عَذَابَ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ
ayahs.sahih: And they denied him, so the punishment of the day of the black cloud seized them. Indeed, it was the punishment of a terrible day.
ayahs.clear: But they denied him. So the punishment of the day of gloom gripped them. It was the punishment of a great day.
ayahs.kemenag: Kemudian mereka mendustakan Syu'aib, lalu mereka ditimpa azab pada hari mereka dinaungi awan. Sesungguhnya azab itu adalah azab hari yang besar.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَةًۭ ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
ayahs.sahih: Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.
ayahs.clear: Surely in this is a sign, but most of them are not believers.
ayahs.kemenag: Sesungguhnya pada yang demikian itu benar-benar terdapat tanda (kekuasaan Allah), tetapi kebanyakan mereka tidak beriman.

ayahs.arabic: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
ayahs.sahih: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.
ayahs.clear: Your Lord is the Almighty, the Merciful.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan sesungguhnya Tuhanmu benar-benar Dialah Yang Maha Perkasa lagi Maha Penyayang.

ayahs.arabic: وَإِنَّهُۥ لَتَنزِيلُ رَبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
ayahs.sahih: And indeed, the Qur'an is the revelation of the Lord of the worlds.
ayahs.clear: It is a revelation from the Lord of the Worlds.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan sesungguhnya Al Quran ini benar-benar diturunkan oleh Tuhan semesta alam,

ayahs.arabic: نَزَلَ بِهِ ٱلرُّوحُ ٱلْأَمِينُ
ayahs.sahih: The Trustworthy Spirit has brought it down
ayahs.clear: The Honest Spirit came down with it.
ayahs.kemenag: dia dibawa turun oleh Ar-Ruh Al-Amin (Jibril),

ayahs.arabic: عَلَىٰ قَلْبِكَ لِتَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلْمُنذِرِينَ
ayahs.sahih: Upon your heart, [O Muhammad] - that you may be of the warners -
ayahs.clear: Upon your heart, that you may be one of the warners.
ayahs.kemenag: ke dalam hatimu (Muhammad) agar kamu menjadi salah seorang di antara orang-orang yang memberi peringatan,

ayahs.arabic: بِلِسَانٍ عَرَبِىٍّۢ مُّبِينٍۢ
ayahs.sahih: In a clear Arabic language.
ayahs.clear: In a clear Arabic tongue.
ayahs.kemenag: dengan bahasa Arab yang jelas.

ayahs.arabic: وَإِنَّهُۥ لَفِى زُبُرِ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
ayahs.sahih: And indeed, it is [mentioned] in the scriptures of former peoples.
ayahs.clear: And it is in the scriptures of the ancients.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan sesungguhnya Al Quran itu benar-benar (tersebut) dalam Kitab-kitab orang yang dahulu.

ayahs.arabic: أَوَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُمْ ءَايَةً أَن يَعْلَمَهُۥ عُلَمَٰٓؤُا۟ بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ
ayahs.sahih: And has it not been a sign to them that it is recognized by the scholars of the Children of Israel?
ayahs.clear: Is it not a sign for them that the scholars of the Children of Israel recognized it?
ayahs.kemenag: Dan apakah tidak cukup menjadi bukti bagi mereka, bahwa para ulama Bani Israil mengetahuinya?

ayahs.arabic: وَلَوْ نَزَّلْنَٰهُ عَلَىٰ بَعْضِ ٱلْأَعْجَمِينَ
ayahs.sahih: And even if We had revealed it to one among the foreigners
ayahs.clear: Had We revealed it to one of the foreigners.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan kalau Al Quran itu Kami turunkan kepada salah seorang dari golongan bukan Arab,

ayahs.arabic: فَقَرَأَهُۥ عَلَيْهِم مَّا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ مُؤْمِنِينَ
ayahs.sahih: And he had recited it to them [perfectly], they would [still] not have been believers in it.
ayahs.clear: And he had recited it to them, they still would not have believed in it.
ayahs.kemenag: lalu ia membacakannya kepada mereka (orang-orang kafir); niscaya mereka tidak akan beriman kepadanya.

ayahs.arabic: كَذَٰلِكَ سَلَكْنَٰهُ فِى قُلُوبِ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ
ayahs.sahih: Thus have We inserted disbelief into the hearts of the criminals.
ayahs.clear: Thus We make it pass through the hearts of the guilty.
ayahs.kemenag: Demikianlah Kami masukkan Al Quran ke dalam hati orang-orang yang durhaka.

ayahs.arabic: لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِهِۦ حَتَّىٰ يَرَوُا۟ ٱلْعَذَابَ ٱلْأَلِيمَ
ayahs.sahih: They will not believe in it until they see the painful punishment.
ayahs.clear: They will not believe in it until they witness the painful punishment.
ayahs.kemenag: Mereka tidak beriman kepadanya, hingga mereka melihat azab yang pedih,

ayahs.arabic: فَيَأْتِيَهُم بَغْتَةًۭ وَهُمْ لَا يَشْعُرُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And it will come to them suddenly while they perceive [it] not.
ayahs.clear: It will come to them suddenly, while they are unaware.
ayahs.kemenag: maka datanglah azab kepada mereka dengan mendadak, sedang mereka tidak menyadarinya,

ayahs.arabic: فَيَقُولُوا۟ هَلْ نَحْنُ مُنظَرُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And they will say, "May we be reprieved?"
ayahs.clear: Then they will say, “Are we given any respite?”
ayahs.kemenag: lalu mereka berkata: "Apakah kami dapat diberi tangguh?"

ayahs.arabic: أَفَبِعَذَابِنَا يَسْتَعْجِلُونَ
ayahs.sahih: So for Our punishment are they impatient?
ayahs.clear: Do they seek to hasten Our punishment?
ayahs.kemenag: Maka apakah mereka meminta supaya disegerakan azab Kami?

ayahs.arabic: أَفَرَءَيْتَ إِن مَّتَّعْنَٰهُمْ سِنِينَ
ayahs.sahih: Then have you considered if We gave them enjoyment for years
ayahs.clear: Have you considered: if We let them enjoy themselves for some years.
ayahs.kemenag: Maka bagaimana pendapatmu jika Kami berikan kepada mereka kenikmatan hidup bertahun-tahun,

ayahs.arabic: ثُمَّ جَآءَهُم مَّا كَانُوا۟ يُوعَدُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And then there came to them that which they were promised?
ayahs.clear: Then there comes to them what they were promised.
ayahs.kemenag: Kemudian datang kepada mereka azab yang telah diancamkan kepada mereka,

ayahs.arabic: مَآ أَغْنَىٰ عَنْهُم مَّا كَانُوا۟ يُمَتَّعُونَ
ayahs.sahih: They would not be availed by the enjoyment with which they were provided.
ayahs.clear: Of what avail to them will be their past enjoyments?
ayahs.kemenag: niscaya tidak berguna bagi mereka apa yang mereka selalu menikmatinya.

ayahs.arabic: وَمَآ أَهْلَكْنَا مِن قَرْيَةٍ إِلَّا لَهَا مُنذِرُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And We did not destroy any city except that it had warners
ayahs.clear: Never did We destroy a town, but it had warners.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan Kami tidak membinasakan sesuatu negeripun, melainkan sesudah ada baginya orang-orang yang memberi peringatan;

ayahs.arabic: ذِكْرَىٰ وَمَا كُنَّا ظَٰلِمِينَ
ayahs.sahih: As a reminder; and never have We been unjust.
ayahs.clear: As a reminder—We are never unjust.
ayahs.kemenag: untuk menjadi peringatan. Dan Kami sekali-kali tidak berlaku zalim.

ayahs.arabic: وَمَا تَنَزَّلَتْ بِهِ ٱلشَّيَٰطِينُ
ayahs.sahih: And the devils have not brought the revelation down.
ayahs.clear: It was not the devils that revealed it.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan Al Quran itu bukanlah dibawa turun oleh syaitan-syaitan.

ayahs.arabic: وَمَا يَنۢبَغِى لَهُمْ وَمَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ
ayahs.sahih: It is not allowable for them, nor would they be able.
ayahs.clear: It is not in their interests, nor in their power.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan tidaklah patut mereka membawa turun Al Quran itu, dan merekapun tidak akan kuasa.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّهُمْ عَنِ ٱلسَّمْعِ لَمَعْزُولُونَ
ayahs.sahih: Indeed they, from [its] hearing, are removed.
ayahs.clear: They are barred from hearing.
ayahs.kemenag: Sesungguhnya mereka benar-benar dijauhkan daripada mendengar Al Quran itu.

ayahs.arabic: فَلَا تَدْعُ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَٰهًا ءَاخَرَ فَتَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلْمُعَذَّبِينَ
ayahs.sahih: So do not invoke with Allah another deity and [thus] be among the punished.
ayahs.clear: So do not pray to another god with God, else you will be of those tormented.
ayahs.kemenag: Maka janganlah kamu menyeru (menyembah) tuhan yang lain di samping Allah, yang menyebabkan kamu termasuk orang-orang yang diazab.

ayahs.arabic: وَأَنذِرْ عَشِيرَتَكَ ٱلْأَقْرَبِينَ
ayahs.sahih: And warn, [O Muhammad], your closest kindred.
ayahs.clear: And warn your close relatives.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan berilah peringatan kepada kerabat-kerabatmu yang terdekat,

ayahs.arabic: وَٱخْفِضْ جَنَاحَكَ لِمَنِ ٱتَّبَعَكَ مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
ayahs.sahih: And lower your wing to those who follow you of the believers.
ayahs.clear: And lower your wing to those of the believers who follow you.
ayahs.kemenag: dan rendahkanlah dirimu terhadap orang-orang yang mengikutimu, yaitu orang-orang yang beriman.

ayahs.arabic: فَإِنْ عَصَوْكَ فَقُلْ إِنِّى بَرِىٓءٌۭ مِّمَّا تَعْمَلُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And if they disobey you, then say, "Indeed, I am disassociated from what you are doing."
ayahs.clear: And if they disobey you, say, “I am innocent of what you do.”
ayahs.kemenag: Jika mereka mendurhakaimu maka katakanlah: "Sesungguhnya aku tidak bertanggung jawab terhadap apa yang kamu kerjakan";

ayahs.arabic: وَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ
ayahs.sahih: And rely upon the Exalted in Might, the Merciful,
ayahs.clear: And put your trust in the Almighty, the Merciful.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan bertawakkallah kepada (Allah) Yang Maha Perkasa lagi Maha Penyayang,

ayahs.arabic: ٱلَّذِى يَرَىٰكَ حِينَ تَقُومُ
ayahs.sahih: Who sees you when you arise
ayahs.clear: He Who sees you when you rise.
ayahs.kemenag: Yang melihat kamu ketika kamu berdiri (untuk sembahyang),

ayahs.arabic: وَتَقَلُّبَكَ فِى ٱلسَّٰجِدِينَ
ayahs.sahih: And your movement among those who prostrate.
ayahs.clear: And your devotions amidst the worshipers.
ayahs.kemenag: dan (melihat pula) perubahan gerak badanmu di antara orang-orang yang sujud.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
ayahs.sahih: Indeed, He is the Hearing, the Knowing.
ayahs.clear: He is indeed the Hearer, the Aware.
ayahs.kemenag: Sesungguhnya Dia adalah Yang Maha Mendengar lagi Maha Mengetahui.

ayahs.arabic: هَلْ أُنَبِّئُكُمْ عَلَىٰ مَن تَنَزَّلُ ٱلشَّيَٰطِينُ
ayahs.sahih: Shall I inform you upon whom the devils descend?
ayahs.clear: Shall I inform you upon whom the devils descend?
ayahs.kemenag: Apakah akan Aku beritakan kepadamu, kepada siapa syaitan-syaitan itu turun?

ayahs.arabic: تَنَزَّلُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ أَفَّاكٍ أَثِيمٍۢ
ayahs.sahih: They descend upon every sinful liar.
ayahs.clear: They descend upon every sinful liar.
ayahs.kemenag: Mereka turun kepada tiap-tiap pendusta lagi yang banyak dosa,

ayahs.arabic: يُلْقُونَ ٱلسَّمْعَ وَأَكْثَرُهُمْ كَٰذِبُونَ
ayahs.sahih: They pass on what is heard, and most of them are liars.
ayahs.clear: They give ear, and most of them are liars.
ayahs.kemenag: mereka menghadapkan pendengaran (kepada syaitan) itu, dan kebanyakan mereka adalah orang-orang pendusta.

ayahs.arabic: وَٱلشُّعَرَآءُ يَتَّبِعُهُمُ ٱلْغَاوُۥنَ
ayahs.sahih: And the poets - [only] the deviators follow them;
ayahs.clear: And as for the poets—the deviators follow them.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan penyair-penyair itu diikuti oleh orang-orang yang sesat.

ayahs.arabic: أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّهُمْ فِى كُلِّ وَادٍۢ يَهِيمُونَ
ayahs.sahih: Do you not see that in every valley they roam
ayahs.clear: Do you not see how they ramble in every style?
ayahs.kemenag: Tidakkah kamu melihat bahwasanya mereka mengembara di tiap-tiap lembah,

ayahs.arabic: وَأَنَّهُمْ يَقُولُونَ مَا لَا يَفْعَلُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And that they say what they do not do? -
ayahs.clear: And how they say what they do not do?
ayahs.kemenag: dan bahwasanya mereka suka mengatakan apa yang mereka sendiri tidak mengerjakan(nya)?

ayahs.arabic: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ وَذَكَرُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ كَثِيرًۭا وَٱنتَصَرُوا۟ مِنۢ بَعْدِ مَا ظُلِمُوا۟ ۗ وَسَيَعْلَمُ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوٓا۟ أَىَّ مُنقَلَبٍۢ يَنقَلِبُونَ
ayahs.sahih: Except those [poets] who believe and do righteous deeds and remember Allah often and defend [the Muslims] after they were wronged. And those who have wronged are going to know to what [kind of] return they will be returned.
ayahs.clear: Except for those who believe, and do good deeds, and remember God frequently, and defend themselves after they are wronged. As for those who do wrong, they will know by what overturning they will be overturned.
ayahs.kemenag: kecuali orang-orang (penyair-penyair) yang beriman dan beramal saleh dan banyak menyebut Allah dan mendapat kemenangan sesudah menderita kezaliman. Dan orang-orang yang zalim itu kelak akan mengetahui ke tempat mana mereka akan kembali.

ayahs.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ طسٓ ۚ تِلْكَ ءَايَٰتُ ٱلْقُرْءَانِ وَكِتَابٍۢ مُّبِينٍ
ayahs.sahih: Ta, Seen. These are the verses of the Qur'an and a clear Book
ayahs.clear: Ta, Seen. These are the Signs of the Quran—a book that makes things clear.
ayahs.kemenag: Thaa Siin (Surat) ini adalah ayat-ayat Al Quran, dan (ayat-ayat) Kitab yang menjelaskan,

ayahs.arabic: هُدًۭى وَبُشْرَىٰ لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
ayahs.sahih: As guidance and good tidings for the believers
ayahs.clear: Guidance and good news for the believers.
ayahs.kemenag: untuk menjadi petunjuk dan berita gembira untuk orang-orang yang beriman,

ayahs.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ يُقِيمُونَ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَيُؤْتُونَ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ وَهُم بِٱلْءَاخِرَةِ هُمْ يُوقِنُونَ
ayahs.sahih: Who establish prayer and give zakah, and of the Hereafter they are certain [in faith].
ayahs.clear: Those who observe the prayers, and give charity regularly, and are certain of the Hereafter.
ayahs.kemenag: (yaitu) orang-orang yang mendirikan sembahyang dan menunaikan zakat dan mereka yakin akan adanya negeri akhirat.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱلْءَاخِرَةِ زَيَّنَّا لَهُمْ أَعْمَٰلَهُمْ فَهُمْ يَعْمَهُونَ
ayahs.sahih: Indeed, for those who do not believe in the Hereafter, We have made pleasing to them their deeds, so they wander blindly.
ayahs.clear: As for those who do not believe in the Hereafter: We made their deeds appear good to them, so they wander aimlessly.
ayahs.kemenag: Sesungguhnya orang-orang yang tidak beriman kepada negeri akhirat, Kami jadikan mereka memandang indah perbuatan-perbuatan mereka, maka mereka bergelimang (dalam kesesatan).

ayahs.arabic: أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ لَهُمْ سُوٓءُ ٱلْعَذَابِ وَهُمْ فِى ٱلْءَاخِرَةِ هُمُ ٱلْأَخْسَرُونَ
ayahs.sahih: Those are the ones for whom there will be the worst of punishment, and in the Hereafter they are the greatest losers.
ayahs.clear: It is they who will receive the grievous punishment—and in the Hereafter they will be the greatest losers.
ayahs.kemenag: Mereka itulah orang-orang yang mendapat (di dunia) azab yang buruk dan mereka di akhirat adalah orang-orang yang paling merugi.

ayahs.arabic: وَإِنَّكَ لَتُلَقَّى ٱلْقُرْءَانَ مِن لَّدُنْ حَكِيمٍ عَلِيمٍ
ayahs.sahih: And indeed, [O Muhammad], you receive the Qur'an from one Wise and Knowing.
ayahs.clear: You are receiving the Quran from an All-Wise, All-Knowing.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan sesungguhnya kamu benar-benar diberi Al Quran dari sisi (Allah) Yang Maha Bijaksana lagi Maha Mengetahui.

ayahs.arabic: إِذْ قَالَ مُوسَىٰ لِأَهْلِهِۦٓ إِنِّىٓ ءَانَسْتُ نَارًۭا سَـَٔاتِيكُم مِّنْهَا بِخَبَرٍ أَوْ ءَاتِيكُم بِشِهَابٍۢ قَبَسٍۢ لَّعَلَّكُمْ تَصْطَلُونَ
ayahs.sahih: [Mention] when Moses said to his family, "Indeed, I have perceived a fire. I will bring you from there information or will bring you a burning torch that you may warm yourselves."
ayahs.clear: When Moses said to his family, “I have glimpsed a fire. I will bring you some news from it; or bring you a firebrand, that you may warm yourselves.”
ayahs.kemenag: (Ingatlah) ketika Musa berkata kepada keluarganya: "Sesungguhnya aku melihat api. Aku kelak akan membawa kepadamu khabar daripadanya, atau aku membawa kepadamu suluh api supaya kamu dapat berdiang".

ayahs.arabic: فَلَمَّا جَآءَهَا نُودِىَ أَنۢ بُورِكَ مَن فِى ٱلنَّارِ وَمَنْ حَوْلَهَا وَسُبْحَٰنَ ٱللَّهِ رَبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
ayahs.sahih: But when he came to it, he was called, "Blessed is whoever is at the fire and whoever is around it. And exalted is Allah, Lord of the worlds.
ayahs.clear: Then, when he reached it, he was called: “Blessed is He who is within the fire, and He who is around it, and glorified be God, Lord of the Worlds.
ayahs.kemenag: Maka tatkala dia tiba di (tempat) api itu, diserulah dia: "Bahwa telah diberkati orang-orang yang berada di dekat api itu, dan orang-orang yang berada di sekitarnya. Dan Maha Suci Allah, Tuhan semesta alam".

ayahs.arabic: يَٰمُوسَىٰٓ إِنَّهُۥٓ أَنَا ٱللَّهُ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ
ayahs.sahih: O Moses, indeed it is I - Allah, the Exalted in Might, the Wise."
ayahs.clear: O Moses, it is I, God, the Almighty, the Wise.
ayahs.kemenag: (Allah berfirman): "Hai Musa, sesungguhnya, Akulah Allah, Yang Maha Perkasa lagi Maha Bijaksana.

ayahs.arabic: وَأَلْقِ عَصَاكَ ۚ فَلَمَّا رَءَاهَا تَهْتَزُّ كَأَنَّهَا جَآنٌّۭ وَلَّىٰ مُدْبِرًۭا وَلَمْ يُعَقِّبْ ۚ يَٰمُوسَىٰ لَا تَخَفْ إِنِّى لَا يَخَافُ لَدَىَّ ٱلْمُرْسَلُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And [he was told], "Throw down your staff." But when he saw it writhing as if it were a snake, he turned in flight and did not return. [Allah said], "O Moses, fear not. Indeed, in My presence the messengers do not fear.
ayahs.clear: Throw down your staff.” But when he saw it quivering, as though it were a demon, he turned around not looking back. “O Moses, do not fear; the messengers do not fear in My presence.
ayahs.kemenag: dan lemparkanlah tongkatmu". Maka tatkala (tongkat itu menjadi ular dan) Musa melihatnya bergerak-gerak seperti dia seekor ular yang gesit, larilah ia berbalik ke belakang tanpa menoleh. "Hai Musa, janganlah kamu takut. Sesungguhnya orang yang dijadikan rasul, tidak takut di hadapan-Ku.

ayahs.arabic: إِلَّا مَن ظَلَمَ ثُمَّ بَدَّلَ حُسْنًۢا بَعْدَ سُوٓءٍۢ فَإِنِّى غَفُورٌۭ رَّحِيمٌۭ
ayahs.sahih: Otherwise, he who wrongs, then substitutes good after evil - indeed, I am Forgiving and Merciful.
ayahs.clear: But whoever has done wrong, and then substituted goodness in place of evil. I am Forgiving and Merciful.
ayahs.kemenag: tetapi orang yang berlaku zalim, kemudian ditukarnya kezalimannya dengan kebaikan (Allah akan mengampuninya); maka seaungguhnya Aku Maha Pangampun lagi Maha Penyayang.

ayahs.arabic: وَأَدْخِلْ يَدَكَ فِى جَيْبِكَ تَخْرُجْ بَيْضَآءَ مِنْ غَيْرِ سُوٓءٍۢ ۖ فِى تِسْعِ ءَايَٰتٍ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ وَقَوْمِهِۦٓ ۚ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ قَوْمًۭا فَٰسِقِينَ
ayahs.sahih: And put your hand into the opening of your garment [at the breast]; it will come out white without disease. [These are] among the nine signs [you will take] to Pharaoh and his people. Indeed, they have been a people defiantly disobedient."
ayahs.clear: Put your hand inside your pocket, and it will come out white, without blemish—among nine miracles to Pharaoh and his people, for they are immoral people.”
ayahs.kemenag: Dan masukkanlah tanganmu ke leher bajumu, niscaya ia akan ke luar putih (bersinar) bukan karena penyakit. (Kedua mukjizat ini) termasuk sembilan buah mukjizat (yang akan dikemukakan) kepada Fir'aun dan kaumnya. Sesungguhnya mereka adalah kaum yang fasik".

ayahs.arabic: فَلَمَّا جَآءَتْهُمْ ءَايَٰتُنَا مُبْصِرَةًۭ قَالُوا۟ هَٰذَا سِحْرٌۭ مُّبِينٌۭ
ayahs.sahih: But when there came to them Our visible signs, they said, "This is obvious magic."
ayahs.clear: Yet when Our enlightening signs came to them, they said, “This is obvious witchcraft.”
ayahs.kemenag: Maka tatkala mukjizat-mukjizat Kami yang jelas itu sampai kepada mereka, berkatalah mereka: "Ini adalah sihir yang nyata".

ayahs.arabic: وَجَحَدُوا۟ بِهَا وَٱسْتَيْقَنَتْهَآ أَنفُسُهُمْ ظُلْمًۭا وَعُلُوًّۭا ۚ فَٱنظُرْ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَٰقِبَةُ ٱلْمُفْسِدِينَ
ayahs.sahih: And they rejected them, while their [inner] selves were convinced thereof, out of injustice and haughtiness. So see how was the end of the corrupters.
ayahs.clear: And they rejected them, although their souls were certain of them, out of wickedness and pride. So see how the outcome was for the mischief-makers.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan mereka mengingkarinya karena kezaliman dan kesombongan (mereka) padahal hati mereka meyakini (kebenaran)nya. Maka perhatikanlah betapa kesudahan orang-orang yang berbuat kebinasaan.

ayahs.arabic: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا دَاوُۥدَ وَسُلَيْمَٰنَ عِلْمًۭا ۖ وَقَالَا ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِى فَضَّلَنَا عَلَىٰ كَثِيرٍۢ مِّنْ عِبَادِهِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
ayahs.sahih: And We had certainly given to David and Solomon knowledge, and they said, "Praise [is due] to Allah, who has favored us over many of His believing servants."
ayahs.clear: And We gave David and Solomon knowledge. They said, “Praise God, who has favored us over many of His believing servants.”
ayahs.kemenag: Dan sesungguhnya Kami telah memberi ilmu kepada Daud dan Sulaiman; dan keduanya mengucapkan: "Segala puji bagi Allah yang melebihkan kami dari kebanyakan hamba-hambanya yang beriman".

ayahs.arabic: وَوَرِثَ سُلَيْمَٰنُ دَاوُۥدَ ۖ وَقَالَ يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّاسُ عُلِّمْنَا مَنطِقَ ٱلطَّيْرِ وَأُوتِينَا مِن كُلِّ شَىْءٍ ۖ إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَهُوَ ٱلْفَضْلُ ٱلْمُبِينُ
ayahs.sahih: And Solomon inherited David. He said, "O people, we have been taught the language of birds, and we have been given from all things. Indeed, this is evident bounty."
ayahs.clear: And Solomon succeeded David. He said, “O people, we were taught the language of birds, and we were given from everything. This is indeed a real blessing.”
ayahs.kemenag: Dan Sulaiman telah mewarisi Daud, dan dia berkata: "Hai Manusia, kami telah diberi pengertian tentang suara burung dan kami diberi segala sesuatu. Sesungguhnya (semua) ini benar-benar suatu kurnia yang nyata".

ayahs.arabic: وَحُشِرَ لِسُلَيْمَٰنَ جُنُودُهُۥ مِنَ ٱلْجِنِّ وَٱلْإِنسِ وَٱلطَّيْرِ فَهُمْ يُوزَعُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And gathered for Solomon were his soldiers of the jinn and men and birds, and they were [marching] in rows.
ayahs.clear: To the service of Solomon were mobilized his troops of sprites, and men, and birds—all held in strict order.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan dihimpunkan untuk Sulaiman tentaranya dari jin, manusia dan burung lalu mereka itu diatur dengan tertib (dalam barisan).

ayahs.arabic: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَآ أَتَوْا۟ عَلَىٰ وَادِ ٱلنَّمْلِ قَالَتْ نَمْلَةٌۭ يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّمْلُ ٱدْخُلُوا۟ مَسَٰكِنَكُمْ لَا يَحْطِمَنَّكُمْ سُلَيْمَٰنُ وَجُنُودُهُۥ وَهُمْ لَا يَشْعُرُونَ
ayahs.sahih: Until, when they came upon the valley of the ants, an ant said, "O ants, enter your dwellings that you not be crushed by Solomon and his soldiers while they perceive not."
ayahs.clear: Until, when they came upon the Valley of Ants, an ant said, “O ants! Go into your nests, lest Solomon and his troops crush you without noticing.”
ayahs.kemenag: Hingga apabila mereka sampai di lembah semut berkatalah seekor semut: Hai semut-semut, masuklah ke dalam sarang-sarangmu, agar kamu tidak diinjak oleh Sulaiman dan tentaranya, sedangkan mereka tidak menyadari";

ayahs.arabic: فَتَبَسَّمَ ضَاحِكًۭا مِّن قَوْلِهَا وَقَالَ رَبِّ أَوْزِعْنِىٓ أَنْ أَشْكُرَ نِعْمَتَكَ ٱلَّتِىٓ أَنْعَمْتَ عَلَىَّ وَعَلَىٰ وَٰلِدَىَّ وَأَنْ أَعْمَلَ صَٰلِحًۭا تَرْضَىٰهُ وَأَدْخِلْنِى بِرَحْمَتِكَ فِى عِبَادِكَ ٱلصَّٰلِحِينَ
ayahs.sahih: So [Solomon] smiled, amused at her speech, and said, "My Lord, enable me to be grateful for Your favor which You have bestowed upon me and upon my parents and to do righteousness of which You approve. And admit me by Your mercy into [the ranks of] Your righteous servants."
ayahs.clear: He smiled and laughed at her words, and said, “My Lord, direct me to be thankful for the blessings you have bestowed upon me and upon my parents, and to do good works that please You. And admit me, by Your grace, into the company of Your virtuous servants.”
ayahs.kemenag: maka dia tersenyum dengan tertawa karena (mendengar) perkataan semut itu. Dan dia berdoa: "Ya Tuhanku berilah aku ilham untuk tetap mensyukuri nikmat Mu yang telah Engkau anugerahkan kepadaku dan kepada dua orang ibu bapakku dan untuk mengerjakan amal saleh yang Engkau ridhai; dan masukkanlah aku dengan rahmat-Mu ke dalam golongan hamba-hamba-Mu yang saleh".

ayahs.arabic: وَتَفَقَّدَ ٱلطَّيْرَ فَقَالَ مَا لِىَ لَآ أَرَى ٱلْهُدْهُدَ أَمْ كَانَ مِنَ ٱلْغَآئِبِينَ
ayahs.sahih: And he took attendance of the birds and said, "Why do I not see the hoopoe - or is he among the absent?
ayahs.clear: Then he inspected the birds, and said, “Why do I not see the hoopoe? Or is he among the absentees?
ayahs.kemenag: Dan dia memeriksa burung-burung lalu berkata: "Mengapa aku tidak melihat hud-hud, apakah dia termasuk yang tidak hadir.

ayahs.arabic: لَأُعَذِّبَنَّهُۥ عَذَابًۭا شَدِيدًا أَوْ لَأَا۟ذْبَحَنَّهُۥٓ أَوْ لَيَأْتِيَنِّى بِسُلْطَٰنٍۢ مُّبِينٍۢ
ayahs.sahih: I will surely punish him with a severe punishment or slaughter him unless he brings me clear authorization."
ayahs.clear: I will punish him most severely, or slay him, unless he gives me a valid excuse.”
ayahs.kemenag: Sungguh aku benar-benar akan mengazabnya dengan azab yang keras atau benar-benar menyembelihnya kecuali jika benar-benar dia datang kepadaku dengan alasan yang terang".

ayahs.arabic: فَمَكَثَ غَيْرَ بَعِيدٍۢ فَقَالَ أَحَطتُ بِمَا لَمْ تُحِطْ بِهِۦ وَجِئْتُكَ مِن سَبَإٍۭ بِنَبَإٍۢ يَقِينٍ
ayahs.sahih: But the hoopoe stayed not long and said, "I have encompassed [in knowledge] that which you have not encompassed, and I have come to you from Sheba with certain news.
ayahs.clear: But he did not stay for long. He said, “I have learnt something you did not know. I have come to you from Sheba, with reliable information.
ayahs.kemenag: Maka tidak lama kemudian (datanglah hud-hud), lalu ia berkata: "Aku telah mengetahui sesuatu yang kamu belum mengetahuinya; dan kubawa kepadamu dari negeri Saba suatu berita penting yang diyakini.

ayahs.arabic: إِنِّى وَجَدتُّ ٱمْرَأَةًۭ تَمْلِكُهُمْ وَأُوتِيَتْ مِن كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ وَلَهَا عَرْشٌ عَظِيمٌۭ
ayahs.sahih: Indeed, I found [there] a woman ruling them, and she has been given of all things, and she has a great throne.
ayahs.clear: I found a woman ruling over them, and she was given of everything, and she has a magnificent throne.
ayahs.kemenag: Sesungguhnya aku menjumpai seorang wanita yang memerintah mereka, dan dia dianugerahi segala sesuatu serta mempunyai singgasana yang besar.

ayahs.arabic: وَجَدتُّهَا وَقَوْمَهَا يَسْجُدُونَ لِلشَّمْسِ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ وَزَيَّنَ لَهُمُ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنُ أَعْمَٰلَهُمْ فَصَدَّهُمْ عَنِ ٱلسَّبِيلِ فَهُمْ لَا يَهْتَدُونَ
ayahs.sahih: I found her and her people prostrating to the sun instead of Allah, and Satan has made their deeds pleasing to them and averted them from [His] way, so they are not guided,
ayahs.clear: I found her and her people worshiping the sun, instead of God. Satan made their conduct appear good to them, and diverted them from the path, so they are not guided.
ayahs.kemenag: Aku mendapati dia dan kaumnya menyembah matahari, selain Allah; dan syaitan telah menjadikan mereka memandang indah perbuatan-perbuatan mereka lalu menghalangi mereka dari jalan (Allah), sehingga mereka tidak dapat petunjuk,

ayahs.arabic: أَلَّا يَسْجُدُوا۟ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِى يُخْرِجُ ٱلْخَبْءَ فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَيَعْلَمُ مَا تُخْفُونَ وَمَا تُعْلِنُونَ
ayahs.sahih: [And] so they do not prostrate to Allah, who brings forth what is hidden within the heavens and the earth and knows what you conceal and what you declare -
ayahs.clear: If only they would worship God, who brings to light the mysteries of the heavens and the earth, and knows what you conceal and what you reveal.
ayahs.kemenag: agar mereka tidak menyembah Allah Yang mengeluarkan apa yang terpendam di langit dan di bumi dan Yang mengetahui apa yang kamu sembunyikan dan apa yang kamu nyatakan.

ayahs.arabic: ٱللَّهُ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ رَبُّ ٱلْعَرْشِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ ۩
ayahs.sahih: Allah - there is no deity except Him, Lord of the Great Throne."
ayahs.clear: God—There is no god but He, the Lord of the Sublime Throne.”
ayahs.kemenag: Allah, tiada Tuhan Yang disembah kecuali Dia, Tuhan Yang mempunyai 'Arsy yang besar".

ayahs.arabic: ۞ قَالَ سَنَنظُرُ أَصَدَقْتَ أَمْ كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلْكَٰذِبِينَ
ayahs.sahih: [Solomon] said, "We will see whether you were truthful or were of the liars.
ayahs.clear: He said, “We will see, whether you have spoken the truth, or whether you are a liar.
ayahs.kemenag: Berkata Sulaiman: "Akan kami lihat, apa kamu benar, ataukah kamu termasuk orang-orang yang berdusta.

ayahs.arabic: ٱذْهَب بِّكِتَٰبِى هَٰذَا فَأَلْقِهْ إِلَيْهِمْ ثُمَّ تَوَلَّ عَنْهُمْ فَٱنظُرْ مَاذَا يَرْجِعُونَ
ayahs.sahih: Take this letter of mine and deliver it to them. Then leave them and see what [answer] they will return."
ayahs.clear: Go with this letter of mine, and deliver it to them; then withdraw from them, and see how they respond.”
ayahs.kemenag: Pergilah dengan (membawa) suratku ini, lalu jatuhkan kepada mereka, kemudian berpalinglah dari mereka, lalu perhatikanlah apa yang mereka bicarakan"

ayahs.arabic: قَالَتْ يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْمَلَؤُا۟ إِنِّىٓ أُلْقِىَ إِلَىَّ كِتَٰبٌۭ كَرِيمٌ
ayahs.sahih: She said, "O eminent ones, indeed, to me has been delivered a noble letter.
ayahs.clear: She said, “O Counselors, a gracious letter was delivered to me.
ayahs.kemenag: Berkata ia (Balqis): "Hai pembesar-pembesar, sesungguhnya telah dijatuhkan kepadaku sebuah surat yang mulia.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّهُۥ مِن سُلَيْمَٰنَ وَإِنَّهُۥ بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ
ayahs.sahih: Indeed, it is from Solomon, and indeed, it reads: 'In the name of Allah, the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful,
ayahs.clear: It is from Solomon, and it is, ‘In the Name of God, the Gracious, the Merciful.
ayahs.kemenag: Sesungguhnya surat itu, dari SuIaiman dan sesungguhnya (isi)nya: "Dengan menyebut nama Allah Yang Maha Pemurah lagi Maha Penyayang.

ayahs.arabic: أَلَّا تَعْلُوا۟ عَلَىَّ وَأْتُونِى مُسْلِمِينَ
ayahs.sahih: Be not haughty with me but come to me in submission [as Muslims].' "
ayahs.clear: Do not defy me, and come to me submissively.’”
ayahs.kemenag: Bahwa janganlah kamu sekalian berlaku sombong terhadapku dan datanglah kepadaku sebagai orang-orang yang berserah diri".

ayahs.arabic: قَالَتْ يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْمَلَؤُا۟ أَفْتُونِى فِىٓ أَمْرِى مَا كُنتُ قَاطِعَةً أَمْرًا حَتَّىٰ تَشْهَدُونِ
ayahs.sahih: She said, "O eminent ones, advise me in my affair. I would not decide a matter until you witness [for] me."
ayahs.clear: She said, “O counselors, advise me in this matter of mine. I never make a decision unless you are present.”
ayahs.kemenag: Berkata dia (Balqis): "Hai para pembesar berilah aku pertimbangan dalam urusanku (ini) aku tidak pernah memutuskan sesuatu persoalan sebelum kamu berada dalam majelis(ku)".

ayahs.arabic: قَالُوا۟ نَحْنُ أُو۟لُوا۟ قُوَّةٍۢ وَأُو۟لُوا۟ بَأْسٍۢ شَدِيدٍۢ وَٱلْأَمْرُ إِلَيْكِ فَٱنظُرِى مَاذَا تَأْمُرِينَ
ayahs.sahih: They said, "We are men of strength and of great military might, but the command is yours, so see what you will command."
ayahs.clear: They said, “We are a people of might and great courage, but the decision is yours, so consider what you wish to command.”
ayahs.kemenag: Mereka menjawab: "Kita adalah orang-orang yang memiliki kekuatan dan (juga) memiliki keberanian yang sangat (dalam peperangan), dan keputusan berada ditanganmu: maka pertimbangkanlah apa yang akan kamu perintahkan".

ayahs.arabic: قَالَتْ إِنَّ ٱلْمُلُوكَ إِذَا دَخَلُوا۟ قَرْيَةً أَفْسَدُوهَا وَجَعَلُوٓا۟ أَعِزَّةَ أَهْلِهَآ أَذِلَّةًۭ ۖ وَكَذَٰلِكَ يَفْعَلُونَ
ayahs.sahih: She said, "Indeed kings - when they enter a city, they ruin it and render the honored of its people humbled. And thus do they do.
ayahs.clear: She said, “When kings enter a city, they devastate it, and subjugate its dignified people. Thus they always do.
ayahs.kemenag: Dia berkata: "Sesungguhnya raja-raja apabila memasuki suatu negeri, niscaya mereka membinasakannya, dan menjadikan penduduknya yang mulia jadi hina; dan demikian pulalah yang akan mereka perbuat.

ayahs.arabic: وَإِنِّى مُرْسِلَةٌ إِلَيْهِم بِهَدِيَّةٍۢ فَنَاظِرَةٌۢ بِمَ يَرْجِعُ ٱلْمُرْسَلُونَ
ayahs.sahih: But indeed, I will send to them a gift and see with what [reply] the messengers will return."
ayahs.clear: I am sending them a gift, and will see what the envoys bring back.”
ayahs.kemenag: Dan sesungguhnya aku akan mengirim utusan kepada mereka dengan (membawa) hadiah, dan (aku akan) menunggu apa yang akan dibawa kembali oleh utusan-utusan itu".

ayahs.arabic: فَلَمَّا جَآءَ سُلَيْمَٰنَ قَالَ أَتُمِدُّونَنِ بِمَالٍۢ فَمَآ ءَاتَىٰنِۦَ ٱللَّهُ خَيْرٌۭ مِّمَّآ ءَاتَىٰكُم بَلْ أَنتُم بِهَدِيَّتِكُمْ تَفْرَحُونَ
ayahs.sahih: So when they came to Solomon, he said, "Do you provide me with wealth? But what Allah has given me is better than what He has given you. Rather, it is you who rejoice in your gift.
ayahs.clear: When he came to Solomon, he said, “Are you supplying me with money? What God has given me is better than what He has given you. It is you who delight in your gift.
ayahs.kemenag: Maka tatkala utusan itu sampai kepada Sulaiman, Sulaiman berkata: "Apakah (patut) kamu menolong aku dengan harta? maka apa yang diberikan Allah kepadaku lebih baik daripada apa yang diberikan-Nya kepadamu; tetapi kamu merasa bangga dengan hadiahmu.

ayahs.arabic: ٱرْجِعْ إِلَيْهِمْ فَلَنَأْتِيَنَّهُم بِجُنُودٍۢ لَّا قِبَلَ لَهُم بِهَا وَلَنُخْرِجَنَّهُم مِّنْهَآ أَذِلَّةًۭ وَهُمْ صَٰغِرُونَ
ayahs.sahih: Return to them, for we will surely come to them with soldiers that they will be powerless to encounter, and we will surely expel them therefrom in humiliation, and they will be debased."
ayahs.clear: Go back to them. We will come upon them with troops they cannot resist; and we will expel them from there, disgraced and humiliated.”
ayahs.kemenag: Kembalilah kepada mereka sungguh kami akan mendatangi mereka dengan balatentara yang mereka tidak kuasa melawannya, dan pasti kami akan mengusir mereka dari negeri itu (Saba) dengan terhina dan mereka menjadi (tawanan-tawanan) yang hina dina".

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْمَلَؤُا۟ أَيُّكُمْ يَأْتِينِى بِعَرْشِهَا قَبْلَ أَن يَأْتُونِى مُسْلِمِينَ
ayahs.sahih: [Solomon] said, "O assembly [of jinn], which of you will bring me her throne before they come to me in submission?"
ayahs.clear: He said, “O notables, which one of you will bring me her throne before they come to me in submission?”
ayahs.kemenag: Berkata Sulaiman: "Hai pembesar-pembesar, siapakah di antara kamu sekalian yang sanggup membawa singgasananya kepadaku sebelum mereka datang kepadaku sebagai orang-orang yang berserah diri".

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ عِفْرِيتٌۭ مِّنَ ٱلْجِنِّ أَنَا۠ ءَاتِيكَ بِهِۦ قَبْلَ أَن تَقُومَ مِن مَّقَامِكَ ۖ وَإِنِّى عَلَيْهِ لَقَوِىٌّ أَمِينٌۭ
ayahs.sahih: A powerful one from among the jinn said, "I will bring it to you before you rise from your place, and indeed, I am for this [task] strong and trustworthy."
ayahs.clear: An imp of the sprites said, “I will bring it to you before you rise from your seat. I am strong and reliable enough to do it.”
ayahs.kemenag: Berkata 'Ifrit (yang cerdik) dari golongan jin: "Aku akan datang kepadamu dengan membawa singgsana itu kepadamu sebelum kamu berdiri dari tempat dudukmu; sesungguhnya aku benar-benar kuat untuk membawanya lagi dapat dipercaya".

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ ٱلَّذِى عِندَهُۥ عِلْمٌۭ مِّنَ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ أَنَا۠ ءَاتِيكَ بِهِۦ قَبْلَ أَن يَرْتَدَّ إِلَيْكَ طَرْفُكَ ۚ فَلَمَّا رَءَاهُ مُسْتَقِرًّا عِندَهُۥ قَالَ هَٰذَا مِن فَضْلِ رَبِّى لِيَبْلُوَنِىٓ ءَأَشْكُرُ أَمْ أَكْفُرُ ۖ وَمَن شَكَرَ فَإِنَّمَا يَشْكُرُ لِنَفْسِهِۦ ۖ وَمَن كَفَرَ فَإِنَّ رَبِّى غَنِىٌّۭ كَرِيمٌۭ
ayahs.sahih: Said one who had knowledge from the Scripture, "I will bring it to you before your glance returns to you." And when [Solomon] saw it placed before him, he said, "This is from the favor of my Lord to test me whether I will be grateful or ungrateful. And whoever is grateful - his gratitude is only for [the benefit of] himself. And whoever is ungrateful - then indeed, my Lord is Free of need and Generous."
ayahs.clear: He who had knowledge from the Book said, “I will bring it to you before your glance returns to you.” And when he saw it settled before him, he said, “This is from the grace of my Lord, to test me, whether I am grateful or ungrateful. He who is grateful, his gratitude is to his own credit; but he who is ungrateful—my Lord is Independent and Generous.”
ayahs.kemenag: Berkatalah seorang yang mempunyai ilmu dari Al Kitab: "Aku akan membawa singgasana itu kepadamu sebelum matamu berkedip". Maka tatkala Sulaiman melihat singgasana itu terletak di hadapannya, iapun berkata: "Ini termasuk kurnia Tuhanku untuk mencoba aku apakah aku bersyukur atau mengingkari (akan nikmat-Nya). Dan barangsiapa yang bersyukur maka sesungguhnya dia bersyukur untuk (kebaikan) dirinya sendiri dan barangsiapa yang ingkar, maka sesungguhnya Tuhanku Maha Kaya lagi Maha Mulia".

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ نَكِّرُوا۟ لَهَا عَرْشَهَا نَنظُرْ أَتَهْتَدِىٓ أَمْ تَكُونُ مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يَهْتَدُونَ
ayahs.sahih: He said, "Disguise for her her throne; we will see whether she will be guided [to truth] or will be of those who is not guided."
ayahs.clear: He said, “Disguise her throne for her, and we shall see whether she will be guided, or remains one of the misguided.”
ayahs.kemenag: Dia berkata: "Rubahlah baginya singgasananya; maka kita akan melihat apakah dia mengenal ataukah dia termasuk orang-orang yang tidak mengenal(nya)".

ayahs.arabic: فَلَمَّا جَآءَتْ قِيلَ أَهَٰكَذَا عَرْشُكِ ۖ قَالَتْ كَأَنَّهُۥ هُوَ ۚ وَأُوتِينَا ٱلْعِلْمَ مِن قَبْلِهَا وَكُنَّا مُسْلِمِينَ
ayahs.sahih: So when she arrived, it was said [to her], "Is your throne like this?" She said, "[It is] as though it was it." [Solomon said], "And we were given knowledge before her, and we have been Muslims [in submission to Allah].
ayahs.clear: When she arrived, it was said, “Is your throne like this?” She said, “As if this is it.” “We were given knowledge before her, and we were submissive.”
ayahs.kemenag: Dan ketika Balqis datang, ditanyakanlah kepadanya: "Serupa inikah singgasanamu?" Dia menjawab: "Seakan-akan singgasana ini singgasanaku, kami telah diberi pengetahuan sebelumnya dan kami adalah orang-orang yang berserah diri".

ayahs.arabic: وَصَدَّهَا مَا كَانَت تَّعْبُدُ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ ۖ إِنَّهَا كَانَتْ مِن قَوْمٍۢ كَٰفِرِينَ
ayahs.sahih: And that which she was worshipping other than Allah had averted her [from submission to Him]. Indeed, she was from a disbelieving people."
ayahs.clear: But she was prevented by what she worshiped besides God; she belonged to a disbelieving people.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan apa yang disembahnya selama ini selain Allah, mencegahnya (untuk melahirkan keislamannya), karena sesungguhnya dia dahulunya termasuk orang-orang yang kafir.

ayahs.arabic: قِيلَ لَهَا ٱدْخُلِى ٱلصَّرْحَ ۖ فَلَمَّا رَأَتْهُ حَسِبَتْهُ لُجَّةًۭ وَكَشَفَتْ عَن سَاقَيْهَا ۚ قَالَ إِنَّهُۥ صَرْحٌۭ مُّمَرَّدٌۭ مِّن قَوَارِيرَ ۗ قَالَتْ رَبِّ إِنِّى ظَلَمْتُ نَفْسِى وَأَسْلَمْتُ مَعَ سُلَيْمَٰنَ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
ayahs.sahih: She was told, "Enter the palace." But when she saw it, she thought it was a body of water and uncovered her shins [to wade through]. He said, "Indeed, it is a palace [whose floor is] made smooth with glass." She said, "My Lord, indeed I have wronged myself, and I submit with Solomon to Allah, Lord of the worlds."
ayahs.clear: It was said to her, “Go inside the palace.” And when she saw it, she thought it was a deep pond, and she bared her legs. He said, “It is a palace paved with glass.” She said, “My Lord, I have done wrong to myself, and I have submitted with Solomon, to God, Lord of the Worlds.”
ayahs.kemenag: Dikatakan kepadanya: "Masuklah ke dalam istana". Maka tatkala dia melihat lantai istana itu, dikiranya kolam air yang besar, dan disingkapkannya kedua betisnya. Berkatalah Sulaiman: "Sesungguhnya ia adalah istana licin terbuat dari kaca". Berkatalah Balqis: "Ya Tuhanku, sesungguhnya aku telah berbuat zalim terhadap diriku dan aku berserah diri bersama Sulaiman kepada Allah, Tuhan semesta alam".

ayahs.arabic: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَىٰ ثَمُودَ أَخَاهُمْ صَٰلِحًا أَنِ ٱعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ فَإِذَا هُمْ فَرِيقَانِ يَخْتَصِمُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And We had certainly sent to Thamud their brother Salih, [saying], "Worship Allah," and at once they were two parties conflicting.
ayahs.clear: And We sent to Thamood their brother Saleh: “Worship God.” But they became two disputing factions.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan sesungguhnya Kami telah mengutus kepada (kaum) Tsamud saudara mereka Shaleh (yang berseru): "Sembahlah Allah". Tetapi tiba-tiba mereka (jadi) dua golongan yang bermusuhan.

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ يَٰقَوْمِ لِمَ تَسْتَعْجِلُونَ بِٱلسَّيِّئَةِ قَبْلَ ٱلْحَسَنَةِ ۖ لَوْلَا تَسْتَغْفِرُونَ ٱللَّهَ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُرْحَمُونَ
ayahs.sahih: He said, "O my people, why are you impatient for evil instead of good? Why do you not seek forgiveness of Allah that you may receive mercy?"
ayahs.clear: He said, “O my people, why are you quick to do evil rather than good? If only you would seek God’s forgiveness, so that you may be shown mercy.”
ayahs.kemenag: Dia berkata: "Hai kaumku mengapa kamu minta disegerakan keburukan sebelum (kamu minta) kebaikan? Hendaklah kamu meminta ampun kepada Allah, agar kamu mendapat rahmat".

ayahs.arabic: قَالُوا۟ ٱطَّيَّرْنَا بِكَ وَبِمَن مَّعَكَ ۚ قَالَ طَٰٓئِرُكُمْ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ ۖ بَلْ أَنتُمْ قَوْمٌۭ تُفْتَنُونَ
ayahs.sahih: They said, "We consider you a bad omen, you and those with you." He said, "Your omen is with Allah. Rather, you are a people being tested."
ayahs.clear: They said, “We consider you an ill omen, and those with you.” He said, “Your omen is with God. In fact, you are a people being tested.”
ayahs.kemenag: Mereka menjawab: "Kami mendapat nasib yang malang, disebabkan kamu dan orang-orang yang besertamu". Shaleh berkata: "Nasibmu ada pada sisi Allah, (bukan kami yang menjadi sebab), tetapi kamu kaum yang diuji".

ayahs.arabic: وَكَانَ فِى ٱلْمَدِينَةِ تِسْعَةُ رَهْطٍۢ يُفْسِدُونَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَا يُصْلِحُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And there were in the city nine family heads causing corruption in the land and not amending [its affairs].
ayahs.clear: In the city was a gang of nine who made mischief in the land and did no good.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan adalah di kota itu sembilan orang laki-laki yang membuat kerusakan di muka bumi, dan mereka tidak berbuat kebaikan.

ayahs.arabic: قَالُوا۟ تَقَاسَمُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ لَنُبَيِّتَنَّهُۥ وَأَهْلَهُۥ ثُمَّ لَنَقُولَنَّ لِوَلِيِّهِۦ مَا شَهِدْنَا مَهْلِكَ أَهْلِهِۦ وَإِنَّا لَصَٰدِقُونَ
ayahs.sahih: They said, "Take a mutual oath by Allah that we will kill him by night, he and his family. Then we will say to his executor, 'We did not witness the destruction of his family, and indeed, we are truthful.' "
ayahs.clear: They said, “Swear by God to one another that we will attack him and his family by night, and then tell his guardian, 'We did not witness the murder of his family, and we are being truthful.'“
ayahs.kemenag: Mereka berkata: "Bersumpahlah kamu dengan nama Allah, bahwa kita sungguh-sungguh akan menyerangnya dengan tiba-tiba beserta keluarganya di malam hari, kemudian kita katakan kepada warisnya (bahwa) kita tidak menyaksikan kematian keluarganya itu, dan sesungguhnya kita adalah orang-orang yang benar".

ayahs.arabic: وَمَكَرُوا۟ مَكْرًۭا وَمَكَرْنَا مَكْرًۭا وَهُمْ لَا يَشْعُرُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And they planned a plan, and We planned a plan, while they perceived not.
ayahs.clear: They planned a plan, and We planned a plan, but they did not notice.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan merekapun merencanakan makar dengan sungguh-sungguh dan Kami merencanakan makar (pula), sedang mereka tidak menyadari.

ayahs.arabic: فَٱنظُرْ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَٰقِبَةُ مَكْرِهِمْ أَنَّا دَمَّرْنَٰهُمْ وَقَوْمَهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
ayahs.sahih: Then look how was the outcome of their plan - that We destroyed them and their people, all.
ayahs.clear: So note the outcome of their planning; We destroyed them and their people, altogether.
ayahs.kemenag: Maka perhatikanlah betapa sesungguhnya akibat makar mereka itu, bahwasanya Kami membinasakan mereka dan kaum mereka semuanya.

ayahs.arabic: فَتِلْكَ بُيُوتُهُمْ خَاوِيَةًۢ بِمَا ظَلَمُوٓا۟ ۗ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَةًۭ لِّقَوْمٍۢ يَعْلَمُونَ
ayahs.sahih: So those are their houses, desolate because of the wrong they had done. Indeed in that is a sign for people who know.
ayahs.clear: Here are their homes, in ruins, on account of their iniquities. Surely in this is a sign for people who know.
ayahs.kemenag: Maka itulah rumah-rumah mereka dalam keadaan runtuh disebabkan kezaliman mereka. Sesungguhnya pada yang demikian itu (terdapat) pelajaran bagi kaum yang mengetahui.

ayahs.arabic: وَأَنجَيْنَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَكَانُوا۟ يَتَّقُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And We saved those who believed and used to fear Allah.
ayahs.clear: And We saved those who believed and were pious.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan telah Kami selamatkan orang-orang yang beriman dan mereka itu selalu bertakwa.

ayahs.arabic: وَلُوطًا إِذْ قَالَ لِقَوْمِهِۦٓ أَتَأْتُونَ ٱلْفَٰحِشَةَ وَأَنتُمْ تُبْصِرُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And [mention] Lot, when he said to his people, "Do you commit immorality while you are seeing?
ayahs.clear: And Lot, when he said to his people, “Do you commit lewdness with open eyes?
ayahs.kemenag: Dan (ingatlah kisah) Luth, ketika dia berkata kepada kaumnya: "Mengapa kamu mengerjakan perbuatan fahisyah itu sedang kamu memperlihatkan(nya)?"

ayahs.arabic: أَئِنَّكُمْ لَتَأْتُونَ ٱلرِّجَالَ شَهْوَةًۭ مِّن دُونِ ٱلنِّسَآءِ ۚ بَلْ أَنتُمْ قَوْمٌۭ تَجْهَلُونَ
ayahs.sahih: Do you indeed approach men with desire instead of women? Rather, you are a people behaving ignorantly."
ayahs.clear: Do you lust after men instead of women? You are truly ignorant people.”
ayahs.kemenag: "Mengapa kamu mendatangi laki-laki untuk (memenuhi) nafsu(mu), bukan (mendatangi) wanita? Sebenarnya kamu adalah kaum yang tidak mengetahui (akibat perbuatanmu)".

ayahs.arabic: ۞ فَمَا كَانَ جَوَابَ قَوْمِهِۦٓ إِلَّآ أَن قَالُوٓا۟ أَخْرِجُوٓا۟ ءَالَ لُوطٍۢ مِّن قَرْيَتِكُمْ ۖ إِنَّهُمْ أُنَاسٌۭ يَتَطَهَّرُونَ
ayahs.sahih: But the answer of his people was not except that they said, "Expel the family of Lot from your city. Indeed, they are people who keep themselves pure."
ayahs.clear: But the only response of his people was to say, “Expel the family of Lot from your town. They are purist people.”
ayahs.kemenag: Maka tidak lain jawaban kaumnya melainkan mengatakan: "Usirlah Luth beserta keluarganya dari negerimu; karena sesungguhnya mereka itu orang-orang yang (mendakwakan dirinya) bersih".

ayahs.arabic: فَأَنجَيْنَٰهُ وَأَهْلَهُۥٓ إِلَّا ٱمْرَأَتَهُۥ قَدَّرْنَٰهَا مِنَ ٱلْغَٰبِرِينَ
ayahs.sahih: So We saved him and his family, except for his wife; We destined her to be of those who remained behind.
ayahs.clear: So We saved him and his family, except for his wife, whom We destined to be among the laggards.
ayahs.kemenag: Maka Kami selamatkan dia beserta keluarganya, kecuali isterinya. Kami telah mentakdirkan dia termasuk orang-orang yang tertinggal (dibinasakan).

ayahs.arabic: وَأَمْطَرْنَا عَلَيْهِم مَّطَرًۭا ۖ فَسَآءَ مَطَرُ ٱلْمُنذَرِينَ
ayahs.sahih: And We rained upon them a rain [of stones], and evil was the rain of those who were warned.
ayahs.clear: And We rained upon them a rain. Miserable was the rain of those forewarned.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan Kami turunkan hujan atas mereka (hujan batu), maka amat buruklah hujan yang ditimpakan atas orang-orang yang diberi peringatan itu.

ayahs.arabic: قُلِ ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ وَسَلَٰمٌ عَلَىٰ عِبَادِهِ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱصْطَفَىٰٓ ۗ ءَآللَّهُ خَيْرٌ أَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ
ayahs.sahih: Say, [O Muhammad], "Praise be to Allah, and peace upon His servants whom He has chosen. Is Allah better or what they associate with Him?"
ayahs.clear: Say, “Praise God, and peace be upon His servants whom He has selected. Is God better, or what they associate?”
ayahs.kemenag: Katakanlah: "Segala puji bagi Allah dan kesejahteraan atas hamba-hamba-Nya yang dipilih-Nya. Apakah Allah yang lebih baik, ataukah apa yang mereka persekutukan dengan Dia?"

ayahs.arabic: أَمَّنْ خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَأَنزَلَ لَكُم مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءًۭ فَأَنۢبَتْنَا بِهِۦ حَدَآئِقَ ذَاتَ بَهْجَةٍۢ مَّا كَانَ لَكُمْ أَن تُنۢبِتُوا۟ شَجَرَهَآ ۗ أَءِلَٰهٌۭ مَّعَ ٱللَّهِ ۚ بَلْ هُمْ قَوْمٌۭ يَعْدِلُونَ
ayahs.sahih: [More precisely], is He [not best] who created the heavens and the earth and sent down for you rain from the sky, causing to grow thereby gardens of joyful beauty which you could not [otherwise] have grown the trees thereof? Is there a deity with Allah? [No], but they are a people who ascribe equals [to Him].
ayahs.clear: Or, who created the heavens and the earth, and rains down water from the sky for you? With it We produce gardens full of beauty, whose trees you could not have produced. Is there another god with God? But they are a people who equate.
ayahs.kemenag: Atau siapakah yang telah menciptakan langit dan bumi dan yang menurunkan air untukmu dari langit, lalu Kami tumbuhkan dengan air itu kebun-kebun yang berpemandangan indah, yang kamu sekali-kali tidak mampu menumbuhkan pohon-pohonnya? Apakah disamping Allah ada tuhan (yang lain)? Bahkan (sebenarnya) mereka adalah orang-orang yang menyimpang (dari kebenaran).

ayahs.arabic: أَمَّن جَعَلَ ٱلْأَرْضَ قَرَارًۭا وَجَعَلَ خِلَٰلَهَآ أَنْهَٰرًۭا وَجَعَلَ لَهَا رَوَٰسِىَ وَجَعَلَ بَيْنَ ٱلْبَحْرَيْنِ حَاجِزًا ۗ أَءِلَٰهٌۭ مَّعَ ٱللَّهِ ۚ بَلْ أَكْثَرُهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
ayahs.sahih: Is He [not best] who made the earth a stable ground and placed within it rivers and made for it firmly set mountains and placed between the two seas a barrier? Is there a deity with Allah? [No], but most of them do not know.
ayahs.clear: Or, who made the earth habitable, and made rivers flow through it, and set mountains on it, and placed a partition between the two seas? Is there another god with God? But most of them do not know.
ayahs.kemenag: Atau siapakah yang telah menjadikan bumi sebagai tempat berdiam, dan yang menjadikan sungai-sungai di celah-celahnya, dan yang menjadikan gunung-gunung untuk (mengkokohkan)nya dan menjadikan suatu pemisah antara dua laut? Apakah disamping Allah ada tuhan (yang lain)? Bahkan (sebenarnya) kebanyakan dari mereka tidak mengetahui.

ayahs.arabic: أَمَّن يُجِيبُ ٱلْمُضْطَرَّ إِذَا دَعَاهُ وَيَكْشِفُ ٱلسُّوٓءَ وَيَجْعَلُكُمْ خُلَفَآءَ ٱلْأَرْضِ ۗ أَءِلَٰهٌۭ مَّعَ ٱللَّهِ ۚ قَلِيلًۭا مَّا تَذَكَّرُونَ
ayahs.sahih: Is He [not best] who responds to the desperate one when he calls upon Him and removes evil and makes you inheritors of the earth? Is there a deity with Allah? Little do you remember.
ayahs.clear: Or, who answers the one in need when he prays to Him, and relieves adversity, and makes you successors on earth? Is there another god with God? How hardly you pay attention.
ayahs.kemenag: Atau siapakah yang memperkenankan (doa) orang yang dalam kesulitan apabila ia berdoa kepada-Nya, dan yang menghilangkan kesusahan dan yang menjadikan kamu (manusia) sebagai khalifah di bumi? Apakah disamping Allah ada tuhan (yang lain)? Amat sedikitlah kamu mengingati(Nya).

ayahs.arabic: أَمَّن يَهْدِيكُمْ فِى ظُلُمَٰتِ ٱلْبَرِّ وَٱلْبَحْرِ وَمَن يُرْسِلُ ٱلرِّيَٰحَ بُشْرًۢا بَيْنَ يَدَىْ رَحْمَتِهِۦٓ ۗ أَءِلَٰهٌۭ مَّعَ ٱللَّهِ ۚ تَعَٰلَى ٱللَّهُ عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ
ayahs.sahih: Is He [not best] who guides you through the darknesses of the land and sea and who sends the winds as good tidings before His mercy? Is there a deity with Allah? High is Allah above whatever they associate with Him.
ayahs.clear: Or, who guides you through the darkness of land and sea, and who sends the winds as heralds of His mercy? Is there another god with God? Most exalted is God, above what they associate.
ayahs.kemenag: Atau siapakah yang memimpin kamu dalam kegelapan di dataran dan lautan dan siapa (pula)kah yang mendatangkan angin sebagai kabar gembira sebelum (kedatangan) rahmat-Nya? Apakah disamping Allah ada tuhan (yang lain)? Maha Tinggi Allah terhadap apa yang mereka persekutukan (dengan-Nya).

ayahs.arabic: أَمَّن يَبْدَؤُا۟ ٱلْخَلْقَ ثُمَّ يُعِيدُهُۥ وَمَن يَرْزُقُكُم مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۗ أَءِلَٰهٌۭ مَّعَ ٱللَّهِ ۚ قُلْ هَاتُوا۟ بُرْهَٰنَكُمْ إِن كُنتُمْ صَٰدِقِينَ
ayahs.sahih: Is He [not best] who begins creation and then repeats it and who provides for you from the heaven and earth? Is there a deity with Allah? Say, "Produce your proof, if you should be truthful."
ayahs.clear: Or, who originates the creation and then repeats it, and who gives you livelihood from the sky and the earth? Is there another god with God? Say, “Produce your evidence, if you are truthful.”
ayahs.kemenag: Atau siapakah yang menciptakan (manusia dari permulaannya), kemudian mengulanginya (lagi), dan siapa (pula) yang memberikan rezeki kepadamu dari langit dan bumi? Apakah disamping Allah ada tuhan (yang lain)?. Katakanlah: "Unjukkanlah bukti kebenaranmu, jika kamu memang orang-orang yang benar".

ayahs.arabic: قُل لَّا يَعْلَمُ مَن فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ٱلْغَيْبَ إِلَّا ٱللَّهُ ۚ وَمَا يَشْعُرُونَ أَيَّانَ يُبْعَثُونَ
ayahs.sahih: Say, "None in the heavens and earth knows the unseen except Allah, and they do not perceive when they will be resurrected."
ayahs.clear: Say, “No one in the heavens or on earth knows the future except God; and they do not perceive when they will be resurrected.”
ayahs.kemenag: Katakanlah: "Tidak ada seorangpun di langit dan di bumi yang mengetahui perkara yang ghaib, kecuali Allah", dan mereka tidak mengetahui bila mereka akan dibangkitkan.

ayahs.arabic: بَلِ ٱدَّٰرَكَ عِلْمُهُمْ فِى ٱلْءَاخِرَةِ ۚ بَلْ هُمْ فِى شَكٍّۢ مِّنْهَا ۖ بَلْ هُم مِّنْهَا عَمُونَ
ayahs.sahih: Rather, their knowledge is arrested concerning the Hereafter. Rather, they are in doubt about it. Rather, they are, concerning it, blind.
ayahs.clear: In fact, their knowledge of the Hereafter is confused. In fact, they are in doubt about it. In fact, they are blind to it.
ayahs.kemenag: Sebenarnya pengetahuan mereka tentang akhirat tidak sampai (kesana) malahan mereka ragu-ragu tentang akhirat itu, lebih-lebih lagi mereka buta daripadanya.

ayahs.arabic: وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓا۟ أَءِذَا كُنَّا تُرَٰبًۭا وَءَابَآؤُنَآ أَئِنَّا لَمُخْرَجُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And those who disbelieve say, "When we have become dust as well as our forefathers, will we indeed be brought out [of the graves]?
ayahs.clear: Those who disbelieve say, “When we have become dust, and our ancestors, shall we be brought out?
ayahs.kemenag: Berkatalah orang-orang yang kafir: "Apakah setelah kita menjadi tanah dan (begitu pula) bapak-bapak kita; apakah sesungguhnya kita akan dikeluarkan (dari kubur)?

ayahs.arabic: لَقَدْ وُعِدْنَا هَٰذَا نَحْنُ وَءَابَآؤُنَا مِن قَبْلُ إِنْ هَٰذَآ إِلَّآ أَسَٰطِيرُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
ayahs.sahih: We have been promised this, we and our forefathers, before. This is not but legends of the former peoples."
ayahs.clear: We were promised that before, we and our ancestors—these are nothing but legends of the ancients.”
ayahs.kemenag: Sesungguhnya kami telah diberi ancaman dengan ini dan (juga) bapak-bapak kami dahulu; ini tidak lain hanyalah dongengan-dongengan orang dahulu kala".

ayahs.arabic: قُلْ سِيرُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَٱنظُرُوا۟ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَٰقِبَةُ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ
ayahs.sahih: Say, [O Muhammad], "Travel through the land and observe how was the end of the criminals."
ayahs.clear: Say, travel through the earth, and observe the fate of the guilty.”
ayahs.kemenag: Katakanlah: "Berjalanlah kamu (di muka) bumi, lalu perhatikanlah bagaimana akibat orang-orang yang berdosa.

ayahs.arabic: وَلَا تَحْزَنْ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا تَكُن فِى ضَيْقٍۢ مِّمَّا يَمْكُرُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And grieve not over them or be in distress from what they conspire.
ayahs.clear: But do not grieve over them, and do not be troubled by what they plot.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan janganlah kamu berduka cita terhadap mereka, dan janganlah (dadamu) merasa sempit terhadap apa yang mereka tipudayakan".

ayahs.arabic: وَيَقُولُونَ مَتَىٰ هَٰذَا ٱلْوَعْدُ إِن كُنتُمْ صَٰدِقِينَ
ayahs.sahih: And they say, "When is [the fulfillment of] this promise, if you should be truthful?"
ayahs.clear: And they say, “When is this promise, if you are truthful?”
ayahs.kemenag: Dan mereka (orang-orang kafir) berkata: "Bilakah datangnya azab itu, jika memang kamu orang-orang yang benar".

ayahs.arabic: قُلْ عَسَىٰٓ أَن يَكُونَ رَدِفَ لَكُم بَعْضُ ٱلَّذِى تَسْتَعْجِلُونَ
ayahs.sahih: Say, "Perhaps it is close behind you - some of that for which you are impatient.
ayahs.clear: Say, “Perhaps some of what you are impatient for has drawn near.”
ayahs.kemenag: Katakanlah: "Mungkin telah hampir datang kepadamu sebagian dari (azab) yang kamu minta (supaya) disegerakan itu.

ayahs.arabic: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَذُو فَضْلٍ عَلَى ٱلنَّاسِ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ لَا يَشْكُرُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And indeed, your Lord is full of bounty for the people, but most of them do not show gratitude."
ayahs.clear: Your Lord is gracious towards humanity, but most of them are not thankful.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan sesungguhnya Tuhanmu benar-benar mempunyai kurnia yang besar (yang diberikan-Nya) kepada manusia, tetapi kebanyakan mereka tidak mensyukuri(nya).

ayahs.arabic: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَيَعْلَمُ مَا تُكِنُّ صُدُورُهُمْ وَمَا يُعْلِنُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And indeed, your Lord knows what their breasts conceal and what they declare.
ayahs.clear: And your Lord knows what their hearts conceal, and what they reveal.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan sesungguhnya Tuhanmu, benar-benar mengetahui apa yang disembunyikan hati mereka dan apa yang mereka nyatakan.

ayahs.arabic: وَمَا مِنْ غَآئِبَةٍۢ فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ إِلَّا فِى كِتَٰبٍۢ مُّبِينٍ
ayahs.sahih: And there is nothing concealed within the heaven and the earth except that it is in a clear Register.
ayahs.clear: There is no mystery in the heaven and the earth, but it is in a Clear Book.
ayahs.kemenag: Tiada sesuatupun yang ghaib di langit dan di bumi, melainkan (terdapat) dalam kitab yang nyata (Lauhul Mahfuzh).

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ هَٰذَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ يَقُصُّ عَلَىٰ بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ أَكْثَرَ ٱلَّذِى هُمْ فِيهِ يَخْتَلِفُونَ
ayahs.sahih: Indeed, this Qur'an relates to the Children of Israel most of that over which they disagree.
ayahs.clear: This Quran relates to the Children of Israel most of what they differ about.
ayahs.kemenag: Sesungguhnya Al Quran ini menjelaskan kepada Bani lsrail sebahagian besar dari (perkara-perkara) yang mereka berselisih tentangnya.

ayahs.arabic: وَإِنَّهُۥ لَهُدًۭى وَرَحْمَةٌۭ لِّلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
ayahs.sahih: And indeed, it is guidance and mercy for the believers.
ayahs.clear: And it is guidance and mercy for the believers.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan sesungguhnya Al Quran itu benar-benar menjadi petunjuk dan rahmat bagi orang-orang yang beriman.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ رَبَّكَ يَقْضِى بَيْنَهُم بِحُكْمِهِۦ ۚ وَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
ayahs.sahih: Indeed, your Lord will judge between them by His [wise] judgement. And He is the Exalted in Might, the Knowing.
ayahs.clear: Your Lord will judge between them by His wisdom. He is the Almighty, the All-Knowing.
ayahs.kemenag: Sesungguhnya Tuhanmu akan menyelesaikan perkara antara mereka dengan keputusan-Nya, dan Dia Maha Perkasa lagi Maha Mengetahui.

ayahs.arabic: فَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ ۖ إِنَّكَ عَلَى ٱلْحَقِّ ٱلْمُبِينِ
ayahs.sahih: So rely upon Allah; indeed, you are upon the clear truth.
ayahs.clear: So rely on God. You are upon the clear truth.
ayahs.kemenag: Sebab itu bertakwalah kepada Allah, sesungguhnya kamu berada di atas kebenaran yang nyata.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّكَ لَا تُسْمِعُ ٱلْمَوْتَىٰ وَلَا تُسْمِعُ ٱلصُّمَّ ٱلدُّعَآءَ إِذَا وَلَّوْا۟ مُدْبِرِينَ
ayahs.sahih: Indeed, you will not make the dead hear, nor will you make the deaf hear the call when they have turned their backs retreating.
ayahs.clear: You cannot make the dead hear, nor can you make the deaf hear the call if they turn their backs and flee.
ayahs.kemenag: Sesungguhnya kamu tidak dapat menjadikan orang-orang yang mati mendengar dan (tidak pula) menjadikan orang-orang yang tuli mendengar panggilan, apabila mereka telah berpaling membelakang.

ayahs.arabic: وَمَآ أَنتَ بِهَٰدِى ٱلْعُمْىِ عَن ضَلَٰلَتِهِمْ ۖ إِن تُسْمِعُ إِلَّا مَن يُؤْمِنُ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا فَهُم مُّسْلِمُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And you cannot guide the blind away from their error. You will only make hear those who believe in Our verses so they are Muslims [submitting to Allah].
ayahs.clear: Nor can you guide the blind out of their straying. You can make no one listen, except those who believe in Our verses; for they are Muslims.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan kamu sekali-kali tidak dapat memimpin (memalingkan) orang-orang buta dari kesesatan mereka. Kamu tidak dapat menjadikan (seorangpun) mendengar, kecuali orang-orang yang beriman kepada ayat-ayat Kami, lalu mereka berserah diri.

ayahs.arabic: ۞ وَإِذَا وَقَعَ ٱلْقَوْلُ عَلَيْهِمْ أَخْرَجْنَا لَهُمْ دَآبَّةًۭ مِّنَ ٱلْأَرْضِ تُكَلِّمُهُمْ أَنَّ ٱلنَّاسَ كَانُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا لَا يُوقِنُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And when the word befalls them, We will bring forth for them a creature from the earth speaking to them, [saying] that the people were, of Our verses, not certain [in faith].
ayahs.clear: And when the Word has fallen on them, We will bring out for them from the earth a creature which will say to them that the people are uncertain of Our revelations.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan apabila perkataan telah jatuh atas mereka, Kami keluarkan sejenis binatang melata dari bumi yang akan mengatakan kepada mereka, bahwa sesungguhnya manusia dahulu tidak yakin kepada ayat-ayat Kami.

ayahs.arabic: وَيَوْمَ نَحْشُرُ مِن كُلِّ أُمَّةٍۢ فَوْجًۭا مِّمَّن يُكَذِّبُ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا فَهُمْ يُوزَعُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And [warn of] the Day when We will gather from every nation a company of those who deny Our signs, and they will be [driven] in rows
ayahs.clear: On the Day when We gather from every community a group of those who rejected Our revelations; and they will be restrained.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan (ingatlah) hari (ketika) Kami kumpulkan dari tiap-tiap umat segolongan orang-orang yang mendustakan ayat-ayat Kami, lalu mereka dibagi-bagi (dalam kelompok-kelompok).

ayahs.arabic: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا جَآءُو قَالَ أَكَذَّبْتُم بِـَٔايَٰتِى وَلَمْ تُحِيطُوا۟ بِهَا عِلْمًا أَمَّاذَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
ayahs.sahih: Until, when they arrive [at the place of Judgement], He will say, "Did you deny My signs while you encompassed them not in knowledge, or what [was it that] you were doing?"
ayahs.clear: Until, when they arrive, He will say, “Did you reject My revelations without comprehending them? Or what is it you were doing?”
ayahs.kemenag: Hingga apabila mereka datang, Allah berfirman: "Apakah kamu telah mendustakan ayat-ayat-Ku, padahal ilmu kamu tidak meliputinya, atau apakah yang telah kamu kerjakan?".

ayahs.arabic: وَوَقَعَ ٱلْقَوْلُ عَلَيْهِم بِمَا ظَلَمُوا۟ فَهُمْ لَا يَنطِقُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And the decree will befall them for the wrong they did, and they will not [be able to] speak.
ayahs.clear: The Word will come down upon them for their wrongdoing, and they will not speak.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan jatuhlah perkataan (azab) atas mereka disebabkan kezaliman mereka, maka mereka tidak dapat berkata (apa-apa).

ayahs.arabic: أَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ أَنَّا جَعَلْنَا ٱلَّيْلَ لِيَسْكُنُوا۟ فِيهِ وَٱلنَّهَارَ مُبْصِرًا ۚ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَٰتٍۢ لِّقَوْمٍۢ يُؤْمِنُونَ
ayahs.sahih: Do they not see that We made the night that they may rest therein and the day giving sight? Indeed in that are signs for a people who believe.
ayahs.clear: Do they not see that We made the night for them to rest therein, and the day for visibility? Surely in that are signs for people who believe.
ayahs.kemenag: Apakah mereka tidak memperhatikan, bahwa sesungguhnya Kami telah menjadikan malam supaya mereka beristirahat padanya dan siang yang menerangi? Sesungguhnya pada yang demikian itu terdapat tanda-tanda (kekuasaan Allah) bagi orang-orang yang beriman.

ayahs.arabic: وَيَوْمَ يُنفَخُ فِى ٱلصُّورِ فَفَزِعَ مَن فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَن فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ إِلَّا مَن شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ ۚ وَكُلٌّ أَتَوْهُ دَٰخِرِينَ
ayahs.sahih: And [warn of] the Day the Horn will be blown, and whoever is in the heavens and whoever is on the earth will be terrified except whom Allah wills. And all will come to Him humbled.
ayahs.clear: On the Day when the Trumpet is blown, everyone in the heavens and the earth will be horrified, except whomever God wills; and everyone will come before Him in humility.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan (ingatlah) hari (ketika) ditiup sangkakala, maka terkejutlah segala yang di langit dan segala yang di bumi, kecuali siapa yang dikehendaki Allah. Dan semua mereka datang menghadap-Nya dengan merendahkan diri.

ayahs.arabic: وَتَرَى ٱلْجِبَالَ تَحْسَبُهَا جَامِدَةًۭ وَهِىَ تَمُرُّ مَرَّ ٱلسَّحَابِ ۚ صُنْعَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَتْقَنَ كُلَّ شَىْءٍ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ خَبِيرٌۢ بِمَا تَفْعَلُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And you see the mountains, thinking them rigid, while they will pass as the passing of clouds. [It is] the work of Allah, who perfected all things. Indeed, He is Acquainted with that which you do.
ayahs.clear: And you see the mountains, and imagine them fixed, yet they pass, as the passing of the clouds—the making of God, who has perfected everything. He is fully Informed of what you do.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan kamu lihat gunung-gunung itu, kamu sangka dia tetap di tempatnya, padahal ia berjalan sebagai jalannya awan. (Begitulah) perbuatan Allah yang membuat dengan kokoh tiap-tiap sesuatu; sesungguhnya Allah Maha Mengetahui apa yang kamu kerjakan.

ayahs.arabic: مَن جَآءَ بِٱلْحَسَنَةِ فَلَهُۥ خَيْرٌۭ مِّنْهَا وَهُم مِّن فَزَعٍۢ يَوْمَئِذٍ ءَامِنُونَ
ayahs.sahih: Whoever comes [at Judgement] with a good deed will have better than it, and they, from the terror of that Day, will be safe.
ayahs.clear: Whoever brings a virtue will receive better than it—and they will be safe from the horrors of that Day.
ayahs.kemenag: Barangsiapa yang membawa kebaikan, maka ia memperoleh (balasan) yang lebih baik dari padanya, sedang mereka itu adalah orang-orang yang aman tenteram dari pada kejutan yang dahsyat pada hari itu.

ayahs.arabic: وَمَن جَآءَ بِٱلسَّيِّئَةِ فَكُبَّتْ وُجُوهُهُمْ فِى ٱلنَّارِ هَلْ تُجْزَوْنَ إِلَّا مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And whoever comes with an evil deed - their faces will be overturned into the Fire, [and it will be said], "Are you recompensed except for what you used to do?"
ayahs.clear: But whoever brings evil—their faces will be tumbled into the Fire. Will you be rewarded except for what you used to do?
ayahs.kemenag: Dan barang siapa yang membawa kejahatan, maka disungkurkanlah muka mereka ke dalam neraka. Tiadalah kamu dibalasi, melainkan (setimpal) dengan apa yang dahulu kamu kerjakan.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّمَآ أُمِرْتُ أَنْ أَعْبُدَ رَبَّ هَٰذِهِ ٱلْبَلْدَةِ ٱلَّذِى حَرَّمَهَا وَلَهُۥ كُلُّ شَىْءٍۢ ۖ وَأُمِرْتُ أَنْ أَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلْمُسْلِمِينَ
ayahs.sahih: [Say, O Muhammad], "I have only been commanded to worship the Lord of this city, who made it sacred and to whom [belongs] all things. And I am commanded to be of the Muslims [those who submit to Allah]
ayahs.clear: “I was commanded to worship the Lord of this town, who has sanctified it, and to Whom everything belongs; and I was commanded to be of those who submit.
ayahs.kemenag: Aku hanya diperintahkan untuk menyembah Tuhan negeri ini (Mekah) Yang telah menjadikannya suci dan kepunyaan-Nya-lah segala sesuatu, dan aku diperintahkan supaya aku termasuk orang-orang yang berserah diri.

ayahs.arabic: وَأَنْ أَتْلُوَا۟ ٱلْقُرْءَانَ ۖ فَمَنِ ٱهْتَدَىٰ فَإِنَّمَا يَهْتَدِى لِنَفْسِهِۦ ۖ وَمَن ضَلَّ فَقُلْ إِنَّمَآ أَنَا۠ مِنَ ٱلْمُنذِرِينَ
ayahs.sahih: And to recite the Qur'an." And whoever is guided is only guided for [the benefit of] himself; and whoever strays - say, "I am only [one] of the warners."
ayahs.clear: And to recite the Quran.” Whoever is guided—is guided to his own advantage. And whoever goes astray, then say, “I am one of the warners.”
ayahs.kemenag: Dan supaya aku membacakan Al Quran (kepada manusia). Maka barangsiapa yang mendapat petunjuk maka sesungguhnya ia hanyalah mendapat petunjuk untuk (kebaikan) dirinya, dan barangsiapa yang sesat maka katakanlah: "Sesungguhnya aku (ini) tidak lain hanyalah salah seorang pemberi peringatan".

ayahs.arabic: وَقُلِ ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ سَيُرِيكُمْ ءَايَٰتِهِۦ فَتَعْرِفُونَهَا ۚ وَمَا رَبُّكَ بِغَٰفِلٍ عَمَّا تَعْمَلُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And say, "[All] praise is [due] to Allah. He will show you His signs, and you will recognize them. And your Lord is not unaware of what you do."
ayahs.clear: And say, “Praise belongs to God; He will show you His signs, and you will recognize them. Your Lord is not heedless of what you do.”
ayahs.kemenag: Dan katakanlah: "Segala puji bagi Allah, Dia akan memperlihatkan kepadamu tanda-tanda kebesaran-Nya, maka kamu akan mengetahuinya. Dan Tuhanmu tiada lalai dari apa yang kamu kerjakan".

ayahs.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ طسٓمٓ
ayahs.sahih: Ta, Seen, Meem.
ayahs.clear: Ta, Seen, Meem.
ayahs.kemenag: Thaa Siin Miim

ayahs.arabic: تِلْكَ ءَايَٰتُ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ ٱلْمُبِينِ
ayahs.sahih: These are the verses of the clear Book.
ayahs.clear: These are the Verses of the Clear Book.
ayahs.kemenag: Ini adalah ayat-ayat Kitab (Al Quran) yang nyata (dari Allah).

ayahs.arabic: نَتْلُوا۟ عَلَيْكَ مِن نَّبَإِ مُوسَىٰ وَفِرْعَوْنَ بِٱلْحَقِّ لِقَوْمٍۢ يُؤْمِنُونَ
ayahs.sahih: We recite to you from the news of Moses and Pharaoh in truth for a people who believe.
ayahs.clear: We narrate to you from the history of Moses and Pharaoh—in truth—for people who believe.
ayahs.kemenag: Kami membacakan kepadamu sebagian dari kisah Musa dan Fir'aun dengan benar untuk orang-orang yang beriman.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ فِرْعَوْنَ عَلَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَجَعَلَ أَهْلَهَا شِيَعًۭا يَسْتَضْعِفُ طَآئِفَةًۭ مِّنْهُمْ يُذَبِّحُ أَبْنَآءَهُمْ وَيَسْتَحْىِۦ نِسَآءَهُمْ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ مِنَ ٱلْمُفْسِدِينَ
ayahs.sahih: Indeed, Pharaoh exalted himself in the land and made its people into factions, oppressing a sector among them, slaughtering their [newborn] sons and keeping their females alive. Indeed, he was of the corrupters.
ayahs.clear: Pharaoh exalted himself in the land, and divided its people into factions. He persecuted a group of them, slaughtering their sons, while sparing their daughters. He was truly a corrupter.
ayahs.kemenag: Sesungguhnya Fir'aun telah berbuat sewenang-wenang di muka bumi dan menjadikan penduduknya berpecah belah, dengan menindas segolongan dari mereka, menyembelih anak laki-laki mereka dan membiarkan hidup anak-anak perempuan mereka. Sesungguhnya Fir'aun termasuk orang-orang yang berbuat kerusakan.

ayahs.arabic: وَنُرِيدُ أَن نَّمُنَّ عَلَى ٱلَّذِينَ ٱسْتُضْعِفُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَنَجْعَلَهُمْ أَئِمَّةًۭ وَنَجْعَلَهُمُ ٱلْوَٰرِثِينَ
ayahs.sahih: And We wanted to confer favor upon those who were oppressed in the land and make them leaders and make them inheritors
ayahs.clear: But We desired to favor those who were oppressed in the land, and to make them leaders, and to make them the inheritors.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan Kami hendak memberi karunia kepada orang-orang yang tertindas di bumi (Mesir) itu dan hendak menjadikan mereka pemimpin dan menjadikan mereka orang-orang yang mewarisi (bumi),

ayahs.arabic: وَنُمَكِّنَ لَهُمْ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَنُرِىَ فِرْعَوْنَ وَهَٰمَٰنَ وَجُنُودَهُمَا مِنْهُم مَّا كَانُوا۟ يَحْذَرُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And establish them in the land and show Pharaoh and [his minister] Haman and their soldiers through them that which they had feared.
ayahs.clear: And to establish them in the land; and to show Pharaoh, Hamaan, and their troops, the very thing they feared.
ayahs.kemenag: dan akan Kami teguhkan kedudukan mereka di muka bumi dan akan Kami perlihatkan kepada Fir'aun dan Haman beserta tentaranya apa yang selalu mereka khawatirkan dari mereka itu.

ayahs.arabic: وَأَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَىٰٓ أُمِّ مُوسَىٰٓ أَنْ أَرْضِعِيهِ ۖ فَإِذَا خِفْتِ عَلَيْهِ فَأَلْقِيهِ فِى ٱلْيَمِّ وَلَا تَخَافِى وَلَا تَحْزَنِىٓ ۖ إِنَّا رَآدُّوهُ إِلَيْكِ وَجَاعِلُوهُ مِنَ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
ayahs.sahih: And We inspired to the mother of Moses, "Suckle him; but when you fear for him, cast him into the river and do not fear and do not grieve. Indeed, We will return him to you and will make him [one] of the messengers."
ayahs.clear: We inspired the mother of Moses: “Nurse him; then, when you fear for him, cast him into the river, and do not fear, nor grieve; We will return him to you, and make him one of the messengers.”
ayahs.kemenag: Dan kami ilhamkan kepada ibu Musa; "Susuilah dia, dan apabila kamu khawatir terhadapnya maka jatuhkanlah dia ke sungai (Nil). Dan janganlah kamu khawatir dan janganlah (pula) bersedih hati, karena sesungguhnya Kami akan mengembalikannya kepadamu, dan menjadikannya (salah seorang) dari para rasul.

ayahs.arabic: فَٱلْتَقَطَهُۥٓ ءَالُ فِرْعَوْنَ لِيَكُونَ لَهُمْ عَدُوًّۭا وَحَزَنًا ۗ إِنَّ فِرْعَوْنَ وَهَٰمَٰنَ وَجُنُودَهُمَا كَانُوا۟ خَٰطِـِٔينَ
ayahs.sahih: And the family of Pharaoh picked him up [out of the river] so that he would become to them an enemy and a [cause of] grief. Indeed, Pharaoh and Haman and their soldiers were deliberate sinners.
ayahs.clear: Pharaoh’s household picked him up, to be an opponent and a sorrow for them. Pharaoh, Hamaan, and their troops were sinners.
ayahs.kemenag: Maka dipungutlah ia oleh keluarga Fir'aun yang akibatnya dia menjadi musuh dan kesedihan bagi mereka. Sesungguhnya Fir'aun dan Haman beserta tentaranya adalah orang-orang yang bersalah.

ayahs.arabic: وَقَالَتِ ٱمْرَأَتُ فِرْعَوْنَ قُرَّتُ عَيْنٍۢ لِّى وَلَكَ ۖ لَا تَقْتُلُوهُ عَسَىٰٓ أَن يَنفَعَنَآ أَوْ نَتَّخِذَهُۥ وَلَدًۭا وَهُمْ لَا يَشْعُرُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And the wife of Pharaoh said, "[He will be] a comfort of the eye for me and for you. Do not kill him; perhaps he may benefit us, or we may adopt him as a son." And they perceived not.
ayahs.clear: Pharaoh’s wife said, “An eye's delight for me and for you. Do not kill him; perhaps he will be useful to us, or we may adopt him as a son.” But they did not foresee.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan berkatalah isteri Fir'aun: "(Ia) adalah penyejuk mata hati bagiku dan bagimu. Janganlah kamu membunuhnya, mudah-mudahan ia bermanfaat kepada kita atau kita ambil ia menjadi anak", sedang mereka tiada menyadari.

ayahs.arabic: وَأَصْبَحَ فُؤَادُ أُمِّ مُوسَىٰ فَٰرِغًا ۖ إِن كَادَتْ لَتُبْدِى بِهِۦ لَوْلَآ أَن رَّبَطْنَا عَلَىٰ قَلْبِهَا لِتَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
ayahs.sahih: And the heart of Moses' mother became empty [of all else]. She was about to disclose [the matter concerning] him had We not bound fast her heart that she would be of the believers.
ayahs.clear: The heart of Moses’ mother became vacant. She was about to disclose him, had We not steadied her heart, that she may remain a believer.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan menjadi kosonglah hati ibu Musa. Sesungguhnya hampir saja ia menyatakan rahasia tentang Musa, seandainya tidak Kami teguhkan hatinya, supaya ia termasuk orang-orang yang percaya (kepada janji Allah).

ayahs.arabic: وَقَالَتْ لِأُخْتِهِۦ قُصِّيهِ ۖ فَبَصُرَتْ بِهِۦ عَن جُنُبٍۢ وَهُمْ لَا يَشْعُرُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And she said to his sister, "Follow him"; so she watched him from a distance while they perceived not.
ayahs.clear: She said to his sister, “Trail him.” So she watched him from afar, and they were unaware.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan berkatalah ibu Musa kepada saudara Musa yang perempuan: "Ikutilah dia" Maka kelihatanlah olehnya Musa dari jauh, sedang mereka tidak mengetahuinya,

ayahs.arabic: ۞ وَحَرَّمْنَا عَلَيْهِ ٱلْمَرَاضِعَ مِن قَبْلُ فَقَالَتْ هَلْ أَدُلُّكُمْ عَلَىٰٓ أَهْلِ بَيْتٍۢ يَكْفُلُونَهُۥ لَكُمْ وَهُمْ لَهُۥ نَٰصِحُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And We had prevented from him [all] wet nurses before, so she said, "Shall I direct you to a household that will be responsible for him for you while they are to him [for his upbringing] sincere?"
ayahs.clear: We forbade him breastfeeding at first. So she said, “Shall I tell you about a family that can raise him for you, and will look after him?”
ayahs.kemenag: dan Kami cegah Musa dari menyusu kepada perempuan-perempuan yang mau menyusui(nya) sebelum itu; maka berkatalah saudara Musa: "Maukah kamu aku tunjukkan kepadamu ahlul bait yang akan memeliharanya untukmu dan mereka dapat berlaku baik kepadanya?".

ayahs.arabic: فَرَدَدْنَٰهُ إِلَىٰٓ أُمِّهِۦ كَىْ تَقَرَّ عَيْنُهَا وَلَا تَحْزَنَ وَلِتَعْلَمَ أَنَّ وَعْدَ ٱللَّهِ حَقٌّۭ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
ayahs.sahih: So We restored him to his mother that she might be content and not grieve and that she would know that the promise of Allah is true. But most of the people do not know.
ayahs.clear: Thus We returned him to his mother, that she may be comforted, and not grieve, and know that God’s promise is true. But most of them do not know.
ayahs.kemenag: Maka kami kembalikan Musa kepada ibunya, supaya senang hatinya dan tidak berduka cita dan supaya ia mengetahui bahwa janji Allah itu adalah benar, tetapi kebanyakan manusia tidak mengetahuinya.

ayahs.arabic: وَلَمَّا بَلَغَ أَشُدَّهُۥ وَٱسْتَوَىٰٓ ءَاتَيْنَٰهُ حُكْمًۭا وَعِلْمًۭا ۚ وَكَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
ayahs.sahih: And when he attained his full strength and was [mentally] mature, We bestowed upon him judgement and knowledge. And thus do We reward the doers of good.
ayahs.clear: And when he reached his maturity, and became established, We gave him wisdom and knowledge. Thus do We reward the virtuous.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan setelah Musa cukup umur dan sempurna akalnya, Kami berikan kepadanya hikmah (kenabian) dan pengetahuan. Dan demikianlah Kami memberi balasan kepada orang-orang yang berbuat baik.

ayahs.arabic: وَدَخَلَ ٱلْمَدِينَةَ عَلَىٰ حِينِ غَفْلَةٍۢ مِّنْ أَهْلِهَا فَوَجَدَ فِيهَا رَجُلَيْنِ يَقْتَتِلَانِ هَٰذَا مِن شِيعَتِهِۦ وَهَٰذَا مِنْ عَدُوِّهِۦ ۖ فَٱسْتَغَٰثَهُ ٱلَّذِى مِن شِيعَتِهِۦ عَلَى ٱلَّذِى مِنْ عَدُوِّهِۦ فَوَكَزَهُۥ مُوسَىٰ فَقَضَىٰ عَلَيْهِ ۖ قَالَ هَٰذَا مِنْ عَمَلِ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنِ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ عَدُوٌّۭ مُّضِلٌّۭ مُّبِينٌۭ
ayahs.sahih: And he entered the city at a time of inattention by its people and found therein two men fighting: one from his faction and one from among his enemy. And the one from his faction called for help to him against the one from his enemy, so Moses struck him and [unintentionally] killed him. [Moses] said, "This is from the work of Satan. Indeed, he is a manifest, misleading enemy."
ayahs.clear: Once he entered the city, unnoticed by its people. He found in it two men fighting—one of his own sect, and one from his enemies. The one of his sect solicited his assistance against the one from his enemies; so Moses punched him, and put an end to him. He said, “This is of Satan's doing; he is an enemy that openly misleads.”
ayahs.kemenag: Dan Musa masuk ke kota (Memphis) ketika penduduknya sedang lengah, maka didapatinya di dalam kota itu dua orang laki-laki yang berkelahi; yang seorang dari golongannya (Bani Israil) dan seorang (lagi) dari musuhnya (kaum Fir'aun). Maka orang yang dari golongannya meminta pertolongan kepadanya, untuk mengalahkan orang yang dari musuhnya lalu Musa meninjunya, dan matilah musuhnya itu. Musa berkata: "Ini adalah perbuatan syaitan sesungguhnya syaitan itu adalah musuh yang menyesatkan lagi nyata (permusuhannya).

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ إِنِّى ظَلَمْتُ نَفْسِى فَٱغْفِرْ لِى فَغَفَرَ لَهُۥٓ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلْغَفُورُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
ayahs.sahih: He said, "My Lord, indeed I have wronged myself, so forgive me," and He forgave him. Indeed, He is the Forgiving, the Merciful.
ayahs.clear: He said, “My Lord, I have wronged myself, so forgive me.” So He forgave him. He is the Forgiver, the Merciful.
ayahs.kemenag: Musa mendoa: "Ya Tuhanku, sesungguhnya aku telah menganiaya diriku sendiri karena itu ampunilah aku". Maka Allah mengampuninya, sesungguhnya Allah Dialah Yang Maha Pengampun lagi Maha Penyayang.

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ بِمَآ أَنْعَمْتَ عَلَىَّ فَلَنْ أَكُونَ ظَهِيرًۭا لِّلْمُجْرِمِينَ
ayahs.sahih: He said, "My Lord, for the favor You bestowed upon me, I will never be an assistant to the criminals."
ayahs.clear: He said, “My Lord, in as much as you have favored me, I will never be a supporter of the criminals.”
ayahs.kemenag: Musa berkata: "Ya Tuhanku, demi nikmat yang telah Engkau anugerahkan kepadaku, aku sekali-kali tiada akan menjadi penolong bagi orang-orang yang berdosa".

ayahs.arabic: فَأَصْبَحَ فِى ٱلْمَدِينَةِ خَآئِفًۭا يَتَرَقَّبُ فَإِذَا ٱلَّذِى ٱسْتَنصَرَهُۥ بِٱلْأَمْسِ يَسْتَصْرِخُهُۥ ۚ قَالَ لَهُۥ مُوسَىٰٓ إِنَّكَ لَغَوِىٌّۭ مُّبِينٌۭ
