ayahs.sahih: Indeed, Allah holds the heavens and the earth, lest they cease. And if they should cease, no one could hold them [in place] after Him. Indeed, He is Forbearing and Forgiving.
ayahs.clear: God holds the heavens and the earth, lest they fall apart. And were they to fall apart, there is none to hold them together except He. He is Most Clement, Most Forgiving.
ayahs.kemenag: Sesungguhnya Allah menahan langit dan bumi supaya jangan lenyap; dan sungguh jika keduanya akan lenyap tidak ada seorangpun yang dapat menahan keduanya selain Allah. Sesungguhnya Dia adalah Maha Penyantun lagi Maha Pengampun.

ayahs.arabic: وَأَقْسَمُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ جَهْدَ أَيْمَٰنِهِمْ لَئِن جَآءَهُمْ نَذِيرٌۭ لَّيَكُونُنَّ أَهْدَىٰ مِنْ إِحْدَى ٱلْأُمَمِ ۖ فَلَمَّا جَآءَهُمْ نَذِيرٌۭ مَّا زَادَهُمْ إِلَّا نُفُورًا
ayahs.sahih: And they swore by Allah their strongest oaths that if a warner came to them, they would be more guided than [any] one of the [previous] nations. But when a warner came to them, it did not increase them except in aversion.
ayahs.clear: And they swore by God with their solemn oaths, that if a warner came to them, they would be more guided than any other people. Yet when a warner came to them, it only increased them in aversion.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan mereka bersumpah dengan nama Allah dengan sekuat-kuat sumpah; sesungguhnya jika datang kepada mereka seorang pemberi peringatan, niscaya mereka akan lebih mendapat petunjuk dari salah satu umat-umat (yang lain). Tatkala datang kepada mereka pemberi peringatan, maka kedatangannya itu tidak menambah kepada mereka, kecuali jauhnya mereka dari (kebenaran),

ayahs.arabic: ٱسْتِكْبَارًۭا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَكْرَ ٱلسَّيِّئِ ۚ وَلَا يَحِيقُ ٱلْمَكْرُ ٱلسَّيِّئُ إِلَّا بِأَهْلِهِۦ ۚ فَهَلْ يَنظُرُونَ إِلَّا سُنَّتَ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ ۚ فَلَن تَجِدَ لِسُنَّتِ ٱللَّهِ تَبْدِيلًۭا ۖ وَلَن تَجِدَ لِسُنَّتِ ٱللَّهِ تَحْوِيلًا
ayahs.sahih: [Due to] arrogance in the land and plotting of evil; but the evil plot does not encompass except its own people. Then do they await except the way of the former peoples? But you will never find in the way of Allah any change, and you will never find in the way of Allah any alteration.
ayahs.clear: Priding themselves on earth, and scheming evil. But evil scheming overwhelms none but its authors. Do they expect anything but the precedent of the ancients? You will not find any change in God’s practice, and you will not find any substitute to God’s practice.
ayahs.kemenag: karena kesombongan (mereka) di muka bumi dan karena rencana (mereka) yang jahat. Rencana yang jahat itu tidak akan menimpa selain orang yang merencanakannya sendiri. Tiadalah yang mereka nanti-nantikan melainkan (berlakunya) sunnah (Allah yang telah berlaku) kepada orang-orang yang terdahulu. Maka sekali-kali kamu tidak akan mendapat penggantian bagi sunnah Allah, dan sekali-kali tidak (pula) akan menemui penyimpangan bagi sunnah Allah itu.

ayahs.arabic: أَوَلَمْ يَسِيرُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَيَنظُرُوا۟ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَٰقِبَةُ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ وَكَانُوٓا۟ أَشَدَّ مِنْهُمْ قُوَّةًۭ ۚ وَمَا كَانَ ٱللَّهُ لِيُعْجِزَهُۥ مِن شَىْءٍۢ فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَلَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ عَلِيمًۭا قَدِيرًۭا
ayahs.sahih: Have they not traveled through the land and observed how was the end of those before them? And they were greater than them in power. But Allah is not to be caused failure by anything in the heavens or on the earth. Indeed, He is ever Knowing and Competent.
ayahs.clear: Have they not journeyed in the land and observed the fate of those who preceded them? They were superior to them in strength. But nothing can defeat God in the heavens or on Earth. He is indeed Omniscient and Omnipotent.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan apakah mereka tidak berjalan di muka bumi, lalu melihat bagaimana kesudahan orang-orang yang sebelum mereka, sedangkan orang-orang itu adalah lebih besar kekuatannya dari mereka? Dan tiada sesuatupun yang dapat melemahkan Allah baik di langit maupun di bumi. Sesungguhnya Allah Maha Mengetahui lagi Maha Kuasa.

ayahs.arabic: وَلَوْ يُؤَاخِذُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلنَّاسَ بِمَا كَسَبُوا۟ مَا تَرَكَ عَلَىٰ ظَهْرِهَا مِن دَآبَّةٍۢ وَلَٰكِن يُؤَخِّرُهُمْ إِلَىٰٓ أَجَلٍۢ مُّسَمًّۭى ۖ فَإِذَا جَآءَ أَجَلُهُمْ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ كَانَ بِعِبَادِهِۦ بَصِيرًۢا
ayahs.sahih: And if Allah were to impose blame on the people for what they have earned, He would not leave upon the earth any creature. But He defers them for a specified term. And when their time comes, then indeed Allah has ever been, of His servants, Seeing.
ayahs.clear: If God were to punish the people for what they have earned, He would not leave a single living creature on its surface. But He defers them until a stated time. Then, when their time has arrived—God is Observant of His creatures.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan kalau sekiranya Allah menyiksa manusia disebabkan usahanya, niscaya Dia tidak akan meninggalkan di atas permukaan bumi suatu mahluk yang melatapun akan tetapi Allah menangguhkan (penyiksaan) mereka, sampai waktu yang tertentu; maka apabila datang ajal mereka, maka sesungguhnya Allah adalah Maha Melihat (keadaan) hamba-hamba-Nya.

ayahs.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ يسٓ
ayahs.sahih: Ya, Seen.
ayahs.clear: Ya, Seen.
ayahs.kemenag: Yaa siin

ayahs.arabic: وَٱلْقُرْءَانِ ٱلْحَكِيمِ
ayahs.sahih: By the wise Qur'an.
ayahs.clear: By the Wise Quran.
ayahs.kemenag: Demi Al Quran yang penuh hikmah,

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّكَ لَمِنَ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
ayahs.sahih: Indeed you, [O Muhammad], are from among the messengers,
ayahs.clear: You are one of the messengers.
ayahs.kemenag: Sesungguhnya kamu salah seorang dari rasul-rasul,

ayahs.arabic: عَلَىٰ صِرَٰطٍۢ مُّسْتَقِيمٍۢ
ayahs.sahih: On a straight path.
ayahs.clear: On a straight path.
ayahs.kemenag: (yang berada) diatas jalan yang lurus,

ayahs.arabic: تَنزِيلَ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ
ayahs.sahih: [This is] a revelation of the Exalted in Might, the Merciful,
ayahs.clear: The revelation of the Almighty, the Merciful.
ayahs.kemenag: (sebagai wahyu) yang diturunkan oleh Yang Maha Perkasa lagi Maha Penyayang,

ayahs.arabic: لِتُنذِرَ قَوْمًۭا مَّآ أُنذِرَ ءَابَآؤُهُمْ فَهُمْ غَٰفِلُونَ
ayahs.sahih: That you may warn a people whose forefathers were not warned, so they are unaware.
ayahs.clear: To warn a people whose ancestors were not warned, and so they are unaware.
ayahs.kemenag: Agar kamu memberi peringatan kepada kaum yang bapak-bapak mereka belum pernah diberi peringatan, karena itu mereka lalai.

ayahs.arabic: لَقَدْ حَقَّ ٱلْقَوْلُ عَلَىٰٓ أَكْثَرِهِمْ فَهُمْ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ
ayahs.sahih: Already the word has come into effect upon most of them, so they do not believe.
ayahs.clear: The Word was realized against most of them, for they do not believe.
ayahs.kemenag: Sesungguhnya telah pasti berlaku perkataan (ketentuan Allah) terhadap kebanyakan mereka, kerena mereka tidak beriman.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّا جَعَلْنَا فِىٓ أَعْنَٰقِهِمْ أَغْلَٰلًۭا فَهِىَ إِلَى ٱلْأَذْقَانِ فَهُم مُّقْمَحُونَ
ayahs.sahih: Indeed, We have put shackles on their necks, and they are to their chins, so they are with heads [kept] aloft.
ayahs.clear: We placed shackles around their necks, up to their chins, so they are stiff-necked.
ayahs.kemenag: Sesungguhnya Kami telah memasang belenggu dileher mereka, lalu tangan mereka (diangkat) ke dagu, maka karena itu mereka tertengadah.

ayahs.arabic: وَجَعَلْنَا مِنۢ بَيْنِ أَيْدِيهِمْ سَدًّۭا وَمِنْ خَلْفِهِمْ سَدًّۭا فَأَغْشَيْنَٰهُمْ فَهُمْ لَا يُبْصِرُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And We have put before them a barrier and behind them a barrier and covered them, so they do not see.
ayahs.clear: And We placed a barrier in front of them, and a barrier behind them, and We have enshrouded them, so they cannot see.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan Kami adakan di hadapan mereka dinding dan di belakang mereka dinding (pula), dan Kami tutup (mata) mereka sehingga mereka tidak dapat melihat.

ayahs.arabic: وَسَوَآءٌ عَلَيْهِمْ ءَأَنذَرْتَهُمْ أَمْ لَمْ تُنذِرْهُمْ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And it is all the same for them whether you warn them or do not warn them - they will not believe.
ayahs.clear: It is the same for them, whether you warn them, or do not warn them—they will not believe.
ayahs.kemenag: Sama saja bagi mereka apakah kamu memberi peringatan kepada mereka ataukah kamu tidak memberi peringatan kepada mereka, mereka tidak akan beriman.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّمَا تُنذِرُ مَنِ ٱتَّبَعَ ٱلذِّكْرَ وَخَشِىَ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنَ بِٱلْغَيْبِ ۖ فَبَشِّرْهُ بِمَغْفِرَةٍۢ وَأَجْرٍۢ كَرِيمٍ
ayahs.sahih: You can only warn one who follows the message and fears the Most Merciful unseen. So give him good tidings of forgiveness and noble reward.
ayahs.clear: You warn only him who follows the Message, and fears the Most Gracious inwardly. So give him good news of forgiveness, and a generous reward.
ayahs.kemenag: Sesungguhnya kamu hanya memberi peringatan kepada orang-orang yang mau mengikuti peringatan dan yang takut kepada Tuhan Yang Maha Pemurah walaupun dia tidak melihatnya. Maka berilah mereka kabar gembira dengan ampunan dan pahala yang mulia.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّا نَحْنُ نُحْىِ ٱلْمَوْتَىٰ وَنَكْتُبُ مَا قَدَّمُوا۟ وَءَاثَٰرَهُمْ ۚ وَكُلَّ شَىْءٍ أَحْصَيْنَٰهُ فِىٓ إِمَامٍۢ مُّبِينٍۢ
ayahs.sahih: Indeed, it is We who bring the dead to life and record what they have put forth and what they left behind, and all things We have enumerated in a clear register.
ayahs.clear: It is We who revive the dead; and We write down what they have forwarded, and their traces. We have tallied all things in a Clear Record.
ayahs.kemenag: Sesungguhnya Kami menghidupkan orang-orang mati dan Kami menuliskan apa yang telah mereka kerjakan dan bekas-bekas yang mereka tinggalkan. Dan segala sesuatu Kami kumpulkan dalam Kitab Induk yang nyata (Lauh Mahfuzh).

ayahs.arabic: وَٱضْرِبْ لَهُم مَّثَلًا أَصْحَٰبَ ٱلْقَرْيَةِ إِذْ جَآءَهَا ٱلْمُرْسَلُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And present to them an example: the people of the city, when the messengers came to it -
ayahs.clear: And cite for them the parable of the landlords of the town—when the messengers came to it.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan buatlah bagi mereka suatu perumpamaan, yaitu penduduk suatu negeri ketika utusan-utusan datang kepada mereka.

ayahs.arabic: إِذْ أَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَيْهِمُ ٱثْنَيْنِ فَكَذَّبُوهُمَا فَعَزَّزْنَا بِثَالِثٍۢ فَقَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّآ إِلَيْكُم مُّرْسَلُونَ
ayahs.sahih: When We sent to them two but they denied them, so We strengthened them with a third, and they said, "Indeed, we are messengers to you."
ayahs.clear: We sent them two messengers, but they denied them both, so We reinforced them with a third. They said, “We are messengers to you.”
ayahs.kemenag: (yaitu) ketika Kami mengutus kepada mereka dua orang utusan, lalu mereka mendustakan keduanya; kemudian Kami kuatkan dengan (utusan) yang ketiga, maka ketiga utusan itu berkata: "Sesungguhnya kami adalah orang-orang di utus kepadamu".

ayahs.arabic: قَالُوا۟ مَآ أَنتُمْ إِلَّا بَشَرٌۭ مِّثْلُنَا وَمَآ أَنزَلَ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ مِن شَىْءٍ إِنْ أَنتُمْ إِلَّا تَكْذِبُونَ
ayahs.sahih: They said, "You are not but human beings like us, and the Most Merciful has not revealed a thing. You are only telling lies."
ayahs.clear: They said, “You are nothing but humans like us, and the Gracious did not send down anything; you are only lying.”
ayahs.kemenag: Mereka menjawab: "Kamu tidak lain hanyalah manusia seperti kami dan Allah Yang Maha Pemurah tidak menurunkan sesuatupun, kamu tidak lain hanyalah pendusta belaka".

ayahs.arabic: قَالُوا۟ رَبُّنَا يَعْلَمُ إِنَّآ إِلَيْكُمْ لَمُرْسَلُونَ
ayahs.sahih: They said, "Our Lord knows that we are messengers to you,
ayahs.clear: They said, “Our Lord knows that we are messengers to you.
ayahs.kemenag: Mereka berkata: "Tuhan kami mengetahui bahwa sesungguhnya kami adalah orang yang diutus kepada kamu".

ayahs.arabic: وَمَا عَلَيْنَآ إِلَّا ٱلْبَلَٰغُ ٱلْمُبِينُ
ayahs.sahih: And we are not responsible except for clear notification."
ayahs.clear: And our only duty is clear communication.”
ayahs.kemenag: Dan kewajiban kami tidak lain hanyalah menyampaikan (perintah Allah) dengan jelas".

ayahs.arabic: قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّا تَطَيَّرْنَا بِكُمْ ۖ لَئِن لَّمْ تَنتَهُوا۟ لَنَرْجُمَنَّكُمْ وَلَيَمَسَّنَّكُم مِّنَّا عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌۭ
ayahs.sahih: They said, "Indeed, we consider you a bad omen. If you do not desist, we will surely stone you, and there will surely touch you, from us, a painful punishment."
ayahs.clear: They said, “We see an evil omen in you; if you do not give up, we will stone you, and a painful punishment from us will befall you.”
ayahs.kemenag: Mereka menjawab: "Sesungguhnya kami bernasib malang karena kamu, sesungguhnya jika kamu tidak berhenti (menyeru kami), niscaya kami akan merajam kamu dan kamu pasti akan mendapat siksa yang pedih dari kami".

ayahs.arabic: قَالُوا۟ طَٰٓئِرُكُم مَّعَكُمْ ۚ أَئِن ذُكِّرْتُم ۚ بَلْ أَنتُمْ قَوْمٌۭ مُّسْرِفُونَ
ayahs.sahih: They said, "Your omen is with yourselves. Is it because you were reminded? Rather, you are a transgressing people."
ayahs.clear: They said, “Your evil omen is upon you. Is it because you were reminded? But you are an extravagant people.”
ayahs.kemenag: Utusan-utusan itu berkata: "Kemalangan kamu adalah karena kamu sendiri. Apakah jika kamu diberi peringatan (kamu bernasib malang)? Sebenarnya kamu adalah kaum yang melampui batas".

ayahs.arabic: وَجَآءَ مِنْ أَقْصَا ٱلْمَدِينَةِ رَجُلٌۭ يَسْعَىٰ قَالَ يَٰقَوْمِ ٱتَّبِعُوا۟ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
ayahs.sahih: And there came from the farthest end of the city a man, running. He said, "O my people, follow the messengers.
ayahs.clear: Then a man came running from the remotest part of the city. He said, “O my people, follow the messengers.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan datanglah dari ujung kota, seorang laki-laki dengan bergegas-gegas ia berkata: "Hai kaumku, ikutilah utusan-utusan itu".

ayahs.arabic: ٱتَّبِعُوا۟ مَن لَّا يَسْـَٔلُكُمْ أَجْرًۭا وَهُم مُّهْتَدُونَ
ayahs.sahih: Follow those who do not ask of you [any] payment, and they are [rightly] guided.
ayahs.clear: Follow those who ask you of no wage, and are themselves guided.
ayahs.kemenag: Ikutilah orang yang tiada minta balasan kepadamu; dan mereka adalah orang-orang yang mendapat petunjuk.

ayahs.arabic: وَمَا لِىَ لَآ أَعْبُدُ ٱلَّذِى فَطَرَنِى وَإِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And why should I not worship He who created me and to whom you will be returned?
ayahs.clear: “And why should I not worship Him Who created me, and to Whom you will be returned?
ayahs.kemenag: Mengapa aku tidak menyembah (Tuhan) yang telah menciptakanku dan yang hanya kepada-Nya-lah kamu (semua) akan dikembalikan?

ayahs.arabic: ءَأَتَّخِذُ مِن دُونِهِۦٓ ءَالِهَةً إِن يُرِدْنِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ بِضُرٍّۢ لَّا تُغْنِ عَنِّى شَفَٰعَتُهُمْ شَيْـًۭٔا وَلَا يُنقِذُونِ
ayahs.sahih: Should I take other than Him [false] deities [while], if the Most Merciful intends for me some adversity, their intercession will not avail me at all, nor can they save me?
ayahs.clear: Shall I take other gods instead of Him? If the Merciful desires harm for me, their intercession will not avail me at all, nor will they save me.
ayahs.kemenag: Mengapa aku akan menyembah tuhan-tuhan selain-Nya jika (Allah) Yang Maha Pemurah menghendaki kemudharatan terhadapku, niscaya syafa'at mereka tidak memberi manfaat sedikitpun bagi diriku dan mereka tidak (pula) dapat menyelamatkanku?

ayahs.arabic: إِنِّىٓ إِذًۭا لَّفِى ضَلَٰلٍۢ مُّبِينٍ
ayahs.sahih: Indeed, I would then be in manifest error.
ayahs.clear: In that case, I would be completely lost.
ayahs.kemenag: Sesungguhnya aku kalau begitu pasti berada dalam kesesatan yang nyata.

ayahs.arabic: إِنِّىٓ ءَامَنتُ بِرَبِّكُمْ فَٱسْمَعُونِ
ayahs.sahih: Indeed, I have believed in your Lord, so listen to me."
ayahs.clear: I have believed in your Lord, so listen to me.”
ayahs.kemenag: Sesungguhnya aku telah beriman kepada Tuhanmu; maka dengarkanlah (pengakuan keimanan)ku.

ayahs.arabic: قِيلَ ٱدْخُلِ ٱلْجَنَّةَ ۖ قَالَ يَٰلَيْتَ قَوْمِى يَعْلَمُونَ
ayahs.sahih: It was said, "Enter Paradise." He said, "I wish my people could know
ayahs.clear: It was said, “Enter Paradise.” He said, “If only my people knew.
ayahs.kemenag: Dikatakan (kepadanya): "Masuklah ke surga". Ia berkata: "Alangkah baiknya sekiranya kamumku mengetahui.

ayahs.arabic: بِمَا غَفَرَ لِى رَبِّى وَجَعَلَنِى مِنَ ٱلْمُكْرَمِينَ
ayahs.sahih: Of how my Lord has forgiven me and placed me among the honored."
ayahs.clear: How my Lord has forgiven me, and made me one of the honored.”
ayahs.kemenag: Apa yang menyebabkan Tuhanku memberi ampun kepadaku dan menjadikan aku termasuk orang-orang yang dimuliakan".

ayahs.arabic: ۞ وَمَآ أَنزَلْنَا عَلَىٰ قَوْمِهِۦ مِنۢ بَعْدِهِۦ مِن جُندٍۢ مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَمَا كُنَّا مُنزِلِينَ
ayahs.sahih: And We did not send down upon his people after him any soldiers from the heaven, nor would We have done so.
ayahs.clear: After him, We sent down no hosts from heaven to his people; nor would We ever send any down.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan kami tidak menurunkan kepada kaumnya sesudah dia (meninggal) suatu pasukanpun dari langit dan tidak layak Kami menurunkannya.

ayahs.arabic: إِن كَانَتْ إِلَّا صَيْحَةًۭ وَٰحِدَةًۭ فَإِذَا هُمْ خَٰمِدُونَ
ayahs.sahih: It was not but one shout, and immediately they were extinguished.
ayahs.clear: It was just one Cry, and they were stilled.
ayahs.kemenag: Tidak ada siksaan atas mereka melainkan satu teriakan suara saja; maka tiba-tiba mereka semuanya mati.

ayahs.arabic: يَٰحَسْرَةً عَلَى ٱلْعِبَادِ ۚ مَا يَأْتِيهِم مِّن رَّسُولٍ إِلَّا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ
ayahs.sahih: How regretful for the servants. There did not come to them any messenger except that they used to ridicule him.
ayahs.clear: Alas for the servants. No messenger ever came to them, but they ridiculed him.
ayahs.kemenag: Alangkah besarnya penyesalan terhadap hamba-hamba itu, tiada datang seorang rasulpun kepada mereka melainkan mereka selalu memperolok-olokkannya.

ayahs.arabic: أَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ كَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا قَبْلَهُم مِّنَ ٱلْقُرُونِ أَنَّهُمْ إِلَيْهِمْ لَا يَرْجِعُونَ
ayahs.sahih: Have they not considered how many generations We destroyed before them - that they to them will not return?
ayahs.clear: Have they not considered how many generations We destroyed before them; and that unto them they will not return?
ayahs.kemenag: Tidakkah mereka mengetahui berapa banyaknya umat-umat sebelum mereka yang telah Kami binasakan, bahwasanya orang-orang (yang telah Kami binasakan) itu tiada kembali kepada mereka.

ayahs.arabic: وَإِن كُلٌّۭ لَّمَّا جَمِيعٌۭ لَّدَيْنَا مُحْضَرُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And indeed, all of them will yet be brought present before Us.
ayahs.clear: All of them, every single one of them, will be arraigned before Us.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan setiap mereka semuanya akan dikumpulkan lagi kepada Kami.

ayahs.arabic: وَءَايَةٌۭ لَّهُمُ ٱلْأَرْضُ ٱلْمَيْتَةُ أَحْيَيْنَٰهَا وَأَخْرَجْنَا مِنْهَا حَبًّۭا فَمِنْهُ يَأْكُلُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And a sign for them is the dead earth. We have brought it to life and brought forth from it grain, and from it they eat.
ayahs.clear: And there is a sign for them in the dead land: We give it life, and produce from it grains from which they eat.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan suatu tanda (kekuasaan Allah yang besar) bagi mereka adalah bumi yang mati. Kami hidupkan bumi itu dan Kami keluarkan dari padanya biji-bijian, maka daripadanya mereka makan.

ayahs.arabic: وَجَعَلْنَا فِيهَا جَنَّٰتٍۢ مِّن نَّخِيلٍۢ وَأَعْنَٰبٍۢ وَفَجَّرْنَا فِيهَا مِنَ ٱلْعُيُونِ
ayahs.sahih: And We placed therein gardens of palm trees and grapevines and caused to burst forth therefrom some springs -
ayahs.clear: And We place in it gardens of palm-trees and vines, and cause springs to gush out of it.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan Kami jadikan padanya kebun-kebun kurma dan anggur dan Kami pancarkan padanya beberapa mata air,

ayahs.arabic: لِيَأْكُلُوا۟ مِن ثَمَرِهِۦ وَمَا عَمِلَتْهُ أَيْدِيهِمْ ۖ أَفَلَا يَشْكُرُونَ
ayahs.sahih: That they may eat of His fruit. And their hands have not produced it, so will they not be grateful?
ayahs.clear: That they may eat from its fruits, although their hands did not make it. Will they not be appreciative?
ayahs.kemenag: supaya mereka dapat makan dari buahnya, dan dari apa yang diusahakan oleh tangan mereka. Maka mengapakah mereka tidak bersyukur?

ayahs.arabic: سُبْحَٰنَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلْأَزْوَٰجَ كُلَّهَا مِمَّا تُنۢبِتُ ٱلْأَرْضُ وَمِنْ أَنفُسِهِمْ وَمِمَّا لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
ayahs.sahih: Exalted is He who created all pairs - from what the earth grows and from themselves and from that which they do not know.
ayahs.clear: Glory be to Him who created all the pairs; of what the earth produces, and of their own selves, and of what they do not know.
ayahs.kemenag: Maha Suci Tuhan yang telah menciptakan pasangan-pasangan semuanya, baik dari apa yang ditumbuhkan oleh bumi dan dari diri mereka maupun dari apa yang tidak mereka ketahui.

ayahs.arabic: وَءَايَةٌۭ لَّهُمُ ٱلَّيْلُ نَسْلَخُ مِنْهُ ٱلنَّهَارَ فَإِذَا هُم مُّظْلِمُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And a sign for them is the night. We remove from it [the light of] day, so they are [left] in darkness.
ayahs.clear: Another sign for them is the night: We strip the day out of it—and they are in darkness.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan suatu tanda (kekuasaan Allah yang besar) bagi mereka adalah malam; Kami tanggalkan siang dari malam itu, maka dengan serta merta mereka berada dalam kegelapan.

ayahs.arabic: وَٱلشَّمْسُ تَجْرِى لِمُسْتَقَرٍّۢ لَّهَا ۚ ذَٰلِكَ تَقْدِيرُ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْعَلِيمِ
ayahs.sahih: And the sun runs [on course] toward its stopping point. That is the determination of the Exalted in Might, the Knowing.
ayahs.clear: And the sun runs towards its destination. Such is the design of the Almighty, the All-Knowing.
ayahs.kemenag: dan matahari berjalan ditempat peredarannya. Demikianlah ketetapan Yang Maha Perkasa lagi Maha Mengetahui.

ayahs.arabic: وَٱلْقَمَرَ قَدَّرْنَٰهُ مَنَازِلَ حَتَّىٰ عَادَ كَٱلْعُرْجُونِ ٱلْقَدِيمِ
ayahs.sahih: And the moon - We have determined for it phases, until it returns [appearing] like the old date stalk.
ayahs.clear: And the moon: We have disposed it in phases, until it returns like the old twig.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan telah Kami tetapkan bagi bulan manzilah-manzilah, sehingga (setelah dia sampai ke manzilah yang terakhir) kembalilah dia sebagai bentuk tandan yang tua.

ayahs.arabic: لَا ٱلشَّمْسُ يَنۢبَغِى لَهَآ أَن تُدْرِكَ ٱلْقَمَرَ وَلَا ٱلَّيْلُ سَابِقُ ٱلنَّهَارِ ۚ وَكُلٌّۭ فِى فَلَكٍۢ يَسْبَحُونَ
ayahs.sahih: It is not allowable for the sun to reach the moon, nor does the night overtake the day, but each, in an orbit, is swimming.
ayahs.clear: The sun is not to overtake the moon, nor is the night to outpace the day. Each floats in an orbit.
ayahs.kemenag: Tidaklah mungkin bagi matahari mendapatkan bulan dan malampun tidak dapat mendahului siang. Dan masing-masing beredar pada garis edarnya.

ayahs.arabic: وَءَايَةٌۭ لَّهُمْ أَنَّا حَمَلْنَا ذُرِّيَّتَهُمْ فِى ٱلْفُلْكِ ٱلْمَشْحُونِ
ayahs.sahih: And a sign for them is that We carried their forefathers in a laden ship.
ayahs.clear: Another sign for them is that We carried their offspring in the laden Ark.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan suatu tanda (kebesaran Allah yang besar) bagi mereka adalah bahwa Kami angkut keturunan mereka dalam bahtera yang penuh muatan.

ayahs.arabic: وَخَلَقْنَا لَهُم مِّن مِّثْلِهِۦ مَا يَرْكَبُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And We created for them from the likes of it that which they ride.
ayahs.clear: And We created for them the like of it, in which they ride.
ayahs.kemenag: dan Kami ciptakan untuk mereka yang akan mereka kendarai seperti bahtera itu.

ayahs.arabic: وَإِن نَّشَأْ نُغْرِقْهُمْ فَلَا صَرِيخَ لَهُمْ وَلَا هُمْ يُنقَذُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And if We should will, We could drown them; then no one responding to a cry would there be for them, nor would they be saved
ayahs.clear: If We will, We can drown them—with no screaming to be heard from them, nor will they be saved.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan jika Kami menghendaki niscaya Kami tenggelamkan mereka, maka tiadalah bagi mereka penolong dan tidak pula mereka diselamatkan.

ayahs.arabic: إِلَّا رَحْمَةًۭ مِّنَّا وَمَتَٰعًا إِلَىٰ حِينٍۢ
ayahs.sahih: Except as a mercy from Us and provision for a time.
ayahs.clear: Except by a mercy from Us, and enjoyment for a while.
ayahs.kemenag: Tetapi (Kami selamatkan mereka) karena rahmat yang besar dari Kami dan untuk memberikan kesenangan hidup sampai kepada suatu ketika.

ayahs.arabic: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمُ ٱتَّقُوا۟ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيكُمْ وَمَا خَلْفَكُمْ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُرْحَمُونَ
ayahs.sahih: But when it is said to them, "Beware of what is before you and what is behind you; perhaps you will receive mercy... "
ayahs.clear: Yet when it is said to them, “Beware of what lies before you, and what lies behind you, that you may receive mercy.”
ayahs.kemenag: Dan apabila dikatakan kepada mereka: "Takutlah kamu akan siksa yang dihadapanmu dan siksa yang akan datang supaya kamu mendapat rahmat", (niscaya mereka berpaling).

ayahs.arabic: وَمَا تَأْتِيهِم مِّنْ ءَايَةٍۢ مِّنْ ءَايَٰتِ رَبِّهِمْ إِلَّا كَانُوا۟ عَنْهَا مُعْرِضِينَ
ayahs.sahih: And no sign comes to them from the signs of their Lord except that they are from it turning away.
ayahs.clear: Yet never came to them a sign of their Lord’s signs, but they turned away from it.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan sekali-kali tiada datang kepada mereka suatu tanda dari tanda tanda kekuasaan Tuhan mereka, melainkan mereka selalu berpaling daripadanya.

ayahs.arabic: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمْ أَنفِقُوا۟ مِمَّا رَزَقَكُمُ ٱللَّهُ قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لِلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ أَنُطْعِمُ مَن لَّوْ يَشَآءُ ٱللَّهُ أَطْعَمَهُۥٓ إِنْ أَنتُمْ إِلَّا فِى ضَلَٰلٍۢ مُّبِينٍۢ
ayahs.sahih: And when it is said to them, "Spend from that which Allah has provided for you," those who disbelieve say to those who believe, "Should we feed one whom, if Allah had willed, He would have fed? You are not but in clear error."
ayahs.clear: And when it is said to them, “Spend of what God has provided for you,” those who disbelieve say to those who believe, “Shall we feed someone whom God could feed, if He so willed? You must be deeply misguided.”
ayahs.kemenag: Dan apabila dikatakakan kepada mereka: "Nafkahkanlah sebahagian dari reski yang diberikan Allah kepadamu", maka orang-orang yang kafir itu berkata kepada orang-orang yang beriman: "Apakah kami akan memberi makan kepada orang-orang yang jika Allah menghendaki tentulah Dia akan memberinya makan, tiadalah kamu melainkan dalam kesesatan yang nyata".

ayahs.arabic: وَيَقُولُونَ مَتَىٰ هَٰذَا ٱلْوَعْدُ إِن كُنتُمْ صَٰدِقِينَ
ayahs.sahih: And they say, "When is this promise, if you should be truthful?"
ayahs.clear: And they say, “When will this promise be, if you are truthful?”
ayahs.kemenag: Dan mereka berkata: "Bilakah (terjadinya) janji ini (hari berbangkit) jika kamu adalah orang-orang yang benar?".

ayahs.arabic: مَا يَنظُرُونَ إِلَّا صَيْحَةًۭ وَٰحِدَةًۭ تَأْخُذُهُمْ وَهُمْ يَخِصِّمُونَ
ayahs.sahih: They do not await except one blast which will seize them while they are disputing.
ayahs.clear: All they can expect is a single blast, which will seize them while they feud.
ayahs.kemenag: Mereka tidak menunggu melainkan satu teriakan saja yang akan membinasakan mereka ketika mereka sedang bertengkar.

ayahs.arabic: فَلَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ تَوْصِيَةًۭ وَلَآ إِلَىٰٓ أَهْلِهِمْ يَرْجِعُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And they will not be able [to give] any instruction, nor to their people can they return.
ayahs.clear: They will not be able to make a will, nor will they return to their families.
ayahs.kemenag: lalu mereka tidak kuasa membuat suatu wasiatpun dan tidak (pula) dapat kembali kepada keluarganya.

ayahs.arabic: وَنُفِخَ فِى ٱلصُّورِ فَإِذَا هُم مِّنَ ٱلْأَجْدَاثِ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِمْ يَنسِلُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And the Horn will be blown; and at once from the graves to their Lord they will hasten.
ayahs.clear: The Trumpet will be blown, then behold, they will rush from the tombs to their Lord.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan ditiuplah sangkalala, maka tiba-tiba mereka keluar dengan segera dari kuburnya (menuju) kepada Tuhan mereka.

ayahs.arabic: قَالُوا۟ يَٰوَيْلَنَا مَنۢ بَعَثَنَا مِن مَّرْقَدِنَا ۜ ۗ هَٰذَا مَا وَعَدَ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ وَصَدَقَ ٱلْمُرْسَلُونَ
ayahs.sahih: They will say, "O woe to us! Who has raised us up from our sleeping place?" [The reply will be], "This is what the Most Merciful had promised, and the messengers told the truth."
ayahs.clear: They will say, “Woe to us! Who resurrected us from our resting-place?” This is what the Most Gracious had promised, and the messengers have spoken the truth.”
ayahs.kemenag: Mereka berkata: "Aduhai celakalah kami! Siapakah yang membangkitkan kami dari tempat-tidur kami (kubur)?". Inilah yang dijanjikan (Tuhan) Yang Maha Pemurah dan benarlah Rasul-rasul(Nya).

ayahs.arabic: إِن كَانَتْ إِلَّا صَيْحَةًۭ وَٰحِدَةًۭ فَإِذَا هُمْ جَمِيعٌۭ لَّدَيْنَا مُحْضَرُونَ
ayahs.sahih: It will not be but one blast, and at once they are all brought present before Us.
ayahs.clear: It will be but a single scream; and behold, they will all be brought before Us.
ayahs.kemenag: Tidak adalah teriakan itu selain sekali teriakan saja, maka tiba-tiba mereka semua dikumpulkan kepada Kami.

ayahs.arabic: فَٱلْيَوْمَ لَا تُظْلَمُ نَفْسٌۭ شَيْـًۭٔا وَلَا تُجْزَوْنَ إِلَّا مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
ayahs.sahih: So today no soul will be wronged at all, and you will not be recompensed except for what you used to do.
ayahs.clear: On that Day, no soul will be wronged in the least, and you will be recompensed only for what you used to do.
ayahs.kemenag: Maka pada hari itu seseorang tidak akan dirugikan sedikitpun dan kamu tidak dibalasi, kecuali dengan apa yang telah kamu kerjakan.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ أَصْحَٰبَ ٱلْجَنَّةِ ٱلْيَوْمَ فِى شُغُلٍۢ فَٰكِهُونَ
ayahs.sahih: Indeed the companions of Paradise, that Day, will be amused in [joyful] occupation -
ayahs.clear: The inhabitants of Paradise, on that Day, will be happily busy.
ayahs.kemenag: Sesungguhnya penghuni surga pada hari itu bersenang-senang dalam kesibukan (mereka).

ayahs.arabic: هُمْ وَأَزْوَٰجُهُمْ فِى ظِلَٰلٍ عَلَى ٱلْأَرَآئِكِ مُتَّكِـُٔونَ
ayahs.sahih: They and their spouses - in shade, reclining on adorned couches.
ayahs.clear: They and their spouses, in shades, reclining on couches.
ayahs.kemenag: Mereka dan isteri-isteri mereka berada dalam tempat yang teduh, bertelekan di atas dipan-dipan.

ayahs.arabic: لَهُمْ فِيهَا فَٰكِهَةٌۭ وَلَهُم مَّا يَدَّعُونَ
ayahs.sahih: For them therein is fruit, and for them is whatever they request [or wish]
ayahs.clear: They will have therein fruits. They will have whatever they call for.
ayahs.kemenag: Di surga itu mereka memperoleh buah-buahan dan memperoleh apa yang mereka minta.

ayahs.arabic: سَلَٰمٌۭ قَوْلًۭا مِّن رَّبٍّۢ رَّحِيمٍۢ
ayahs.sahih: [And] "Peace," a word from a Merciful Lord.
ayahs.clear: Peace—a saying from a Most Merciful Lord.
ayahs.kemenag: (Kepada mereka dikatakan): "Salam", sebagai ucapan selamat dari Tuhan Yang Maha Penyayang.

ayahs.arabic: وَٱمْتَٰزُوا۟ ٱلْيَوْمَ أَيُّهَا ٱلْمُجْرِمُونَ
ayahs.sahih: [Then He will say], "But stand apart today, you criminals.
ayahs.clear: But step aside today, you criminals.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan (dikatakan kepada orang-orang kafir): "Berpisahlah kamu (dari orang-orang mukmin) pada hari ini, hai orang-orang yang berbuat jahat.

ayahs.arabic: ۞ أَلَمْ أَعْهَدْ إِلَيْكُمْ يَٰبَنِىٓ ءَادَمَ أَن لَّا تَعْبُدُوا۟ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنَ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ لَكُمْ عَدُوٌّۭ مُّبِينٌۭ
ayahs.sahih: Did I not enjoin upon you, O children of Adam, that you not worship Satan - [for] indeed, he is to you a clear enemy -
ayahs.clear: Did I not covenant with you, O Children of Adam, that you shall not serve the devil? That he is your sworn enemy?
ayahs.kemenag: Bukankah Aku telah memerintahkan kepadamu hai Bani Adam supaya kamu tidak menyembah syaitan? Sesungguhnya syaitan itu adalah musuh yang nyata bagi kamu",

ayahs.arabic: وَأَنِ ٱعْبُدُونِى ۚ هَٰذَا صِرَٰطٌۭ مُّسْتَقِيمٌۭ
ayahs.sahih: And that you worship [only] Me? This is a straight path.
ayahs.clear: And that you shall serve Me? This is a straight path.
ayahs.kemenag: dan hendaklah kamu menyembah-Ku. Inilah jalan yang lurus.

ayahs.arabic: وَلَقَدْ أَضَلَّ مِنكُمْ جِبِلًّۭا كَثِيرًا ۖ أَفَلَمْ تَكُونُوا۟ تَعْقِلُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And he had already led astray from among you much of creation, so did you not use reason?
ayahs.clear: He has misled a great multitude of you. Did you not understand?
ayahs.kemenag: Sesungguhnya syaitan itu telah menyesatkan sebahagian besar diantaramu, Maka apakah kamu tidak memikirkan?.

ayahs.arabic: هَٰذِهِۦ جَهَنَّمُ ٱلَّتِى كُنتُمْ تُوعَدُونَ
ayahs.sahih: This is the Hellfire which you were promised.
ayahs.clear: This is Hellfire, which you were promised.
ayahs.kemenag: Inilah Jahannam yang dahulu kamu diancam (dengannya).

ayahs.arabic: ٱصْلَوْهَا ٱلْيَوْمَ بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَكْفُرُونَ
ayahs.sahih: [Enter to] burn therein today for what you used to deny."
ayahs.clear: Roast in it today, because you persistently disbelieved.
ayahs.kemenag: Masuklah ke dalamnya pada hari ini disebabkan kamu dahulu mengingkarinya.

ayahs.arabic: ٱلْيَوْمَ نَخْتِمُ عَلَىٰٓ أَفْوَٰهِهِمْ وَتُكَلِّمُنَآ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَتَشْهَدُ أَرْجُلُهُم بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَكْسِبُونَ
ayahs.sahih: That Day, We will seal over their mouths, and their hands will speak to Us, and their feet will testify about what they used to earn.
ayahs.clear: On this Day, We will seal their mouths, and their hands will speak to Us, and their feet will testify to everything they had done.
ayahs.kemenag: Pada hari ini Kami tutup mulut mereka; dan berkatalah kepada Kami tangan mereka dan memberi kesaksianlah kaki mereka terhadap apa yang dahulu mereka usahakan.

ayahs.arabic: وَلَوْ نَشَآءُ لَطَمَسْنَا عَلَىٰٓ أَعْيُنِهِمْ فَٱسْتَبَقُوا۟ ٱلصِّرَٰطَ فَأَنَّىٰ يُبْصِرُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And if We willed, We could have obliterated their eyes, and they would race to [find] the path, and how could they see?
ayahs.clear: If We will, We can blind their eyes as they rush towards the path—but how will they see?
ayahs.kemenag: Dan jikalau Kami menghendaki pastilah Kami hapuskan penglihatan mata mereka; lalu mereka berlomba-lomba (mencari) jalan, Maka betapakah mereka dapat melihat(nya).

ayahs.arabic: وَلَوْ نَشَآءُ لَمَسَخْنَٰهُمْ عَلَىٰ مَكَانَتِهِمْ فَمَا ٱسْتَطَٰعُوا۟ مُضِيًّۭا وَلَا يَرْجِعُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And if We willed, We could have deformed them, [paralyzing them] in their places so they would not be able to proceed, nor could they return.
ayahs.clear: And if We will, We can cripple them in their place; so they can neither move forward, nor go back.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan jikalau Kami menghendaki pastilah Kami ubah mereka di tempat mereka berada; maka mereka tidak sanggup berjalan lagi dan tidak (pula) sanggup kembali.

ayahs.arabic: وَمَن نُّعَمِّرْهُ نُنَكِّسْهُ فِى ٱلْخَلْقِ ۖ أَفَلَا يَعْقِلُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And he to whom We grant long life We reverse in creation; so will they not understand?
ayahs.clear: Whomever We grant old age, We reverse his development. Do they not understand?
ayahs.kemenag: Dan barangsiapa yang Kami panjangkan umurnya niscaya Kami kembalikan dia kepada kejadian(nya). Maka apakah mereka tidak memikirkan?

ayahs.arabic: وَمَا عَلَّمْنَٰهُ ٱلشِّعْرَ وَمَا يَنۢبَغِى لَهُۥٓ ۚ إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا ذِكْرٌۭ وَقُرْءَانٌۭ مُّبِينٌۭ
ayahs.sahih: And We did not give Prophet Muhammad, knowledge of poetry, nor is it befitting for him. It is not but a message and a clear Qur'an
ayahs.clear: We did not teach him poetry, nor is it proper for him. It is only a reminder, and a Clear Quran.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan Kami tidak mengajarkan syair kepadanya (Muhammad) dan bersyair itu tidaklah layak baginya. Al Quran itu tidak lain hanyalah pelajaran dan kitab yang memberi penerangan.

ayahs.arabic: لِّيُنذِرَ مَن كَانَ حَيًّۭا وَيَحِقَّ ٱلْقَوْلُ عَلَى ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ
ayahs.sahih: To warn whoever is alive and justify the word against the disbelievers.
ayahs.clear: That he may warn whoever is alive, and prove the Word against the faithless.
ayahs.kemenag: supaya dia (Muhammad) memberi peringatan kepada orang-orang yang hidup (hatinya) dan supaya pastilah (ketetapan azab) terhadap orang-orang kafir.

ayahs.arabic: أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ أَنَّا خَلَقْنَا لَهُم مِّمَّا عَمِلَتْ أَيْدِينَآ أَنْعَٰمًۭا فَهُمْ لَهَا مَٰلِكُونَ
ayahs.sahih: Do they not see that We have created for them from what Our hands have made, grazing livestock, and [then] they are their owners?
ayahs.clear: Have they not seen that We created for them, of Our Handiwork, livestock that they own?
ayahs.kemenag: Dan apakah mereka tidak melihat bahwa sesungguhnya Kami telah menciptakan binatang ternak untuk mereka yaitu sebahagian dari apa yang telah Kami ciptakan dengan kekuasaan Kami sendiri, lalu mereka menguasainya?

ayahs.arabic: وَذَلَّلْنَٰهَا لَهُمْ فَمِنْهَا رَكُوبُهُمْ وَمِنْهَا يَأْكُلُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And We have tamed them for them, so some of them they ride, and some of them they eat.
ayahs.clear: And We subdued them for them. Some they ride, and some they eat.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan Kami tundukkan binatang-binatang itu untuk mereka; maka sebahagiannya menjadi tunggangan mereka dan sebahagiannya mereka makan.

ayahs.arabic: وَلَهُمْ فِيهَا مَنَٰفِعُ وَمَشَارِبُ ۖ أَفَلَا يَشْكُرُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And for them therein are [other] benefits and drinks, so will they not be grateful?
ayahs.clear: And they have in them other benefits, and drinks. Will they not give thanks?
ayahs.kemenag: Dan mereka memperoleh padanya manfaat-manfaat dan minuman. Maka mengapakah mereka tidak bersyukur?

ayahs.arabic: وَٱتَّخَذُوا۟ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ ءَالِهَةًۭ لَّعَلَّهُمْ يُنصَرُونَ
ayahs.sahih: But they have taken besides Allah [false] deities that perhaps they would be helped.
ayahs.clear: Yet they have taken to themselves gods other than God, that perhaps they may be helped.
ayahs.kemenag: Mereka mengambil sembahan-sembahan selain Allah, agar mereka mendapat pertolongan.

ayahs.arabic: لَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ نَصْرَهُمْ وَهُمْ لَهُمْ جُندٌۭ مُّحْضَرُونَ
ayahs.sahih: They are not able to help them, and they [themselves] are for them soldiers in attendance.
ayahs.clear: They cannot help them, although they are arrayed as troops for them.
ayahs.kemenag: Berhala-berhala itu tiada dapat menolong mereka; padahal berhala-berhala itu menjadi tentara yang disiapkan untuk menjaga mereka.

ayahs.arabic: فَلَا يَحْزُنكَ قَوْلُهُمْ ۘ إِنَّا نَعْلَمُ مَا يُسِرُّونَ وَمَا يُعْلِنُونَ
ayahs.sahih: So let not their speech grieve you. Indeed, We know what they conceal and what they declare.
ayahs.clear: So let their words not sadden you. We know what they conceal, and what they reveal.
ayahs.kemenag: Maka janganlah ucapan mereka menyedihkan kamu. Sesungguhnya Kami mengetahui apa yang mereka rahasiakan dan apa yang mereka nyatakan.

ayahs.arabic: أَوَلَمْ يَرَ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ أَنَّا خَلَقْنَٰهُ مِن نُّطْفَةٍۢ فَإِذَا هُوَ خَصِيمٌۭ مُّبِينٌۭ
ayahs.sahih: Does man not consider that We created him from a [mere] sperm-drop - then at once he is a clear adversary?
ayahs.clear: Does the human being not consider that We created him from a seed? Yet he becomes a fierce adversary.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan apakah manusia tidak memperhatikan bahwa Kami menciptakannya dari setitik air (mani), maka tiba-tiba ia menjadi penantang yang nyata!

ayahs.arabic: وَضَرَبَ لَنَا مَثَلًۭا وَنَسِىَ خَلْقَهُۥ ۖ قَالَ مَن يُحْىِ ٱلْعِظَٰمَ وَهِىَ رَمِيمٌۭ
ayahs.sahih: And he presents for Us an example and forgets his [own] creation. He says, "Who will give life to bones while they are disintegrated?"
ayahs.clear: And he produces arguments against Us, and he forgets his own creation. He says, “Who will revive the bones when they have decayed?”
ayahs.kemenag: Dan ia membuat perumpamaan bagi Kami; dan dia lupa kepada kejadiannya; ia berkata: "Siapakah yang dapat menghidupkan tulang belulang, yang telah hancur luluh?"

ayahs.arabic: قُلْ يُحْيِيهَا ٱلَّذِىٓ أَنشَأَهَآ أَوَّلَ مَرَّةٍۢ ۖ وَهُوَ بِكُلِّ خَلْقٍ عَلِيمٌ
ayahs.sahih: Say, "He will give them life who produced them the first time; and He is, of all creation, Knowing."
ayahs.clear: Say, “He who initiated them in the first instance will revive them. He has knowledge of every creation.”
ayahs.kemenag: Katakanlah: "Ia akan dihidupkan oleh Tuhan yang menciptakannya kali yang pertama. Dan Dia Maha Mengetahui tentang segala makhluk.

ayahs.arabic: ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَ لَكُم مِّنَ ٱلشَّجَرِ ٱلْأَخْضَرِ نَارًۭا فَإِذَآ أَنتُم مِّنْهُ تُوقِدُونَ
ayahs.sahih: [It is] He who made for you from the green tree, fire, and then from it you ignite.
ayahs.clear: He who produced fuel for you from the green trees, with which you kindle a fire.
ayahs.kemenag: yaitu Tuhan yang menjadikan untukmu api dari kayu yang hijau, maka tiba-tiba kamu nyalakan (api) dari kayu itu".

ayahs.arabic: أَوَلَيْسَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ بِقَٰدِرٍ عَلَىٰٓ أَن يَخْلُقَ مِثْلَهُم ۚ بَلَىٰ وَهُوَ ٱلْخَلَّٰقُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
ayahs.sahih: Is not He who created the heavens and the earth Able to create the likes of them? Yes, [it is so]; and He is the Knowing Creator.
ayahs.clear: Is not He who created the heavens and the earth able to create the like of them? Certainly. He is the Supreme All-Knowing Creator.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan tidaklah Tuhan yang menciptakan langit dan bumi itu berkuasa menciptakan yang serupa dengan itu? Benar, Dia berkuasa. Dan Dialah Maha Pencipta lagi Maha Mengetahui.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّمَآ أَمْرُهُۥٓ إِذَآ أَرَادَ شَيْـًٔا أَن يَقُولَ لَهُۥ كُن فَيَكُونُ
ayahs.sahih: His command is only when He intends a thing that He says to it, "Be," and it is.
ayahs.clear: His command, when He wills a thing, is to say to it, “Be,” and it comes to be.
ayahs.kemenag: Sesungguhnya keadaan-Nya apabila Dia menghendaki sesuatu hanyalah berkata kepadanya: "Jadilah!" maka terjadilah ia.

ayahs.arabic: فَسُبْحَٰنَ ٱلَّذِى بِيَدِهِۦ مَلَكُوتُ كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ وَإِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ
ayahs.sahih: So exalted is He in whose hand is the realm of all things, and to Him you will be returned.
ayahs.clear: So glory be to Him in whose hand is the dominion of everything, and to Him you will be returned.
ayahs.kemenag: Maka Maha Suci (Allah) yang di tangan-Nya kekuasaaan atas segala sesuatu dan kepada-Nya-lah kamu dikembalikan.

ayahs.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ وَٱلصَّٰٓفَّٰتِ صَفًّۭا
ayahs.sahih: By those [angels] lined up in rows
ayahs.clear: By the aligners aligning.
ayahs.kemenag: Demi (rombongan) yang ber shaf-shaf dengan sebenar-benarnya],

ayahs.arabic: فَٱلزَّٰجِرَٰتِ زَجْرًۭا
ayahs.sahih: And those who drive [the clouds]
ayahs.clear: And the drivers driving.
ayahs.kemenag: dan demi (rombongan) yang melarang dengan sebenar-benarnya (dari perbuatan-perbuatan maksiat),

ayahs.arabic: فَٱلتَّٰلِيَٰتِ ذِكْرًا
ayahs.sahih: And those who recite the message,
ayahs.clear: And the reciters of the Reminder.
ayahs.kemenag: dan demi (rombongan) yang membacakan pelajaran,

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ إِلَٰهَكُمْ لَوَٰحِدٌۭ
ayahs.sahih: Indeed, your God is One,
ayahs.clear: Your God is indeed One.
ayahs.kemenag: Sesungguhnya Tuhanmu benar-benar Esa.

ayahs.arabic: رَّبُّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا وَرَبُّ ٱلْمَشَٰرِقِ
ayahs.sahih: Lord of the heavens and the earth and that between them and Lord of the sunrises.
ayahs.clear: Lord of the heavens and the earth, and everything between them; and Lord of the Easts.
ayahs.kemenag: Tuhan langit dan bumi dan apa yang berada di antara keduanya dan Tuhan tempat-tempat terbit matahari.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّا زَيَّنَّا ٱلسَّمَآءَ ٱلدُّنْيَا بِزِينَةٍ ٱلْكَوَاكِبِ
ayahs.sahih: Indeed, We have adorned the nearest heaven with an adornment of stars
ayahs.clear: We have adorned the lower heaven with the beauty of the planets.
ayahs.kemenag: Sesungguhnya Kami telah menghias langit yang terdekat dengan hiasan, yaitu bintang-bintang,

ayahs.arabic: وَحِفْظًۭا مِّن كُلِّ شَيْطَٰنٍۢ مَّارِدٍۢ
ayahs.sahih: And as protection against every rebellious devil
ayahs.clear: And guarded it against every defiant devil.
ayahs.kemenag: dan telah memeliharanya (sebenar-benarnya) dari setiap syaitan yang sangat durhaka,

ayahs.arabic: لَّا يَسَّمَّعُونَ إِلَى ٱلْمَلَإِ ٱلْأَعْلَىٰ وَيُقْذَفُونَ مِن كُلِّ جَانِبٍۢ
ayahs.sahih: [So] they may not listen to the exalted assembly [of angels] and are pelted from every side,
ayahs.clear: They cannot eavesdrop on the Supernal Elite, for they get bombarded from every side.
ayahs.kemenag: syaitan syaitan itu tidak dapat mendengar-dengarkan (pembicaraan) para malaikat dan mereka dilempari dari segala penjuru.

ayahs.arabic: دُحُورًۭا ۖ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌۭ وَاصِبٌ
ayahs.sahih: Repelled; and for them is a constant punishment,
ayahs.clear: Repelled—they will have a lingering torment.
ayahs.kemenag: Untuk mengusir mereka dan bagi mereka siksaan yang kekal,

ayahs.arabic: إِلَّا مَنْ خَطِفَ ٱلْخَطْفَةَ فَأَتْبَعَهُۥ شِهَابٌۭ ثَاقِبٌۭ
ayahs.sahih: Except one who snatches [some words] by theft, but they are pursued by a burning flame, piercing [in brightness].
ayahs.clear: Except for him who snatches a fragment—he gets pursued by a piercing projectile.
ayahs.kemenag: akan tetapi barangsiapa (di antara mereka) yang mencuri-curi (pembicaraan); maka ia dikejar oleh suluh api yang cemerlang.

ayahs.arabic: فَٱسْتَفْتِهِمْ أَهُمْ أَشَدُّ خَلْقًا أَم مَّنْ خَلَقْنَآ ۚ إِنَّا خَلَقْنَٰهُم مِّن طِينٍۢ لَّازِبٍۭ
ayahs.sahih: Then inquire of them, [O Muhammad], "Are they a stronger [or more difficult] creation or those [others] We have created?" Indeed, We created men from sticky clay.
ayahs.clear: Inquire of them, “Are they more difficult to create, or the others We created?” We created them from sticky clay.
ayahs.kemenag: Maka tanyakanlah kepada mereka (musyrik Mekah): "Apakah mereka yang lebih kukuh kejadiannya ataukah apa yang telah Kami ciptakan itu?" Sesungguhnya Kami telah menciptakan mereka dari tanah liat.

ayahs.arabic: بَلْ عَجِبْتَ وَيَسْخَرُونَ
ayahs.sahih: But you wonder, while they mock,
ayahs.clear: But you wonder, and they ridicule.
ayahs.kemenag: Bahkan kamu menjadi heran (terhadap keingkaran mereka) dan mereka menghinakan kamu.

ayahs.arabic: وَإِذَا ذُكِّرُوا۟ لَا يَذْكُرُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And when they are reminded, they remember not.
ayahs.clear: And when reminded, they pay no attention.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan apabila mereka diberi pelajaran mereka tiada mengingatnya.

ayahs.arabic: وَإِذَا رَأَوْا۟ ءَايَةًۭ يَسْتَسْخِرُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And when they see a sign, they ridicule
ayahs.clear: And when they see a sign, they ridicule.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan apabila mereka melihat sesuatu tanda kebesaran Allah, mereka sangat menghinakan.

ayahs.arabic: وَقَالُوٓا۟ إِنْ هَٰذَآ إِلَّا سِحْرٌۭ مُّبِينٌ
ayahs.sahih: And say, "This is not but obvious magic.
ayahs.clear: And they say, “This is nothing but plain magic.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan mereka berkata "Ini tiada lain hanyalah sihir yang nyata.

ayahs.arabic: أَءِذَا مِتْنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابًۭا وَعِظَٰمًا أَءِنَّا لَمَبْعُوثُونَ
ayahs.sahih: When we have died and become dust and bones, are we indeed to be resurrected?
ayahs.clear: When we have died and become dust and bones, shall we be resurrected?
ayahs.kemenag: Apakah apabila kami telah mati dan telah menjadi tanah serta menjadi tulang belulang, apakah benar-benar kami akan dibangkitkan (kembali)?

ayahs.arabic: أَوَءَابَآؤُنَا ٱلْأَوَّلُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And our forefathers [as well]?"
ayahs.clear: And our ancestors of old?”
ayahs.kemenag: Dan apakah bapak-bapak kami yang telah terdahulu (akan dibangkitkan pula)"?

ayahs.arabic: قُلْ نَعَمْ وَأَنتُمْ دَٰخِرُونَ
ayahs.sahih: Say, "Yes, and you will be [rendered] contemptible."
ayahs.clear: Say, “Yes indeed, and you will be totally subdued.”
ayahs.kemenag: Katakanlah: "Ya, dan kamu akan terhina"

ayahs.arabic: فَإِنَّمَا هِىَ زَجْرَةٌۭ وَٰحِدَةٌۭ فَإِذَا هُمْ يَنظُرُونَ
ayahs.sahih: It will be only one shout, and at once they will be observing.
ayahs.clear: It will be a single nudge, and they will be staring.
ayahs.kemenag: Maka sesungguhnya kebangkitan itu hanya dengan satu teriakan saja; maka tiba-tiba mereka meIihatnya.

ayahs.arabic: وَقَالُوا۟ يَٰوَيْلَنَا هَٰذَا يَوْمُ ٱلدِّينِ
ayahs.sahih: They will say, "O woe to us! This is the Day of Recompense."
ayahs.clear: They will say, “Woe to us. This is the Day of Judgment.”
ayahs.kemenag: Dan mereka berkata: "Aduhai celakalah kita!" Inilah hari pembalasan.

ayahs.arabic: هَٰذَا يَوْمُ ٱلْفَصْلِ ٱلَّذِى كُنتُم بِهِۦ تُكَذِّبُونَ
ayahs.sahih: [They will be told], "This is the Day of Judgement which you used to deny."
ayahs.clear: “This is the Day of Separation which you used to deny.
ayahs.kemenag: Inilah hari keputusan yang kamu selalu mendustakannya.

ayahs.arabic: ۞ ٱحْشُرُوا۟ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ وَأَزْوَٰجَهُمْ وَمَا كَانُوا۟ يَعْبُدُونَ
ayahs.sahih: [The angels will be ordered], "Gather those who committed wrong, their kinds, and what they used to worship
ayahs.clear: Gather those who did wrong, and their mates, and what they used to worship.
ayahs.kemenag: (kepada malaikat diperintahkan): "Kumpulkanlah orang-orang yang zalim beserta teman sejawat mereka dan sembahan-sembahan yang selalu mereka sembah,

ayahs.arabic: مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ فَٱهْدُوهُمْ إِلَىٰ صِرَٰطِ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
ayahs.sahih: Other than Allah, and guide them to the path of Hellfire
ayahs.clear: Besides God, and lead them to the way to Hell.
ayahs.kemenag: selain Allah; maka tunjukkanlah kepada mereka jalan ke neraka.

ayahs.arabic: وَقِفُوهُمْ ۖ إِنَّهُم مَّسْـُٔولُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And stop them; indeed, they are to be questioned."
ayahs.clear: And stop them. They are to be questioned.”
ayahs.kemenag: Dan tahanlah mereka (di tempat perhentian) karena sesungguhnya mereka akan ditanya:

ayahs.arabic: مَا لَكُمْ لَا تَنَاصَرُونَ
ayahs.sahih: [They will be asked], "What is [wrong] with you? Why do you not help each other?"
ayahs.clear: What is the matter with you? Why do you not help one another?
ayahs.kemenag: "Kenapa kamu tidak tolong menolong?"

ayahs.arabic: بَلْ هُمُ ٱلْيَوْمَ مُسْتَسْلِمُونَ
ayahs.sahih: But they, that Day, are in surrender.
ayahs.clear: In fact, on that Day, they will be submissive.
ayahs.kemenag: Bahkan mereka pada hari itu menyerah diri.

ayahs.arabic: وَأَقْبَلَ بَعْضُهُمْ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍۢ يَتَسَآءَلُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And they will approach one another blaming each other.
ayahs.clear: They will come to one another, questioning one another.
ayahs.kemenag: Sebahagian dan mereka menghadap kepada sebahagian yang lain berbantah-bantahan.

ayahs.arabic: قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّكُمْ كُنتُمْ تَأْتُونَنَا عَنِ ٱلْيَمِينِ
ayahs.sahih: They will say, "Indeed, you used to come at us from the right."
ayahs.clear: They will say, “You used to come at us from the right.”
ayahs.kemenag: Pengikut-pengikut mereka berkata (kepada pemimpin-pemimpin mereka): "Sesungguhnya kamulah yang datang kepada kami dan kanan.

ayahs.arabic: قَالُوا۟ بَل لَّمْ تَكُونُوا۟ مُؤْمِنِينَ
ayahs.sahih: The oppressors will say, "Rather, you [yourselves] were not believers,
ayahs.clear: They will say, “You yourselves were not believers.
ayahs.kemenag: Pemimpin-pemimpin mereka menjawab: "Sebenarnya kamulah yang tidak beriman".

ayahs.arabic: وَمَا كَانَ لَنَا عَلَيْكُم مِّن سُلْطَٰنٍۭ ۖ بَلْ كُنتُمْ قَوْمًۭا طَٰغِينَ
ayahs.sahih: And we had over you no authority, but you were a transgressing people.
ayahs.clear: We had no authority over you. You yourselves were rebellious people.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan sekali-kali kami tidak berkuasa terhadapmu, bahkan kamulah kaum yang melampaui batas.

ayahs.arabic: فَحَقَّ عَلَيْنَا قَوْلُ رَبِّنَآ ۖ إِنَّا لَذَآئِقُونَ
ayahs.sahih: So the word of our Lord has come into effect upon us; indeed, we will taste [punishment].
ayahs.clear: The Word of our Lord has been realized against us. We are tasting it.
ayahs.kemenag: Maka pastilah putusan (azab) Tuhan kita menimpa atas kita; sesungguhnya kita akan merasakan (azab itu).

ayahs.arabic: فَأَغْوَيْنَٰكُمْ إِنَّا كُنَّا غَٰوِينَ
ayahs.sahih: And we led you to deviation; indeed, we were deviators."
ayahs.clear: We seduced you. We were seducers.”
ayahs.kemenag: Maka kami telah menyesatkan kamu, sesungguhnya kami adalah orang-orang yang sesat.

ayahs.arabic: فَإِنَّهُمْ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ فِى ٱلْعَذَابِ مُشْتَرِكُونَ
ayahs.sahih: So indeed they, that Day, will be sharing in the punishment.
ayahs.clear: On that Day, they will share in the punishment.
ayahs.kemenag: Maka sesungguhnya mereka pada hari itu bersama-sama dalam azab.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَفْعَلُ بِٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ
ayahs.sahih: Indeed, that is how We deal with the criminals.
ayahs.clear: Thus We deal with the sinners.
ayahs.kemenag: Sesungguhnya demikianlah Kami berbuat terhadap orang-orang yang berbuat jahat.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوٓا۟ إِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمْ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا ٱللَّهُ يَسْتَكْبِرُونَ
ayahs.sahih: Indeed they, when it was said to them, "There is no deity but Allah," were arrogant
ayahs.clear: When it was said to them, “There is no god except God,” they grew arrogant.
ayahs.kemenag: Sesungguhnya mereka dahulu apabila dikatakan kepada mereka: "Laa ilaaha illallah" (Tiada Tuhan yang berhak disembah melainkan Allah) mereka menyombongkan diri,

ayahs.arabic: وَيَقُولُونَ أَئِنَّا لَتَارِكُوٓا۟ ءَالِهَتِنَا لِشَاعِرٍۢ مَّجْنُونٍۭ
ayahs.sahih: And were saying, "Are we to leave our gods for a mad poet?"
ayahs.clear: And said, “Are we to abandon our gods for a mad poet?”
ayahs.kemenag: dan mereka berkata: "Apakah sesungguhnya kami harus meninggalkan sembahan-sembahan kami karena seorang penyair gila?"

ayahs.arabic: بَلْ جَآءَ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَصَدَّقَ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
ayahs.sahih: Rather, the Prophet has come with the truth and confirmed the [previous] messengers.
ayahs.clear: In fact, he came with the truth, and he confirmed the messengers.
ayahs.kemenag: Sebenarnya dia (Muhammad) telah datang membawa kebenaran dan membenarkan rasul-rasul (sebelumnya).

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّكُمْ لَذَآئِقُوا۟ ٱلْعَذَابِ ٱلْأَلِيمِ
ayahs.sahih: Indeed, you [disbelievers] will be tasters of the painful punishment,
ayahs.clear: Most assuredly, you will taste the painful punishment.
ayahs.kemenag: Sesungguhnya kamu pasti akan merasakan azab yang pedih.

ayahs.arabic: وَمَا تُجْزَوْنَ إِلَّا مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And you will not be recompensed except for what you used to do -
ayahs.clear: And you will be repaid only for what you used to do.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan kamu tidak diberi pembalasan melainkan terhadap kejahatan yang telah kamu kerjakan,

ayahs.arabic: إِلَّا عِبَادَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْمُخْلَصِينَ
ayahs.sahih: But not the chosen servants of Allah.
ayahs.clear: Except for God’s sincere servants.
ayahs.kemenag: tetapi hamba-hamba Allah yang dibersihkan (dari dosa).

ayahs.arabic: أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ لَهُمْ رِزْقٌۭ مَّعْلُومٌۭ
ayahs.sahih: Those will have a provision determined -
ayahs.clear: For them is a known provision.
ayahs.kemenag: Mereka itu memperoleh rezeki yang tertentu,

ayahs.arabic: فَوَٰكِهُ ۖ وَهُم مُّكْرَمُونَ
ayahs.sahih: Fruits; and they will be honored
ayahs.clear: Fruits; and they will be honored.
ayahs.kemenag: yaitu buah-buahan. Dan mereka adalah orang-orang yang dimuliakan,

ayahs.arabic: فِى جَنَّٰتِ ٱلنَّعِيمِ
ayahs.sahih: In gardens of pleasure
ayahs.clear: In the Gardens of Bliss.
ayahs.kemenag: di dalam surga-surga yang penuh nikmat.

ayahs.arabic: عَلَىٰ سُرُرٍۢ مُّتَقَٰبِلِينَ
ayahs.sahih: On thrones facing one another.
ayahs.clear: On furnishings, facing one another.
ayahs.kemenag: di atas takhta-takhta kebesaran berhadap-hadapan.

ayahs.arabic: يُطَافُ عَلَيْهِم بِكَأْسٍۢ مِّن مَّعِينٍۭ
ayahs.sahih: There will be circulated among them a cup [of wine] from a flowing spring,
ayahs.clear: They will be offered a cup of pure drink.
ayahs.kemenag: Diedarkan kepada mereka gelas yang berisi khamar dari sungai yang mengalir.

ayahs.arabic: بَيْضَآءَ لَذَّةٍۢ لِّلشَّٰرِبِينَ
ayahs.sahih: White and delicious to the drinkers;
ayahs.clear: White; a delight to those who drink.
ayahs.kemenag: (Warnanya) putih bersih, sedap rasanya bagi orang-orang yang minum.

ayahs.arabic: لَا فِيهَا غَوْلٌۭ وَلَا هُمْ عَنْهَا يُنزَفُونَ
ayahs.sahih: No bad effect is there in it, nor from it will they be intoxicated.
ayahs.clear: Never polluted, and never intoxicating.
ayahs.kemenag: Tidak ada dalam khamar itu alkohol dan mereka tiada mabuk karenanya.

ayahs.arabic: وَعِندَهُمْ قَٰصِرَٰتُ ٱلطَّرْفِ عِينٌۭ
ayahs.sahih: And with them will be women limiting [their] glances, with large, [beautiful] eyes,
ayahs.clear: With them will be bashful women with lovely eyes.
ayahs.kemenag: Di sisi mereka ada bidadari-bidadari yang tidak liar pandangannya dan jelita matanya,

ayahs.arabic: كَأَنَّهُنَّ بَيْضٌۭ مَّكْنُونٌۭ
ayahs.sahih: As if they were [delicate] eggs, well-protected.
ayahs.clear: As if they were closely guarded pearls.
ayahs.kemenag: seakan-akan mereka adalah telur (burung unta) yang tersimpan dengan baik.

ayahs.arabic: فَأَقْبَلَ بَعْضُهُمْ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍۢ يَتَسَآءَلُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And they will approach one another, inquiring of each other.
ayahs.clear: Then they will approach one another, questioning.
ayahs.kemenag: Lalu sebahagian mereka menghadap kepada sebahagian yang lain sambil bercakap-cakap.

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ قَآئِلٌۭ مِّنْهُمْ إِنِّى كَانَ لِى قَرِينٌۭ
ayahs.sahih: A speaker among them will say, "Indeed, I had a companion [on earth]
ayahs.clear: One of them will say, “I used to have a friend.
ayahs.kemenag: Berkatalah salah seorang di antara mereka: "Sesungguhnya aku dahulu (di dunia) mempunyai seorang teman,

ayahs.arabic: يَقُولُ أَءِنَّكَ لَمِنَ ٱلْمُصَدِّقِينَ
ayahs.sahih: Who would say, 'Are you indeed of those who believe
ayahs.clear: Who used to say, “Are you of those who believe?
ayahs.kemenag: yang berkata: "Apakah kamu sungguh-sungguh termasuk orang-orang yang membenarkan (hari berbangkit)?

ayahs.arabic: أَءِذَا مِتْنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابًۭا وَعِظَٰمًا أَءِنَّا لَمَدِينُونَ
ayahs.sahih: That when we have died and become dust and bones, we will indeed be recompensed?'"
ayahs.clear: That after we die and become dust and bones, we will be called to account?”
ayahs.kemenag: Apakah bila kita telah mati dan kita telah menjadi tanah dan tulang belulang, apakah sesungguhnya kita benar-benar (akan dibangkitkan) untuk diberi pembalasan?"

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ هَلْ أَنتُم مُّطَّلِعُونَ
ayahs.sahih: He will say, "Would you [care to] look?"
ayahs.clear: He will say, “Will you have a look?”
ayahs.kemenag: Berkata pulalah ia: "Maukah kamu meninjau (temanku itu)?"

ayahs.arabic: فَٱطَّلَعَ فَرَءَاهُ فِى سَوَآءِ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
ayahs.sahih: And he will look and see him in the midst of the Hellfire.
ayahs.clear: He will look, and will see him in the pit of Hell.
ayahs.kemenag: Maka ia meninjaunya, lalu dia melihat temannya itu di tengah-tengah neraka menyala-nyala.

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ تَٱللَّهِ إِن كِدتَّ لَتُرْدِينِ
ayahs.sahih: He will say, "By Allah, you almost ruined me.
ayahs.clear: He will say, “By God, you almost ruined me.
ayahs.kemenag: Ia berkata (pula): "Demi Allah, sesungguhnya kamu benar-benar hampir mencelakakanku,

ayahs.arabic: وَلَوْلَا نِعْمَةُ رَبِّى لَكُنتُ مِنَ ٱلْمُحْضَرِينَ
ayahs.sahih: If not for the favor of my Lord, I would have been of those brought in [to Hell].
ayahs.clear: Were it not for the grace of my Lord, I would have been among the arraigned.”
ayahs.kemenag: jikalau tidaklah karena nikmat Tuhanku pastilah aku termasuk orang-orang yang diseret (ke neraka).

ayahs.arabic: أَفَمَا نَحْنُ بِمَيِّتِينَ
ayahs.sahih: Then, are we not to die
ayahs.clear: “We will not die.
ayahs.kemenag: Maka apakah kita tidak akan mati?,

ayahs.arabic: إِلَّا مَوْتَتَنَا ٱلْأُولَىٰ وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمُعَذَّبِينَ
ayahs.sahih: Except for our first death, and we will not be punished?"
ayahs.clear: Except for our first death, and we will not be punished.”
ayahs.kemenag: melainkan hanya kematian kita yang pertama saja (di dunia), dan kita tidak akan disiksa (di akhirat ini)?

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَهُوَ ٱلْفَوْزُ ٱلْعَظِيمُ
ayahs.sahih: Indeed, this is the great attainment.
ayahs.clear: This is the supreme triumph.
ayahs.kemenag: Sesungguhnya ini benar-benar kemenangan yang besar.

ayahs.arabic: لِمِثْلِ هَٰذَا فَلْيَعْمَلِ ٱلْعَٰمِلُونَ
ayahs.sahih: For the like of this let the workers [on earth] work.
ayahs.clear: For the like of this let the workers work.
ayahs.kemenag: Untuk kemenangan serupa ini hendaklah berusaha orang-orang yang bekerja"

ayahs.arabic: أَذَٰلِكَ خَيْرٌۭ نُّزُلًا أَمْ شَجَرَةُ ٱلزَّقُّومِ
ayahs.sahih: Is Paradise a better accommodation or the tree of zaqqum?
ayahs.clear: Is this a better hospitality, or the Tree of Bitterness?
ayahs.kemenag: (Makanan surga) itukah hidangan yang lebih baik ataukah pohon zaqqum.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّا جَعَلْنَٰهَا فِتْنَةًۭ لِّلظَّٰلِمِينَ
ayahs.sahih: Indeed, We have made it a torment for the wrongdoers.
ayahs.clear: We made it an ordeal for the unjust.
ayahs.kemenag: Sesungguhnya Kami menjadikan pohon zaqqum itu sebagai siksaan bagi orang-orang yang zalim.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّهَا شَجَرَةٌۭ تَخْرُجُ فِىٓ أَصْلِ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
ayahs.sahih: Indeed, it is a tree issuing from the bottom of the Hellfire,
ayahs.clear: It is a tree that grows from the bottom of Hell.
ayahs.kemenag: Sesungguhnya dia adalah sebatang pohon yang ke luar dan dasar neraka yang menyala.

ayahs.arabic: طَلْعُهَا كَأَنَّهُۥ رُءُوسُ ٱلشَّيَٰطِينِ
ayahs.sahih: Its emerging fruit as if it was heads of the devils.
ayahs.clear: Its fruits are like the devils’ heads.
ayahs.kemenag: mayangnya seperti kepala syaitan-syaitan.

ayahs.arabic: فَإِنَّهُمْ لَءَاكِلُونَ مِنْهَا فَمَالِـُٔونَ مِنْهَا ٱلْبُطُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And indeed, they will eat from it and fill with it their bellies.
ayahs.clear: They will eat from it, and fill their bellies with it.
ayahs.kemenag: Maka sesungguhnya mereka benar-benar memakan sebagian dari buah pohon itu, maka mereka memenuhi perutnya dengan buah zaqqum itu.

ayahs.arabic: ثُمَّ إِنَّ لَهُمْ عَلَيْهَا لَشَوْبًۭا مِّنْ حَمِيمٍۢ
ayahs.sahih: Then indeed, they will have after it a mixture of scalding water.
ayahs.clear: Then, on top of it, they will have a brew of boiling liquid.
ayahs.kemenag: Kemudian sesudah makan buah pohon zaqqum itu pasti mereka mendapat minuman yang bercampur dengan air yang sangat panas.

ayahs.arabic: ثُمَّ إِنَّ مَرْجِعَهُمْ لَإِلَى ٱلْجَحِيمِ
ayahs.sahih: Then indeed, their return will be to the Hellfire.
ayahs.clear: Then their return will be to the Blaze.
ayahs.kemenag: Kemudian sesungguhnya tempat kembali mereka benar-benar ke neraka Jahim.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّهُمْ أَلْفَوْا۟ ءَابَآءَهُمْ ضَآلِّينَ
ayahs.sahih: Indeed they found their fathers astray.
ayahs.clear: They had found their parents astray.
ayahs.kemenag: Karena sesungguhnya mereka mendapati bapak-bapak mereka dalam Keadaaan sesat.

ayahs.arabic: فَهُمْ عَلَىٰٓ ءَاثَٰرِهِمْ يُهْرَعُونَ
ayahs.sahih: So they hastened [to follow] in their footsteps.
ayahs.clear: And rushed along in their footsteps.
ayahs.kemenag: Lalu mereka sangat tergesa-gesa mengikuti jejak orang-orang tua mereka itu.

ayahs.arabic: وَلَقَدْ ضَلَّ قَبْلَهُمْ أَكْثَرُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
ayahs.sahih: And there had already strayed before them most of the former peoples,
ayahs.clear: And most of the ancients before them went astray.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan sesungguhnya telah sesat sebelum mereka (Quraisy) sebagian besar dari orang-orang yang dahulu,

ayahs.arabic: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا فِيهِم مُّنذِرِينَ
ayahs.sahih: And We had already sent among them warners.
ayahs.clear: Even though We sent messengers to warn them.
ayahs.kemenag: dan sesungguhnya telah Kami utus pemberi-pemberi peringatan (rasul-rasul) di kalangan mereka.

ayahs.arabic: فَٱنظُرْ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَٰقِبَةُ ٱلْمُنذَرِينَ
ayahs.sahih: Then look how was the end of those who were warned -
ayahs.clear: So observe the end of those who were warned.
ayahs.kemenag: Maka perhatikanlah bagaimana kesudahan orang-orang yang diberi peringatan itu.

ayahs.arabic: إِلَّا عِبَادَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْمُخْلَصِينَ
ayahs.sahih: But not the chosen servants of Allah.
ayahs.clear: Except for the sincere servants of God.
ayahs.kemenag: Tetapi hamba-hamba Allah yang bersihkan (dari dosa tidak akan diazab).

ayahs.arabic: وَلَقَدْ نَادَىٰنَا نُوحٌۭ فَلَنِعْمَ ٱلْمُجِيبُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And Noah had certainly called Us, and [We are] the best of responders.
ayahs.clear: And Noah called out to Us, and We are the Best of responders.
ayahs.kemenag: Sesungguhnya Nuh telah menyeru Kami: maka sesungguhnya sebaik-baik yang memperkenankan (adalah Kami).

ayahs.arabic: وَنَجَّيْنَٰهُ وَأَهْلَهُۥ مِنَ ٱلْكَرْبِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
ayahs.sahih: And We saved him and his family from the great affliction.
ayahs.clear: And We saved him and his family from the great calamity.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan Kami telah menyelamatkannya dan pengikutnya dari bencana yang besar.

ayahs.arabic: وَجَعَلْنَا ذُرِّيَّتَهُۥ هُمُ ٱلْبَاقِينَ
ayahs.sahih: And We made his descendants those remaining [on the earth]
ayahs.clear: And We made his descendants the survivors.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan Kami jadikan anak cucunya orang-orang yang melanjutkan keturunan.

ayahs.arabic: وَتَرَكْنَا عَلَيْهِ فِى ٱلْءَاخِرِينَ
ayahs.sahih: And left for him [favorable mention] among later generations:
ayahs.clear: And We left mention of him among those who succeeded.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan Kami abadikan untuk Nuh itu (pujian yang baik) di kalangan orang-orang yang datang kemudian;

ayahs.arabic: سَلَٰمٌ عَلَىٰ نُوحٍۢ فِى ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
ayahs.sahih: "Peace upon Noah among the worlds."
ayahs.clear: Peace be upon Noah among all people.
ayahs.kemenag: "Kesejahteraan dilimpahkan atas Nuh di seluruh alam".

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
ayahs.sahih: Indeed, We thus reward the doers of good.
ayahs.clear: We thus reward the righteous.
ayahs.kemenag: Sesungguhnya demikianlah Kami memberi balasan kepada orang-orang yang berbuat baik.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّهُۥ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
ayahs.sahih: Indeed, he was of Our believing servants.
ayahs.clear: He was one of Our believing servants.
ayahs.kemenag: Sesungguhnya dia termasuk di antara hamba-hamba Kami yang beriman.

ayahs.arabic: ثُمَّ أَغْرَقْنَا ٱلْءَاخَرِينَ
ayahs.sahih: Then We drowned the disbelievers.
ayahs.clear: Then We drowned the others.
ayahs.kemenag: Kemudian Kami tenggelamkan orang-orang yang lain.

ayahs.arabic: ۞ وَإِنَّ مِن شِيعَتِهِۦ لَإِبْرَٰهِيمَ
ayahs.sahih: And indeed, among his kind was Abraham,
ayahs.clear: Of his kind was Abraham.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan sesungguhnya Ibrahim benar-benar termasuk golongannya (Nuh).

ayahs.arabic: إِذْ جَآءَ رَبَّهُۥ بِقَلْبٍۢ سَلِيمٍ
ayahs.sahih: When he came to his Lord with a sound heart
ayahs.clear: When he came to his Lord with a sound heart.
ayahs.kemenag: (lngatlah) ketika ia datang kepada Tuhannya dengan hati yang suci:

ayahs.arabic: إِذْ قَالَ لِأَبِيهِ وَقَوْمِهِۦ مَاذَا تَعْبُدُونَ
ayahs.sahih: [And] when he said to his father and his people, "What do you worship?
ayahs.clear: He said to his father and his people, “What are you worshiping?
ayahs.kemenag: (Ingatlah) ketika ia berkata kepada bapaknya dan kaumnya: "Apakah yang kamu sembah itu?

ayahs.arabic: أَئِفْكًا ءَالِهَةًۭ دُونَ ٱللَّهِ تُرِيدُونَ
ayahs.sahih: Is it falsehood [as] gods other than Allah you desire?
ayahs.clear: Is it falsified gods, instead of God, that you want?
ayahs.kemenag: Apakah kamu menghendaki sembahan-sembahan selain Allah dengan jalan berbohong?

ayahs.arabic: فَمَا ظَنُّكُم بِرَبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
ayahs.sahih: Then what is your thought about the Lord of the worlds?"
ayahs.clear: So what is your opinion about the Lord of the Worlds?”
ayahs.kemenag: Maka apakah anggapanmu terhadap Tuhan semesta alam?"

ayahs.arabic: فَنَظَرَ نَظْرَةًۭ فِى ٱلنُّجُومِ
ayahs.sahih: And he cast a look at the stars
ayahs.clear: Then he took a glance at the stars.
ayahs.kemenag: Lalu ia memandang sekali pandang ke bintang-bintang.

ayahs.arabic: فَقَالَ إِنِّى سَقِيمٌۭ
ayahs.sahih: And said, "Indeed, I am [about to be] ill."
ayahs.clear: And said, “I am sick.”
ayahs.kemenag: Kemudian ia berkata: "Sesungguhnya aku sakit".

ayahs.arabic: فَتَوَلَّوْا۟ عَنْهُ مُدْبِرِينَ
ayahs.sahih: So they turned away from him, departing.
ayahs.clear: But they turned their backs on him, and went away.
ayahs.kemenag: Lalu mereka berpaling daripadanya dengan membelakang.

ayahs.arabic: فَرَاغَ إِلَىٰٓ ءَالِهَتِهِمْ فَقَالَ أَلَا تَأْكُلُونَ
ayahs.sahih: Then he turned to their gods and said, "Do you not eat?
ayahs.clear: Then he turned to their gods, and said, “will you not eat?
ayahs.kemenag: Kemudian ia pergi dengan diam-diam kepada berhala-berhala mereka; lalu ia berkata: "Apakah kamu tidak makan?

ayahs.arabic: مَا لَكُمْ لَا تَنطِقُونَ
ayahs.sahih: What is [wrong] with you that you do not speak?"
ayahs.clear: What is it with you, that you do not speak?”
ayahs.kemenag: Kenapa kamu tidak menjawab?"

ayahs.arabic: فَرَاغَ عَلَيْهِمْ ضَرْبًۢا بِٱلْيَمِينِ
ayahs.sahih: And he turned upon them a blow with [his] right hand.
ayahs.clear: Then he turned on them, striking with his right hand.
ayahs.kemenag: Lalu dihadapinya berhala-berhala itu sambil memukulnya dengan tangan kanannya (dengan kuat).

ayahs.arabic: فَأَقْبَلُوٓا۟ إِلَيْهِ يَزِفُّونَ
ayahs.sahih: Then the people came toward him, hastening.
ayahs.clear: And they came running towards him.
ayahs.kemenag: Kemudian kaumnya datang kepadanya dengan bergegas.

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ أَتَعْبُدُونَ مَا تَنْحِتُونَ
ayahs.sahih: He said, "Do you worship that which you [yourselves] carve,
ayahs.clear: He said, “Do you worship what you carve?
ayahs.kemenag: Ibrahim berkata: "Apakah kamu menyembah patung-patung yang kamu pahat itu?

ayahs.arabic: وَٱللَّهُ خَلَقَكُمْ وَمَا تَعْمَلُونَ
ayahs.sahih: While Allah created you and that which you do?"
ayahs.clear: When God created you, and what you manufacture?”
ayahs.kemenag: Padahal Allah-lah yang menciptakan kamu dan apa yang kamu perbuat itu".

ayahs.arabic: قَالُوا۟ ٱبْنُوا۟ لَهُۥ بُنْيَٰنًۭا فَأَلْقُوهُ فِى ٱلْجَحِيمِ
ayahs.sahih: They said, "Construct for him a furnace and throw him into the burning fire."
ayahs.clear: They said, “Build a pyre for him, and throw him into the furnace.”
ayahs.kemenag: Mereka berkata: "Dirikanlah suatu bangunan untuk (membakar) Ibrahim; lalu lemparkanlah dia ke dalam api yang menyala-nyala itu".

ayahs.arabic: فَأَرَادُوا۟ بِهِۦ كَيْدًۭا فَجَعَلْنَٰهُمُ ٱلْأَسْفَلِينَ
ayahs.sahih: And they intended for him a plan, but We made them the most debased.
ayahs.clear: They wished him ill, but We made them the losers.
ayahs.kemenag: Mereka hendak melakukan tipu muslihat kepadanya, maka Kami jadikan mereka orang-orang yang hina.

ayahs.arabic: وَقَالَ إِنِّى ذَاهِبٌ إِلَىٰ رَبِّى سَيَهْدِينِ
ayahs.sahih: And [then] he said, "Indeed, I will go to [where I am ordered by] my Lord; He will guide me.
ayahs.clear: He said, “I am going towards my Lord, and He will guide me.”
ayahs.kemenag: Dan Ibrahim berkata: "Sesungguhnya aku pergi menghadap kepada Tuhanku, dan Dia akan memberi petunjuk kepadaku.

ayahs.arabic: رَبِّ هَبْ لِى مِنَ ٱلصَّٰلِحِينَ
ayahs.sahih: My Lord, grant me [a child] from among the righteous."
ayahs.clear: “My Lord, give me one of the righteous.”
ayahs.kemenag: Ya Tuhanku, anugrahkanlah kepadaku (seorang anak) yang termasuk orang-orang yang saleh.

ayahs.arabic: فَبَشَّرْنَٰهُ بِغُلَٰمٍ حَلِيمٍۢ
ayahs.sahih: So We gave him good tidings of a forbearing boy.
ayahs.clear: So We gave him good news of a clement boy.
ayahs.kemenag: Maka Kami beri dia khabar gembira dengan seorang anak yang amat sabar.

ayahs.arabic: فَلَمَّا بَلَغَ مَعَهُ ٱلسَّعْىَ قَالَ يَٰبُنَىَّ إِنِّىٓ أَرَىٰ فِى ٱلْمَنَامِ أَنِّىٓ أَذْبَحُكَ فَٱنظُرْ مَاذَا تَرَىٰ ۚ قَالَ يَٰٓأَبَتِ ٱفْعَلْ مَا تُؤْمَرُ ۖ سَتَجِدُنِىٓ إِن شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ مِنَ ٱلصَّٰبِرِينَ
ayahs.sahih: And when he reached with him [the age of] exertion, he said, "O my son, indeed I have seen in a dream that I [must] sacrifice you, so see what you think." He said, "O my father, do as you are commanded. You will find me, if Allah wills, of the steadfast."
ayahs.clear: Then, when he was old enough to accompany him, he said, “O My son, I see in a dream that I am sacrificing you; see what you think.” He said, “O my Father, do as you are commanded; you will find me, God willing, one of the steadfast.”
ayahs.kemenag: Maka tatkala anak itu sampai (pada umur sanggup) berusaha bersama-sama Ibrahim, Ibrahim berkata: "Hai anakku sesungguhnya aku melihat dalam mimpi bahwa aku menyembelihmu. Maka fikirkanlah apa pendapatmu!" Ia menjawab: "Hai bapakku, kerjakanlah apa yang diperintahkan kepadamu; insya Allah kamu akan mendapatiku termasuk orang-orang yang sabar".

ayahs.arabic: فَلَمَّآ أَسْلَمَا وَتَلَّهُۥ لِلْجَبِينِ
ayahs.sahih: And when they had both submitted and he put him down upon his forehead,
ayahs.clear: Then, when they had submitted, and he put his forehead down.
ayahs.kemenag: Tatkala keduanya telah berserah diri dan Ibrahim membaringkan anaknya atas pelipis(nya), (nyatalah kesabaran keduanya).

ayahs.arabic: وَنَٰدَيْنَٰهُ أَن يَٰٓإِبْرَٰهِيمُ
ayahs.sahih: We called to him, "O Abraham,
ayahs.clear: We called out to him, “O Abraham!
ayahs.kemenag: Dan Kami panggillah dia: "Hai Ibrahim,

ayahs.arabic: قَدْ صَدَّقْتَ ٱلرُّءْيَآ ۚ إِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
ayahs.sahih: You have fulfilled the vision." Indeed, We thus reward the doers of good.
ayahs.clear: You have fulfilled the vision.” Thus We reward the doers of good.
ayahs.kemenag: sesungguhnya kamu telah membenarkan mimpi itu sesungguhnya demikianlah Kami memberi balasan kepada orang-orang yang berbuat baik.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَهُوَ ٱلْبَلَٰٓؤُا۟ ٱلْمُبِينُ
ayahs.sahih: Indeed, this was the clear trial.
ayahs.clear: This was certainly an evident test.
ayahs.kemenag: Sesungguhnya ini benar-benar suatu ujian yang nyata.

ayahs.arabic: وَفَدَيْنَٰهُ بِذِبْحٍ عَظِيمٍۢ
ayahs.sahih: And We ransomed him with a great sacrifice,
ayahs.clear: And We redeemed him with a great sacrifice.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan Kami tebus anak itu dengan seekor sembelihan yang besar.

ayahs.arabic: وَتَرَكْنَا عَلَيْهِ فِى ٱلْءَاخِرِينَ
ayahs.sahih: And We left for him [favorable mention] among later generations:
ayahs.clear: And We left with him for later generations.
ayahs.kemenag: Kami abadikan untuk Ibrahim itu (pujian yang baik) di kalangan orang-orang yang datang kemudian,

ayahs.arabic: سَلَٰمٌ عَلَىٰٓ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ
ayahs.sahih: "Peace upon Abraham."
ayahs.clear: Peace be upon Abraham.
ayahs.kemenag: (yaitu)"Kesejahteraan dilimpahkan atas Ibrahim".

ayahs.arabic: كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
ayahs.sahih: Indeed, We thus reward the doers of good.
ayahs.clear: Thus We reward the doers of good.
ayahs.kemenag: Demikianlah Kami memberi balasan kepada orang-orang yang berbuat baik.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّهُۥ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
ayahs.sahih: Indeed, he was of Our believing servants.
ayahs.clear: He was one of Our believing servants.
ayahs.kemenag: Sesungguhnya ia termasuk hamba-hamba Kami yang beriman.

ayahs.arabic: وَبَشَّرْنَٰهُ بِإِسْحَٰقَ نَبِيًّۭا مِّنَ ٱلصَّٰلِحِينَ
ayahs.sahih: And We gave him good tidings of Isaac, a prophet from among the righteous.
ayahs.clear: And We gave him good news of Isaac, a prophet, one of the righteous.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan Kami beri dia kabar gembira dengan (kelahiran) Ishaq seorang nabi yang termasuk orang-orang yang saleh.

ayahs.arabic: وَبَٰرَكْنَا عَلَيْهِ وَعَلَىٰٓ إِسْحَٰقَ ۚ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّتِهِمَا مُحْسِنٌۭ وَظَالِمٌۭ لِّنَفْسِهِۦ مُبِينٌۭ
ayahs.sahih: And We blessed him and Isaac. But among their descendants is the doer of good and the clearly unjust to himself.
ayahs.clear: And We blessed him, and Isaac. But among their descendants are some who are righteous, and some who are clearly unjust to themselves.
ayahs.kemenag: Kami limpahkan keberkatan atasnya dan atas Ishaq. Dan diantara anak cucunya ada yang berbuat baik dan ada (pula) yang Zalim terhadap dirinya sendiri dengan nyata.

ayahs.arabic: وَلَقَدْ مَنَنَّا عَلَىٰ مُوسَىٰ وَهَٰرُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And We did certainly confer favor upon Moses and Aaron.
ayahs.clear: And We blessed Moses and Aaron.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan sesungguhnya Kami telah melimpahkan nikmat atas Musa dan Harun.

ayahs.arabic: وَنَجَّيْنَٰهُمَا وَقَوْمَهُمَا مِنَ ٱلْكَرْبِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
ayahs.sahih: And We saved them and their people from the great affliction,
ayahs.clear: And We delivered them and their people from the terrible disaster.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan Kami selamatkan keduanya dan kaumnya dari bencana yang besar.

ayahs.arabic: وَنَصَرْنَٰهُمْ فَكَانُوا۟ هُمُ ٱلْغَٰلِبِينَ
ayahs.sahih: And We supported them so it was they who overcame.
ayahs.clear: And We supported them, and so they were the victors.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan Kami tolong mereka, maka jadilah mereka orang-orang yang menang.

ayahs.arabic: وَءَاتَيْنَٰهُمَا ٱلْكِتَٰبَ ٱلْمُسْتَبِينَ
ayahs.sahih: And We gave them the explicit Scripture,
ayahs.clear: And We gave them the Clarifying Scripture.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan Kami berikan kepada keduanya kitab yang sangat jelas.

ayahs.arabic: وَهَدَيْنَٰهُمَا ٱلصِّرَٰطَ ٱلْمُسْتَقِيمَ
ayahs.sahih: And We guided them on the straight path.
ayahs.clear: And We guided them upon the straight path.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan Kami tunjuki keduanya ke jalan yang lurus.

ayahs.arabic: وَتَرَكْنَا عَلَيْهِمَا فِى ٱلْءَاخِرِينَ
ayahs.sahih: And We left for them [favorable mention] among later generations:
ayahs.clear: And We left with them for later generations.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan Kami abadikan untuk keduanya (pujian yang baik) dikalangan orang-orang yang datang kemudian;

ayahs.arabic: سَلَٰمٌ عَلَىٰ مُوسَىٰ وَهَٰرُونَ
ayahs.sahih: "Peace upon Moses and Aaron."
ayahs.clear: Peace be upon Moses and Aaron.
ayahs.kemenag: (yaitu): "Kesejahteraan dilimpahkan atas Musa dan Harun".

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
ayahs.sahih: Indeed, We thus reward the doers of good.
ayahs.clear: Thus We reward the righteous.
ayahs.kemenag: Sesungguhnya demikianlah Kami memberi balasan kepada orang-orang yang berbuat baik.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّهُمَا مِنْ عِبَادِنَا ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
ayahs.sahih: Indeed, they were of Our believing servants.
ayahs.clear: They were of Our believing servants.
ayahs.kemenag: Sesungguhnya keduanya termasuk hamba-hamba Kami yang beriman.

ayahs.arabic: وَإِنَّ إِلْيَاسَ لَمِنَ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
ayahs.sahih: And indeed, Elias was from among the messengers,
ayahs.clear: Also Elijah was one of the messengers.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan sesungguhnya Ilyas benar-benar termasuk salah seorang rasul-rasul.

ayahs.arabic: إِذْ قَالَ لِقَوْمِهِۦٓ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
ayahs.sahih: When he said to his people, "Will you not fear Allah?
ayahs.clear: He said to his people, “Do you not fear?
ayahs.kemenag: (ingatlah) ketika ia berkata kepada kaumnya: "Mengapa kamu tidak bertakwa?

ayahs.arabic: أَتَدْعُونَ بَعْلًۭا وَتَذَرُونَ أَحْسَنَ ٱلْخَٰلِقِينَ
ayahs.sahih: Do you call upon Ba'l and leave the best of creators -
ayahs.clear: Do you call on Baal, and forsake the Best of creators?
ayahs.kemenag: Patutkah kamu menyembah Ba'l dan kamu tinggalkan sebaik-baik Pencipta,

ayahs.arabic: ٱللَّهَ رَبَّكُمْ وَرَبَّ ءَابَآئِكُمُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
ayahs.sahih: Allah, your Lord and the Lord of your first forefathers?"
ayahs.clear: God is your Lord, and the Lord of your ancestors.”
ayahs.kemenag: (yaitu) Allah Tuhanmu dan Tuhan bapak-bapakmu yang terdahulu?"

ayahs.arabic: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَإِنَّهُمْ لَمُحْضَرُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And they denied him, so indeed, they will be brought [for punishment],
ayahs.clear: But they called him a liar, and thus they will be brought forward.
ayahs.kemenag: Maka mereka mendustakannya, karena itu mereka akan diseret (ke neraka),

ayahs.arabic: إِلَّا عِبَادَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْمُخْلَصِينَ
ayahs.sahih: Except the chosen servants of Allah.
ayahs.clear: Except for God’s sincere servants.
ayahs.kemenag: kecuali hamba-hamba Allah yang dibersihkan (dari dosa).

ayahs.arabic: وَتَرَكْنَا عَلَيْهِ فِى ٱلْءَاخِرِينَ
ayahs.sahih: And We left for him [favorable mention] among later generations:
ayahs.clear: And We left with him for later generations.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan Kami abadikan untuk Ilyas (pujian yang baik) di kalangan orang-orang yang datang kemudian.

ayahs.arabic: سَلَٰمٌ عَلَىٰٓ إِلْ يَاسِينَ
ayahs.sahih: "Peace upon Elias."
