ayahs.clear: Peace be upon the House of Elijah.
ayahs.kemenag: (yaitu): "Kesejahteraan dilimpahkan atas Ilyas?"

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
ayahs.sahih: Indeed, We thus reward the doers of good.
ayahs.clear: Thus We reward the virtuous.
ayahs.kemenag: Sesungguhnya demikianlah Kami memberi balasan kepada orang-orang yang berbuat baik.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّهُۥ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
ayahs.sahih: Indeed, he was of Our believing servants.
ayahs.clear: He was one of Our believing servants.
ayahs.kemenag: Sesungguhnya dia termasuk hamba-hamba Kami yang beriman.

ayahs.arabic: وَإِنَّ لُوطًۭا لَّمِنَ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
ayahs.sahih: And indeed, Lot was among the messengers.
ayahs.clear: And Lot was one of the messengers.
ayahs.kemenag: Sesungguhnya Luth benar-benar salah seorang rasul.

ayahs.arabic: إِذْ نَجَّيْنَٰهُ وَأَهْلَهُۥٓ أَجْمَعِينَ
ayahs.sahih: [So mention] when We saved him and his family, all,
ayahs.clear: We saved him and his family, all of them.
ayahs.kemenag: (Ingatlah) ketika Kami selamatkan dia dan keluarganya (pengikut-pengikutnya) semua,

ayahs.arabic: إِلَّا عَجُوزًۭا فِى ٱلْغَٰبِرِينَ
ayahs.sahih: Except his wife among those who remained [with the evildoers].
ayahs.clear: Except for an old woman who lagged behind.
ayahs.kemenag: kecuali seorang perempuan tua (isterinya yang berada) bersama-sama orang yang tinggal.

ayahs.arabic: ثُمَّ دَمَّرْنَا ٱلْءَاخَرِينَ
ayahs.sahih: Then We destroyed the others.
ayahs.clear: Then We annihilated the others.
ayahs.kemenag: Kemudian Kami binasakan orang-orang yang lain.

ayahs.arabic: وَإِنَّكُمْ لَتَمُرُّونَ عَلَيْهِم مُّصْبِحِينَ
ayahs.sahih: And indeed, you pass by them in the morning
ayahs.clear: You pass by them in the morning.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan sesungguhnya kamu (hai penduduk Mekah) benar-benar akan melalui (bekas-bekas) mereka di waktu pagi,

ayahs.arabic: وَبِٱلَّيْلِ ۗ أَفَلَا تَعْقِلُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And at night. Then will you not use reason?
ayahs.clear: And at night. Do you not understand?
ayahs.kemenag: dan di waktu malam. Maka apakah kamu tidak memikirkan?

ayahs.arabic: وَإِنَّ يُونُسَ لَمِنَ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
ayahs.sahih: And indeed, Jonah was among the messengers.
ayahs.clear: And Jonah was one of the messengers.
ayahs.kemenag: Sesungguhnya Yunus benar-benar salah seorang rasul,

ayahs.arabic: إِذْ أَبَقَ إِلَى ٱلْفُلْكِ ٱلْمَشْحُونِ
ayahs.sahih: [Mention] when he ran away to the laden ship.
ayahs.clear: When he fled to the laden boat.
ayahs.kemenag: (ingatlah) ketika ia lari, ke kapal yang penuh muatan,

ayahs.arabic: فَسَاهَمَ فَكَانَ مِنَ ٱلْمُدْحَضِينَ
ayahs.sahih: And he drew lots and was among the losers.
ayahs.clear: He gambled and lost.
ayahs.kemenag: kemudian ia ikut berundi lalu dia termasuk orang-orang yang kalah dalam undian.

ayahs.arabic: فَٱلْتَقَمَهُ ٱلْحُوتُ وَهُوَ مُلِيمٌۭ
ayahs.sahih: Then the fish swallowed him, while he was blameworthy.
ayahs.clear: Then the fish swallowed him, and he was to blame.
ayahs.kemenag: Maka ia ditelan oleh ikan besar dalam keadaan tercela.

ayahs.arabic: فَلَوْلَآ أَنَّهُۥ كَانَ مِنَ ٱلْمُسَبِّحِينَ
ayahs.sahih: And had he not been of those who exalt Allah,
ayahs.clear: Had he not been one of those who praised.
ayahs.kemenag: Maka kalau sekiranya dia tidak termasuk orang-orang yang banyak mengingat Allah,

ayahs.arabic: لَلَبِثَ فِى بَطْنِهِۦٓ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ يُبْعَثُونَ
ayahs.sahih: He would have remained inside its belly until the Day they are resurrected.
ayahs.clear: He would have stayed in its belly until the Day they are raised.
ayahs.kemenag: niscaya ia akan tetap tinggal di perut ikan itu sampai hari berbangkit.

ayahs.arabic: ۞ فَنَبَذْنَٰهُ بِٱلْعَرَآءِ وَهُوَ سَقِيمٌۭ
ayahs.sahih: But We threw him onto the open shore while he was ill.
ayahs.clear: Then We threw him into the wilderness, and he was sick.
ayahs.kemenag: Kemudian Kami lemparkan dia ke daerah yang tandus, sedang ia dalam keadaan sakit.

ayahs.arabic: وَأَنۢبَتْنَا عَلَيْهِ شَجَرَةًۭ مِّن يَقْطِينٍۢ
ayahs.sahih: And We caused to grow over him a gourd vine.
ayahs.clear: And We made a gourd tree grow over him.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan Kami tumbuhkan untuk dia sebatang pohon dari jenis labu.

ayahs.arabic: وَأَرْسَلْنَٰهُ إِلَىٰ مِا۟ئَةِ أَلْفٍ أَوْ يَزِيدُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And We sent him to [his people of] a hundred thousand or more.
ayahs.clear: Then We sent him to a hundred thousand, or more.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan Kami utus dia kepada seratus ribu orang atau lebih.

ayahs.arabic: فَـَٔامَنُوا۟ فَمَتَّعْنَٰهُمْ إِلَىٰ حِينٍۢ
ayahs.sahih: And they believed, so We gave them enjoyment [of life] for a time.
ayahs.clear: And they believed, so We gave them enjoyment for a while.
ayahs.kemenag: Lalu mereka beriman, karena itu Kami anugerahkan kenikmatan hidup kepada mereka hingga waktu yang tertentu.

ayahs.arabic: فَٱسْتَفْتِهِمْ أَلِرَبِّكَ ٱلْبَنَاتُ وَلَهُمُ ٱلْبَنُونَ
ayahs.sahih: So inquire of them, [O Muhammad], "Does your Lord have daughters while they have sons?
ayahs.clear: Ask them, “Are the daughters for your Lord, while for them the sons?”
ayahs.kemenag: Tanyakanlah (ya Muhammad) kepada mereka (orang-orang kafir Mekah): "Apakah untuk Tuhanmu anak-anak perempuan dan untuk mereka anak laki-laki,

ayahs.arabic: أَمْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةَ إِنَٰثًۭا وَهُمْ شَٰهِدُونَ
ayahs.sahih: Or did We create the angels as females while they were witnesses?"
ayahs.clear: Or did We create the angels females, as they witnessed?”
ayahs.kemenag: atau apakah Kami menciptakan malaikat-malaikat berupa perempuan dan mereka menyaksikan(nya)?

ayahs.arabic: أَلَآ إِنَّهُم مِّنْ إِفْكِهِمْ لَيَقُولُونَ
ayahs.sahih: Unquestionably, it is out of their [invented] falsehood that they say,
ayahs.clear: No indeed! It is one of their lies when they say.
ayahs.kemenag: Ketahuilah bahwa sesungguhnya mereka dengan kebohongannya benar-benar mengatakan:

ayahs.arabic: وَلَدَ ٱللَّهُ وَإِنَّهُمْ لَكَٰذِبُونَ
ayahs.sahih: " Allah has begotten," and indeed, they are liars.
ayahs.clear: “God has begotten.” They are indeed lying.
ayahs.kemenag: "Allah beranak". Dan sesungguhnya mereka benar-benar orang yang berdusta.

ayahs.arabic: أَصْطَفَى ٱلْبَنَاتِ عَلَى ٱلْبَنِينَ
ayahs.sahih: Has He chosen daughters over sons?
ayahs.clear: So He preferred girls over boys?
ayahs.kemenag: Apakah Tuhan memilih (mengutamakan) anak-anak perempuan daripada anak laki-laki?

ayahs.arabic: مَا لَكُمْ كَيْفَ تَحْكُمُونَ
ayahs.sahih: What is [wrong] with you? How do you make judgement?
ayahs.clear: What is the matter with you? How do you judge?
ayahs.kemenag: Apakah yang terjadi padamu? Bagaimana (caranya) kamu menetapkan?

ayahs.arabic: أَفَلَا تَذَكَّرُونَ
ayahs.sahih: Then will you not be reminded?
ayahs.clear: Will you not reflect?
ayahs.kemenag: Maka apakah kamu tidak memikirkan?

ayahs.arabic: أَمْ لَكُمْ سُلْطَٰنٌۭ مُّبِينٌۭ
ayahs.sahih: Or do you have a clear authority?
ayahs.clear: Or do you have some clear proof?
ayahs.kemenag: Atau apakah kamu mempunyai bukti yang nyata?

ayahs.arabic: فَأْتُوا۟ بِكِتَٰبِكُمْ إِن كُنتُمْ صَٰدِقِينَ
ayahs.sahih: Then produce your scripture, if you should be truthful.
ayahs.clear: Then bring your book, if you are telling the truth.
ayahs.kemenag: Maka bawalah kitabmu jika kamu memang orang-orang yang benar.

ayahs.arabic: وَجَعَلُوا۟ بَيْنَهُۥ وَبَيْنَ ٱلْجِنَّةِ نَسَبًۭا ۚ وَلَقَدْ عَلِمَتِ ٱلْجِنَّةُ إِنَّهُمْ لَمُحْضَرُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And they have claimed between Him and the jinn a lineage, but the jinn have already known that they [who made such claims] will be brought to [punishment].
ayahs.clear: And they invented a relationship between Him and the jinn. But the jinn know that they will be arraigned.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan mereka adakan (hubungan) nasab antara Allah dan antara jin. Dan sesungguhnya jin mengetahui bahwa mereka benar-benar akan diseret (ke neraka),

ayahs.arabic: سُبْحَٰنَ ٱللَّهِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ
ayahs.sahih: Exalted is Allah above what they describe,
ayahs.clear: God be glorified, far above what they allege.
ayahs.kemenag: Maha Suci Allah dari apa yang mereka sifatkan,

ayahs.arabic: إِلَّا عِبَادَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْمُخْلَصِينَ
ayahs.sahih: Except the chosen servants of Allah [who do not share in that sin].
ayahs.clear: Except for God’s sincere servants.
ayahs.kemenag: Kecuali hamba-hamba Allah yang dibersihkan dari (dosa).

ayahs.arabic: فَإِنَّكُمْ وَمَا تَعْبُدُونَ
ayahs.sahih: So indeed, you [disbelievers] and whatever you worship,
ayahs.clear: Surely, you and what you serve.
ayahs.kemenag: Maka sesungguhnya kamu dan apa-apa yang kamu sembah itu,

ayahs.arabic: مَآ أَنتُمْ عَلَيْهِ بِفَٰتِنِينَ
ayahs.sahih: You cannot tempt [anyone] away from Him
ayahs.clear: Cannot seduce away from Him.
ayahs.kemenag: Sekali-kali tidak dapat menyesatkan (seseorang) terhadap Allah,

ayahs.arabic: إِلَّا مَنْ هُوَ صَالِ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
ayahs.sahih: Except he who is to [enter and] burn in the Hellfire.
ayahs.clear: Except for he who will be roasting in Hell.
ayahs.kemenag: kecuali orang-orang yang akan masuk neraka yang menyala.

ayahs.arabic: وَمَا مِنَّآ إِلَّا لَهُۥ مَقَامٌۭ مَّعْلُومٌۭ
ayahs.sahih: [The angels say], "There is not among us any except that he has a known position.
ayahs.clear: “There is not one of us but has an assigned position.
ayahs.kemenag: Tiada seorangpun di antara kami (malaikat) melainkan mempunyai kedudukan yang tertentu,

ayahs.arabic: وَإِنَّا لَنَحْنُ ٱلصَّآفُّونَ
ayahs.sahih: And indeed, we are those who line up [for prayer].
ayahs.clear: And we are the arrangers.
ayahs.kemenag: dan sesungguhnya kami benar-benar bershaf-shaf (dalam menunaikan perintah Allah).

ayahs.arabic: وَإِنَّا لَنَحْنُ ٱلْمُسَبِّحُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And indeed, we are those who exalt Allah."
ayahs.clear: And we are the glorifiers.”
ayahs.kemenag: Dan sesungguhnya kami benar-benar bertasbih (kepada Allah).

ayahs.arabic: وَإِن كَانُوا۟ لَيَقُولُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And indeed, the disbelievers used to say,
ayahs.clear: Even though they used to say.
ayahs.kemenag: Sesungguhnya mereka benar-benar akan berkata:

ayahs.arabic: لَوْ أَنَّ عِندَنَا ذِكْرًۭا مِّنَ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
ayahs.sahih: "If we had a message from [those of] the former peoples,
ayahs.clear: “Had we received advice from the ancients.
ayahs.kemenag: "Kalau sekiranya di sksi kami ada sebuah kitab dari (kitab-kitab yang diturunkan) kepada orang-orang dahulu,

ayahs.arabic: لَكُنَّا عِبَادَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْمُخْلَصِينَ
ayahs.sahih: We would have been the chosen servants of Allah."
ayahs.clear: We would have been God's faithful servants.”
ayahs.kemenag: benar-benar kami akan jadi hamba Allah yang dibersihkan (dari dosa)".

ayahs.arabic: فَكَفَرُوا۟ بِهِۦ ۖ فَسَوْفَ يَعْلَمُونَ
ayahs.sahih: But they disbelieved in it, so they are going to know.
ayahs.clear: But they rejected it, so they will find out.
ayahs.kemenag: Tetapi mereka mengingkarinya (Al Quran); maka kelak mereka akan mengetahui (akibat keingkarannya itu).

ayahs.arabic: وَلَقَدْ سَبَقَتْ كَلِمَتُنَا لِعِبَادِنَا ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
ayahs.sahih: And Our word has already preceded for Our servants, the messengers,
ayahs.clear: Our Word has already gone out to our servant messengers.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan sesungguhnya telah tetap janji Kami kepada hamba-hamba Kami yang menjadi rasul,

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّهُمْ لَهُمُ ٱلْمَنصُورُونَ
ayahs.sahih: [That] indeed, they would be those given victory
ayahs.clear: It is they who will be supported.
ayahs.kemenag: (yaitu) sesungguhnya mereka itulah yang pasti mendapat pertolongan.

ayahs.arabic: وَإِنَّ جُندَنَا لَهُمُ ٱلْغَٰلِبُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And [that] indeed, Our soldiers will be those who overcome.
ayahs.clear: And Our troops will be the victors.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan sesungguhnya tentara Kami itulah yang pasti menang,

ayahs.arabic: فَتَوَلَّ عَنْهُمْ حَتَّىٰ حِينٍۢ
ayahs.sahih: So, [O Muhammad], leave them for a time.
ayahs.clear: So disregard them for a while.
ayahs.kemenag: Maka berpalinglah kamu (Muhammad) dari mereka sampai suatu ketika.

ayahs.arabic: وَأَبْصِرْهُمْ فَسَوْفَ يُبْصِرُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And see [what will befall] them, for they are going to see.
ayahs.clear: And watch them—they will soon see.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan lihatlah mereka, maka kelak mereka akan melihat (azab itu).

ayahs.arabic: أَفَبِعَذَابِنَا يَسْتَعْجِلُونَ
ayahs.sahih: Then for Our punishment are they impatient?
ayahs.clear: Are they seeking to hasten Our punishment?
ayahs.kemenag: Maka apakah mereka meminta supaya siksa Kami disegerakan?

ayahs.arabic: فَإِذَا نَزَلَ بِسَاحَتِهِمْ فَسَآءَ صَبَاحُ ٱلْمُنذَرِينَ
ayahs.sahih: But when it descends in their territory, then evil is the morning of those who were warned.
ayahs.clear: When it descends into their yard, miserable will be the morning of those forewarned.
ayahs.kemenag: Maka apabila siksaan itu turun dihalaman mereka, maka amat buruklah pagi hari yang dialami oleh orang-orang yang diperingatkan itu.

ayahs.arabic: وَتَوَلَّ عَنْهُمْ حَتَّىٰ حِينٍۢ
ayahs.sahih: And leave them for a time.
ayahs.clear: So avoid them for a while.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan berpalinglah kamu dari mereka hingga suatu ketika.

ayahs.arabic: وَأَبْصِرْ فَسَوْفَ يُبْصِرُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And see, for they are going to see.
ayahs.clear: And watch—they will soon see.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan lihatlah, maka kelak mereka juga akan melihat.

ayahs.arabic: سُبْحَٰنَ رَبِّكَ رَبِّ ٱلْعِزَّةِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ
ayahs.sahih: Exalted is your Lord, the Lord of might, above what they describe.
ayahs.clear: Exalted be your Lord, the Lord of Glory, beyond their allegations.
ayahs.kemenag: Maha Suci Tuhanmu Yang mempunyai keperkasaan dari apa yang mereka katakan.

ayahs.arabic: وَسَلَٰمٌ عَلَى ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
ayahs.sahih: And peace upon the messengers.
ayahs.clear: And peace be upon the messengers.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan kesejahteraan dilimpahkan atas para rasul.

ayahs.arabic: وَٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
ayahs.sahih: And praise to Allah, Lord of the worlds.
ayahs.clear: And praise be to God, the Lord of the Worlds.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan segala puji bagi Allah Tuhan seru sekalian alam.

ayahs.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ صٓ ۚ وَٱلْقُرْءَانِ ذِى ٱلذِّكْرِ
ayahs.sahih: Sad. By the Qur'an containing reminder...
ayahs.clear: Saad. By the renowned Quran.
ayahs.kemenag: Shaad, demi Al Quran yang mempunyai keagungan.

ayahs.arabic: بَلِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ فِى عِزَّةٍۢ وَشِقَاقٍۢ
ayahs.sahih: But those who disbelieve are in pride and dissension.
ayahs.clear: Those who disbelieve are steeped in arrogance and defiance.
ayahs.kemenag: Sebenarnya orang-orang kafir itu (berada) dalam kesombongan dan permusuhan yang sengit.

ayahs.arabic: كَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا مِن قَبْلِهِم مِّن قَرْنٍۢ فَنَادَوا۟ وَّلَاتَ حِينَ مَنَاصٍۢ
ayahs.sahih: How many a generation have We destroyed before them, and they [then] called out; but it was not a time for escape.
ayahs.clear: How many generations have We destroyed before them? They cried out when it was too late to escape.
ayahs.kemenag: Betapa banyaknya umat sebelum mereka yang telah Kami binasakan, lalu mereka meminta tolong padahal (waktu itu) bukanlah saat untuk lari melepaskan diri.

ayahs.arabic: وَعَجِبُوٓا۟ أَن جَآءَهُم مُّنذِرٌۭ مِّنْهُمْ ۖ وَقَالَ ٱلْكَٰفِرُونَ هَٰذَا سَٰحِرٌۭ كَذَّابٌ
ayahs.sahih: And they wonder that there has come to them a warner from among themselves. And the disbelievers say, "This is a magician and a liar.
ayahs.clear: And they marveled that a warner has come to them from among them. The disbelievers said, “This is a lying magician.”
ayahs.kemenag: Dan mereka heran karena mereka kedatangan seorang pemberi peringatan (rasul) dari kalangan mereka; dan orang-orang kafir berkata: "Ini adalah seorang ahli sihir yang banyak berdusta".

ayahs.arabic: أَجَعَلَ ٱلْءَالِهَةَ إِلَٰهًۭا وَٰحِدًا ۖ إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَشَىْءٌ عُجَابٌۭ
ayahs.sahih: Has he made the gods [only] one God? Indeed, this is a curious thing."
ayahs.clear: “Did he turn all the gods into one God? This is something strange.”
ayahs.kemenag: Mengapa ia menjadikan tuhan-tuhan itu Tuhan Yang Satu saja? Sesungguhnya ini benar-benar suatu hal yang sangat mengherankan.

ayahs.arabic: وَٱنطَلَقَ ٱلْمَلَأُ مِنْهُمْ أَنِ ٱمْشُوا۟ وَٱصْبِرُوا۟ عَلَىٰٓ ءَالِهَتِكُمْ ۖ إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَشَىْءٌۭ يُرَادُ
ayahs.sahih: And the eminent among them went forth, [saying], "Continue, and be patient over [the defense of] your gods. Indeed, this is a thing intended.
ayahs.clear: The notables among them announced: “Go on, and hold fast to your gods. This is something planned.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan pergilah pemimpin-pemimpin mereka (seraya berkata): "Pergilah kamu dan tetaplah (menyembah) tuhan-tuhanmu, sesungguhnya ini benar-benar suatu hal yang dikehendaki.

ayahs.arabic: مَا سَمِعْنَا بِهَٰذَا فِى ٱلْمِلَّةِ ٱلْءَاخِرَةِ إِنْ هَٰذَآ إِلَّا ٱخْتِلَٰقٌ
ayahs.sahih: We have not heard of this in the latest religion. This is not but a fabrication.
ayahs.clear: We never heard of this in the former faith. This is nothing but a fabrication.
ayahs.kemenag: Kami tidak pernah mendengar hal ini dalam agama yang terakhir; ini (mengesakan Allah), tidak lain hanyalah (dusta) yang diada-adakan,

ayahs.arabic: أَءُنزِلَ عَلَيْهِ ٱلذِّكْرُ مِنۢ بَيْنِنَا ۚ بَلْ هُمْ فِى شَكٍّۢ مِّن ذِكْرِى ۖ بَل لَّمَّا يَذُوقُوا۟ عَذَابِ
ayahs.sahih: Has the message been revealed to him out of [all of] us?" Rather, they are in doubt about My message. Rather, they have not yet tasted My punishment.
ayahs.clear: Was the message sent down to him, out of all of us?” In fact, they are doubtful of My warning. In fact, they have not yet tasted My punishment.
ayahs.kemenag: mengapa Al Quran itu diturunkan kepadanya di antara kita?" Sebenarnya mereka ragu-ragu terhadap Al Quran-Ku, dan sebenarnya mereka belum merasakan azab-Ku.

ayahs.arabic: أَمْ عِندَهُمْ خَزَآئِنُ رَحْمَةِ رَبِّكَ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْوَهَّابِ
ayahs.sahih: Or do they have the depositories of the mercy of your Lord, the Exalted in Might, the Bestower?
ayahs.clear: Or do they possess the treasuries of the mercy of your Lord—the Majestic, the Giver?
ayahs.kemenag: Atau apakah mereka itu mempunyai perbendaharaan rahmat Tuhanmu Yang Maha Perkasa lagi Maha Pemberi?

ayahs.arabic: أَمْ لَهُم مُّلْكُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا ۖ فَلْيَرْتَقُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَسْبَٰبِ
ayahs.sahih: Or is theirs the dominion of the heavens and the earth and what is between them? Then let them ascend through [any] ways of access.
ayahs.clear: Or do they possess the sovereignty of the heavens and the earth and what is between them? Then let them ascend the ropes.
ayahs.kemenag: Atau apakah bagi mereka kerajaan langit dan bumi dan yang ada di antara keduanya? (Jika ada), maka hendaklah mereka menaiki tangga-tangga (ke langit).

ayahs.arabic: جُندٌۭ مَّا هُنَالِكَ مَهْزُومٌۭ مِّنَ ٱلْأَحْزَابِ
ayahs.sahih: [They are but] soldiers [who will be] defeated there among the companies [of disbelievers].
ayahs.clear: An army of confederates with be defeated there.
ayahs.kemenag: Suatu tentara yang besar yang berada disana dari golongan-golongan yang berserikat, pasti akan dikalahkan.

ayahs.arabic: كَذَّبَتْ قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍۢ وَعَادٌۭ وَفِرْعَوْنُ ذُو ٱلْأَوْتَادِ
ayahs.sahih: The people of Noah denied before them, and [the tribe of] 'Aad and Pharaoh, the owner of stakes,
ayahs.clear: Before them the people of Noah denied the truth; as did Aad, and Pharaoh of the Stakes.
ayahs.kemenag: Telah mendustakan (rasul-rasul pula) sebelum mereka itu kaum Nuh, 'Aad, Fir'aun yang mempunyai tentara yang banyak,

ayahs.arabic: وَثَمُودُ وَقَوْمُ لُوطٍۢ وَأَصْحَٰبُ لْـَٔيْكَةِ ۚ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ ٱلْأَحْزَابُ
ayahs.sahih: And [the tribe of] Thamud and the people of Lot and the companions of the thicket. Those are the companies.
ayahs.clear: And Thamood, and the people of Lot, and the dwellers of the Woods—these were the confederates.
ayahs.kemenag: dan Tsamud, kaum Luth dan penduduk Aikah. Mereka itulah golongan-golongan yang bersekutu (menentang rasul-rasul).

ayahs.arabic: إِن كُلٌّ إِلَّا كَذَّبَ ٱلرُّسُلَ فَحَقَّ عِقَابِ
ayahs.sahih: Each of them denied the messengers, so My penalty was justified.
ayahs.clear: None of them but denied the messengers, so My retribution was deserved.
ayahs.kemenag: Semua mereka itu tidak lain hanyalah mendustakan rasul-rasul, maka pastilah (bagi mereka) azab-Ku.

ayahs.arabic: وَمَا يَنظُرُ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ إِلَّا صَيْحَةًۭ وَٰحِدَةًۭ مَّا لَهَا مِن فَوَاقٍۢ
ayahs.sahih: And these [disbelievers] await not but one blast [of the Horn]; for it there will be no delay.
ayahs.clear: These can expect only a single scream, from which there is no recovery.
ayahs.kemenag: Tidaklah yang mereka tunggu melainkan hanya satu teriakan saja yang tidak ada baginya saat berselang.

ayahs.arabic: وَقَالُوا۟ رَبَّنَا عَجِّل لَّنَا قِطَّنَا قَبْلَ يَوْمِ ٱلْحِسَابِ
ayahs.sahih: And they say, "Our Lord, hasten for us our share [of the punishment] before the Day of Account"
ayahs.clear: And they say, “Our Lord, hasten Your writ upon us, before the Day of Account.”
ayahs.kemenag: Dan mereka berkata: "Ya Tuhan kami cepatkanlah untuk kami azab yang diperuntukkan bagi kami sebelum hari berhisab".

ayahs.arabic: ٱصْبِرْ عَلَىٰ مَا يَقُولُونَ وَٱذْكُرْ عَبْدَنَا دَاوُۥدَ ذَا ٱلْأَيْدِ ۖ إِنَّهُۥٓ أَوَّابٌ
ayahs.sahih: Be patient over what they say and remember Our servant, David, the possessor of strength; indeed, he was one who repeatedly turned back [to Allah].
ayahs.clear: Be patient in the face of what they say, and mention Our servant David, the resourceful. He was obedient.
ayahs.kemenag: Bersabarlah atas segala apa yang mereka katakan; dan ingatlah hamba Kami Daud yang mempunyai kekuatan; sesungguhnya dia amat taat (kepada Tuhan).

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّا سَخَّرْنَا ٱلْجِبَالَ مَعَهُۥ يُسَبِّحْنَ بِٱلْعَشِىِّ وَٱلْإِشْرَاقِ
ayahs.sahih: Indeed, We subjected the mountains [to praise] with him, exalting [Allah] in the [late] afternoon and [after] sunrise.
ayahs.clear: We committed the mountains to glorify with him, in the evening and at daybreak.
ayahs.kemenag: Sesungguhnya Kami menundukkan gunung-gunung untuk bertasbih bersama dia (Daud) di waktu petang dan pagi,

ayahs.arabic: وَٱلطَّيْرَ مَحْشُورَةًۭ ۖ كُلٌّۭ لَّهُۥٓ أَوَّابٌۭ
ayahs.sahih: And the birds were assembled, all with him repeating [praises].
ayahs.clear: And the birds, gathered together. All obedient to him.
ayahs.kemenag: dan (Kami tundukkan pula) burung-burung dalam keadaan terkumpul. Masing-masingnya amat taat kepada Allah.

ayahs.arabic: وَشَدَدْنَا مُلْكَهُۥ وَءَاتَيْنَٰهُ ٱلْحِكْمَةَ وَفَصْلَ ٱلْخِطَابِ
ayahs.sahih: And We strengthened his kingdom and gave him wisdom and discernment in speech.
ayahs.clear: And We strengthened his kingdom, and gave him wisdom and decisive speech.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan Kami kuatkan kerajaannya dan Kami berikan kepadanya hikmahdan kebijaksanaan dalam menyelesaikan perselisihan.

ayahs.arabic: ۞ وَهَلْ أَتَىٰكَ نَبَؤُا۟ ٱلْخَصْمِ إِذْ تَسَوَّرُوا۟ ٱلْمِحْرَابَ
ayahs.sahih: And has there come to you the news of the adversaries, when they climbed over the wall of [his] prayer chamber -
ayahs.clear: Has the story of the two disputants reached you? When they scaled the sanctuary?
ayahs.kemenag: Dan adakah sampai kepadamu berita orang-orang yang berperkara ketika mereka memanjat pagar?

ayahs.arabic: إِذْ دَخَلُوا۟ عَلَىٰ دَاوُۥدَ فَفَزِعَ مِنْهُمْ ۖ قَالُوا۟ لَا تَخَفْ ۖ خَصْمَانِ بَغَىٰ بَعْضُنَا عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍۢ فَٱحْكُم بَيْنَنَا بِٱلْحَقِّ وَلَا تُشْطِطْ وَٱهْدِنَآ إِلَىٰ سَوَآءِ ٱلصِّرَٰطِ
ayahs.sahih: When they entered upon David and he was alarmed by them? They said, "Fear not. [We are] two adversaries, one of whom has wronged the other, so judge between us with truth and do not exceed [it] and guide us to the sound path.
ayahs.clear: When they entered upon David, and he was startled by them. They said, “Do not fear. Two disputants; one of us has wronged the other; so judge between us fairly, and do not be biased, and guide us to the straight way.”
ayahs.kemenag: Ketika mereka masuk (menemui) Daud lalu ia terkejut karena kedatangan) mereka. Mereka berkata: "Janganlah kamu merasa takut; (kami) adalah dua orang yang berperkara yang salah seorang dari kami berbuat zalim kepada yang lain; maka berilah keputusan antara kami dengan adil dan janganlah kamu menyimpang dari kebenaran dan tunjukilah kami ke jalan yang lurus.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ هَٰذَآ أَخِى لَهُۥ تِسْعٌۭ وَتِسْعُونَ نَعْجَةًۭ وَلِىَ نَعْجَةٌۭ وَٰحِدَةٌۭ فَقَالَ أَكْفِلْنِيهَا وَعَزَّنِى فِى ٱلْخِطَابِ
ayahs.sahih: Indeed this, my brother, has ninety-nine ewes, and I have one ewe; so he said, 'Entrust her to me,' and he overpowered me in speech."
ayahs.clear: “This brother of mine has ninety nine ewes, and I have one ewe, and he said, ‘Entrust it to me,’ and he pressured me with words.”
ayahs.kemenag: Sesungguhnya saudaraku ini mempunyai sembilan puluh sembilan ekor kambing betina dan aku mempunyai seekor saja. Maka dia berkata: "Serahkanlah kambingmu itu kepadaku dan dia mengalahkan aku dalam perdebatan".

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ لَقَدْ ظَلَمَكَ بِسُؤَالِ نَعْجَتِكَ إِلَىٰ نِعَاجِهِۦ ۖ وَإِنَّ كَثِيرًۭا مِّنَ ٱلْخُلَطَآءِ لَيَبْغِى بَعْضُهُمْ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍ إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ وَقَلِيلٌۭ مَّا هُمْ ۗ وَظَنَّ دَاوُۥدُ أَنَّمَا فَتَنَّٰهُ فَٱسْتَغْفَرَ رَبَّهُۥ وَخَرَّ رَاكِعًۭا وَأَنَابَ ۩
ayahs.sahih: [David] said, "He has certainly wronged you in demanding your ewe [in addition] to his ewes. And indeed, many associates oppress one another, except for those who believe and do righteous deeds - and few are they." And David became certain that We had tried him, and he asked forgiveness of his Lord and fell down bowing [in prostration] and turned in repentance [to Allah].
ayahs.clear: He said, “He has done you wrong by asking your ewe in addition to his ewes. Many partners take advantage of one another, except those who believe and do good deeds, but these are so few.” David realized that We were testing him, so he sought forgiveness from his Lord, and fell down to his knees, and repented.
ayahs.kemenag: Daud berkata: "Sesungguhnya dia telah berbuat zalim kepadamu dengan meminta kambingmu itu untuk ditambahkan kepada kambingnya. Dan sesungguhnya kebanyakan dari orang-orang yang berserikat itu sebahagian mereka berbuat zalim kepada sebahagian yang lain, kecuali orang-orang yang beriman dan mengerjakan amal yang saleh; dan amat sedikitlah mereka ini". Dan Daud mengetahui bahwa Kami mengujinya; maka ia meminta ampun kepada Tuhannya lalu menyungkur sujud dan bertaubat.

ayahs.arabic: فَغَفَرْنَا لَهُۥ ذَٰلِكَ ۖ وَإِنَّ لَهُۥ عِندَنَا لَزُلْفَىٰ وَحُسْنَ مَـَٔابٍۢ
ayahs.sahih: So We forgave him that; and indeed, for him is nearness to Us and a good place of return.
ayahs.clear: So We forgave him that. And for him is nearness to Us, and a good place of return.
ayahs.kemenag: Maka Kami ampuni baginya kesalahannya itu. Dan sesungguhnya dia mempunyai kedudukan dekat pada sisi Kami dan tempat kembali yang baik.

ayahs.arabic: يَٰدَاوُۥدُ إِنَّا جَعَلْنَٰكَ خَلِيفَةًۭ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَٱحْكُم بَيْنَ ٱلنَّاسِ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَلَا تَتَّبِعِ ٱلْهَوَىٰ فَيُضِلَّكَ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ ۚ إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يَضِلُّونَ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌۭ شَدِيدٌۢ بِمَا نَسُوا۟ يَوْمَ ٱلْحِسَابِ
ayahs.sahih: [We said], "O David, indeed We have made you a successor upon the earth, so judge between the people in truth and do not follow [your own] desire, as it will lead you astray from the way of Allah." Indeed, those who go astray from the way of Allah will have a severe punishment for having forgotten the Day of Account.
ayahs.clear: “O David, We made you a ruler in the land, so judge between the people with justice, and do not follow desire, lest it diverts you from God’s path. Those who stray from God’s path will have a painful punishment, for having ignored the Day of Account.”
ayahs.kemenag: Hai Daud, sesungguhnya Kami menjadikan kamu khalifah (penguasa) di muka bumi, maka berilah keputusan (perkara) di antara manusia dengan adil dan janganlah kamu mengikuti hawa nafsu, karena ia akan menyesatkan kamu dari jalan Allah. Sesungguhnya orang-orang yang sesat darin jalan Allah akan mendapat azab yang berat, karena mereka melupakan hari perhitungan.

ayahs.arabic: وَمَا خَلَقْنَا ٱلسَّمَآءَ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا بَٰطِلًۭا ۚ ذَٰلِكَ ظَنُّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ ۚ فَوَيْلٌۭ لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلنَّارِ
ayahs.sahih: And We did not create the heaven and the earth and that between them aimlessly. That is the assumption of those who disbelieve, so woe to those who disbelieve from the Fire.
ayahs.clear: We did not create the heaven and the earth and everything between them in vain. That is the assumption of those who disbelieve—so woe to those who disbelieve because of the Fire.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan Kami tidak menciptakan langit dan bumi dan apa yang ada antara keduanya tanpa hikmah. Yang demikian itu adalah anggapan orang-orang kafir, maka celakalah orang-orang kafir itu karena mereka akan masuk neraka.

ayahs.arabic: أَمْ نَجْعَلُ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ كَٱلْمُفْسِدِينَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ أَمْ نَجْعَلُ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ كَٱلْفُجَّارِ
ayahs.sahih: Or should we treat those who believe and do righteous deeds like corrupters in the land? Or should We treat those who fear Allah like the wicked?
ayahs.clear: Or are We to treat those who believe and do righteous deeds like those who make trouble on earth? Or are We to treat the pious like the shameless?
ayahs.kemenag: Patutkah Kami menganggap orang-orang yang beriman dan mengerjakan amal yang saleh sama dengan orang-orang yang berbuat kerusakan di muka bumi? Patutkah (pula) Kami menganggap orang-orang yang bertakwa sama dengan orang-orang yang berbuat maksiat?

ayahs.arabic: كِتَٰبٌ أَنزَلْنَٰهُ إِلَيْكَ مُبَٰرَكٌۭ لِّيَدَّبَّرُوٓا۟ ءَايَٰتِهِۦ وَلِيَتَذَكَّرَ أُو۟لُوا۟ ٱلْأَلْبَٰبِ
ayahs.sahih: [This is] a blessed Book which We have revealed to you, [O Muhammad], that they might reflect upon its verses and that those of understanding would be reminded.
ayahs.clear: A blessed Book that We sent down to you, that they may ponder its Verses, and for those with intelligence to take heed.
ayahs.kemenag: Ini adalah sebuah kitab yang Kami turunkan kepadamu penuh dengan berkah supaya mereka memperhatikan ayat-ayatnya dan supaya mendapat pelajaran orang-orang yang mempunyai fikiran.

ayahs.arabic: وَوَهَبْنَا لِدَاوُۥدَ سُلَيْمَٰنَ ۚ نِعْمَ ٱلْعَبْدُ ۖ إِنَّهُۥٓ أَوَّابٌ
ayahs.sahih: And to David We gave Solomon. An excellent servant, indeed he was one repeatedly turning back [to Allah].
ayahs.clear: And We granted David, Solomon, an excellent servant. He was penitent.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan Kami karuniakan kepada Daud, Sulaiman, dia adalah sebaik-baik hamba. Sesungguhnya dia amat taat (kepada Tuhannya),

ayahs.arabic: إِذْ عُرِضَ عَلَيْهِ بِٱلْعَشِىِّ ٱلصَّٰفِنَٰتُ ٱلْجِيَادُ
ayahs.sahih: [Mention] when there were exhibited before him in the afternoon the poised [standing] racehorses.
ayahs.clear: When the beautiful horses were paraded before him in the evening.
ayahs.kemenag: (ingatlah) ketika dipertunjukkan kepadanya kuda-kuda yang tenang di waktu berhenti dan cepat waktu berlari pada waktu sore,

ayahs.arabic: فَقَالَ إِنِّىٓ أَحْبَبْتُ حُبَّ ٱلْخَيْرِ عَن ذِكْرِ رَبِّى حَتَّىٰ تَوَارَتْ بِٱلْحِجَابِ
ayahs.sahih: And he said, "Indeed, I gave preference to the love of good [things] over the remembrance of my Lord until the sun disappeared into the curtain [of darkness]."
ayahs.clear: He said, “I have preferred the love of niceties to the remembrance of my Lord—until it disappeared behind the veil.
ayahs.kemenag: maka ia berkata: "Sesungguhnya aku menyukai kesenangan terhadap barang yang baik (kuda) sehingga aku lalai mengingat Tuhanku sampai kuda itu hilang dari pandangan".

ayahs.arabic: رُدُّوهَا عَلَىَّ ۖ فَطَفِقَ مَسْحًۢا بِٱلسُّوقِ وَٱلْأَعْنَاقِ
ayahs.sahih: [He said], "Return them to me," and set about striking [their] legs and necks.
ayahs.clear: Bring them back to me.” And he began caressing their legs and necks.
ayahs.kemenag: "Bawalah kuda-kuda itu kembali kepadaku". Lalu ia potong kaki dan leher kuda itu.

ayahs.arabic: وَلَقَدْ فَتَنَّا سُلَيْمَٰنَ وَأَلْقَيْنَا عَلَىٰ كُرْسِيِّهِۦ جَسَدًۭا ثُمَّ أَنَابَ
ayahs.sahih: And We certainly tried Solomon and placed on his throne a body; then he returned.
ayahs.clear: We tested Solomon, and placed a body on his throne; then he repented.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan sesungguhnya Kami telah menguji Sulaiman dan Kami jadikan (dia) tergeletak di atas kursinya sebagai tubuh (yang lemah karena sakit), kemudian ia bertaubat.

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ ٱغْفِرْ لِى وَهَبْ لِى مُلْكًۭا لَّا يَنۢبَغِى لِأَحَدٍۢ مِّنۢ بَعْدِىٓ ۖ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلْوَهَّابُ
ayahs.sahih: He said, "My Lord, forgive me and grant me a kingdom such as will not belong to anyone after me. Indeed, You are the Bestower."
ayahs.clear: He said, “My Lord, forgive me, and grant me a kingdom never to be attained by anyone after me. You are the Giver.”
ayahs.kemenag: Ia berkata: "Ya Tuhanku, ampunilah aku dan anugerahkanlah kepadaku kerajaan yang tidak dimiliki oleh seorang juapun sesudahku, sesungguhnya Engkaulah Yang Maha Pemberi".

ayahs.arabic: فَسَخَّرْنَا لَهُ ٱلرِّيحَ تَجْرِى بِأَمْرِهِۦ رُخَآءً حَيْثُ أَصَابَ
ayahs.sahih: So We subjected to him the wind blowing by his command, gently, wherever he directed,
ayahs.clear: So We placed the wind at his service, blowing gently by his command, wherever he directed.
ayahs.kemenag: Kemudian Kami tundukkan kepadanya angin yang berhembus dengan baik menurut ke mana saja yang dikehendakinya,

ayahs.arabic: وَٱلشَّيَٰطِينَ كُلَّ بَنَّآءٍۢ وَغَوَّاصٍۢ
ayahs.sahih: And [also] the devils [of jinn] - every builder and diver
ayahs.clear: And the demons—every builder and diver.
ayahs.kemenag: dan (Kami tundukkan pula kepadanya) syaitan-syaitan semuanya ahli bangunan dan penyelam,

ayahs.arabic: وَءَاخَرِينَ مُقَرَّنِينَ فِى ٱلْأَصْفَادِ
ayahs.sahih: And others bound together in shackles.
ayahs.clear: And others fettered in chains.
ayahs.kemenag: dan syaitan yang lain yang terikat dalam belenggu.

ayahs.arabic: هَٰذَا عَطَآؤُنَا فَٱمْنُنْ أَوْ أَمْسِكْ بِغَيْرِ حِسَابٍۢ
ayahs.sahih: [We said], "This is Our gift, so grant or withhold without account."
ayahs.clear: “This is Our gift; so give generously, or withhold; without account.”
ayahs.kemenag: Inilah anugerah Kami; maka berikanlah (kepada orang lain) atau tahanlah (untuk dirimu sendiri) dengan tiada pertanggungan jawab.

ayahs.arabic: وَإِنَّ لَهُۥ عِندَنَا لَزُلْفَىٰ وَحُسْنَ مَـَٔابٍۢ
ayahs.sahih: And indeed, for him is nearness to Us and a good place of return.
ayahs.clear: For him is nearness to Us, and a beautiful resort.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan sesungguhnya dia mempunyai kedudukan yang dekat pada sisi Kami dan tempat kembali yang baik.

ayahs.arabic: وَٱذْكُرْ عَبْدَنَآ أَيُّوبَ إِذْ نَادَىٰ رَبَّهُۥٓ أَنِّى مَسَّنِىَ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنُ بِنُصْبٍۢ وَعَذَابٍ
ayahs.sahih: And remember Our servant Job, when he called to his Lord, "Indeed, Satan has touched me with hardship and torment."
ayahs.clear: And mention Our servant Job, when he called out to his Lord, “Satan has afflicted me with hardship and pain.”
ayahs.kemenag: Dan ingatlah akan hamba Kami Ayyub ketika ia menyeru Tuhan-nya: "Sesungguhnya aku diganggu syaitan dengan kepayahan dan siksaan".

ayahs.arabic: ٱرْكُضْ بِرِجْلِكَ ۖ هَٰذَا مُغْتَسَلٌۢ بَارِدٌۭ وَشَرَابٌۭ
ayahs.sahih: [So he was told], "Strike [the ground] with your foot; this is a [spring for] a cool bath and drink."
ayahs.clear: “Stamp with your foot—here is cool water to wash with, and to drink.”
ayahs.kemenag: (Allah berfirman): "Hantamkanlah kakimu; inilah air yang sejuk untuk mandi dan untuk minum".

ayahs.arabic: وَوَهَبْنَا لَهُۥٓ أَهْلَهُۥ وَمِثْلَهُم مَّعَهُمْ رَحْمَةًۭ مِّنَّا وَذِكْرَىٰ لِأُو۟لِى ٱلْأَلْبَٰبِ
ayahs.sahih: And We granted him his family and a like [number] with them as mercy from Us and a reminder for those of understanding.
ayahs.clear: And We restored his family for him, and their like with them; as a mercy from Us, and a lesson for those who possess insight.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan Kami anugerahi dia (dengan mengumpulkan kembali) keluarganya dan (Kami tambahkan) kepada mereka sebanyak mereka pula sebagai rahmat dari Kami dan pelajaran bagi orang-orang yang mempunyai fikiran.

ayahs.arabic: وَخُذْ بِيَدِكَ ضِغْثًۭا فَٱضْرِب بِّهِۦ وَلَا تَحْنَثْ ۗ إِنَّا وَجَدْنَٰهُ صَابِرًۭا ۚ نِّعْمَ ٱلْعَبْدُ ۖ إِنَّهُۥٓ أَوَّابٌۭ
ayahs.sahih: [We said], "And take in your hand a bunch [of grass] and strike with it and do not break your oath." Indeed, We found him patient, an excellent servant. Indeed, he was one repeatedly turning back [to Allah].
ayahs.clear: “Take with your hand a bundle, and strike with it, and do not break your oath.” We found him patient. What an excellent servant! He was obedient.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan ambillah dengan tanganmu seikat (rumput), maka pukullah dengan itu dan janganlah kamu melanggar sumpah. Sesungguhnya Kami dapati dia (Ayyub) seorang yang sabar. Dialah sebaik-baik hamba. Sesungguhnya dia amat taat (kepada Tuhan-nya).

ayahs.arabic: وَٱذْكُرْ عِبَٰدَنَآ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ وَإِسْحَٰقَ وَيَعْقُوبَ أُو۟لِى ٱلْأَيْدِى وَٱلْأَبْصَٰرِ
ayahs.sahih: And remember Our servants, Abraham, Isaac and Jacob - those of strength and [religious] vision.
ayahs.clear: And mention Our servants Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob—endowed with ability and vision.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan ingatlah hamba-hamba Kami: Ibrahim, Ishaq dan Ya'qub yang mempunyai perbuatan-perbuatan yang besar dan ilmu-ilmu yang tinggi.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّآ أَخْلَصْنَٰهُم بِخَالِصَةٍۢ ذِكْرَى ٱلدَّارِ
ayahs.sahih: Indeed, We chose them for an exclusive quality: remembrance of the home [of the Hereafter].
ayahs.clear: We distinguished them with a distinct quality: the remembrance of the Home.
ayahs.kemenag: Sesungguhnya Kami telah mensucikan mereka dengan (menganugerahkan kepada mereka) akhlak yang tinggi yaitu selalu mengingatkan (manusia) kepada negeri akhirat.

ayahs.arabic: وَإِنَّهُمْ عِندَنَا لَمِنَ ٱلْمُصْطَفَيْنَ ٱلْأَخْيَارِ
ayahs.sahih: And indeed they are, to Us, among the chosen and outstanding.
ayahs.clear: To Us they are among the chosen, the outstanding.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan sesungguhnya mereka pada sisi Kami benar-benar termasuk orang-orang pilihan yang paling baik.

ayahs.arabic: وَٱذْكُرْ إِسْمَٰعِيلَ وَٱلْيَسَعَ وَذَا ٱلْكِفْلِ ۖ وَكُلٌّۭ مِّنَ ٱلْأَخْيَارِ
ayahs.sahih: And remember Ishmael, Elisha and Dhul-Kifl, and all are among the outstanding.
ayahs.clear: And mention Ishmael, Elisha, and Ezekiel; all are among the outstanding.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan ingatlah akan Ismail, Ilyasa' dan Zulkifli. Semuanya termasuk orang-orang yang paling baik.

ayahs.arabic: هَٰذَا ذِكْرٌۭ ۚ وَإِنَّ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ لَحُسْنَ مَـَٔابٍۢ
ayahs.sahih: This is a reminder. And indeed, for the righteous is a good place of return
ayahs.clear: This is a reminder. The devout will have a good place of return.
ayahs.kemenag: Ini adalah kehormatan (bagi mereka). Dan sesungguhnya bagi orang-orang yang bertakwa benar-benar (disediakan) tempat kembali yang baik,

ayahs.arabic: جَنَّٰتِ عَدْنٍۢ مُّفَتَّحَةًۭ لَّهُمُ ٱلْأَبْوَٰبُ
ayahs.sahih: Gardens of perpetual residence, whose doors will be opened to them.
ayahs.clear: The Gardens of Eden, with their doors wide-open for them.
ayahs.kemenag: (yaitu) surga 'Adn yang pintu-pintunya terbuka bagi mereka,

ayahs.arabic: مُتَّكِـِٔينَ فِيهَا يَدْعُونَ فِيهَا بِفَٰكِهَةٍۢ كَثِيرَةٍۢ وَشَرَابٍۢ
ayahs.sahih: Reclining within them, they will call therein for abundant fruit and drink.
ayahs.clear: Relaxing therein, and calling for abundant fruit and beverage.
ayahs.kemenag: di dalamnya mereka bertelekan (diatas dipan-dipan) sambil meminta buah-buahan yang banyak dan minuman di surga itu.

ayahs.arabic: ۞ وَعِندَهُمْ قَٰصِرَٰتُ ٱلطَّرْفِ أَتْرَابٌ
ayahs.sahih: And with them will be women limiting [their] glances and of equal age.
ayahs.clear: With them will be attendants with modest gaze, of same age.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan pada sisi mereka (ada bidadari-bidadari) yang tidak liar pandangannya dan sebaya umurnya.

ayahs.arabic: هَٰذَا مَا تُوعَدُونَ لِيَوْمِ ٱلْحِسَابِ
ayahs.sahih: This is what you, [the righteous], are promised for the Day of Account.
ayahs.clear: This is what you are promised for the Day of Account.
ayahs.kemenag: Inilah apa yang dijanjikan kepadamu pada hari berhisab.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَرِزْقُنَا مَا لَهُۥ مِن نَّفَادٍ
ayahs.sahih: Indeed, this is Our provision; for it there is no depletion.
ayahs.clear: Such is Our bounty, inexhaustible.
ayahs.kemenag: Sesungguhnya ini adalah benar-benar rezeki dari Kami yang tiada habis-habisnya.

ayahs.arabic: هَٰذَا ۚ وَإِنَّ لِلطَّٰغِينَ لَشَرَّ مَـَٔابٍۢ
ayahs.sahih: This [is so]. But indeed, for the transgressors is an evil place of return -
ayahs.clear: All This. But the transgressors will have a miserable return.
ayahs.kemenag: Beginilah (keadaan mereka). Dan sesungguhnya bagi orang-orang yang durhaka benar-benar (disediakan) tempat kembali yang buruk,

ayahs.arabic: جَهَنَّمَ يَصْلَوْنَهَا فَبِئْسَ ٱلْمِهَادُ
ayahs.sahih: Hell, which they will [enter to] burn, and wretched is the resting place.
ayahs.clear: Hell; in which they will roast; what a miserable abode!
ayahs.kemenag: (yaitu) neraka Jahannam, yang mereka masuk ke dalamnya; maka amat buruklah Jahannam itu sebagai tempat tinggal.

ayahs.arabic: هَٰذَا فَلْيَذُوقُوهُ حَمِيمٌۭ وَغَسَّاقٌۭ
ayahs.sahih: This - so let them taste it - is scalding water and [foul] purulence.
ayahs.clear: All this. Let them taste it—boiling and bitter cold.
ayahs.kemenag: Inilah (azab neraka), biarlah mereka merasakannya, (minuman mereka) air yang sangat panas dan air yang sangat dingin.

ayahs.arabic: وَءَاخَرُ مِن شَكْلِهِۦٓ أَزْوَٰجٌ
ayahs.sahih: And other [punishments] of its type [in various] kinds.
ayahs.clear: And similar torments of diverse kinds.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan azab yang lain yang serupa itu berbagai macam.

ayahs.arabic: هَٰذَا فَوْجٌۭ مُّقْتَحِمٌۭ مَّعَكُمْ ۖ لَا مَرْحَبًۢا بِهِمْ ۚ إِنَّهُمْ صَالُوا۟ ٱلنَّارِ
ayahs.sahih: [Its inhabitants will say], "This is a company bursting in with you. No welcome for them. Indeed, they will burn in the Fire."
ayahs.clear: “This is a crowd rushing headlong with you.” There is no welcome for them. They will be scorched by the Fire.
ayahs.kemenag: (Dikatakan kepada mereka): "Ini adalah suatu rombongan (pengikut-pengikutmu) yang masuk berdesak-desak bersama kamu (ke neraka)". (Berkata pemimpin-pemimpin mereka yang durhaka): "Tiadalah ucapan selamat datang kepada mereka karena sesungguhnya mereka akan masuk neraka".

ayahs.arabic: قَالُوا۟ بَلْ أَنتُمْ لَا مَرْحَبًۢا بِكُمْ ۖ أَنتُمْ قَدَّمْتُمُوهُ لَنَا ۖ فَبِئْسَ ٱلْقَرَارُ
ayahs.sahih: They will say, "Nor you! No welcome for you. You, [our leaders], brought this upon us, and wretched is the settlement."
ayahs.clear: They will say, “But it is you! There is no welcome for you! It is you who brought it upon us! What a miserable end!”
ayahs.kemenag: Pengikut-pengikut mereka menjawab: "Sebenarnya kamulah. Tiada ucapan selamat datang bagimu, karena kamulah yang menjerumuskan kami ke dalam azab, maka amat buruklah Jahannam itu sebagai tempat menetap".

ayahs.arabic: قَالُوا۟ رَبَّنَا مَن قَدَّمَ لَنَا هَٰذَا فَزِدْهُ عَذَابًۭا ضِعْفًۭا فِى ٱلنَّارِ
ayahs.sahih: They will say, "Our Lord, whoever brought this upon us - increase for him double punishment in the Fire."
ayahs.clear: They will say, “Our Lord, whoever brought this upon us, give him double torment in the Fire.”
ayahs.kemenag: Mereka berkata (lagi): "Ya Tuhan kami; barang siapa yang menjerumuskan kami ke dalam azab ini maka tambahkanlah azab kepadanya dengan berlipat ganda di dalam neraka".

ayahs.arabic: وَقَالُوا۟ مَا لَنَا لَا نَرَىٰ رِجَالًۭا كُنَّا نَعُدُّهُم مِّنَ ٱلْأَشْرَارِ
ayahs.sahih: And they will say, "Why do we not see men whom we used to count among the worst?
ayahs.clear: And they will say, “What is it with us that we do not see men we used to count among the wicked?
ayahs.kemenag: Dan (orang-orang durhaka) berkata: "Mengapa kami tidak melihat orang-orang yang dahulu (di dunia) kami anggap sebagai orang-orang yang jahat (hina).

ayahs.arabic: أَتَّخَذْنَٰهُمْ سِخْرِيًّا أَمْ زَاغَتْ عَنْهُمُ ٱلْأَبْصَٰرُ
ayahs.sahih: Is it [because] we took them in ridicule, or has [our] vision turned away from them?"
ayahs.clear: Did we take them for mockery, or have our eyes swerved from them?
ayahs.kemenag: Apakah kami dahulu menjadikan mereka olok-olokan, ataukah karena mata kami tidak melihat mereka?"

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ ذَٰلِكَ لَحَقٌّۭ تَخَاصُمُ أَهْلِ ٱلنَّارِ
ayahs.sahih: Indeed, that is truth - the quarreling of the people of the Fire.
ayahs.clear: This is certainly true—the feuding of the people of the Fire.
ayahs.kemenag: Sesungguhnya yang demikian itu pasti terjadi, (yaitu) pertengkaran penghuni neraka.

ayahs.arabic: قُلْ إِنَّمَآ أَنَا۠ مُنذِرٌۭ ۖ وَمَا مِنْ إِلَٰهٍ إِلَّا ٱللَّهُ ٱلْوَٰحِدُ ٱلْقَهَّارُ
ayahs.sahih: Say, [O Muhammad], "I am only a warner, and there is not any deity except Allah, the One, the Prevailing.
ayahs.clear: Say, “I am only a warner, and there is no god except God—the One, the Conqueror.
ayahs.kemenag: Katakanlah (ya Muhammad): "Sesungguhnya aku hanya seorang pemberi peringatan, dan sekali-kali tidak ada Tuhan selain Allah Yang Maha Esa dan Maha Mengalahkan.

ayahs.arabic: رَبُّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْغَفَّٰرُ
ayahs.sahih: Lord of the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them, the Exalted in Might, the Perpetual Forgiver."
ayahs.clear: The Lord of the heavens and the earth, and everything between them; the Mighty, the Forgiver.”
ayahs.kemenag: Tuhan langit dan bumi dan apa yang ada di antara keduanya Yang Maha Perkasa lagi Maha Pengampun.

ayahs.arabic: قُلْ هُوَ نَبَؤٌا۟ عَظِيمٌ
ayahs.sahih: Say, "It is great news
ayahs.clear: Say, “It is a message of great importance.
ayahs.kemenag: Katakanlah: "Berita itu adalah berita yang besar,

ayahs.arabic: أَنتُمْ عَنْهُ مُعْرِضُونَ
ayahs.sahih: From which you turn away.
ayahs.clear: From which you are turning away.
ayahs.kemenag: yang kamu berpaling daripadanya.

ayahs.arabic: مَا كَانَ لِىَ مِنْ عِلْمٍۭ بِٱلْمَلَإِ ٱلْأَعْلَىٰٓ إِذْ يَخْتَصِمُونَ
ayahs.sahih: I had no knowledge of the exalted assembly [of angels] when they were disputing [the creation of Adam].
ayahs.clear: I have no knowledge of the Highest Assembly as they dispute.
ayahs.kemenag: Aku tiada mempunyai pengetahuan sedikitpun tentang al mala'ul a'la (malaikat) itu ketika mereka berbantah-bantahan.

ayahs.arabic: إِن يُوحَىٰٓ إِلَىَّ إِلَّآ أَنَّمَآ أَنَا۠ نَذِيرٌۭ مُّبِينٌ
ayahs.sahih: It has not been revealed to me except that I am a clear warner."
ayahs.clear: It is only revealed to me that I am a clear warner.”
ayahs.kemenag: Tidak diwahyukan kepadaku, melainkan bahwa sesungguhnya aku hanyalah seorang pemberi peringatan yang nyata".

ayahs.arabic: إِذْ قَالَ رَبُّكَ لِلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةِ إِنِّى خَٰلِقٌۢ بَشَرًۭا مِّن طِينٍۢ
ayahs.sahih: [So mention] when your Lord said to the angels, "Indeed, I am going to create a human being from clay.
ayahs.clear: Your Lord said to the angels, “I am creating a human being from clay.
ayahs.kemenag: (Ingatlah) ketika Tuhanmu berfirman kepada malaikat: "Sesungguhnya Aku akan menciptakan manusia dari tanah".

ayahs.arabic: فَإِذَا سَوَّيْتُهُۥ وَنَفَخْتُ فِيهِ مِن رُّوحِى فَقَعُوا۟ لَهُۥ سَٰجِدِينَ
ayahs.sahih: So when I have proportioned him and breathed into him of My [created] soul, then fall down to him in prostration."
ayahs.clear: When I have formed him, and breathed into him of My spirit, fall prostrate before him.
ayahs.kemenag: Maka apabila telah Kusempurnakan kejadiannya dan Kutiupkan kepadanya roh (ciptaan)Ku; maka hendaklah kamu tersungkur dengan bersujud kepadanya".

ayahs.arabic: فَسَجَدَ ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ كُلُّهُمْ أَجْمَعُونَ
ayahs.sahih: So the angels prostrated - all of them entirely.
ayahs.clear: So the angels fell prostrate, all of them.
ayahs.kemenag: Lalu seluruh malaikat-malaikat itu bersujud semuanya,

ayahs.arabic: إِلَّآ إِبْلِيسَ ٱسْتَكْبَرَ وَكَانَ مِنَ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ
ayahs.sahih: Except Iblees; he was arrogant and became among the disbelievers.
ayahs.clear: Except for Satan. He was too proud, and one of the faithless.
ayahs.kemenag: kecuali iblis; dia menyombongkan diri dan adalah dia termasuk orang-orang yang kafir.

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ يَٰٓإِبْلِيسُ مَا مَنَعَكَ أَن تَسْجُدَ لِمَا خَلَقْتُ بِيَدَىَّ ۖ أَسْتَكْبَرْتَ أَمْ كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلْعَالِينَ
ayahs.sahih: [Allah] said, "O Iblees, what prevented you from prostrating to that which I created with My hands? Were you arrogant [then], or were you [already] among the haughty?"
ayahs.clear: He said, “O Satan, what prevented you from prostrating before what I created with My Own hands? Are you too proud, or were you one of the exalted?”
ayahs.kemenag: Allah berfirman: "Hai iblis, apakah yang menghalangi kamu sujud kepada yang telah Ku-ciptakan dengan kedua tangan-Ku. Apakah kamu menyombongkan diri ataukah kamu (merasa) termasuk orang-orang yang (lebih) tinggi?".

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ أَنَا۠ خَيْرٌۭ مِّنْهُ ۖ خَلَقْتَنِى مِن نَّارٍۢ وَخَلَقْتَهُۥ مِن طِينٍۢ
ayahs.sahih: He said, "I am better than him. You created me from fire and created him from clay."
ayahs.clear: He said, “I am better than he; You created me from fire, and You created him from clay.”
ayahs.kemenag: Iblis berkata: "Aku lebih baik daripadanya, karena Engkau ciptakan aku dari api, sedangkan dia Engkau ciptakan dari tanah".

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ فَٱخْرُجْ مِنْهَا فَإِنَّكَ رَجِيمٌۭ
ayahs.sahih: [Allah] said, "Then get out of Paradise, for indeed, you are expelled.
ayahs.clear: He said, “Then get out of here! You are an outcast!
ayahs.kemenag: Allah berfirman: "Maka keluarlah kamu dari surga; sesungguhnya kamu adalah orang yang terkutuk,

ayahs.arabic: وَإِنَّ عَلَيْكَ لَعْنَتِىٓ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلدِّينِ
ayahs.sahih: And indeed, upon you is My curse until the Day of Recompense."
ayahs.clear: And My curse will be upon you until the Day of Judgment.”
ayahs.kemenag: Sesungguhnya kutukan-Ku tetap atasmu sampai hari pembalasan".

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ فَأَنظِرْنِىٓ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ يُبْعَثُونَ
ayahs.sahih: He said, "My Lord, then reprieve me until the Day they are resurrected."
ayahs.clear: He said, “Lord, defer me until the Day they are resurrected.”
ayahs.kemenag: Iblis berkata: "Ya Tuhanku, beri tangguhlah aku sampai hari mereka dibangkitkan".

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ فَإِنَّكَ مِنَ ٱلْمُنظَرِينَ
ayahs.sahih: [Allah] said, "So indeed, you are of those reprieved
ayahs.clear: He said, “You are one of those deferred.
ayahs.kemenag: Allah berfirman: "Sesungguhnya kamu termasuk orang-orang yang diberi tangguh,

ayahs.arabic: إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلْوَقْتِ ٱلْمَعْلُومِ
ayahs.sahih: Until the Day of the time well-known."
ayahs.clear: Until the Day of the Time Appointed.”
ayahs.kemenag: sampai kepada hari yang telah ditentukan waktunya (hari Kiamat)".

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ فَبِعِزَّتِكَ لَأُغْوِيَنَّهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
ayahs.sahih: [Iblees] said, "By your might, I will surely mislead them all
ayahs.clear: He said, “By Your majesty, I will seduce them all.
ayahs.kemenag: Iblis menjawab: "Demi kekuasaan Engkau aku akan menyesatkan mereka semuanya,

ayahs.arabic: إِلَّا عِبَادَكَ مِنْهُمُ ٱلْمُخْلَصِينَ
ayahs.sahih: Except, among them, Your chosen servants."
ayahs.clear: Except for your loyal servants among them.”
ayahs.kemenag: kecuali hamba-hamba-Mu yang mukhlis di antara mereka.

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ فَٱلْحَقُّ وَٱلْحَقَّ أَقُولُ
ayahs.sahih: [Allah] said, "The truth [is My oath], and the truth I say -
ayahs.clear: He said, “The truth is, and I say the truth.
ayahs.kemenag: Allah berfirman: "Maka yang benar (adalah sumpah-Ku) dan hanya kebenaran itulah yang Ku-katakan".

ayahs.arabic: لَأَمْلَأَنَّ جَهَنَّمَ مِنكَ وَمِمَّن تَبِعَكَ مِنْهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
ayahs.sahih: [That] I will surely fill Hell with you and those of them that follow you all together."
ayahs.clear: I will fill Hell with you, and with every one of them who follows you.”
ayahs.kemenag: Sesungguhnya Aku pasti akan memenuhi neraka Jahannam dengan jenis kamu dan dengan orang-orang yang mengikuti kamu di antara mereka kesemuanya.

ayahs.arabic: قُلْ مَآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍۢ وَمَآ أَنَا۠ مِنَ ٱلْمُتَكَلِّفِينَ
ayahs.sahih: Say, [O Muhammad], "I do not ask you for the Qur'an any payment, and I am not of the pretentious
ayahs.clear: Say, “I ask of you no wage for this, and I am not a pretender.
ayahs.kemenag: Katakanlah (hai Muhammad): "Aku tidak meminta upah sedikitpun padamu atas dakwahku dan bukanlah aku termasuk orang-orang yang mengada-adakan.

ayahs.arabic: إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا ذِكْرٌۭ لِّلْعَٰلَمِينَ
ayahs.sahih: It is but a reminder to the worlds.
ayahs.clear: It is but a reminder to mankind.
ayahs.kemenag: Al Quran ini tidak lain hanyalah peringatan bagi semesta alam.

ayahs.arabic: وَلَتَعْلَمُنَّ نَبَأَهُۥ بَعْدَ حِينٍۭ
ayahs.sahih: And you will surely know [the truth of] its information after a time."
ayahs.clear: And you will know its message after a while.”
ayahs.kemenag: Dan sesungguhnya kamu akan mengetahui (kebenaran) berita Al Quran setelah beberapa waktu lagi.

ayahs.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ تَنزِيلُ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْحَكِيمِ
ayahs.sahih: The revelation of the Qur'an is from Allah, the Exalted in Might, the Wise.
ayahs.clear: The revelation of the Book is from God, the Mighty and Wise.
ayahs.kemenag: Kitab (Al Quran ini) diturunkan oleh Allah Yang Maha Perkasa lagi Maha Bijaksana.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّآ أَنزَلْنَآ إِلَيْكَ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ بِٱلْحَقِّ فَٱعْبُدِ ٱللَّهَ مُخْلِصًۭا لَّهُ ٱلدِّينَ
ayahs.sahih: Indeed, We have sent down to you the Book, [O Muhammad], in truth. So worship Allah, [being] sincere to Him in religion.
ayahs.clear: We sent down to you the Book with the truth, so serve God, devoting your religion to Him.
ayahs.kemenag: Sesunguhnya Kami menurunkan kepadamu Kitab (Al Quran) dengan (membawa) kebenaran. Maka sembahlah Allah dengan memurnikan ketaatan kepada-Nya.

ayahs.arabic: أَلَا لِلَّهِ ٱلدِّينُ ٱلْخَالِصُ ۚ وَٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّخَذُوا۟ مِن دُونِهِۦٓ أَوْلِيَآءَ مَا نَعْبُدُهُمْ إِلَّا لِيُقَرِّبُونَآ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ زُلْفَىٰٓ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَحْكُمُ بَيْنَهُمْ فِى مَا هُمْ فِيهِ يَخْتَلِفُونَ ۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يَهْدِى مَنْ هُوَ كَٰذِبٌۭ كَفَّارٌۭ
ayahs.sahih: Unquestionably, for Allah is the pure religion. And those who take protectors besides Him [say], "We only worship them that they may bring us nearer to Allah in position." Indeed, Allah will judge between them concerning that over which they differ. Indeed, Allah does not guide he who is a liar and [confirmed] disbeliever.
ayahs.clear: Is not to God that sincere faith is due? As for those who take guardians besides Him, “We only worship them that they may bring us nearer to God.” God will judge between them regarding their differences. God does not guide the lying blasphemer.
ayahs.kemenag: Ingatlah, hanya kepunyaan Allah-lah agama yang bersih (dari syirik). Dan orang-orang yang mengambil pelindung selain Allah (berkata): "Kami tidak menyembah mereka melainkan supaya mereka mendekatkan kami kepada Allah dengan sedekat-dekatnya". Sesungguhnya Allah akan memutuskan di antara mereka tentang apa yang mereka berselisih padanya. Sesungguhnya Allah tidak menunjuki orang-orang yang pendusta dan sangat ingkar.

ayahs.arabic: لَّوْ أَرَادَ ٱللَّهُ أَن يَتَّخِذَ وَلَدًۭا لَّٱصْطَفَىٰ مِمَّا يَخْلُقُ مَا يَشَآءُ ۚ سُبْحَٰنَهُۥ ۖ هُوَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْوَٰحِدُ ٱلْقَهَّارُ
ayahs.sahih: If Allah had intended to take a son, He could have chosen from what He creates whatever He willed. Exalted is He; He is Allah, the One, the Prevailing.
ayahs.clear: If God wanted to have a son, He could have selected from His creation at will. Glory be to Him. He is God, the One, the Prevailing.
ayahs.kemenag: Kalau sekiranya Allah hendak mengambil anak, tentu Dia akan memilih apa yang dikehendaki-Nya di antara ciptaan-ciptaan yang telah diciptakan-Nya. Maha Suci Allah. Dialah Allah Yang Maha Esa lagi Maha Mengalahkan.

ayahs.arabic: خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ بِٱلْحَقِّ ۖ يُكَوِّرُ ٱلَّيْلَ عَلَى ٱلنَّهَارِ وَيُكَوِّرُ ٱلنَّهَارَ عَلَى ٱلَّيْلِ ۖ وَسَخَّرَ ٱلشَّمْسَ وَٱلْقَمَرَ ۖ كُلٌّۭ يَجْرِى لِأَجَلٍۢ مُّسَمًّى ۗ أَلَا هُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْغَفَّٰرُ
ayahs.sahih: He created the heavens and earth in truth. He wraps the night over the day and wraps the day over the night and has subjected the sun and the moon, each running [its course] for a specified term. Unquestionably, He is the Exalted in Might, the Perpetual Forgiver.
ayahs.clear: He created the heavens and the earth with reason. He wraps the night around the day, and He wraps the day around the night. And He regulates the sun and the moon, each running along a specific course. He is indeed the Almighty, the Forgiver.
ayahs.kemenag: Dia menciptakan langit dan bumi dengan (tujuan) yang benar; Dia menutupkan malam atas siang dan menutupkan siang atas malam dan menundukkan matahari dan bulan, masing-masing berjalan menurut waktu yang ditentukan. Ingatlah Dialah Yang Maha Perkasa lagi Maha Pengampun.

ayahs.arabic: خَلَقَكُم مِّن نَّفْسٍۢ وَٰحِدَةٍۢ ثُمَّ جَعَلَ مِنْهَا زَوْجَهَا وَأَنزَلَ لَكُم مِّنَ ٱلْأَنْعَٰمِ ثَمَٰنِيَةَ أَزْوَٰجٍۢ ۚ يَخْلُقُكُمْ فِى بُطُونِ أُمَّهَٰتِكُمْ خَلْقًۭا مِّنۢ بَعْدِ خَلْقٍۢ فِى ظُلُمَٰتٍۢ ثَلَٰثٍۢ ۚ ذَٰلِكُمُ ٱللَّهُ رَبُّكُمْ لَهُ ٱلْمُلْكُ ۖ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ۖ فَأَنَّىٰ تُصْرَفُونَ
ayahs.sahih: He created you from one soul. Then He made from it its mate, and He produced for you from the grazing livestock eight mates. He creates you in the wombs of your mothers, creation after creation, within three darknesses. That is Allah, your Lord; to Him belongs dominion. There is no deity except Him, so how are you averted?
ayahs.clear: He created you from one person, then made from it its mate, and brought down livestock for you—eight kinds in pairs. He creates you in the wombs of your mothers, in successive formations, in a triple darkness. Such is God, your Lord. His is the kingdom. There is no god but He. So what made you deviate?
ayahs.kemenag: Dia menciptakan kamu dari seorang diri kemudian Dia jadikan daripadanya isterinya dan Dia menurunkan untuk kamu delapan ekor yang berpasangan dari binatang ternak. Dia menjadikan kamu dalam perut ibumu kejadian demi kejadian dalam tiga kegelapan. Yang (berbuat) demikian itu adalah Allah, Tuhan kamu, Tuhan Yang mempunyai kerajaan. Tidak ada Tuhan selain Dia; maka bagaimana kamu dapat dipalingkan?

ayahs.arabic: إِن تَكْفُرُوا۟ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَنِىٌّ عَنكُمْ ۖ وَلَا يَرْضَىٰ لِعِبَادِهِ ٱلْكُفْرَ ۖ وَإِن تَشْكُرُوا۟ يَرْضَهُ لَكُمْ ۗ وَلَا تَزِرُ وَازِرَةٌۭ وِزْرَ أُخْرَىٰ ۗ ثُمَّ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكُم مَّرْجِعُكُمْ فَيُنَبِّئُكُم بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ عَلِيمٌۢ بِذَاتِ ٱلصُّدُورِ
ayahs.sahih: If you disbelieve - indeed, Allah is Free from need of you. And He does not approve for His servants disbelief. And if you are grateful, He approves it for you; and no bearer of burdens will bear the burden of another. Then to your Lord is your return, and He will inform you about what you used to do. Indeed, He is Knowing of that within the breasts.
ayahs.clear: If you disbelieve, God is Independent of you, yet He does not approve ingratitude on the part of His servants. And if you are thankful, He will approve that in you. No bearer of burden can bear the burden of another. Then to your Lord is your return; and He will inform you of what you used to do. He is aware of what the hearts contain.
ayahs.kemenag: Jika kamu kafir maka sesungguhnya Allah tidak memerlukan (iman)mu dan Dia tidak meridhai kekafiran bagi hamba-Nya; dan jika kamu bersyukur, niscaya Dia meridhai bagimu kesyukuranmu itu; dan seorang yang berdosa tidak akan memikul dosa orang lain. Kemudian kepada Tuhanmulah kembalimu lalu Dia memberitakan kepadamu apa yang telah kamu kerjakan. Sesungguhnya Dia Maha Mengetahui apa yang tersimpan dalam (dada)mu.

ayahs.arabic: ۞ وَإِذَا مَسَّ ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ ضُرٌّۭ دَعَا رَبَّهُۥ مُنِيبًا إِلَيْهِ ثُمَّ إِذَا خَوَّلَهُۥ نِعْمَةًۭ مِّنْهُ نَسِىَ مَا كَانَ يَدْعُوٓا۟ إِلَيْهِ مِن قَبْلُ وَجَعَلَ لِلَّهِ أَندَادًۭا لِّيُضِلَّ عَن سَبِيلِهِۦ ۚ قُلْ تَمَتَّعْ بِكُفْرِكَ قَلِيلًا ۖ إِنَّكَ مِنْ أَصْحَٰبِ ٱلنَّارِ
ayahs.sahih: And when adversity touches man, he calls upon his Lord, turning to Him [alone]; then when He bestows on him a favor from Himself, he forgets Him whom he called upon before, and he attributes to Allah equals to mislead [people] from His way. Say, "Enjoy your disbelief for a little; indeed, you are of the companions of the Fire."
ayahs.clear: When some adversity touches the human being, he prays to his Lord, repenting to Him. But then, when He confers on him a grace of His, he forgets what he was praying for before, and he attributes rivals to God, in order to lead astray from His way. Say, “Enjoy your disbelief for a little while; you will be among the inmates of the Fire.”
ayahs.kemenag: Dan apabila manusia itu ditimpa kemudharatan, dia memohon (pertolongan) kepada Tuhannya dengan kembali kepada-Nya; kemudian apabila Tuhan memberikan nikmat-Nya kepadanya lupalah dia akan kemudharatan yang pernah dia berdoa (kepada Allah) untuk (menghilangkannya) sebelum itu, dan dia mengada-adakan sekutu-sekutu bagi Allah untuk menyesatkan (manusia) dari jalan-Nya. Katakanlah: "Bersenang-senanglah dengan kekafiranmu itu sementara waktu; sesungguhnya kamu termasuk penghuni neraka".

ayahs.arabic: أَمَّنْ هُوَ قَٰنِتٌ ءَانَآءَ ٱلَّيْلِ سَاجِدًۭا وَقَآئِمًۭا يَحْذَرُ ٱلْءَاخِرَةَ وَيَرْجُوا۟ رَحْمَةَ رَبِّهِۦ ۗ قُلْ هَلْ يَسْتَوِى ٱلَّذِينَ يَعْلَمُونَ وَٱلَّذِينَ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ ۗ إِنَّمَا يَتَذَكَّرُ أُو۟لُوا۟ ٱلْأَلْبَٰبِ
ayahs.sahih: Is one who is devoutly obedient during periods of the night, prostrating and standing [in prayer], fearing the Hereafter and hoping for the mercy of his Lord, [like one who does not]? Say, "Are those who know equal to those who do not know?" Only they will remember [who are] people of understanding.
ayahs.clear: Is he who worships devoutly during the watches of the night, prostrating himself and standing up, mindful of the Hereafter, and placing his hope in the mercy of his Lord? Say, “Are those who know and those who do not know equal?” Only those possessed of reason will remember.
ayahs.kemenag: (Apakah kamu hai orang musyrik yang lebih beruntung) ataukah orang yang beribadat di waktu-waktu malam dengan sujud dan berdiri, sedang ia takut kepada (azab) akhirat dan mengharapkan rahmat Tuhannya? Katakanlah: "Adakah sama orang-orang yang mengetahui dengan orang-orang yang tidak mengetahui?" Sesungguhnya orang yang berakallah yang dapat menerima pelajaran.

ayahs.arabic: قُلْ يَٰعِبَادِ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ٱتَّقُوا۟ رَبَّكُمْ ۚ لِلَّذِينَ أَحْسَنُوا۟ فِى هَٰذِهِ ٱلدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةٌۭ ۗ وَأَرْضُ ٱللَّهِ وَٰسِعَةٌ ۗ إِنَّمَا يُوَفَّى ٱلصَّٰبِرُونَ أَجْرَهُم بِغَيْرِ حِسَابٍۢ
ayahs.sahih: Say, "O My servants who have believed, fear your Lord. For those who do good in this world is good, and the earth of Allah is spacious. Indeed, the patient will be given their reward without account."
ayahs.clear: Say, “O My devotees who have believed, keep your duty to your Lord. For those who do good in this world, is goodness. And God’s earth is vast. The steadfast will be paid their wages in full, without reckoning.”
ayahs.kemenag: Katakanlah: "Hai hamba-hamba-Ku yang beriman. bertakwalah kepada Tuhanmu". Orang-orang yang berbuat baik di dunia ini memperoleh kebaikan. Dan bumi Allah itu adalah luas. Sesungguhnya hanya orang-orang yang bersabarlah Yang dicukupkan pahala mereka tanpa batas.

ayahs.arabic: قُلْ إِنِّىٓ أُمِرْتُ أَنْ أَعْبُدَ ٱللَّهَ مُخْلِصًۭا لَّهُ ٱلدِّينَ
ayahs.sahih: Say, [O Muhammad], "Indeed, I have been commanded to worship Allah, [being] sincere to Him in religion.
ayahs.clear: Say, “I was commanded to serve God, devoting my religion exclusively to Him.
ayahs.kemenag: Katakanlah: "Sesungguhnya aku diperintahkan supaya menyembah Allah dengan memurnikan ketaatan kepada-Nya dalam (menjalankan) agama.

ayahs.arabic: وَأُمِرْتُ لِأَنْ أَكُونَ أَوَّلَ ٱلْمُسْلِمِينَ
ayahs.sahih: And I have been commanded to be the first [among you] of the Muslims."
ayahs.clear: And I was commanded to be the first of those who submit.”
ayahs.kemenag: Dan aku diperintahkan supaya menjadi orang yang pertama-tama berserah diri".

ayahs.arabic: قُلْ إِنِّىٓ أَخَافُ إِنْ عَصَيْتُ رَبِّى عَذَابَ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍۢ
ayahs.sahih: Say, "Indeed I fear, if I should disobey my Lord, the punishment of a tremendous Day."
ayahs.clear: Say, “I fear, if I disobeyed my Lord, the punishment of a horrendous Day.”
ayahs.kemenag: Katakanlah: "Sesungguhnya aku takut akan siksaan hari yang besar jika aku durhaka kepada Tuhanku".

ayahs.arabic: قُلِ ٱللَّهَ أَعْبُدُ مُخْلِصًۭا لَّهُۥ دِينِى
ayahs.sahih: Say, "Allah [alone] do I worship, sincere to Him in my religion,
ayahs.clear: Say, “It is God I worship, sincere in my faith in Him.”
ayahs.kemenag: Katakanlah: "Hanya Allah saja Yang aku sembah dengan memurnikan ketaatan kepada-Nya dalam (menjalankan) agamaku".

ayahs.arabic: فَٱعْبُدُوا۟ مَا شِئْتُم مِّن دُونِهِۦ ۗ قُلْ إِنَّ ٱلْخَٰسِرِينَ ٱلَّذِينَ خَسِرُوٓا۟ أَنفُسَهُمْ وَأَهْلِيهِمْ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ ۗ أَلَا ذَٰلِكَ هُوَ ٱلْخُسْرَانُ ٱلْمُبِينُ
ayahs.sahih: So worship what you will besides Him." Say, "Indeed, the losers are the ones who will lose themselves and their families on the Day of Resurrection. Unquestionably, that is the manifest loss."
ayahs.clear: “But you can worship whatever you wish besides Him.” Say, “The losers are those who lose their souls and their people on the Day of Resurrection.” That is indeed the obvious loss.
ayahs.kemenag: Maka sembahlah olehmu (hai orang-orang musyrik) apa yang kamu kehendaki selain Dia. Katakanlah: "Sesungguhnya orang-orang yang rugi ialah orang-orang yang merugikan diri mereka sendiri dan keluarganya pada hari kiamat". Ingatlah yang demikian itu adalah kerugian yang nyata.

ayahs.arabic: لَهُم مِّن فَوْقِهِمْ ظُلَلٌۭ مِّنَ ٱلنَّارِ وَمِن تَحْتِهِمْ ظُلَلٌۭ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ يُخَوِّفُ ٱللَّهُ بِهِۦ عِبَادَهُۥ ۚ يَٰعِبَادِ فَٱتَّقُونِ
ayahs.sahih: They will have canopies of fire above them and below them, canopies. By that Allah threatens His servants. O My servants, then fear Me.
ayahs.clear: They will have layers of Fire above them, and layers beneath them. That is how God strikes fear into His servants—“O My servants! Beware of Me!”
ayahs.kemenag: Bagi mereka lapisan-lapisan dari api di atas mereka dan di bawah merekapun lapisan-lapisan (dari api). Demikianlah Allah mempertakuti hamba-hamba-Nya dengan azab itu. Maka bertakwalah kepada-Ku hai hamba-hamba-Ku.

ayahs.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ ٱجْتَنَبُوا۟ ٱلطَّٰغُوتَ أَن يَعْبُدُوهَا وَأَنَابُوٓا۟ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ لَهُمُ ٱلْبُشْرَىٰ ۚ فَبَشِّرْ عِبَادِ
ayahs.sahih: But those who have avoided Taghut, lest they worship it, and turned back to Allah - for them are good tidings. So give good tidings to My servants
ayahs.clear: As for those who avoid the worship of idols, and devote themselves to God—theirs is the good news. So give good news to My servants.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan orang-orang yang menjauhi thaghut (yaitu) tidak menyembahnya dan kembali kepada Allah, bagi mereka berita gembira; sebab itu sampaikanlah berita itu kepada hamba-hamba-Ku,

ayahs.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ يَسْتَمِعُونَ ٱلْقَوْلَ فَيَتَّبِعُونَ أَحْسَنَهُۥٓ ۚ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ هَدَىٰهُمُ ٱللَّهُ ۖ وَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمْ أُو۟لُوا۟ ٱلْأَلْبَٰبِ
ayahs.sahih: Who listen to speech and follow the best of it. Those are the ones Allah has guided, and those are people of understanding.
ayahs.clear: Those who listen to the Word, and follow the best of it. These are they whom God has guided. These are they who possess intellect.
ayahs.kemenag: yang mendengarkan perkataan lalu mengikuti apa yang paling baik di antaranya. Mereka itulah orang-orang yang telah diberi Allah petunjuk dan mereka itulah orang-orang yang mempunyai akal.

ayahs.arabic: أَفَمَنْ حَقَّ عَلَيْهِ كَلِمَةُ ٱلْعَذَابِ أَفَأَنتَ تُنقِذُ مَن فِى ٱلنَّارِ
ayahs.sahih: Then, is one who has deserved the decree of punishment [to be guided]? Then, can you save one who is in the Fire?
ayahs.clear: What about someone who has deserved the sentence of punishment? Is it you who can save those in the Fire?
ayahs.kemenag: Apakah (kamu hendak merubah nasib) orang-orang yang telah pasti ketentuan azab atasnya? Apakah kamu akan menyelamatkan orang yang berada dalam api neraka?

ayahs.arabic: لَٰكِنِ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّقَوْا۟ رَبَّهُمْ لَهُمْ غُرَفٌۭ مِّن فَوْقِهَا غُرَفٌۭ مَّبْنِيَّةٌۭ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَٰرُ ۖ وَعْدَ ٱللَّهِ ۖ لَا يُخْلِفُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْمِيعَادَ
ayahs.sahih: But those who have feared their Lord - for them are chambers, above them chambers built high, beneath which rivers flow. [This is] the promise of Allah. Allah does not fail in [His] promise.
ayahs.clear: But those who fear their Lord will have mansions upon mansions, built high, with streams flowing beneath them. The promise of God; and God never breaks a promise.
ayahs.kemenag: Tetapi orang-orang yang bertakwa kepada Tuhannya mereka mendapat tempat-tempat yang tinggi, di atasnya dibangun pula tempat-tempat yang tinggi yang di bawahnya mengalir sungai-sungai. Allah telah berjanji dengan sebenar-benarnya. Allah tidak akan memungkiri janji-Nya.

ayahs.arabic: أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ أَنزَلَ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءًۭ فَسَلَكَهُۥ يَنَٰبِيعَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ثُمَّ يُخْرِجُ بِهِۦ زَرْعًۭا مُّخْتَلِفًا أَلْوَٰنُهُۥ ثُمَّ يَهِيجُ فَتَرَىٰهُ مُصْفَرًّۭا ثُمَّ يَجْعَلُهُۥ حُطَٰمًا ۚ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَذِكْرَىٰ لِأُو۟لِى ٱلْأَلْبَٰبِ
ayahs.sahih: Do you not see that Allah sends down rain from the sky and makes it flow as springs [and rivers] in the earth; then He produces thereby crops of varying colors; then they dry and you see them turned yellow; then He makes them [scattered] debris. Indeed in that is a reminder for those of understanding.
ayahs.clear: Have you not considered how God sends down water from the sky, then He makes it flow into underground wells, then He produces with it plants of various colors, then they wither and you see them yellowing, then He turns them into debris? Surely in this is a reminder for those with understanding.
ayahs.kemenag: Apakah kamu tidak memperhatikan, bahwa sesungguhnya Allah menurunkan air dari langit, maka diaturnya menjadi sumber-sumber air di bumi kemudian ditumbuhkan-Nya dengan air itu tanam-tanaman yang bermacam-macam warnanya, lalu menjadi kering lalu kamu melihatnya kekuning-kuningan, kemudian dijadikan-Nya hancur berderai-derai. Sesungguhnya pada yang demikian itu benar-benar terdapat pelajaran bagi orang-orang yang mempunyai akal.

ayahs.arabic: أَفَمَن شَرَحَ ٱللَّهُ صَدْرَهُۥ لِلْإِسْلَٰمِ فَهُوَ عَلَىٰ نُورٍۢ مِّن رَّبِّهِۦ ۚ فَوَيْلٌۭ لِّلْقَٰسِيَةِ قُلُوبُهُم مِّن ذِكْرِ ٱللَّهِ ۚ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ فِى ضَلَٰلٍۢ مُّبِينٍ
ayahs.sahih: So is one whose breast Allah has expanded to [accept] Islam and he is upon a light from his Lord [like one whose heart rejects it]? Then woe to those whose hearts are hardened against the remembrance of Allah. Those are in manifest error.
ayahs.clear: What about someone whose heart God has opened to Islam, so that he follows a light from His Lord? Woe to those whose hearts are hardened against the mention of God. Those are in manifest error.
ayahs.kemenag: Maka apakah orang-orang yang dibukakan Allah hatinya untuk (menerima) agama Islam lalu ia mendapat cahaya dari Tuhannya (sama dengan orang yang membatu hatinya)? Maka kecelakaan yang besarlah bagi mereka yang telah membatu hatinya untuk mengingat Allah. Mereka itu dalam kesesatan yang nyata.

ayahs.arabic: ٱللَّهُ نَزَّلَ أَحْسَنَ ٱلْحَدِيثِ كِتَٰبًۭا مُّتَشَٰبِهًۭا مَّثَانِىَ تَقْشَعِرُّ مِنْهُ جُلُودُ ٱلَّذِينَ يَخْشَوْنَ رَبَّهُمْ ثُمَّ تَلِينُ جُلُودُهُمْ وَقُلُوبُهُمْ إِلَىٰ ذِكْرِ ٱللَّهِ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ هُدَى ٱللَّهِ يَهْدِى بِهِۦ مَن يَشَآءُ ۚ وَمَن يُضْلِلِ ٱللَّهُ فَمَا لَهُۥ مِنْ هَادٍ
ayahs.sahih: Allah has sent down the best statement: a consistent Book wherein is reiteration. The skins shiver therefrom of those who fear their Lord; then their skins and their hearts relax at the remembrance of Allah. That is the guidance of Allah by which He guides whom He wills. And one whom Allah leaves astray - for him there is no guide.
ayahs.clear: God has sent down the best of narrations: a Scripture consistent and paired. The skins of those who reverence their Lord shiver from it, then their skins and their hearts soften up to the remembrance of God. Such is God’s guidance; He guides with it whomever He wills. But whomever God leaves astray, for him there is no guide.
ayahs.kemenag: Allah telah menurunkan perkataan yang paling baik (yaitu) Al Quran yang serupa (mutu ayat-ayatnya) lagi berulang-ulang, gemetar karenanya kulit orang-orang yang takut kepada Tuhannya, kemudian menjadi tenang kulit dan hati mereka di waktu mengingat Allah. Itulah petunjuk Allah, dengan kitab itu Dia menunjuki siapa yang dikehendaki-Nya. Dan barangsiapa yang disesatkan Allah, niscaya tak ada baginya seorang pemimpinpun.

ayahs.arabic: أَفَمَن يَتَّقِى بِوَجْهِهِۦ سُوٓءَ ٱلْعَذَابِ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ ۚ وَقِيلَ لِلظَّٰلِمِينَ ذُوقُوا۟ مَا كُنتُمْ تَكْسِبُونَ
ayahs.sahih: Then is he who will shield with his face the worst of the punishment on the Day of Resurrection [like one secure from it]? And it will be said to the wrongdoers, "Taste what you used to earn."
ayahs.clear: What about someone who covers his face against the terrible misery of the Day of Resurrection? To the evildoers it will be said, “Taste what you used to earn.”
ayahs.kemenag: Maka apakah orang-orang yang menoleh dengan mukanya menghindari azab yang buruk pada hari kiamat (sama dengan orang mukmin yang tidak kena azab)? Dan dikatakan kepada orang-orang yang zalim: "Rasakanlah olehmu balasan apa yang telah kamu kerjakan".

ayahs.arabic: كَذَّبَ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ فَأَتَىٰهُمُ ٱلْعَذَابُ مِنْ حَيْثُ لَا يَشْعُرُونَ
ayahs.sahih: Those before them denied, and punishment came upon them from where they did not perceive.
ayahs.clear: Those before them also denied the truth, so the penalty came upon them from where they did not perceive.
ayahs.kemenag: Orang-orang yang sebelum mereka telah mendustakan (rasul-rasul), maka datanglah kepada mereka azab dari arah yang tidak mereka sangka.

ayahs.arabic: فَأَذَاقَهُمُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْخِزْىَ فِى ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا ۖ وَلَعَذَابُ ٱلْءَاخِرَةِ أَكْبَرُ ۚ لَوْ كَانُوا۟ يَعْلَمُونَ
ayahs.sahih: So Allah made them taste disgrace in worldly life. But the punishment of the Hereafter is greater, if they only knew.
ayahs.clear: God made them taste disgrace in the present life, but the punishment of the Hereafter is worse, if they only knew.
ayahs.kemenag: Maka Allah merasakan kepada mereka kehinaan pada kehidupan dunia. Dan sesungguhnya azab pada hari akhirat lebih besar kalau mereka mengetahui.

ayahs.arabic: وَلَقَدْ ضَرَبْنَا لِلنَّاسِ فِى هَٰذَا ٱلْقُرْءَانِ مِن كُلِّ مَثَلٍۢ لَّعَلَّهُمْ يَتَذَكَّرُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And We have certainly presented for the people in this Qur'an from every [kind of] example - that they might remember.
ayahs.clear: We have cited in this Quran for mankind every ideal, that they may take heed.
ayahs.kemenag: Sesungguhnya telah Kami buatkan bagi manusia dalam Al Quran ini setiap macam perumpamaan supaya mereka dapat pelajaran.

ayahs.arabic: قُرْءَانًا عَرَبِيًّا غَيْرَ ذِى عِوَجٍۢ لَّعَلَّهُمْ يَتَّقُونَ
ayahs.sahih: [It is] an Arabic Qur'an, without any deviance that they might become righteous.
ayahs.clear: An Arabic Quran, without any defect, so they may become righteous.
ayahs.kemenag: (Ialah) Al Quran dalam bahasa Arab yang tidak ada kebengkokan (di dalamnya) supaya mereka bertakwa.

ayahs.arabic: ضَرَبَ ٱللَّهُ مَثَلًۭا رَّجُلًۭا فِيهِ شُرَكَآءُ مُتَشَٰكِسُونَ وَرَجُلًۭا سَلَمًۭا لِّرَجُلٍ هَلْ يَسْتَوِيَانِ مَثَلًا ۚ ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ ۚ بَلْ أَكْثَرُهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
ayahs.sahih: Allah presents an example: a slave owned by quarreling partners and another belonging exclusively to one man - are they equal in comparison? Praise be to Allah! But most of them do not know.
ayahs.clear: God cites the example of a man shared by partners at odds, and a man belonging exclusively to one man. Are they equal in status? Praise be to God, but most of them do not know.
ayahs.kemenag: Allah membuat perumpamaan (yaitu) seorang laki-laki (budak) yang dimiliki oleh beberapa orang yang berserikat yang dalam perselisihan dan seorang budak yang menjadi milik penuh dari seorang laki-laki (saja); Adakah kedua budak itu sama halnya? Segala puji bagi Allah tetapi kebanyakan mereka tidak mengetahui.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّكَ مَيِّتٌۭ وَإِنَّهُم مَّيِّتُونَ
ayahs.sahih: Indeed, you are to die, and indeed, they are to die.
ayahs.clear: You will die, and they will die.
ayahs.kemenag: Sesungguhnya kamu akan mati dan sesungguhnya mereka akan mati (pula).

ayahs.arabic: ثُمَّ إِنَّكُمْ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ عِندَ رَبِّكُمْ تَخْتَصِمُونَ
ayahs.sahih: Then indeed you, on the Day of Resurrection, before your Lord, will dispute.
ayahs.clear: Then, on the Day of Resurrection, you will be quarrelling before your Lord.
ayahs.kemenag: Kemudian sesungguhnya kamu pada hari kiamat akan berbantah-bantah di hadapan Tuhanmu.

ayahs.arabic: ۞ فَمَنْ أَظْلَمُ مِمَّن كَذَبَ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ وَكَذَّبَ بِٱلصِّدْقِ إِذْ جَآءَهُۥٓ ۚ أَلَيْسَ فِى جَهَنَّمَ مَثْوًۭى لِّلْكَٰفِرِينَ
ayahs.sahih: So who is more unjust than one who lies about Allah and denies the truth when it has come to him? Is there not in Hell a residence for the disbelievers?
ayahs.clear: Who is more evil than he who lies about God, and denies the truth when it has come to him? Is there not in Hell room for the ungrateful?
ayahs.kemenag: Maka siapakah yang lebih zalim daripada orang yang membuat-buat dusta terhadap Allah dan mendustakan kebenaran ketika datang kepadanya? Bukankah di neraka Jahannam tersedia tempat tinggal bagi orang-orang yang kafir?

ayahs.arabic: وَٱلَّذِى جَآءَ بِٱلصِّدْقِ وَصَدَّقَ بِهِۦٓ ۙ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْمُتَّقُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And the one who has brought the truth and [they who] believed in it - those are the righteous.
ayahs.clear: But he who promotes the truth, and testifies to it—these are the righteous.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan orang yang membawa kebenaran (Muhammad) dan membenarkannya, mereka itulah orang-orang yang bertakwa.

ayahs.arabic: لَهُم مَّا يَشَآءُونَ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ جَزَآءُ ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
ayahs.sahih: They will have whatever they desire with their Lord. That is the reward of the doers of good -
ayahs.clear: They will have whatever they please with their Lord. Such is the reward for the virtuous.
ayahs.kemenag: Mereka memperoleh apa yang mereka kehendaki pada sisi Tuhan mereka. Demikianlah balasan orang-orang yang berbuat baik,

ayahs.arabic: لِيُكَفِّرَ ٱللَّهُ عَنْهُمْ أَسْوَأَ ٱلَّذِى عَمِلُوا۟ وَيَجْزِيَهُمْ أَجْرَهُم بِأَحْسَنِ ٱلَّذِى كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ
ayahs.sahih: That Allah may remove from them the worst of what they did and reward them their due for the best of what they used to do.
ayahs.clear: God will acquit them of the worst of their deeds, and will reward them according to the best of what they used to do.
ayahs.kemenag: agar Allah akan menutupi (mengampuni) bagi mereka perbuatan yang paling buruk yang mereka kerjakan dan membalas mereka dengan upah yang lebih baik dari apa yang telah mereka kerjakan.

ayahs.arabic: أَلَيْسَ ٱللَّهُ بِكَافٍ عَبْدَهُۥ ۖ وَيُخَوِّفُونَكَ بِٱلَّذِينَ مِن دُونِهِۦ ۚ وَمَن يُضْلِلِ ٱللَّهُ فَمَا لَهُۥ مِنْ هَادٍۢ
ayahs.sahih: Is not Allah sufficient for His Servant [Prophet Muhammad]? And [yet], they threaten you with those [they worship] other than Him. And whoever Allah leaves astray - for him there is no guide.
ayahs.clear: Is God not enough for His servant? And they frighten you with those besides Him. Whomever God sends astray, for him there is no guide.
ayahs.kemenag: Bukankah Allah cukup untuk melindungi hamba-hamba-Nya. Dan mereka mempertakuti kamu dengan (sembahan-sembahan) yang selain Allah? Dan siapa yang disesatkan Allah maka tidak seorangpun pemberi petunjuk baginya.

ayahs.arabic: وَمَن يَهْدِ ٱللَّهُ فَمَا لَهُۥ مِن مُّضِلٍّ ۗ أَلَيْسَ ٱللَّهُ بِعَزِيزٍۢ ذِى ٱنتِقَامٍۢ
