ayahs.kemenag: Jika mereka berpaling maka Kami tidak mengutus kamu sebagai pengawas bagi mereka. Kewajibanmu tidak lain hanyalah menyampaikan (risalah). Sesungguhnya apabila Kami merasakan kepada manusia sesuatu rahmat dari Kami dia bergembira ria karena rahmat itu. Dan jika mereka ditimpa kesusahan disebabkan perbuatan tangan mereka sendiri (niscaya mereka ingkar) karena sesungguhnya manusia itu amat ingkar (kepada nikmat).

ayahs.arabic: لِّلَّهِ مُلْكُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ يَخْلُقُ مَا يَشَآءُ ۚ يَهَبُ لِمَن يَشَآءُ إِنَٰثًۭا وَيَهَبُ لِمَن يَشَآءُ ٱلذُّكُورَ
ayahs.sahih: To Allah belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth; He creates what he wills. He gives to whom He wills female [children], and He gives to whom He wills males.
ayahs.clear: To God belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth. He creates whatever He wills. He grants daughters to whomever He wills, and He grants sons to whomever He wills.
ayahs.kemenag: Kepunyaan Allah-lah kerajaan langit dan bumi, Dia menciptakan apa yang Dia kehendaki. Dia memberikan anak-anak perempuan kepada siapa yang Dia kehendaki dan memberikan anak-anak lelaki kepada siapa yang Dia kehendaki,

ayahs.arabic: أَوْ يُزَوِّجُهُمْ ذُكْرَانًۭا وَإِنَٰثًۭا ۖ وَيَجْعَلُ مَن يَشَآءُ عَقِيمًا ۚ إِنَّهُۥ عَلِيمٌۭ قَدِيرٌۭ
ayahs.sahih: Or He makes them [both] males and females, and He renders whom He wills barren. Indeed, He is Knowing and Competent.
ayahs.clear: Or He combines them together, males and females; and He renders whomever He wills sterile. He is Knowledgeable and Capable.
ayahs.kemenag: atau Dia menganugerahkan kedua jenis laki-laki dan perempuan (kepada siapa) yang dikehendaki-Nya, dan Dia menjadikan mandul siapa yang Dia kehendaki. Sesungguhnya Dia Maha Mengetahui lagi Maha Kuasa.

ayahs.arabic: ۞ وَمَا كَانَ لِبَشَرٍ أَن يُكَلِّمَهُ ٱللَّهُ إِلَّا وَحْيًا أَوْ مِن وَرَآئِ حِجَابٍ أَوْ يُرْسِلَ رَسُولًۭا فَيُوحِىَ بِإِذْنِهِۦ مَا يَشَآءُ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ عَلِىٌّ حَكِيمٌۭ
ayahs.sahih: And it is not for any human being that Allah should speak to him except by revelation or from behind a partition or that He sends a messenger to reveal, by His permission, what He wills. Indeed, He is Most High and Wise.
ayahs.clear: It is not for any human that God should speak to him, except by inspiration, or from behind a veil, or by sending a messenger to reveal by His permission whatever He wills. He is All-High, All-Wise.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan tidak mungkin bagi seorang manusiapun bahwa Allah berkata-kata dengan dia kecuali dengan perantaraan wahyu atau dibelakang tabir atau dengan mengutus seorang utusan (malaikat) lalu diwahyukan kepadanya dengan seizin-Nya apa yang Dia kehendaki. Sesungguhnya Dia Maha Tinggi lagi Maha Bijaksana.

ayahs.arabic: وَكَذَٰلِكَ أَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَيْكَ رُوحًۭا مِّنْ أَمْرِنَا ۚ مَا كُنتَ تَدْرِى مَا ٱلْكِتَٰبُ وَلَا ٱلْإِيمَٰنُ وَلَٰكِن جَعَلْنَٰهُ نُورًۭا نَّهْدِى بِهِۦ مَن نَّشَآءُ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا ۚ وَإِنَّكَ لَتَهْدِىٓ إِلَىٰ صِرَٰطٍۢ مُّسْتَقِيمٍۢ
ayahs.sahih: And thus We have revealed to you an inspiration of Our command. You did not know what is the Book or [what is] faith, but We have made it a light by which We guide whom We will of Our servants. And indeed, [O Muhammad], you guide to a straight path -
ayahs.clear: We thus inspired you spiritually, by Our command. You did not know what the Scripture is, nor what faith is, but We made it a light, with which We guide whomever We will of Our servants. You surely guide to a straight path.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan demikianlah Kami wahyukan kepadamu wahyu (Al Quran) dengan perintah Kami. Sebelumnya kamu tidaklah mengetahui apakah Al Kitab (Al Quran) dan tidak pula mengetahui apakah iman itu, tetapi Kami menjadikan Al Quran itu cahaya, yang Kami tunjuki dengan dia siapa yang kami kehendaki di antara hamba-hamba Kami. Dan sesungguhnya kamu benar-benar memberi petunjuk kepada jalan yang lurus.

ayahs.arabic: صِرَٰطِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلَّذِى لَهُۥ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ۗ أَلَآ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ تَصِيرُ ٱلْأُمُورُ
ayahs.sahih: The path of Allah, to whom belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth. Unquestionably, to Allah do [all] matters evolve.
ayahs.clear: The path of God, to whom belongs everything in the heavens and everything on earth. Indeed, to God all matters revert.
ayahs.kemenag: (Yaitu) jalan Allah yang kepunyaan-Nya segala apa yang ada di langit dan apa yang ada di bumi. Ingatlah, bahwa kepada Allah-lah kembali semua urusan.

ayahs.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ حمٓ
ayahs.sahih: Ha, Meem.
ayahs.clear: Ha, Meem.
ayahs.kemenag: Haa Miim.

ayahs.arabic: وَٱلْكِتَٰبِ ٱلْمُبِينِ
ayahs.sahih: By the clear Book,
ayahs.clear: By the Book that makes things clear.
ayahs.kemenag: Demi Kitab (Al Quran) yang menerangkan.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّا جَعَلْنَٰهُ قُرْءَٰنًا عَرَبِيًّۭا لَّعَلَّكُمْ تَعْقِلُونَ
ayahs.sahih: Indeed, We have made it an Arabic Qur'an that you might understand.
ayahs.clear: We made it an Arabic Quran, so that you may understand.
ayahs.kemenag: Sesungguhnya Kami menjadikan Al Quran dalam bahasa Arab supaya kamu memahami(nya).

ayahs.arabic: وَإِنَّهُۥ فِىٓ أُمِّ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ لَدَيْنَا لَعَلِىٌّ حَكِيمٌ
ayahs.sahih: And indeed it is, in the Mother of the Book with Us, exalted and full of wisdom.
ayahs.clear: And it is with Us, in the Source Book, sublime and wise.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan sesungguhnya Al Quran itu dalam induk Al Kitab (Lauh Mahfuzh) di sisi Kami, adalah benar-benar tinggi (nilainya) dan amat banyak mengandung hikmah.

ayahs.arabic: أَفَنَضْرِبُ عَنكُمُ ٱلذِّكْرَ صَفْحًا أَن كُنتُمْ قَوْمًۭا مُّسْرِفِينَ
ayahs.sahih: Then should We turn the message away, disregarding you, because you are a transgressing people?
ayahs.clear: Shall We hold back the Reminder from you, since you are a transgressing people?
ayahs.kemenag: Maka apakah Kami akan berhenti menurunkan Al Quran kepadamu, karena kamu adalah kaum yang melampaui batas?

ayahs.arabic: وَكَمْ أَرْسَلْنَا مِن نَّبِىٍّۢ فِى ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
ayahs.sahih: And how many a prophet We sent among the former peoples,
ayahs.clear: How many a prophet did We send to the ancients?
ayahs.kemenag: Berapa banyaknya nabi-nabi yang telah Kami utus kepada umat-umat yang terdahulu.

ayahs.arabic: وَمَا يَأْتِيهِم مِّن نَّبِىٍّ إِلَّا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ
ayahs.sahih: But there would not come to them a prophet except that they used to ridicule him.
ayahs.clear: No messenger came to them, but they ridiculed him.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan tiada seorang nabipun datang kepada mereka melainkan mereka selalu memperolok-olokkannya.

ayahs.arabic: فَأَهْلَكْنَآ أَشَدَّ مِنْهُم بَطْشًۭا وَمَضَىٰ مَثَلُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
ayahs.sahih: And We destroyed greater than them in [striking] power, and the example of the former peoples has preceded.
ayahs.clear: We destroyed people more powerful than they, and so the example of the ancients has passed away.
ayahs.kemenag: Maka telah Kami binasakan orang-orang yang lebih besar kekuatannya dari mereka itu (musyrikin Mekah) dan telah terdahulu (tersebut dalam Al Quran) perumpamaan umat-umat masa dahulu.

ayahs.arabic: وَلَئِن سَأَلْتَهُم مَّنْ خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ لَيَقُولُنَّ خَلَقَهُنَّ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
ayahs.sahih: And if you should ask them, "Who has created the heavens and the earth?" they would surely say, "They were created by the Exalted in Might, the Knowing."
ayahs.clear: And if you asked them, “Who created the heavens and the earth?” They would say, “The Mighty, the Knower created them.”
ayahs.kemenag: Dan sungguh jika kamu tanyakan kepada mereka: "Siapakah yang menciptakan langit dan bumi?", niscaya mereka akan menjawab: "Semuanya diciptakan oleh Yang Maha Perkasa lagi Maha Mengetahui".

ayahs.arabic: ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلْأَرْضَ مَهْدًۭا وَجَعَلَ لَكُمْ فِيهَا سُبُلًۭا لَّعَلَّكُمْ تَهْتَدُونَ
ayahs.sahih: [The one] who has made for you the earth a bed and made for you upon it roads that you might be guided
ayahs.clear: He who made the earth a habitat for you, and traced pathways for you on it, that you may be guided.
ayahs.kemenag: Yang menjadikan bumi untuk kamu sebagai tempat menetap dan Dia membuat jalan-jalan di atas bumi untuk kamu supaya kamu mendapat petunjuk.

ayahs.arabic: وَٱلَّذِى نَزَّلَ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءًۢ بِقَدَرٍۢ فَأَنشَرْنَا بِهِۦ بَلْدَةًۭ مَّيْتًۭا ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ تُخْرَجُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And who sends down rain from the sky in measured amounts, and We revive thereby a dead land - thus will you be brought forth -
ayahs.clear: He who sends down water from the sky in due proportion; and so We revive thereby a dead land. Thus you will be brought out.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan Yang menurunkan air dari langit menurut kadar (yang diperlukan) lalu Kami hidupkan dengan air itu negeri yang mati, seperti itulah kamu akan dikeluarkan (dari dalam kubur).

ayahs.arabic: وَٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلْأَزْوَٰجَ كُلَّهَا وَجَعَلَ لَكُم مِّنَ ٱلْفُلْكِ وَٱلْأَنْعَٰمِ مَا تَرْكَبُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And who created the species, all of them, and has made for you of ships and animals those which you mount.
ayahs.clear: He Who created all the pairs; and provided you with ships, and animals on which you ride.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan Yang menciptakan semua yang berpasang-pasangan dan menjadikan untukmu kapal dan binatang ternak yang kamu tunggangi.

ayahs.arabic: لِتَسْتَوُۥا۟ عَلَىٰ ظُهُورِهِۦ ثُمَّ تَذْكُرُوا۟ نِعْمَةَ رَبِّكُمْ إِذَا ٱسْتَوَيْتُمْ عَلَيْهِ وَتَقُولُوا۟ سُبْحَٰنَ ٱلَّذِى سَخَّرَ لَنَا هَٰذَا وَمَا كُنَّا لَهُۥ مُقْرِنِينَ
ayahs.sahih: That you may settle yourselves upon their backs and then remember the favor of your Lord when you have settled upon them and say. "Exalted is He who has subjected this to us, and we could not have [otherwise] subdued it.
ayahs.clear: That you may mount their backs, and remember the favor of your Lord as you sit firmly upon them, and say, “Glory be to Him Who placed these at our service; surely we could not have done it by ourselves.
ayahs.kemenag: Supaya kamu duduk di atas punggungnya kemudian kamu ingat nikmat Tuhanmu apabila kamu telah duduk di atasnya; dan supaya kamu mengucapkan: "Maha Suci Tuhan yang telah menundukkan semua ini bagi kami padahal kami sebelumnya tidak mampu menguasainya,

ayahs.arabic: وَإِنَّآ إِلَىٰ رَبِّنَا لَمُنقَلِبُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And indeed we, to our Lord, will [surely] return."
ayahs.clear: And surely, to our Lord we will return.”
ayahs.kemenag: dan sesungguhnya kami akan kembali kepada Tuhan kami".

ayahs.arabic: وَجَعَلُوا۟ لَهُۥ مِنْ عِبَادِهِۦ جُزْءًا ۚ إِنَّ ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ لَكَفُورٌۭ مُّبِينٌ
ayahs.sahih: But they have attributed to Him from His servants a portion. Indeed, man is clearly ungrateful.
ayahs.clear: Yet they turn one of His servants into a part of Him. Man is clearly ungrateful.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan mereka menjadikan sebahagian dari hamba-hamba-Nya sebagai bahagian daripada-Nya. Sesungguhnya manusia itu benar-benar pengingkar yang nyata (terhadap rahmat Allah).

ayahs.arabic: أَمِ ٱتَّخَذَ مِمَّا يَخْلُقُ بَنَاتٍۢ وَأَصْفَىٰكُم بِٱلْبَنِينَ
ayahs.sahih: Or has He taken, out of what He has created, daughters and chosen you for [having] sons?
ayahs.clear: Or has He chosen for Himself daughters from what He creates, and favored you with sons?
ayahs.kemenag: Patutkah Dia mengambil anak perempuan dari yang diciptakan-Nya dan Dia mengkhususkan buat kamu anak laki-laki.

ayahs.arabic: وَإِذَا بُشِّرَ أَحَدُهُم بِمَا ضَرَبَ لِلرَّحْمَٰنِ مَثَلًۭا ظَلَّ وَجْهُهُۥ مُسْوَدًّۭا وَهُوَ كَظِيمٌ
ayahs.sahih: And when one of them is given good tidings of that which he attributes to the Most Merciful in comparison, his face becomes dark, and he suppresses grief.
ayahs.clear: Yet when one of them is given news of what he attributes to the Most Gracious, his face darkens, and he suppresses grief.
ayahs.kemenag: Padahal apabila salah seorang di antara mereka diberi kabar gembira dengan apa yang dijadikan sebagai misal bagi Allah Yang Maha Pemurah; jadilah mukanya hitam pekat sedang dia amat menahan sedih.

ayahs.arabic: أَوَمَن يُنَشَّؤُا۟ فِى ٱلْحِلْيَةِ وَهُوَ فِى ٱلْخِصَامِ غَيْرُ مُبِينٍۢ
ayahs.sahih: So is one brought up in ornaments while being during conflict unevident [attributed to Allah]?
ayahs.clear: “Someone brought up to be beautiful, and unable to help in a fight?”
ayahs.kemenag: Dan apakah patut (menjadi anak Allah) orang yang dibesarkan dalam keadaan berperhiasan sedang dia tidak dapat memberi alasan yang terang dalam pertengkaran.

ayahs.arabic: وَجَعَلُوا۟ ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةَ ٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ عِبَٰدُ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ إِنَٰثًا ۚ أَشَهِدُوا۟ خَلْقَهُمْ ۚ سَتُكْتَبُ شَهَٰدَتُهُمْ وَيُسْـَٔلُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And they have made the angels, who are servants of the Most Merciful, females. Did they witness their creation? Their testimony will be recorded, and they will be questioned.
ayahs.clear: And they appoint the angels, who are servants to the Most Gracious, as females. Have they witnessed their creation? Their claim will be recorded, and they will be questioned.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan mereka menjadikan malaikat-malaikat yang mereka itu adalah hamba-hamba Allah Yang Maha Pemurah sebagai orang-orang perempuan. Apakah mereka menyaksikan penciptaan malaika-malaikat itu? Kelak akan dituliskan persaksian mereka dan mereka akan dimintai pertanggung-jawaban.

ayahs.arabic: وَقَالُوا۟ لَوْ شَآءَ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ مَا عَبَدْنَٰهُم ۗ مَّا لَهُم بِذَٰلِكَ مِنْ عِلْمٍ ۖ إِنْ هُمْ إِلَّا يَخْرُصُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And they said, "If the Most Merciful had willed, we would not have worshipped them." They have of that no knowledge. They are not but falsifying.
ayahs.clear: And they say, “Had the Most Gracious willed, we would not have worshiped them.” But they have no knowledge of that; they are merely guessing.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan mereka berkata: "Jikalau Allah Yang Maha Pemurah menghendaki tentulah kami tidak menyembah mereka (malaikat)". Mereka tidak mempunyai pengetahuan sedikitpun tentang itu, mereka tidak lain hanyalah menduga-duga belaka.

ayahs.arabic: أَمْ ءَاتَيْنَٰهُمْ كِتَٰبًۭا مِّن قَبْلِهِۦ فَهُم بِهِۦ مُسْتَمْسِكُونَ
ayahs.sahih: Or have We given them a book before the Qur'an to which they are adhering?
ayahs.clear: Or have We given them a book prior to this one, to which they adhere?
ayahs.kemenag: Atau adakah Kami memberikan sebuah kitab kepada mereka sebelum Al Quran, lalu mereka berpegang dengan kitab itu?

ayahs.arabic: بَلْ قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّا وَجَدْنَآ ءَابَآءَنَا عَلَىٰٓ أُمَّةٍۢ وَإِنَّا عَلَىٰٓ ءَاثَٰرِهِم مُّهْتَدُونَ
ayahs.sahih: Rather, they say, "Indeed, we found our fathers upon a religion, and we are in their footsteps [rightly] guided."
ayahs.clear: But they say, “We found our parents on a course, and we are guided in their footsteps.”
ayahs.kemenag: Bahkan mereka berkata: "Sesungguhnya kami mendapati bapak-bapak kami menganut suatu agama, dan sesungguhnya kami orang-orang yang mendapat petunjuk dengan (mengikuti) jejak mereka".

ayahs.arabic: وَكَذَٰلِكَ مَآ أَرْسَلْنَا مِن قَبْلِكَ فِى قَرْيَةٍۢ مِّن نَّذِيرٍ إِلَّا قَالَ مُتْرَفُوهَآ إِنَّا وَجَدْنَآ ءَابَآءَنَا عَلَىٰٓ أُمَّةٍۢ وَإِنَّا عَلَىٰٓ ءَاثَٰرِهِم مُّقْتَدُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And similarly, We did not send before you any warner into a city except that its affluent said, "Indeed, we found our fathers upon a religion, and we are, in their footsteps, following."
ayahs.clear: Likewise, We sent no warner before you to any town, but the wealthy among them said, “We found our parents on a course, and we are following in their footsteps.”
ayahs.kemenag: Dan demikianlah, Kami tidak mengutus sebelum kamu seorang pemberi peringatanpun dalam suatu negeri, melainkan orang-orang yang hidup mewah di negeri itu berkata: "Sesungguhnya kami mendapati bapak-bapak kami menganut suatu agama dan sesungguhnya kami adalah pengikut jejak-jejak mereka".

ayahs.arabic: ۞ قَٰلَ أَوَلَوْ جِئْتُكُم بِأَهْدَىٰ مِمَّا وَجَدتُّمْ عَلَيْهِ ءَابَآءَكُمْ ۖ قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّا بِمَآ أُرْسِلْتُم بِهِۦ كَٰفِرُونَ
ayahs.sahih: [Each warner] said, "Even if I brought you better guidance than that [religion] upon which you found your fathers?" They said, "Indeed we, in that with which you were sent, are disbelievers."
ayahs.clear: He would say, “Even if I bring you better guidance than what you found your parents following?” They would say, “We reject what you are sent with.”
ayahs.kemenag: (Rasul itu) berkata: "Apakah (kamu akan mengikutinya juga) sekalipun aku membawa untukmu (agama) yang lebih (nyata) memberi petunjuk daripada apa yang kamu dapati bapak-bapakmu menganutnya?" Mereka menjawab: "Sesungguhnya kami mengingkari agama yang kamu diutus untuk menyampaikannya".

ayahs.arabic: فَٱنتَقَمْنَا مِنْهُمْ ۖ فَٱنظُرْ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَٰقِبَةُ ٱلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
ayahs.sahih: So we took retribution from them; then see how was the end of the deniers.
ayahs.clear: So We wreaked vengeance upon them. Behold, then, what was the fate of those who deny.
ayahs.kemenag: Maka Kami binasakan mereka maka perhatikanlah bagaimana kesudahan orang-orang yang mendustakan itu.

ayahs.arabic: وَإِذْ قَالَ إِبْرَٰهِيمُ لِأَبِيهِ وَقَوْمِهِۦٓ إِنَّنِى بَرَآءٌۭ مِّمَّا تَعْبُدُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And [mention, O Muhammad], when Abraham said to his father and his people, "Indeed, I am disassociated from that which you worship
ayahs.clear: When Abraham said to his father and his people, “I am innocent of what you worship.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan ingatlah ketika Ibrahim berkata kepada bapaknya dan kaumnya: "Sesungguhnya aku tidak bertanggung jawab terhadap apa yang kamu sembah,

ayahs.arabic: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِى فَطَرَنِى فَإِنَّهُۥ سَيَهْدِينِ
ayahs.sahih: Except for He who created me; and indeed, He will guide me."
ayahs.clear: Except for He who created me, for He will guide me.”
ayahs.kemenag: tetapi (aku menyembah) Tuhan Yang menjadikanku; karena sesungguhnya Dia akan memberi hidayah kepadaku".

ayahs.arabic: وَجَعَلَهَا كَلِمَةًۢ بَاقِيَةًۭ فِى عَقِبِهِۦ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَرْجِعُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And he made it a word remaining among his descendants that they might return [to it].
ayahs.clear: And he made it an enduring word in his progeny, so that they may return.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan (lbrahim a. s.) menjadikan kalimat tauhid itu kalimat yang kekal pada keturunannya supaya mereka kembali kepada kalimat tauhid itu.

ayahs.arabic: بَلْ مَتَّعْتُ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ وَءَابَآءَهُمْ حَتَّىٰ جَآءَهُمُ ٱلْحَقُّ وَرَسُولٌۭ مُّبِينٌۭ
ayahs.sahih: However, I gave enjoyment to these [people of Makkah] and their fathers until there came to them the truth and a clear Messenger.
ayahs.clear: I gave these and their forefathers some enjoyment, until the truth and a manifest messenger came to them.
ayahs.kemenag: Tetapi Aku telah memberikan kenikmatan hidup kepada mereka dan bapak-bapak mereka sehingga datanglah kepada mereka kebenaran (Al Quran) dan seorang rasul yang memberi penjelasan.

ayahs.arabic: وَلَمَّا جَآءَهُمُ ٱلْحَقُّ قَالُوا۟ هَٰذَا سِحْرٌۭ وَإِنَّا بِهِۦ كَٰفِرُونَ
ayahs.sahih: But when the truth came to them, they said, "This is magic, and indeed we are, concerning it, disbelievers."
ayahs.clear: But when the truth came to them, they said, “This is sorcery, and we refuse to believe in it.”
ayahs.kemenag: Dan tatkala kebenaran (Al Quran) itu datang kepada mereka, mereka berkata: "Ini adalah sihir dan sesungguhnya kami adalah orang-orang yang mengingkarinya".

ayahs.arabic: وَقَالُوا۟ لَوْلَا نُزِّلَ هَٰذَا ٱلْقُرْءَانُ عَلَىٰ رَجُلٍۢ مِّنَ ٱلْقَرْيَتَيْنِ عَظِيمٍ
ayahs.sahih: And they said, "Why was this Qur'an not sent down upon a great man from [one of] the two cities?"
ayahs.clear: They also said, “If only this Quran was sent down to a man of importance from the two cities.”
ayahs.kemenag: Dan mereka berkata: "Mengapa Al Quran ini tidak diturunkan kepada seorang besar dari salah satu dua negeri (Mekah dan Thaif) ini?"

ayahs.arabic: أَهُمْ يَقْسِمُونَ رَحْمَتَ رَبِّكَ ۚ نَحْنُ قَسَمْنَا بَيْنَهُم مَّعِيشَتَهُمْ فِى ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا ۚ وَرَفَعْنَا بَعْضَهُمْ فَوْقَ بَعْضٍۢ دَرَجَٰتٍۢ لِّيَتَّخِذَ بَعْضُهُم بَعْضًۭا سُخْرِيًّۭا ۗ وَرَحْمَتُ رَبِّكَ خَيْرٌۭ مِّمَّا يَجْمَعُونَ
ayahs.sahih: Do they distribute the mercy of your Lord? It is We who have apportioned among them their livelihood in the life of this world and have raised some of them above others in degrees [of rank] that they may make use of one another for service. But the mercy of your Lord is better than whatever they accumulate.
ayahs.clear: Is it they who allocate the mercy of your Lord? It is We who have allocated their livelihood in this life, and We elevated some of them in rank above others, that some of them would take others in service. But your Lord’s mercy is better than what they amass.
ayahs.kemenag: Apakah mereka yang membagi-bagi rahmat Tuhanmu? Kami telah menentukan antara mereka penghidupan mereka dalam kehidupan dunia, dan kami telah meninggikan sebahagian mereka atas sebagian yang lain beberapa derajat, agar sebagian mereka dapat mempergunakan sebagian yang lain. Dan rahmat Tuhanmu lebih baik dari apa yang mereka kumpulkan.

ayahs.arabic: وَلَوْلَآ أَن يَكُونَ ٱلنَّاسُ أُمَّةًۭ وَٰحِدَةًۭ لَّجَعَلْنَا لِمَن يَكْفُرُ بِٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ لِبُيُوتِهِمْ سُقُفًۭا مِّن فِضَّةٍۢ وَمَعَارِجَ عَلَيْهَا يَظْهَرُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And if it were not that the people would become one community [of disbelievers], We would have made for those who disbelieve in the Most Merciful - for their houses - ceilings and stairways of silver upon which to mount
ayahs.clear: Were it not that humanity would become a single community, We would have provided those who disbelieve in the Most Gracious with roofs of silver to their houses, and stairways by which they ascend.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan sekiranya bukan karena hendak menghindari manusia menjadi umat yang satu (dalam kekafiran), tentulah kami buatkan bagi orang-orang yang kafir kepada Tuhan Yang Maha Pemurah loteng-loteng perak bagi rumah mereka dan (juga) tangga-tangga (perak) yang mereka menaikinya.

ayahs.arabic: وَلِبُيُوتِهِمْ أَبْوَٰبًۭا وَسُرُرًا عَلَيْهَا يَتَّكِـُٔونَ
ayahs.sahih: And for their houses - doors and couches [of silver] upon which to recline
ayahs.clear: And doors to their houses, and furnishings on which they recline.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan (Kami buatkan pula) pintu-pintu (perak) bagi rumah-rumah mereka dan (begitu pula) dipan-dipan yang mereka bertelekan atasnya.

ayahs.arabic: وَزُخْرُفًۭا ۚ وَإِن كُلُّ ذَٰلِكَ لَمَّا مَتَٰعُ ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا ۚ وَٱلْءَاخِرَةُ عِندَ رَبِّكَ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ
ayahs.sahih: And gold ornament. But all that is not but the enjoyment of worldly life. And the Hereafter with your Lord is for the righteous.
ayahs.clear: And decorations. Yet all that is nothing but the stuff of this life. Yet the Hereafter, with your Lord, is for the righteous.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan (Kami buatkan pula) perhiasan-perhiasan (dari emas untuk mereka). Dan semuanya itu tidak lain hanyalah kesenangan kehidupan dunia, dan kehidupan akhirat itu di sisi Tuhanmu adalah bagi orang-orang yang bertakwa.

ayahs.arabic: وَمَن يَعْشُ عَن ذِكْرِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ نُقَيِّضْ لَهُۥ شَيْطَٰنًۭا فَهُوَ لَهُۥ قَرِينٌۭ
ayahs.sahih: And whoever is blinded from remembrance of the Most Merciful - We appoint for him a devil, and he is to him a companion.
ayahs.clear: Whoever shuns the remembrance of the Most Gracious, We assign for him a devil, to be his companion.
ayahs.kemenag: Barangsiapa yang berpaling dari pengajaran Tuhan Yang Maha Pemurah (Al Quran), kami adakan baginya syaitan (yang menyesatkan) maka syaitan itulah yang menjadi teman yang selalu menyertainya.

ayahs.arabic: وَإِنَّهُمْ لَيَصُدُّونَهُمْ عَنِ ٱلسَّبِيلِ وَيَحْسَبُونَ أَنَّهُم مُّهْتَدُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And indeed, the devils avert them from the way [of guidance] while they think that they are [rightly] guided
ayahs.clear: They hinder them from the path, though they think they are guided.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan sesungguhnya syaitan-syaitan itu benar-benar menghalangi mereka dari jalan yang benar dan mereka menyangka bahwa mereka mendapat petunjuk.

ayahs.arabic: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا جَآءَنَا قَالَ يَٰلَيْتَ بَيْنِى وَبَيْنَكَ بُعْدَ ٱلْمَشْرِقَيْنِ فَبِئْسَ ٱلْقَرِينُ
ayahs.sahih: Until, when he comes to Us [at Judgement], he says [to his companion], "Oh, I wish there was between me and you the distance between the east and west - how wretched a companion."
ayahs.clear: Until, when He comes to Us, he will say, “If only there were between me and you the distance of the two Easts.” What an evil companion!
ayahs.kemenag: Sehingga apabila orang-orang yang berpaling itu datang kepada kami (di hari kiamat) dia berkata: "Aduhai, semoga (jarak) antaraku dan kamu seperti jarak antara masyrik dan maghrib, maka syaitan itu adalah sejahat-jahat teman (yang menyertai manusia)".

ayahs.arabic: وَلَن يَنفَعَكُمُ ٱلْيَوْمَ إِذ ظَّلَمْتُمْ أَنَّكُمْ فِى ٱلْعَذَابِ مُشْتَرِكُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And never will it benefit you that Day, when you have wronged, that you are [all] sharing in the punishment.
ayahs.clear: It will not benefit you on that Day, since you did wrong. You are partners in the suffering.
ayahs.kemenag: (Harapanmu itu) sekali-kali tidak akan memberi manfaat kepadamu di hari itu karena kamu telah menganiaya (dirimu sendiri). Sesungguhnya kamu bersekutu dalam azab itu.

ayahs.arabic: أَفَأَنتَ تُسْمِعُ ٱلصُّمَّ أَوْ تَهْدِى ٱلْعُمْىَ وَمَن كَانَ فِى ضَلَٰلٍۢ مُّبِينٍۢ
ayahs.sahih: Then will you make the deaf hear, [O Muhammad], or guide the blind or he who is in clear error?
ayahs.clear: Can you make the deaf hear, or guide the blind, and him who is in evident error?
ayahs.kemenag: Maka apakah kamu dapat menjadikan orang yang pekak bisa mendengar atau (dapatkah) kamu memberi petunjuk kepada orang yang buta (hatinya) dan kepada orang yang tetap dalam kesesatan yang nyata?

ayahs.arabic: فَإِمَّا نَذْهَبَنَّ بِكَ فَإِنَّا مِنْهُم مُّنتَقِمُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And whether [or not] We take you away [in death], indeed, We will take retribution upon them.
ayahs.clear: Even if We take you away, We will wreak vengeance upon them.
ayahs.kemenag: Sungguh, jika Kami mewafatkan kamu (sebelum kamu mencapai kemenangan) maka sesungguhnya Kami akan menyiksa mereka (di akhirat).

ayahs.arabic: أَوْ نُرِيَنَّكَ ٱلَّذِى وَعَدْنَٰهُمْ فَإِنَّا عَلَيْهِم مُّقْتَدِرُونَ
ayahs.sahih: Or whether [or not] We show you that which We have promised them, indeed, We are Perfect in Ability.
ayahs.clear: Or show you what We have promised them; for We have absolute power over them.
ayahs.kemenag: Atau Kami memperlihatkan kepadamu (azab) yang telah Kami ancamkan kepada mereka. Maka sesungguhnya Kami berkuasa atas mereka.

ayahs.arabic: فَٱسْتَمْسِكْ بِٱلَّذِىٓ أُوحِىَ إِلَيْكَ ۖ إِنَّكَ عَلَىٰ صِرَٰطٍۢ مُّسْتَقِيمٍۢ
ayahs.sahih: So adhere to that which is revealed to you. Indeed, you are on a straight path.
ayahs.clear: So adhere to what is revealed to you. You are upon a straight path.
ayahs.kemenag: Maka berpegang teguhlah kamu kepada agama yang telah diwahyukan kepadamu. Sesungguhnya kamu berada di atas jalan yang lurus.

ayahs.arabic: وَإِنَّهُۥ لَذِكْرٌۭ لَّكَ وَلِقَوْمِكَ ۖ وَسَوْفَ تُسْـَٔلُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And indeed, it is a remembrance for you and your people, and you [all] are going to be questioned.
ayahs.clear: It is a message for you, and for your people; and you will be questioned.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan sesungguhnya Al Quran itu benar-benar adalah suatu kemuliaan besar bagimu dan bagi kaummu dan kelak kamu akan diminta pertanggungan jawab.

ayahs.arabic: وَسْـَٔلْ مَنْ أَرْسَلْنَا مِن قَبْلِكَ مِن رُّسُلِنَآ أَجَعَلْنَا مِن دُونِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ءَالِهَةًۭ يُعْبَدُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And ask those We sent before you of Our messengers; have We made besides the Most Merciful deities to be worshipped?
ayahs.clear: Ask those of Our messengers We sent before you: “Did We appoint gods besides the Most Gracious to be worshiped?”
ayahs.kemenag: Dan tanyakanlah kepada rasul-rasul Kami yang telah Kami utus sebelum kamu: "Adakah Kami menentukan tuhan-tuhan untuk disembah selain Allah Yang Maha Pemurah?"

ayahs.arabic: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا مُوسَىٰ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَآ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ وَمَلَإِي۟هِۦ فَقَالَ إِنِّى رَسُولُ رَبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
ayahs.sahih: And certainly did We send Moses with Our signs to Pharaoh and his establishment, and he said, "Indeed, I am the messenger of the Lord of the worlds."
ayahs.clear: We sent Moses with Our revelations to Pharaoh and his dignitaries. He said, “I am the Messenger of the Lord of the Worlds.”
ayahs.kemenag: Dan sesunguhnya Kami telah mengutus Musa dengan membawa mukjizat-mukjizat Kami kepada Fir'aun dan pemuka-pemuka kaumnya. Maka Musa berkata: "Sesungguhnya aku adalah utusan dari Tuhan seru sekalian alam".

ayahs.arabic: فَلَمَّا جَآءَهُم بِـَٔايَٰتِنَآ إِذَا هُم مِّنْهَا يَضْحَكُونَ
ayahs.sahih: But when he brought them Our signs, at once they laughed at them.
ayahs.clear: But when he showed them Our signs, they started laughing at them.
ayahs.kemenag: Maka tatkala dia datang kepada mereka dengan membawa mukjizat-mukjizat Kami dengan serta merta mereka mentertawakannya.

ayahs.arabic: وَمَا نُرِيهِم مِّنْ ءَايَةٍ إِلَّا هِىَ أَكْبَرُ مِنْ أُخْتِهَا ۖ وَأَخَذْنَٰهُم بِٱلْعَذَابِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَرْجِعُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And We showed them not a sign except that it was greater than its sister, and We seized them with affliction that perhaps they might return [to faith].
ayahs.clear: Each sign We showed them was more marvelous than its counterpart. And We afflicted them with the plagues, so that they may repent.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan tidaklah Kami perlihatkan kepada mereka sesuatu mukjizat kecuali mukjizat itu lebih besar dari mukjizat-mukjizat yang sebelumnya. Dan Kami timpakan kepada mereka azab supaya mereka kembali (ke jalan yang benar).

ayahs.arabic: وَقَالُوا۟ يَٰٓأَيُّهَ ٱلسَّاحِرُ ٱدْعُ لَنَا رَبَّكَ بِمَا عَهِدَ عِندَكَ إِنَّنَا لَمُهْتَدُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And they said [to Moses], "O magician, invoke for us your Lord by what He has promised you. Indeed, we will be guided."
ayahs.clear: They said, “O sorcerer, pray to your Lord for us, according to His pledge to you, and then we will be guided.”
ayahs.kemenag: Dan mereka berkata: "Hai ahli sihir, berdoalah kepada Tuhanmu untuk (melepaskan) kami sesuai dengan apa yang telah dijanjikan-Nya kepadamu; sesungguhnya kami (jika doamu dikabulkan) benar-benar akan menjadi orang yang mendapat petunjuk.

ayahs.arabic: فَلَمَّا كَشَفْنَا عَنْهُمُ ٱلْعَذَابَ إِذَا هُمْ يَنكُثُونَ
ayahs.sahih: But when We removed from them the affliction, at once they broke their word.
ayahs.clear: But when We lifted the torment from them, they immediately broke their promise.
ayahs.kemenag: Maka tatkala Kami hilangkan azab itu dari mereka, dengan serta merta mereka memungkiri (janjinya).

ayahs.arabic: وَنَادَىٰ فِرْعَوْنُ فِى قَوْمِهِۦ قَالَ يَٰقَوْمِ أَلَيْسَ لِى مُلْكُ مِصْرَ وَهَٰذِهِ ٱلْأَنْهَٰرُ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِىٓ ۖ أَفَلَا تُبْصِرُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And Pharaoh called out among his people; he said, "O my people, does not the kingdom of Egypt belong to me, and these rivers flowing beneath me; then do you not see?
ayahs.clear: Pharaoh proclaimed among his people, saying, “O my people, do I not own the Kingdom of Egypt, and these rivers flow beneath me? Do you not see?
ayahs.kemenag: Dan Fir'aun berseru kepada kaumnya (seraya) berkata: "Hai kaumku, bukankah kerajaan Mesir ini kepunyaanku dan (bukankah) sungai-sungai ini mengalir di bawahku; maka apakah kamu tidak melihat(nya)?

ayahs.arabic: أَمْ أَنَا۠ خَيْرٌۭ مِّنْ هَٰذَا ٱلَّذِى هُوَ مَهِينٌۭ وَلَا يَكَادُ يُبِينُ
ayahs.sahih: Or am I [not] better than this one who is insignificant and hardly makes himself clear?
ayahs.clear: Am I not better than this miserable wretch, who can barely express himself?
ayahs.kemenag: Bukankah aku lebih baik dari orang yang hina ini dan yang hampir tidak dapat menjelaskan (perkataannya)?

ayahs.arabic: فَلَوْلَآ أُلْقِىَ عَلَيْهِ أَسْوِرَةٌۭ مِّن ذَهَبٍ أَوْ جَآءَ مَعَهُ ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ مُقْتَرِنِينَ
ayahs.sahih: Then why have there not been placed upon him bracelets of gold or come with him the angels in conjunction?"
ayahs.clear: Why are bracelets of gold not dropped on him, or they angels came with him in procession?”
ayahs.kemenag: Mengapa tidak dipakaikan kepadanya gelang dari emas atau malaikat datang bersama-sama dia untuk mengiringkannya?"

ayahs.arabic: فَٱسْتَخَفَّ قَوْمَهُۥ فَأَطَاعُوهُ ۚ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ قَوْمًۭا فَٰسِقِينَ
ayahs.sahih: So he bluffed his people, and they obeyed him. Indeed, they were [themselves] a people defiantly disobedient [of Allah].
ayahs.clear: Thus he fooled his people, and they obeyed him. They were wicked people.
ayahs.kemenag: Maka Fir'aun mempengaruhi kaumnya (dengan perkataan itu) lalu mereka patuh kepadanya. Karena sesungguhnya mereka adalah kaum yang fasik.

ayahs.arabic: فَلَمَّآ ءَاسَفُونَا ٱنتَقَمْنَا مِنْهُمْ فَأَغْرَقْنَٰهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
ayahs.sahih: And when they angered Us, We took retribution from them and drowned them all.
ayahs.clear: And when they provoked Our wrath, We took retribution from them, and We drowned them all.
ayahs.kemenag: Maka tatkala mereka membuat Kami murka, Kami menghukum mereka lalu kami tenggelamkan mereka semuanya (di laut),

ayahs.arabic: فَجَعَلْنَٰهُمْ سَلَفًۭا وَمَثَلًۭا لِّلْءَاخِرِينَ
ayahs.sahih: And We made them a precedent and an example for the later peoples.
ayahs.clear: Thus We made them a precedent and an example for the others.
ayahs.kemenag: dan Kami jadikan mereka sebagai pelajaran dan contoh bagi orang-orang yang kemudian.

ayahs.arabic: ۞ وَلَمَّا ضُرِبَ ٱبْنُ مَرْيَمَ مَثَلًا إِذَا قَوْمُكَ مِنْهُ يَصِدُّونَ
ayahs.sahih: And when the son of Mary was presented as an example, immediately your people laughed aloud.
ayahs.clear: And when the son of Mary was cited as an example, your people opposed.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan tatkala putra Maryam (Isa) dijadikan perumpamnaan tiba-tiba kaummu (Quraisy) bersorak karenanya.

ayahs.arabic: وَقَالُوٓا۟ ءَأَٰلِهَتُنَا خَيْرٌ أَمْ هُوَ ۚ مَا ضَرَبُوهُ لَكَ إِلَّا جَدَلًۢا ۚ بَلْ هُمْ قَوْمٌ خَصِمُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And they said, "Are your gods better, or is he?" They did not present the comparison except for [mere] argument. But, [in fact], they are a people prone to dispute.
ayahs.clear: They said, “Are our gods better, or he?” They cited him only for argument. In fact, they are a quarrelsome people.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan mereka berkata: "Manakah yang lebih baik tuhan-tuhan kami atau dia (Isa)?" Mereka tidak memberikan perumpamaan itu kepadamu melainkan dengan maksud membantah saja, sebenarnya mereka adalah kaum yang suka bertengkar.

ayahs.arabic: إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا عَبْدٌ أَنْعَمْنَا عَلَيْهِ وَجَعَلْنَٰهُ مَثَلًۭا لِّبَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ
ayahs.sahih: Jesus was not but a servant upon whom We bestowed favor, and We made him an example for the Children of Israel.
ayahs.clear: He was just a servant whom We blessed, and We made him an example for the Children of Israel.
ayahs.kemenag: Isa tidak lain hanyalah seorang hamba yang Kami berikan kepadanya nikmat (kenabian) dan Kami jadikan dia sebagai tanda bukti (kekuasaan Allah) untuk Bani lsrail

ayahs.arabic: وَلَوْ نَشَآءُ لَجَعَلْنَا مِنكُم مَّلَٰٓئِكَةًۭ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ يَخْلُفُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And if We willed, We could have made [instead] of you angels succeeding [one another] on the earth.
ayahs.clear: Had We willed, We would have made of you angels to be successors on earth.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan kalau Kami kehendaki benar-benar Kami jadikan sebagai gantimu di muka bumi malaikat-malaikat yang turun temurun.

ayahs.arabic: وَإِنَّهُۥ لَعِلْمٌۭ لِّلسَّاعَةِ فَلَا تَمْتَرُنَّ بِهَا وَٱتَّبِعُونِ ۚ هَٰذَا صِرَٰطٌۭ مُّسْتَقِيمٌۭ
ayahs.sahih: And indeed, Jesus will be [a sign for] knowledge of the Hour, so be not in doubt of it, and follow Me. This is a straight path.
ayahs.clear: He is a portent of the Hour, so have no doubt about it, and follow Me. This is a straight way.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan sesungguhnya Isa itu benar-benar memberikan pengetahuan tentang hari kiamat. Karena itu janganlah kamu ragu-ragu tentang kiamat itu dan ikutilah Aku. Inilah jalan yang lurus.

ayahs.arabic: وَلَا يَصُدَّنَّكُمُ ٱلشَّيْطَٰنُ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ لَكُمْ عَدُوٌّۭ مُّبِينٌۭ
ayahs.sahih: And never let Satan avert you. Indeed, he is to you a clear enemy.
ayahs.clear: And let not Satan divert you. He is an open enemy to you.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan janganlah kamu sekali-kali dipalingkan oleh syaitan; sesungguhnya syaitan itu musuh yang nyata bagimu.

ayahs.arabic: وَلَمَّا جَآءَ عِيسَىٰ بِٱلْبَيِّنَٰتِ قَالَ قَدْ جِئْتُكُم بِٱلْحِكْمَةِ وَلِأُبَيِّنَ لَكُم بَعْضَ ٱلَّذِى تَخْتَلِفُونَ فِيهِ ۖ فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
ayahs.sahih: And when Jesus brought clear proofs, he said, "I have come to you with wisdom and to make clear to you some of that over which you differ, so fear Allah and obey me.
ayahs.clear: When Jesus came with the clarifications, he said, “I have come to you with wisdom, and to clarify for you some of what you differ about. So fear God, and obey me.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan tatkala Isa datang membawa keterangan dia berkata: "Sesungguhnya aku datang kepadamu dengan membawa hikmat dan untuk menjelaskan kepadamu sebagian dari apa yang kamu berselisih tentangnya, maka bertakwalah kepada Allah dan taatlah (kepada)ku".

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ رَبِّى وَرَبُّكُمْ فَٱعْبُدُوهُ ۚ هَٰذَا صِرَٰطٌۭ مُّسْتَقِيمٌۭ
ayahs.sahih: Indeed, Allah is my Lord and your Lord, so worship Him. This is a straight path."
ayahs.clear: God is my Lord and your Lord, so worship Him—this is a straight path.”
ayahs.kemenag: Sesungguhnya Allah Dialah Tuhanku dan Tuhan kamu maka sembahlah Dia, ini adalah jalan yang lurus.

ayahs.arabic: فَٱخْتَلَفَ ٱلْأَحْزَابُ مِنۢ بَيْنِهِمْ ۖ فَوَيْلٌۭ لِّلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ مِنْ عَذَابِ يَوْمٍ أَلِيمٍ
ayahs.sahih: But the denominations from among them differed [and separated], so woe to those who have wronged from the punishment of a painful Day.
ayahs.clear: But the factions differed among themselves. So woe to the wrongdoers from the suffering of a painful Day.
ayahs.kemenag: Maka berselisihlah golongan-golongan (yang terdapat) di antara mereka, lalu kecelakaan yang besarlah bagi orang-orang yang zalim yakni siksaan hari yang pedih (kiamat).

ayahs.arabic: هَلْ يَنظُرُونَ إِلَّا ٱلسَّاعَةَ أَن تَأْتِيَهُم بَغْتَةًۭ وَهُمْ لَا يَشْعُرُونَ
ayahs.sahih: Are they waiting except for the Hour to come upon them suddenly while they perceive not?
ayahs.clear: Are they only waiting for the Hour to come upon them suddenly, while they are unaware?
ayahs.kemenag: Mereka tidak menunggu kecuali kedatangan hari kiamat kepada mereka dengan tiba-tiba sedang mereka tidak menyadarinya.

ayahs.arabic: ٱلْأَخِلَّآءُ يَوْمَئِذٍۭ بَعْضُهُمْ لِبَعْضٍ عَدُوٌّ إِلَّا ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ
ayahs.sahih: Close friends, that Day, will be enemies to each other, except for the righteous
ayahs.clear: On that Day, friends will be enemies of one another, except for the righteous.
ayahs.kemenag: Teman-teman akrab pada hari itu sebagiannya menjadi musuh bagi sebagian yang lain kecuali orang-orang yang bertakwa.

ayahs.arabic: يَٰعِبَادِ لَا خَوْفٌ عَلَيْكُمُ ٱلْيَوْمَ وَلَآ أَنتُمْ تَحْزَنُونَ
ayahs.sahih: [To whom Allah will say], "O My servants, no fear will there be concerning you this Day, nor will you grieve,
ayahs.clear: O My servants, you have nothing to fear on that Day, nor will you grieve.
ayahs.kemenag: "Hai hamba-hamba-Ku, tiada kekhawatiran terhadapmu pada hari ini dan tidak pula kamu bersedih hati.

ayahs.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا وَكَانُوا۟ مُسْلِمِينَ
ayahs.sahih: [You] who believed in Our verses and were Muslims.
ayahs.clear: Those who believed in Our revelations, and were submissive.
ayahs.kemenag: (Yaitu) orang-orang yang beriman kepada ayat-ayat Kami dan adalah mereka dahulu orang-orang yang berserah diri.

ayahs.arabic: ٱدْخُلُوا۟ ٱلْجَنَّةَ أَنتُمْ وَأَزْوَٰجُكُمْ تُحْبَرُونَ
ayahs.sahih: Enter Paradise, you and your kinds, delighted."
ayahs.clear: Enter the Garden, you and your spouses, Joyfully.
ayahs.kemenag: Masuklah kamu ke dalam surga, kamu dan isteri-isteri kamu digembirakan".

ayahs.arabic: يُطَافُ عَلَيْهِم بِصِحَافٍۢ مِّن ذَهَبٍۢ وَأَكْوَابٍۢ ۖ وَفِيهَا مَا تَشْتَهِيهِ ٱلْأَنفُسُ وَتَلَذُّ ٱلْأَعْيُنُ ۖ وَأَنتُمْ فِيهَا خَٰلِدُونَ
ayahs.sahih: Circulated among them will be plates and vessels of gold. And therein is whatever the souls desire and [what] delights the eyes, and you will abide therein eternally.
ayahs.clear: They will be served around with trays of gold, and cups. Therein is whatever the souls desire and delights the eyes. Therein you will stay forever.
ayahs.kemenag: Diedarkan kepada mereka piring-piring dari emas, dan piala-piala dan di dalam surga itu terdapat segala apa yang diingini oleh hati dan sedap (dipandang) mata dan kamu kekal di dalamnya".

ayahs.arabic: وَتِلْكَ ٱلْجَنَّةُ ٱلَّتِىٓ أُورِثْتُمُوهَا بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And that is Paradise which you are made to inherit for what you used to do.
ayahs.clear: Such is the Garden you are made to inherit, because of what you used to do.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan itulah surga yang diwariskan kepada kamu disebabkan amal-amal yang dahulu kamu kerjakan.

ayahs.arabic: لَكُمْ فِيهَا فَٰكِهَةٌۭ كَثِيرَةٌۭ مِّنْهَا تَأْكُلُونَ
ayahs.sahih: For you therein is much fruit from which you will eat.
ayahs.clear: Therein you will have abundant fruit, from which you eat.
ayahs.kemenag: Di dalam surga itu ada buah-buahan yang banyak untukmu yang sebahagiannya kamu makan.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ فِى عَذَابِ جَهَنَّمَ خَٰلِدُونَ
ayahs.sahih: Indeed, the criminals will be in the punishment of Hell, abiding eternally.
ayahs.clear: As for the sinners, they will be in the torment of Hell forever.
ayahs.kemenag: Sesungguhnya orang-orang yang berdosa kekal di dalam azab neraka Jahannam.

ayahs.arabic: لَا يُفَتَّرُ عَنْهُمْ وَهُمْ فِيهِ مُبْلِسُونَ
ayahs.sahih: It will not be allowed to subside for them, and they, therein, are in despair.
ayahs.clear: It will never be eased for them. In it, they will be devastated.
ayahs.kemenag: Tidak diringankan azab itu dari mereka dan mereka di dalamnya berputus asa.

ayahs.arabic: وَمَا ظَلَمْنَٰهُمْ وَلَٰكِن كَانُوا۟ هُمُ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ
ayahs.sahih: And We did not wrong them, but it was they who were the wrongdoers.
ayahs.clear: We did them no injustice, but it was they who were the unjust.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan tidaklah Kami menganiaya mereka tetapi merekalah yang menganiaya diri mereka sendiri.

ayahs.arabic: وَنَادَوْا۟ يَٰمَٰلِكُ لِيَقْضِ عَلَيْنَا رَبُّكَ ۖ قَالَ إِنَّكُم مَّٰكِثُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And they will call, "O Malik, let your Lord put an end to us!" He will say, "Indeed, you will remain."
ayahs.clear: And they will cry, “O Malek, let your Lord finish us off.” He will say, “You are staying.”
ayahs.kemenag: Mereka berseru: "Hai Malik biarlah Tuhanmu membunuh kami saja". Dia menjawab: "Kamu akan tetap tinggal (di neraka ini)".

ayahs.arabic: لَقَدْ جِئْنَٰكُم بِٱلْحَقِّ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَكُمْ لِلْحَقِّ كَٰرِهُونَ
ayahs.sahih: We had certainly brought you the truth, but most of you, to the truth, were averse.
ayahs.clear: We have given you the truth, but most of you hate the truth.
ayahs.kemenag: Sesungguhnya Kami benar-benar telah memhawa kebenaran kepada kamu tetapi kebanyakan di antara kamu benci pada kebenaran itu.

ayahs.arabic: أَمْ أَبْرَمُوٓا۟ أَمْرًۭا فَإِنَّا مُبْرِمُونَ
ayahs.sahih: Or have they devised [some] affair? But indeed, We are devising [a plan].
ayahs.clear: Have they contrived some scheme? We too are contriving.
ayahs.kemenag: Bahkan mereka telah menetapkan satu tipu daya (jahat), maka sesungguhnya Kami menetapkan pula.

ayahs.arabic: أَمْ يَحْسَبُونَ أَنَّا لَا نَسْمَعُ سِرَّهُمْ وَنَجْوَىٰهُم ۚ بَلَىٰ وَرُسُلُنَا لَدَيْهِمْ يَكْتُبُونَ
ayahs.sahih: Or do they think that We hear not their secrets and their private conversations? Yes, [We do], and Our messengers are with them recording.
ayahs.clear: Or do they think that We cannot hear their secrets and their conspiracies? Yes indeed, Our messengers are by them, writing down.
ayahs.kemenag: Apakah mereka mengira, bahwa Kami tidak mendengar rahasia dan bisikan-bisikan mereka? Sebenarnya (Kami mendengar), dan utusan-utusan (malaikat-malaikat) Kami selalu mencatat di sisi mereka.

ayahs.arabic: قُلْ إِن كَانَ لِلرَّحْمَٰنِ وَلَدٌۭ فَأَنَا۠ أَوَّلُ ٱلْعَٰبِدِينَ
ayahs.sahih: Say, [O Muhammad], "If the Most Merciful had a son, then I would be the first of [his] worshippers."
ayahs.clear: Say, “If the Most Gracious had a son, I would be the first to worship.”
ayahs.kemenag: Katakanlah, jika benar Tuhan Yang Maha Pemurah mempunyai anak, maka akulah (Muhammad) orang yang mula-mula memuliakan (anak itu).

ayahs.arabic: سُبْحَٰنَ رَبِّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ رَبِّ ٱلْعَرْشِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ
ayahs.sahih: Exalted is the Lord of the heavens and the earth, Lord of the Throne, above what they describe.
ayahs.clear: Glorified be the Lord of the heavens and the earth, the Lord of the Throne, beyond what they describe.
ayahs.kemenag: Maha Suci Tuhan Yang empunya langit dan bumi, Tuhan Yang empunya 'Arsy, dari apa yang mereka sifatkan itu.

ayahs.arabic: فَذَرْهُمْ يَخُوضُوا۟ وَيَلْعَبُوا۟ حَتَّىٰ يُلَٰقُوا۟ يَوْمَهُمُ ٱلَّذِى يُوعَدُونَ
ayahs.sahih: So leave them to converse vainly and amuse themselves until they meet their Day which they are promised.
ayahs.clear: So leave them to blunder and play, until they encounter their Day which they are promised.
ayahs.kemenag: Maka biarlah mereka tenggelam (dalam kesesatan) dan bermain-main sampai mereka menemui hari yang dijanjikan kepada mereka.

ayahs.arabic: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِى فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ إِلَٰهٌۭ وَفِى ٱلْأَرْضِ إِلَٰهٌۭ ۚ وَهُوَ ٱلْحَكِيمُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
ayahs.sahih: And it is Allah who is [the only] deity in the heaven, and on the earth [the only] deity. And He is the Wise, the Knowing.
ayahs.clear: It is He who is God in heaven, and God on earth. He is the Wise, the Knower.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan Dialah Tuhan (Yang disembah) di langit dan Tuhan (Yang disembah) di bumi dan Dialah Yang Maha Bijaksana lagi Maha Mengetahui.

ayahs.arabic: وَتَبَارَكَ ٱلَّذِى لَهُۥ مُلْكُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا وَعِندَهُۥ عِلْمُ ٱلسَّاعَةِ وَإِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And blessed is He to whom belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them and with whom is knowledge of the Hour and to whom you will be returned.
ayahs.clear: And blessed is He Who has sovereignty over the heavens and the earth and what is between them. He alone has knowledge of the Hour, and to Him you will be returned.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan Maha Suci Tuhan Yang mempunyai kerajaan langit dan bumi; dan apa yang ada di antara keduanya; dan di sisi-Nya-lah pengetahuan tentang hari kiamat dan hanya kepada-Nya-lah kamu dikembalikan.

ayahs.arabic: وَلَا يَمْلِكُ ٱلَّذِينَ يَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِهِ ٱلشَّفَٰعَةَ إِلَّا مَن شَهِدَ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَهُمْ يَعْلَمُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And those they invoke besides Him do not possess [power of] intercession; but only those who testify to the truth [can benefit], and they know.
ayahs.clear: Those they invoke besides Him are incapable of intercession; only those who testify to the truth and have knowledge.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan sembahan-sembahan yang mereka sembah selain Allah tidak dapat memberi syafa'at; akan tetapi (orang yang dapat memberi syafa'at ialah) orang yang mengakui yang hak (tauhid) dan mereka meyakini(nya).

ayahs.arabic: وَلَئِن سَأَلْتَهُم مَّنْ خَلَقَهُمْ لَيَقُولُنَّ ٱللَّهُ ۖ فَأَنَّىٰ يُؤْفَكُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And if you asked them who created them, they would surely say, "Allah." So how are they deluded?
ayahs.clear: And if you asked them, “Who created them?”, they would say, “God.” Why then do they deviate?
ayahs.kemenag: Dan sungguh jika kamu bertanya kepada mereka: "Siapakah yang menciptakan mereka, niscaya mereka menjawab: "Allah", maka bagaimanakah mereka dapat dipalingkan (dari menyembah Allah)?,

ayahs.arabic: وَقِيلِهِۦ يَٰرَبِّ إِنَّ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ قَوْمٌۭ لَّا يُؤْمِنُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And [Allah acknowledges] his saying, "O my Lord, indeed these are a people who do not believe."
ayahs.clear: As for his statement: “My Lord, these are a people who do not believe.”
ayahs.kemenag: dan (Allah mengetabui) ucapan Muhammad: "Ya Tuhanku, sesungguhnya mereka itu adalah kaum yang tidak beriman".

ayahs.arabic: فَٱصْفَحْ عَنْهُمْ وَقُلْ سَلَٰمٌۭ ۚ فَسَوْفَ يَعْلَمُونَ
ayahs.sahih: So turn aside from them and say, "Peace." But they are going to know.
ayahs.clear: Pardon them, and say, “Peace.” They will come to know.
ayahs.kemenag: Maka berpalinglah (hai Muhammad) dari mereka dan katakanlah: "Salam (selamat tinggal)". Kelak mereka akan mengetahui (nasib mereka yang buruk).

ayahs.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ حمٓ
ayahs.sahih: Ha, Meem.
ayahs.clear: Ha, Meem.
ayahs.kemenag: Haa miim.

ayahs.arabic: وَٱلْكِتَٰبِ ٱلْمُبِينِ
ayahs.sahih: By the clear Book,
ayahs.clear: By the Enlightening Scripture.
ayahs.kemenag: Demi Kitab (Al Quran) yang menjelaskan,

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّآ أَنزَلْنَٰهُ فِى لَيْلَةٍۢ مُّبَٰرَكَةٍ ۚ إِنَّا كُنَّا مُنذِرِينَ
ayahs.sahih: Indeed, We sent it down during a blessed night. Indeed, We were to warn [mankind].
ayahs.clear: We have revealed it on a Blessed Night—We have warned.
ayahs.kemenag: sesungguhnya Kami menurunkannya pada suatu malam yang diberkahi dan sesungguhnya Kami-lah yang memberi peringatan.

ayahs.arabic: فِيهَا يُفْرَقُ كُلُّ أَمْرٍ حَكِيمٍ
ayahs.sahih: On that night is made distinct every precise matter -
ayahs.clear: In it is distinguished every wise command.
ayahs.kemenag: Pada malam itu dijelaskan segala urusan yang penuh hikmah,

ayahs.arabic: أَمْرًۭا مِّنْ عِندِنَآ ۚ إِنَّا كُنَّا مُرْسِلِينَ
ayahs.sahih: [Every] matter [proceeding] from Us. Indeed, We were to send [a messenger]
ayahs.clear: A decree from Us. We have been sending messages.
ayahs.kemenag: (yaitu) urusan yang besar dari sisi Kami. Sesungguhnya Kami adalah Yang mengutus rasul-rasul,

ayahs.arabic: رَحْمَةًۭ مِّن رَّبِّكَ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
ayahs.sahih: As mercy from your Lord. Indeed, He is the Hearing, the Knowing.
ayahs.clear: As mercy from your Lord. He is the Hearer, the Knower.
ayahs.kemenag: sebagai rahmat dari Tuhanmu. Sesungguhnya Dialah Yang Maha Mendengar lagi Maha Mengetahui,

ayahs.arabic: رَبِّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَآ ۖ إِن كُنتُم مُّوقِنِينَ
ayahs.sahih: Lord of the heavens and the earth and that between them, if you would be certain.
ayahs.clear: Lord of the heavens and the earth and what is between them, if you know for sure.
ayahs.kemenag: Tuhan Yang memelihara langit dan bumi dan apa yang ada di antara keduanya, jika kamu adalah orang yang meyakini.

ayahs.arabic: لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ يُحْىِۦ وَيُمِيتُ ۖ رَبُّكُمْ وَرَبُّ ءَابَآئِكُمُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
ayahs.sahih: There is no deity except Him; He gives life and causes death. [He is] your Lord and the Lord of your first forefathers.
ayahs.clear: There is no god but He. He gives life and causes death—your Lord and Lord of your ancestors of old.
ayahs.kemenag: Tidak ada Tuhan (yang berhak disembah) melainkan Dia, Yang menghidupkan dan Yang mematikan (Dialah) Tuhanmu dan Tuhan bapak-bapakmu yang terdahulu.

ayahs.arabic: بَلْ هُمْ فِى شَكٍّۢ يَلْعَبُونَ
ayahs.sahih: But they are in doubt, amusing themselves.
ayahs.clear: Yet they play around in doubt.
ayahs.kemenag: Tetapi mereka bermain-main dalam keragu-raguan.

ayahs.arabic: فَٱرْتَقِبْ يَوْمَ تَأْتِى ٱلسَّمَآءُ بِدُخَانٍۢ مُّبِينٍۢ
ayahs.sahih: Then watch for the Day when the sky will bring a visible smoke.
ayahs.clear: So watch out for the Day when the sky produces a visible smoke.
ayahs.kemenag: Maka tunggulah hari ketika langit membawa kabut yang nyata,

ayahs.arabic: يَغْشَى ٱلنَّاسَ ۖ هَٰذَا عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌۭ
ayahs.sahih: Covering the people; this is a painful torment.
ayahs.clear: Enveloping mankind; this is a painful punishment.
ayahs.kemenag: yang meliputi manusia. Inilah azab yang pedih.

ayahs.arabic: رَّبَّنَا ٱكْشِفْ عَنَّا ٱلْعَذَابَ إِنَّا مُؤْمِنُونَ
ayahs.sahih: [They will say], "Our Lord, remove from us the torment; indeed, we are believers."
ayahs.clear: “Our Lord, lift the torment from us, we are believers.”
ayahs.kemenag: (Mereka berdoa): "Ya Tuhan kami, lenyapkanlah dari kami azab itu. Sesungguhnya kami akan beriman".

ayahs.arabic: أَنَّىٰ لَهُمُ ٱلذِّكْرَىٰ وَقَدْ جَآءَهُمْ رَسُولٌۭ مُّبِينٌۭ
ayahs.sahih: How will there be for them a reminder [at that time]? And there had come to them a clear Messenger.
ayahs.clear: But how can they be reminded? An enlightening messenger has already come to them.
ayahs.kemenag: Bagaimanakah mereka dapat menerima peringatan, padahal telah datang kepada mereka seorang rasul yang memberi penjelasan,

ayahs.arabic: ثُمَّ تَوَلَّوْا۟ عَنْهُ وَقَالُوا۟ مُعَلَّمٌۭ مَّجْنُونٌ
ayahs.sahih: Then they turned away from him and said, "[He was] taught [and is] a madman."
ayahs.clear: But they turned away from him, and said, “Educated, but crazy!”
ayahs.kemenag: kemudian mereka berpaling daripadanya dan berkata: "Dia adalah seorang yang menerima ajaran (dari orang lain) lagi pula seorang yang gila".

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّا كَاشِفُوا۟ ٱلْعَذَابِ قَلِيلًا ۚ إِنَّكُمْ عَآئِدُونَ
ayahs.sahih: Indeed, We will remove the torment for a little. Indeed, you [disbelievers] will return [to disbelief].
ayahs.clear: We will ease the punishment a little, but you will revert.
ayahs.kemenag: Sesungguhnya (kalau) Kami akan melenyapkan siksaan itu agak sedikit sesungguhnya kamu akan kembali (ingkar).

ayahs.arabic: يَوْمَ نَبْطِشُ ٱلْبَطْشَةَ ٱلْكُبْرَىٰٓ إِنَّا مُنتَقِمُونَ
ayahs.sahih: The Day We will strike with the greatest assault, indeed, We will take retribution.
ayahs.clear: The Day when We launch the Great Assault—We will avenge.
ayahs.kemenag: (Ingatlah) hari (ketika) Kami menghantam mereka dengan hantaman yang keras. Sesungguhnya Kami adalah Pemberi balasan.

ayahs.arabic: ۞ وَلَقَدْ فَتَنَّا قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمَ فِرْعَوْنَ وَجَآءَهُمْ رَسُولٌۭ كَرِيمٌ
ayahs.sahih: And We had already tried before them the people of Pharaoh, and there came to them a noble messenger,
ayahs.clear: Before them We tested the people of Pharaoh; a noble messenger came to them.
ayahs.kemenag: Sesungguhnya sebelum mereka telah Kami uji kaum Fir'aun dan telah datang kepada mereka seorang rasul yang mulia,

ayahs.arabic: أَنْ أَدُّوٓا۟ إِلَىَّ عِبَادَ ٱللَّهِ ۖ إِنِّى لَكُمْ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٌۭ
ayahs.sahih: [Saying], "Render to me the servants of Allah. Indeed, I am to you a trustworthy messenger,"
ayahs.clear: Saying, “Hand over God’s servants to me. I am an honest messenger to you.”
ayahs.kemenag: (dengan berkata): "Serahkanlah kepadaku hamba-hamba Allah (Bani Israil yang kamu perbudak). Sesungguhnya aku adalah utusan (Allah) yang dipercaya kepadamu,

ayahs.arabic: وَأَن لَّا تَعْلُوا۟ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ ۖ إِنِّىٓ ءَاتِيكُم بِسُلْطَٰنٍۢ مُّبِينٍۢ
ayahs.sahih: And [saying], "Be not haughty with Allah. Indeed, I have come to you with clear authority.
ayahs.clear: And, “Do not exalt yourselves above God. I come to you with clear authority.
ayahs.kemenag: dan janganlah kamu menyombongkan diri terhadap Allah. Sesungguhnya aku datang kepadamu dengan membawa bukti yang nyata.

ayahs.arabic: وَإِنِّى عُذْتُ بِرَبِّى وَرَبِّكُمْ أَن تَرْجُمُونِ
ayahs.sahih: And indeed, I have sought refuge in my Lord and your Lord, lest you stone me.
ayahs.clear: I have taken refuge in my Lord and your Lord, lest you stone me.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan sesungguhnya aku berlindung kepada Tuhanku dan Tuhanmu, dari keinginanmu merajamku,

ayahs.arabic: وَإِن لَّمْ تُؤْمِنُوا۟ لِى فَٱعْتَزِلُونِ
ayahs.sahih: But if you do not believe me, then leave me alone."
ayahs.clear: But if you do not believe in me, keep away from me.”
ayahs.kemenag: dan jika kamu tidak beriman kepadaku maka biarkanlah aku (memimpin Bani Israil)".

ayahs.arabic: فَدَعَا رَبَّهُۥٓ أَنَّ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ قَوْمٌۭ مُّجْرِمُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And [finally] he called to his Lord that these were a criminal people.
ayahs.clear: He appealed to his Lord: “These are a sinful people.”
ayahs.kemenag: Kemudian Musa berdoa kepada Tuhannya: "Sesungguhnya mereka ini adalah kaum yang berdosa (segerakanlah azab kepada mereka)".

ayahs.arabic: فَأَسْرِ بِعِبَادِى لَيْلًا إِنَّكُم مُّتَّبَعُونَ
ayahs.sahih: [Allah said], "Then set out with My servants by night. Indeed, you are to be pursued.
ayahs.clear: “Set out with My servants by night—you will be followed.
ayahs.kemenag: (Allah berfirman): "Maka berjalanlah kamu dengan membawa hamba-hamba-Ku pada malam hari, sesungguhnya kamu akan dikejar,

ayahs.arabic: وَٱتْرُكِ ٱلْبَحْرَ رَهْوًا ۖ إِنَّهُمْ جُندٌۭ مُّغْرَقُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And leave the sea in stillness. Indeed, they are an army to be drowned."
ayahs.clear: And cross the sea quickly; they are an army to be drowned.”
ayahs.kemenag: dan biarkanlah laut itu tetap terbelah. Sesungguhnya mereka adalah tentara yang akan ditenggelamkan".

ayahs.arabic: كَمْ تَرَكُوا۟ مِن جَنَّٰتٍۢ وَعُيُونٍۢ
ayahs.sahih: How much they left behind of gardens and springs
ayahs.clear: How many gardens and fountains did they leave behind?
ayahs.kemenag: Alangkah banyaknya taman dan mata air yang mereka tinggalkan,

ayahs.arabic: وَزُرُوعٍۢ وَمَقَامٍۢ كَرِيمٍۢ
ayahs.sahih: And crops and noble sites
ayahs.clear: And plantations, and splendid buildings.
ayahs.kemenag: dan kebun-kebun serta tempat-tempat yang indah-indah,

ayahs.arabic: وَنَعْمَةٍۢ كَانُوا۟ فِيهَا فَٰكِهِينَ
ayahs.sahih: And comfort wherein they were amused.
ayahs.clear: And comforts they used to enjoy.
ayahs.kemenag: dan kesenangan-kesenangan yang mereka menikmatinya,

ayahs.arabic: كَذَٰلِكَ ۖ وَأَوْرَثْنَٰهَا قَوْمًا ءَاخَرِينَ
ayahs.sahih: Thus. And We caused to inherit it another people.
ayahs.clear: So it was; and We passed it on to another people.
ayahs.kemenag: demikianlah. Dan Kami wariskan semua itu kepada kaum yang lain.

ayahs.arabic: فَمَا بَكَتْ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلسَّمَآءُ وَٱلْأَرْضُ وَمَا كَانُوا۟ مُنظَرِينَ
ayahs.sahih: And the heaven and earth wept not for them, nor were they reprieved.
ayahs.clear: Neither heaven nor earth wept over them, nor were they reprieved.
ayahs.kemenag: Maka langit dan bumi tidak menangisi mereka dan merekapun tidak diberi tangguh.

ayahs.arabic: وَلَقَدْ نَجَّيْنَا بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ مِنَ ٱلْعَذَابِ ٱلْمُهِينِ
ayahs.sahih: And We certainly saved the Children of Israel from the humiliating torment -
ayahs.clear: And We delivered the Children of Israel from the humiliating persecution.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan sesungguhnya telah Kami selamatkan Bani Israil dari siksa yang menghinakan,

ayahs.arabic: مِن فِرْعَوْنَ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ عَالِيًۭا مِّنَ ٱلْمُسْرِفِينَ
ayahs.sahih: From Pharaoh. Indeed, he was a haughty one among the transgressors.
ayahs.clear: From Pharaoh. He was a transgressing tyrant.
ayahs.kemenag: dari (azab) Fir'aun. Sesungguhnya dia adalah orang yang sombong, salah seorang dari orang-orang yang melampaui batas.

ayahs.arabic: وَلَقَدِ ٱخْتَرْنَٰهُمْ عَلَىٰ عِلْمٍ عَلَى ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
ayahs.sahih: And We certainly chose them by knowledge over [all] the worlds.
ayahs.clear: And We chose them knowingly over all other people.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan sesungguhnya telah Kami pilih mereka dengan pengetahuan (Kami) atas bangsa-bangsa.

ayahs.arabic: وَءَاتَيْنَٰهُم مِّنَ ٱلْءَايَٰتِ مَا فِيهِ بَلَٰٓؤٌۭا۟ مُّبِينٌ
ayahs.sahih: And We gave them of signs that in which there was a clear trial.
ayahs.clear: And We gave them many signs, in which was an obvious test.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan Kami telah memberikan kepada mereka di antara tanda-tanda kekuasaan (Kami) sesuatu yang di dalamnya terdapat nikmat yang nyata.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ لَيَقُولُونَ
ayahs.sahih: Indeed, these [disbelievers] are saying,
ayahs.clear: These people say.
ayahs.kemenag: Sesungguhnya mereka (kaum musyrik) itu benar-benar berkata,

ayahs.arabic: إِنْ هِىَ إِلَّا مَوْتَتُنَا ٱلْأُولَىٰ وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمُنشَرِينَ
ayahs.sahih: "There is not but our first death, and we will not be resurrected.
ayahs.clear: “There is nothing but our first death, and we will not be resurrected.
ayahs.kemenag: "tidak ada kematian selain kematian di dunia ini. Dan kami sekali-kali tidak akan dibangkitkan,

ayahs.arabic: فَأْتُوا۟ بِـَٔابَآئِنَآ إِن كُنتُمْ صَٰدِقِينَ
ayahs.sahih: Then bring [back] our forefathers, if you should be truthful."
ayahs.clear: Bring back our ancestors, if you are truthful.”
ayahs.kemenag: maka datangkanlah (kembali) bapak-bapak kami jika kamu memang orang-orang yang benar".

ayahs.arabic: أَهُمْ خَيْرٌ أَمْ قَوْمُ تُبَّعٍۢ وَٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ ۚ أَهْلَكْنَٰهُمْ ۖ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ مُجْرِمِينَ
ayahs.sahih: Are they better or the people of Tubba' and those before them? We destroyed them, [for] indeed, they were criminals.
ayahs.clear: Are they better, or the people of Tubba and those before them? We annihilated them. They were evildoers.
ayahs.kemenag: Apakah mereka (kaum musyrikin) yang lebih baik ataukah kaum Tubba' dan orang-orang yang sebelum mereka. Kami telah membinasakan mereka karena sesungguhnya mereka adalah orang-orang yang berdosa.

ayahs.arabic: وَمَا خَلَقْنَا ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا لَٰعِبِينَ
ayahs.sahih: And We did not create the heavens and earth and that between them in play.
ayahs.clear: We did not create the heavens and the earth and what is between them to play.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan Kami tidak menciptakan langit dan bumi dan apa yang ada antara keduanya dengan bermain-main.

ayahs.arabic: مَا خَلَقْنَٰهُمَآ إِلَّا بِٱلْحَقِّ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
ayahs.sahih: We did not create them except in truth, but most of them do not know.
ayahs.clear: We created them only for a specific purpose, but most of them do not know.
ayahs.kemenag: Kami tidak menciptakan keduanya melainkan dengan haq, tetapi kebanyakan mereka tidak mengetahui.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ يَوْمَ ٱلْفَصْلِ مِيقَٰتُهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
ayahs.sahih: Indeed, the Day of Judgement is the appointed time for them all -
ayahs.clear: The Day of Sorting Out is the appointed time for them all.
ayahs.kemenag: Sesungguhnya hari keputusan (hari kiamat) itu adalah waktu yang dijanjikan bagi mereka semuanya,

ayahs.arabic: يَوْمَ لَا يُغْنِى مَوْلًى عَن مَّوْلًۭى شَيْـًۭٔا وَلَا هُمْ يُنصَرُونَ
ayahs.sahih: The Day when no relation will avail a relation at all, nor will they be helped -
ayahs.clear: The Day when no friend will avail a friend in any way, and they will not be helped.
ayahs.kemenag: yaitu hari yang seorang karib tidak dapat memberi manfaat kepada karibnya sedikitpun, dan mereka tidak akan mendapat pertolongan,

ayahs.arabic: إِلَّا مَن رَّحِمَ ٱللَّهُ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
ayahs.sahih: Except those [believers] on whom Allah has mercy. Indeed, He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.
ayahs.clear: Except for him upon whom God has mercy. He is the Mighty, the Merciful.
ayahs.kemenag: kecuali orang yang diberi rahmat oleh Allah. Sesungguhnya Dialah Yang Maha Perkasa lagi Maha Penyayang.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ شَجَرَتَ ٱلزَّقُّومِ
ayahs.sahih: Indeed, the tree of zaqqum
ayahs.clear: The Tree of Bitterness.
ayahs.kemenag: Sesungguhnya pohon zaqqum itu,

ayahs.arabic: طَعَامُ ٱلْأَثِيمِ
ayahs.sahih: Is food for the sinful.
ayahs.clear: The food of the sinner.
ayahs.kemenag: makanan orang yang banyak berdosa.

ayahs.arabic: كَٱلْمُهْلِ يَغْلِى فِى ٱلْبُطُونِ
ayahs.sahih: Like murky oil, it boils within bellies
ayahs.clear: Like molten lead; boiling inside the bellies.
ayahs.kemenag: (Ia) sebagai kotoran minyak yang mendidih di dalam perut,

ayahs.arabic: كَغَلْىِ ٱلْحَمِيمِ
ayahs.sahih: Like the boiling of scalding water.
ayahs.clear: Like the boiling of seething water.
ayahs.kemenag: seperti mendidihnya air yang amat panas.

ayahs.arabic: خُذُوهُ فَٱعْتِلُوهُ إِلَىٰ سَوَآءِ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
ayahs.sahih: [It will be commanded], "Seize him and drag him into the midst of the Hellfire,
ayahs.clear: Seize him and drag him into the midst of Hell!
ayahs.kemenag: Peganglah dia kemudian seretlah dia ke tengah-tengah neraka.

ayahs.arabic: ثُمَّ صُبُّوا۟ فَوْقَ رَأْسِهِۦ مِنْ عَذَابِ ٱلْحَمِيمِ
ayahs.sahih: Then pour over his head from the torment of scalding water."
ayahs.clear: Then pour over his head the suffering of the Inferno!
ayahs.kemenag: Kemudian tuangkanlah di atas kepalanya siksaan (dari) air yang amat panas.

ayahs.arabic: ذُقْ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْكَرِيمُ
ayahs.sahih: [It will be said], "Taste! Indeed, you are the honored, the noble!
ayahs.clear: Taste! You who were powerful and noble.
ayahs.kemenag: Rasakanlah, sesungguhnya kamu orang yang perkasa lagi mulia.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ هَٰذَا مَا كُنتُم بِهِۦ تَمْتَرُونَ
ayahs.sahih: Indeed, this is what you used to dispute."
ayahs.clear: This is what you used to doubt.
ayahs.kemenag: Sesungguhnya ini adalah azab yang dahulu selalu kamu meragu-ragukannya.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِى مَقَامٍ أَمِينٍۢ
ayahs.sahih: Indeed, the righteous will be in a secure place;
ayahs.clear: As for the righteous, they will be in a secure place.
ayahs.kemenag: Sesungguhnya orang-orang yang bertakwa berada dalam tempat yang aman,

ayahs.arabic: فِى جَنَّٰتٍۢ وَعُيُونٍۢ
ayahs.sahih: Within gardens and springs,
ayahs.clear: Amidst gardens and springs.
ayahs.kemenag: (yaitu) di dalam taman-taman dan mata-air-mata-air;

ayahs.arabic: يَلْبَسُونَ مِن سُندُسٍۢ وَإِسْتَبْرَقٍۢ مُّتَقَٰبِلِينَ
ayahs.sahih: Wearing [garments of] fine silk and brocade, facing each other.
ayahs.clear: Dressed in silk and brocade, facing one another.
ayahs.kemenag: mereka memakai sutera yang halus dan sutera yang tebal, (duduk) berhadap-hadapan,

ayahs.arabic: كَذَٰلِكَ وَزَوَّجْنَٰهُم بِحُورٍ عِينٍۢ
ayahs.sahih: Thus. And We will marry them to fair women with large, [beautiful] eyes.
ayahs.clear: So it is, and We will wed them to lovely companions.
ayahs.kemenag: demikianlah. Dan Kami berikan kepada mereka bidadari.

ayahs.arabic: يَدْعُونَ فِيهَا بِكُلِّ فَٰكِهَةٍ ءَامِنِينَ
ayahs.sahih: They will call therein for every [kind of] fruit - safe and secure.
ayahs.clear: They will call therein for every kind of fruit, in peace and security.
ayahs.kemenag: Di dalamnya mereka meminta segala macam buah-buahan dengan aman (dari segala kekhawatiran),

ayahs.arabic: لَا يَذُوقُونَ فِيهَا ٱلْمَوْتَ إِلَّا ٱلْمَوْتَةَ ٱلْأُولَىٰ ۖ وَوَقَىٰهُمْ عَذَابَ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
ayahs.sahih: They will not taste death therein except the first death, and He will have protected them from the punishment of Hellfire
ayahs.clear: Therein they will not taste death, beyond the first death; and He will protect them from the torment of Hell.
ayahs.kemenag: mereka tidak akan merasakan mati di dalamnya kecuali mati di dunia. Dan Allah memelihara mereka dari azab neraka,

ayahs.arabic: فَضْلًۭا مِّن رَّبِّكَ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ هُوَ ٱلْفَوْزُ ٱلْعَظِيمُ
ayahs.sahih: As bounty from your Lord. That is what is the great attainment.
ayahs.clear: A favor from your Lord. That is the supreme salvation.
ayahs.kemenag: sebagai karunia dari Tuhanmu. Yang demikian itu adalah keberuntungan yang besar.

ayahs.arabic: فَإِنَّمَا يَسَّرْنَٰهُ بِلِسَانِكَ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَتَذَكَّرُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And indeed, We have eased the Qur'an in your tongue that they might be reminded.
ayahs.clear: We made it easy in your language, so that they may remember.
ayahs.kemenag: Sesungguhnya Kami mudahkan Al Quran itu dengan bahasamu supaya mereka mendapat pelajaran.

ayahs.arabic: فَٱرْتَقِبْ إِنَّهُم مُّرْتَقِبُونَ
ayahs.sahih: So watch, [O Muhammad]; indeed, they are watching [for your end].
ayahs.clear: So wait and watch. They too are waiting and watching.
ayahs.kemenag: Maka tunggulah; sesungguhnya mereka itu menunggu (pula).

ayahs.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ حمٓ
ayahs.sahih: Ha, Meem.
ayahs.clear: Ha, Meem.
ayahs.kemenag: Haa Miim

ayahs.arabic: تَنزِيلُ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْحَكِيمِ
ayahs.sahih: The revelation of the Book is from Allah, the Exalted in Might, the Wise.
ayahs.clear: The revelation of the Book is from God, the Exalted in Might, the Wise.
ayahs.kemenag: Kitab (ini) diturunkan dari Allah Yang Maha Perkasa lagi Maha Bijaksana.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ لَءَايَٰتٍۢ لِّلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
ayahs.sahih: Indeed, within the heavens and earth are signs for the believers.
ayahs.clear: In the heavens and the earth are proofs for the believers.
ayahs.kemenag: Sesungguhnya pada langit dan bumi benar-benar terdapat tanda-tanda (kekuasaan Allah) untuk orang-orang yang beriman.

ayahs.arabic: وَفِى خَلْقِكُمْ وَمَا يَبُثُّ مِن دَآبَّةٍ ءَايَٰتٌۭ لِّقَوْمٍۢ يُوقِنُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And in the creation of yourselves and what He disperses of moving creatures are signs for people who are certain [in faith].
ayahs.clear: And in your own creation, and in the creatures He scattered, are signs for people of firm faith.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan pada penciptakan kamu dan pada binatang-binatang yang melata yang bertebaran (di muka bumi) terdapat tanda-tanda (kekuasaan Allah) untuk kaum yang meyakini,

ayahs.arabic: وَٱخْتِلَٰفِ ٱلَّيْلِ وَٱلنَّهَارِ وَمَآ أَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مِن رِّزْقٍۢ فَأَحْيَا بِهِ ٱلْأَرْضَ بَعْدَ مَوْتِهَا وَتَصْرِيفِ ٱلرِّيَٰحِ ءَايَٰتٌۭ لِّقَوْمٍۢ يَعْقِلُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And [in] the alternation of night and day and [in] what Allah sends down from the sky of provision and gives life thereby to the earth after its lifelessness and [in His] directing of the winds are signs for a people who reason.
ayahs.clear: And in the alternation of night and day, and in the sustenance God sends down from the sky, with which He revives the earth after its death, and in the circulation of the winds, are marvels for people who reason.
ayahs.kemenag: dan pada pergantian malam dan siang dan hujan yang diturunkan Allah dari langit lalu dihidupkan-Nya dengan air hujan itu bumi sesudah matinya; dan pada perkisaran angin terdapat tanda-tanda (kekuasaan Allah) bagi kaum yang berakal.

ayahs.arabic: تِلْكَ ءَايَٰتُ ٱللَّهِ نَتْلُوهَا عَلَيْكَ بِٱلْحَقِّ ۖ فَبِأَىِّ حَدِيثٍۭ بَعْدَ ٱللَّهِ وَءَايَٰتِهِۦ يُؤْمِنُونَ
ayahs.sahih: These are the verses of Allah which We recite to you in truth. Then in what statement after Allah and His verses will they believe?
ayahs.clear: These are God’s Verses which We recite to you in truth. In which message, after God and His revelations, will they believe?
ayahs.kemenag: Itulah ayat-ayat Allah yang Kami membacakannya kepadamu dengan sebenarnya; maka dengan perkataan manakah lagi mereka akan beriman sesudah (kalam) Allah dan keterangan-keterangan-Nya.

ayahs.arabic: وَيْلٌۭ لِّكُلِّ أَفَّاكٍ أَثِيمٍۢ
ayahs.sahih: Woe to every sinful liar
ayahs.clear: Woe to every sinful liar.
ayahs.kemenag: Kecelakaan besarlah bagi tiap-tiap orang yang banyak berdusta lagi banyak berdosa,

ayahs.arabic: يَسْمَعُ ءَايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِ ثُمَّ يُصِرُّ مُسْتَكْبِرًۭا كَأَن لَّمْ يَسْمَعْهَا ۖ فَبَشِّرْهُ بِعَذَابٍ أَلِيمٍۢ
ayahs.sahih: Who hears the verses of Allah recited to him, then persists arrogantly as if he had not heard them. So give him tidings of a painful punishment.
ayahs.clear: Who hears God's revelations being recited to him, yet he persists arrogantly, as though he did not hear them. Announce to him a painful punishment.
ayahs.kemenag: dia mendengar ayat-ayat Allah dibacakan kepadanya kemudian dia tetap menyombongkan diri seakan-akan dia tidak mendengarnya. Maka beri khabar gembiralah dia dengan azab yang pedih.

ayahs.arabic: وَإِذَا عَلِمَ مِنْ ءَايَٰتِنَا شَيْـًٔا ٱتَّخَذَهَا هُزُوًا ۚ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌۭ مُّهِينٌۭ
ayahs.sahih: And when he knows anything of Our verses, he takes them in ridicule. Those will have a humiliating punishment.
ayahs.clear: And when he learns something of Our revelations, he takes them in mockery. For such there is a shameful punishment.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan apabila dia mengetahui barang sedikit tentang ayat-ayat Kami, maka ayat-ayat itu dijadikan olok-olok. Merekalah yang memperoleh azab yang menghinakan.

ayahs.arabic: مِّن وَرَآئِهِمْ جَهَنَّمُ ۖ وَلَا يُغْنِى عَنْهُم مَّا كَسَبُوا۟ شَيْـًۭٔا وَلَا مَا ٱتَّخَذُوا۟ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ أَوْلِيَآءَ ۖ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ عَظِيمٌ
ayahs.sahih: Before them is Hell, and what they had earned will not avail them at all nor what they had taken besides Allah as allies. And they will have a great punishment.
ayahs.clear: Beyond them lies Hell. What they have earned will not benefit them at all, nor will those they adopted as lords instead of God. They will have a terrible punishment.
ayahs.kemenag: Di hadapan mereka neraka Jahannam dan tidak akan berguna bagi mereka sedikitpun apa yang telah mereka kerjakan, dan tidak pula berguna apa yang mereka jadikan sebagai sembahan-sembahan (mereka) dari selain Allah. Dan bagi mereka azab yang besar.

ayahs.arabic: هَٰذَا هُدًۭى ۖ وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِ رَبِّهِمْ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌۭ مِّن رِّجْزٍ أَلِيمٌ
ayahs.sahih: This [Qur'an] is guidance. And those who have disbelieved in the verses of their Lord will have a painful punishment of foul nature.
ayahs.clear: This is guidance. Those who blaspheme their Lord’s revelations will have a punishment of agonizing pain.
ayahs.kemenag: Ini (Al Quran) adalah petunjuk. Dan orang-orang yang kafir kepada ayat-ayat Tuhannya bagi mereka azab yaitu siksaan yang sangat pedih.

ayahs.arabic: ۞ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِى سَخَّرَ لَكُمُ ٱلْبَحْرَ لِتَجْرِىَ ٱلْفُلْكُ فِيهِ بِأَمْرِهِۦ وَلِتَبْتَغُوا۟ مِن فَضْلِهِۦ وَلَعَلَّكُمْ تَشْكُرُونَ
ayahs.sahih: It is Allah who subjected to you the sea so that ships may sail upon it by His command and that you may seek of His bounty; and perhaps you will be grateful.
ayahs.clear: It is God who placed the sea at your service, so that ships may run through it by His command, and that you may seek of His bounty, and that you may give thanks.
ayahs.kemenag: Allah-lah yang menundukkan lautan untukmu supaya kapal-kapal dapat berlayar padanya dengan seizin-Nya dan supaya kamu dapat mencari karunia -Nya dan mudah-mudahan kamu bersyukur.

ayahs.arabic: وَسَخَّرَ لَكُم مَّا فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ جَمِيعًۭا مِّنْهُ ۚ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَءَايَٰتٍۢ لِّقَوْمٍۢ يَتَفَكَّرُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And He has subjected to you whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth - all from Him. Indeed in that are signs for a people who give thought.
ayahs.clear: And He placed at your service whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on earth—all is from Him. In that are signs for a people who think.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan Dia telah menundukkan untukmu apa yang di langit dan apa yang di bumi semuanya, (sebagai rahmat) daripada-Nya. Sesungguhnya pada yang demikian itu benar-benar terdapat tanda-tanda (kekuasaan Allah) bagi kaum yang berfikir.

ayahs.arabic: قُل لِّلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ يَغْفِرُوا۟ لِلَّذِينَ لَا يَرْجُونَ أَيَّامَ ٱللَّهِ لِيَجْزِىَ قَوْمًۢا بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَكْسِبُونَ
ayahs.sahih: Say, [O Muhammad], to those who have believed that they [should] forgive those who expect not the days of Allah so that He may recompense a people for what they used to earn.
ayahs.clear: Tell those who believe to forgive those who do not hope for the Days of God. He will fully recompense people for whatever they have earned.
ayahs.kemenag: Katakanlah kepada orang-orang yang beriman hendaklah mereka memaafkan orang-orang yang tiada takut hari-hari Allah karena Dia akan membalas sesuatu kaum terhadap apa yang telah mereka kerjakan.

ayahs.arabic: مَنْ عَمِلَ صَٰلِحًۭا فَلِنَفْسِهِۦ ۖ وَمَنْ أَسَآءَ فَعَلَيْهَا ۖ ثُمَّ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكُمْ تُرْجَعُونَ
ayahs.sahih: Whoever does a good deed - it is for himself; and whoever does evil - it is against the self. Then to your Lord you will be returned.
ayahs.clear: Whoever does a good deed, it is for his soul; and whoever commits evil, it is against it; then to your Lord you will be returned.
ayahs.kemenag: Barangsiapa yang mengerjakan amal saleh, maka itu adalah untuk dirinya sendiri, dan barangsiapa yang mengerjakan kejahatan, maka itu akan menimpa dirinya sendiri, kemudian kepada Tuhanmulah kamu dikembalikan.

ayahs.arabic: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ وَٱلْحُكْمَ وَٱلنُّبُوَّةَ وَرَزَقْنَٰهُم مِّنَ ٱلطَّيِّبَٰتِ وَفَضَّلْنَٰهُمْ عَلَى ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
ayahs.sahih: And We did certainly give the Children of Israel the Scripture and judgement and prophethood, and We provided them with good things and preferred them over the worlds.
ayahs.clear: We gave the Children of Israel the Book, and wisdom, and prophecy; and We provided them with the good things; and We gave them advantage over all other people.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan sesungguhnya telah Kami berikan kepada Bani Israil Al Kitab (Taurat), kekuasaan dan kenabian dan Kami berikan kepada mereka rezeki-rezeki yang baik dan Kami lebihkan mereka atas bangsa-bangsa (pada masanya).

ayahs.arabic: وَءَاتَيْنَٰهُم بَيِّنَٰتٍۢ مِّنَ ٱلْأَمْرِ ۖ فَمَا ٱخْتَلَفُوٓا۟ إِلَّا مِنۢ بَعْدِ مَا جَآءَهُمُ ٱلْعِلْمُ بَغْيًۢا بَيْنَهُمْ ۚ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ يَقْضِى بَيْنَهُمْ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ فِيمَا كَانُوا۟ فِيهِ يَخْتَلِفُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And We gave them clear proofs of the matter [of religion]. And they did not differ except after knowledge had come to them - out of jealous animosity between themselves. Indeed, your Lord will judge between them on the Day of Resurrection concerning that over which they used to differ.
ayahs.clear: And We gave them precise rulings. They fell into dispute only after knowledge came to them, out of mutual rivalry. Your Lord will judge between them on the Day of Resurrection regarding the things they differed about.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan Kami berikan kepada mereka keterangan-keterangan yang nyata tentang urusan (agama); maka mereka tidak berselisih melainkan sesudah datang kepada mereka pengetahuan karena kedengkian yang ada di antara mereka. Sesungguhnya Tuhanmu akan memutuskan antara mereka pada hari kiamat terhadap apa yang mereka selalu berselisih padanya.

ayahs.arabic: ثُمَّ جَعَلْنَٰكَ عَلَىٰ شَرِيعَةٍۢ مِّنَ ٱلْأَمْرِ فَٱتَّبِعْهَا وَلَا تَتَّبِعْ أَهْوَآءَ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
ayahs.sahih: Then We put you, [O Muhammad], on an ordained way concerning the matter [of religion]; so follow it and do not follow the inclinations of those who do not know.
ayahs.clear: Then We set you upon a pathway of faith, so follow it, and do not follow the inclinations of those who do not know.
ayahs.kemenag: Kemudian Kami jadikan kamu berada di atas suatu syariat (peraturan) dari urusan (agama itu), maka ikutilah syariat itu dan janganlah kamu ikuti hawa nafsu orang-orang yang tidak mengetahui.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّهُمْ لَن يُغْنُوا۟ عَنكَ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ شَيْـًۭٔا ۚ وَإِنَّ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ بَعْضُهُمْ أَوْلِيَآءُ بَعْضٍۢ ۖ وَٱللَّهُ وَلِىُّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ
ayahs.sahih: Indeed, they will never avail you against Allah at all. And indeed, the wrongdoers are allies of one another; but Allah is the protector of the righteous.
ayahs.clear: They will not help you against God in any way. The wrongdoers are allies of one another, while God is the Protector of the righteous.
ayahs.kemenag: Sesungguhnya mereka sekali-kali tidak akan dapat menolak dari kamu sedikitpun dari siksaan Allah. Dan Sesungguhnya orang-orang yang zalim itu sebagian mereka menjadi penolong bagi sebagian yang lain, dan Allah adalah pelindung orang-orang yang bertakwa.

ayahs.arabic: هَٰذَا بَصَٰٓئِرُ لِلنَّاسِ وَهُدًۭى وَرَحْمَةٌۭ لِّقَوْمٍۢ يُوقِنُونَ
ayahs.sahih: This [Qur'an] is enlightenment for mankind and guidance and mercy for a people who are certain [in faith].
ayahs.clear: This is an illumination for mankind, and guidance, and mercy for people who believe with certainty.
ayahs.kemenag: Al Quran ini adalah pedoman bagi manusia, petunjuk dan rahmat bagi kaum yang meyakini.

ayahs.arabic: أَمْ حَسِبَ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱجْتَرَحُوا۟ ٱلسَّيِّـَٔاتِ أَن نَّجْعَلَهُمْ كَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ سَوَآءًۭ مَّحْيَاهُمْ وَمَمَاتُهُمْ ۚ سَآءَ مَا يَحْكُمُونَ
ayahs.sahih: Or do those who commit evils think We will make them like those who have believed and done righteous deeds - [make them] equal in their life and their death? Evil is that which they judge.
