ayahs.kemenag: Orang-orang Badwi yang tertinggal itu akan berkata apabila kamu berangkat untuk mengambil barang rampasan: "Biarkanlah kami, niscaya kami mengikuti kamu"; mereka hendak merubah janji Allah. Katakanlah: "Kamu sekali-kali tidak (boleh) mengikuti kami; demikian Allah telah menetapkan sebelumnya"; mereka akan mengatakan: "Sebenarnya kamu dengki kepada kami". Bahkan mereka tidak mengerti melainkan sedikit sekali.

ayahs.arabic: قُل لِّلْمُخَلَّفِينَ مِنَ ٱلْأَعْرَابِ سَتُدْعَوْنَ إِلَىٰ قَوْمٍ أُو۟لِى بَأْسٍۢ شَدِيدٍۢ تُقَٰتِلُونَهُمْ أَوْ يُسْلِمُونَ ۖ فَإِن تُطِيعُوا۟ يُؤْتِكُمُ ٱللَّهُ أَجْرًا حَسَنًۭا ۖ وَإِن تَتَوَلَّوْا۟ كَمَا تَوَلَّيْتُم مِّن قَبْلُ يُعَذِّبْكُمْ عَذَابًا أَلِيمًۭا
ayahs.sahih: Say to those who remained behind of the bedouins, "You will be called to [face] a people of great military might; you may fight them, or they will submit. So if you obey, Allah will give you a good reward; but if you turn away as you turned away before, He will punish you with a painful punishment."
ayahs.clear: Say to the Desert-Arabs who lagged behind, “You will be called against a people of great might; you will fight them, unless they submit. If you obey, God will give you a fine reward. But if you turn away, as you turned away before, He will punish you with a painful punishment.”
ayahs.kemenag: Katakanlah kepada orang-orang Badwi yang tertinggal: "Kamu akan diajak untuk (memerangi) kaum yang mempunyai kekuatan yang besar, kamu akan memerangi mereka atau mereka menyerah (masuk Islam). Maka jika kamu patuhi (ajakan itu) niscaya Allah akan memberikan kepadamu pahala yang baik dan jika kamu berpaling sebagaimana kamu telah berpaling sebelumnya, niscaya Dia akan mengazab kamu dengan azab yang pedih".

ayahs.arabic: لَّيْسَ عَلَى ٱلْأَعْمَىٰ حَرَجٌۭ وَلَا عَلَى ٱلْأَعْرَجِ حَرَجٌۭ وَلَا عَلَى ٱلْمَرِيضِ حَرَجٌۭ ۗ وَمَن يُطِعِ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُۥ يُدْخِلْهُ جَنَّٰتٍۢ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَٰرُ ۖ وَمَن يَتَوَلَّ يُعَذِّبْهُ عَذَابًا أَلِيمًۭا
ayahs.sahih: There is not upon the blind any guilt or upon the lame any guilt or upon the ill any guilt [for remaining behind]. And whoever obeys Allah and His Messenger - He will admit him to gardens beneath which rivers flow; but whoever turns away - He will punish him with a painful punishment.
ayahs.clear: There is no blame on the blind, nor any blame on the lame, nor any blame on the sick. Whoever obeys God and His Messenger—He will admit him into gardens beneath which rivers flow; but whoever turns away—He will punish him with a painful punishment.
ayahs.kemenag: Tiada dosa atas orang-orang yang buta dan atas orang yang pincang dan atas orang yang sakit (apabila tidak ikut berperang). Dan barangsiapa yang taat kepada Allah dan Rasul-Nya; niscaya Allah akan memasukkannya ke dalam surga yang mengalir di bawahnya sungai-sungai dan barang siapa yang berpaling niscaya akan diazab-Nya dengan azab yang pedih.

ayahs.arabic: ۞ لَّقَدْ رَضِىَ ٱللَّهُ عَنِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ إِذْ يُبَايِعُونَكَ تَحْتَ ٱلشَّجَرَةِ فَعَلِمَ مَا فِى قُلُوبِهِمْ فَأَنزَلَ ٱلسَّكِينَةَ عَلَيْهِمْ وَأَثَٰبَهُمْ فَتْحًۭا قَرِيبًۭا
ayahs.sahih: Certainly was Allah pleased with the believers when they pledged allegiance to you, [O Muhammad], under the tree, and He knew what was in their hearts, so He sent down tranquillity upon them and rewarded them with an imminent conquest
ayahs.clear: God was pleased with the believers, when they pledged allegiance to you under the tree. He knew what was in their hearts, and sent down serenity upon them, and rewarded them with an imminent conquest.
ayahs.kemenag: Sesungguhnya Allah telah ridha terhadap orang-orang mukmin ketika mereka berjanji setia kepadamu di bawah pohon, maka Allah mengetahui apa yang ada dalam hati mereka lalu menurunkan ketenangan atas mereka dan memberi balasan kepada mereka dengan kemenangan yang dekat (waktunya).

ayahs.arabic: وَمَغَانِمَ كَثِيرَةًۭ يَأْخُذُونَهَا ۗ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ عَزِيزًا حَكِيمًۭا
ayahs.sahih: And much war booty which they will take. And ever is Allah Exalted in Might and Wise.
ayahs.clear: And abundant gains for them to capture. God is Mighty and Wise.
ayahs.kemenag: Serta harta rampasan yang banyak yang dapat mereka ambil. Dan adalah Allah Maha Perkasa lagi Maha Bijaksana.

ayahs.arabic: وَعَدَكُمُ ٱللَّهُ مَغَانِمَ كَثِيرَةًۭ تَأْخُذُونَهَا فَعَجَّلَ لَكُمْ هَٰذِهِۦ وَكَفَّ أَيْدِىَ ٱلنَّاسِ عَنكُمْ وَلِتَكُونَ ءَايَةًۭ لِّلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَيَهْدِيَكُمْ صِرَٰطًۭا مُّسْتَقِيمًۭا
ayahs.sahih: Allah has promised you much booty that you will take [in the future] and has hastened for you this [victory] and withheld the hands of people from you - that it may be a sign for the believers and [that] He may guide you to a straight path.
ayahs.clear: God has promised you abundant gains, which you will capture. He has expedited this for you, and has restrained people’s hands from you; that it may be a sign to the believers, and that He may guide you on a straight path.
ayahs.kemenag: Allah menjanjikan kepada kamu harta rampasan yang banyak yang dapat kamu ambil, maka disegerakan-Nya harta rampasan ini untukmu dan Dia menahan tangan manusia dari (membinasakan)mu (agar kamu mensyukuri-Nya) dan agar hal itu menjadi bukti bagi orang-orang mukmin dan agar Dia menunjuki kamu kepada jalan yang lurus.

ayahs.arabic: وَأُخْرَىٰ لَمْ تَقْدِرُوا۟ عَلَيْهَا قَدْ أَحَاطَ ٱللَّهُ بِهَا ۚ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ قَدِيرًۭا
ayahs.sahih: And [He promises] other [victories] that you were [so far] unable to [realize] which Allah has already encompassed. And ever is Allah, over all things, competent.
ayahs.clear: And other things, of which you were incapable, but God has encompassed them. God is Capable of everything.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan (telah menjanjikan pula kemenangan-kemenangan) yang lain (atas negeri-negeri) yang kamu belum dapat menguasainya yang sungguh Allah telah menentukan-Nya. Dan adalah Allah Maha Kuasa atas segala sesuatu.

ayahs.arabic: وَلَوْ قَٰتَلَكُمُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لَوَلَّوُا۟ ٱلْأَدْبَٰرَ ثُمَّ لَا يَجِدُونَ وَلِيًّۭا وَلَا نَصِيرًۭا
ayahs.sahih: And if those [Makkans] who disbelieve had fought you, they would have turned their backs [in flight]. Then they would not find a protector or a helper.
ayahs.clear: If those who disbelieve had fought you, they would have turned back and fled, then found neither protector nor helper.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan sekiranya orang-orang kafir itu memerangi kamu pastilah mereka berbalik melarikan diri ke belakang (kalah) kemudian mereka tiada memperoleh pelindung dan tidak (pula) penolong.

ayahs.arabic: سُنَّةَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلَّتِى قَدْ خَلَتْ مِن قَبْلُ ۖ وَلَن تَجِدَ لِسُنَّةِ ٱللَّهِ تَبْدِيلًۭا
ayahs.sahih: [This is] the established way of Allah which has occurred before. And never will you find in the way of Allah any change.
ayahs.clear: It is God’s pattern, ongoing since the past. You will never find any change in God’s pattern.
ayahs.kemenag: Sebagai suatu sunnatullah yang telah berlaku sejak dahulu, kamu sekali-kali tiada akan menemukan perubahan bagi sunnatullah itu.

ayahs.arabic: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِى كَفَّ أَيْدِيَهُمْ عَنكُمْ وَأَيْدِيَكُمْ عَنْهُم بِبَطْنِ مَكَّةَ مِنۢ بَعْدِ أَنْ أَظْفَرَكُمْ عَلَيْهِمْ ۚ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ بَصِيرًا
ayahs.sahih: And it is He who withheld their hands from you and your hands from them within [the area of] Makkah after He caused you to overcome them. And ever is Allah of what you do, Seeing.
ayahs.clear: It is He who withheld their hands from you, and your hands from them, in the valley of Mecca, after giving you advantage over them. God is Observer of what you do.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan Dialah yang menahan tangan mereka dari (membinasakan) kamu dan (menahan) tangan kamu dari (membinasakan) mereka di tengah kota Mekah sesudah Allah memenangkan kamu atas mereka, dan adalah Allah Maha Melihat apa yang kamu kerjakan.

ayahs.arabic: هُمُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ وَصَدُّوكُمْ عَنِ ٱلْمَسْجِدِ ٱلْحَرَامِ وَٱلْهَدْىَ مَعْكُوفًا أَن يَبْلُغَ مَحِلَّهُۥ ۚ وَلَوْلَا رِجَالٌۭ مُّؤْمِنُونَ وَنِسَآءٌۭ مُّؤْمِنَٰتٌۭ لَّمْ تَعْلَمُوهُمْ أَن تَطَـُٔوهُمْ فَتُصِيبَكُم مِّنْهُم مَّعَرَّةٌۢ بِغَيْرِ عِلْمٍۢ ۖ لِّيُدْخِلَ ٱللَّهُ فِى رَحْمَتِهِۦ مَن يَشَآءُ ۚ لَوْ تَزَيَّلُوا۟ لَعَذَّبْنَا ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِنْهُمْ عَذَابًا أَلِيمًا
ayahs.sahih: They are the ones who disbelieved and obstructed you from al-Masjid al-Haram while the offering was prevented from reaching its place of sacrifice. And if not for believing men and believing women whom you did not know - that you might trample them and there would befall you because of them dishonor without [your] knowledge - [you would have been permitted to enter Makkah]. [This was so] that Allah might admit to His mercy whom He willed. If they had been apart [from them], We would have punished those who disbelieved among them with painful punishment
ayahs.clear: It is they who disbelieved, and barred you from the Sacred Mosque, and prevented the offering from reaching its destination. Were it not for faithful men and faithful women, whom you did not know, you were about to hurt them, and became guilty of an unintentional crime. Thus God admits into His mercy whomever He wills. Had they dispersed, We would have punished those who disbelieved among them with a painful penalty.
ayahs.kemenag: Merekalah orang-orang yang kafir yang menghalangi kamu dari (masuk) Masjidil Haram dan menghalangi hewan korban sampai ke tempat (penyembelihan)nya. Dan kalau tidaklah karena laki-laki yang mukmin dan perempuan-perempuan yang mukmin yang tiada kamu ketahui, bahwa kamu akan membunuh mereka yang menyebabkan kamu ditimpa kesusahan tanpa pengetahuanmu (tentulah Allah tidak akan menahan tanganmu dari membinasakan mereka). Supaya Allah memasukkan siapa yang dikehendaki-Nya ke dalam rahmat-Nya. Sekiranya mereka tidak bercampur-baur, tentulah Kami akan mengazab orang-orang yag kafir di antara mereka dengan azab yang pedih.

ayahs.arabic: إِذْ جَعَلَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ فِى قُلُوبِهِمُ ٱلْحَمِيَّةَ حَمِيَّةَ ٱلْجَٰهِلِيَّةِ فَأَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ سَكِينَتَهُۥ عَلَىٰ رَسُولِهِۦ وَعَلَى ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَأَلْزَمَهُمْ كَلِمَةَ ٱلتَّقْوَىٰ وَكَانُوٓا۟ أَحَقَّ بِهَا وَأَهْلَهَا ۚ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ عَلِيمًۭا
ayahs.sahih: When those who disbelieved had put into their hearts chauvinism - the chauvinism of the time of ignorance. But Allah sent down His tranquillity upon His Messenger and upon the believers and imposed upon them the word of righteousness, and they were more deserving of it and worthy of it. And ever is Allah, of all things, Knowing.
ayahs.clear: Those who disbelieved filled their hearts with rage—the rage of the days of ignorance. But God sent His serenity down upon His Messenger, and upon the believers, and imposed on them the words of righteousness—of which they were most worthy and deserving. God is aware of everything.
ayahs.kemenag: Ketika orang-orang kafir menanamkan dalam hati mereka kesombongan (yaitu) kesombongan jahiliyah lalu Allah menurunkan ketenangan kepada Rasul-Nya, dan kepada orang-orang mukmin dan Allah mewajibkan kepada mereka kalimat-takwa dan adalah mereka berhak dengan kalimat takwa itu dan patut memilikinya. Dan adalah Allah Maha Mengetahui segala sesuatu.

ayahs.arabic: لَّقَدْ صَدَقَ ٱللَّهُ رَسُولَهُ ٱلرُّءْيَا بِٱلْحَقِّ ۖ لَتَدْخُلُنَّ ٱلْمَسْجِدَ ٱلْحَرَامَ إِن شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ ءَامِنِينَ مُحَلِّقِينَ رُءُوسَكُمْ وَمُقَصِّرِينَ لَا تَخَافُونَ ۖ فَعَلِمَ مَا لَمْ تَعْلَمُوا۟ فَجَعَلَ مِن دُونِ ذَٰلِكَ فَتْحًۭا قَرِيبًا
ayahs.sahih: Certainly has Allah showed to His Messenger the vision in truth. You will surely enter al-Masjid al-Haram, if Allah wills, in safety, with your heads shaved and [hair] shortened, not fearing [anyone]. He knew what you did not know and has arranged before that a conquest near [at hand].
ayahs.clear: God has fulfilled His Messenger’s vision in truth: “You will enter the Sacred Mosque, God willing, in security, heads shaven, or hair cut short, not fearing. He knew what you did not know, and has granted besides that an imminent victory.”
ayahs.kemenag: Sesungguhnya Allah akan membuktikan kepada Rasul-Nya, tentang kebenaran mimpinya dengan sebenarnya (yaitu) bahwa sesungguhnya kamu pasti akan memasuki Masjidil Haram, insya Allah dalam keadaan aman, dengan mencukur rambut kepala dan mengguntingnya, sedang kamu tidak merasa takut. Maka Allah mengetahui apa yang tiada kamu ketahui dan Dia memberikan sebelum itu kemenangan yang dekat.

ayahs.arabic: هُوَ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَرْسَلَ رَسُولَهُۥ بِٱلْهُدَىٰ وَدِينِ ٱلْحَقِّ لِيُظْهِرَهُۥ عَلَى ٱلدِّينِ كُلِّهِۦ ۚ وَكَفَىٰ بِٱللَّهِ شَهِيدًۭا
ayahs.sahih: It is He who sent His Messenger with guidance and the religion of truth to manifest it over all religion. And sufficient is Allah as Witness.
ayahs.clear: It is He who sent His Messenger with the guidance and the religion of truth, to make it prevail over all religions. God suffices as Witness.
ayahs.kemenag: Dialah yang mengutus Rasul-Nya dengan membawa petunjuk dan agama yang hak agar dimenangkan-Nya terhadap semua agama. Dan cukuplah Allah sebagai saksi.

ayahs.arabic: مُّحَمَّدٌۭ رَّسُولُ ٱللَّهِ ۚ وَٱلَّذِينَ مَعَهُۥٓ أَشِدَّآءُ عَلَى ٱلْكُفَّارِ رُحَمَآءُ بَيْنَهُمْ ۖ تَرَىٰهُمْ رُكَّعًۭا سُجَّدًۭا يَبْتَغُونَ فَضْلًۭا مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ وَرِضْوَٰنًۭا ۖ سِيمَاهُمْ فِى وُجُوهِهِم مِّنْ أَثَرِ ٱلسُّجُودِ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ مَثَلُهُمْ فِى ٱلتَّوْرَىٰةِ ۚ وَمَثَلُهُمْ فِى ٱلْإِنجِيلِ كَزَرْعٍ أَخْرَجَ شَطْـَٔهُۥ فَـَٔازَرَهُۥ فَٱسْتَغْلَظَ فَٱسْتَوَىٰ عَلَىٰ سُوقِهِۦ يُعْجِبُ ٱلزُّرَّاعَ لِيَغِيظَ بِهِمُ ٱلْكُفَّارَ ۗ وَعَدَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ مِنْهُم مَّغْفِرَةًۭ وَأَجْرًا عَظِيمًۢا
ayahs.sahih: Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah; and those with him are forceful against the disbelievers, merciful among themselves. You see them bowing and prostrating [in prayer], seeking bounty from Allah and [His] pleasure. Their mark is on their faces from the trace of prostration. That is their description in the Torah. And their description in the Gospel is as a plant which produces its offshoots and strengthens them so they grow firm and stand upon their stalks, delighting the sowers - so that Allah may enrage by them the disbelievers. Allah has promised those who believe and do righteous deeds among them forgiveness and a great reward.
ayahs.clear: Muhammad is the Messenger of God. Those with him are stern against the disbelievers, yet compassionate amongst themselves. You see them kneeling, prostrating, seeking blessings from God and approval. Their marks are on their faces from the effects of prostration. Such is their description in the Torah, and their description in the Gospel: like a plant that sprouts, becomes strong, grows thick, and rests on its stem, impressing the farmers. Through them He enrages the disbelievers. God has promised those among them who believe and do good deeds forgiveness and a great reward.
ayahs.kemenag: Muhammad itu adalah utusan Allah dan orang-orang yang bersama dengan dia adalah keras terhadap orang-orang kafir, tetapi berkasih sayang sesama mereka. Kamu lihat mereka ruku' dan sujud mencari karunia Allah dan keridhaan-Nya, tanda-tanda mereka tampak pada muka mereka dari bekas sujud. Demikianlah sifat-sifat mereka dalam Taurat dan sifat-sifat mereka dalam Injil, yaitu seperti tanaman yang mengeluarkan tunasnya maka tunas itu menjadikan tanaman itu kuat lalu menjadi besarlah dia dan tegak lurus di atas pokoknya; tanaman itu menyenangkan hati penanam-penanamnya karena Allah hendak menjengkelkan hati orang-orang kafir (dengan kekuatan orang-orang mukmin). Allah menjanjikan kepada orang-orang yang beriman dan mengerjakan amal yang saleh di antara mereka ampunan dan pahala yang besar.

ayahs.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ لَا تُقَدِّمُوا۟ بَيْنَ يَدَىِ ٱللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِۦ ۖ وَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ سَمِيعٌ عَلِيمٌۭ
ayahs.sahih: O you who have believed, do not put [yourselves] before Allah and His Messenger but fear Allah. Indeed, Allah is Hearing and Knowing.
ayahs.clear: O you who believe! Do not place your opinions above that of God and His Messenger, and fear God. God is Hearing and Knowing.
ayahs.kemenag: Hai orang-orang yang beriman, janganlah kamu mendahului Allah dan Rasulnya dan bertakwalah kepada Allah. Sesungguhnya Allah Maha Mendengar lagi Maha Mengetahui.

ayahs.arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ لَا تَرْفَعُوٓا۟ أَصْوَٰتَكُمْ فَوْقَ صَوْتِ ٱلنَّبِىِّ وَلَا تَجْهَرُوا۟ لَهُۥ بِٱلْقَوْلِ كَجَهْرِ بَعْضِكُمْ لِبَعْضٍ أَن تَحْبَطَ أَعْمَٰلُكُمْ وَأَنتُمْ لَا تَشْعُرُونَ
ayahs.sahih: O you who have believed, do not raise your voices above the voice of the Prophet or be loud to him in speech like the loudness of some of you to others, lest your deeds become worthless while you perceive not.
ayahs.clear: O you who believe! Do not raise your voices above the voice of the Prophet, and do not speak loudly to him, as you speak loudly to one another, lest your works be in vain without you realizing.
ayahs.kemenag: Hai orang-orang yang beriman, janganlah kamu meninggikan suaramu melebihi suara Nabi, dan janganlah kamu berkata kepadanya dengan suara yang keras, sebagaimana kerasnya suara sebagian kamu terhadap sebagian yang lain, supaya tidak hapus (pahala) amalanmu, sedangkan kamu tidak menyadari.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يَغُضُّونَ أَصْوَٰتَهُمْ عِندَ رَسُولِ ٱللَّهِ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱمْتَحَنَ ٱللَّهُ قُلُوبَهُمْ لِلتَّقْوَىٰ ۚ لَهُم مَّغْفِرَةٌۭ وَأَجْرٌ عَظِيمٌ
ayahs.sahih: Indeed, those who lower their voices before the Messenger of Allah - they are the ones whose hearts Allah has tested for righteousness. For them is forgiveness and great reward.
ayahs.clear: Those who lower their voices before God’s Messenger—those are they whose hearts God has tested for piety. They will have forgiveness and a great reward.
ayahs.kemenag: Sesungguhnya orang yang merendahkan suaranya di sisi Rasulullah mereka itulah orang-orang yang telah diuji hati mereka oleh Allah untuk bertakwa. Bagi mereka ampunan dan pahala yang besar.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يُنَادُونَكَ مِن وَرَآءِ ٱلْحُجُرَٰتِ أَكْثَرُهُمْ لَا يَعْقِلُونَ
ayahs.sahih: Indeed, those who call you, [O Muhammad], from behind the chambers - most of them do not use reason.
ayahs.clear: Those who call you from behind the chambers—most of them do not understand.
ayahs.kemenag: Sesungguhnya orang-orang yang memanggil kamu dari luar kamar(mu) kebanyakan mereka tidak mengerti.

ayahs.arabic: وَلَوْ أَنَّهُمْ صَبَرُوا۟ حَتَّىٰ تَخْرُجَ إِلَيْهِمْ لَكَانَ خَيْرًۭا لَّهُمْ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ غَفُورٌۭ رَّحِيمٌۭ
ayahs.sahih: And if they had been patient until you [could] come out to them, it would have been better for them. But Allah is Forgiving and Merciful.
ayahs.clear: Had they remained patient until you came out to them, it would have been better for them. But God is Forgiving and Merciful.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan kalau sekiranya mereka bersabar sampai kamu keluar menemui mereka sesungguhnya itu lebih baik bagi mereka, dan Allah Maha Pengampun lagi Maha Penyayang.

ayahs.arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ إِن جَآءَكُمْ فَاسِقٌۢ بِنَبَإٍۢ فَتَبَيَّنُوٓا۟ أَن تُصِيبُوا۟ قَوْمًۢا بِجَهَٰلَةٍۢ فَتُصْبِحُوا۟ عَلَىٰ مَا فَعَلْتُمْ نَٰدِمِينَ
ayahs.sahih: O you who have believed, if there comes to you a disobedient one with information, investigate, lest you harm a people out of ignorance and become, over what you have done, regretful.
ayahs.clear: O you who believe! If a troublemaker brings you any news, investigate, lest you harm people out of ignorance, and you become regretful for what you have done.
ayahs.kemenag: Hai orang-orang yang beriman, jika datang kepadamu orang fasik membawa suatu berita, maka periksalah dengan teliti agar kamu tidak menimpakan suatu musibah kepada suatu kaum tanpa mengetahui keadaannya yang menyebabkan kamu menyesal atas perbuatanmu itu.

ayahs.arabic: وَٱعْلَمُوٓا۟ أَنَّ فِيكُمْ رَسُولَ ٱللَّهِ ۚ لَوْ يُطِيعُكُمْ فِى كَثِيرٍۢ مِّنَ ٱلْأَمْرِ لَعَنِتُّمْ وَلَٰكِنَّ ٱللَّهَ حَبَّبَ إِلَيْكُمُ ٱلْإِيمَٰنَ وَزَيَّنَهُۥ فِى قُلُوبِكُمْ وَكَرَّهَ إِلَيْكُمُ ٱلْكُفْرَ وَٱلْفُسُوقَ وَٱلْعِصْيَانَ ۚ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلرَّٰشِدُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And know that among you is the Messenger of Allah. If he were to obey you in much of the matter, you would be in difficulty, but Allah has endeared to you the faith and has made it pleasing in your hearts and has made hateful to you disbelief, defiance and disobedience. Those are the [rightly] guided.
ayahs.clear: And know that among you is the Messenger of God. Had he obeyed you in many things, you would have suffered hardship. But God has given you the love of faith, and adorned it in your hearts, and made disbelief, mischief, and rebellion hateful to you. These are the rightly guided.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan ketahuilah olehmu bahwa di kalanganmu ada Rasulullah. Kalau ia menuruti kemauanmu dalam beberapa urusan benar-benarlah kamu mendapat kesusahan, tetapi Allah menjadikan kamu "cinta" kepada keimanan dan menjadikan keimanan itu indah di dalam hatimu serta menjadikan kamu benci kepada kekafiran, kefasikan, dan kedurhakaan. Mereka itulah orang-orang yang mengikuti jalan yang lurus,

ayahs.arabic: فَضْلًۭا مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ وَنِعْمَةًۭ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ عَلِيمٌ حَكِيمٌۭ
ayahs.sahih: [It is] as bounty from Allah and favor. And Allah is Knowing and Wise.
ayahs.clear: A Grace and Favor from God. God is Knowing and Wise.
ayahs.kemenag: sebagai karunia dan nikmat dari Allah. Dan Allah Maha Mengetahui lagi Maha Bijaksana.

ayahs.arabic: وَإِن طَآئِفَتَانِ مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ ٱقْتَتَلُوا۟ فَأَصْلِحُوا۟ بَيْنَهُمَا ۖ فَإِنۢ بَغَتْ إِحْدَىٰهُمَا عَلَى ٱلْأُخْرَىٰ فَقَٰتِلُوا۟ ٱلَّتِى تَبْغِى حَتَّىٰ تَفِىٓءَ إِلَىٰٓ أَمْرِ ٱللَّهِ ۚ فَإِن فَآءَتْ فَأَصْلِحُوا۟ بَيْنَهُمَا بِٱلْعَدْلِ وَأَقْسِطُوٓا۟ ۖ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُحِبُّ ٱلْمُقْسِطِينَ
ayahs.sahih: And if two factions among the believers should fight, then make settlement between the two. But if one of them oppresses the other, then fight against the one that oppresses until it returns to the ordinance of Allah. And if it returns, then make settlement between them in justice and act justly. Indeed, Allah loves those who act justly.
ayahs.clear: If two groups of believers fight each other, reconcile between them. But if one group aggresses against the other, fight the aggressing group until it complies with God’s command. Once it has complied, reconcile between them with justice, and be equitable. God loves the equitable.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan kalau ada dua golongan dari mereka yang beriman itu berperang hendaklah kamu damaikan antara keduanya! Tapi kalau yang satu melanggar perjanjian terhadap yang lain, hendaklah yang melanggar perjanjian itu kamu perangi sampai surut kembali pada perintah Allah. Kalau dia telah surut, damaikanlah antara keduanya menurut keadilan, dan hendaklah kamu berlaku adil; sesungguhnya Allah mencintai orang-orang yang berlaku adil.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّمَا ٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ إِخْوَةٌۭ فَأَصْلِحُوا۟ بَيْنَ أَخَوَيْكُمْ ۚ وَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُرْحَمُونَ
ayahs.sahih: The believers are but brothers, so make settlement between your brothers. And fear Allah that you may receive mercy.
ayahs.clear: The believers are brothers, so reconcile between your brothers, and remain conscious of God, so that you may receive mercy.
ayahs.kemenag: Orang-orang beriman itu sesungguhnya bersaudara. Sebab itu damaikanlah (perbaikilah hubungan) antara kedua saudaramu itu dan takutlah terhadap Allah, supaya kamu mendapat rahmat.

ayahs.arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ لَا يَسْخَرْ قَوْمٌۭ مِّن قَوْمٍ عَسَىٰٓ أَن يَكُونُوا۟ خَيْرًۭا مِّنْهُمْ وَلَا نِسَآءٌۭ مِّن نِّسَآءٍ عَسَىٰٓ أَن يَكُنَّ خَيْرًۭا مِّنْهُنَّ ۖ وَلَا تَلْمِزُوٓا۟ أَنفُسَكُمْ وَلَا تَنَابَزُوا۟ بِٱلْأَلْقَٰبِ ۖ بِئْسَ ٱلِٱسْمُ ٱلْفُسُوقُ بَعْدَ ٱلْإِيمَٰنِ ۚ وَمَن لَّمْ يَتُبْ فَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلظَّٰلِمُونَ
ayahs.sahih: O you who have believed, let not a people ridicule [another] people; perhaps they may be better than them; nor let women ridicule [other] women; perhaps they may be better than them. And do not insult one another and do not call each other by [offensive] nicknames. Wretched is the name of disobedience after [one's] faith. And whoever does not repent - then it is those who are the wrongdoers.
ayahs.clear: O you who believe! No people shall ridicule other people, for they may be better than they. Nor shall any women ridicule other women, for they may be better than they. Nor shall you slander one another, nor shall you insult one another with names. Evil is the return to wickedness after having attained faith. Whoever does not repent—these are the wrongdoers.
ayahs.kemenag: Hai orang-orang yang beriman, janganlah sekumpulan orang laki-laki merendahkan kumpulan yang lain, boleh jadi yang ditertawakan itu lebih baik dari mereka. Dan jangan pula sekumpulan perempuan merendahkan kumpulan lainnya, boleh jadi yang direndahkan itu lebih baik. Dan janganlah suka mencela dirimu sendiri dan jangan memanggil dengan gelaran yang mengandung ejekan. Seburuk-buruk panggilan adalah (panggilan) yang buruk sesudah iman dan barangsiapa yang tidak bertobat, maka mereka itulah orang-orang yang zalim.

ayahs.arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ٱجْتَنِبُوا۟ كَثِيرًۭا مِّنَ ٱلظَّنِّ إِنَّ بَعْضَ ٱلظَّنِّ إِثْمٌۭ ۖ وَلَا تَجَسَّسُوا۟ وَلَا يَغْتَب بَّعْضُكُم بَعْضًا ۚ أَيُحِبُّ أَحَدُكُمْ أَن يَأْكُلَ لَحْمَ أَخِيهِ مَيْتًۭا فَكَرِهْتُمُوهُ ۚ وَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ تَوَّابٌۭ رَّحِيمٌۭ
ayahs.sahih: O you who have believed, avoid much [negative] assumption. Indeed, some assumption is sin. And do not spy or backbite each other. Would one of you like to eat the flesh of his brother when dead? You would detest it. And fear Allah; indeed, Allah is Accepting of repentance and Merciful.
ayahs.clear: O you who believe! Avoid most suspicion—some suspicion is sinful. And do not spy on one another, nor backbite one another. Would any of you like to eat the flesh of his dead brother? You would detest it. So remain mindful of God. God is Most Relenting, Most Merciful.
ayahs.kemenag: Hai orang-orang yang beriman, jauhilah kebanyakan purba-sangka (kecurigaan), karena sebagian dari purba-sangka itu dosa. Dan janganlah mencari-cari keburukan orang dan janganlah menggunjingkan satu sama lain. Adakah seorang diantara kamu yang suka memakan daging saudaranya yang sudah mati? Maka tentulah kamu merasa jijik kepadanya. Dan bertakwalah kepada Allah. Sesungguhnya Allah Maha Penerima Taubat lagi Maha Penyayang.

ayahs.arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّاسُ إِنَّا خَلَقْنَٰكُم مِّن ذَكَرٍۢ وَأُنثَىٰ وَجَعَلْنَٰكُمْ شُعُوبًۭا وَقَبَآئِلَ لِتَعَارَفُوٓا۟ ۚ إِنَّ أَكْرَمَكُمْ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ أَتْقَىٰكُمْ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلِيمٌ خَبِيرٌۭ
ayahs.sahih: O mankind, indeed We have created you from male and female and made you peoples and tribes that you may know one another. Indeed, the most noble of you in the sight of Allah is the most righteous of you. Indeed, Allah is Knowing and Acquainted.
ayahs.clear: O people! We created you from a male and a female, and made you races and tribes, that you may know one another. The best among you in the sight of God is the most righteous. God is All-Knowing, Well-Experienced.
ayahs.kemenag: Hai manusia, sesungguhnya Kami menciptakan kamu dari seorang laki-laki dan seorang perempuan dan menjadikan kamu berbangsa-bangsa dan bersuku-suku supaya kamu saling kenal-mengenal. Sesungguhnya orang yang paling mulia diantara kamu disisi Allah ialah orang yang paling takwa diantara kamu. Sesungguhnya Allah Maha Mengetahui lagi Maha Mengenal.

ayahs.arabic: ۞ قَالَتِ ٱلْأَعْرَابُ ءَامَنَّا ۖ قُل لَّمْ تُؤْمِنُوا۟ وَلَٰكِن قُولُوٓا۟ أَسْلَمْنَا وَلَمَّا يَدْخُلِ ٱلْإِيمَٰنُ فِى قُلُوبِكُمْ ۖ وَإِن تُطِيعُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُۥ لَا يَلِتْكُم مِّنْ أَعْمَٰلِكُمْ شَيْـًٔا ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَفُورٌۭ رَّحِيمٌ
ayahs.sahih: The bedouins say, "We have believed." Say, "You have not [yet] believed; but say [instead], 'We have submitted,' for faith has not yet entered your hearts. And if you obey Allah and His Messenger, He will not deprive you from your deeds of anything. Indeed, Allah is Forgiving and Merciful."
ayahs.clear: The Desert-Arabs say, “We have believed.” Say, “You have not believed; but say, ‘We have submitted,’ for faith has not yet entered into your hearts. But if you obey God and His Messenger, He will not diminish any of your deeds. God is Forgiving and Merciful.”
ayahs.kemenag: Orang-orang Arab Badui itu berkata: "Kami telah beriman". Katakanlah: "Kamu belum beriman, tapi katakanlah 'kami telah tunduk', karena iman itu belum masuk ke dalam hatimu; dan jika kamu taat kepada Allah dan Rasul-Nya, Dia tidak akan mengurangi sedikitpun pahala amalanmu; sesungguhnya Allah Maha Pengampun lagi Maha Penyayang".

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّمَا ٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِۦ ثُمَّ لَمْ يَرْتَابُوا۟ وَجَٰهَدُوا۟ بِأَمْوَٰلِهِمْ وَأَنفُسِهِمْ فِى سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ ۚ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلصَّٰدِقُونَ
ayahs.sahih: The believers are only the ones who have believed in Allah and His Messenger and then doubt not but strive with their properties and their lives in the cause of Allah. It is those who are the truthful.
ayahs.clear: The believers are those who believe in God and His Messenger, and then have not doubted, and strive for God’s cause with their wealth and their persons. These are the sincere.
ayahs.kemenag: Sesungguhnya orang-orang yang beriman itu hanyalah orang-orang yang percaya (beriman) kepada Allah dan Rasul-Nya, kemudian mereka tidak ragu-ragu dan mereka berjuang (berjihad) dengan harta dan jiwa mereka pada jalan Allah. Mereka itulah orang-orang yang benar.

ayahs.arabic: قُلْ أَتُعَلِّمُونَ ٱللَّهَ بِدِينِكُمْ وَٱللَّهُ يَعْلَمُ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ عَلِيمٌۭ
ayahs.sahih: Say, "Would you acquaint Allah with your religion while Allah knows whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth, and Allah is Knowing of all things?"
ayahs.clear: Say, “Are you going to teach God about your religion, when God knows everything in the heavens and the earth, and God is aware of all things?”
ayahs.kemenag: Katakanlah: "Apakah kamu akan memberitahukan kepada Allah tentang agamamu, padahal Allah mengetahui apa yang di langit dan apa yang di bumi dan Allah Maha Mengetahui segala sesuatu?"

ayahs.arabic: يَمُنُّونَ عَلَيْكَ أَنْ أَسْلَمُوا۟ ۖ قُل لَّا تَمُنُّوا۟ عَلَىَّ إِسْلَٰمَكُم ۖ بَلِ ٱللَّهُ يَمُنُّ عَلَيْكُمْ أَنْ هَدَىٰكُمْ لِلْإِيمَٰنِ إِن كُنتُمْ صَٰدِقِينَ
ayahs.sahih: They consider it a favor to you that they have accepted Islam. Say, "Do not consider your Islam a favor to me. Rather, Allah has conferred favor upon you that He has guided you to the faith, if you should be truthful."
ayahs.clear: They regarded it a favor to you that they have submitted. Say, “Do not consider your submission a favor to me; it is God who has done you a favor by guiding you to the faith, if you are sincere.”
ayahs.kemenag: Mereka merasa telah memberi nikmat kepadamu dengan keislaman mereka. Katakanlah: "Janganlah kamu merasa telah memberi nikmat kepadaku dengan keislamanmu, sebenarnya Allah, Dialah yang melimpahkan nikmat kepadamu dengan menunjuki kamu kepada keimanan jika kamu adalah orang-orang yang benar".

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَعْلَمُ غَيْبَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ بَصِيرٌۢ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ
ayahs.sahih: Indeed, Allah knows the unseen [aspects] of the heavens and the earth. And Allah is Seeing of what you do.
ayahs.clear: God knows the secrets of the heavens and the earth, and God is seeing of everything you do.
ayahs.kemenag: Sesungguhnya Allah mengetahui apa yang ghaib di langit dan bumi. Dan Allah Maha Melihat apa yang kamu kerjakan.

ayahs.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ قٓ ۚ وَٱلْقُرْءَانِ ٱلْمَجِيدِ
ayahs.sahih: Qaf. By the honored Qur'an...
ayahs.clear: Qaf. By the Glorious Quran.
ayahs.kemenag: Qaaf Demi Al Quran yang sangat mulia.

ayahs.arabic: بَلْ عَجِبُوٓا۟ أَن جَآءَهُم مُّنذِرٌۭ مِّنْهُمْ فَقَالَ ٱلْكَٰفِرُونَ هَٰذَا شَىْءٌ عَجِيبٌ
ayahs.sahih: But they wonder that there has come to them a warner from among themselves, and the disbelievers say, "This is an amazing thing.
ayahs.clear: They marveled that a warner has come to them from among them. The disbelievers say, “This is something strange.
ayahs.kemenag: (Mereka tidak menerimanya) bahkan mereka tercengang karena telah datang kepada mereka seorang pemberi peringatan dari (kalangan) mereka sendiri, maka berkatalah orang-orang kafir: "Ini adalah suatu yang amat ajaib".

ayahs.arabic: أَءِذَا مِتْنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابًۭا ۖ ذَٰلِكَ رَجْعٌۢ بَعِيدٌۭ
ayahs.sahih: When we have died and have become dust, [we will return to life]? That is a distant return."
ayahs.clear: When we have died and become dust? This is a farfetched return.”
ayahs.kemenag: Apakah kami setelah mati dan setelah menjadi tanah (kami akan kembali lagi)?, itu adalah suatu pengembalian yang tidak mungkin.

ayahs.arabic: قَدْ عَلِمْنَا مَا تَنقُصُ ٱلْأَرْضُ مِنْهُمْ ۖ وَعِندَنَا كِتَٰبٌ حَفِيظٌۢ
ayahs.sahih: We know what the earth diminishes of them, and with Us is a retaining record.
ayahs.clear: We know what the earth consumes of them, and with Us is a comprehensive book.
ayahs.kemenag: Sesungguhnya Kami telah mengetahui apa yang dihancurkan oleh bumi dari (tubuh-tubuh) mereka, dan pada sisi Kamipun ada kitab yang memelihara (mencatat).

ayahs.arabic: بَلْ كَذَّبُوا۟ بِٱلْحَقِّ لَمَّا جَآءَهُمْ فَهُمْ فِىٓ أَمْرٍۢ مَّرِيجٍ
ayahs.sahih: But they denied the truth when it came to them, so they are in a confused condition.
ayahs.clear: But they denied the truth when it has come to them, so they are in a confused state.
ayahs.kemenag: Sebenarnya, mereka telah mendustakan kebenaran tatkala kebenaran itu datang kepada mereka, maka mereka berada dalam keadaan kacau balau.

ayahs.arabic: أَفَلَمْ يَنظُرُوٓا۟ إِلَى ٱلسَّمَآءِ فَوْقَهُمْ كَيْفَ بَنَيْنَٰهَا وَزَيَّنَّٰهَا وَمَا لَهَا مِن فُرُوجٍۢ
ayahs.sahih: Have they not looked at the heaven above them - how We structured it and adorned it and [how] it has no rifts?
ayahs.clear: Have they not observed the sky above them, how We constructed it, and decorated it, and it has no cracks?
ayahs.kemenag: Maka apakah mereka tidak melihat akan langit yang ada di atas mereka, bagaimana Kami meninggikannya dan menghiasinya dan langit itu tidak mempunyai retak-retak sedikitpun?

ayahs.arabic: وَٱلْأَرْضَ مَدَدْنَٰهَا وَأَلْقَيْنَا فِيهَا رَوَٰسِىَ وَأَنۢبَتْنَا فِيهَا مِن كُلِّ زَوْجٍۭ بَهِيجٍۢ
ayahs.sahih: And the earth - We spread it out and cast therein firmly set mountains and made grow therein [something] of every beautiful kind,
ayahs.clear: And the earth, how We spread it out, and set on it mountains, and grew in it all kinds of delightful pairs?
ayahs.kemenag: Dan Kami hamparkan bumi itu dan Kami letakkan padanya gunung-gunung yang kokoh dan Kami tumbuhkan padanya segala macam tanaman yang indah dipandang mata,

ayahs.arabic: تَبْصِرَةًۭ وَذِكْرَىٰ لِكُلِّ عَبْدٍۢ مُّنِيبٍۢ
ayahs.sahih: Giving insight and a reminder for every servant who turns [to Allah].
ayahs.clear: A lesson and a reminder for every penitent worshiper.
ayahs.kemenag: untuk menjadi pelajaran dan peringatan bagi tiap-tiap hamba yang kembali (mengingat Allah).

ayahs.arabic: وَنَزَّلْنَا مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءًۭ مُّبَٰرَكًۭا فَأَنۢبَتْنَا بِهِۦ جَنَّٰتٍۢ وَحَبَّ ٱلْحَصِيدِ
ayahs.sahih: And We have sent down blessed rain from the sky and made grow thereby gardens and grain from the harvest
ayahs.clear: And We brought down from the sky blessed water, and produced with it gardens and grain to harvest.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan Kami turunkan dari langit air yang banyak manfaatnya lalu Kami tumbuhkan dengan air itu pohon-pohon dan biji-biji tanaman yang diketam,

ayahs.arabic: وَٱلنَّخْلَ بَاسِقَٰتٍۢ لَّهَا طَلْعٌۭ نَّضِيدٌۭ
ayahs.sahih: And lofty palm trees having fruit arranged in layers -
ayahs.clear: And the soaring palm trees, with clustered dates.
ayahs.kemenag: dan pohon kurma yang tinggi-tinggi yang mempunyai mayang yang bersusun-susun,

ayahs.arabic: رِّزْقًۭا لِّلْعِبَادِ ۖ وَأَحْيَيْنَا بِهِۦ بَلْدَةًۭ مَّيْتًۭا ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ ٱلْخُرُوجُ
ayahs.sahih: As provision for the servants, and We have given life thereby to a dead land. Thus is the resurrection.
ayahs.clear: As sustenance for the servants. And We revive thereby a dead town. Likewise is the resurrection.
ayahs.kemenag: untuk menjadi rezeki bagi hamba-hamba (Kami), dan Kami hidupkan dengan air itu tanah yang mati (kering). Seperti itulah terjadinya kebangkitan.

ayahs.arabic: كَذَّبَتْ قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍۢ وَأَصْحَٰبُ ٱلرَّسِّ وَثَمُودُ
ayahs.sahih: The people of Noah denied before them, and the companions of the well and Thamud
ayahs.clear: Before them the people of Noah denied the truth, and so did the dwellers of Russ, and Thamood.
ayahs.kemenag: Sebelum mereka telah mendustakan (pula) kaum Nuh dan penduduk Rass dan Tsamud,

ayahs.arabic: وَعَادٌۭ وَفِرْعَوْنُ وَإِخْوَٰنُ لُوطٍۢ
ayahs.sahih: And 'Aad and Pharaoh and the brothers of Lot
ayahs.clear: And Aad, and Pharaoh, and the brethren of Lot.
ayahs.kemenag: dan kaum Aad, kaum Fir'aun dan kaum Luth,

ayahs.arabic: وَأَصْحَٰبُ ٱلْأَيْكَةِ وَقَوْمُ تُبَّعٍۢ ۚ كُلٌّۭ كَذَّبَ ٱلرُّسُلَ فَحَقَّ وَعِيدِ
ayahs.sahih: And the companions of the thicket and the people of Tubba'. All denied the messengers, so My threat was justly fulfilled.
ayahs.clear: And the Dwellers of the Woods, and the people of Tubba. They all rejected the messengers, so My threat came true.
ayahs.kemenag: dan penduduk Aikah serta kaum Tubba' semuanya telah mendustakan rasul-rasul maka sudah semestinyalah mereka mendapat hukuman yang sudah diancamkan.

ayahs.arabic: أَفَعَيِينَا بِٱلْخَلْقِ ٱلْأَوَّلِ ۚ بَلْ هُمْ فِى لَبْسٍۢ مِّنْ خَلْقٍۢ جَدِيدٍۢ
ayahs.sahih: Did We fail in the first creation? But they are in confusion over a new creation.
ayahs.clear: Were We fatigued by the first creation? But they are in doubt of a new creation.
ayahs.kemenag: Maka apakah Kami letih dengan penciptaan yang pertama? Sebenarnya mereka dalam keadaan ragu-ragu tentang penciptaan yang baru.

ayahs.arabic: وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ وَنَعْلَمُ مَا تُوَسْوِسُ بِهِۦ نَفْسُهُۥ ۖ وَنَحْنُ أَقْرَبُ إِلَيْهِ مِنْ حَبْلِ ٱلْوَرِيدِ
ayahs.sahih: And We have already created man and know what his soul whispers to him, and We are closer to him than [his] jugular vein
ayahs.clear: We created the human being, and We know what his soul whispers to him. We are nearer to him than his jugular vein.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan sesungguhnya Kami telah menciptakan manusia dan mengetahui apa yang dibisikkan oleh hatinya, dan Kami lebih dekat kepadanya daripada urat lehernya,

ayahs.arabic: إِذْ يَتَلَقَّى ٱلْمُتَلَقِّيَانِ عَنِ ٱلْيَمِينِ وَعَنِ ٱلشِّمَالِ قَعِيدٌۭ
ayahs.sahih: When the two receivers receive, seated on the right and on the left.
ayahs.clear: As the two receivers receive, seated to the right and to the left.
ayahs.kemenag: (yaitu) ketika dua orang malaikat mencatat amal perbuatannya, seorang duduk di sebelah kanan dan yang lain duduk di sebelah kiri.

ayahs.arabic: مَّا يَلْفِظُ مِن قَوْلٍ إِلَّا لَدَيْهِ رَقِيبٌ عَتِيدٌۭ
ayahs.sahih: Man does not utter any word except that with him is an observer prepared [to record].
ayahs.clear: Not a word does he utter, but there is a watcher by him, ready.
ayahs.kemenag: Tiada suatu ucapanpun yang diucapkannya melainkan ada di dekatnya malaikat pengawas yang selalu hadir.

ayahs.arabic: وَجَآءَتْ سَكْرَةُ ٱلْمَوْتِ بِٱلْحَقِّ ۖ ذَٰلِكَ مَا كُنتَ مِنْهُ تَحِيدُ
ayahs.sahih: And the intoxication of death will bring the truth; that is what you were trying to avoid.
ayahs.clear: The daze of death has come in truth: “This is what you tried to evade.”
ayahs.kemenag: Dan datanglah sakaratul maut dengan sebenar-benarnya. Itulah yang kamu selalu lari daripadanya.

ayahs.arabic: وَنُفِخَ فِى ٱلصُّورِ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ يَوْمُ ٱلْوَعِيدِ
ayahs.sahih: And the Horn will be blown. That is the Day of [carrying out] the threat.
ayahs.clear: And the Trumpet is blown: “This is the Promised Day.”
ayahs.kemenag: Dan ditiuplah sangkakala. Itulah hari terlaksananya ancaman.

ayahs.arabic: وَجَآءَتْ كُلُّ نَفْسٍۢ مَّعَهَا سَآئِقٌۭ وَشَهِيدٌۭ
ayahs.sahih: And every soul will come, with it a driver and a witness.
ayahs.clear: And every soul will come forward, accompanied by a driver and a witness.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan datanglah tiap-tiap diri, bersama dengan dia seorang malaikat penggiring dan seorang malaikat penyaksi.

ayahs.arabic: لَّقَدْ كُنتَ فِى غَفْلَةٍۢ مِّنْ هَٰذَا فَكَشَفْنَا عَنكَ غِطَآءَكَ فَبَصَرُكَ ٱلْيَوْمَ حَدِيدٌۭ
ayahs.sahih: [It will be said], "You were certainly in unmindfulness of this, and We have removed from you your cover, so your sight, this Day, is sharp."
ayahs.clear: “You were in neglect of this, so We lifted your screen from you, and your vision today is keen.”
ayahs.kemenag: Sesungguhnya kamu berada dalam keadaan lalai dari (hal) ini, maka Kami singkapkan daripadamu tutup (yang menutupi) matamu, maka penglihatanmu pada hari itu amat tajam.

ayahs.arabic: وَقَالَ قَرِينُهُۥ هَٰذَا مَا لَدَىَّ عَتِيدٌ
ayahs.sahih: And his companion, [the angel], will say, "This [record] is what is with me, prepared."
ayahs.clear: And His escort will say, “This is what I have ready with me.”
ayahs.kemenag: Dan yang menyertai dia berkata: "Inilah (catatan amalnya) yang tersedia pada sisiku".

ayahs.arabic: أَلْقِيَا فِى جَهَنَّمَ كُلَّ كَفَّارٍ عَنِيدٍۢ
ayahs.sahih: [Allah will say], "Throw into Hell every obstinate disbeliever,
ayahs.clear: “Throw into Hell every stubborn disbeliever.
ayahs.kemenag: Allah berfirman: "Lemparkanlah olehmu berdua ke dalam neraka semua orang yang sangat ingkar dan keras kepala,

ayahs.arabic: مَّنَّاعٍۢ لِّلْخَيْرِ مُعْتَدٍۢ مُّرِيبٍ
ayahs.sahih: Preventer of good, aggressor, and doubter,
ayahs.clear: Preventer of good, aggressor, doubter.
ayahs.kemenag: yang sangat menghalangi kebajikan, melanggar batas lagi ragu-ragu,

ayahs.arabic: ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَٰهًا ءَاخَرَ فَأَلْقِيَاهُ فِى ٱلْعَذَابِ ٱلشَّدِيدِ
ayahs.sahih: Who made [as equal] with Allah another deity; then throw him into the severe punishment."
ayahs.clear: Who fabricated another god with God; toss him into the intense agony.”
ayahs.kemenag: yang menyembah sembahan yang lain beserta Allah maka lemparkanlah dia ke dalam siksaan yang sangat".

ayahs.arabic: ۞ قَالَ قَرِينُهُۥ رَبَّنَا مَآ أَطْغَيْتُهُۥ وَلَٰكِن كَانَ فِى ضَلَٰلٍۭ بَعِيدٍۢ
ayahs.sahih: His [devil] companion will say, "Our Lord, I did not make him transgress, but he [himself] was in extreme error."
ayahs.clear: His escort will say, “Our Lord, I did not make him rebel, but he was far astray.”
ayahs.kemenag: Yang menyertai dia berkata (pula): "Ya Tuhan kami, aku tidak menyesatkannya tetapi dialah yang berada dalam kesesatan yang jauh".

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ لَا تَخْتَصِمُوا۟ لَدَىَّ وَقَدْ قَدَّمْتُ إِلَيْكُم بِٱلْوَعِيدِ
ayahs.sahih: [Allah] will say, "Do not dispute before Me, while I had already presented to you the warning.
ayahs.clear: He will say, “Do not feud in My presence—I had warned you in advance.
ayahs.kemenag: Allah berfirman: "Janganlah kamu bertengkar di hadapan-Ku, padahal sesungguhnya Aku dahulu telah memberikan ancaman kepadamu".

ayahs.arabic: مَا يُبَدَّلُ ٱلْقَوْلُ لَدَىَّ وَمَآ أَنَا۠ بِظَلَّٰمٍۢ لِّلْعَبِيدِ
ayahs.sahih: The word will not be changed with Me, and never will I be unjust to the servants."
ayahs.clear: The decree from Me will not be changed, and I am not unjust to the servants.”
ayahs.kemenag: Keputusan di sisi-Ku tidak dapat diubah dan Aku sekali-kali tidak menganiaya hamba-hamba-Ku

ayahs.arabic: يَوْمَ نَقُولُ لِجَهَنَّمَ هَلِ ٱمْتَلَأْتِ وَتَقُولُ هَلْ مِن مَّزِيدٍۢ
ayahs.sahih: On the Day We will say to Hell, "Have you been filled?" and it will say, "Are there some more,"
ayahs.clear: On the Day when We will say to Hell, “Are you full?” And it will say, “Are there any more?”
ayahs.kemenag: (Dan ingatlah akan) hari (yang pada hari itu) Kami bertanya kepada jahannam: "Apakah kamu sudah penuh?" Dia menjawab: "Masih ada tambahan?"

ayahs.arabic: وَأُزْلِفَتِ ٱلْجَنَّةُ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ غَيْرَ بَعِيدٍ
ayahs.sahih: And Paradise will be brought near to the righteous, not far,
ayahs.clear: And Paradise will be brought closer to the pious, not far away.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan didekatkanlah surga itu kepada orang-orang yang bertakwa pada tempat yang tiada jauh (dari mereka).

ayahs.arabic: هَٰذَا مَا تُوعَدُونَ لِكُلِّ أَوَّابٍ حَفِيظٍۢ
ayahs.sahih: [It will be said], "This is what you were promised - for every returner [to Allah] and keeper [of His covenant]
ayahs.clear: “This is what you were promised—for every careful penitent.
ayahs.kemenag: Inilah yang dijanjikan kepadamu, (yaitu) kepada setiap hamba yang selalu kembali (kepada Allah) lagi memelihara (semua peraturan-peraturan-Nya)

ayahs.arabic: مَّنْ خَشِىَ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنَ بِٱلْغَيْبِ وَجَآءَ بِقَلْبٍۢ مُّنِيبٍ
ayahs.sahih: Who feared the Most Merciful unseen and came with a heart returning [in repentance].
ayahs.clear: Who inwardly feared the Most Gracious, and came with a repentant heart.
ayahs.kemenag: (Yaitu) orang yang takut kepada Tuhan Yang Maha Pemurah sedang Dia tidak kelihatan (olehnya) dan dia datang dengan hati yang bertaubat,

ayahs.arabic: ٱدْخُلُوهَا بِسَلَٰمٍۢ ۖ ذَٰلِكَ يَوْمُ ٱلْخُلُودِ
ayahs.sahih: Enter it in peace. This is the Day of Eternity."
ayahs.clear: Enter it in peace. This is the Day of Eternity.”
ayahs.kemenag: masukilah surga itu dengan aman, itulah hari kekekalan.

ayahs.arabic: لَهُم مَّا يَشَآءُونَ فِيهَا وَلَدَيْنَا مَزِيدٌۭ
ayahs.sahih: They will have whatever they wish therein, and with Us is more.
ayahs.clear: Therein they will have whatever they desire—and We have even more.
ayahs.kemenag: Mereka di dalamnya memperoleh apa yang mereka kehendaki; dan pada sisi Kami ada tambahannya.

ayahs.arabic: وَكَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا قَبْلَهُم مِّن قَرْنٍ هُمْ أَشَدُّ مِنْهُم بَطْشًۭا فَنَقَّبُوا۟ فِى ٱلْبِلَٰدِ هَلْ مِن مَّحِيصٍ
ayahs.sahih: And how many a generation before them did We destroy who were greater than them in [striking] power and had explored throughout the lands. Is there any place of escape?
ayahs.clear: How many generations before them, who were more powerful than they, did We destroy? They explored the lands—was there any escape?
ayahs.kemenag: Dan berapa banyaknya umat-umat yang telah Kami binasakan sebelum mereka yang mereka itu lebih besar kekuatannya daripada mereka ini, maka mereka (yang telah dibinasakan itu) telah pernah menjelajah di beberapa negeri. Adakah (mereka) mendapat tempat lari (dari kebinasaan)?

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَذِكْرَىٰ لِمَن كَانَ لَهُۥ قَلْبٌ أَوْ أَلْقَى ٱلسَّمْعَ وَهُوَ شَهِيدٌۭ
ayahs.sahih: Indeed in that is a reminder for whoever has a heart or who listens while he is present [in mind].
ayahs.clear: In that is a reminder for whoever possesses a heart, or cares to listen and witness.
ayahs.kemenag: Sesungguhnya pada yang demikian itu benar-benar terdapat peringatan bagi orang-orang yang mempunyai akal atau yang menggunakan pendengarannya, sedang dia menyaksikannya.

ayahs.arabic: وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا فِى سِتَّةِ أَيَّامٍۢ وَمَا مَسَّنَا مِن لُّغُوبٍۢ
ayahs.sahih: And We did certainly create the heavens and earth and what is between them in six days, and there touched Us no weariness.
ayahs.clear: We created the heavens and the earth and what is between them in six days, and no fatigue touched Us.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan sesungguhnya telah Kami ciptakan langit dan bumi dan apa yang ada antara keduanya dalam enam masa, dan Kami sedikitpun tidak ditimpa keletihan.

ayahs.arabic: فَٱصْبِرْ عَلَىٰ مَا يَقُولُونَ وَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ قَبْلَ طُلُوعِ ٱلشَّمْسِ وَقَبْلَ ٱلْغُرُوبِ
ayahs.sahih: So be patient, [O Muhammad], over what they say and exalt [Allah] with praise of your Lord before the rising of the sun and before its setting,
ayahs.clear: So endure what they say, and proclaim the praises of your Lord before the rising of the sun, and before sunset.
ayahs.kemenag: Maka bersabarlah kamu terhadap apa yang mereka katakan dan bertasbihlah sambil memuji Tuhanmu sebelum terbit matahari dan sebelum terbenam(nya).

ayahs.arabic: وَمِنَ ٱلَّيْلِ فَسَبِّحْهُ وَأَدْبَٰرَ ٱلسُّجُودِ
ayahs.sahih: And [in part] of the night exalt Him and after prostration.
ayahs.clear: And glorify Him during the night, and at the end of devotions.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan bertasbihlah kamu kepada-Nya di malam hari dan setiap selesai sembahyang.

ayahs.arabic: وَٱسْتَمِعْ يَوْمَ يُنَادِ ٱلْمُنَادِ مِن مَّكَانٍۢ قَرِيبٍۢ
ayahs.sahih: And listen on the Day when the Caller will call out from a place that is near -
ayahs.clear: And listen for the Day when the caller calls from a nearby place.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan dengarkanlah (seruan) pada hari penyeru (malaikat) menyeru dari tempat yang dekat.

ayahs.arabic: يَوْمَ يَسْمَعُونَ ٱلصَّيْحَةَ بِٱلْحَقِّ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ يَوْمُ ٱلْخُرُوجِ
ayahs.sahih: The Day they will hear the blast [of the Horn] in truth. That is the Day of Emergence [from the graves].
ayahs.clear: The Day when they will hear the Shout in all truth. That is the Day of Emergence.
ayahs.kemenag: (Yaitu) pada hari mereka mendengar teriakan dengan sebenar-benarnya itulah hari ke luar (dari kubur).

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّا نَحْنُ نُحْىِۦ وَنُمِيتُ وَإِلَيْنَا ٱلْمَصِيرُ
ayahs.sahih: Indeed, it is We who give life and cause death, and to Us is the destination
ayahs.clear: It is We who control life and death, and to Us is the destination.
ayahs.kemenag: Sesungguhnya Kami menghidupkan dan mematikan dan hanya kepada Kami-lah tempat kembali (semua makhluk).

ayahs.arabic: يَوْمَ تَشَقَّقُ ٱلْأَرْضُ عَنْهُمْ سِرَاعًۭا ۚ ذَٰلِكَ حَشْرٌ عَلَيْنَا يَسِيرٌۭ
ayahs.sahih: On the Day the earth breaks away from them [and they emerge] rapidly; that is a gathering easy for Us.
ayahs.clear: The Day when the earth will crack for them at once. That is an easy gathering for Us.
ayahs.kemenag: (Yaitu) pada hari bumi terbelah-belah menampakkan mereka (lalu mereka ke luar) dengan cepat. Yang demikian itu adalah pengumpulan yang mudah bagi Kami.

ayahs.arabic: نَّحْنُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا يَقُولُونَ ۖ وَمَآ أَنتَ عَلَيْهِم بِجَبَّارٍۢ ۖ فَذَكِّرْ بِٱلْقُرْءَانِ مَن يَخَافُ وَعِيدِ
ayahs.sahih: We are most knowing of what they say, and you are not over them a tyrant. But remind by the Qur'an whoever fears My threat.
ayahs.clear: We are fully aware of what they say, and you are not a dictator over them. So remind by the Quran whoever fears My warning.
ayahs.kemenag: Kami lebih mengetahui tentang apa yang mereka katakan, dan kamu sekali-kali bukanlah seorang pemaksa terhadap mereka. Maka beri peringatanlah dengan Al Quran orang yang takut dengan ancaman-Ku.

ayahs.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ وَٱلذَّٰرِيَٰتِ ذَرْوًۭا
ayahs.sahih: By those [winds] scattering [dust] dispersing
ayahs.clear: By the spreaders spreading.
ayahs.kemenag: Demi (angin) yang menerbangkan debu dengan kuat.

ayahs.arabic: فَٱلْحَٰمِلَٰتِ وِقْرًۭا
ayahs.sahih: And those [clouds] carrying a load [of water]
ayahs.clear: And those carrying loads.
ayahs.kemenag: dan awan yang mengandung hujan,

ayahs.arabic: فَٱلْجَٰرِيَٰتِ يُسْرًۭا
ayahs.sahih: And those [ships] sailing with ease
ayahs.clear: And those moving gently.
ayahs.kemenag: dan kapal-kapal yang berlayar dengan mudah.

ayahs.arabic: فَٱلْمُقَسِّمَٰتِ أَمْرًا
ayahs.sahih: And those [angels] apportioning [each] matter,
ayahs.clear: And those distributing as commanded.
ayahs.kemenag: dan (malaikat-malaikat) yang membagi-bagi urusan,

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّمَا تُوعَدُونَ لَصَادِقٌۭ
ayahs.sahih: Indeed, what you are promised is true.
ayahs.clear: What you are promised is true.
ayahs.kemenag: sesungguhnya apa yang dijanjikan kepadamu pasti benar.

ayahs.arabic: وَإِنَّ ٱلدِّينَ لَوَٰقِعٌۭ
ayahs.sahih: And indeed, the recompense is to occur.
ayahs.clear: Judgment will take place.
ayahs.kemenag: dan sesungguhnya (hari) pembalasan pasti terjadi.

ayahs.arabic: وَٱلسَّمَآءِ ذَاتِ ٱلْحُبُكِ
ayahs.sahih: By the heaven containing pathways,
ayahs.clear: By the sky that is woven.
ayahs.kemenag: Demi langit yang mempunyai jalan-jalan,

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّكُمْ لَفِى قَوْلٍۢ مُّخْتَلِفٍۢ
ayahs.sahih: Indeed, you are in differing speech.
ayahs.clear: You differ in what you say.
ayahs.kemenag: sesungguhnya kamu benar-benar dalam keadaan berbeda pendapat,

ayahs.arabic: يُؤْفَكُ عَنْهُ مَنْ أُفِكَ
ayahs.sahih: Deluded away from the Qur'an is he who is deluded.
ayahs.clear: Averted from it is he who is averted.
ayahs.kemenag: dipalingkan daripadanya (Rasul dan Al-Quran) orang yang dipalingkan.

ayahs.arabic: قُتِلَ ٱلْخَرَّٰصُونَ
ayahs.sahih: Destroyed are the falsifiers
ayahs.clear: Perish the imposters.
ayahs.kemenag: Terkutuklah orang-orang yang banyak berdusta,

ayahs.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ فِى غَمْرَةٍۢ سَاهُونَ
ayahs.sahih: Who are within a flood [of confusion] and heedless.
ayahs.clear: Those who are dazed in ignorance.
ayahs.kemenag: (yaitu) orang-orang yang terbenam dalam kebodohan yang lalai,

ayahs.arabic: يَسْـَٔلُونَ أَيَّانَ يَوْمُ ٱلدِّينِ
ayahs.sahih: They ask, "When is the Day of Recompense?"
ayahs.clear: They ask, “When is the Day of Judgment?”
ayahs.kemenag: mereka bertanya: "Bilakah hari pembalasan itu?"

ayahs.arabic: يَوْمَ هُمْ عَلَى ٱلنَّارِ يُفْتَنُونَ
ayahs.sahih: [It is] the Day they will be tormented over the Fire
ayahs.clear: The Day they are presented to the Fire.
ayahs.kemenag: (Hari pembalasan itu) ialah pada hari ketika mereka diazab di atas api neraka.

ayahs.arabic: ذُوقُوا۟ فِتْنَتَكُمْ هَٰذَا ٱلَّذِى كُنتُم بِهِۦ تَسْتَعْجِلُونَ
ayahs.sahih: [And will be told], "Taste your torment. This is that for which you were impatient."
ayahs.clear: “Taste your ordeal. This is what you used to challenge.”
ayahs.kemenag: (Dikatakan kepada mereka): "Rasakanlah azabmu itu. Inilah azab yang dulu kamu minta untuk disegerakan".

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِى جَنَّٰتٍۢ وَعُيُونٍ
ayahs.sahih: Indeed, the righteous will be among gardens and springs,
ayahs.clear: But the pious are amidst gardens and springs.
ayahs.kemenag: Sesungguhnya orang-orang yang bertakwa itu berada dalam taman-taman (surga) dan mata air-mata air,

ayahs.arabic: ءَاخِذِينَ مَآ ءَاتَىٰهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ ۚ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ قَبْلَ ذَٰلِكَ مُحْسِنِينَ
ayahs.sahih: Accepting what their Lord has given them. Indeed, they were before that doers of good.
ayahs.clear: Receiving what their Lord has given them. They were virtuous before that.
ayahs.kemenag: sambil menerima segala pemberian Rabb mereka. Sesungguhnya mereka sebelum itu di dunia adalah orang-orang yang berbuat kebaikan.

ayahs.arabic: كَانُوا۟ قَلِيلًۭا مِّنَ ٱلَّيْلِ مَا يَهْجَعُونَ
ayahs.sahih: They used to sleep but little of the night,
ayahs.clear: They used to sleep a little at night.
ayahs.kemenag: Di dunia mereka sedikit sekali tidur diwaktu malam.

ayahs.arabic: وَبِٱلْأَسْحَارِ هُمْ يَسْتَغْفِرُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And in the hours before dawn they would ask forgiveness,
ayahs.clear: And at dawn, they would pray for pardon.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan selalu memohonkan ampunan diwaktu pagi sebelum fajar.

ayahs.arabic: وَفِىٓ أَمْوَٰلِهِمْ حَقٌّۭ لِّلسَّآئِلِ وَٱلْمَحْرُومِ
ayahs.sahih: And from their properties was [given] the right of the [needy] petitioner and the deprived.
ayahs.clear: And in their wealth, there was a share for the beggar and the deprived.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan pada harta-harta mereka ada hak untuk orang miskin yang meminta dan orang miskin yang tidak mendapat bagian.

ayahs.arabic: وَفِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ءَايَٰتٌۭ لِّلْمُوقِنِينَ
ayahs.sahih: And on the earth are signs for the certain [in faith]
ayahs.clear: And on earth are signs for the convinced.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan di bumi itu terdapat tanda-tanda (kekuasaan Allah) bagi orang-orang yang yakin.

ayahs.arabic: وَفِىٓ أَنفُسِكُمْ ۚ أَفَلَا تُبْصِرُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And in yourselves. Then will you not see?
ayahs.clear: And within yourselves. Do you not see?
ayahs.kemenag: dan (juga) pada dirimu sendiri. Maka apakah kamu tidak memperhatikan?

ayahs.arabic: وَفِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ رِزْقُكُمْ وَمَا تُوعَدُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And in the heaven is your provision and whatever you are promised.
ayahs.clear: And in the heaven is your livelihood, and what you are promised.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan di langit terdapat (sebab-sebab) rezekimu dan terdapat (pula) apa yang dijanjikan kepadamu.

ayahs.arabic: فَوَرَبِّ ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ إِنَّهُۥ لَحَقٌّۭ مِّثْلَ مَآ أَنَّكُمْ تَنطِقُونَ
ayahs.sahih: Then by the Lord of the heaven and earth, indeed, it is truth - just as [sure as] it is that you are speaking.
ayahs.clear: By the Lord of the heaven and the earth, it is as true as the fact that you speak.
ayahs.kemenag: Maka demi Tuhan langit dan bumi, sesungguhnya yang dijanjikan itu adalah benar-benar (akan terjadi) seperti perkataan yang kamu ucapkan.

ayahs.arabic: هَلْ أَتَىٰكَ حَدِيثُ ضَيْفِ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ ٱلْمُكْرَمِينَ
ayahs.sahih: Has there reached you the story of the honored guests of Abraham? -
ayahs.clear: Has the story of Abraham’s honorable guests reached you?
ayahs.kemenag: Sudahkah sampai kepadamu (Muhammad) cerita tentang tamu Ibrahim (yaitu malaikat-malaikat) yang dimuliakan?

ayahs.arabic: إِذْ دَخَلُوا۟ عَلَيْهِ فَقَالُوا۟ سَلَٰمًۭا ۖ قَالَ سَلَٰمٌۭ قَوْمٌۭ مُّنكَرُونَ
ayahs.sahih: When they entered upon him and said, "[We greet you with] peace." He answered, "[And upon you] peace, [you are] a people unknown.
ayahs.clear: When they entered upon him, they said, “Peace.” He said, “Peace, strangers.”
ayahs.kemenag: (Ingatlah) ketika mereka masuk ke tempatnya lalu mengucapkan: "Salaamun". Ibrahim menjawab: "Salaamun (kamu) adalah orang-orang yang tidak dikenal".

ayahs.arabic: فَرَاغَ إِلَىٰٓ أَهْلِهِۦ فَجَآءَ بِعِجْلٍۢ سَمِينٍۢ
ayahs.sahih: Then he went to his family and came with a fat [roasted] calf
ayahs.clear: Then he slipped away to his family, and brought a fatted calf.
ayahs.kemenag: Maka dia pergi dengan diam-diam menemui keluarganya, kemudian dibawanya daging anak sapi gemuk.

ayahs.arabic: فَقَرَّبَهُۥٓ إِلَيْهِمْ قَالَ أَلَا تَأْكُلُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And placed it near them; he said, "Will you not eat?"
ayahs.clear: He set it before them. He said, “Will you not eat?”
ayahs.kemenag: Lalu dihidangkannya kepada mereka. Ibrahim lalu berkata: "Silahkan anda makan".

ayahs.arabic: فَأَوْجَسَ مِنْهُمْ خِيفَةًۭ ۖ قَالُوا۟ لَا تَخَفْ ۖ وَبَشَّرُوهُ بِغُلَٰمٍ عَلِيمٍۢ
ayahs.sahih: And he felt from them apprehension. They said, "Fear not," and gave him good tidings of a learned boy.
ayahs.clear: And he harbored fear of them. They said, “Do not fear,” and they announced to him the good news of a knowledgeable boy.
ayahs.kemenag: (Tetapi mereka tidak mau makan), karena itu Ibrahim merasa takut terhadap mereka. Mereka berkata: "Janganlah kamu takut", dan mereka memberi kabar gembira kepadanya dengan (kelahiran) seorang anak yang alim (Ishak).

ayahs.arabic: فَأَقْبَلَتِ ٱمْرَأَتُهُۥ فِى صَرَّةٍۢ فَصَكَّتْ وَجْهَهَا وَقَالَتْ عَجُوزٌ عَقِيمٌۭ
ayahs.sahih: And his wife approached with a cry [of alarm] and struck her face and said, "[I am] a barren old woman!"
ayahs.clear: His wife came forward crying. She clasped her face, and said, “A barren old woman?”
ayahs.kemenag: Kemudian isterinya datang memekik lalu menepuk mukanya sendiri seraya berkata: "(Aku adalah) seorang perempuan tua yang mandul".

ayahs.arabic: قَالُوا۟ كَذَٰلِكِ قَالَ رَبُّكِ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلْحَكِيمُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
ayahs.sahih: They said, "Thus has said your Lord; indeed, He is the Wise, the Knowing."
ayahs.clear: They said, “Thus spoke your Lord. He is the Wise, the Knowing.”
ayahs.kemenag: Mereka berkata: "Demikianlah Tuhanmu memfirmankan" Sesungguhnya Dialah yang Maha Bijaksana lagi Maha Mengetahui.

ayahs.arabic: ۞ قَالَ فَمَا خَطْبُكُمْ أَيُّهَا ٱلْمُرْسَلُونَ
ayahs.sahih: [Abraham] said, "Then what is your business [here], O messengers?"
ayahs.clear: He said, “What is your business, O envoys?”
ayahs.kemenag: Ibrahim bertanya: "Apakah urusanmu hai para utusan?"

ayahs.arabic: قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّآ أُرْسِلْنَآ إِلَىٰ قَوْمٍۢ مُّجْرِمِينَ
ayahs.sahih: They said, "Indeed, we have been sent to a people of criminals
ayahs.clear: They said, “We are sent to a people guilty of sin.”
ayahs.kemenag: Mereka menjawab: "Sesungguhnya kami diutus kepada kaum yang berdosa (kaum Luth),

ayahs.arabic: لِنُرْسِلَ عَلَيْهِمْ حِجَارَةًۭ مِّن طِينٍۢ
ayahs.sahih: To send down upon them stones of clay,
ayahs.clear: “To unleash upon them rocks of clay.”
ayahs.kemenag: agar kami timpakan kepada mereka batu-batu dari tanah,

ayahs.arabic: مُّسَوَّمَةً عِندَ رَبِّكَ لِلْمُسْرِفِينَ
ayahs.sahih: Marked in the presence of your Lord for the transgressors."
ayahs.clear: “Marked by your Lord for the excessive.”
ayahs.kemenag: yang ditandai di sisi Tuhanmu untuk membinasakan orang-orang yang melampaui batas".

ayahs.arabic: فَأَخْرَجْنَا مَن كَانَ فِيهَا مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
ayahs.sahih: So We brought out whoever was in the cities of the believers.
ayahs.clear: We evacuated all the believers who were in it.
ayahs.kemenag: Lalu Kami keluarkan orang-orang yang beriman yang berada di negeri kaum Luth itu.

ayahs.arabic: فَمَا وَجَدْنَا فِيهَا غَيْرَ بَيْتٍۢ مِّنَ ٱلْمُسْلِمِينَ
ayahs.sahih: And We found not within them other than a [single] house of Muslims.
ayahs.clear: But found in it only one household of Muslims.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan Kami tidak mendapati negeri itu, kecuali sebuah rumah dari orang yang berserah diri.

ayahs.arabic: وَتَرَكْنَا فِيهَآ ءَايَةًۭ لِّلَّذِينَ يَخَافُونَ ٱلْعَذَابَ ٱلْأَلِيمَ
ayahs.sahih: And We left therein a sign for those who fear the painful punishment.
ayahs.clear: And We left in it a sign for those who fear the painful punishment.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan Kami tinggalkan pada negeri itu suatu tanda bagi orang-orang yang takut kepada siksa yang pedih.

ayahs.arabic: وَفِى مُوسَىٰٓ إِذْ أَرْسَلْنَٰهُ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ بِسُلْطَٰنٍۢ مُّبِينٍۢ
ayahs.sahih: And in Moses [was a sign], when We sent him to Pharaoh with clear authority.
ayahs.clear: And in Moses. We sent him to Pharaoh with a clear authority.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan juga pada Musa (terdapat tanda-tanda kekuasaan Allah) ketika Kami mengutusnya kepada Fir'aun dengan membawa mukjizat yang nyata.

ayahs.arabic: فَتَوَلَّىٰ بِرُكْنِهِۦ وَقَالَ سَٰحِرٌ أَوْ مَجْنُونٌۭ
ayahs.sahih: But he turned away with his supporters and said," A magician or a madman."
ayahs.clear: But he turned away with his warlords, and said, “A sorcerer or a madman.”
ayahs.kemenag: Maka dia (Fir'aun) berpaling (dari iman) bersama tentaranya dan berkata: "Dia adalah seorang tukang sihir atau seorang gila".

ayahs.arabic: فَأَخَذْنَٰهُ وَجُنُودَهُۥ فَنَبَذْنَٰهُمْ فِى ٱلْيَمِّ وَهُوَ مُلِيمٌۭ
ayahs.sahih: So We took him and his soldiers and cast them into the sea, and he was blameworthy.
ayahs.clear: So We seized him and his troops, and threw them into the sea, and He was to blame.
ayahs.kemenag: Maka Kami siksa dia dan tentaranya lalu Kami lemparkan mereka ke dalam laut, sedang dia melakukan pekerjaan yang tercela.

ayahs.arabic: وَفِى عَادٍ إِذْ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلرِّيحَ ٱلْعَقِيمَ
ayahs.sahih: And in 'Aad [was a sign], when We sent against them the barren wind.
ayahs.clear: And in Aad. We unleashed against them the devastating wind.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan juga pada (kisah) Aad ketika Kami kirimkan kepada mereka angin yang membinasakan,

ayahs.arabic: مَا تَذَرُ مِن شَىْءٍ أَتَتْ عَلَيْهِ إِلَّا جَعَلَتْهُ كَٱلرَّمِيمِ
ayahs.sahih: It left nothing of what it came upon but that it made it like disintegrated ruins.
ayahs.clear: It spared nothing it came upon, but rendered it like decayed ruins.
ayahs.kemenag: angin itu tidak membiarkan satupun yang dilaluinya, melainkan dijadikannya seperti serbuk.

ayahs.arabic: وَفِى ثَمُودَ إِذْ قِيلَ لَهُمْ تَمَتَّعُوا۟ حَتَّىٰ حِينٍۢ
ayahs.sahih: And in Thamud, when it was said to them, "Enjoy yourselves for a time."
ayahs.clear: And in Thamood. They were told, “Enjoy yourselves for a while.”
ayahs.kemenag: Dan pada (kisah) kaum Tsamud ketika dikatakan kepada mereka: "Bersenang-senanglah kalian sampai suatu waktu".

ayahs.arabic: فَعَتَوْا۟ عَنْ أَمْرِ رَبِّهِمْ فَأَخَذَتْهُمُ ٱلصَّٰعِقَةُ وَهُمْ يَنظُرُونَ
ayahs.sahih: But they were insolent toward the command of their Lord, so the thunderbolt seized them while they were looking on.
ayahs.clear: But they defied the command of their Lord, so the lightning struck them as they looked on.
ayahs.kemenag: Maka mereka berlaku angkuh terhadap perintah Tuhannya, lalu mereka disambar petir dan mereka melihatnya.

ayahs.arabic: فَمَا ٱسْتَطَٰعُوا۟ مِن قِيَامٍۢ وَمَا كَانُوا۟ مُنتَصِرِينَ
ayahs.sahih: And they were unable to arise, nor could they defend themselves.
ayahs.clear: They could not rise up, nor could they find help.
ayahs.kemenag: Maka mereka sekali-kali tidak dapat bangun dan tidak pula mendapat pertolongan,

ayahs.arabic: وَقَوْمَ نُوحٍۢ مِّن قَبْلُ ۖ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ قَوْمًۭا فَٰسِقِينَ
ayahs.sahih: And [We destroyed] the people of Noah before; indeed, they were a people defiantly disobedient.
ayahs.clear: And before that, the people of Noah. They were immoral people.
ayahs.kemenag: dan (Kami membinasakan) kaum Nuh sebelum itu. Sesungguhnya mereka adalah kaum yang fasik.

ayahs.arabic: وَٱلسَّمَآءَ بَنَيْنَٰهَا بِأَيْي۟دٍۢ وَإِنَّا لَمُوسِعُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And the heaven We constructed with strength, and indeed, We are [its] expander.
ayahs.clear: We constructed the universe with power, and We are expanding it.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan langit itu Kami bangun dengan kekuasaan (Kami) dan sesungguhnya Kami benar-benar berkuasa

ayahs.arabic: وَٱلْأَرْضَ فَرَشْنَٰهَا فَنِعْمَ ٱلْمَٰهِدُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And the earth We have spread out, and excellent is the preparer.
ayahs.clear: And the earth—We spread it out—How well We prepared it!
ayahs.kemenag: Dan bumi itu Kami hamparkan, maka sebaik-baik yang menghamparkan (adalah Kami).

ayahs.arabic: وَمِن كُلِّ شَىْءٍ خَلَقْنَا زَوْجَيْنِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَذَكَّرُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And of all things We created two mates; perhaps you will remember.
ayahs.clear: We created all things in pairs, so that you may reflect and ponder.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan segala sesuatu Kami ciptakan berpasang-pasangan supaya kamu mengingat kebesaran Allah.

ayahs.arabic: فَفِرُّوٓا۟ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ ۖ إِنِّى لَكُم مِّنْهُ نَذِيرٌۭ مُّبِينٌۭ
ayahs.sahih: So flee to Allah. Indeed, I am to you from Him a clear warner.
ayahs.clear: “So flee towards God. I am to you from Him a clear warner.”
ayahs.kemenag: Maka segeralah kembali kepada (mentaati) Allah. Sesungguhnya aku seorang pemberi peringatan yang nyata dari Allah untukmu.

ayahs.arabic: وَلَا تَجْعَلُوا۟ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَٰهًا ءَاخَرَ ۖ إِنِّى لَكُم مِّنْهُ نَذِيرٌۭ مُّبِينٌۭ
ayahs.sahih: And do not make [as equal] with Allah another deity. Indeed, I am to you from Him a clear warner.
ayahs.clear: “And do not set up any other god with God. I am to you from Him a clear warner.”
ayahs.kemenag: Dan janganlah kamu mengadakan tuhan yang lain disamping Allah. Sesungguhnya aku seorang pemberi peringatan yang nyata dari Allah untukmu.

ayahs.arabic: كَذَٰلِكَ مَآ أَتَى ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِم مِّن رَّسُولٍ إِلَّا قَالُوا۟ سَاحِرٌ أَوْ مَجْنُونٌ
ayahs.sahih: Similarly, there came not to those before them any messenger except that they said, "A magician or a madman."
ayahs.clear: Likewise, no messenger came to those before them, but they said, “A sorcerer or a madman.”
ayahs.kemenag: Demikianlah tidak seorang rasulpun yang datang kepada orang-orang yang sebelum mereka, melainkan mereka mengatakan: "Dia adalah seorang tukang sihir atau seorang gila".

ayahs.arabic: أَتَوَاصَوْا۟ بِهِۦ ۚ بَلْ هُمْ قَوْمٌۭ طَاغُونَ
ayahs.sahih: Did they suggest it to them? Rather, they [themselves] are a transgressing people.
ayahs.clear: Did they recommend it to one another? In fact, they are rebellious people.
ayahs.kemenag: Apakah mereka saling berpesan tentang apa yang dikatakan itu. Sebenarnya mereka adalah kaum yang melampaui batas.

ayahs.arabic: فَتَوَلَّ عَنْهُمْ فَمَآ أَنتَ بِمَلُومٍۢ
ayahs.sahih: So leave them, [O Muhammad], for you are not to be blamed.
ayahs.clear: So turn away from them; you are not to blame.
ayahs.kemenag: Maka berpalinglah kamu dari mereka dan kamu sekali-kali tidak tercela.

ayahs.arabic: وَذَكِّرْ فَإِنَّ ٱلذِّكْرَىٰ تَنفَعُ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
ayahs.sahih: And remind, for indeed, the reminder benefits the believers.
ayahs.clear: And remind, for the reminder benefits the believers.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan tetaplah memberi peringatan, karena sesungguhnya peringatan itu bermanfaat bagi orang-orang yang beriman.

ayahs.arabic: وَمَا خَلَقْتُ ٱلْجِنَّ وَٱلْإِنسَ إِلَّا لِيَعْبُدُونِ
ayahs.sahih: And I did not create the jinn and mankind except to worship Me.
ayahs.clear: I did not create the jinn and the humans except to worship Me.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan aku tidak menciptakan jin dan manusia melainkan supaya mereka mengabdi kepada-Ku.

ayahs.arabic: مَآ أُرِيدُ مِنْهُم مِّن رِّزْقٍۢ وَمَآ أُرِيدُ أَن يُطْعِمُونِ
ayahs.sahih: I do not want from them any provision, nor do I want them to feed Me.
ayahs.clear: I need no livelihood from them, nor do I need them to feed Me.
ayahs.kemenag: Aku tidak menghendaki rezeki sedikitpun dari mereka dan Aku tidak menghendaki supaya mereka memberi-Ku makan.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ ٱلرَّزَّاقُ ذُو ٱلْقُوَّةِ ٱلْمَتِينُ
ayahs.sahih: Indeed, it is Allah who is the [continual] Provider, the firm possessor of strength.
ayahs.clear: God is the Provider, the One with Power, the Strong.
ayahs.kemenag: Sesungguhnya Allah Dialah Maha Pemberi rezeki Yang mempunyai Kekuatan lagi Sangat Kokoh.

ayahs.arabic: فَإِنَّ لِلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ ذَنُوبًۭا مِّثْلَ ذَنُوبِ أَصْحَٰبِهِمْ فَلَا يَسْتَعْجِلُونِ
ayahs.sahih: And indeed, for those who have wronged is a portion [of punishment] like the portion of their predecessors, so let them not impatiently urge Me.
ayahs.clear: Those who do wrong will have their turn, like the turn of their counterparts, so let them not rush Me.
ayahs.kemenag: Maka sesungguhnya untuk orang-orang zalim ada bagian (siksa) seperti bahagian teman mereka (dahulu); maka janganlah mereka meminta kepada-Ku untuk menyegerakannya.

ayahs.arabic: فَوَيْلٌۭ لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِن يَوْمِهِمُ ٱلَّذِى يُوعَدُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And woe to those who have disbelieved from their Day which they are promised.
ayahs.clear: So woe to those who disbelieve because of that Day of theirs which they are promised.
ayahs.kemenag: Maka kecelakaanlah bagi orang-orang yang kafir pada hari yang diancamkan kepada mereka.

ayahs.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ وَٱلطُّورِ
ayahs.sahih: By the mount
ayahs.clear: By the Mount.
ayahs.kemenag: Demi bukit,

ayahs.arabic: وَكِتَٰبٍۢ مَّسْطُورٍۢ
ayahs.sahih: And [by] a Book inscribed
ayahs.clear: And a Book inscribed.
ayahs.kemenag: dan Kitab yang ditulis,

ayahs.arabic: فِى رَقٍّۢ مَّنشُورٍۢ
ayahs.sahih: In parchment spread open
ayahs.clear: In a published scroll.
ayahs.kemenag: pada lembaran yang terbuka,

ayahs.arabic: وَٱلْبَيْتِ ٱلْمَعْمُورِ
ayahs.sahih: And [by] the frequented House
ayahs.clear: And the frequented House.
ayahs.kemenag: dan demi Baitul Ma'mur,

ayahs.arabic: وَٱلسَّقْفِ ٱلْمَرْفُوعِ
ayahs.sahih: And [by] the heaven raised high
ayahs.clear: And the elevated roof.
ayahs.kemenag: dan atap yang ditinggikan (langit),

ayahs.arabic: وَٱلْبَحْرِ ٱلْمَسْجُورِ
ayahs.sahih: And [by] the sea filled [with fire],
ayahs.clear: And the seething sea.
ayahs.kemenag: dan laut yang di dalam tanahnya ada api,

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ عَذَابَ رَبِّكَ لَوَٰقِعٌۭ
ayahs.sahih: Indeed, the punishment of your Lord will occur.
ayahs.clear: The punishment of your Lord is coming.
ayahs.kemenag: sesungguhnya azab Tuhanmu pasti terjadi,

ayahs.arabic: مَّا لَهُۥ مِن دَافِعٍۢ
ayahs.sahih: Of it there is no preventer.
ayahs.clear: There is nothing to avert it.
ayahs.kemenag: tidak seorangpun yang dapat menolaknya,

ayahs.arabic: يَوْمَ تَمُورُ ٱلسَّمَآءُ مَوْرًۭا
ayahs.sahih: On the Day the heaven will sway with circular motion
ayahs.clear: On the Day when the heaven sways in agitation.
ayahs.kemenag: pada hari ketika langit benar-benar bergoncang,

ayahs.arabic: وَتَسِيرُ ٱلْجِبَالُ سَيْرًۭا
ayahs.sahih: And the mountains will pass on, departing -
ayahs.clear: And the mountains go into motion.
ayahs.kemenag: dan gunung benar-benar berjalan.

ayahs.arabic: فَوَيْلٌۭ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
ayahs.sahih: Then woe, that Day, to the deniers,
ayahs.clear: Woe on that Day to the deniers.
ayahs.kemenag: Maka kecelakaan yang besarlah di hari itu bagi orang-orang yang mendustakan,

ayahs.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ فِى خَوْضٍۢ يَلْعَبُونَ
ayahs.sahih: Who are in [empty] discourse amusing themselves.
ayahs.clear: Those who play with speculation.
ayahs.kemenag: (yaitu) orang-orang yang bermain-main dalam kebathilan,

ayahs.arabic: يَوْمَ يُدَعُّونَ إِلَىٰ نَارِ جَهَنَّمَ دَعًّا
ayahs.sahih: The Day they are thrust toward the fire of Hell with a [violent] thrust, [its angels will say],
ayahs.clear: The Day when they are shoved into the Fire of Hell forcefully.
ayahs.kemenag: pada hari mereka didorong ke neraka Jahannam dengan sekuat-kuatnya.

ayahs.arabic: هَٰذِهِ ٱلنَّارُ ٱلَّتِى كُنتُم بِهَا تُكَذِّبُونَ
ayahs.sahih: "This is the Fire which you used to deny.
ayahs.clear: “This is the Fire which you used to deny.
ayahs.kemenag: (Dikatakan kepada mereka): "Inilah neraka yang dahulu kamu selalu mendustakannya".

ayahs.arabic: أَفَسِحْرٌ هَٰذَآ أَمْ أَنتُمْ لَا تُبْصِرُونَ
ayahs.sahih: Then is this magic, or do you not see?
ayahs.clear: Is this magic, or do you not see?
ayahs.kemenag: Maka apakah ini sihir? Ataukah kamu tidak melihat?

ayahs.arabic: ٱصْلَوْهَا فَٱصْبِرُوٓا۟ أَوْ لَا تَصْبِرُوا۟ سَوَآءٌ عَلَيْكُمْ ۖ إِنَّمَا تُجْزَوْنَ مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
ayahs.sahih: [Enter to] burn therein; then be patient or impatient - it is all the same for you. You are only being recompensed [for] what you used to do."
ayahs.clear: Burn in it. Whether you are patient, or impatient, it is the same for you. You are only being repaid for what you used to do.”
ayahs.kemenag: Masukklah kamu ke dalamnya (rasakanlah panas apinya); maka baik kamu bersabar atau tidak, sama saja bagimu; kamu diberi balasan terhadap apa yang telah kamu kerjakan.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِى جَنَّٰتٍۢ وَنَعِيمٍۢ
ayahs.sahih: Indeed, the righteous will be in gardens and pleasure,
ayahs.clear: But the righteous will be amid gardens and bliss.
ayahs.kemenag: Sesungguhnya orang-orang yang bertakwa berada dalam surga dan kenikmatan,

ayahs.arabic: فَٰكِهِينَ بِمَآ ءَاتَىٰهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ وَوَقَىٰهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ عَذَابَ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
ayahs.sahih: Enjoying what their Lord has given them, and their Lord protected them from the punishment of Hellfire.
ayahs.clear: Enjoying what their Lord has given them, and their Lord has spared them the suffering of Hell.
ayahs.kemenag: mereka bersuka ria dengan apa yang diberikan kepada mereka oleh Tuhan mereka; dan Tuhan mereka memelihara mereka dari azab neraka.

ayahs.arabic: كُلُوا۟ وَٱشْرَبُوا۟ هَنِيٓـًٔۢا بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
ayahs.sahih: [They will be told], "Eat and drink in satisfaction for what you used to do."
ayahs.clear: Eat and drink happily, for what you used to do.
ayahs.kemenag: (Dikatakan kepada mereka): "Makan dan minumlah dengan enak sebagai balasan dari apa yang telah kamu kerjakan",

ayahs.arabic: مُتَّكِـِٔينَ عَلَىٰ سُرُرٍۢ مَّصْفُوفَةٍۢ ۖ وَزَوَّجْنَٰهُم بِحُورٍ عِينٍۢ
ayahs.sahih: They will be reclining on thrones lined up, and We will marry them to fair women with large, [beautiful] eyes.
ayahs.clear: Relaxing on luxurious furnishings; and We will couple them with gorgeous spouses.
ayahs.kemenag: mereka bertelekan di atas dipan-dipan berderetan dan Kami kawinkan mereka dengan bidadari-bidadari yang cantik bermata jeli.

ayahs.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَٱتَّبَعَتْهُمْ ذُرِّيَّتُهُم بِإِيمَٰنٍ أَلْحَقْنَا بِهِمْ ذُرِّيَّتَهُمْ وَمَآ أَلَتْنَٰهُم مِّنْ عَمَلِهِم مِّن شَىْءٍۢ ۚ كُلُّ ٱمْرِئٍۭ بِمَا كَسَبَ رَهِينٌۭ
ayahs.sahih: And those who believed and whose descendants followed them in faith - We will join with them their descendants, and We will not deprive them of anything of their deeds. Every person, for what he earned, is retained.
ayahs.clear: Those who believed and their offspring followed them in faith—We will unite them with their offspring, and We will not deprive them of any of their works. Every person is hostage to what he has earned.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan orang-oranng yang beriman, dan yang anak cucu mereka mengikuti mereka dalam keimanan, Kami hubungkan anak cucu mereka dengan mereka, dan Kami tiada mengurangi sedikitpun dari pahala amal mereka. Tiap-tiap manusia terikat dengan apa yang dikerjakannya.

ayahs.arabic: وَأَمْدَدْنَٰهُم بِفَٰكِهَةٍۢ وَلَحْمٍۢ مِّمَّا يَشْتَهُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And We will provide them with fruit and meat from whatever they desire.
ayahs.clear: And We will supply them with fruit, and meat; such as they desire.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan Kami beri mereka tambahan dengan buah-buahan dan daging dari segala jenis yang mereka ingini.

ayahs.arabic: يَتَنَٰزَعُونَ فِيهَا كَأْسًۭا لَّا لَغْوٌۭ فِيهَا وَلَا تَأْثِيمٌۭ
ayahs.sahih: They will exchange with one another a cup [of wine] wherein [results] no ill speech or commission of sin.
ayahs.clear: They will exchange therein a cup; wherein is neither harm, nor sin.
ayahs.kemenag: Di dalam surga mereka saling memperebutkan piala (gelas) yang isinya tidak (menimbulkan) kata-kata yang tidak berfaedah dan tiada pula perbuatan dosa.

ayahs.arabic: ۞ وَيَطُوفُ عَلَيْهِمْ غِلْمَانٌۭ لَّهُمْ كَأَنَّهُمْ لُؤْلُؤٌۭ مَّكْنُونٌۭ
ayahs.sahih: There will circulate among them [servant] boys [especially] for them, as if they were pearls well-protected.
ayahs.clear: Serving them will be youths like hidden pearls.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan berkeliling di sekitar mereka anak-anak muda untuk (melayani) mereka, seakan-akan mereka itu mutiara yang tersimpan.

ayahs.arabic: وَأَقْبَلَ بَعْضُهُمْ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍۢ يَتَسَآءَلُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And they will approach one another, inquiring of each other.
ayahs.clear: And they will approach one another, inquiring.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan sebahagian mereka menghadap kepada sebahagian yang lain saling tanya-menanya.

ayahs.arabic: قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّا كُنَّا قَبْلُ فِىٓ أَهْلِنَا مُشْفِقِينَ
ayahs.sahih: They will say, "Indeed, we were previously among our people fearful [of displeasing Allah].
ayahs.clear: They will say, “Before this, we were fearful for our families.
ayahs.kemenag: Mereka berkata: "Sesungguhnya kami dahulu, sewaktu berada di tengah-tengah keluarga kami merasa takut (akan diazab)".

ayahs.arabic: فَمَنَّ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْنَا وَوَقَىٰنَا عَذَابَ ٱلسَّمُومِ
ayahs.sahih: So Allah conferred favor upon us and protected us from the punishment of the Scorching Fire.
ayahs.clear: But God blessed us, and spared us the agony of the Fiery Winds.
ayahs.kemenag: Maka Allah memberikan karunia kepada kami dan memelihara kami dari azab neraka.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّا كُنَّا مِن قَبْلُ نَدْعُوهُ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلْبَرُّ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
ayahs.sahih: Indeed, we used to supplicate Him before. Indeed, it is He who is the Beneficent, the Merciful."
ayahs.clear: Before this, we used to pray to Him. He is the Good, the Compassionate.”
ayahs.kemenag: Sesungguhnya kami dahulu menyembah-Nya. Sesungguhnya Dialah yang melimpahkan kebaikan lagi Maha Penyayang.

ayahs.arabic: فَذَكِّرْ فَمَآ أَنتَ بِنِعْمَتِ رَبِّكَ بِكَاهِنٍۢ وَلَا مَجْنُونٍ
ayahs.sahih: So remind [O Muhammad], for you are not, by the favor of your Lord, a soothsayer or a madman.
ayahs.clear: So remind. By the grace of your Lord, you are neither a soothsayer, nor a madman.
ayahs.kemenag: Maka tetaplah memberi peringatan, dan kamu disebabkan nikmat Tuhanmu bukanlah seorang tukang tenung dan bukan pula seorang gila.

ayahs.arabic: أَمْ يَقُولُونَ شَاعِرٌۭ نَّتَرَبَّصُ بِهِۦ رَيْبَ ٱلْمَنُونِ
ayahs.sahih: Or do they say [of you], "A poet for whom we await a misfortune of time?"
ayahs.clear: Or do they say, “A poet—we await for him a calamity of time”?
