ayahs.kemenag: Bahkan mereka mengatakan: "Dia adalah seorang penyair yang kami tunggu-tunggu kecelakaan menimpanya".

ayahs.arabic: قُلْ تَرَبَّصُوا۟ فَإِنِّى مَعَكُم مِّنَ ٱلْمُتَرَبِّصِينَ
ayahs.sahih: Say, "Wait, for indeed I am, with you, among the waiters."
ayahs.clear: Say, “Go on waiting; I will be waiting with you.”
ayahs.kemenag: Katakanlah: "Tunggulah, maka sesungguhnya akupun termasuk orang yang menunggu (pula) bersama kamu".

ayahs.arabic: أَمْ تَأْمُرُهُمْ أَحْلَٰمُهُم بِهَٰذَآ ۚ أَمْ هُمْ قَوْمٌۭ طَاغُونَ
ayahs.sahih: Or do their minds command them to [say] this, or are they a transgressing people?
ayahs.clear: Or is it that their dreams compel them to this? Or are they aggressive people?
ayahs.kemenag: Apakah mereka diperintah oleh fikiran-fikiran mereka untuk mengucapkan tuduhan-tuduhan ini ataukah mereka kaum yang melampaui batas?

ayahs.arabic: أَمْ يَقُولُونَ تَقَوَّلَهُۥ ۚ بَل لَّا يُؤْمِنُونَ
ayahs.sahih: Or do they say, "He has made it up"? Rather, they do not believe.
ayahs.clear: Or do they say, “He made it up”? Rather, they do not believe.
ayahs.kemenag: Ataukah mereka mengatakan: "Dia (Muhammad) membuat-buatnya". Sebenarnya mereka tidak beriman.

ayahs.arabic: فَلْيَأْتُوا۟ بِحَدِيثٍۢ مِّثْلِهِۦٓ إِن كَانُوا۟ صَٰدِقِينَ
ayahs.sahih: Then let them produce a statement like it, if they should be truthful.
ayahs.clear: So let them produce a discourse like it, if they are truthful.
ayahs.kemenag: Maka hendaklah mereka mendatangkan kalimat yang semisal Al Quran itu jika mereka orang-orang yang benar.

ayahs.arabic: أَمْ خُلِقُوا۟ مِنْ غَيْرِ شَىْءٍ أَمْ هُمُ ٱلْخَٰلِقُونَ
ayahs.sahih: Or were they created by nothing, or were they the creators [of themselves]?
ayahs.clear: Or were they created out of nothing? Or are they the creators?
ayahs.kemenag: Apakah mereka diciptakan tanpa sesuatupun ataukah mereka yang menciptakan (diri mereka sendiri)?

ayahs.arabic: أَمْ خَلَقُوا۟ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ ۚ بَل لَّا يُوقِنُونَ
ayahs.sahih: Or did they create the heavens and the earth? Rather, they are not certain.
ayahs.clear: Or did they create the heavens and the earth? In fact, they are not certain.
ayahs.kemenag: Ataukah mereka telah menciptakan langit dan bumi itu?; sebenarnya mereka tidak meyakini (apa yang mereka katakan).

ayahs.arabic: أَمْ عِندَهُمْ خَزَآئِنُ رَبِّكَ أَمْ هُمُ ٱلْمُصَۣيْطِرُونَ
ayahs.sahih: Or have they the depositories [containing the provision] of your Lord? Or are they the controllers [of them]?
ayahs.clear: Or do they possess the treasuries of your Lord? Or are they the controllers?
ayahs.kemenag: Ataukah di sisi mereka ada perbendaharaan Tuhanmu atau merekakah yang berkuasa?

ayahs.arabic: أَمْ لَهُمْ سُلَّمٌۭ يَسْتَمِعُونَ فِيهِ ۖ فَلْيَأْتِ مُسْتَمِعُهُم بِسُلْطَٰنٍۢ مُّبِينٍ
ayahs.sahih: Or have they a stairway [into the heaven] upon which they listen? Then let their listener produce a clear authority.
ayahs.clear: Or do they have a stairway by means of which they listen? Then let their listener produce a clear proof.
ayahs.kemenag: Ataukah mereka mempunyai tangga (ke langit) untuk mendengarkan pada tangga itu (hal-hal yang gaib)? Maka hendaklah orang yang mendengarkan di antara mereka mendatangkan suatu keterangan yang nyata.

ayahs.arabic: أَمْ لَهُ ٱلْبَنَٰتُ وَلَكُمُ ٱلْبَنُونَ
ayahs.sahih: Or has He daughters while you have sons?
ayahs.clear: Or for Him the daughters, and for you the sons?
ayahs.kemenag: Ataukah untuk Allah anak-anak perempuan dan untuk kamu anak-anak laki-laki?

ayahs.arabic: أَمْ تَسْـَٔلُهُمْ أَجْرًۭا فَهُم مِّن مَّغْرَمٍۢ مُّثْقَلُونَ
ayahs.sahih: Or do you, [O Muhammad], ask of them a payment, so they are by debt burdened down?
ayahs.clear: Or do you demand a payment from them, and they are burdened by debt?
ayahs.kemenag: Ataukah kamu meminta upah kepada mereka sehingga mereka dibebani dengan hutang?

ayahs.arabic: أَمْ عِندَهُمُ ٱلْغَيْبُ فَهُمْ يَكْتُبُونَ
ayahs.sahih: Or have they [knowledge of] the unseen, so they write [it] down?
ayahs.clear: Or do they know the future, and they are writing it down?
ayahs.kemenag: Apakah ada pada sisi mereka pengetahuan tentang yang gaib lalu mereka menuliskannya?

ayahs.arabic: أَمْ يُرِيدُونَ كَيْدًۭا ۖ فَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ هُمُ ٱلْمَكِيدُونَ
ayahs.sahih: Or do they intend a plan? But those who disbelieve - they are the object of a plan.
ayahs.clear: Or are they planning a conspiracy? The conspiracy will befall the disbelievers.
ayahs.kemenag: Ataukah mereka hendak melakukan tipu daya? Maka orang-orang yang kafir itu merekalah yang kena tipu daya.

ayahs.arabic: أَمْ لَهُمْ إِلَٰهٌ غَيْرُ ٱللَّهِ ۚ سُبْحَٰنَ ٱللَّهِ عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ
ayahs.sahih: Or have they a deity other than Allah? Exalted is Allah above whatever they associate with Him.
ayahs.clear: Or do they have a god besides God? God transcends what they associate.
ayahs.kemenag: Ataukah mereka mempunyai tuhan selain Allah. Maha Suci Allah dari apa yang mereka persekutukan.

ayahs.arabic: وَإِن يَرَوْا۟ كِسْفًۭا مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ سَاقِطًۭا يَقُولُوا۟ سَحَابٌۭ مَّرْكُومٌۭ
ayahs.sahih: And if they were to see a fragment from the sky falling, they would say, "[It is merely] clouds heaped up."
ayahs.clear: Even if they were to see lumps of the sky falling down, they would say, “A mass of clouds.”
ayahs.kemenag: Jika mereka melihat sebagian dari langit gugur, mereka akan mengatakan: "Itu adalah awan yang bertindih-tindih".

ayahs.arabic: فَذَرْهُمْ حَتَّىٰ يُلَٰقُوا۟ يَوْمَهُمُ ٱلَّذِى فِيهِ يُصْعَقُونَ
ayahs.sahih: So leave them until they meet their Day in which they will be struck insensible -
ayahs.clear: So leave them until they meet their Day in which they will be stunned.
ayahs.kemenag: Maka biarkanlah mereka hingga mereka menemui hari (yang dijanjikan kepada) mereka yang pada hari itu mereka dibinasakan,

ayahs.arabic: يَوْمَ لَا يُغْنِى عَنْهُمْ كَيْدُهُمْ شَيْـًۭٔا وَلَا هُمْ يُنصَرُونَ
ayahs.sahih: The Day their plan will not avail them at all, nor will they be helped.
ayahs.clear: The Day when their ploys will avail them nothing; and they will not be helped.
ayahs.kemenag: (yaitu) hari ketika tidak berguna bagi mereka sedikitpun tipu daya mereka dan mereka tidak ditolong.

ayahs.arabic: وَإِنَّ لِلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ عَذَابًۭا دُونَ ذَٰلِكَ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And indeed, for those who have wronged is a punishment before that, but most of them do not know.
ayahs.clear: For those who do wrong, there is a punishment besides that; but most of them do not know.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan sesungguhnya untuk orang-orang yang zalim ada azab selain daripada itu. Tetapi kebanyakan mereka tidak mengetahui.

ayahs.arabic: وَٱصْبِرْ لِحُكْمِ رَبِّكَ فَإِنَّكَ بِأَعْيُنِنَا ۖ وَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ حِينَ تَقُومُ
ayahs.sahih: And be patient, [O Muhammad], for the decision of your Lord, for indeed, you are in Our eyes. And exalt [Allah] with praise of your Lord when you arise.
ayahs.clear: So patiently await the decision of your Lord, for you are before Our Eyes; and proclaim the praises of your Lord when you arise.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan bersabarlah dalam menunggu ketetapan Tuhanmu, maka sesungguhnya kamu berada dalam penglihatan Kami, dan bertasbihlah dengan memuji Tuhanmu ketika kamu bangun berdiri,

ayahs.arabic: وَمِنَ ٱلَّيْلِ فَسَبِّحْهُ وَإِدْبَٰرَ ٱلنُّجُومِ
ayahs.sahih: And in a part of the night exalt Him and after [the setting of] the stars.
ayahs.clear: And glorify Him during the night, and at the receding of the stars.
ayahs.kemenag: dan bertasbihlah kepada-Nya pada beberapa saat di malam hari dan di waktu terbenam bintang-bintang (di waktu fajar).

ayahs.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ وَٱلنَّجْمِ إِذَا هَوَىٰ
ayahs.sahih: By the star when it descends,
ayahs.clear: By the star as it goes down.
ayahs.kemenag: Demi bintang ketika terbenam.

ayahs.arabic: مَا ضَلَّ صَاحِبُكُمْ وَمَا غَوَىٰ
ayahs.sahih: Your companion [Muhammad] has not strayed, nor has he erred,
ayahs.clear: Your friend has not gone astray, nor has he erred.
ayahs.kemenag: kawanmu (Muhammad) tidak sesat dan tidak pula keliru.

ayahs.arabic: وَمَا يَنطِقُ عَنِ ٱلْهَوَىٰٓ
ayahs.sahih: Nor does he speak from [his own] inclination.
ayahs.clear: Nor does he speak out of desire.
ayahs.kemenag: dan tiadalah yang diucapkannya itu (Al-Quran) menurut kemauan hawa nafsunya.

ayahs.arabic: إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا وَحْىٌۭ يُوحَىٰ
ayahs.sahih: It is not but a revelation revealed,
ayahs.clear: It is but a revelation revealed.
ayahs.kemenag: Ucapannya itu tiada lain hanyalah wahyu yang diwahyukan (kepadanya).

ayahs.arabic: عَلَّمَهُۥ شَدِيدُ ٱلْقُوَىٰ
ayahs.sahih: Taught to him by one intense in strength -
ayahs.clear: Taught to him by the Extremely Powerful.
ayahs.kemenag: yang diajarkan kepadanya oleh (Jibril) yang sangat kuat.

ayahs.arabic: ذُو مِرَّةٍۢ فَٱسْتَوَىٰ
ayahs.sahih: One of soundness. And he rose to [his] true form
ayahs.clear: The one of vigor. He settled.
ayahs.kemenag: yang mempunyai akal yang cerdas; dan (Jibril itu) menampakkan diri dengan rupa yang asli.

ayahs.arabic: وَهُوَ بِٱلْأُفُقِ ٱلْأَعْلَىٰ
ayahs.sahih: While he was in the higher [part of the] horizon.
ayahs.clear: While he was at the highest horizon.
ayahs.kemenag: sedang dia berada di ufuk yang tinggi.

ayahs.arabic: ثُمَّ دَنَا فَتَدَلَّىٰ
ayahs.sahih: Then he approached and descended
ayahs.clear: Then he came near, and hovered around.
ayahs.kemenag: Kemudian dia mendekat, lalu bertambah dekat lagi.

ayahs.arabic: فَكَانَ قَابَ قَوْسَيْنِ أَوْ أَدْنَىٰ
ayahs.sahih: And was at a distance of two bow lengths or nearer.
ayahs.clear: He was within two bows’ length, or closer.
ayahs.kemenag: maka jadilah dia dekat (pada Muhammad sejarak) dua ujung busur panah atau lebih dekat (lagi).

ayahs.arabic: فَأَوْحَىٰٓ إِلَىٰ عَبْدِهِۦ مَآ أَوْحَىٰ
ayahs.sahih: And he revealed to His Servant what he revealed.
ayahs.clear: Then He revealed to His servant what He revealed.
ayahs.kemenag: Lalu dia menyampaikan kepada hamba-Nya (Muhammad) apa yang telah Allah wahyukan.

ayahs.arabic: مَا كَذَبَ ٱلْفُؤَادُ مَا رَأَىٰٓ
ayahs.sahih: The heart did not lie [about] what it saw.
ayahs.clear: The heart did not lie about what it saw.
ayahs.kemenag: Hatinya tidak mendustakan apa yang telah dilihatnya.

ayahs.arabic: أَفَتُمَٰرُونَهُۥ عَلَىٰ مَا يَرَىٰ
ayahs.sahih: So will you dispute with him over what he saw?
ayahs.clear: Will you dispute with him concerning what he saw?
ayahs.kemenag: Maka apakah kaum (musyrik Mekah) hendak membantahnya tentang apa yang telah dilihatnya?

ayahs.arabic: وَلَقَدْ رَءَاهُ نَزْلَةً أُخْرَىٰ
ayahs.sahih: And he certainly saw him in another descent
ayahs.clear: He saw him on another descent.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan sesungguhnya Muhammad telah melihat Jibril itu (dalam rupanya yang asli) pada waktu yang lain,

ayahs.arabic: عِندَ سِدْرَةِ ٱلْمُنتَهَىٰ
ayahs.sahih: At the Lote Tree of the Utmost Boundary -
ayahs.clear: At the Lotus Tree of the Extremity.
ayahs.kemenag: (yaitu) di Sidratil Muntaha.

ayahs.arabic: عِندَهَا جَنَّةُ ٱلْمَأْوَىٰٓ
ayahs.sahih: Near it is the Garden of Refuge -
ayahs.clear: Near which is the Garden of Repose.
ayahs.kemenag: Di dekatnya ada surga tempat tinggal,

ayahs.arabic: إِذْ يَغْشَى ٱلسِّدْرَةَ مَا يَغْشَىٰ
ayahs.sahih: When there covered the Lote Tree that which covered [it].
ayahs.clear: As there covered the Lotus Tree what covered it.
ayahs.kemenag: (Muhammad melihat Jibril) ketika Sidratil Muntaha diliputi oleh sesuatu yang meliputinya.

ayahs.arabic: مَا زَاغَ ٱلْبَصَرُ وَمَا طَغَىٰ
ayahs.sahih: The sight [of the Prophet] did not swerve, nor did it transgress [its limit].
ayahs.clear: The sight did not waver, nor did it exceed.
ayahs.kemenag: Penglihatannya (muhammad) tidak berpaling dari yang dilihatnya itu dan tidak (pula) melampauinya.

ayahs.arabic: لَقَدْ رَأَىٰ مِنْ ءَايَٰتِ رَبِّهِ ٱلْكُبْرَىٰٓ
ayahs.sahih: He certainly saw of the greatest signs of his Lord.
ayahs.clear: He saw some of the Great Signs of his Lord.
ayahs.kemenag: Sesungguhnya dia telah melihat sebahagian tanda-tanda (kekuasaan) Tuhannya yang paling besar.

ayahs.arabic: أَفَرَءَيْتُمُ ٱللَّٰتَ وَٱلْعُزَّىٰ
ayahs.sahih: So have you considered al-Lat and al-'Uzza?
ayahs.clear: Have you considered al-Lat and al-Uzza?
ayahs.kemenag: Maka apakah patut kamu (hai orang-orang musyrik) menganggap al Lata dan al Uzza,

ayahs.arabic: وَمَنَوٰةَ ٱلثَّالِثَةَ ٱلْأُخْرَىٰٓ
ayahs.sahih: And Manat, the third - the other one?
ayahs.clear: And Manat, the third one, the other?
ayahs.kemenag: dan Manah yang ketiga, yang paling terkemudian (sebagai anak perempuan Allah)?

ayahs.arabic: أَلَكُمُ ٱلذَّكَرُ وَلَهُ ٱلْأُنثَىٰ
ayahs.sahih: Is the male for you and for Him the female?
ayahs.clear: Are you to have the males, and He the females?
ayahs.kemenag: Apakah (patut) untuk kamu (anak) laki-laki dan untuk Allah (anak) perempuan?

ayahs.arabic: تِلْكَ إِذًۭا قِسْمَةٌۭ ضِيزَىٰٓ
ayahs.sahih: That, then, is an unjust division.
ayahs.clear: What a bizarre distribution.
ayahs.kemenag: Yang demikian itu tentulah suatu pembagian yang tidak adil.

ayahs.arabic: إِنْ هِىَ إِلَّآ أَسْمَآءٌۭ سَمَّيْتُمُوهَآ أَنتُمْ وَءَابَآؤُكُم مَّآ أَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ بِهَا مِن سُلْطَٰنٍ ۚ إِن يَتَّبِعُونَ إِلَّا ٱلظَّنَّ وَمَا تَهْوَى ٱلْأَنفُسُ ۖ وَلَقَدْ جَآءَهُم مِّن رَّبِّهِمُ ٱلْهُدَىٰٓ
ayahs.sahih: They are not but [mere] names you have named them - you and your forefathers - for which Allah has sent down no authority. They follow not except assumption and what [their] souls desire, and there has already come to them from their Lord guidance.
ayahs.clear: These are nothing but names, which you have devised, you and your ancestors, for which God sent down no authority. They follow nothing but assumptions, and what the ego desires, even though guidance has come to them from their Lord.
ayahs.kemenag: Itu tidak lain hanyalah nama-nama yang kamu dan bapak-bapak kamu mengadakannya; Allah tidak menurunkan suatu keteranganpun untuk (menyembah)nya. Mereka tidak lain hanyalah mengikuti sangkaan-sangkaan, dan apa yang diingini oleh hawa nafsu mereka dan sesungguhnya telah datang petunjuk kepada mereka dari Tuhan mereka.

ayahs.arabic: أَمْ لِلْإِنسَٰنِ مَا تَمَنَّىٰ
ayahs.sahih: Or is there for man whatever he wishes?
ayahs.clear: Or is the human being to have whatever he desires?
ayahs.kemenag: Atau apakah manusia akan mendapat segala yang dicita-citakannya?

ayahs.arabic: فَلِلَّهِ ٱلْءَاخِرَةُ وَٱلْأُولَىٰ
ayahs.sahih: Rather, to Allah belongs the Hereafter and the first [life].
ayahs.clear: To God belong the Last and the First.
ayahs.kemenag: (Tidak), maka hanya bagi Allah kehidupan akhirat dan kehidupan dunia.

ayahs.arabic: ۞ وَكَم مِّن مَّلَكٍۢ فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ لَا تُغْنِى شَفَٰعَتُهُمْ شَيْـًٔا إِلَّا مِنۢ بَعْدِ أَن يَأْذَنَ ٱللَّهُ لِمَن يَشَآءُ وَيَرْضَىٰٓ
ayahs.sahih: And how many angels there are in the heavens whose intercession will not avail at all except [only] after Allah has permitted [it] to whom He wills and approves.
ayahs.clear: How many an angel is there in the heavens whose intercession avails nothing, except after God gives permission to whomever He wills, and approves?
ayahs.kemenag: Dan berapa banyaknya malaikat di langit, syafa'at mereka sedikitpun tidak berguna, kecuali sesudah Allah mengijinkan bagi orang yang dikehendaki dan diridhai (Nya).

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱلْءَاخِرَةِ لَيُسَمُّونَ ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةَ تَسْمِيَةَ ٱلْأُنثَىٰ
ayahs.sahih: Indeed, those who do not believe in the Hereafter name the angels female names,
ayahs.clear: Those who do not believe in the Hereafter give the angels the names of females.
ayahs.kemenag: Sesungguhnya orang-orang yang tiada beriman kepada kehidupan akhirat, mereka benar-benar menamakan malaikat itu dengan nama perempuan.

ayahs.arabic: وَمَا لَهُم بِهِۦ مِنْ عِلْمٍ ۖ إِن يَتَّبِعُونَ إِلَّا ٱلظَّنَّ ۖ وَإِنَّ ٱلظَّنَّ لَا يُغْنِى مِنَ ٱلْحَقِّ شَيْـًۭٔا
ayahs.sahih: And they have thereof no knowledge. They follow not except assumption, and indeed, assumption avails not against the truth at all.
ayahs.clear: They have no knowledge of that. They only follow assumptions, and assumptions are no substitute for the truth.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan mereka tidak mempunyai sesuatu pengetahuanpun tentang itu. Mereka tidak lain hanyalah mengikuti persangkaan sedang sesungguhnya persangkaan itu tiada berfaedah sedikitpun terhadap kebenaran.

ayahs.arabic: فَأَعْرِضْ عَن مَّن تَوَلَّىٰ عَن ذِكْرِنَا وَلَمْ يُرِدْ إِلَّا ٱلْحَيَوٰةَ ٱلدُّنْيَا
ayahs.sahih: So turn away from whoever turns his back on Our message and desires not except the worldly life.
ayahs.clear: So avoid him who has turned away from Our remembrance, and desires nothing but the present life.
ayahs.kemenag: Maka berpalinglah (hai Muhammad) dari orang yang berpaling dari peringatan Kami, dan tidak mengingini kecuali kehidupan duniawi.

ayahs.arabic: ذَٰلِكَ مَبْلَغُهُم مِّنَ ٱلْعِلْمِ ۚ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَن ضَلَّ عَن سَبِيلِهِۦ وَهُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَنِ ٱهْتَدَىٰ
ayahs.sahih: That is their sum of knowledge. Indeed, your Lord is most knowing of who strays from His way, and He is most knowing of who is guided.
ayahs.clear: That is the extent of their knowledge. Your Lord knows best who has strayed from His path, and He knows best who has accepted guidance.
ayahs.kemenag: Itulah sejauh-jauh pengetahuan mereka. Sesungguhnya Tuhanmu, Dialah yang paling mengetahui siapa yang tersesat dari jalan-Nya dan Dia pulalah yang paling mengetahui siapa yang mendapat petunjuk.

ayahs.arabic: وَلِلَّهِ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ لِيَجْزِىَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَسَٰٓـُٔوا۟ بِمَا عَمِلُوا۟ وَيَجْزِىَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَحْسَنُوا۟ بِٱلْحُسْنَى
ayahs.sahih: And to Allah belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is in the earth - that He may recompense those who do evil with [the penalty of] what they have done and recompense those who do good with the best [reward] -
ayahs.clear: To God belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on earth. He will repay those who do evil according to their deeds, and recompense those who do good with the best.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan hanya kepunyaan Allah-lah apa yang ada di langit dan apa yang ada di bumi supaya Dia memberi balasan kepada orang-orang yang berbuat jahat terhadap apa yang telah mereka kerjakan dan memberi balasan kepada orang-orang yang berbuat baik dengan pahala yang lebih baik (surga).

ayahs.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ يَجْتَنِبُونَ كَبَٰٓئِرَ ٱلْإِثْمِ وَٱلْفَوَٰحِشَ إِلَّا ٱللَّمَمَ ۚ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ وَٰسِعُ ٱلْمَغْفِرَةِ ۚ هُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِكُمْ إِذْ أَنشَأَكُم مِّنَ ٱلْأَرْضِ وَإِذْ أَنتُمْ أَجِنَّةٌۭ فِى بُطُونِ أُمَّهَٰتِكُمْ ۖ فَلَا تُزَكُّوٓا۟ أَنفُسَكُمْ ۖ هُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَنِ ٱتَّقَىٰٓ
ayahs.sahih: Those who avoid the major sins and immoralities, only [committing] slight ones. Indeed, your Lord is vast in forgiveness. He was most knowing of you when He produced you from the earth and when you were fetuses in the wombs of your mothers. So do not claim yourselves to be pure; He is most knowing of who fears Him.
ayahs.clear: Those who avoid gross sins and indecencies—except for minor lapses—your Lord is of Vast Forgiveness. He knows you well, ever since He created you from the earth, and ever since you were embryos in your mothers’ wombs. So do not acclaim your own virtue; He is fully aware of the righteous.
ayahs.kemenag: (Yaitu) orang-orang yang menjauhi dosa-dosa besar dan perbuatan keji yang selain dari kesalahan-kesalahan kecil. Sesungguhnya Tuhanmu maha luas ampunan-Nya. Dan Dia lebih mengetahui (tentang keadaan)mu ketika Dia menjadikan kamu dari tanah dan ketika kamu masih janin dalam perut ibumu; maka janganlah kamu mengatakan dirimu suci. Dialah yang paling mengetahui tentang orang yang bertakwa.

ayahs.arabic: أَفَرَءَيْتَ ٱلَّذِى تَوَلَّىٰ
ayahs.sahih: Have you seen the one who turned away
ayahs.clear: Have you considered him who turned away?
ayahs.kemenag: Maka apakah kamu melihat orang yang berpaling (dari Al-Quran)?

ayahs.arabic: وَأَعْطَىٰ قَلِيلًۭا وَأَكْدَىٰٓ
ayahs.sahih: And gave a little and [then] refrained?
ayahs.clear: And gave a little, and held back?
ayahs.kemenag: serta memberi sedikit dan tidak mau memberi lagi?

ayahs.arabic: أَعِندَهُۥ عِلْمُ ٱلْغَيْبِ فَهُوَ يَرَىٰٓ
ayahs.sahih: Does he have knowledge of the unseen, so he sees?
ayahs.clear: Does he possess knowledge of the unseen, and can therefore foresee?
ayahs.kemenag: Apakah dia mempunyai pengetahuan tentang yang ghaib, sehingga dia mengetahui (apa yang dikatakan)?

ayahs.arabic: أَمْ لَمْ يُنَبَّأْ بِمَا فِى صُحُفِ مُوسَىٰ
ayahs.sahih: Or has he not been informed of what was in the scriptures of Moses
ayahs.clear: Or was he not informed of what is in the Scrolls of Moses?
ayahs.kemenag: Ataukah belum diberitakan kepadanya apa yang ada dalam lembaran-lembaran Musa?

ayahs.arabic: وَإِبْرَٰهِيمَ ٱلَّذِى وَفَّىٰٓ
ayahs.sahih: And [of] Abraham, who fulfilled [his obligations] -
ayahs.clear: And of Abraham, who fulfilled?
ayahs.kemenag: dan lembaran-lembaran Ibrahim yang selalu menyempurnakan janji?

ayahs.arabic: أَلَّا تَزِرُ وَازِرَةٌۭ وِزْرَ أُخْرَىٰ
ayahs.sahih: That no bearer of burdens will bear the burden of another
ayahs.clear: That no soul bears the burdens of another soul.
ayahs.kemenag: (yaitu) bahwasanya seorang yang berdosa tidak akan memikul dosa orang lain,

ayahs.arabic: وَأَن لَّيْسَ لِلْإِنسَٰنِ إِلَّا مَا سَعَىٰ
ayahs.sahih: And that there is not for man except that [good] for which he strives
ayahs.clear: And that the human being attains only what he strives for.
ayahs.kemenag: dan bahwasanya seorang manusia tiada memperoleh selain apa yang telah diusahakannya,

ayahs.arabic: وَأَنَّ سَعْيَهُۥ سَوْفَ يُرَىٰ
ayahs.sahih: And that his effort is going to be seen -
ayahs.clear: And that his efforts will be witnessed.
ayahs.kemenag: dan bahwasanya usaha itu kelak akan diperlihatkan (kepadanya).

ayahs.arabic: ثُمَّ يُجْزَىٰهُ ٱلْجَزَآءَ ٱلْأَوْفَىٰ
ayahs.sahih: Then he will be recompensed for it with the fullest recompense
ayahs.clear: Then he will be rewarded for it the fullest reward.
ayahs.kemenag: Kemudian akan diberi balasan kepadanya dengan balasan yang paling sempurna,

ayahs.arabic: وَأَنَّ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ ٱلْمُنتَهَىٰ
ayahs.sahih: And that to your Lord is the finality
ayahs.clear: And that to your Lord is the finality.
ayahs.kemenag: dan bahwasanya kepada Tuhanmulah kesudahan (segala sesuatu),

ayahs.arabic: وَأَنَّهُۥ هُوَ أَضْحَكَ وَأَبْكَىٰ
ayahs.sahih: And that it is He who makes [one] laugh and weep
ayahs.clear: And that it is He who causes laughter and weeping.
ayahs.kemenag: dan bahwasanya Dialah yang menjadikan orang tertawa dan menangis,

ayahs.arabic: وَأَنَّهُۥ هُوَ أَمَاتَ وَأَحْيَا
ayahs.sahih: And that it is He who causes death and gives life
ayahs.clear: And that it is He who gives death and life.
ayahs.kemenag: dan bahwasanya Dialah yang mematikan dan menghidupkan,

ayahs.arabic: وَأَنَّهُۥ خَلَقَ ٱلزَّوْجَيْنِ ٱلذَّكَرَ وَٱلْأُنثَىٰ
ayahs.sahih: And that He creates the two mates - the male and female -
ayahs.clear: And that it is He who created the two kinds—the male and the female.
ayahs.kemenag: dan bahwasanya Dialah yang menciptakan berpasang-pasangan pria dan wanita.

ayahs.arabic: مِن نُّطْفَةٍ إِذَا تُمْنَىٰ
ayahs.sahih: From a sperm-drop when it is emitted
ayahs.clear: From a sperm drop, when emitted.
ayahs.kemenag: dari air mani, apabila dipancarkan.

ayahs.arabic: وَأَنَّ عَلَيْهِ ٱلنَّشْأَةَ ٱلْأُخْرَىٰ
ayahs.sahih: And that [incumbent] upon Him is the next creation
ayahs.clear: And that upon Him is the next existence.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan bahwasanya Dialah yang menetapkan kejadian yang lain (kebangkitan sesudah mati),

ayahs.arabic: وَأَنَّهُۥ هُوَ أَغْنَىٰ وَأَقْنَىٰ
ayahs.sahih: And that it is He who enriches and suffices
ayahs.clear: And that it is He who enriches and impoverishes.
ayahs.kemenag: dan bahwasanya Dia yang memberikan kekayaan dan memberikan kecukupan,

ayahs.arabic: وَأَنَّهُۥ هُوَ رَبُّ ٱلشِّعْرَىٰ
ayahs.sahih: And that it is He who is the Lord of Sirius
ayahs.clear: And that it is He who is the Lord of Sirius.
ayahs.kemenag: dan bahwasanya Dialah yang Tuhan (yang memiliki) bintang syi'ra,

ayahs.arabic: وَأَنَّهُۥٓ أَهْلَكَ عَادًا ٱلْأُولَىٰ
ayahs.sahih: And that He destroyed the first [people of] 'Aad
ayahs.clear: And that it is He who destroyed the first Aad.
ayahs.kemenag: dan bahwasanya Dia telah membinasakan kaum 'Aad yang pertama,

ayahs.arabic: وَثَمُودَا۟ فَمَآ أَبْقَىٰ
ayahs.sahih: And Thamud - and He did not spare [them] -
ayahs.clear: And Thamood, sparing no one.
ayahs.kemenag: dan kaum Tsamud. Maka tidak seorangpun yang ditinggalkan-Nya (hidup).

ayahs.arabic: وَقَوْمَ نُوحٍۢ مِّن قَبْلُ ۖ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ هُمْ أَظْلَمَ وَأَطْغَىٰ
ayahs.sahih: And the people of Noah before. Indeed, it was they who were [even] more unjust and oppressing.
ayahs.clear: And the people of Noah before that; for they were most unjust and most oppressive.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan kaum Nuh sebelum itu. Sesungguhnya mereka adalah orang-orang yang paling zalim dan paling durhaka,

ayahs.arabic: وَٱلْمُؤْتَفِكَةَ أَهْوَىٰ
ayahs.sahih: And the overturned towns He hurled down
ayahs.clear: And He toppled the ruined cities.
ayahs.kemenag: dan negeri-negeri kaum Luth yang telah dihancurkan Allah.

ayahs.arabic: فَغَشَّىٰهَا مَا غَشَّىٰ
ayahs.sahih: And covered them by that which He covered.
ayahs.clear: And covered them with whatever covered them.
ayahs.kemenag: lalu Allah menimpakan atas negeri itu azab besar yang menimpanya.

ayahs.arabic: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكَ تَتَمَارَىٰ
ayahs.sahih: Then which of the favors of your Lord do you doubt?
ayahs.clear: So which of your Lord's marvels can you deny?
ayahs.kemenag: Maka terhadap nikmat Tuhanmu yang manakah kamu ragu-ragu?

ayahs.arabic: هَٰذَا نَذِيرٌۭ مِّنَ ٱلنُّذُرِ ٱلْأُولَىٰٓ
ayahs.sahih: This [Prophet] is a warner like the former warners.
ayahs.clear: This is a warning, just like the first warnings.
ayahs.kemenag: Ini (Muhammad) adalah seorang pemberi peringatan di antara pemberi-pemberi peringatan yang terdahulu.

ayahs.arabic: أَزِفَتِ ٱلْءَازِفَةُ
ayahs.sahih: The Approaching Day has approached.
ayahs.clear: The inevitable is imminent.
ayahs.kemenag: Telah dekat terjadinya hari kiamat.

ayahs.arabic: لَيْسَ لَهَا مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ كَاشِفَةٌ
ayahs.sahih: Of it, [from those] besides Allah, there is no remover.
ayahs.clear: None besides God can unveil it.
ayahs.kemenag: Tidak ada yang akan menyatakan terjadinya hari itu selain Allah.

ayahs.arabic: أَفَمِنْ هَٰذَا ٱلْحَدِيثِ تَعْجَبُونَ
ayahs.sahih: Then at this statement do you wonder?
ayahs.clear: Do you marvel at this discourse?
ayahs.kemenag: Maka apakah kamu merasa heran terhadap pemberitaan ini?

ayahs.arabic: وَتَضْحَكُونَ وَلَا تَبْكُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And you laugh and do not weep
ayahs.clear: And laugh, and do not weep?
ayahs.kemenag: Dan kamu mentertawakan dan tidak menangis?

ayahs.arabic: وَأَنتُمْ سَٰمِدُونَ
ayahs.sahih: While you are proudly sporting?
ayahs.clear: Lost in your frivolity?
ayahs.kemenag: Sedang kamu melengahkan(nya)?

ayahs.arabic: فَٱسْجُدُوا۟ لِلَّهِ وَٱعْبُدُوا۟ ۩
ayahs.sahih: So prostrate to Allah and worship [Him].
ayahs.clear: So bow down to God, and worship!
ayahs.kemenag: Maka bersujudlah kepada Allah dan sembahlah (Dia).

ayahs.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ ٱقْتَرَبَتِ ٱلسَّاعَةُ وَٱنشَقَّ ٱلْقَمَرُ
ayahs.sahih: The Hour has come near, and the moon has split [in two].
ayahs.clear: The Hour has drawn near, and the moon has split.
ayahs.kemenag: Telah dekat datangnya saat itu dan telah terbelah bulan.

ayahs.arabic: وَإِن يَرَوْا۟ ءَايَةًۭ يُعْرِضُوا۟ وَيَقُولُوا۟ سِحْرٌۭ مُّسْتَمِرٌّۭ
ayahs.sahih: And if they see a miracle, they turn away and say, "Passing magic."
ayahs.clear: Yet whenever they see a miracle, they turn away, and say, “Continuous magic.”
ayahs.kemenag: Dan jika mereka (orang-orang musyrikin) melihat suatu tanda (mukjizat), mereka berpaling dan berkata: "(Ini adalah) sihir yang terus menerus".

ayahs.arabic: وَكَذَّبُوا۟ وَٱتَّبَعُوٓا۟ أَهْوَآءَهُمْ ۚ وَكُلُّ أَمْرٍۢ مُّسْتَقِرٌّۭ
ayahs.sahih: And they denied and followed their inclinations. But for every matter is a [time of] settlement.
ayahs.clear: They lied, and followed their opinions, but everything has its time.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan mereka mendutakan (Nabi) dan mengikuti hawa nafsu mereka, sedang tiap-tiap urusan telah ada ketetapannya

ayahs.arabic: وَلَقَدْ جَآءَهُم مِّنَ ٱلْأَنۢبَآءِ مَا فِيهِ مُزْدَجَرٌ
ayahs.sahih: And there has already come to them of information that in which there is deterrence -
ayahs.clear: And there came to them news containing a deterrent.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan sesungguhnya telah datang kepada mereka beberapa kisah yang di dalamnya terdapat cegahan (dari kekafiran).

ayahs.arabic: حِكْمَةٌۢ بَٰلِغَةٌۭ ۖ فَمَا تُغْنِ ٱلنُّذُرُ
ayahs.sahih: Extensive wisdom - but warning does not avail [them].
ayahs.clear: Profound wisdom—but warnings are of no avail.
ayahs.kemenag: Itulah suatu hikmah yang sempurna maka peringatan-peringatan itu tidak berguna (bagi mereka).

ayahs.arabic: فَتَوَلَّ عَنْهُمْ ۘ يَوْمَ يَدْعُ ٱلدَّاعِ إِلَىٰ شَىْءٍۢ نُّكُرٍ
ayahs.sahih: So leave them, [O Muhammad]. The Day the Caller calls to something forbidding,
ayahs.clear: So turn away from them. On the Day when the Caller calls to something terrible.
ayahs.kemenag: Maka berpalinglah kamu dari mereka. (Ingatlah) hari (ketika) seorang penyeru (malaikat) menyeru kepada sesuatu yang tidak menyenangkan (hari pembalasan),

ayahs.arabic: خُشَّعًا أَبْصَٰرُهُمْ يَخْرُجُونَ مِنَ ٱلْأَجْدَاثِ كَأَنَّهُمْ جَرَادٌۭ مُّنتَشِرٌۭ
ayahs.sahih: Their eyes humbled, they will emerge from the graves as if they were locusts spreading,
ayahs.clear: Their eyes humiliated, they will emerge from the graves, as if they were swarming locusts.
ayahs.kemenag: sambil menundukkan pandangan-pandangan mereka keluar dari kuburan seakan-akan mereka belalang yang beterbangan

ayahs.arabic: مُّهْطِعِينَ إِلَى ٱلدَّاعِ ۖ يَقُولُ ٱلْكَٰفِرُونَ هَٰذَا يَوْمٌ عَسِرٌۭ
ayahs.sahih: Racing ahead toward the Caller. The disbelievers will say, "This is a difficult Day."
ayahs.clear: Scrambling towards the Caller, the disbelievers will say, “This is a difficult Day.”
ayahs.kemenag: mereka datang dengan cepat kepada penyeru itu. Orang-orang kafir berkata: "Ini adalah hari yang berat".

ayahs.arabic: ۞ كَذَّبَتْ قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍۢ فَكَذَّبُوا۟ عَبْدَنَا وَقَالُوا۟ مَجْنُونٌۭ وَٱزْدُجِرَ
ayahs.sahih: The people of Noah denied before them, and they denied Our servant and said, "A madman," and he was repelled.
ayahs.clear: Before them the people of Noah disbelieved. They rejected Our servant, and said, “Crazy,” and he was rebuked.
ayahs.kemenag: Sebelum mereka, telah mendustakan (pula) kamu Nuh, maka mereka mendustakan hamba Kami (Nuh) dan mengatakan: "Dia seorang gila dan dia sudah pernah diberi ancaman).

ayahs.arabic: فَدَعَا رَبَّهُۥٓ أَنِّى مَغْلُوبٌۭ فَٱنتَصِرْ
ayahs.sahih: So he invoked his Lord, "Indeed, I am overpowered, so help."
ayahs.clear: So he appealed to his Lord, “I am overwhelmed, so help me.”
ayahs.kemenag: Maka dia mengadu kepada Tuhannya: "bahwasanya aku ini adalah orang yang dikalahkan, oleh sebab itu menangkanlah (aku)".

ayahs.arabic: فَفَتَحْنَآ أَبْوَٰبَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ بِمَآءٍۢ مُّنْهَمِرٍۢ
ayahs.sahih: Then We opened the gates of the heaven with rain pouring down
ayahs.clear: So We opened the floodgates of heaven with water pouring down.
ayahs.kemenag: Maka Kami bukakan pintu-pintu langit dengan (menurunkan) air yang tercurah.

ayahs.arabic: وَفَجَّرْنَا ٱلْأَرْضَ عُيُونًۭا فَٱلْتَقَى ٱلْمَآءُ عَلَىٰٓ أَمْرٍۢ قَدْ قُدِرَ
ayahs.sahih: And caused the earth to burst with springs, and the waters met for a matter already predestined.
ayahs.clear: And We made the earth burst with springs, and the waters met for a purpose already destined.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan Kami jadikan bumi memancarkan mata air-mata air, maka bertemulah air-air itu untuk suatu urusan yang sungguh telah ditetapkan.

ayahs.arabic: وَحَمَلْنَٰهُ عَلَىٰ ذَاتِ أَلْوَٰحٍۢ وَدُسُرٍۢ
ayahs.sahih: And We carried him on a [construction of] planks and nails,
ayahs.clear: And We carried him on a craft of planks and nails.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan Kami angkut Nuh ke atas (bahtera) yang terbuat dari papan dan paku,

ayahs.arabic: تَجْرِى بِأَعْيُنِنَا جَزَآءًۭ لِّمَن كَانَ كُفِرَ
ayahs.sahih: Sailing under Our observation as reward for he who had been denied.
ayahs.clear: Sailing before Our eyes; a reward for him who was rejected.
ayahs.kemenag: Yang berlayar dengan pemeliharaan Kami sebagai belasan bagi orang-orang yang diingkari (Nuh).

ayahs.arabic: وَلَقَد تَّرَكْنَٰهَآ ءَايَةًۭ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍۢ
ayahs.sahih: And We left it as a sign, so is there any who will remember?
ayahs.clear: And We left it as a sign. Is there anyone who would take heed?
ayahs.kemenag: Dan sesungguhnya telah Kami jadikan kapal itu sebagai pelajaran, maka adakah orang yang mau mengambil pelajaran?

ayahs.arabic: فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ
ayahs.sahih: And how [severe] were My punishment and warning.
ayahs.clear: So how were My punishment and My warnings?
ayahs.kemenag: Maka alangkah dahsyatnya azab-Ku dan ancaman-ancaman-Ku.

ayahs.arabic: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍۢ
ayahs.sahih: And We have certainly made the Qur'an easy for remembrance, so is there any who will remember?
ayahs.clear: We made the Quran easy to learn. Is there anyone who would learn?
ayahs.kemenag: Dan sesungguhnya telah Kami mudahkan Al-Quran untuk pelajaran, maka adakah orang yang mengambil pelajaran?

ayahs.arabic: كَذَّبَتْ عَادٌۭ فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ
ayahs.sahih: 'Aad denied; and how [severe] were My punishment and warning.
ayahs.clear: Aad denied the truth. So how were My punishment and My warnings?
ayahs.kemenag: Kaum 'Aad pun mendustakan (pula). Maka alangkah dahsyatnya azab-Ku dan ancaman-ancaman-Ku.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ رِيحًۭا صَرْصَرًۭا فِى يَوْمِ نَحْسٍۢ مُّسْتَمِرٍّۢ
ayahs.sahih: Indeed, We sent upon them a screaming wind on a day of continuous misfortune,
ayahs.clear: We unleashed upon them a screaming wind, on a day of unrelenting misery.
ayahs.kemenag: Sesungguhnya Kami telah menghembuskan kepada mereka angin yang sangat kencang pada hari nahas yang terus menerus,

ayahs.arabic: تَنزِعُ ٱلنَّاسَ كَأَنَّهُمْ أَعْجَازُ نَخْلٍۢ مُّنقَعِرٍۢ
ayahs.sahih: Extracting the people as if they were trunks of palm trees uprooted.
ayahs.clear: Plucking the people away, as though they were trunks of uprooted palm-trees.
ayahs.kemenag: yang menggelimpangkan manusia seakan-akan mereka pokok korma yang tumbang.

ayahs.arabic: فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ
ayahs.sahih: And how [severe] were My punishment and warning.
ayahs.clear: So how were My punishment and My warnings?
ayahs.kemenag: Maka alangkah dahsyatnya azab-Ku dan ancaman-ancaman-Ku.

ayahs.arabic: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍۢ
ayahs.sahih: And We have certainly made the Qur'an easy for remembrance, so is there any who will remember?
ayahs.clear: We made the Quran easy to remember. Is there anyone who would remember?
ayahs.kemenag: Dan sesungguhnya telah Kami mudahkan Al Quran untuk pelajaran, maka adakah orang yang mengambil pelajaran?

ayahs.arabic: كَذَّبَتْ ثَمُودُ بِٱلنُّذُرِ
ayahs.sahih: Thamud denied the warning
ayahs.clear: Thamood rejected the warnings.
ayahs.kemenag: Kaum Tsamudpun telah mendustakan ancaman-ancaman (itu).

ayahs.arabic: فَقَالُوٓا۟ أَبَشَرًۭا مِّنَّا وَٰحِدًۭا نَّتَّبِعُهُۥٓ إِنَّآ إِذًۭا لَّفِى ضَلَٰلٍۢ وَسُعُرٍ
ayahs.sahih: And said, "Is it one human being among us that we should follow? Indeed, we would then be in error and madness.
ayahs.clear: They said, “Are we to follow one of us, a human being? We would then go astray, and end up in Hell.
ayahs.kemenag: Maka mereka berkata: "Bagaimana kita akan mengikuti seorang manusia (biasa) di antara kita?" Sesungguhnya kalau kita begitu benar-benar berada dalam keadaan sesat dan gila".

ayahs.arabic: أَءُلْقِىَ ٱلذِّكْرُ عَلَيْهِ مِنۢ بَيْنِنَا بَلْ هُوَ كَذَّابٌ أَشِرٌۭ
ayahs.sahih: Has the message been sent down upon him from among us? Rather, he is an insolent liar."
ayahs.clear: Was the message given to him, out of all of us? In fact, he is a wicked liar.”
ayahs.kemenag: Apakah wahyu itu diturunkan kepadanya di antara kita? Sebenarnya dia adalah seorang yang amat pendusta lagi sombong.

ayahs.arabic: سَيَعْلَمُونَ غَدًۭا مَّنِ ٱلْكَذَّابُ ٱلْأَشِرُ
ayahs.sahih: They will know tomorrow who is the insolent liar.
ayahs.clear: They will know tomorrow who the wicked liar is.
ayahs.kemenag: Kelak mereka akan mengetahui siapakah yang sebenarnya amat pendusta lagi sombong.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّا مُرْسِلُوا۟ ٱلنَّاقَةِ فِتْنَةًۭ لَّهُمْ فَٱرْتَقِبْهُمْ وَٱصْطَبِرْ
ayahs.sahih: Indeed, We are sending the she-camel as trial for them, so watch them and be patient.
ayahs.clear: We are sending the she-camel as a test for them; so watch them and be patient.
ayahs.kemenag: Sesungguhnya Kami akan mengirimkan unta betina sebagai cobaan bagi mereka, maka tunggulah (tindakan) mereka dan bersabarlah.

ayahs.arabic: وَنَبِّئْهُمْ أَنَّ ٱلْمَآءَ قِسْمَةٌۢ بَيْنَهُمْ ۖ كُلُّ شِرْبٍۢ مُّحْتَضَرٌۭ
ayahs.sahih: And inform them that the water is shared between them, each [day of] drink attended [by turn].
ayahs.clear: And inform them that the water is to be shared between them; each share of drink made available.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan beritakanlah kepada mereka bahwa sesungguhnya air itu terbagi antara mereka (dengan unta betina itu); tiap-tiap giliran minum dihadiri (oleh yang punya giliran)

ayahs.arabic: فَنَادَوْا۟ صَاحِبَهُمْ فَتَعَاطَىٰ فَعَقَرَ
ayahs.sahih: But they called their companion, and he dared and hamstrung [her].
ayahs.clear: But they called their friend, and he dared, and he slaughtered.
ayahs.kemenag: Maka mereka memanggil kawannya, lalu kawannya menangkap (unta itu) dan membunuhnya.

ayahs.arabic: فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ
ayahs.sahih: And how [severe] were My punishment and warning.
ayahs.clear: So how were My punishment and My warnings?
ayahs.kemenag: Alangkah dahsyatnya azab-Ku dan ancaman-ancaman-Ku.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ صَيْحَةًۭ وَٰحِدَةًۭ فَكَانُوا۟ كَهَشِيمِ ٱلْمُحْتَظِرِ
ayahs.sahih: Indeed, We sent upon them one blast from the sky, and they became like the dry twig fragments of an [animal] pen.
ayahs.clear: We sent against them a single Scream, and they became like crushed hay.
ayahs.kemenag: Sesungguhnya Kami menimpakan atas mereka satu suara yang keras mengguntur, maka jadilah mereka seperti rumput kering (yang dikumpulkan oleh) yang punya kandang binatang.

ayahs.arabic: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍۢ
ayahs.sahih: And We have certainly made the Qur'an easy for remembrance, so is there any who will remember?
ayahs.clear: We made the Quran easy to understand. Is there anyone who would understand?
ayahs.kemenag: Dan sesungguhnya telah Kami mudahkan Al Quran untuk pelajaran, maka adakah orang yang mengambil pelajaran?

ayahs.arabic: كَذَّبَتْ قَوْمُ لُوطٍۭ بِٱلنُّذُرِ
ayahs.sahih: The people of Lot denied the warning.
ayahs.clear: The people of Lot rejected the warnings.
ayahs.kemenag: Kaum Luth-pun telah mendustakan ancaman-ancaman (nabinya).

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ حَاصِبًا إِلَّآ ءَالَ لُوطٍۢ ۖ نَّجَّيْنَٰهُم بِسَحَرٍۢ
ayahs.sahih: Indeed, We sent upon them a storm of stones, except the family of Lot - We saved them before dawn
ayahs.clear: We unleashed upon them a shower of stones, except for the family of Lot; We rescued them at dawn.
ayahs.kemenag: Sesungguhnya Kami telah menghembuskan kepada mereka angin yang membawa batu-batu (yang menimpa mereka), kecuali keluarga Luth. Mereka Kami selamatkan sebelum fajar menyingsing,

ayahs.arabic: نِّعْمَةًۭ مِّنْ عِندِنَا ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى مَن شَكَرَ
ayahs.sahih: As favor from us. Thus do We reward he who is grateful.
ayahs.clear: A blessing from Us. Thus We reward the thankful.
ayahs.kemenag: sebagai nikmat dari Kami. Demikianlah Kami memberi balasan kepada orang-orang yang bersyukur,

ayahs.arabic: وَلَقَدْ أَنذَرَهُم بَطْشَتَنَا فَتَمَارَوْا۟ بِٱلنُّذُرِ
ayahs.sahih: And he had already warned them of Our assault, but they disputed the warning.
ayahs.clear: He had warned them of Our onslaught, but they dismissed the warnings.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan sesungguhnya dia (Luth) telah memperingatkan mereka akan azab-azab Kami, maka mereka mendustakan ancaman-ancaman itu.

ayahs.arabic: وَلَقَدْ رَٰوَدُوهُ عَن ضَيْفِهِۦ فَطَمَسْنَآ أَعْيُنَهُمْ فَذُوقُوا۟ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ
ayahs.sahih: And they had demanded from him his guests, but We obliterated their eyes, [saying], "Taste My punishment and warning."
ayahs.clear: They even lusted for his guest, so We obliterated their eyes. “So taste My punishment and My warnings.”
ayahs.kemenag: Dan sesungguhnya mereka telah membujuknya (agar menyerahkan) tamunya (kepada mereka), lalu Kami butakan mata mereka, maka rasakanlah azab-Ku dan ancaman-ancaman-Ku.

ayahs.arabic: وَلَقَدْ صَبَّحَهُم بُكْرَةً عَذَابٌۭ مُّسْتَقِرٌّۭ
ayahs.sahih: And there came upon them by morning an abiding punishment.
ayahs.clear: Early morning brought upon them enduring punishment.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan sesungguhnya pada esok harinya mereka ditimpa azab yang kekal.

ayahs.arabic: فَذُوقُوا۟ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ
ayahs.sahih: So taste My punishment and warning.
ayahs.clear: So taste My punishment and My warnings.
ayahs.kemenag: Maka rasakanlah azab-Ku dan ancaman-ancaman-Ku.

ayahs.arabic: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍۢ
ayahs.sahih: And We have certainly made the Qur'an easy for remembrance, so is there any who will remember?
ayahs.clear: We made the Quran easy to memorize. Is there anyone who would memorize?
ayahs.kemenag: Dan sesungguhnya telah Kami mudahkan Al Quran untuk pelajaran, maka adakah orang yang mengambil pelajaran?

ayahs.arabic: وَلَقَدْ جَآءَ ءَالَ فِرْعَوْنَ ٱلنُّذُرُ
ayahs.sahih: And there certainly came to the people of Pharaoh warning.
ayahs.clear: The warnings also came to the people of Pharaoh.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan sesungguhnya telah datang kepada kaum Fir'aun ancaman-ancaman.

ayahs.arabic: كَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا كُلِّهَا فَأَخَذْنَٰهُمْ أَخْذَ عَزِيزٍۢ مُّقْتَدِرٍ
ayahs.sahih: They denied Our signs, all of them, so We seized them with a seizure of one Exalted in Might and Perfect in Ability.
ayahs.clear: They rejected Our signs, all of them, so We seized them—the seizure of an Almighty Omnipotent.
ayahs.kemenag: Mereka mendustakan mukjizat Kami semuanya, lalu Kami azab mereka sebagai azab dari Yang Maha Perkasa lagi Maha Kuasa

ayahs.arabic: أَكُفَّارُكُمْ خَيْرٌۭ مِّنْ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكُمْ أَمْ لَكُم بَرَآءَةٌۭ فِى ٱلزُّبُرِ
ayahs.sahih: Are your disbelievers better than those [former ones], or have you immunity in the scripture?
ayahs.clear: Are your unbelievers better than all those? Or do you have immunity in the scriptures?
ayahs.kemenag: Apakah orang-orang kafirmu (hai kaum musyrikin) lebih baik dari mereka itu, atau apakah kamu telah mempunyai jaminan kebebasan (dari azab) dalam Kitab-kitab yang dahulu

ayahs.arabic: أَمْ يَقُولُونَ نَحْنُ جَمِيعٌۭ مُّنتَصِرٌۭ
ayahs.sahih: Or do they say, "We are an assembly supporting [each other]"?
ayahs.clear: Or do they say, “We are united, and we will be victorious”?
ayahs.kemenag: Atau apakah mereka mengatakan: "Kami adalah satu golongan yang bersatu yang pasti menang".

ayahs.arabic: سَيُهْزَمُ ٱلْجَمْعُ وَيُوَلُّونَ ٱلدُّبُرَ
ayahs.sahih: [Their] assembly will be defeated, and they will turn their backs [in retreat].
ayahs.clear: The multitude will be defeated, and they will turn their backs.
ayahs.kemenag: Golongan itu pasti akan dikalahkan dan mereka akan mundur ke belakang.

ayahs.arabic: بَلِ ٱلسَّاعَةُ مَوْعِدُهُمْ وَٱلسَّاعَةُ أَدْهَىٰ وَأَمَرُّ
ayahs.sahih: But the Hour is their appointment [for due punishment], and the Hour is more disastrous and more bitter.
ayahs.clear: The Hour is their appointed time—the Hour is more disastrous, and most bitter.
ayahs.kemenag: Sebenarnya hari kiamat itulah hari yang dijanjikan kepada mereka dan kiamat itu lebih dahsyat dan lebih pahit.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ فِى ضَلَٰلٍۢ وَسُعُرٍۢ
ayahs.sahih: Indeed, the criminals are in error and madness.
ayahs.clear: The wicked are in confusion and madness.
ayahs.kemenag: Sesungguhnya orang-orang yang berdosa berada dalam kesesatan (di dunia) dan dalam neraka.

ayahs.arabic: يَوْمَ يُسْحَبُونَ فِى ٱلنَّارِ عَلَىٰ وُجُوهِهِمْ ذُوقُوا۟ مَسَّ سَقَرَ
ayahs.sahih: The Day they are dragged into the Fire on their faces [it will be said], "Taste the touch of Saqar."
ayahs.clear: The Day when they are dragged upon their faces into the Fire: “Taste the touch of Saqar.”
ayahs.kemenag: (Ingatlah) pada hari mereka diseret ke neraka atas muka mereka. (Dikatakan kepada mereka): "Rasakanlah sentuhan api neraka!"

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّا كُلَّ شَىْءٍ خَلَقْنَٰهُ بِقَدَرٍۢ
ayahs.sahih: Indeed, all things We created with predestination.
ayahs.clear: Everything We created is precisely measured.
ayahs.kemenag: Sesungguhnya Kami menciptakan segala sesuatu menurut ukuran.

ayahs.arabic: وَمَآ أَمْرُنَآ إِلَّا وَٰحِدَةٌۭ كَلَمْحٍۭ بِٱلْبَصَرِ
ayahs.sahih: And Our command is but one, like a glance of the eye.
ayahs.clear: And Our command is but once, like the twinkling of an eye.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan perintah Kami hanyalah satu perkataan seperti kejapan mata.

ayahs.arabic: وَلَقَدْ أَهْلَكْنَآ أَشْيَاعَكُمْ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍۢ
ayahs.sahih: And We have already destroyed your kinds, so is there any who will remember?
ayahs.clear: We have destroyed your likes. Is there anyone who would ponder?
ayahs.kemenag: Dan sesungguhnya telah Kami binasakan orang yang serupa dengan kamu. Maka adakah orang yang mau mengambil pelajaran?

ayahs.arabic: وَكُلُّ شَىْءٍۢ فَعَلُوهُ فِى ٱلزُّبُرِ
ayahs.sahih: And everything they did is in written records.
ayahs.clear: Everything they have done is in the Books.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan segala sesuatu yang telah mereka perbuat tercatat dalam buku-buku catatan

ayahs.arabic: وَكُلُّ صَغِيرٍۢ وَكَبِيرٍۢ مُّسْتَطَرٌ
ayahs.sahih: And every small and great [thing] is inscribed.
ayahs.clear: Everything, small or large, is written down.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan segala (urusan) yang kecil maupun yang besar adalah tertulis.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِى جَنَّٰتٍۢ وَنَهَرٍۢ
ayahs.sahih: Indeed, the righteous will be among gardens and rivers,
ayahs.clear: The righteous will be amidst gardens and rivers.
ayahs.kemenag: Sesungguhnya orang-orang yang bertakwa itu di dalam taman-taman dan sungai-sungai,

ayahs.arabic: فِى مَقْعَدِ صِدْقٍ عِندَ مَلِيكٍۢ مُّقْتَدِرٍۭ
ayahs.sahih: In a seat of honor near a Sovereign, Perfect in Ability.
ayahs.clear: In an assembly of virtue, in the presence of an Omnipotent King.
ayahs.kemenag: di tempat yang disenangi di sisi Tuhan Yang Berkuasa.

ayahs.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ
ayahs.sahih: The Most Merciful
ayahs.clear: The Compassionate.
ayahs.kemenag: (Tuhan) Yang Maha Pemurah,

ayahs.arabic: عَلَّمَ ٱلْقُرْءَانَ
ayahs.sahih: Taught the Qur'an,
ayahs.clear: Has taught the Quran.
ayahs.kemenag: Yang telah mengajarkan al Quran.

ayahs.arabic: خَلَقَ ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ
ayahs.sahih: Created man,
ayahs.clear: He created man.
ayahs.kemenag: Dia menciptakan manusia.

ayahs.arabic: عَلَّمَهُ ٱلْبَيَانَ
ayahs.sahih: [And] taught him eloquence.
ayahs.clear: And taught him clear expression.
ayahs.kemenag: Mengajarnya pandai berbicara.

ayahs.arabic: ٱلشَّمْسُ وَٱلْقَمَرُ بِحُسْبَانٍۢ
ayahs.sahih: The sun and the moon [move] by precise calculation,
ayahs.clear: The sun and the moon move according to plan.
ayahs.kemenag: Matahari dan bulan (beredar) menurut perhitungan.

ayahs.arabic: وَٱلنَّجْمُ وَٱلشَّجَرُ يَسْجُدَانِ
ayahs.sahih: And the stars and trees prostrate.
ayahs.clear: And the stars and the trees prostrate themselves.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan tumbuh-tumbuhan dan pohon-pohonan kedua-duanya tunduk kepada-Nya.

ayahs.arabic: وَٱلسَّمَآءَ رَفَعَهَا وَوَضَعَ ٱلْمِيزَانَ
ayahs.sahih: And the heaven He raised and imposed the balance
ayahs.clear: And the sky, He raised; and He set up the balance.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan Allah telah meninggikan langit dan Dia meletakkan neraca (keadilan).

ayahs.arabic: أَلَّا تَطْغَوْا۟ فِى ٱلْمِيزَانِ
ayahs.sahih: That you not transgress within the balance.
ayahs.clear: So do not transgress in the balance.
ayahs.kemenag: Supaya kamu jangan melampaui batas tentang neraca itu.

ayahs.arabic: وَأَقِيمُوا۟ ٱلْوَزْنَ بِٱلْقِسْطِ وَلَا تُخْسِرُوا۟ ٱلْمِيزَانَ
ayahs.sahih: And establish weight in justice and do not make deficient the balance.
ayahs.clear: But maintain the weights with justice, and do not violate the balance.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan tegakkanlah timbangan itu dengan adil dan janganlah kamu mengurangi neraca itu.

ayahs.arabic: وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَضَعَهَا لِلْأَنَامِ
ayahs.sahih: And the earth He laid [out] for the creatures.
ayahs.clear: And the earth; He set up for the creatures.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan Allah telah meratakan bumi untuk makhluk(Nya).

ayahs.arabic: فِيهَا فَٰكِهَةٌۭ وَٱلنَّخْلُ ذَاتُ ٱلْأَكْمَامِ
ayahs.sahih: Therein is fruit and palm trees having sheaths [of dates]
ayahs.clear: In it are fruits, and palms in clusters.
ayahs.kemenag: Di bumi itu ada buah-buahan dan pohon kurma yang mempunyai kelopak mayang.

ayahs.arabic: وَٱلْحَبُّ ذُو ٱلْعَصْفِ وَٱلرَّيْحَانُ
ayahs.sahih: And grain having husks and scented plants.
ayahs.clear: And grains in the blades, and fragrant plants.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan biji-bijian yang berkulit dan bunga-bunga yang harum baunya.

ayahs.arabic: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
ayahs.sahih: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
ayahs.clear: So which of your Lord’s marvels will you deny?
ayahs.kemenag: Maka nikmat Tuhan kamu yang manakah yang kamu dustakan?

ayahs.arabic: خَلَقَ ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ مِن صَلْصَٰلٍۢ كَٱلْفَخَّارِ
ayahs.sahih: He created man from clay like [that of] pottery.
ayahs.clear: He created man from hard clay, like bricks.
ayahs.kemenag: Dia menciptakan manusia dari tanah kering seperti tembikar,

ayahs.arabic: وَخَلَقَ ٱلْجَآنَّ مِن مَّارِجٍۢ مِّن نَّارٍۢ
ayahs.sahih: And He created the jinn from a smokeless flame of fire.
ayahs.clear: And created the jinn from a fusion of fire.
ayahs.kemenag: dan Dia menciptakan jin dari nyala api.

ayahs.arabic: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
ayahs.sahih: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
ayahs.clear: So which of your Lord’s marvels will you deny?
ayahs.kemenag: Maka nikmat Tuhan kamu yang manakah yang kamu dustakan?

ayahs.arabic: رَبُّ ٱلْمَشْرِقَيْنِ وَرَبُّ ٱلْمَغْرِبَيْنِ
ayahs.sahih: [He is] Lord of the two sunrises and Lord of the two sunsets.
ayahs.clear: Lord of the two Easts and Lord of the two Wests.
ayahs.kemenag: Tuhan yang memelihara kedua tempat terbit matahari dan Tuhan yang memelihara kedua tempat terbenamnya

ayahs.arabic: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
ayahs.sahih: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
ayahs.clear: So which of your Lord’s marvels will you deny?
ayahs.kemenag: Maka nikmat Tuhan kamu yang manakah yang kamu dustakan?

ayahs.arabic: مَرَجَ ٱلْبَحْرَيْنِ يَلْتَقِيَانِ
ayahs.sahih: He released the two seas, meeting [side by side];
ayahs.clear: He merged the two seas, converging together.
ayahs.kemenag: Dia membiarkan dua lautan mengalir yang keduanya kemudian bertemu,

ayahs.arabic: بَيْنَهُمَا بَرْزَخٌۭ لَّا يَبْغِيَانِ
ayahs.sahih: Between them is a barrier [so] neither of them transgresses.
ayahs.clear: Between them is a barrier, which they do not overrun.
ayahs.kemenag: antara keduanya ada batas yang tidak dilampaui masing-masing.

ayahs.arabic: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
ayahs.sahih: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
ayahs.clear: So which of your Lord’s marvels will you deny?
ayahs.kemenag: Maka nikmat Tuhan kamu yang manakah yang kamu dustakan?

ayahs.arabic: يَخْرُجُ مِنْهُمَا ٱللُّؤْلُؤُ وَٱلْمَرْجَانُ
ayahs.sahih: From both of them emerge pearl and coral.
ayahs.clear: From them emerge pearls and coral.
ayahs.kemenag: Dari keduanya keluar mutiara dan marjan.

ayahs.arabic: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
ayahs.sahih: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
ayahs.clear: So which of your Lord’s marvels will you deny?
ayahs.kemenag: Maka nikmat Tuhan kamu yang manakah yang kamu dustakan?

ayahs.arabic: وَلَهُ ٱلْجَوَارِ ٱلْمُنشَـَٔاتُ فِى ٱلْبَحْرِ كَٱلْأَعْلَٰمِ
ayahs.sahih: And to Him belong the ships [with sails] elevated in the sea like mountains.
ayahs.clear: His are the ships, raised above the sea like landmarks.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan kepunyaan-Nya lah bahtera-bahtera yang tinggi layarnya di lautan laksana gunung-gunung.

ayahs.arabic: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
ayahs.sahih: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
ayahs.clear: So which of your Lord’s marvels will you deny?
ayahs.kemenag: Maka nikmat Tuhan kamu yang manakah yang kamu dustakan?

ayahs.arabic: كُلُّ مَنْ عَلَيْهَا فَانٍۢ
ayahs.sahih: Everyone upon the earth will perish,
ayahs.clear: Everyone upon it is perishing.
ayahs.kemenag: Semua yang ada di bumi itu akan binasa.

ayahs.arabic: وَيَبْقَىٰ وَجْهُ رَبِّكَ ذُو ٱلْجَلَٰلِ وَٱلْإِكْرَامِ
ayahs.sahih: And there will remain the Face of your Lord, Owner of Majesty and Honor.
ayahs.clear: But will remain the Presence of your Lord, Full of Majesty and Splendor.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan tetap kekal Dzat Tuhanmu yang mempunyai kebesaran dan kemuliaan.

ayahs.arabic: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
ayahs.sahih: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
ayahs.clear: So which of your Lord’s marvels will you deny?
ayahs.kemenag: Maka nikmat Tuhan kamu yang manakah yang kamu dustakan?

ayahs.arabic: يَسْـَٔلُهُۥ مَن فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ كُلَّ يَوْمٍ هُوَ فِى شَأْنٍۢ
ayahs.sahih: Whoever is within the heavens and earth asks Him; every day He is bringing about a matter.
ayahs.clear: Everyone in the heavens and the earth asks Him. Every day He is managing.
ayahs.kemenag: Semua yang ada di langit dan bumi selalu meminta kepada-Nya. Setiap waktu Dia dalam kesibukan.

ayahs.arabic: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
ayahs.sahih: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
ayahs.clear: So which of your Lord’s marvels will you deny?
ayahs.kemenag: Maka nikmat Rabb-mu yang manakah yang kamu dustakan?

ayahs.arabic: سَنَفْرُغُ لَكُمْ أَيُّهَ ٱلثَّقَلَانِ
ayahs.sahih: We will attend to you, O prominent beings.
ayahs.clear: We will attend to you, O prominent two.
ayahs.kemenag: Kami akan memperhatikan sepenuhnya kepadamu hai manusia dan jin.

ayahs.arabic: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
ayahs.sahih: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
ayahs.clear: So which of your Lord’s marvels will you deny?
ayahs.kemenag: Maka nikmat Tuhan kamu yang manakah yang kamu dustakan?

ayahs.arabic: يَٰمَعْشَرَ ٱلْجِنِّ وَٱلْإِنسِ إِنِ ٱسْتَطَعْتُمْ أَن تَنفُذُوا۟ مِنْ أَقْطَارِ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ فَٱنفُذُوا۟ ۚ لَا تَنفُذُونَ إِلَّا بِسُلْطَٰنٍۢ
ayahs.sahih: O company of jinn and mankind, if you are able to pass beyond the regions of the heavens and the earth, then pass. You will not pass except by authority [from Allah].
ayahs.clear: O society of jinn and humans! If you can pass through the bounds of the heavens and the earth, go ahead and pass. But you will not pass except with authorization.
ayahs.kemenag: Hai jama'ah jin dan manusia, jika kamu sanggup menembus (melintasi) penjuru langit dan bumi, maka lintasilah, kamu tidak dapat menembusnya kecuali dengan kekuatan.

ayahs.arabic: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
ayahs.sahih: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
ayahs.clear: So which of your Lord’s marvels will you deny?
ayahs.kemenag: Maka nikmat Tuhan kamu yang manakah yang kamu dustakan?

ayahs.arabic: يُرْسَلُ عَلَيْكُمَا شُوَاظٌۭ مِّن نَّارٍۢ وَنُحَاسٌۭ فَلَا تَنتَصِرَانِ
ayahs.sahih: There will be sent upon you a flame of fire and smoke, and you will not defend yourselves.
ayahs.clear: You will be bombarded with flares of fire and brass, and you will not succeed.
ayahs.kemenag: Kepada kamu, (jin dan manusia) dilepaskan nyala api dan cairan tembaga maka kamu tidak dapat menyelamatkan diri (dari padanya).

ayahs.arabic: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
ayahs.sahih: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
ayahs.clear: So which of your Lord’s marvels will you deny?
ayahs.kemenag: Maka nikmat Tuhan kamu yang manakah yang kamu dustakan?

ayahs.arabic: فَإِذَا ٱنشَقَّتِ ٱلسَّمَآءُ فَكَانَتْ وَرْدَةًۭ كَٱلدِّهَانِ
ayahs.sahih: And when the heaven is split open and becomes rose-colored like oil -
ayahs.clear: When the sky splits apart, and becomes rose, like paint.
ayahs.kemenag: Maka apabila langit telah terbelah dan menjadi merah mawar seperti (kilapan) minyak.

ayahs.arabic: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
ayahs.sahih: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny? -
ayahs.clear: So which of your Lord’s marvels will you deny?
ayahs.kemenag: Maka nikmat Tuhan kamu yang manakah yang kamu dustakan?

ayahs.arabic: فَيَوْمَئِذٍۢ لَّا يُسْـَٔلُ عَن ذَنۢبِهِۦٓ إِنسٌۭ وَلَا جَآنٌّۭ
ayahs.sahih: Then on that Day none will be asked about his sin among men or jinn.
ayahs.clear: On that Day, no human and no jinn will be asked about his sins.
ayahs.kemenag: Pada waktu itu manusia dan jin tidak ditanya tentang dosanya.

ayahs.arabic: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
ayahs.sahih: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
ayahs.clear: So which of your Lord’s marvels will you deny?
ayahs.kemenag: Maka nikmat Tuhan kamu yang manakah yang kamu dustakan?

ayahs.arabic: يُعْرَفُ ٱلْمُجْرِمُونَ بِسِيمَٰهُمْ فَيُؤْخَذُ بِٱلنَّوَٰصِى وَٱلْأَقْدَامِ
ayahs.sahih: The criminals will be known by their marks, and they will be seized by the forelocks and the feet.
ayahs.clear: The guilty will be recognized by their marks; they will be taken by the forelocks and the feet.
ayahs.kemenag: Orang-orang yang berdosa dikenal dengan tanda-tandannya, lalu dipegang ubun-ubun dan kaki mereka.

ayahs.arabic: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
ayahs.sahih: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
ayahs.clear: So which of your Lord’s marvels will you deny?
ayahs.kemenag: Maka nikmat Tuhan kamu yang manakah yang kamu dustakan?

ayahs.arabic: هَٰذِهِۦ جَهَنَّمُ ٱلَّتِى يُكَذِّبُ بِهَا ٱلْمُجْرِمُونَ
ayahs.sahih: This is Hell, which the criminals deny.
ayahs.clear: This is Hell that the guilty denied.
ayahs.kemenag: Inilah neraka Jahannam yang didustakan oleh orang-orang berdosa.

ayahs.arabic: يَطُوفُونَ بَيْنَهَا وَبَيْنَ حَمِيمٍ ءَانٍۢ
ayahs.sahih: They will go around between it and scalding water, heated [to the utmost degree].
ayahs.clear: They circulate between it and between a seething bath.
ayahs.kemenag: Mereka berkeliling di antaranya dan di antara air mendidih yang memuncak panasnya.

ayahs.arabic: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
ayahs.sahih: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
ayahs.clear: So which of your Lord’s marvels will you deny?
ayahs.kemenag: Maka nikmat Tuhan kamu yang manakah yang kamu dustakan?

ayahs.arabic: وَلِمَنْ خَافَ مَقَامَ رَبِّهِۦ جَنَّتَانِ
ayahs.sahih: But for he who has feared the position of his Lord are two gardens -
ayahs.clear: But for him who feared the standing of his Lord are two gardens.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan bagi orang yang takut akan saat menghadap Tuhannya ada dua surga.

ayahs.arabic: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
ayahs.sahih: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny? -
ayahs.clear: So which of your Lord’s marvels will you deny?
ayahs.kemenag: Maka nikmat Tuhan kamu yang manakah yang kamu dustakan?,

ayahs.arabic: ذَوَاتَآ أَفْنَانٍۢ
ayahs.sahih: Having [spreading] branches.
ayahs.clear: Full of varieties.
ayahs.kemenag: kedua surga itu mempunyai pohon-pohonan dan buah-buahan.

ayahs.arabic: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
ayahs.sahih: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
ayahs.clear: So which of your Lord’s marvels will you deny?
ayahs.kemenag: Maka nikmat Tuhan kamu yang manakah yang kamu dustakan?

ayahs.arabic: فِيهِمَا عَيْنَانِ تَجْرِيَانِ
ayahs.sahih: In both of them are two springs, flowing.
ayahs.clear: In them are two flowing springs.
ayahs.kemenag: Di dalam kedua surga itu ada dua buah mata air yang mengalir

ayahs.arabic: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
ayahs.sahih: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
ayahs.clear: So which of your Lord’s marvels will you deny?
ayahs.kemenag: Maka nikmat Tuhan kamu yang manakah yang kamu dustakan?

ayahs.arabic: فِيهِمَا مِن كُلِّ فَٰكِهَةٍۢ زَوْجَانِ
ayahs.sahih: In both of them are of every fruit, two kinds.
ayahs.clear: In them are fruits of every kind, in pairs.
ayahs.kemenag: Di dalam kedua surga itu terdapat segala macam buah-buahan yang berpasangan.

ayahs.arabic: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
ayahs.sahih: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
ayahs.clear: So which of your Lord’s marvels will you deny?
ayahs.kemenag: Maka nikmat Tuhan kamu yang manakah yang kamu dustakan?

ayahs.arabic: مُتَّكِـِٔينَ عَلَىٰ فُرُشٍۭ بَطَآئِنُهَا مِنْ إِسْتَبْرَقٍۢ ۚ وَجَنَى ٱلْجَنَّتَيْنِ دَانٍۢ
ayahs.sahih: [They are] reclining on beds whose linings are of silk brocade, and the fruit of the two gardens is hanging low.
ayahs.clear: Reclining on furnishings lined with brocade, and the fruits of the two gardens are near at hand.
ayahs.kemenag: Mereka bertelekan di atas permadani yang sebelah dalamnya dari sutera. Dan buah-buahan di kedua surga itu dapat (dipetik) dari dekat.

ayahs.arabic: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
ayahs.sahih: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
ayahs.clear: So which of your Lord’s marvels will you deny?
ayahs.kemenag: Maka nikmat Tuhan kamu yang manakah yang kamu dustakan?

ayahs.arabic: فِيهِنَّ قَٰصِرَٰتُ ٱلطَّرْفِ لَمْ يَطْمِثْهُنَّ إِنسٌۭ قَبْلَهُمْ وَلَا جَآنٌّۭ
ayahs.sahih: In them are women limiting [their] glances, untouched before them by man or jinni -
ayahs.clear: In them are maidens restraining their glances, untouched before by any man or jinn.
ayahs.kemenag: Di dalam surga itu ada bidadari-bidadari yang sopan menundukkan pandangannya, tidak pernah disentuh oleh manusia sebelum mereka (penghuni-penghuni surga yang menjadi suami mereka), dan tidak pula oleh jin.

ayahs.arabic: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
ayahs.sahih: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny? -
ayahs.clear: So which of your Lord’s marvels will you deny?
ayahs.kemenag: Maka nikmat Tuhan kamu yang manakah yang kamu dustakan?

ayahs.arabic: كَأَنَّهُنَّ ٱلْيَاقُوتُ وَٱلْمَرْجَانُ
ayahs.sahih: As if they were rubies and coral.
ayahs.clear: As though they were rubies and corals.
ayahs.kemenag: Seakan-akan bidadari itu permata yakut dan marjan.

ayahs.arabic: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
ayahs.sahih: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
ayahs.clear: So which of your Lord’s marvels will you deny?
ayahs.kemenag: Maka nikmat Tuhan kamu yang manakah yang kamu dustakan?

ayahs.arabic: هَلْ جَزَآءُ ٱلْإِحْسَٰنِ إِلَّا ٱلْإِحْسَٰنُ
ayahs.sahih: Is the reward for good [anything] but good?
ayahs.clear: Is the reward of goodness anything but goodness?
ayahs.kemenag: Tidak ada balasan kebaikan kecuali kebaikan (pula).

ayahs.arabic: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
ayahs.sahih: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
ayahs.clear: So which of your Lord’s marvels will you deny?
ayahs.kemenag: Maka nikmat Tuhan kamu yang manakah yang kamu dustakan?

ayahs.arabic: وَمِن دُونِهِمَا جَنَّتَانِ
ayahs.sahih: And below them both [in excellence] are two [other] gardens -
ayahs.clear: And beneath them are two gardens.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan selain dari dua surga itu ada dua surga lagi

ayahs.arabic: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
ayahs.sahih: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny? -
ayahs.clear: So which of your Lord’s marvels will you deny?
ayahs.kemenag: Maka nikmat Tuhan kamu yang manakah yang kamu dustakan?

ayahs.arabic: مُدْهَآمَّتَانِ
ayahs.sahih: Dark green [in color].
ayahs.clear: Deep green.
ayahs.kemenag: Kedua surga itu (kelihatan) hijau tua warnanya.

ayahs.arabic: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
ayahs.sahih: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
ayahs.clear: So which of your Lord’s marvels will you deny?
ayahs.kemenag: Maka nikmat Tuhan kamu yang manakah yang kamu dustakan?

ayahs.arabic: فِيهِمَا عَيْنَانِ نَضَّاخَتَانِ
ayahs.sahih: In both of them are two springs, spouting.
ayahs.clear: In them are two gushing springs.
ayahs.kemenag: Di dalam kedua surga itu ada dua buah mata air yang memancar.

ayahs.arabic: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
ayahs.sahih: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
ayahs.clear: So which of your Lord’s marvels will you deny?
ayahs.kemenag: Maka nikmat Tuhan kamu yang manakah yang kamu dustakan?

ayahs.arabic: فِيهِمَا فَٰكِهَةٌۭ وَنَخْلٌۭ وَرُمَّانٌۭ
ayahs.sahih: In both of them are fruit and palm trees and pomegranates.
ayahs.clear: In them are fruits, and date-palms, and pomegranates.
ayahs.kemenag: Di dalam keduanya (ada macam-macam) buah-buahan dan kurma serta delima.

ayahs.arabic: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
ayahs.sahih: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
ayahs.clear: So which of your Lord’s marvels will you deny?
ayahs.kemenag: Maka nikmat Tuhan kamu yang manakah yang kamu dustakan?

ayahs.arabic: فِيهِنَّ خَيْرَٰتٌ حِسَانٌۭ
ayahs.sahih: In them are good and beautiful women -
ayahs.clear: In them are good and beautiful ones.
ayahs.kemenag: Di dalam surga itu ada bidadari-bidadari yang baik-baik lagi cantik-cantik.

ayahs.arabic: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
ayahs.sahih: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny? -
ayahs.clear: So which of your Lord’s marvels will you deny?
ayahs.kemenag: Maka nikmat Tuhan kamu yang manakah yang kamu dustakan?

ayahs.arabic: حُورٌۭ مَّقْصُورَٰتٌۭ فِى ٱلْخِيَامِ
ayahs.sahih: Fair ones reserved in pavilions -
ayahs.clear: Companions, secluded in the tents.
ayahs.kemenag: (Bidadari-bidadari) yang jelita, putih bersih, dipingit dalam rumah.

ayahs.arabic: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
ayahs.sahih: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny? -
ayahs.clear: So which of your Lord’s marvels will you deny?
ayahs.kemenag: Maka nikmat Tuhan kamu yang manakah yang kamu dustakan?

ayahs.arabic: لَمْ يَطْمِثْهُنَّ إِنسٌۭ قَبْلَهُمْ وَلَا جَآنٌّۭ
ayahs.sahih: Untouched before them by man or jinni -
ayahs.clear: Whom no human has touched before, nor jinn.
ayahs.kemenag: Mereka tidak pernah disentuh oleh manusia sebelum mereka (penghuni-penghuni surga yang menjadi suami mereka), dan tidak pula oleh jin.

ayahs.arabic: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
ayahs.sahih: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny? -
ayahs.clear: So which of your Lord’s marvels will you deny?
ayahs.kemenag: Maka nikmat Tuhan kamu yang manakah yang kamu dustakan?

ayahs.arabic: مُتَّكِـِٔينَ عَلَىٰ رَفْرَفٍ خُضْرٍۢ وَعَبْقَرِىٍّ حِسَانٍۢ
ayahs.sahih: Reclining on green cushions and beautiful fine carpets.
ayahs.clear: Reclining on green cushions, and exquisite carpets.
ayahs.kemenag: Mereka bertelekan pada bantal-bantal yang hijau dan permadani-permadani yang indah.

ayahs.arabic: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
ayahs.sahih: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
ayahs.clear: So which of your Lord’s marvels will you deny?
ayahs.kemenag: Maka nikmat Tuhan kamu yang manakah yang kamu dustakan?

ayahs.arabic: تَبَٰرَكَ ٱسْمُ رَبِّكَ ذِى ٱلْجَلَٰلِ وَٱلْإِكْرَامِ
ayahs.sahih: Blessed is the name of your Lord, Owner of Majesty and Honor.
ayahs.clear: Blessed be the name of your Lord, Full of Majesty and Splendor.
ayahs.kemenag: Maha Agung nama Tuhanmu Yang Mempunyai Kebesaran dan Karunia.

ayahs.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ إِذَا وَقَعَتِ ٱلْوَاقِعَةُ
ayahs.sahih: When the Occurrence occurs,
ayahs.clear: When the inevitable occurs.
ayahs.kemenag: Apabila terjadi hari kiamat,

ayahs.arabic: لَيْسَ لِوَقْعَتِهَا كَاذِبَةٌ
ayahs.sahih: There is, at its occurrence, no denial.
ayahs.clear: Of its occurrence, there is no denial.
ayahs.kemenag: tidak seorangpun dapat berdusta tentang kejadiannya.

ayahs.arabic: خَافِضَةٌۭ رَّافِعَةٌ
ayahs.sahih: It will bring down [some] and raise up [others].
ayahs.clear: Bringing low, raising high.
ayahs.kemenag: (Kejadian itu) merendahkan (satu golongan) dan meninggikan (golongan yang lain),

ayahs.arabic: إِذَا رُجَّتِ ٱلْأَرْضُ رَجًّۭا
ayahs.sahih: When the earth is shaken with convulsion
ayahs.clear: When the earth is shaken with a shock.
ayahs.kemenag: apabila bumi digoncangkan sedahsyat-dahsyatnya,

ayahs.arabic: وَبُسَّتِ ٱلْجِبَالُ بَسًّۭا
ayahs.sahih: And the mountains are broken down, crumbling
ayahs.clear: And the mountains are crushed and crumbled.
ayahs.kemenag: dan gunung-gunung dihancur luluhkan seluluh-luluhnya,

ayahs.arabic: فَكَانَتْ هَبَآءًۭ مُّنۢبَثًّۭا
ayahs.sahih: And become dust dispersing.
ayahs.clear: And they become scattered dust.
ayahs.kemenag: maka jadilah ia debu yang beterbangan,

ayahs.arabic: وَكُنتُمْ أَزْوَٰجًۭا ثَلَٰثَةًۭ
ayahs.sahih: And you become [of] three kinds:
ayahs.clear: And you become three classes.
ayahs.kemenag: dan kamu menjadi tiga golongan.

ayahs.arabic: فَأَصْحَٰبُ ٱلْمَيْمَنَةِ مَآ أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلْمَيْمَنَةِ
ayahs.sahih: Then the companions of the right - what are the companions of the right?
ayahs.clear: Those on the Right—what of those on the Right?
ayahs.kemenag: Yaitu golongan kanan. Alangkah mulianya golongan kanan itu.

ayahs.arabic: وَأَصْحَٰبُ ٱلْمَشْـَٔمَةِ مَآ أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلْمَشْـَٔمَةِ
ayahs.sahih: And the companions of the left - what are the companions of the left?
ayahs.clear: And those on the Left—what of those on the Left?
ayahs.kemenag: Dan golongan kiri. Alangkah sengsaranya golongan kiri itu.

ayahs.arabic: وَٱلسَّٰبِقُونَ ٱلسَّٰبِقُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And the forerunners, the forerunners -
ayahs.clear: And the forerunners, the forerunners.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan orang-orang yang beriman paling dahulu,

ayahs.arabic: أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ ٱلْمُقَرَّبُونَ
ayahs.sahih: Those are the ones brought near [to Allah]
ayahs.clear: Those are the nearest.
ayahs.kemenag: Mereka itulah yang didekatkan kepada Allah.

ayahs.arabic: فِى جَنَّٰتِ ٱلنَّعِيمِ
ayahs.sahih: In the Gardens of Pleasure,
ayahs.clear: In the Gardens of Bliss.
ayahs.kemenag: Berada dalam jannah kenikmatan.

ayahs.arabic: ثُلَّةٌۭ مِّنَ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
ayahs.sahih: A [large] company of the former peoples
ayahs.clear: A throng from the ancients.
ayahs.kemenag: Segolongan besar dari orang-orang yang terdahulu,

ayahs.arabic: وَقَلِيلٌۭ مِّنَ ٱلْءَاخِرِينَ
ayahs.sahih: And a few of the later peoples,
ayahs.clear: And a small band from the latecomers.
ayahs.kemenag: dan segolongan kecil dari orang-orang yang kemudian

ayahs.arabic: عَلَىٰ سُرُرٍۢ مَّوْضُونَةٍۢ
ayahs.sahih: On thrones woven [with ornament],
ayahs.clear: On luxurious furnishings.
ayahs.kemenag: Mereka berada di atas dipan yang bertahta emas dan permata,

ayahs.arabic: مُّتَّكِـِٔينَ عَلَيْهَا مُتَقَٰبِلِينَ
ayahs.sahih: Reclining on them, facing each other.
ayahs.clear: Reclining on them, facing one another.
ayahs.kemenag: seraya bertelekan di atasnya berhadap-hadapan.

ayahs.arabic: يَطُوفُ عَلَيْهِمْ وِلْدَٰنٌۭ مُّخَلَّدُونَ
ayahs.sahih: There will circulate among them young boys made eternal
ayahs.clear: Serving them will be immortalized youth.
ayahs.kemenag: Mereka dikelilingi oleh anak-anak muda yang tetap muda,

ayahs.arabic: بِأَكْوَابٍۢ وَأَبَارِيقَ وَكَأْسٍۢ مِّن مَّعِينٍۢ
ayahs.sahih: With vessels, pitchers and a cup [of wine] from a flowing spring -
ayahs.clear: With cups, pitchers, and sparkling drinks.
ayahs.kemenag: dengan membawa gelas, cerek dan minuman yang diambil dari air yang mengalir,

ayahs.arabic: لَّا يُصَدَّعُونَ عَنْهَا وَلَا يُنزِفُونَ
ayahs.sahih: No headache will they have therefrom, nor will they be intoxicated -
ayahs.clear: Causing them neither headache, nor intoxication.
ayahs.kemenag: mereka tidak pening karenanya dan tidak pula mabuk,

ayahs.arabic: وَفَٰكِهَةٍۢ مِّمَّا يَتَخَيَّرُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And fruit of what they select
ayahs.clear: And fruits of their choice.
ayahs.kemenag: dan buah-buahan dari apa yang mereka pilih,

ayahs.arabic: وَلَحْمِ طَيْرٍۢ مِّمَّا يَشْتَهُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And the meat of fowl, from whatever they desire.
ayahs.clear: And meat of birds that they may desire.
ayahs.kemenag: dan daging burung dari apa yang mereka inginkan.

ayahs.arabic: وَحُورٌ عِينٌۭ
ayahs.sahih: And [for them are] fair women with large, [beautiful] eyes,
ayahs.clear: And lovely companions.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan ada bidadari-bidadari bermata jeli,

ayahs.arabic: كَأَمْثَٰلِ ٱللُّؤْلُؤِ ٱلْمَكْنُونِ
ayahs.sahih: The likenesses of pearls well-protected,
ayahs.clear: The likenesses of treasured pearls.
ayahs.kemenag: laksana mutiara yang tersimpan baik.

ayahs.arabic: جَزَآءًۢ بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ
ayahs.sahih: As reward for what they used to do.
ayahs.clear: As a reward for what they used to do.
ayahs.kemenag: Sebagai balasan bagi apa yang telah mereka kerjakan.

ayahs.arabic: لَا يَسْمَعُونَ فِيهَا لَغْوًۭا وَلَا تَأْثِيمًا
ayahs.sahih: They will not hear therein ill speech or commission of sin -
ayahs.clear: Therein they will hear no nonsense, and no accusations.
ayahs.kemenag: Mereka tidak mendengar di dalamnya perkataan yang sia-sia dan tidak pula perkataan yang menimbulkan dosa,

ayahs.arabic: إِلَّا قِيلًۭا سَلَٰمًۭا سَلَٰمًۭا
ayahs.sahih: Only a saying: "Peace, peace."
ayahs.clear: But only the greeting: “Peace, peace.”
ayahs.kemenag: akan tetapi mereka mendengar ucapan salam.

ayahs.arabic: وَأَصْحَٰبُ ٱلْيَمِينِ مَآ أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلْيَمِينِ
ayahs.sahih: The companions of the right - what are the companions of the right?
ayahs.clear: And those on the Right—what of those on the Right?
ayahs.kemenag: Dan golongan kanan, alangkah bahagianya golongan kanan itu.

ayahs.arabic: فِى سِدْرٍۢ مَّخْضُودٍۢ
ayahs.sahih: [They will be] among lote trees with thorns removed
ayahs.clear: In lush orchards.
ayahs.kemenag: Berada di antara pohon bidara yang tak berduri,

ayahs.arabic: وَطَلْحٍۢ مَّنضُودٍۢ
ayahs.sahih: And [banana] trees layered [with fruit]
ayahs.clear: And sweet-smelling plants.
ayahs.kemenag: dan pohon pisang yang bersusun-susun (buahnya),

ayahs.arabic: وَظِلٍّۢ مَّمْدُودٍۢ
ayahs.sahih: And shade extended
ayahs.clear: And extended shade.
ayahs.kemenag: dan naungan yang terbentang luas,

ayahs.arabic: وَمَآءٍۢ مَّسْكُوبٍۢ
ayahs.sahih: And water poured out
ayahs.clear: And outpouring water.
ayahs.kemenag: dan air yang tercurah,

ayahs.arabic: وَفَٰكِهَةٍۢ كَثِيرَةٍۢ
ayahs.sahih: And fruit, abundant [and varied],
ayahs.clear: And abundant fruit.
ayahs.kemenag: dan buah-buahan yang banyak,

ayahs.arabic: لَّا مَقْطُوعَةٍۢ وَلَا مَمْنُوعَةٍۢ
ayahs.sahih: Neither limited [to season] nor forbidden,
ayahs.clear: Neither withheld, nor forbidden.
ayahs.kemenag: yang tidak berhenti (berbuah) dan tidak terlarang mengambilnya.

ayahs.arabic: وَفُرُشٍۢ مَّرْفُوعَةٍ
ayahs.sahih: And [upon] beds raised high.
ayahs.clear: And uplifted mattresses.
ayahs.kemenag: dan kasur-kasur yang tebal lagi empuk.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّآ أَنشَأْنَٰهُنَّ إِنشَآءًۭ
ayahs.sahih: Indeed, We have produced the women of Paradise in a [new] creation
ayahs.clear: We have created them of special creation.
ayahs.kemenag: Sesungguhnya Kami menciptakan mereka (bidadari-bidadari) dengan langsung

ayahs.arabic: فَجَعَلْنَٰهُنَّ أَبْكَارًا
ayahs.sahih: And made them virgins,
ayahs.clear: And made them virgins.
ayahs.kemenag: dan Kami jadikan mereka gadis-gadis perawan.

ayahs.arabic: عُرُبًا أَتْرَابًۭا
ayahs.sahih: Devoted [to their husbands] and of equal age,
ayahs.clear: Tender and un-aging.
ayahs.kemenag: penuh cinta lagi sebaya umurnya.

ayahs.arabic: لِّأَصْحَٰبِ ٱلْيَمِينِ
ayahs.sahih: For the companions of the right [who are]
ayahs.clear: For those on the Right.
ayahs.kemenag: (Kami ciptakan mereka) untuk golongan kanan,

ayahs.arabic: ثُلَّةٌۭ مِّنَ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
ayahs.sahih: A company of the former peoples
ayahs.clear: A throng from the ancients.
ayahs.kemenag: (yaitu) segolongan besar dari orang-orang yang terdahulu.

ayahs.arabic: وَثُلَّةٌۭ مِّنَ ٱلْءَاخِرِينَ
ayahs.sahih: And a company of the later peoples.
ayahs.clear: And a throng from the latecomers.
ayahs.kemenag: dan segolongan besar pula dari orang-orang yang kemudian.

ayahs.arabic: وَأَصْحَٰبُ ٱلشِّمَالِ مَآ أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلشِّمَالِ
ayahs.sahih: And the companions of the left - what are the companions of the left?
ayahs.clear: And those on the Left—what of those on the Left?
ayahs.kemenag: Dan golongan kiri, siapakah golongan kiri itu?

ayahs.arabic: فِى سَمُومٍۢ وَحَمِيمٍۢ
ayahs.sahih: [They will be] in scorching fire and scalding water
ayahs.clear: Amid searing wind and boiling water.
ayahs.kemenag: Dalam (siksaan) angin yang amat panas, dan air panas yang mendidih,

ayahs.arabic: وَظِلٍّۢ مِّن يَحْمُومٍۢ
ayahs.sahih: And a shade of black smoke,
ayahs.clear: And a shadow of thick smoke.
ayahs.kemenag: dan dalam naungan asap yang hitam.

ayahs.arabic: لَّا بَارِدٍۢ وَلَا كَرِيمٍ
ayahs.sahih: Neither cool nor beneficial.
ayahs.clear: Neither cool, nor refreshing.
ayahs.kemenag: Tidak sejuk dan tidak menyenangkan.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ قَبْلَ ذَٰلِكَ مُتْرَفِينَ
ayahs.sahih: Indeed they were, before that, indulging in affluence,
ayahs.clear: They had lived before that in luxury.
ayahs.kemenag: Sesungguhnya mereka sebelum itu hidup bermewahan.

ayahs.arabic: وَكَانُوا۟ يُصِرُّونَ عَلَى ٱلْحِنثِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
ayahs.sahih: And they used to persist in the great violation,
ayahs.clear: And they used to persist in immense wrongdoing.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan mereka terus-menerus mengerjakan dosa besar.

ayahs.arabic: وَكَانُوا۟ يَقُولُونَ أَئِذَا مِتْنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابًۭا وَعِظَٰمًا أَءِنَّا لَمَبْعُوثُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And they used to say, "When we die and become dust and bones, are we indeed to be resurrected?
ayahs.clear: And they used to say, “When we are dead and turned into dust and bones, are we to be resurrected?
ayahs.kemenag: Dan mereka selalu mengatakan: "Apakah bila kami mati dan menjadi tanah dan tulang belulang, apakah sesungguhnya kami akan benar-benar dibangkitkan kembali?

ayahs.arabic: أَوَءَابَآؤُنَا ٱلْأَوَّلُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And our forefathers [as well]?"
ayahs.clear: And our ancient ancestors too?”
ayahs.kemenag: apakah bapak-bapak kami yang terdahulu (juga)?"

ayahs.arabic: قُلْ إِنَّ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ وَٱلْءَاخِرِينَ
ayahs.sahih: Say, [O Muhammad], "Indeed, the former and the later peoples
ayahs.clear: Say, “The first and the last.
ayahs.kemenag: Katakanlah: "Sesungguhnya orang-orang yang terdahulu dan orang-orang yang terkemudian,

ayahs.arabic: لَمَجْمُوعُونَ إِلَىٰ مِيقَٰتِ يَوْمٍۢ مَّعْلُومٍۢ
ayahs.sahih: Are to be gathered together for the appointment of a known Day."
ayahs.clear: Will be gathered for the appointment of a familiar Day.”
ayahs.kemenag: benar-benar akan dikumpulkan di waktu tertentu pada hari yang dikenal.

ayahs.arabic: ثُمَّ إِنَّكُمْ أَيُّهَا ٱلضَّآلُّونَ ٱلْمُكَذِّبُونَ
ayahs.sahih: Then indeed you, O those astray [who are] deniers,
ayahs.clear: Then you, you misguided, who deny the truth.
ayahs.kemenag: Kemudian sesungguhnya kamu hai orang-orang yang sesat lagi mendustakan,

ayahs.arabic: لَءَاكِلُونَ مِن شَجَرٍۢ مِّن زَقُّومٍۢ
ayahs.sahih: Will be eating from trees of zaqqum
ayahs.clear: Will be eating from the Tree of Bitterness.
ayahs.kemenag: benar-benar akan memakan pohon zaqqum,

ayahs.arabic: فَمَالِـُٔونَ مِنْهَا ٱلْبُطُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And filling with it your bellies
ayahs.clear: Will be filling your bellies with it.
