ayahs.kemenag: Hai Nabi, perangilah orang-orang kafir dan orang-orang munafik dan bersikap keraslah terhadap mereka. Tempat mereka adalah jahannam dan itu adalah seburuk-buruknya tempat kembali.

ayahs.arabic: ضَرَبَ ٱللَّهُ مَثَلًۭا لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ ٱمْرَأَتَ نُوحٍۢ وَٱمْرَأَتَ لُوطٍۢ ۖ كَانَتَا تَحْتَ عَبْدَيْنِ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا صَٰلِحَيْنِ فَخَانَتَاهُمَا فَلَمْ يُغْنِيَا عَنْهُمَا مِنَ ٱللَّهِ شَيْـًۭٔا وَقِيلَ ٱدْخُلَا ٱلنَّارَ مَعَ ٱلدَّٰخِلِينَ
ayahs.sahih: Allah presents an example of those who disbelieved: the wife of Noah and the wife of Lot. They were under two of Our righteous servants but betrayed them, so those prophets did not avail them from Allah at all, and it was said, "Enter the Fire with those who enter."
ayahs.clear: God illustrates an example of those who disbelieve: the wife of Noah and the wife of Lot. They were under two of Our righteous servants, but they betrayed them. They availed them nothing against God, and it was said, “Enter the Fire with those who are entering.”
ayahs.kemenag: Allah membuat isteri Nuh dan isteri Luth sebagai perumpamaan bagi orang-orang kafir. Keduanya berada di bawah pengawasan dua orang hamba yang saleh di antara hamba-hamba Kami; lalu kedua isteri itu berkhianat kepada suaminya (masing-masing), maka suaminya itu tiada dapat membantu mereka sedikitpun dari (siksa) Allah; dan dikatakan (kepada keduanya): "Masuklah ke dalam jahannam bersama orang-orang yang masuk (jahannam)".

ayahs.arabic: وَضَرَبَ ٱللَّهُ مَثَلًۭا لِّلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ٱمْرَأَتَ فِرْعَوْنَ إِذْ قَالَتْ رَبِّ ٱبْنِ لِى عِندَكَ بَيْتًۭا فِى ٱلْجَنَّةِ وَنَجِّنِى مِن فِرْعَوْنَ وَعَمَلِهِۦ وَنَجِّنِى مِنَ ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ
ayahs.sahih: And Allah presents an example of those who believed: the wife of Pharaoh, when she said, "My Lord, build for me near You a house in Paradise and save me from Pharaoh and his deeds and save me from the wrongdoing people."
ayahs.clear: And God illustrates an example of those who believe: the wife of Pharaoh, when she said, “My Lord, build for me, with you, a house in Paradise, and save me from Pharaoh and his works, and save me from the wrongdoing people.”
ayahs.kemenag: Dan Allah membuat isteri Fir'aun perumpamaan bagi orang-orang yang beriman, ketika ia berkata: "Ya Rabbku, bangunkanlah untukku sebuah rumah di sisi-Mu dalam firdaus, dan selamatkanlah aku dari Fir'aun dan perbuatannya, dan selamatkanlah aku dari kaum yang zhalim.

ayahs.arabic: وَمَرْيَمَ ٱبْنَتَ عِمْرَٰنَ ٱلَّتِىٓ أَحْصَنَتْ فَرْجَهَا فَنَفَخْنَا فِيهِ مِن رُّوحِنَا وَصَدَّقَتْ بِكَلِمَٰتِ رَبِّهَا وَكُتُبِهِۦ وَكَانَتْ مِنَ ٱلْقَٰنِتِينَ
ayahs.sahih: And [the example of] Mary, the daughter of 'Imran, who guarded her chastity, so We blew into [her garment] through Our angel, and she believed in the words of her Lord and His scriptures and was of the devoutly obedient.
ayahs.clear: And Mary, the daughter of Imran, who guarded her womb, and so We breathed into her of Our Spirit; and she believed in the truth of her Lord’s Words and His Books, and was one of the devout.
ayahs.kemenag: dan (ingatlah) Maryam binti Imran yang memelihara kehormatannya, maka Kami tiupkan ke dalam rahimnya sebagian dari ruh (ciptaan) Kami, dan dia membenarkan kalimat Rabbnya dan Kitab-Kitab-Nya, dan dia adalah termasuk orang-orang yang taat.

ayahs.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ تَبَٰرَكَ ٱلَّذِى بِيَدِهِ ٱلْمُلْكُ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ قَدِيرٌ
ayahs.sahih: Blessed is He in whose hand is dominion, and He is over all things competent -
ayahs.clear: Blessed is He in whose hand is the sovereignty, and Who has power over everything.
ayahs.kemenag: Maha Suci Allah Yang di tangan-Nya-lah segala kerajaan, dan Dia Maha Kuasa atas segala sesuatu,

ayahs.arabic: ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلْمَوْتَ وَٱلْحَيَوٰةَ لِيَبْلُوَكُمْ أَيُّكُمْ أَحْسَنُ عَمَلًۭا ۚ وَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْغَفُورُ
ayahs.sahih: [He] who created death and life to test you [as to] which of you is best in deed - and He is the Exalted in Might, the Forgiving -
ayahs.clear: He who created death and life—to test you—as to which of you is better in conduct. He is the Almighty, the Forgiving.
ayahs.kemenag: Yang menjadikan mati dan hidup, supaya Dia menguji kamu, siapa di antara kamu yang lebih baik amalnya. Dan Dia Maha Perkasa lagi Maha Pengampun,

ayahs.arabic: ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ سَبْعَ سَمَٰوَٰتٍۢ طِبَاقًۭا ۖ مَّا تَرَىٰ فِى خَلْقِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ مِن تَفَٰوُتٍۢ ۖ فَٱرْجِعِ ٱلْبَصَرَ هَلْ تَرَىٰ مِن فُطُورٍۢ
ayahs.sahih: [And] who created seven heavens in layers. You do not see in the creation of the Most Merciful any inconsistency. So return [your] vision [to the sky]; do you see any breaks?
ayahs.clear: He who created seven heavens in layers. You see no discrepancy in the creation of the Compassionate. Look again. Can you see any cracks?
ayahs.kemenag: Yang telah menciptakan tujuh langit berlapis-lapis. Kamu sekali-kali tidak melihat pada ciptaan Tuhan Yang Maha Pemurah sesuatu yang tidak seimbang. Maka lihatlah berulang-ulang, adakah kamu lihat sesuatu yang tidak seimbang?

ayahs.arabic: ثُمَّ ٱرْجِعِ ٱلْبَصَرَ كَرَّتَيْنِ يَنقَلِبْ إِلَيْكَ ٱلْبَصَرُ خَاسِئًۭا وَهُوَ حَسِيرٌۭ
ayahs.sahih: Then return [your] vision twice again. [Your] vision will return to you humbled while it is fatigued.
ayahs.clear: Then look again, and again, and your sight will return to you dazzled and exhausted.
ayahs.kemenag: Kemudian pandanglah sekali lagi niscaya penglihatanmu akan kembali kepadamu dengan tidak menemukan sesuatu cacat dan penglihatanmu itupun dalam keadaan payah.

ayahs.arabic: وَلَقَدْ زَيَّنَّا ٱلسَّمَآءَ ٱلدُّنْيَا بِمَصَٰبِيحَ وَجَعَلْنَٰهَا رُجُومًۭا لِّلشَّيَٰطِينِ ۖ وَأَعْتَدْنَا لَهُمْ عَذَابَ ٱلسَّعِيرِ
ayahs.sahih: And We have certainly beautified the nearest heaven with stars and have made [from] them what is thrown at the devils and have prepared for them the punishment of the Blaze.
ayahs.clear: We have adorned the lower heaven with lanterns, and made them missiles against the devils; and We have prepared for them the punishment of the Blaze.
ayahs.kemenag: Sesungguhnya Kami telah menghiasi langit yang dekat dengan bintang-bintang, dan Kami jadikan bintang-bintang itu alat-alat pelempar syaitan, dan Kami sediakan bagi mereka siksa neraka yang menyala-nyala.

ayahs.arabic: وَلِلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ بِرَبِّهِمْ عَذَابُ جَهَنَّمَ ۖ وَبِئْسَ ٱلْمَصِيرُ
ayahs.sahih: And for those who disbelieved in their Lord is the punishment of Hell, and wretched is the destination.
ayahs.clear: For those who reject their Lord, there is the torment of Hell. What an evil destination!
ayahs.kemenag: Dan orang-orang yang kafir kepada Tuhannya, memperoleh azab Jahannam. Dan itulah seburuk-buruk tempat kembali.

ayahs.arabic: إِذَآ أُلْقُوا۟ فِيهَا سَمِعُوا۟ لَهَا شَهِيقًۭا وَهِىَ تَفُورُ
ayahs.sahih: When they are thrown into it, they hear from it a [dreadful] inhaling while it boils up.
ayahs.clear: When they are thrown into it, they will hear it roaring, as it seethes.
ayahs.kemenag: Apabila mereka dilemparkan ke dalamnya mereka mendengar suara neraka yang mengerikan, sedang neraka itu menggelegak,

ayahs.arabic: تَكَادُ تَمَيَّزُ مِنَ ٱلْغَيْظِ ۖ كُلَّمَآ أُلْقِىَ فِيهَا فَوْجٌۭ سَأَلَهُمْ خَزَنَتُهَآ أَلَمْ يَأْتِكُمْ نَذِيرٌۭ
ayahs.sahih: It almost bursts with rage. Every time a company is thrown into it, its keepers ask them, "Did there not come to you a warner?"
ayahs.clear: It almost bursts with fury. Every time a batch is thrown into it, its keepers will ask them, “Has no warner come to you?”
ayahs.kemenag: hampir-hampir (neraka) itu terpecah-pecah lantaran marah. Setiap kali dilemparkan ke dalamnya sekumpulan (orang-orang kafir), penjaga-penjaga (neraka itu) bertanya kepada mereka: "Apakah belum pernah datang kepada kamu (di dunia) seorang pemberi peringatan?"

ayahs.arabic: قَالُوا۟ بَلَىٰ قَدْ جَآءَنَا نَذِيرٌۭ فَكَذَّبْنَا وَقُلْنَا مَا نَزَّلَ ٱللَّهُ مِن شَىْءٍ إِنْ أَنتُمْ إِلَّا فِى ضَلَٰلٍۢ كَبِيرٍۢ
ayahs.sahih: They will say," Yes, a warner had come to us, but we denied and said, 'Allah has not sent down anything. You are not but in great error.'"
ayahs.clear: They will say, “Yes, a warner did come to us, but we disbelieved, and said, ‘God did not send down anything; you are very much mistaken.’”
ayahs.kemenag: Mereka menjawab: "Benar ada", sesungguhnya telah datang kepada kami seorang pemberi peringatan, maka kami mendustakan(nya) dan kami katakan: "Allah tidak menurunkan sesuatupun; kamu tidak lain hanyalah di dalam kesesatan yang besar".

ayahs.arabic: وَقَالُوا۟ لَوْ كُنَّا نَسْمَعُ أَوْ نَعْقِلُ مَا كُنَّا فِىٓ أَصْحَٰبِ ٱلسَّعِيرِ
ayahs.sahih: And they will say, "If only we had been listening or reasoning, we would not be among the companions of the Blaze."
ayahs.clear: And they will say, “Had we listened or reasoned, we would not have been among the inmates of the Blaze.”
ayahs.kemenag: Dan mereka berkata: "Sekiranya kami mendengarkan atau memikirkan (peringatan itu) niscaya tidaklah kami termasuk penghuni-penghuni neraka yang menyala-nyala".

ayahs.arabic: فَٱعْتَرَفُوا۟ بِذَنۢبِهِمْ فَسُحْقًۭا لِّأَصْحَٰبِ ٱلسَّعِيرِ
ayahs.sahih: And they will admit their sin, so [it is] alienation for the companions of the Blaze.
ayahs.clear: So they will acknowledge their sins. So away with the inmates of the Blaze.
ayahs.kemenag: Mereka mengakui dosa mereka. Maka kebinasaanlah bagi penghuni-penghuni neraka yang menyala-nyala.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يَخْشَوْنَ رَبَّهُم بِٱلْغَيْبِ لَهُم مَّغْفِرَةٌۭ وَأَجْرٌۭ كَبِيرٌۭ
ayahs.sahih: Indeed, those who fear their Lord unseen will have forgiveness and great reward.
ayahs.clear: As for those who fear their Lord in secret—for them is forgiveness and a great reward.
ayahs.kemenag: Sesungguhnya orang-orang yang takut kepada Tuhannya Yang tidak nampak oleh mereka, mereka akan memperoleh ampunan dan pahala yang besar.

ayahs.arabic: وَأَسِرُّوا۟ قَوْلَكُمْ أَوِ ٱجْهَرُوا۟ بِهِۦٓ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ عَلِيمٌۢ بِذَاتِ ٱلصُّدُورِ
ayahs.sahih: And conceal your speech or publicize it; indeed, He is Knowing of that within the breasts.
ayahs.clear: Whether you keep your words secret, or declare them—He is Aware of the inner thoughts.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan rahasiakanlah perkataanmu atau lahirkanlah; sesungguhnya Dia Maha Mengetahui segala isi hati.

ayahs.arabic: أَلَا يَعْلَمُ مَنْ خَلَقَ وَهُوَ ٱللَّطِيفُ ٱلْخَبِيرُ
ayahs.sahih: Does He who created not know, while He is the Subtle, the Acquainted?
ayahs.clear: Would He not know, He Who created? He is the Refined, the Expert.
ayahs.kemenag: Apakah Allah Yang menciptakan itu tidak mengetahui (yang kamu lahirkan atau rahasiakan); dan Dia Maha Halus lagi Maha Mengetahui?

ayahs.arabic: هُوَ ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلْأَرْضَ ذَلُولًۭا فَٱمْشُوا۟ فِى مَنَاكِبِهَا وَكُلُوا۟ مِن رِّزْقِهِۦ ۖ وَإِلَيْهِ ٱلنُّشُورُ
ayahs.sahih: It is He who made the earth tame for you - so walk among its slopes and eat of His provision - and to Him is the resurrection.
ayahs.clear: It is He who made the earth manageable for you, so travel its regions, and eat of His provisions. To Him is the Resurgence.
ayahs.kemenag: Dialah Yang menjadikan bumi itu mudah bagi kamu, maka berjalanlah di segala penjurunya dan makanlah sebahagian dari rezeki-Nya. Dan hanya kepada-Nya-lah kamu (kembali setelah) dibangkitkan.

ayahs.arabic: ءَأَمِنتُم مَّن فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ أَن يَخْسِفَ بِكُمُ ٱلْأَرْضَ فَإِذَا هِىَ تَمُورُ
ayahs.sahih: Do you feel secure that He who [holds authority] in the heaven would not cause the earth to swallow you and suddenly it would sway?
ayahs.clear: Are you confident that the One in heaven will not cause the earth to collapse beneath you as it spins?
ayahs.kemenag: Apakah kamu merasa aman terhadap Allah yang (berkuasa) di langit bahwa Dia akan menjungkir balikkan bumi bersama kamu, sehingga dengan tiba-tiba bumi itu bergoncang?,

ayahs.arabic: أَمْ أَمِنتُم مَّن فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ أَن يُرْسِلَ عَلَيْكُمْ حَاصِبًۭا ۖ فَسَتَعْلَمُونَ كَيْفَ نَذِيرِ
ayahs.sahih: Or do you feel secure that He who [holds authority] in the heaven would not send against you a storm of stones? Then you would know how [severe] was My warning.
ayahs.clear: Or are you confident that the One in Heaven will not unleash against you a violent storm? Then you will know what My warning is like.
ayahs.kemenag: atau apakah kamu merasa aman terhadap Allah yang (berkuasa) di langit bahwa Dia akan mengirimkan badai yang berbatu. Maka kelak kamu akan mengetahui bagaimana (akibat mendustakan) peringatan-Ku?

ayahs.arabic: وَلَقَدْ كَذَّبَ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ فَكَيْفَ كَانَ نَكِيرِ
ayahs.sahih: And already had those before them denied, and how [terrible] was My reproach.
ayahs.clear: Those before them also denied the truth; and how was My disapproval?
ayahs.kemenag: Dan sesungguhnya orang-orang yang sebelum mereka telah mendustakan (rasul-rasul-Nya). Maka alangkah hebatnya kemurkaan-Ku.

ayahs.arabic: أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ إِلَى ٱلطَّيْرِ فَوْقَهُمْ صَٰٓفَّٰتٍۢ وَيَقْبِضْنَ ۚ مَا يُمْسِكُهُنَّ إِلَّا ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍۭ بَصِيرٌ
ayahs.sahih: Do they not see the birds above them with wings outspread and [sometimes] folded in? None holds them [aloft] except the Most Merciful. Indeed He is, of all things, Seeing.
ayahs.clear: Have they not seen the birds above them, spreading their wings, and folding them? None holds them except the Compassionate. He is Perceiver of everything.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan apakah mereka tidak memperhatikan burung-burung yang mengembangkan dan mengatupkan sayapnya di atas mereka? Tidak ada yang menahannya (di udara) selain Yang Maha Pemurah. Sesungguhnya Dia Maha Melihat segala sesuatu.

ayahs.arabic: أَمَّنْ هَٰذَا ٱلَّذِى هُوَ جُندٌۭ لَّكُمْ يَنصُرُكُم مِّن دُونِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ۚ إِنِ ٱلْكَٰفِرُونَ إِلَّا فِى غُرُورٍ
ayahs.sahih: Or who is it that could be an army for you to aid you other than the Most Merciful? The disbelievers are not but in delusion.
ayahs.clear: Or who is this who is a force for you to protect you against the Compassionate? The disbelievers are in nothing but delusion.
ayahs.kemenag: Atau siapakah dia yang menjadi tentara bagimu yang akan menolongmu selain daripada Allah Yang Maha Pemurah? Orang-orang kafir itu tidak lain hanyalah dalam (keadaan) tertipu.

ayahs.arabic: أَمَّنْ هَٰذَا ٱلَّذِى يَرْزُقُكُمْ إِنْ أَمْسَكَ رِزْقَهُۥ ۚ بَل لَّجُّوا۟ فِى عُتُوٍّۢ وَنُفُورٍ
ayahs.sahih: Or who is it that could provide for you if He withheld His provision? But they have persisted in insolence and aversion.
ayahs.clear: Or who is this that will provide for you, if He withholds His provision? Yet they persist in defiance and aversion.
ayahs.kemenag: Atau siapakah dia yang memberi kamu rezeki jika Allah menahan rezeki-Nya? Sebenarnya mereka terus menerus dalam kesombongan dan menjauhkan diri?

ayahs.arabic: أَفَمَن يَمْشِى مُكِبًّا عَلَىٰ وَجْهِهِۦٓ أَهْدَىٰٓ أَمَّن يَمْشِى سَوِيًّا عَلَىٰ صِرَٰطٍۢ مُّسْتَقِيمٍۢ
ayahs.sahih: Then is one who walks fallen on his face better guided or one who walks erect on a straight path?
ayahs.clear: Is he who walks bent on his own design better guided, or he who walks upright on a straight path?
ayahs.kemenag: Maka apakah orang yang berjalan terjungkal di atas mukanya itu lebih banyak mendapatkan petunjuk ataukah orang yang berjalan tegap di atas jalan yang lurus?

ayahs.arabic: قُلْ هُوَ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَنشَأَكُمْ وَجَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلسَّمْعَ وَٱلْأَبْصَٰرَ وَٱلْأَفْـِٔدَةَ ۖ قَلِيلًۭا مَّا تَشْكُرُونَ
ayahs.sahih: Say, "It is He who has produced you and made for you hearing and vision and hearts; little are you grateful."
ayahs.clear: Say, “It is He who produced you; and made for you the hearing, and the vision, and the organs. But rarely do you give thanks.”
ayahs.kemenag: Katakanlah: "Dialah Yang menciptakan kamu dan menjadikan bagi kamu pendengaran, penglihatan dan hati". (Tetapi) amat sedikit kamu bersyukur.

ayahs.arabic: قُلْ هُوَ ٱلَّذِى ذَرَأَكُمْ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَإِلَيْهِ تُحْشَرُونَ
ayahs.sahih: Say, "It is He who has multiplied you throughout the earth, and to Him you will be gathered."
ayahs.clear: Say, “It is He who scattered you on earth, and to Him you will be rounded up.”
ayahs.kemenag: Katakanlah: "Dialah Yang menjadikan kamu berkembang biak di muka bumi, dan hanya kepada-Nya-lah kamu kelak dikumpulkan".

ayahs.arabic: وَيَقُولُونَ مَتَىٰ هَٰذَا ٱلْوَعْدُ إِن كُنتُمْ صَٰدِقِينَ
ayahs.sahih: And they say, "When is this promise, if you should be truthful?"
ayahs.clear: And they say, “When will this promise be fulfilled, if you are truthful?”
ayahs.kemenag: Dan mereka berkata: "Kapankah datangnya ancaman itu jika kamu adalah orang-orang yang benar?"

ayahs.arabic: قُلْ إِنَّمَا ٱلْعِلْمُ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ وَإِنَّمَآ أَنَا۠ نَذِيرٌۭ مُّبِينٌۭ
ayahs.sahih: Say, "The knowledge is only with Allah, and I am only a clear warner."
ayahs.clear: Say, “Knowledge is with God, and I am only a clear warner.”
ayahs.kemenag: Katakanlah: "Sesungguhnya ilmu (tentang hari kiamat itu) hanya pada sisi Allah. Dan sesungguhnya aku hanyalah seorang pemberi peringatan yang menjelaskan".

ayahs.arabic: فَلَمَّا رَأَوْهُ زُلْفَةًۭ سِيٓـَٔتْ وُجُوهُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ وَقِيلَ هَٰذَا ٱلَّذِى كُنتُم بِهِۦ تَدَّعُونَ
ayahs.sahih: But when they see it approaching, the faces of those who disbelieve will be distressed, and it will be said, "This is that for which you used to call."
ayahs.clear: But when they see it approaching, the faces of those who disbelieved will turn gloomy, and it will be said, “This is what you used to call for.”
ayahs.kemenag: Ketika mereka melihat azab (pada hari kiamat) sudah dekat, muka orang-orang kafir itu menjadi muram. Dan dikatakan (kepada mereka) inilah (azab) yang dahulunya kamu selalu meminta-mintanya.

ayahs.arabic: قُلْ أَرَءَيْتُمْ إِنْ أَهْلَكَنِىَ ٱللَّهُ وَمَن مَّعِىَ أَوْ رَحِمَنَا فَمَن يُجِيرُ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ مِنْ عَذَابٍ أَلِيمٍۢ
ayahs.sahih: Say, [O Muhammad], "Have you considered: whether Allah should cause my death and those with me or have mercy upon us, who can protect the disbelievers from a painful punishment?"
ayahs.clear: Say, “Have you considered? Should God make me perish, and those with me; or else He bestows His mercy on us; who will protect the disbelievers from an agonizing torment?”
ayahs.kemenag: Katakanlah: "Terangkanlah kepadaku jika Allah mematikan aku dan orang-orang yang bersama dengan aku atau memberi rahmat kepada kami, (maka kami akan masuk surga), tetapi siapakah yang dapat melindungi orang-orang yang kafir dari siksa yang pedih?"

ayahs.arabic: قُلْ هُوَ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ ءَامَنَّا بِهِۦ وَعَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْنَا ۖ فَسَتَعْلَمُونَ مَنْ هُوَ فِى ضَلَٰلٍۢ مُّبِينٍۢ
ayahs.sahih: Say, "He is the Most Merciful; we have believed in Him, and upon Him we have relied. And you will [come to] know who it is that is in clear error."
ayahs.clear: Say, “He is the Compassionate. We have faith in Him, and in Him we trust. Soon you will know who is in evident error.”
ayahs.kemenag: Katakanlah: "Dialah Allah Yang Maha Penyayang kami beriman kepada-Nya dan kepada-Nya-lah kami bertawakkal. Kelak kamu akan mengetahui siapakah yang berada dalam kesesatan yang nyata".

ayahs.arabic: قُلْ أَرَءَيْتُمْ إِنْ أَصْبَحَ مَآؤُكُمْ غَوْرًۭا فَمَن يَأْتِيكُم بِمَآءٍۢ مَّعِينٍۭ
ayahs.sahih: Say, "Have you considered: if your water was to become sunken [into the earth], then who could bring you flowing water?"
ayahs.clear: Say, “Have you considered? If your water drains away, who will bring you pure running water?”
ayahs.kemenag: Katakanlah: "Terangkanlah kepadaku jika sumber air kamu menjadi kering; maka siapakah yang akan mendatangkan air yang mengalir bagimu?".

ayahs.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ نٓ ۚ وَٱلْقَلَمِ وَمَا يَسْطُرُونَ
ayahs.sahih: Nun. By the pen and what they inscribe,
ayahs.clear: Noon. By the pen, and by what they inscribe.
ayahs.kemenag: Nun, demi kalam dan apa yang mereka tulis,

ayahs.arabic: مَآ أَنتَ بِنِعْمَةِ رَبِّكَ بِمَجْنُونٍۢ
ayahs.sahih: You are not, [O Muhammad], by the favor of your Lord, a madman.
ayahs.clear: By the grace of your Lord, you are not insane.
ayahs.kemenag: berkat nikmat Tuhanmu kamu (Muhammad) sekali-kali bukan orang gila.

ayahs.arabic: وَإِنَّ لَكَ لَأَجْرًا غَيْرَ مَمْنُونٍۢ
ayahs.sahih: And indeed, for you is a reward uninterrupted.
ayahs.clear: In fact, you will have a reward that will never end.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan sesungguhnya bagi kamu benar-benar pahala yang besar yang tidak putus-putusnya.

ayahs.arabic: وَإِنَّكَ لَعَلَىٰ خُلُقٍ عَظِيمٍۢ
ayahs.sahih: And indeed, you are of a great moral character.
ayahs.clear: And you are of a great moral character.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan sesungguhnya kamu benar-benar berbudi pekerti yang agung.

ayahs.arabic: فَسَتُبْصِرُ وَيُبْصِرُونَ
ayahs.sahih: So you will see and they will see
ayahs.clear: You will see, and they will see.
ayahs.kemenag: Maka kelak kamu akan melihat dan mereka (orang-orang kafir)pun akan melihat,

ayahs.arabic: بِأَييِّكُمُ ٱلْمَفْتُونُ
ayahs.sahih: Which of you is the afflicted [by a devil].
ayahs.clear: Which of you is the afflicted.
ayahs.kemenag: siapa di antara kamu yang gila.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَن ضَلَّ عَن سَبِيلِهِۦ وَهُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِٱلْمُهْتَدِينَ
ayahs.sahih: Indeed, your Lord is most knowing of who has gone astray from His way, and He is most knowing of the [rightly] guided.
ayahs.clear: Your Lord knows best who has strayed from His path, and He knows best the well-guided.
ayahs.kemenag: Sesungguhnya Tuhanmu, Dialah Yang Paling Mengetahui siapa yang sesat dari jalan-Nya; dan Dialah Yang Paling Mengetahui orang-orang yang mendapat petunjuk.

ayahs.arabic: فَلَا تُطِعِ ٱلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
ayahs.sahih: Then do not obey the deniers.
ayahs.clear: So do not obey the deniers.
ayahs.kemenag: Maka janganlah kamu ikuti orang-orang yang mendustakan (ayat-ayat Allah).

ayahs.arabic: وَدُّوا۟ لَوْ تُدْهِنُ فَيُدْهِنُونَ
ayahs.sahih: They wish that you would soften [in your position], so they would soften [toward you].
ayahs.clear: They would like you to compromise, so they would compromise.
ayahs.kemenag: Maka mereka menginginkan supaya kamu bersikap lunak lalu mereka bersikap lunak (pula kepadamu).

ayahs.arabic: وَلَا تُطِعْ كُلَّ حَلَّافٍۢ مَّهِينٍ
ayahs.sahih: And do not obey every worthless habitual swearer
ayahs.clear: And do not obey any vile swearer.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan janganlah kamu ikuti setiap orang yang banyak bersumpah lagi hina,

ayahs.arabic: هَمَّازٍۢ مَّشَّآءٍۭ بِنَمِيمٍۢ
ayahs.sahih: [And] scorner, going about with malicious gossip -
ayahs.clear: Backbiter, spreader of slander.
ayahs.kemenag: yang banyak mencela, yang kian ke mari menghambur fitnah,

ayahs.arabic: مَّنَّاعٍۢ لِّلْخَيْرِ مُعْتَدٍ أَثِيمٍ
ayahs.sahih: A preventer of good, transgressing and sinful,
ayahs.clear: Preventer of good, transgressor, sinner.
ayahs.kemenag: yang banyak menghalangi perbuatan baik, yang melampaui batas lagi banyak dosa,

ayahs.arabic: عُتُلٍّۭ بَعْدَ ذَٰلِكَ زَنِيمٍ
ayahs.sahih: Cruel, moreover, and an illegitimate pretender.
ayahs.clear: Rude and fake besides.
ayahs.kemenag: yang kaku kasar, selain dari itu, yang terkenal kejahatannya,

ayahs.arabic: أَن كَانَ ذَا مَالٍۢ وَبَنِينَ
ayahs.sahih: Because he is a possessor of wealth and children,
ayahs.clear: Just because he has money and children.
ayahs.kemenag: karena dia mempunyai (banyak) harta dan anak.

ayahs.arabic: إِذَا تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِ ءَايَٰتُنَا قَالَ أَسَٰطِيرُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
ayahs.sahih: When Our verses are recited to him, he says, "Legends of the former peoples."
ayahs.clear: When Our Verses are recited to him, he says, “Myths of the ancients!”
ayahs.kemenag: Apabila dibacakan kepadanya ayat-ayat Kami, ia berkata: "(Ini adalah) dongeng-dongengan orang-orang dahulu kala".

ayahs.arabic: سَنَسِمُهُۥ عَلَى ٱلْخُرْطُومِ
ayahs.sahih: We will brand him upon the snout.
ayahs.clear: We will brand him on the muzzle.
ayahs.kemenag: Kelak akan Kami beri tanda dia di belalai(nya).

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّا بَلَوْنَٰهُمْ كَمَا بَلَوْنَآ أَصْحَٰبَ ٱلْجَنَّةِ إِذْ أَقْسَمُوا۟ لَيَصْرِمُنَّهَا مُصْبِحِينَ
ayahs.sahih: Indeed, We have tried them as We tried the companions of the garden, when they swore to cut its fruit in the [early] morning
ayahs.clear: We tested them, as We tested the owners of the garden, when they vowed to harvest it in the morning.
ayahs.kemenag: Sesungguhnya Kami telah mencobai mereka (musyrikin Mekah) sebagaimana Kami telah mencobai pemilik-pemilik kebun, ketika mereka bersumpah bahwa mereka sungguh-sungguh akanmemetik (hasil)nya di pagi hari,

ayahs.arabic: وَلَا يَسْتَثْنُونَ
ayahs.sahih: Without making exception.
ayahs.clear: Without any reservation.
ayahs.kemenag: dan mereka tidak menyisihkan (hak fakir miskin),

ayahs.arabic: فَطَافَ عَلَيْهَا طَآئِفٌۭ مِّن رَّبِّكَ وَهُمْ نَآئِمُونَ
ayahs.sahih: So there came upon the garden an affliction from your Lord while they were asleep.
ayahs.clear: But a calamity from your Lord went around it while they slept.
ayahs.kemenag: lalu kebun itu diliputi malapetaka (yang datang) dari Tuhanmu ketika mereka sedang tidur,

ayahs.arabic: فَأَصْبَحَتْ كَٱلصَّرِيمِ
ayahs.sahih: And it became as though reaped.
ayahs.clear: And in the morning it was as if picked.
ayahs.kemenag: maka jadilah kebun itu hitam seperti malam yang gelap gulita.

ayahs.arabic: فَتَنَادَوْا۟ مُصْبِحِينَ
ayahs.sahih: And they called one another at morning,
ayahs.clear: In the morning, they called to one another.
ayahs.kemenag: lalu mereka panggil memanggil di pagi hari:

ayahs.arabic: أَنِ ٱغْدُوا۟ عَلَىٰ حَرْثِكُمْ إِن كُنتُمْ صَٰرِمِينَ
ayahs.sahih: [Saying], "Go early to your crop if you would cut the fruit."
ayahs.clear: “Go early to your plantation, if you are going to harvest.”
ayahs.kemenag: "Pergilah diwaktu pagi (ini) ke kebunmu jika kamu hendak memetik buahnya".

ayahs.arabic: فَٱنطَلَقُوا۟ وَهُمْ يَتَخَٰفَتُونَ
ayahs.sahih: So they set out, while lowering their voices,
ayahs.clear: So off they went, murmuring to one another.
ayahs.kemenag: Maka pergilah mereka saling berbisik-bisik.

ayahs.arabic: أَن لَّا يَدْخُلَنَّهَا ٱلْيَوْمَ عَلَيْكُم مِّسْكِينٌۭ
ayahs.sahih: [Saying], "There will surely not enter it today upon you [any] poor person."
ayahs.clear: “No poor person is to enter it upon you today.”
ayahs.kemenag: "Pada hari ini janganlah ada seorang miskinpun masuk ke dalam kebunmu".

ayahs.arabic: وَغَدَوْا۟ عَلَىٰ حَرْدٍۢ قَٰدِرِينَ
ayahs.sahih: And they went early in determination, [assuming themselves] able.
ayahs.clear: And early they went, resolved in intent.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan berangkatlah mereka di pagi hari dengan niat menghalangi (orang-orang miskin) padahal mereka (menolongnya).

ayahs.arabic: فَلَمَّا رَأَوْهَا قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّا لَضَآلُّونَ
ayahs.sahih: But when they saw it, they said, "Indeed, we are lost;
ayahs.clear: But when they saw it, they said, “We were wrong.
ayahs.kemenag: Tatkala mereka melihat kebun itu, mereka berkata: "Sesungguhnya kita benar-benar orang-orang yang sesat (jalan),

ayahs.arabic: بَلْ نَحْنُ مَحْرُومُونَ
ayahs.sahih: Rather, we have been deprived."
ayahs.clear: We are now deprived.”
ayahs.kemenag: bahkan kita dihalangi (dari memperoleh hasilnya)".

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ أَوْسَطُهُمْ أَلَمْ أَقُل لَّكُمْ لَوْلَا تُسَبِّحُونَ
ayahs.sahih: The most moderate of them said, "Did I not say to you, 'Why do you not exalt [Allah]?' "
ayahs.clear: The most reasonable of them said, “Did I not say to you, ‘if only you would glorify?’”
ayahs.kemenag: Berkatalah seorang yang paling baik pikirannya di antara mereka: "Bukankah aku telah mengatakan kepadamu, hendaklah kamu bertasbih (kepada Tuhanmu)?"

ayahs.arabic: قَالُوا۟ سُبْحَٰنَ رَبِّنَآ إِنَّا كُنَّا ظَٰلِمِينَ
ayahs.sahih: They said, "Exalted is our Lord! Indeed, we were wrongdoers."
ayahs.clear: They said, “Glory to our Lord—We were indeed in the wrong.”
ayahs.kemenag: Mereka mengucapkan: "Maha Suci Tuhan kami, sesungguhnya kami adalah orang-orang yang zalim".

ayahs.arabic: فَأَقْبَلَ بَعْضُهُمْ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍۢ يَتَلَٰوَمُونَ
ayahs.sahih: Then they approached one another, blaming each other.
ayahs.clear: Then they turned to one another, blaming one another.
ayahs.kemenag: Lalu sebahagian mereka menghadapi sebahagian yang lain seraya cela mencela.

ayahs.arabic: قَالُوا۟ يَٰوَيْلَنَآ إِنَّا كُنَّا طَٰغِينَ
ayahs.sahih: They said, "O woe to us; indeed we were transgressors.
ayahs.clear: They said, “Woe to us—we were indeed domineering.
ayahs.kemenag: Mereka berkata: "Aduhai celakalah kita; sesungguhnya kita ini adalah orang-orang yang melampaui batas".

ayahs.arabic: عَسَىٰ رَبُّنَآ أَن يُبْدِلَنَا خَيْرًۭا مِّنْهَآ إِنَّآ إِلَىٰ رَبِّنَا رَٰغِبُونَ
ayahs.sahih: Perhaps our Lord will substitute for us [one] better than it. Indeed, we are toward our Lord desirous."
ayahs.clear: Perhaps our Lord will give us a better substitute for it. We are turning to our Lord.”
ayahs.kemenag: Mudah-mudahan Tuhan kita memberikan ganti kepada kita dengan (kebun) yang lebih baik daripada itu; sesungguhnya kita mengharapkan ampunan dari Tuhan kita.

ayahs.arabic: كَذَٰلِكَ ٱلْعَذَابُ ۖ وَلَعَذَابُ ٱلْءَاخِرَةِ أَكْبَرُ ۚ لَوْ كَانُوا۟ يَعْلَمُونَ
ayahs.sahih: Such is the punishment [of this world]. And the punishment of the Hereafter is greater, if they only knew.
ayahs.clear: Such is the punishment; but the punishment of the Hereafter is greater, if they only knew.
ayahs.kemenag: Seperti itulah azab (dunia). Dan sesungguhnya azab akhirat lebih besar jika mereka mengetahui.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ جَنَّٰتِ ٱلنَّعِيمِ
ayahs.sahih: Indeed, for the righteous with their Lord are the Gardens of Pleasure.
ayahs.clear: For the righteous are Gardens of Delight with their Lord.
ayahs.kemenag: Sesungguhnya bagi orang-orang yang bertakwa (disediakan) surga-surga yang penuh kenikmatan di sisi Tuhannya.

ayahs.arabic: أَفَنَجْعَلُ ٱلْمُسْلِمِينَ كَٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ
ayahs.sahih: Then will We treat the Muslims like the criminals?
ayahs.clear: Shall We treat the Muslims like the villains?
ayahs.kemenag: Maka apakah patut Kami menjadikan orang-orang Islam itu sama dengan orang-orang yang berdosa (orang kafir)?

ayahs.arabic: مَا لَكُمْ كَيْفَ تَحْكُمُونَ
ayahs.sahih: What is [the matter] with you? How do you judge?
ayahs.clear: What is the matter with you? How do you judge?
ayahs.kemenag: Atau adakah kamu (berbuat demikian): bagaimanakah kamu mengambil keputusan?

ayahs.arabic: أَمْ لَكُمْ كِتَٰبٌۭ فِيهِ تَدْرُسُونَ
ayahs.sahih: Or do you have a scripture in which you learn
ayahs.clear: Or do you have a scripture in which you study.
ayahs.kemenag: Atau adakah kamu mempunyai sebuah kitab (yang diturunkan Allah) yang kamu membacanya?,

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ لَكُمْ فِيهِ لَمَا تَخَيَّرُونَ
ayahs.sahih: That indeed for you is whatever you choose?
ayahs.clear: Wherein there is whatever you choose?
ayahs.kemenag: bahwa di dalamnya kamu benar-benar boleh memilih apa yang kamu sukai untukmu.

ayahs.arabic: أَمْ لَكُمْ أَيْمَٰنٌ عَلَيْنَا بَٰلِغَةٌ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ ۙ إِنَّ لَكُمْ لَمَا تَحْكُمُونَ
ayahs.sahih: Or do you have oaths [binding] upon Us, extending until the Day of Resurrection, that indeed for you is whatever you judge?
ayahs.clear: Or do you have oaths from Us, binding until the Day of Resurrection, that you will have whatever you demand?
ayahs.kemenag: Atau apakah kamu memperoleh janji yang diperkuat dengan sumpah dari Kami, yang tetap berlaku sampai hari kiamat; sesungguhnya kamu benar-benar dapat mengambil keputusan (sekehendakmu)?

ayahs.arabic: سَلْهُمْ أَيُّهُم بِذَٰلِكَ زَعِيمٌ
ayahs.sahih: Ask them which of them, for that [claim], is responsible.
ayahs.clear: Ask them, which of them will guarantee that.
ayahs.kemenag: Tanyakanlah kepada mereka: "Siapakah di antara mereka yang bertanggung jawab terhadap keputusan yang diambil itu?"

ayahs.arabic: أَمْ لَهُمْ شُرَكَآءُ فَلْيَأْتُوا۟ بِشُرَكَآئِهِمْ إِن كَانُوا۟ صَٰدِقِينَ
ayahs.sahih: Or do they have partners? Then let them bring their partners, if they should be truthful.
ayahs.clear: Or do they have partners? Then let them produce their partners, if they are truthful.
ayahs.kemenag: Atau apakah mereka mempunyai sekutu-sekutu? Maka hendaklah mereka mendatangkan sekutu-sekutunya jika mereka adalah orang-orang yang benar.

ayahs.arabic: يَوْمَ يُكْشَفُ عَن سَاقٍۢ وَيُدْعَوْنَ إِلَى ٱلسُّجُودِ فَلَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ
ayahs.sahih: The Day the shin will be uncovered and they are invited to prostration but the disbelievers will not be able,
ayahs.clear: On the Day when the Shin will be exposed, and they will be called to bow down, but they will be unable.
ayahs.kemenag: Pada hari betis disingkapkan dan mereka dipanggil untuk bersujud; maka mereka tidak kuasa,

ayahs.arabic: خَٰشِعَةً أَبْصَٰرُهُمْ تَرْهَقُهُمْ ذِلَّةٌۭ ۖ وَقَدْ كَانُوا۟ يُدْعَوْنَ إِلَى ٱلسُّجُودِ وَهُمْ سَٰلِمُونَ
ayahs.sahih: Their eyes humbled, humiliation will cover them. And they used to be invited to prostration while they were sound.
ayahs.clear: Their eyes subdued, shame will cover them. They were invited to bow down when they were sound.
ayahs.kemenag: (dalam keadaan) pandangan mereka tunduk ke bawah, lagi mereka diliputi kehinaan. Dan sesungguhnya mereka dahulu (di dunia) diseru untuk bersujud, dan mereka dalam keadaan sejahtera.

ayahs.arabic: فَذَرْنِى وَمَن يُكَذِّبُ بِهَٰذَا ٱلْحَدِيثِ ۖ سَنَسْتَدْرِجُهُم مِّنْ حَيْثُ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
ayahs.sahih: So leave Me, [O Muhammad], with [the matter of] whoever denies the Qur'an. We will progressively lead them [to punishment] from where they do not know.
ayahs.clear: So leave Me to those who reject this discourse; We will proceed against them gradually, from where they do not know.
ayahs.kemenag: Maka serahkanlah (ya Muhammad) kepada-Ku (urusan) orang-orang yang mendustakan perkataan ini (Al Quran). Nanti Kami akan menarik mereka dengan berangsur-angsur (ke arah kebinasaan) dari arah yang tidak mereka ketahui,

ayahs.arabic: وَأُمْلِى لَهُمْ ۚ إِنَّ كَيْدِى مَتِينٌ
ayahs.sahih: And I will give them time. Indeed, My plan is firm.
ayahs.clear: And I will give them respite. My plan is firm.
ayahs.kemenag: dan Aku memberi tangguh kepada mereka. Sesungguhnya rencana-Ku amat tangguh.

ayahs.arabic: أَمْ تَسْـَٔلُهُمْ أَجْرًۭا فَهُم مِّن مَّغْرَمٍۢ مُّثْقَلُونَ
ayahs.sahih: Or do you ask of them a payment, so they are by debt burdened down?
ayahs.clear: Or do you ask them for a fee, so they are burdened with debt?
ayahs.kemenag: Apakah kamu meminta upah kepada mereka, lalu mereka diberati dengan hutang?

ayahs.arabic: أَمْ عِندَهُمُ ٱلْغَيْبُ فَهُمْ يَكْتُبُونَ
ayahs.sahih: Or have they [knowledge of] the unseen, so they write [it] down?
ayahs.clear: Or do they know the future, and so they write it down?
ayahs.kemenag: Ataukah ada pada mereka ilmu tentang yang ghaib lalu mereka menulis (padanya apa yang mereka tetapkan)?

ayahs.arabic: فَٱصْبِرْ لِحُكْمِ رَبِّكَ وَلَا تَكُن كَصَاحِبِ ٱلْحُوتِ إِذْ نَادَىٰ وَهُوَ مَكْظُومٌۭ
ayahs.sahih: Then be patient for the decision of your Lord, [O Muhammad], and be not like the companion of the fish when he called out while he was distressed.
ayahs.clear: So wait patiently for the Decision of your Lord, and do not be like the Fellow of the Fish who cried out in despair.
ayahs.kemenag: Maka bersabarlah kamu (hai Muhammad) terhadap ketetapan Tuhanmu, dan janganlah kamu seperti orang yang berada dalam (perut) ikan ketika ia berdoa sedang ia dalam keadaan marah (kepada kaumnya).

ayahs.arabic: لَّوْلَآ أَن تَدَٰرَكَهُۥ نِعْمَةٌۭ مِّن رَّبِّهِۦ لَنُبِذَ بِٱلْعَرَآءِ وَهُوَ مَذْمُومٌۭ
ayahs.sahih: If not that a favor from his Lord overtook him, he would have been thrown onto the naked shore while he was censured.
ayahs.clear: Were it not for his Lord’s favor that reached him, he would have been thrown into the wilderness, fully despised.
ayahs.kemenag: Kalau sekiranya ia tidak segera mendapat nikmat dari Tuhannya, benar-benar ia dicampakkan ke tanah tandus dalam keadaan tercela.

ayahs.arabic: فَٱجْتَبَٰهُ رَبُّهُۥ فَجَعَلَهُۥ مِنَ ٱلصَّٰلِحِينَ
ayahs.sahih: And his Lord chose him and made him of the righteous.
ayahs.clear: But his Lord chose him, and made him one of the righteous.
ayahs.kemenag: Lalu Tuhannya memilihnya dan menjadikannya termasuk orang-orang yang saleh.

ayahs.arabic: وَإِن يَكَادُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لَيُزْلِقُونَكَ بِأَبْصَٰرِهِمْ لَمَّا سَمِعُوا۟ ٱلذِّكْرَ وَيَقُولُونَ إِنَّهُۥ لَمَجْنُونٌۭ
ayahs.sahih: And indeed, those who disbelieve would almost make you slip with their eyes when they hear the message, and they say, "Indeed, he is mad."
ayahs.clear: Those who disbelieve almost stab you with their glances when they hear the message, and say, “He is crazy!”
ayahs.kemenag: Dan sesungguhnya orang-orang kafir itu benar-benar hampir menggelincirkan kamu dengan pandangan mereka, tatkala mereka mendengar Al Quran dan mereka berkata: "Sesungguhnya ia (Muhammad) benar-benar orang yang gila".

ayahs.arabic: وَمَا هُوَ إِلَّا ذِكْرٌۭ لِّلْعَٰلَمِينَ
ayahs.sahih: But it is not except a reminder to the worlds.
ayahs.clear: But it is no less than a reminder to all the Worlds.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan Al Quran itu tidak lain hanyalah peringatan bagi seluruh umat.

ayahs.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ ٱلْحَآقَّةُ
ayahs.sahih: The Inevitable Reality -
ayahs.clear: The Reality.
ayahs.kemenag: Hari kiamat,

ayahs.arabic: مَا ٱلْحَآقَّةُ
ayahs.sahih: What is the Inevitable Reality?
ayahs.clear: What is the Reality?
ayahs.kemenag: apakah hari kiamat itu?

ayahs.arabic: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا ٱلْحَآقَّةُ
ayahs.sahih: And what can make you know what is the Inevitable Reality?
ayahs.clear: What will make you understand what the Reality is?
ayahs.kemenag: Dan tahukah kamu apakah hari kiamat itu?

ayahs.arabic: كَذَّبَتْ ثَمُودُ وَعَادٌۢ بِٱلْقَارِعَةِ
ayahs.sahih: Thamud and 'Aad denied the Striking Calamity.
ayahs.clear: Thamood and Aad denied the Catastrophe.
ayahs.kemenag: Kaum Tsamud dan 'Aad telah mendustakan hari kiamat.

ayahs.arabic: فَأَمَّا ثَمُودُ فَأُهْلِكُوا۟ بِٱلطَّاغِيَةِ
ayahs.sahih: So as for Thamud, they were destroyed by the overpowering [blast].
ayahs.clear: As for Thamood, they were annihilated by the Overwhelming.
ayahs.kemenag: Adapun kaum Tsamud, maka mereka telah dibinasakan dengan kejadian yang luar biasa.

ayahs.arabic: وَأَمَّا عَادٌۭ فَأُهْلِكُوا۟ بِرِيحٍۢ صَرْصَرٍ عَاتِيَةٍۢ
ayahs.sahih: And as for 'Aad, they were destroyed by a screaming, violent wind
ayahs.clear: And as for Aad; they were annihilated by a furious, roaring wind.
ayahs.kemenag: Adapun kaum 'Aad maka mereka telah dibinasakan dengan angin yang sangat dingin lagi amat kencang,

ayahs.arabic: سَخَّرَهَا عَلَيْهِمْ سَبْعَ لَيَالٍۢ وَثَمَٰنِيَةَ أَيَّامٍ حُسُومًۭا فَتَرَى ٱلْقَوْمَ فِيهَا صَرْعَىٰ كَأَنَّهُمْ أَعْجَازُ نَخْلٍ خَاوِيَةٍۢ
ayahs.sahih: Which Allah imposed upon them for seven nights and eight days in succession, so you would see the people therein fallen as if they were hollow trunks of palm trees.
ayahs.clear: He unleashed it upon them for seven nights and eight days, in succession. You could see the people tossed around, as though they were stumps of hollow palm-trees.
ayahs.kemenag: yang Allah menimpakan angin itu kepada mereka selama tujuh malam dan delapan hari terus menerus; maka kamu lihat kaum 'Aad pada waktu itu mati bergelimpangan seakan-akan mereka tunggul pohon kurma yang telah kosong (lapuk).

ayahs.arabic: فَهَلْ تَرَىٰ لَهُم مِّنۢ بَاقِيَةٍۢ
ayahs.sahih: Then do you see of them any remains?
ayahs.clear: Can you see any remnant of them?
ayahs.kemenag: Maka kamu tidak melihat seorangpun yang tinggal di antara mereka.

ayahs.arabic: وَجَآءَ فِرْعَوْنُ وَمَن قَبْلَهُۥ وَٱلْمُؤْتَفِكَٰتُ بِٱلْخَاطِئَةِ
ayahs.sahih: And there came Pharaoh and those before him and the overturned cities with sin.
ayahs.clear: Then Pharaoh came, and those before him, and the Overturned Cities steeped in sin.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan telah datang Fir'aun dan orang-orang yang sebelumnya dan (penduduk) negeri-negeri yang dijungkir balikkan karena kesalahan yang besar.

ayahs.arabic: فَعَصَوْا۟ رَسُولَ رَبِّهِمْ فَأَخَذَهُمْ أَخْذَةًۭ رَّابِيَةً
ayahs.sahih: And they disobeyed the messenger of their Lord, so He seized them with a seizure exceeding [in severity].
ayahs.clear: But they disobeyed the messenger of their Lord, so He seized them with an overpowering grip.
ayahs.kemenag: Maka (masing-masing) mereka mendurhakai rasul Tuhan mereka, lalu Allah menyiksa mereka dengan siksaan yang sangat keras.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّا لَمَّا طَغَا ٱلْمَآءُ حَمَلْنَٰكُمْ فِى ٱلْجَارِيَةِ
ayahs.sahih: Indeed, when the water overflowed, We carried your ancestors in the sailing ship
ayahs.clear: When the waters overflowed, We carried you in the cruising ship.
ayahs.kemenag: Sesungguhnya Kami, tatkala air telah naik (sampai ke gunung) Kami bawa (nenek moyang) kamu, ke dalam bahtera,

ayahs.arabic: لِنَجْعَلَهَا لَكُمْ تَذْكِرَةًۭ وَتَعِيَهَآ أُذُنٌۭ وَٰعِيَةٌۭ
ayahs.sahih: That We might make it for you a reminder and [that] a conscious ear would be conscious of it.
ayahs.clear: To make it a lesson for you—so that retaining ears may retain it.
ayahs.kemenag: agar Kami jadikan peristiwa itu peringatan bagi kamu dan agar diperhatikan oleh telinga yang mau mendengar.

ayahs.arabic: فَإِذَا نُفِخَ فِى ٱلصُّورِ نَفْخَةٌۭ وَٰحِدَةٌۭ
ayahs.sahih: Then when the Horn is blown with one blast
ayahs.clear: Then, when the Trumpet is sounded a single time.
ayahs.kemenag: Maka apabila sangkakala ditiup sekali tiup

ayahs.arabic: وَحُمِلَتِ ٱلْأَرْضُ وَٱلْجِبَالُ فَدُكَّتَا دَكَّةًۭ وَٰحِدَةًۭ
ayahs.sahih: And the earth and the mountains are lifted and leveled with one blow -
ayahs.clear: And the earth and the mountains are lifted up, and crushed, with a single crush.
ayahs.kemenag: dan diangkatlah bumi dan gunung-gunung, lalu dibenturkan keduanya sekali bentur.

ayahs.arabic: فَيَوْمَئِذٍۢ وَقَعَتِ ٱلْوَاقِعَةُ
ayahs.sahih: Then on that Day, the Resurrection will occur,
ayahs.clear: On that Day, the Event will come to pass.
ayahs.kemenag: Maka pada hari itu terjadilah hari kiamat,

ayahs.arabic: وَٱنشَقَّتِ ٱلسَّمَآءُ فَهِىَ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ وَاهِيَةٌۭ
ayahs.sahih: And the heaven will split [open], for that Day it is infirm.
ayahs.clear: And the heaven will crack; so on that Day it will be frail.
ayahs.kemenag: dan terbelahlah langit, karena pada hari itu langit menjadi lemah.

ayahs.arabic: وَٱلْمَلَكُ عَلَىٰٓ أَرْجَآئِهَا ۚ وَيَحْمِلُ عَرْشَ رَبِّكَ فَوْقَهُمْ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ ثَمَٰنِيَةٌۭ
ayahs.sahih: And the angels are at its edges. And there will bear the Throne of your Lord above them, that Day, eight [of them].
ayahs.clear: And the angels will be ranged around its borders, while eight will be carrying the Throne of your Lord above them that Day.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan malaikat-malaikat berada di penjuru-penjuru langit. Dan pada hari itu delapan orang malaikat menjunjung 'Arsy Tuhanmu di atas (kepala) mereka.

ayahs.arabic: يَوْمَئِذٍۢ تُعْرَضُونَ لَا تَخْفَىٰ مِنكُمْ خَافِيَةٌۭ
ayahs.sahih: That Day, you will be exhibited [for judgement]; not hidden among you is anything concealed.
ayahs.clear: On that Day you will be exposed, and no secret of yours will remain hidden.
ayahs.kemenag: Pada hari itu kamu dihadapkan (kepada Tuhanmu), tiada sesuatupun dari keadaanmu yang tersembunyi (bagi Allah).

ayahs.arabic: فَأَمَّا مَنْ أُوتِىَ كِتَٰبَهُۥ بِيَمِينِهِۦ فَيَقُولُ هَآؤُمُ ٱقْرَءُوا۟ كِتَٰبِيَهْ
ayahs.sahih: So as for he who is given his record in his right hand, he will say, "Here, read my record!
ayahs.clear: As for him who is given his book in his right hand, he will say, “Here, take my book and read it.
ayahs.kemenag: Adapun orang-orang yang diberikan kepadanya kitabnya dari sebelah kanannya, maka dia berkata: "Ambillah, bacalah kitabku (ini)".

ayahs.arabic: إِنِّى ظَنَنتُ أَنِّى مُلَٰقٍ حِسَابِيَهْ
ayahs.sahih: Indeed, I was certain that I would be meeting my account."
ayahs.clear: I knew I would be held accountable.”
ayahs.kemenag: Sesungguhnya aku yakin, bahwa sesungguhnya aku akan menemui hisab terhadap diriku.

ayahs.arabic: فَهُوَ فِى عِيشَةٍۢ رَّاضِيَةٍۢ
ayahs.sahih: So he will be in a pleasant life -
ayahs.clear: So he will be in pleasant living.
ayahs.kemenag: Maka orang itu berada dalam kehidupan yang diridhai,

ayahs.arabic: فِى جَنَّةٍ عَالِيَةٍۢ
ayahs.sahih: In an elevated garden,
ayahs.clear: In a lofty Garden.
ayahs.kemenag: dalam surga yang tinggi,

ayahs.arabic: قُطُوفُهَا دَانِيَةٌۭ
ayahs.sahih: Its [fruit] to be picked hanging near.
ayahs.clear: Its pickings are within reach.
ayahs.kemenag: buah-buahannya dekat,

ayahs.arabic: كُلُوا۟ وَٱشْرَبُوا۟ هَنِيٓـًٔۢا بِمَآ أَسْلَفْتُمْ فِى ٱلْأَيَّامِ ٱلْخَالِيَةِ
ayahs.sahih: [They will be told], "Eat and drink in satisfaction for what you put forth in the days past."
ayahs.clear: “Eat and drink merrily for what you did in the days gone by.”
ayahs.kemenag: (kepada mereka dikatakan): "Makan dan minumlah dengan sedap disebabkan amal yang telah kamu kerjakan pada hari-hari yang telah lalu".

ayahs.arabic: وَأَمَّا مَنْ أُوتِىَ كِتَٰبَهُۥ بِشِمَالِهِۦ فَيَقُولُ يَٰلَيْتَنِى لَمْ أُوتَ كِتَٰبِيَهْ
ayahs.sahih: But as for he who is given his record in his left hand, he will say, "Oh, I wish I had not been given my record
ayahs.clear: But as for him who is given his book in his left hand, he will say, “I wish I was never given my book.
ayahs.kemenag: Adapun orang yang diberikan kepadanya kitabnya dari sebelah kirinya, maka dia berkata: "Wahai alangkah baiknya kiranya tidak diberikan kepadaku kitabku (ini).

ayahs.arabic: وَلَمْ أَدْرِ مَا حِسَابِيَهْ
ayahs.sahih: And had not known what is my account.
ayahs.clear: And never knew what my account was.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan aku tidak mengetahui apa hisab terhadap diriku.

ayahs.arabic: يَٰلَيْتَهَا كَانَتِ ٱلْقَاضِيَةَ
ayahs.sahih: I wish my death had been the decisive one.
ayahs.clear: If only it was the end.
ayahs.kemenag: Wahai kiranya kematian itulah yang menyelesaikan segala sesuatu.

ayahs.arabic: مَآ أَغْنَىٰ عَنِّى مَالِيَهْ ۜ
ayahs.sahih: My wealth has not availed me.
ayahs.clear: My money cannot avail me.
ayahs.kemenag: Hartaku sekali-kali tidak memberi manfaat kepadaku.

ayahs.arabic: هَلَكَ عَنِّى سُلْطَٰنِيَهْ
ayahs.sahih: Gone from me is my authority."
ayahs.clear: My power has vanished from me.”
ayahs.kemenag: Telah hilang kekuasaanku daripadaku".

ayahs.arabic: خُذُوهُ فَغُلُّوهُ
ayahs.sahih: [Allah will say], "Seize him and shackle him.
ayahs.clear: “Take him and shackle him.
ayahs.kemenag: (Allah berfirman): "Peganglah dia lalu belenggulah tangannya ke lehernya.

ayahs.arabic: ثُمَّ ٱلْجَحِيمَ صَلُّوهُ
ayahs.sahih: Then into Hellfire drive him.
ayahs.clear: Then scorch him in the Blaze.
ayahs.kemenag: Kemudian masukkanlah dia ke dalam api neraka yang menyala-nyala.

ayahs.arabic: ثُمَّ فِى سِلْسِلَةٍۢ ذَرْعُهَا سَبْعُونَ ذِرَاعًۭا فَٱسْلُكُوهُ
ayahs.sahih: Then into a chain whose length is seventy cubits insert him."
ayahs.clear: Then in a chain which length is seventy cubits tie him up.
ayahs.kemenag: Kemudian belitlah dia dengan rantai yang panjangnya tujuh puluh hasta.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ لَا يُؤْمِنُ بِٱللَّهِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
ayahs.sahih: Indeed, he did not used to believe in Allah, the Most Great,
ayahs.clear: For he would not believe in God the Great.
ayahs.kemenag: Sesungguhnya dia dahulu tidak beriman kepada Allah Yang Maha Besar.

ayahs.arabic: وَلَا يَحُضُّ عَلَىٰ طَعَامِ ٱلْمِسْكِينِ
ayahs.sahih: Nor did he encourage the feeding of the poor.
ayahs.clear: Nor would he advocate the feeding of the destitute.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan juga dia tidak mendorong (orang lain) untuk memberi makan orang miskin.

ayahs.arabic: فَلَيْسَ لَهُ ٱلْيَوْمَ هَٰهُنَا حَمِيمٌۭ
ayahs.sahih: So there is not for him here this Day any devoted friend
ayahs.clear: So he has no friend here today.
ayahs.kemenag: Maka tiada seorang temanpun baginya pada hari ini di sini.

ayahs.arabic: وَلَا طَعَامٌ إِلَّا مِنْ غِسْلِينٍۢ
ayahs.sahih: Nor any food except from the discharge of wounds;
ayahs.clear: And no food except scum.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan tiada (pula) makanan sedikitpun (baginya) kecuali dari darah dan nanah.

ayahs.arabic: لَّا يَأْكُلُهُۥٓ إِلَّا ٱلْخَٰطِـُٔونَ
ayahs.sahih: None will eat it except the sinners.
ayahs.clear: Which only the sinners eat.”
ayahs.kemenag: Tidak ada yang memakannya kecuali orang-orang yang berdosa.

ayahs.arabic: فَلَآ أُقْسِمُ بِمَا تُبْصِرُونَ
ayahs.sahih: So I swear by what you see
ayahs.clear: Indeed, I swear by what you see.
ayahs.kemenag: Maka Aku bersumpah dengan apa yang kamu lihat.

ayahs.arabic: وَمَا لَا تُبْصِرُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And what you do not see
ayahs.clear: And by what you do not see.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan dengan apa yang tidak kamu lihat.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّهُۥ لَقَوْلُ رَسُولٍۢ كَرِيمٍۢ
ayahs.sahih: [That] indeed, the Qur'an is the word of a noble Messenger.
ayahs.clear: It is the speech of a noble messenger.
ayahs.kemenag: Sesungguhnya Al Quran itu adalah benar-benar wahyu (Allah yang diturunkan kepada) Rasul yang mulia,

ayahs.arabic: وَمَا هُوَ بِقَوْلِ شَاعِرٍۢ ۚ قَلِيلًۭا مَّا تُؤْمِنُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And it is not the word of a poet; little do you believe.
ayahs.clear: And it is not the speech of a poet—little do you believe.
ayahs.kemenag: dan Al Quran itu bukanlah perkataan seorang penyair. Sedikit sekali kamu beriman kepadanya.

ayahs.arabic: وَلَا بِقَوْلِ كَاهِنٍۢ ۚ قَلِيلًۭا مَّا تَذَكَّرُونَ
ayahs.sahih: Nor the word of a soothsayer; little do you remember.
ayahs.clear: Nor is it the speech of a soothsayer—little do you take heed.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan bukan pula perkataan tukang tenung. Sedikit sekali kamu mengambil pelajaran daripadanya.

ayahs.arabic: تَنزِيلٌۭ مِّن رَّبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
ayahs.sahih: [It is] a revelation from the Lord of the worlds.
ayahs.clear: It is a revelation from the Lord of the Worlds.
ayahs.kemenag: Ia adalah wahyu yang diturunkan dari Tuhan semesta alam.

ayahs.arabic: وَلَوْ تَقَوَّلَ عَلَيْنَا بَعْضَ ٱلْأَقَاوِيلِ
ayahs.sahih: And if Muhammad had made up about Us some [false] sayings,
ayahs.clear: Had he falsely attributed some statements to Us.
ayahs.kemenag: Seandainya dia (Muhammad) mengadakan sebagian perkataan atas (nama) Kami,

ayahs.arabic: لَأَخَذْنَا مِنْهُ بِٱلْيَمِينِ
ayahs.sahih: We would have seized him by the right hand;
ayahs.clear: We would have seized him by the right arm.
ayahs.kemenag: niscaya benar-benar Kami pegang dia pada tangan kanannya.

ayahs.arabic: ثُمَّ لَقَطَعْنَا مِنْهُ ٱلْوَتِينَ
ayahs.sahih: Then We would have cut from him the aorta.
ayahs.clear: Then slashed his lifeline.
ayahs.kemenag: Kemudian benar-benar Kami potong urat tali jantungnya.

ayahs.arabic: فَمَا مِنكُم مِّنْ أَحَدٍ عَنْهُ حَٰجِزِينَ
ayahs.sahih: And there is no one of you who could prevent [Us] from him.
ayahs.clear: And none of you could have restrained Us from him.
ayahs.kemenag: Maka sekali-kali tidak ada seorangpun dari kamu yang dapat menghalangi (Kami), dari pemotongan urat nadi itu.

ayahs.arabic: وَإِنَّهُۥ لَتَذْكِرَةٌۭ لِّلْمُتَّقِينَ
ayahs.sahih: And indeed, the Qur'an is a reminder for the righteous.
ayahs.clear: Surely, it is a message for the righteous.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan sesungguhnya Al Quran itu benar-benar suatu pelajaran bagi orang-orang yang bertakwa.

ayahs.arabic: وَإِنَّا لَنَعْلَمُ أَنَّ مِنكُم مُّكَذِّبِينَ
ayahs.sahih: And indeed, We know that among you are deniers.
ayahs.clear: And We know that some of you will reject it.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan sesungguhnya Kami benar-benar mengetahui bahwa di antara kamu ada orang yang mendustakan(nya).

ayahs.arabic: وَإِنَّهُۥ لَحَسْرَةٌ عَلَى ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ
ayahs.sahih: And indeed, it will be [a cause of] regret upon the disbelievers.
ayahs.clear: And it is surely a source of grief for the unbelievers.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan sesungguhnya Al Quran itu benar-benar menjadi penyesalan bagi orang-orang kafir (di akhirat).

ayahs.arabic: وَإِنَّهُۥ لَحَقُّ ٱلْيَقِينِ
ayahs.sahih: And indeed, it is the truth of certainty.
ayahs.clear: Yet it is the absolute truth.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan sesungguhnya Al Quran itu benar-benar kebenaran yang diyakini.

ayahs.arabic: فَسَبِّحْ بِٱسْمِ رَبِّكَ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
ayahs.sahih: So exalt the name of your Lord, the Most Great.
ayahs.clear: So glorify the name of your Lord, the Magnificent.
ayahs.kemenag: Maka bertasbihlah dengan (menyebut) nama Tuhanmu Yang Maha Besar.

ayahs.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ سَأَلَ سَآئِلٌۢ بِعَذَابٍۢ وَاقِعٍۢ
ayahs.sahih: A supplicant asked for a punishment bound to happen
ayahs.clear: A questioner questioned the imminent torment.
ayahs.kemenag: Seseorang telah meminta kedatangan azab yang akan menimpa,

ayahs.arabic: لِّلْكَٰفِرِينَ لَيْسَ لَهُۥ دَافِعٌۭ
ayahs.sahih: To the disbelievers; of it there is no preventer.
ayahs.clear: For the disbelievers; none can repel it.
ayahs.kemenag: orang-orang kafir, yang tidak seorangpun dapat menolaknya,

ayahs.arabic: مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ ذِى ٱلْمَعَارِجِ
ayahs.sahih: [It is] from Allah, owner of the ways of ascent.
ayahs.clear: From God, Lord of the Ways of Ascent.
ayahs.kemenag: (yang datang) dari Allah, Yang mempunyai tempat-tempat naik.

ayahs.arabic: تَعْرُجُ ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ وَٱلرُّوحُ إِلَيْهِ فِى يَوْمٍۢ كَانَ مِقْدَارُهُۥ خَمْسِينَ أَلْفَ سَنَةٍۢ
ayahs.sahih: The angels and the Spirit will ascend to Him during a Day the extent of which is fifty thousand years.
ayahs.clear: Unto Him the angels and the Spirit ascend on a Day the duration of which is fifty thousand years.
ayahs.kemenag: Malaikat-malaikat dan Jibril naik (menghadap) kepada Tuhan dalam sehari yang kadarnya limapuluh ribu tahun.

ayahs.arabic: فَٱصْبِرْ صَبْرًۭا جَمِيلًا
ayahs.sahih: So be patient with gracious patience.
ayahs.clear: So be patient, with sweet patience.
ayahs.kemenag: Maka bersabarlah kamu dengan sabar yang baik.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّهُمْ يَرَوْنَهُۥ بَعِيدًۭا
ayahs.sahih: Indeed, they see it [as] distant,
ayahs.clear: They see it distant.
ayahs.kemenag: Sesungguhnya mereka memandang siksaaan itu jauh (mustahil).

ayahs.arabic: وَنَرَىٰهُ قَرِيبًۭا
ayahs.sahih: But We see it [as] near.
ayahs.clear: But We see it near.
ayahs.kemenag: Sedangkan Kami memandangnya dekat (mungkin terjadi).

ayahs.arabic: يَوْمَ تَكُونُ ٱلسَّمَآءُ كَٱلْمُهْلِ
ayahs.sahih: On the Day the sky will be like murky oil,
ayahs.clear: On the Day when the sky will be like molten brass.
ayahs.kemenag: Pada hari ketika langit menjadi seperti luluhan perak,

ayahs.arabic: وَتَكُونُ ٱلْجِبَالُ كَٱلْعِهْنِ
ayahs.sahih: And the mountains will be like wool,
ayahs.clear: And the mountains will be like tufted wool.
ayahs.kemenag: dan gunung-gunung menjadi seperti bulu (yang berterbangan),

ayahs.arabic: وَلَا يَسْـَٔلُ حَمِيمٌ حَمِيمًۭا
ayahs.sahih: And no friend will ask [anything of] a friend,
ayahs.clear: No friend will care about his friend.
ayahs.kemenag: dan tidak ada seorang teman akrabpun menanyakan temannya,

ayahs.arabic: يُبَصَّرُونَهُمْ ۚ يَوَدُّ ٱلْمُجْرِمُ لَوْ يَفْتَدِى مِنْ عَذَابِ يَوْمِئِذٍۭ بِبَنِيهِ
ayahs.sahih: They will be shown each other. The criminal will wish that he could be ransomed from the punishment of that Day by his children
ayahs.clear: They will be shown each other. The criminal wishes he would be redeemed from the punishment of that Day by his children.
ayahs.kemenag: sedang mereka saling memandang. Orang kafir ingin kalau sekiranya dia dapat menebus (dirinya) dari azab hari itu dengan anak-anaknya,

ayahs.arabic: وَصَٰحِبَتِهِۦ وَأَخِيهِ
ayahs.sahih: And his wife and his brother
ayahs.clear: And his spouse, and his brother.
ayahs.kemenag: dan isterinya dan saudaranya,

ayahs.arabic: وَفَصِيلَتِهِ ٱلَّتِى تُـْٔوِيهِ
ayahs.sahih: And his nearest kindred who shelter him
ayahs.clear: And his family that sheltered him.
ayahs.kemenag: dan kaum familinya yang melindunginya (di dunia).

ayahs.arabic: وَمَن فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ جَمِيعًۭا ثُمَّ يُنجِيهِ
ayahs.sahih: And whoever is on earth entirely [so] then it could save him.
ayahs.clear: And everyone on earth, in order to save him.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan orang-orang di atas bumi seluruhnya kemudian (mengharapkan) tebusan itu dapat menyelamatkannya.

ayahs.arabic: كَلَّآ ۖ إِنَّهَا لَظَىٰ
ayahs.sahih: No! Indeed, it is the Flame [of Hell],
ayahs.clear: By no means! It is a Raging Fire.
ayahs.kemenag: Sekali-kali tidak dapat, sesungguhnya neraka itu adalah api yang bergolak,

ayahs.arabic: نَزَّاعَةًۭ لِّلشَّوَىٰ
ayahs.sahih: A remover of exteriors.
ayahs.clear: It strips away the scalps.
ayahs.kemenag: yang mengelupas kulit kepala,

ayahs.arabic: تَدْعُوا۟ مَنْ أَدْبَرَ وَتَوَلَّىٰ
ayahs.sahih: It invites he who turned his back [on truth] and went away [from obedience]
ayahs.clear: It invites him who once turned his back and fled.
ayahs.kemenag: yang memanggil orang yang membelakang dan yang berpaling (dari agama),

ayahs.arabic: وَجَمَعَ فَأَوْعَىٰٓ
ayahs.sahih: And collected [wealth] and hoarded.
ayahs.clear: And accumulated and hoarded.
ayahs.kemenag: serta mengumpulkan (harta benda) lalu menyimpannya.

ayahs.arabic: ۞ إِنَّ ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ خُلِقَ هَلُوعًا
ayahs.sahih: Indeed, mankind was created anxious:
ayahs.clear: Man was created restless.
ayahs.kemenag: Sesungguhnya manusia diciptakan bersifat keluh kesah lagi kikir.

ayahs.arabic: إِذَا مَسَّهُ ٱلشَّرُّ جَزُوعًۭا
ayahs.sahih: When evil touches him, impatient,
ayahs.clear: Touched by adversity, he is fretful.
ayahs.kemenag: Apabila ia ditimpa kesusahan ia berkeluh kesah,

ayahs.arabic: وَإِذَا مَسَّهُ ٱلْخَيْرُ مَنُوعًا
ayahs.sahih: And when good touches him, withholding [of it],
ayahs.clear: Touched by good, he is ungenerous.
ayahs.kemenag: dan apabila ia mendapat kebaikan ia amat kikir,

ayahs.arabic: إِلَّا ٱلْمُصَلِّينَ
ayahs.sahih: Except the observers of prayer -
ayahs.clear: Except the prayerful.
ayahs.kemenag: kecuali orang-orang yang mengerjakan shalat,

ayahs.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ عَلَىٰ صَلَاتِهِمْ دَآئِمُونَ
ayahs.sahih: Those who are constant in their prayer
ayahs.clear: Those who are constant at their prayers.
ayahs.kemenag: yang mereka itu tetap mengerjakan shalatnya,

ayahs.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ فِىٓ أَمْوَٰلِهِمْ حَقٌّۭ مَّعْلُومٌۭ
ayahs.sahih: And those within whose wealth is a known right
ayahs.clear: And those in whose wealth is a rightful share.
ayahs.kemenag: dan orang-orang yang dalam hartanya tersedia bagian tertentu,

ayahs.arabic: لِّلسَّآئِلِ وَٱلْمَحْرُومِ
ayahs.sahih: For the petitioner and the deprived -
ayahs.clear: For the beggar and the deprived.
ayahs.kemenag: bagi orang (miskin) yang meminta dan orang yang tidak mempunyai apa-apa (yang tidak mau meminta),

ayahs.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ يُصَدِّقُونَ بِيَوْمِ ٱلدِّينِ
ayahs.sahih: And those who believe in the Day of Recompense
ayahs.clear: And those who affirm the Day of Judgment.
ayahs.kemenag: dan orang-orang yang mempercayai hari pembalasan,

ayahs.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُم مِّنْ عَذَابِ رَبِّهِم مُّشْفِقُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And those who are fearful of the punishment of their Lord -
ayahs.clear: And those who fear the punishment of their Lord.
ayahs.kemenag: dan orang-orang yang takut terhadap azab Tuhannya.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ عَذَابَ رَبِّهِمْ غَيْرُ مَأْمُونٍۢ
ayahs.sahih: Indeed, the punishment of their Lord is not that from which one is safe -
ayahs.clear: Their Lord’s punishment is not to be taken for granted.
ayahs.kemenag: Karena sesungguhnya azab Tuhan mereka tidak dapat orang merasa aman (dari kedatangannya).

ayahs.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ لِفُرُوجِهِمْ حَٰفِظُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And those who guard their private parts
ayahs.clear: And those who guard their chastity.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan orang-orang yang memelihara kemaluannya,

ayahs.arabic: إِلَّا عَلَىٰٓ أَزْوَٰجِهِمْ أَوْ مَا مَلَكَتْ أَيْمَٰنُهُمْ فَإِنَّهُمْ غَيْرُ مَلُومِينَ
ayahs.sahih: Except from their wives or those their right hands possess, for indeed, they are not to be blamed -
ayahs.clear: Except from their spouses or those living under their control, for then they are free of blame.
ayahs.kemenag: kecuali terhadap isteri-isteri mereka atau budak-budak yang mereka miliki, maka sesungguhnya mereka dalam hal ini tiada tercela.

ayahs.arabic: فَمَنِ ٱبْتَغَىٰ وَرَآءَ ذَٰلِكَ فَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْعَادُونَ
ayahs.sahih: But whoever seeks beyond that, then they are the transgressors -
ayahs.clear: But whoever seeks to go beyond that—these are the transgressors.
ayahs.kemenag: Barangsiapa mencari yang di balik itu, maka mereka itulah orang-orang yang melampaui batas.

ayahs.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ لِأَمَٰنَٰتِهِمْ وَعَهْدِهِمْ رَٰعُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And those who are to their trusts and promises attentive
ayahs.clear: And those who honor their trusts and their pledges.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan orang-orang yang memelihara amanat-amanat (yang dipikulnya) dan janjinya.

ayahs.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُم بِشَهَٰدَٰتِهِمْ قَآئِمُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And those who are in their testimonies upright
ayahs.clear: And those who stand by their testimonies.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan orang-orang yang memberikan kesaksiannya.

ayahs.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ عَلَىٰ صَلَاتِهِمْ يُحَافِظُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And those who [carefully] maintain their prayer:
ayahs.clear: And those who are dedicated to their prayers.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan orang-orang yang memelihara shalatnya.

ayahs.arabic: أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ فِى جَنَّٰتٍۢ مُّكْرَمُونَ
ayahs.sahih: They will be in gardens, honored.
ayahs.clear: These will be honored in Gardens.
ayahs.kemenag: Mereka itu (kekal) di surga lagi dimuliakan.

ayahs.arabic: فَمَالِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ قِبَلَكَ مُهْطِعِينَ
ayahs.sahih: So what is [the matter] with those who disbelieve, hastening [from] before you, [O Muhammad],
ayahs.clear: What is with those who disbelieve, stretching their necks towards you.
ayahs.kemenag: Mengapakah orang-orang kafir itu bersegera datang ke arahmu,

ayahs.arabic: عَنِ ٱلْيَمِينِ وَعَنِ ٱلشِّمَالِ عِزِينَ
ayahs.sahih: [To sit] on [your] right and [your] left in separate groups?
ayahs.clear: From the right, and from the left, banding together?
ayahs.kemenag: dari kanan dan dari kiri dengan berkelompok-kelompok.

ayahs.arabic: أَيَطْمَعُ كُلُّ ٱمْرِئٍۢ مِّنْهُمْ أَن يُدْخَلَ جَنَّةَ نَعِيمٍۢ
ayahs.sahih: Does every person among them aspire to enter a garden of pleasure?
ayahs.clear: Is every one of them aspiring to be admitted into a Garden of Bliss?
ayahs.kemenag: Adakah setiap orang dari orang-orang kafir itu ingin masuk ke dalam surga yang penuh kenikmatan?,

ayahs.arabic: كَلَّآ ۖ إِنَّا خَلَقْنَٰهُم مِّمَّا يَعْلَمُونَ
ayahs.sahih: No! Indeed, We have created them from that which they know.
ayahs.clear: No indeed! We created them from what they know.
ayahs.kemenag: sekali-kali tidak! Sesungguhnya Kami ciptakan mereka dari apa yang mereka ketahui (air mani).

ayahs.arabic: فَلَآ أُقْسِمُ بِرَبِّ ٱلْمَشَٰرِقِ وَٱلْمَغَٰرِبِ إِنَّا لَقَٰدِرُونَ
ayahs.sahih: So I swear by the Lord of [all] risings and settings that indeed We are able
ayahs.clear: I swear by the Lord of the Easts and the Wests, that We are Able.
ayahs.kemenag: Maka aku bersumpah dengan Tuhan Yang memiliki timur dan barat, sesungguhnya Kami benar-benar Maha Kuasa.

ayahs.arabic: عَلَىٰٓ أَن نُّبَدِّلَ خَيْرًۭا مِّنْهُمْ وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمَسْبُوقِينَ
ayahs.sahih: To replace them with better than them; and We are not to be outdone.
ayahs.clear: To replace them with better than they, and We are not to be outdone.
ayahs.kemenag: Untuk mengganti (mereka) dengan kaum yang lebih baik dari mereka, dan Kami sekali-kali tidak dapat dikalahkan.

ayahs.arabic: فَذَرْهُمْ يَخُوضُوا۟ وَيَلْعَبُوا۟ حَتَّىٰ يُلَٰقُوا۟ يَوْمَهُمُ ٱلَّذِى يُوعَدُونَ
ayahs.sahih: So leave them to converse vainly and amuse themselves until they meet their Day which they are promised -
ayahs.clear: So leave them to blunder and play, until they meet their Day which they are promised.
ayahs.kemenag: Maka biarkanlah mereka tenggelam (dalam kebatilan) dan bermain-main sampai mereka menjumpai hari yang diancamkan kepada mereka,

ayahs.arabic: يَوْمَ يَخْرُجُونَ مِنَ ٱلْأَجْدَاثِ سِرَاعًۭا كَأَنَّهُمْ إِلَىٰ نُصُبٍۢ يُوفِضُونَ
ayahs.sahih: The Day they will emerge from the graves rapidly as if they were, toward an erected idol, hastening.
ayahs.clear: The Day when they will emerge from the tombs in a rush, as though they were hurrying towards a target.
ayahs.kemenag: (yaitu) pada hari mereka keluar dari kubur dengan cepat seakan-akan mereka pergi dengan segera kepada berhala-berhala (sewaktu di dunia),

ayahs.arabic: خَٰشِعَةً أَبْصَٰرُهُمْ تَرْهَقُهُمْ ذِلَّةٌۭ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْيَوْمُ ٱلَّذِى كَانُوا۟ يُوعَدُونَ
ayahs.sahih: Their eyes humbled, humiliation will cover them. That is the Day which they had been promised.
ayahs.clear: Their eyes cast down; overwhelmed by humiliation. This is the Day which they were promised.
ayahs.kemenag: dalam keadaan mereka menekurkan pandangannya (serta) diliputi kehinaan. Itulah hari yang dahulunya diancamkan kepada mereka.

ayahs.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا نُوحًا إِلَىٰ قَوْمِهِۦٓ أَنْ أَنذِرْ قَوْمَكَ مِن قَبْلِ أَن يَأْتِيَهُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌۭ
ayahs.sahih: Indeed, We sent Noah to his people, [saying], "Warn your people before there comes to them a painful punishment."
ayahs.clear: We sent Noah to his people: “Warn your people before there comes upon them a painful punishment.”
ayahs.kemenag: Sesungguhnya Kami telah mengutus Nuh kepada kaumnya (dengan memerintahkan): "Berilah kaummu peringatan sebelum datang kepadanya azab yang pedih",

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ يَٰقَوْمِ إِنِّى لَكُمْ نَذِيرٌۭ مُّبِينٌ
ayahs.sahih: He said, "O my people, indeed I am to you a clear warner,
ayahs.clear: He said, “O my people, I am to you a clear warner.
ayahs.kemenag: Nuh berkata: "Hai kaumku, sesungguhnya aku adalah pemberi peringatan yang menjelaskan kepada kamu,

ayahs.arabic: أَنِ ٱعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَٱتَّقُوهُ وَأَطِيعُونِ
ayahs.sahih: [Saying], 'Worship Allah, fear Him and obey me.
ayahs.clear: Worship God and reverence Him, and obey me.
ayahs.kemenag: (yaitu) sembahlah olehmu Allah, bertakwalah kepada-Nya dan taatlah kepadaku,

ayahs.arabic: يَغْفِرْ لَكُم مِّن ذُنُوبِكُمْ وَيُؤَخِّرْكُمْ إِلَىٰٓ أَجَلٍۢ مُّسَمًّى ۚ إِنَّ أَجَلَ ٱللَّهِ إِذَا جَآءَ لَا يُؤَخَّرُ ۖ لَوْ كُنتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ
ayahs.sahih: Allah will forgive you of your sins and delay you for a specified term. Indeed, the time [set by] Allah, when it comes, will not be delayed, if you only knew.' "
ayahs.clear: And He will forgive you of your sins, and reprieve you until a stated term. God’s term cannot be deferred once it has arrived, if you only knew.”
ayahs.kemenag: niscaya Allah akan mengampuni sebagian dosa-dosamu dan menangguhkan kamu sampai kepada waktu yang ditentukan. Sesungguhnya ketetapan Allah apabila telah datang tidak dapat ditangguhkan, kalau kamu mengetahui".

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ إِنِّى دَعَوْتُ قَوْمِى لَيْلًۭا وَنَهَارًۭا
ayahs.sahih: He said, "My Lord, indeed I invited my people [to truth] night and day.
ayahs.clear: He said, “My Lord, I have called my people night and day.
ayahs.kemenag: Nuh berkata: "Ya Tuhanku sesungguhnya aku telah menyeru kaumku malam dan siang,

ayahs.arabic: فَلَمْ يَزِدْهُمْ دُعَآءِىٓ إِلَّا فِرَارًۭا
ayahs.sahih: But my invitation increased them not except in flight.
ayahs.clear: But my call added only to their flight.
ayahs.kemenag: maka seruanku itu hanyalah menambah mereka lari (dari kebenaran).

ayahs.arabic: وَإِنِّى كُلَّمَا دَعَوْتُهُمْ لِتَغْفِرَ لَهُمْ جَعَلُوٓا۟ أَصَٰبِعَهُمْ فِىٓ ءَاذَانِهِمْ وَٱسْتَغْشَوْا۟ ثِيَابَهُمْ وَأَصَرُّوا۟ وَٱسْتَكْبَرُوا۟ ٱسْتِكْبَارًۭا
ayahs.sahih: And indeed, every time I invited them that You may forgive them, they put their fingers in their ears, covered themselves with their garments, persisted, and were arrogant with [great] arrogance.
ayahs.clear: Whenever I called them to Your forgiveness, they thrust their fingers into their ears, and wrapped themselves in their garments, and insisted, and became more and more arrogant.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan sesungguhnya setiap kali aku menyeru mereka (kepada iman) agar Engkau mengampuni mereka, mereka memasukkan anak jari mereka ke dalam telinganya dan menutupkan bajunya (kemukanya) dan mereka tetap (mengingkari) dan menyombongkan diri dengan sangat.

ayahs.arabic: ثُمَّ إِنِّى دَعَوْتُهُمْ جِهَارًۭا
ayahs.sahih: Then I invited them publicly.
ayahs.clear: Then I called them openly.
ayahs.kemenag: Kemudian sesungguhnya aku telah menyeru mereka (kepada iman) dengan cara terang-terangan,

ayahs.arabic: ثُمَّ إِنِّىٓ أَعْلَنتُ لَهُمْ وَأَسْرَرْتُ لَهُمْ إِسْرَارًۭا
ayahs.sahih: Then I announced to them and [also] confided to them secretly
ayahs.clear: Then I appealed to them publicly, and I spoke to them privately.
ayahs.kemenag: kemudian sesungguhnya aku (menyeru) mereka (lagi) dengan terang-terangan dan dengan diam-diam,

ayahs.arabic: فَقُلْتُ ٱسْتَغْفِرُوا۟ رَبَّكُمْ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ غَفَّارًۭا
ayahs.sahih: And said, 'Ask forgiveness of your Lord. Indeed, He is ever a Perpetual Forgiver.
ayahs.clear: I said, ‘Ask your Lord for forgiveness; He is Forgiving.
ayahs.kemenag: maka aku katakan kepada mereka: 'Mohonlah ampun kepada Tuhanmu, -sesungguhnya Dia adalah Maha Pengampun-,

ayahs.arabic: يُرْسِلِ ٱلسَّمَآءَ عَلَيْكُم مِّدْرَارًۭا
ayahs.sahih: He will send [rain from] the sky upon you in [continuing] showers
ayahs.clear: He will let loose the sky upon you in torrents.
ayahs.kemenag: niscaya Dia akan mengirimkan hujan kepadamu dengan lebat,

ayahs.arabic: وَيُمْدِدْكُم بِأَمْوَٰلٍۢ وَبَنِينَ وَيَجْعَل لَّكُمْ جَنَّٰتٍۢ وَيَجْعَل لَّكُمْ أَنْهَٰرًۭا
ayahs.sahih: And give you increase in wealth and children and provide for you gardens and provide for you rivers.
ayahs.clear: And provide you with wealth and children, and allot for you gardens, and allot for you rivers.
ayahs.kemenag: dan membanyakkan harta dan anak-anakmu, dan mengadakan untukmu kebun-kebun dan mengadakan (pula di dalamnya) untukmu sungai-sungai.

ayahs.arabic: مَّا لَكُمْ لَا تَرْجُونَ لِلَّهِ وَقَارًۭا
ayahs.sahih: What is [the matter] with you that you do not attribute to Allah [due] grandeur
ayahs.clear: What is the matter with you, that you do not appreciate God’s Greatness?
ayahs.kemenag: Mengapa kamu tidak percaya akan kebesaran Allah?

ayahs.arabic: وَقَدْ خَلَقَكُمْ أَطْوَارًا
ayahs.sahih: While He has created you in stages?
ayahs.clear: Although He created you in stages.
ayahs.kemenag: Padahal Dia sesungguhnya telah menciptakan kamu dalam beberapa tingkatan kejadian.

ayahs.arabic: أَلَمْ تَرَوْا۟ كَيْفَ خَلَقَ ٱللَّهُ سَبْعَ سَمَٰوَٰتٍۢ طِبَاقًۭا
ayahs.sahih: Do you not consider how Allah has created seven heavens in layers
ayahs.clear: Do you not realize that God created seven heavens in layers?
ayahs.kemenag: Tidakkah kamu perhatikan bagaimana Allah telah menciptakan tujuh langit bertingkat-tingkat?

ayahs.arabic: وَجَعَلَ ٱلْقَمَرَ فِيهِنَّ نُورًۭا وَجَعَلَ ٱلشَّمْسَ سِرَاجًۭا
ayahs.sahih: And made the moon therein a [reflected] light and made the sun a burning lamp?
ayahs.clear: And He set the moon in their midst for light, and He made the sun a lamp.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan Allah menciptakan padanya bulan sebagai cahaya dan menjadikan matahari sebagai pelita?

ayahs.arabic: وَٱللَّهُ أَنۢبَتَكُم مِّنَ ٱلْأَرْضِ نَبَاتًۭا
ayahs.sahih: And Allah has caused you to grow from the earth a [progressive] growth.
ayahs.clear: And God germinated you from the earth like plants.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan Allah menumbuhkan kamu dari tanah dengan sebaik-baiknya,

ayahs.arabic: ثُمَّ يُعِيدُكُمْ فِيهَا وَيُخْرِجُكُمْ إِخْرَاجًۭا
ayahs.sahih: Then He will return you into it and extract you [another] extraction.
ayahs.clear: Then He will return you into it, and will bring you out again.
ayahs.kemenag: kemudian Dia mengembalikan kamu ke dalam tanah dan mengeluarkan kamu (daripadanya pada hari kiamat) dengan sebenar-benarnya.

ayahs.arabic: وَٱللَّهُ جَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلْأَرْضَ بِسَاطًۭا
ayahs.sahih: And Allah has made for you the earth an expanse
ayahs.clear: And God made the earth a spread for you.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan Allah menjadikan bumi untukmu sebagai hamparan,

ayahs.arabic: لِّتَسْلُكُوا۟ مِنْهَا سُبُلًۭا فِجَاجًۭا
ayahs.sahih: That you may follow therein roads of passage.' "
ayahs.clear: That you may travel its diverse roads.’”
ayahs.kemenag: supaya kamu menjalani jalan-jalan yang luas di bumi itu".

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ نُوحٌۭ رَّبِّ إِنَّهُمْ عَصَوْنِى وَٱتَّبَعُوا۟ مَن لَّمْ يَزِدْهُ مَالُهُۥ وَوَلَدُهُۥٓ إِلَّا خَسَارًۭا
ayahs.sahih: Noah said, "My Lord, indeed they have disobeyed me and followed him whose wealth and children will not increase him except in loss.
ayahs.clear: Noah said, “My Lord, they have defied me, and followed him whose wealth and children increase him only in perdition.”
ayahs.kemenag: Nuh berkata: "Ya Tuhanku, sesungguhnya mereka telah mendurhakaiku dan telah mengikuti orang-orang yang harta dan anak-anaknya tidak menambah kepadanya melainkan kerugian belaka,

ayahs.arabic: وَمَكَرُوا۟ مَكْرًۭا كُبَّارًۭا
ayahs.sahih: And they conspired an immense conspiracy.
ayahs.clear: And they schemed outrageous schemes.
ayahs.kemenag: dan melakukan tipu-daya yang amat besar".

ayahs.arabic: وَقَالُوا۟ لَا تَذَرُنَّ ءَالِهَتَكُمْ وَلَا تَذَرُنَّ وَدًّۭا وَلَا سُوَاعًۭا وَلَا يَغُوثَ وَيَعُوقَ وَنَسْرًۭا
ayahs.sahih: And said, 'Never leave your gods and never leave Wadd or Suwa' or Yaghuth and Ya'uq and Nasr.
ayahs.clear: And they said, “Do not give up your gods; do not give up Wadd, nor Souwa, nor Yaghoos, and Yaooq, and Nassr.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan mereka berkata: "Jangan sekali-kali kamu meninggalkan (penyembahan) tuhan-tuhan kamu dan jangan pula sekali-kali kamu meninggalkan (penyembahan) wadd, dan jangan pula suwwa', yaghuts, ya'uq dan nasr".

ayahs.arabic: وَقَدْ أَضَلُّوا۟ كَثِيرًۭا ۖ وَلَا تَزِدِ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ إِلَّا ضَلَٰلًۭا
ayahs.sahih: And already they have misled many. And, [my Lord], do not increase the wrongdoers except in error."
ayahs.clear: They have misled many, so do not increase the wrongdoers except in confusion.”
ayahs.kemenag: Dan sesudahnya mereka menyesatkan kebanyakan (manusia); dan janganlah Engkau tambahkan bagi orang-orang yang zalim itu selain kesesatan.

ayahs.arabic: مِّمَّا خَطِيٓـَٰٔتِهِمْ أُغْرِقُوا۟ فَأُدْخِلُوا۟ نَارًۭا فَلَمْ يَجِدُوا۟ لَهُم مِّن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ أَنصَارًۭا
ayahs.sahih: Because of their sins they were drowned and put into the Fire, and they found not for themselves besides Allah [any] helpers.
ayahs.clear: Because of their wrongs, they were drowned, and were hurled into a Fire. They did not find apart from God any helpers.
ayahs.kemenag: Disebabkan kesalahan-kesalahan mereka, mereka ditenggelamkan lalu dimasukkan ke neraka, maka mereka tidak mendapat penolong-penolong bagi mereka selain dari Allah.

ayahs.arabic: وَقَالَ نُوحٌۭ رَّبِّ لَا تَذَرْ عَلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ مِنَ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ دَيَّارًا
ayahs.sahih: And Noah said, "My Lord, do not leave upon the earth from among the disbelievers an inhabitant.
ayahs.clear: Noah said, “My Lord, do not leave of the unbelievers a single dweller on earth.
ayahs.kemenag: Nuh berkata: "Ya Tuhanku, janganlah Engkau biarkan seorangpun di antara orang-orang kafir itu tinggal di atas bumi.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّكَ إِن تَذَرْهُمْ يُضِلُّوا۟ عِبَادَكَ وَلَا يَلِدُوٓا۟ إِلَّا فَاجِرًۭا كَفَّارًۭا
ayahs.sahih: Indeed, if You leave them, they will mislead Your servants and not beget except [every] wicked one and [confirmed] disbeliever.
ayahs.clear: If You leave them, they will mislead your servants, and will breed only wicked unbelievers.
ayahs.kemenag: Sesungguhnya jika Engkau biarkan mereka tinggal, niscaya mereka akan menyesatkan hamba-hamba-Mu, dan mereka tidak akan melahirkan selain anak yang berbuat maksiat lagi sangat kafir.

ayahs.arabic: رَّبِّ ٱغْفِرْ لِى وَلِوَٰلِدَىَّ وَلِمَن دَخَلَ بَيْتِىَ مُؤْمِنًۭا وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَٱلْمُؤْمِنَٰتِ وَلَا تَزِدِ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ إِلَّا تَبَارًۢا
ayahs.sahih: My Lord, forgive me and my parents and whoever enters my house a believer and the believing men and believing women. And do not increase the wrongdoers except in destruction."
ayahs.clear: My Lord! Forgive me and my parents, and anyone who enters my home in faith, and all the believing men and believing women; and do not increase the wrongdoers except in perdition.”
ayahs.kemenag: Ya Tuhanku! Ampunilah aku, ibu bapakku, orang yang masuk ke rumahku dengan beriman dan semua orang yang beriman laki-laki dan perempuan. Dan janganlah Engkau tambahkan bagi orang-orang yang zalim itu selain kebinasaan".

ayahs.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ قُلْ أُوحِىَ إِلَىَّ أَنَّهُ ٱسْتَمَعَ نَفَرٌۭ مِّنَ ٱلْجِنِّ فَقَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّا سَمِعْنَا قُرْءَانًا عَجَبًۭا
ayahs.sahih: Say, [O Muhammad], "It has been revealed to me that a group of the jinn listened and said, 'Indeed, we have heard an amazing Qur'an.
ayahs.clear: Say, “It was revealed to me that a band of jinn listened in, and said, ‘We have heard a wondrous Quran.
ayahs.kemenag: Katakanlah (hai Muhammad): "Telah diwahyukan kepadamu bahwasanya: telah mendengarkan sekumpulan jin (akan Al Quran), lalu mereka berkata: Sesungguhnya kami telah mendengarkan Al Quran yang menakjubkan,

ayahs.arabic: يَهْدِىٓ إِلَى ٱلرُّشْدِ فَـَٔامَنَّا بِهِۦ ۖ وَلَن نُّشْرِكَ بِرَبِّنَآ أَحَدًۭا
ayahs.sahih: It guides to the right course, and we have believed in it. And we will never associate with our Lord anyone.
ayahs.clear: It guides to rectitude, so we have believed in it; and we will never associate anyone with our Lord.
ayahs.kemenag: (yang) memberi petunjuk kapada jalan yang benar, lalu kami beriman kepadanya. Dan kami sekali-kali tidak akan mempersekutukan seseorangpun dengan Tuhan kami,

ayahs.arabic: وَأَنَّهُۥ تَعَٰلَىٰ جَدُّ رَبِّنَا مَا ٱتَّخَذَ صَٰحِبَةًۭ وَلَا وَلَدًۭا
ayahs.sahih: And [it teaches] that exalted is the nobleness of our Lord; He has not taken a wife or a son
ayahs.clear: And Exalted is the Grandeur of our Lord—He never had a mate, nor a child.
ayahs.kemenag: dan bahwasanya Maha Tinggi kebesaran Tuhan kami, Dia tidak beristeri dan tidak (pula) beranak.

ayahs.arabic: وَأَنَّهُۥ كَانَ يَقُولُ سَفِيهُنَا عَلَى ٱللَّهِ شَطَطًۭا
ayahs.sahih: And that our foolish one has been saying about Allah an excessive transgression.
ayahs.clear: But the fools among us used to say nonsense about God.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan bahwasanya: orang yang kurang akal daripada kami selalu mengatakan (perkataan) yang melampaui batas terhadap Allah,

ayahs.arabic: وَأَنَّا ظَنَنَّآ أَن لَّن تَقُولَ ٱلْإِنسُ وَٱلْجِنُّ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ كَذِبًۭا
ayahs.sahih: And we had thought that mankind and the jinn would never speak about Allah a lie.
ayahs.clear: And we thought that humans and jinn would never utter lies about God.
ayahs.kemenag: dan sesungguhnya kami mengira, bahwa manusia dan jin sekali-kali tidak akan mengatakan perkataan yang dusta terhadap Allah.

ayahs.arabic: وَأَنَّهُۥ كَانَ رِجَالٌۭ مِّنَ ٱلْإِنسِ يَعُوذُونَ بِرِجَالٍۢ مِّنَ ٱلْجِنِّ فَزَادُوهُمْ رَهَقًۭا
ayahs.sahih: And there were men from mankind who sought refuge in men from the jinn, so they [only] increased them in burden.
ayahs.clear: Some individual humans used to seek power through some individual jinn, but they only increased them in confusion.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan bahwasanya ada beberapa orang laki-laki di antara manusia meminta perlindungan kepada beberapa laki-laki di antara jin, maka jin-jin itu menambah bagi mereka dosa dan kesalahan.

ayahs.arabic: وَأَنَّهُمْ ظَنُّوا۟ كَمَا ظَنَنتُمْ أَن لَّن يَبْعَثَ ٱللَّهُ أَحَدًۭا
ayahs.sahih: And they had thought, as you thought, that Allah would never send anyone [as a messenger].
ayahs.clear: They thought, as you thought, that God would never resurrect anyone.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan sesungguhnya mereka (jin) menyangka sebagaimana persangkaan kamu (orang-orang kafir Mekah), bahwa Allah sekali-kali tidak akan membangkitkan seorang (rasul)pun,

ayahs.arabic: وَأَنَّا لَمَسْنَا ٱلسَّمَآءَ فَوَجَدْنَٰهَا مُلِئَتْ حَرَسًۭا شَدِيدًۭا وَشُهُبًۭا
ayahs.sahih: And we have sought [to reach] the heaven but found it filled with powerful guards and burning flames.
ayahs.clear: We probed the heaven, and found it filled with stern guards and projectiles.
ayahs.kemenag: dan sesungguhnya kami telah mencoba mengetahui (rahasia) langit, maka kami mendapatinya penuh dengan penjagaan yang kuat dan panah-panah api,
