ayahs.arabic: وَأَنَّا كُنَّا نَقْعُدُ مِنْهَا مَقَٰعِدَ لِلسَّمْعِ ۖ فَمَن يَسْتَمِعِ ٱلْءَانَ يَجِدْ لَهُۥ شِهَابًۭا رَّصَدًۭا
ayahs.sahih: And we used to sit therein in positions for hearing, but whoever listens now will find a burning flame lying in wait for him.
ayahs.clear: We used to take up positions to listen in; but whoever listens now finds a projectile in wait for him.
ayahs.kemenag: dan sesungguhnya kami dahulu dapat menduduki beberapa tempat di langit itu untuk mendengar-dengarkan (berita-beritanya). Tetapi sekarang barangsiapa yang (mencoba) mendengar-dengarkan (seperti itu) tentu akan menjumpai panah api yang mengintai (untuk membakarnya).

ayahs.arabic: وَأَنَّا لَا نَدْرِىٓ أَشَرٌّ أُرِيدَ بِمَن فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ أَمْ أَرَادَ بِهِمْ رَبُّهُمْ رَشَدًۭا
ayahs.sahih: And we do not know [therefore] whether evil is intended for those on earth or whether their Lord intends for them a right course.
ayahs.clear: We do not know whether ill is intended for those on earth, or if their Lord intends goodness for them.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan sesungguhnya kami tidak mengetahui (dengan adanya penjagaan itu) apakah keburukan yang dikehendaki bagi orang yang di bumi ataukah Tuhan mereka menghendaki kebaikan bagi mereka.

ayahs.arabic: وَأَنَّا مِنَّا ٱلصَّٰلِحُونَ وَمِنَّا دُونَ ذَٰلِكَ ۖ كُنَّا طَرَآئِقَ قِدَدًۭا
ayahs.sahih: And among us are the righteous, and among us are [others] not so; we were [of] divided ways.
ayahs.clear: Some of us are righteous, but some of us are less than that; we follow divergent paths.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan sesungguhnya di antara kami ada orang-orang yang saleh dan di antara kami ada (pula) yang tidak demikian halnya. Adalah kami menempuh jalan yang berbeda-beda.

ayahs.arabic: وَأَنَّا ظَنَنَّآ أَن لَّن نُّعْجِزَ ٱللَّهَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَن نُّعْجِزَهُۥ هَرَبًۭا
ayahs.sahih: And we have become certain that we will never cause failure to Allah upon earth, nor can we escape Him by flight.
ayahs.clear: We realized that we cannot defeat God on earth, and that we cannot escape Him by fleeing.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan sesungguhnya kami mengetahui bahwa kami sekali-kali tidak akan dapat melepaskan diri (dari kekuasaan) Allah di muka bumi dan sekali-kali tidak (pula) dapat melepaskan diri (daripada)Nya dengan lari.

ayahs.arabic: وَأَنَّا لَمَّا سَمِعْنَا ٱلْهُدَىٰٓ ءَامَنَّا بِهِۦ ۖ فَمَن يُؤْمِنۢ بِرَبِّهِۦ فَلَا يَخَافُ بَخْسًۭا وَلَا رَهَقًۭا
ayahs.sahih: And when we heard the guidance, we believed in it. And whoever believes in his Lord will not fear deprivation or burden.
ayahs.clear: And when we heard the guidance, we believed in it. Whoever believes in his Lord fears neither loss, nor burden.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan sesungguhnya kami tatkala mendengar petunjuk (Al Quran), kami beriman kepadanya. Barangsiapa beriman kepada Tuhannya, maka ia tidak takut akan pengurangan pahala dan tidak (takut pula) akan penambahan dosa dan kesalahan.

ayahs.arabic: وَأَنَّا مِنَّا ٱلْمُسْلِمُونَ وَمِنَّا ٱلْقَٰسِطُونَ ۖ فَمَنْ أَسْلَمَ فَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ تَحَرَّوْا۟ رَشَدًۭا
ayahs.sahih: And among us are Muslims [in submission to Allah], and among us are the unjust. And whoever has become Muslim - those have sought out the right course.
ayahs.clear: Among us are those who are submitting, and among us are the compromisers. As for those who have submitted—it is they who pursue rectitude.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan sesungguhnya di antara kami ada orang-orang yang taat dan ada (pula) orang-orang yang menyimpang dari kebenaran. Barangsiapa yang yang taat, maka mereka itu benar-benar telah memilih jalan yang lurus.

ayahs.arabic: وَأَمَّا ٱلْقَٰسِطُونَ فَكَانُوا۟ لِجَهَنَّمَ حَطَبًۭا
ayahs.sahih: But as for the unjust, they will be, for Hell, firewood.'
ayahs.clear: But as for the compromisers—they will be firewood for Hell.’”
ayahs.kemenag: Adapun orang-orang yang menyimpang dari kebenaran, maka mereka menjadi kayu api bagi neraka Jahannam.

ayahs.arabic: وَأَلَّوِ ٱسْتَقَٰمُوا۟ عَلَى ٱلطَّرِيقَةِ لَأَسْقَيْنَٰهُم مَّآءً غَدَقًۭا
ayahs.sahih: And [Allah revealed] that if they had remained straight on the way, We would have given them abundant provision
ayahs.clear: Had they kept true to the Path, We would have given them plenty water to drink.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan bahwasanya: jikalau mereka tetap berjalan lurus di atas jalan itu (agama Islam), benar-benar Kami akan memberi minum kepada mereka air yang segar (rezeki yang banyak).

ayahs.arabic: لِّنَفْتِنَهُمْ فِيهِ ۚ وَمَن يُعْرِضْ عَن ذِكْرِ رَبِّهِۦ يَسْلُكْهُ عَذَابًۭا صَعَدًۭا
ayahs.sahih: So We might test them therein. And whoever turns away from the remembrance of his Lord He will put into arduous punishment.
ayahs.clear: To test them with it. Whoever turns away from the remembrance of his Lord, He will direct him to torment ever mounting.
ayahs.kemenag: Untuk Kami beri cobaan kepada mereka padanya. Dan barangsiapa yang berpaling dari peringatan Tuhannya, niscaya akan dimasukkan-Nya ke dalam azab yang amat berat.

ayahs.arabic: وَأَنَّ ٱلْمَسَٰجِدَ لِلَّهِ فَلَا تَدْعُوا۟ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ أَحَدًۭا
ayahs.sahih: And [He revealed] that the masjids are for Allah, so do not invoke with Allah anyone.
ayahs.clear: The places of worship are for God. So do not call, besides God, upon anyone else.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan sesungguhnya mesjid-mesjid itu adalah kepunyaan Allah. Maka janganlah kamu menyembah seseorangpun di dalamnya di samping (menyembah) Allah.

ayahs.arabic: وَأَنَّهُۥ لَمَّا قَامَ عَبْدُ ٱللَّهِ يَدْعُوهُ كَادُوا۟ يَكُونُونَ عَلَيْهِ لِبَدًۭا
ayahs.sahih: And that when the Servant of Allah stood up supplicating Him, they almost became about him a compacted mass."
ayahs.clear: And when the servant of God got up calling on Him, they almost fell on him in a mass.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan bahwasanya tatkala hamba Allah (Muhammad) berdiri menyembah-Nya (mengerjakan ibadat), hampir saja jin-jin itu desak mendesak mengerumuninya.

ayahs.arabic: قُلْ إِنَّمَآ أَدْعُوا۟ رَبِّى وَلَآ أُشْرِكُ بِهِۦٓ أَحَدًۭا
ayahs.sahih: Say, [O Muhammad], "I only invoke my Lord and do not associate with Him anyone."
ayahs.clear: Say, “I pray only to my Lord, and I never associate anyone with Him.”
ayahs.kemenag: Katakanlah: "Sesungguhnya aku hanya menyembah Tuhanku dan aku tidak mempersekutukan sesuatupun dengan-Nya".

ayahs.arabic: قُلْ إِنِّى لَآ أَمْلِكُ لَكُمْ ضَرًّۭا وَلَا رَشَدًۭا
ayahs.sahih: Say, "Indeed, I do not possess for you [the power of] harm or right direction."
ayahs.clear: Say, “It is not in my power to harm you, nor to bring you to right conduct.”
ayahs.kemenag: Katakanlah: "Sesungguhnya aku tidak kuasa mendatangkan sesuatu kemudharatanpun kepadamu dan tidak (pula) suatu kemanfaatan".

ayahs.arabic: قُلْ إِنِّى لَن يُجِيرَنِى مِنَ ٱللَّهِ أَحَدٌۭ وَلَنْ أَجِدَ مِن دُونِهِۦ مُلْتَحَدًا
ayahs.sahih: Say, "Indeed, there will never protect me from Allah anyone [if I should disobey], nor will I find in other than Him a refuge.
ayahs.clear: Say, “No one can protect me from God, and I will not find any refuge except with Him.
ayahs.kemenag: Katakanlah: "Sesungguhnya aku sekali-kali tiada seorangpun dapat melindungiku dari (azab) Allah dan sekali-kali aku tiada akan memperoleh tempat berlindung selain daripada-Nya".

ayahs.arabic: إِلَّا بَلَٰغًۭا مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ وَرِسَٰلَٰتِهِۦ ۚ وَمَن يَعْصِ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُۥ فَإِنَّ لَهُۥ نَارَ جَهَنَّمَ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَآ أَبَدًا
ayahs.sahih: But [I have for you] only notification from Allah, and His messages." And whoever disobeys Allah and His Messenger - then indeed, for him is the fire of Hell; they will abide therein forever.
ayahs.clear: Except for a proclamation from God and His messages. He who defies God and His Messenger—for him is the Fire of Hell, in which they will dwell forever.”
ayahs.kemenag: Akan tetapi (aku hanya) menyampaikan (peringatan) dari Allah dan risalah-Nya. Dan barangsiapa yang mendurhakai Allah dan Rasul-Nya maka sesungguhnya baginyalah neraka Jahannam, mereka kekal di dalamnya selama-lamanya.

ayahs.arabic: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا رَأَوْا۟ مَا يُوعَدُونَ فَسَيَعْلَمُونَ مَنْ أَضْعَفُ نَاصِرًۭا وَأَقَلُّ عَدَدًۭا
ayahs.sahih: [The disbelievers continue] until, when they see that which they are promised, then they will know who is weaker in helpers and less in number.
ayahs.clear: Until, when they see what they were promised, they will know who is weaker in helpers, and fewer in numbers.
ayahs.kemenag: Sehingga apabila mereka melihat azab yang diancamkan kepada mereka, maka mereka akan mengetahui siapakah yang lebih lemah penolongnya dan lebih sedikit bilangannya.

ayahs.arabic: قُلْ إِنْ أَدْرِىٓ أَقَرِيبٌۭ مَّا تُوعَدُونَ أَمْ يَجْعَلُ لَهُۥ رَبِّىٓ أَمَدًا
ayahs.sahih: Say, "I do not know if what you are promised is near or if my Lord will grant for it a [long] period."
ayahs.clear: Say, “I do not know whether what you are promised is near, or whether my Lord will extend it for a period.”
ayahs.kemenag: Katakanlah: "Aku tidak mengetahui, apakah azab yang diancamkan kepadamu itu dekat ataukah Tuhanku menjadikan bagi (kedatangan) azab itu masa yang panjang?".

ayahs.arabic: عَٰلِمُ ٱلْغَيْبِ فَلَا يُظْهِرُ عَلَىٰ غَيْبِهِۦٓ أَحَدًا
ayahs.sahih: [He is] Knower of the unseen, and He does not disclose His [knowledge of the] unseen to anyone
ayahs.clear: The Knower of the Invisible; He does not disclose His Invisible to anyone.
ayahs.kemenag: (Dia adalah Tuhan) Yang Mengetahui yang ghaib, maka Dia tidak memperlihatkan kepada seorangpun tentang yang ghaib itu.

ayahs.arabic: إِلَّا مَنِ ٱرْتَضَىٰ مِن رَّسُولٍۢ فَإِنَّهُۥ يَسْلُكُ مِنۢ بَيْنِ يَدَيْهِ وَمِنْ خَلْفِهِۦ رَصَدًۭا
ayahs.sahih: Except whom He has approved of messengers, and indeed, He sends before each messenger and behind him observers
ayahs.clear: Except to a Messenger of His choosing. He then dispatches guards before him and behind him.
ayahs.kemenag: Kecuali kepada rasul yang diridhai-Nya, maka sesungguhnya Dia mengadakan penjaga-penjaga (malaikat) di muka dan di belakangnya.

ayahs.arabic: لِّيَعْلَمَ أَن قَدْ أَبْلَغُوا۟ رِسَٰلَٰتِ رَبِّهِمْ وَأَحَاطَ بِمَا لَدَيْهِمْ وَأَحْصَىٰ كُلَّ شَىْءٍ عَدَدًۢا
ayahs.sahih: That he may know that they have conveyed the messages of their Lord; and He has encompassed whatever is with them and has enumerated all things in number.
ayahs.clear: That He may know that they have conveyed the messages of their Lord. He encompasses what they have, and has tallied everything by number.
ayahs.kemenag: Supaya Dia mengetahui, bahwa sesungguhnya rasul-rasul itu telah menyampaikan risalah-risalah Tuhannya, sedang (sebenarnya) ilmu-Nya meliputi apa yang ada pada mereka, dan Dia menghitung segala sesuatu satu persatu.

ayahs.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْمُزَّمِّلُ
ayahs.sahih: O you who wraps himself [in clothing],
ayahs.clear: O you Enwrapped one.
ayahs.kemenag: Hai orang yang berselimut (Muhammad),

ayahs.arabic: قُمِ ٱلَّيْلَ إِلَّا قَلِيلًۭا
ayahs.sahih: Arise [to pray] the night, except for a little -
ayahs.clear: Stay up during the night, except a little.
ayahs.kemenag: bangunlah (untuk sembahyang) di malam hari, kecuali sedikit (daripadanya),

ayahs.arabic: نِّصْفَهُۥٓ أَوِ ٱنقُصْ مِنْهُ قَلِيلًا
ayahs.sahih: Half of it - or subtract from it a little
ayahs.clear: For half of it, or reduce it a little.
ayahs.kemenag: (yaitu) seperduanya atau kurangilah dari seperdua itu sedikit.

ayahs.arabic: أَوْ زِدْ عَلَيْهِ وَرَتِّلِ ٱلْقُرْءَانَ تَرْتِيلًا
ayahs.sahih: Or add to it, and recite the Qur'an with measured recitation.
ayahs.clear: Or add to it; and chant the Quran rhythmically.
ayahs.kemenag: atau lebih dari seperdua itu. Dan bacalah Al Quran itu dengan perlahan-lahan.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّا سَنُلْقِى عَلَيْكَ قَوْلًۭا ثَقِيلًا
ayahs.sahih: Indeed, We will cast upon you a heavy word.
ayahs.clear: We are about to give you a heavy message.
ayahs.kemenag: Sesungguhnya Kami akan menurunkan kapadamu perkataan yang berat.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ نَاشِئَةَ ٱلَّيْلِ هِىَ أَشَدُّ وَطْـًۭٔا وَأَقْوَمُ قِيلًا
ayahs.sahih: Indeed, the hours of the night are more effective for concurrence [of heart and tongue] and more suitable for words.
ayahs.clear: The vigil of night is more effective, and better suited for recitation.
ayahs.kemenag: Sesungguhnya bangun di waktu malam adalah lebih tepat (untuk khusyu') dan bacaan di waktu itu lebih berkesan.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ لَكَ فِى ٱلنَّهَارِ سَبْحًۭا طَوِيلًۭا
ayahs.sahih: Indeed, for you by day is prolonged occupation.
ayahs.clear: In the daytime, you have lengthy work to do.
ayahs.kemenag: Sesungguhnya kamu pada siang hari mempunyai urusan yang panjang (banyak).

ayahs.arabic: وَٱذْكُرِ ٱسْمَ رَبِّكَ وَتَبَتَّلْ إِلَيْهِ تَبْتِيلًۭا
ayahs.sahih: And remember the name of your Lord and devote yourself to Him with [complete] devotion.
ayahs.clear: So remember the Name of your Lord, and devote yourself to Him wholeheartedly.
ayahs.kemenag: Sebutlah nama Tuhanmu, dan beribadatlah kepada-Nya dengan penuh ketekunan.

ayahs.arabic: رَّبُّ ٱلْمَشْرِقِ وَٱلْمَغْرِبِ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ فَٱتَّخِذْهُ وَكِيلًۭا
ayahs.sahih: [He is] the Lord of the East and the West; there is no deity except Him, so take Him as Disposer of [your] affairs.
ayahs.clear: Lord of the East and the West. There is no god but He, so take Him as a Trustee.
ayahs.kemenag: (Dialah) Tuhan masyrik dan maghrib, tiada Tuhan (yang berhak disembah) melainkan Dia, maka ambillah Dia sebagai pelindung.

ayahs.arabic: وَٱصْبِرْ عَلَىٰ مَا يَقُولُونَ وَٱهْجُرْهُمْ هَجْرًۭا جَمِيلًۭا
ayahs.sahih: And be patient over what they say and avoid them with gracious avoidance.
ayahs.clear: And endure patiently what they say, and withdraw from them politely.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan bersabarlah terhadap apa yang mereka ucapkan dan jauhilah mereka dengan cara yang baik.

ayahs.arabic: وَذَرْنِى وَٱلْمُكَذِّبِينَ أُو۟لِى ٱلنَّعْمَةِ وَمَهِّلْهُمْ قَلِيلًا
ayahs.sahih: And leave Me with [the matter of] the deniers, those of ease [in life], and allow them respite a little.
ayahs.clear: And leave Me to those who deny the truth, those of luxury, and give them a brief respite.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan biarkanlah Aku (saja) bertindak terhadap orang-orang yang mendustakan itu, orang-orang yang mempunyai kemewahan dan beri tangguhlah mereka barang sebentar.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ لَدَيْنَآ أَنكَالًۭا وَجَحِيمًۭا
ayahs.sahih: Indeed, with Us [for them] are shackles and burning fire
ayahs.clear: With Us are shackles, and a Fierce Fire.
ayahs.kemenag: Karena sesungguhnya pada sisi Kami ada belenggu-belenggu yang berat dan neraka yang menyala-nyala.

ayahs.arabic: وَطَعَامًۭا ذَا غُصَّةٍۢ وَعَذَابًا أَلِيمًۭا
ayahs.sahih: And food that chokes and a painful punishment -
ayahs.clear: And food that chokes, and a painful punishment.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan makanan yang menyumbat di kerongkongan dan azab yang pedih.

ayahs.arabic: يَوْمَ تَرْجُفُ ٱلْأَرْضُ وَٱلْجِبَالُ وَكَانَتِ ٱلْجِبَالُ كَثِيبًۭا مَّهِيلًا
ayahs.sahih: On the Day the earth and the mountains will convulse and the mountains will become a heap of sand pouring down.
ayahs.clear: On the Day when the earth and the mountains tremble, and the mountains become heaps of sand.
ayahs.kemenag: Pada hari bumi dan gunung-gunung bergoncangan, dan menjadilah gunung-gunung itu tumpukan-tumpukan pasir yang berterbangan.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَيْكُمْ رَسُولًۭا شَٰهِدًا عَلَيْكُمْ كَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ رَسُولًۭا
ayahs.sahih: Indeed, We have sent to you a Messenger as a witness upon you just as We sent to Pharaoh a messenger.
ayahs.clear: We have sent to you a messenger, a witness over you, as We sent to Pharaoh a messenger.
ayahs.kemenag: Sesungguhnya Kami telah mengutus kepada kamu (hai orang kafir Mekah) seorang Rasul, yang menjadi saksi terhadapmu, sebagaimana Kami telah mengutus (dahulu) seorang Rasul kepada Fir'aun.

ayahs.arabic: فَعَصَىٰ فِرْعَوْنُ ٱلرَّسُولَ فَأَخَذْنَٰهُ أَخْذًۭا وَبِيلًۭا
ayahs.sahih: But Pharaoh disobeyed the messenger, so We seized him with a ruinous seizure.
ayahs.clear: But Pharaoh defied the Messenger, so We seized him with a terrible seizing.
ayahs.kemenag: Maka Fir'aun mendurhakai Rasul itu, lalu Kami siksa dia dengan siksaan yang berat.

ayahs.arabic: فَكَيْفَ تَتَّقُونَ إِن كَفَرْتُمْ يَوْمًۭا يَجْعَلُ ٱلْوِلْدَٰنَ شِيبًا
ayahs.sahih: Then how can you fear, if you disbelieve, a Day that will make the children white- haired?
ayahs.clear: So how will you, if you persist in unbelief, save yourself from a Day which will turn the children gray-haired?
ayahs.kemenag: Maka bagaimanakah kamu akan dapat memelihara dirimu jika kamu tetap kafir kepada hari yang menjadikan anak-anak beruban.

ayahs.arabic: ٱلسَّمَآءُ مُنفَطِرٌۢ بِهِۦ ۚ كَانَ وَعْدُهُۥ مَفْعُولًا
ayahs.sahih: The heaven will break apart therefrom; ever is His promise fulfilled.
ayahs.clear: The heaven will shatter thereby. His promise is always fulfilled.
ayahs.kemenag: Langit(pun) menjadi pecah belah pada hari itu. Adalah janji-Nya itu pasti terlaksana.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ هَٰذِهِۦ تَذْكِرَةٌۭ ۖ فَمَن شَآءَ ٱتَّخَذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ سَبِيلًا
ayahs.sahih: Indeed, this is a reminder, so whoever wills may take to his Lord a way.
ayahs.clear: This is a reminder. So whoever wills, let him take a path to his Lord.
ayahs.kemenag: Sesungguhnya ini adalah suatu peringatan. Maka barangsiapa yang menghendaki niscaya ia menempuh jalan (yang menyampaikannya) kepada Tuhannya.

ayahs.arabic: ۞ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ يَعْلَمُ أَنَّكَ تَقُومُ أَدْنَىٰ مِن ثُلُثَىِ ٱلَّيْلِ وَنِصْفَهُۥ وَثُلُثَهُۥ وَطَآئِفَةٌۭ مِّنَ ٱلَّذِينَ مَعَكَ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ يُقَدِّرُ ٱلَّيْلَ وَٱلنَّهَارَ ۚ عَلِمَ أَن لَّن تُحْصُوهُ فَتَابَ عَلَيْكُمْ ۖ فَٱقْرَءُوا۟ مَا تَيَسَّرَ مِنَ ٱلْقُرْءَانِ ۚ عَلِمَ أَن سَيَكُونُ مِنكُم مَّرْضَىٰ ۙ وَءَاخَرُونَ يَضْرِبُونَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ يَبْتَغُونَ مِن فَضْلِ ٱللَّهِ ۙ وَءَاخَرُونَ يُقَٰتِلُونَ فِى سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ ۖ فَٱقْرَءُوا۟ مَا تَيَسَّرَ مِنْهُ ۚ وَأَقِيمُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَءَاتُوا۟ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ وَأَقْرِضُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ قَرْضًا حَسَنًۭا ۚ وَمَا تُقَدِّمُوا۟ لِأَنفُسِكُم مِّنْ خَيْرٍۢ تَجِدُوهُ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ هُوَ خَيْرًۭا وَأَعْظَمَ أَجْرًۭا ۚ وَٱسْتَغْفِرُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ ۖ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَفُورٌۭ رَّحِيمٌۢ
ayahs.sahih: Indeed, your Lord knows, [O Muhammad], that you stand [in prayer] almost two thirds of the night or half of it or a third of it, and [so do] a group of those with you. And Allah determines [the extent of] the night and the day. He has known that you [Muslims] will not be able to do it and has turned to you in forgiveness, so recite what is easy [for you] of the Qur'an. He has known that there will be among you those who are ill and others traveling throughout the land seeking [something] of the bounty of Allah and others fighting for the cause of Allah. So recite what is easy from it and establish prayer and give zakah and loan Allah a goodly loan. And whatever good you put forward for yourselves - you will find it with Allah. It is better and greater in reward. And seek forgiveness of Allah. Indeed, Allah is Forgiving and Merciful.
ayahs.clear: Your Lord knows that you stay up nearly two-thirds of the night, or half of it, or one-third of it, along with a group of those with you. God designed the night and the day. He knows that you are unable to sustain it, so He has pardoned you. So read of the Quran what is possible for you. He knows that some of you may be ill; and others travelling through the land, seeking God’s bounty; and others fighting in God’s cause. So read of it what is possible for you, and observe the prayers, and give regular charity, and lend God a generous loan. Whatever good you advance for yourselves, you will find it with God, better and generously rewarded. And seek God’s forgiveness, for God is Forgiving and Merciful.
ayahs.kemenag: Sesungguhnya Tuhanmu mengetahui bahwasanya kamu berdiri (sembahyang) kurang dari dua pertiga malam, atau seperdua malam atau sepertiganya dan (demikian pula) segolongan dari orang-orang yang bersama kamu. Dan Allah menetapkan ukuran malam dan siang. Allah mengetahui bahwa kamu sekali-kali tidak dapat menentukan batas-batas waktu-waktu itu, maka Dia memberi keringanan kepadamu, karena itu bacalah apa yang mudah (bagimu) dari Al Quran. Dia mengetahui bahwa akan ada di antara kamu orang-orang yang sakit dan orang-orang yang berjalan di muka bumi mencari sebagian karunia Allah; dan orang-orang yang lain lagi berperang di jalan Allah, maka bacalah apa yang mudah (bagimu) dari Al Quran dan dirikanlah sembahyang, tunaikanlah zakat dan berikanlah pinjaman kepada Allah pinjaman yang baik. Dan kebaikan apa saja yang kamu perbuat untuk dirimu niscaya kamu memperoleh (balasan)nya di sisi Allah sebagai balasan yang paling baik dan yang paling besar pahalanya. Dan mohonlah ampunan kepada Allah; sesungguhnya Allah Maha Pengampun lagi Maha Penyayang.

ayahs.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْمُدَّثِّرُ
ayahs.sahih: O you who covers himself [with a garment],
ayahs.clear: O you Enrobed one.
ayahs.kemenag: Hai orang yang berkemul (berselimut),

ayahs.arabic: قُمْ فَأَنذِرْ
ayahs.sahih: Arise and warn
ayahs.clear: Arise and warn.
ayahs.kemenag: bangunlah, lalu berilah peringatan!

ayahs.arabic: وَرَبَّكَ فَكَبِّرْ
ayahs.sahih: And your Lord glorify
ayahs.clear: And magnify your Lord.
ayahs.kemenag: dan Tuhanmu agungkanlah!

ayahs.arabic: وَثِيَابَكَ فَطَهِّرْ
ayahs.sahih: And your clothing purify
ayahs.clear: And purify your clothes.
ayahs.kemenag: dan pakaianmu bersihkanlah,

ayahs.arabic: وَٱلرُّجْزَ فَٱهْجُرْ
ayahs.sahih: And uncleanliness avoid
ayahs.clear: And abandon abominations.
ayahs.kemenag: dan perbuatan dosa tinggalkanlah,

ayahs.arabic: وَلَا تَمْنُن تَسْتَكْثِرُ
ayahs.sahih: And do not confer favor to acquire more
ayahs.clear: And show no favor seeking gain.
ayahs.kemenag: dan janganlah kamu memberi (dengan maksud) memperoleh (balasan) yang lebih banyak.

ayahs.arabic: وَلِرَبِّكَ فَٱصْبِرْ
ayahs.sahih: But for your Lord be patient.
ayahs.clear: And be constant for your Lord.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan untuk (memenuhi perintah) Tuhanmu, bersabarlah.

ayahs.arabic: فَإِذَا نُقِرَ فِى ٱلنَّاقُورِ
ayahs.sahih: And when the trumpet is blown,
ayahs.clear: When the Trumpet is blown.
ayahs.kemenag: Apabila ditiup sangkakala,

ayahs.arabic: فَذَٰلِكَ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ يَوْمٌ عَسِيرٌ
ayahs.sahih: That Day will be a difficult day
ayahs.clear: That Day will be a difficult day.
ayahs.kemenag: maka waktu itu adalah waktu (datangnya) hari yang sulit,

ayahs.arabic: عَلَى ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ غَيْرُ يَسِيرٍۢ
ayahs.sahih: For the disbelievers - not easy.
ayahs.clear: For the disbelievers—not easy.
ayahs.kemenag: bagi orang-orang kafir lagi tidak mudah.

ayahs.arabic: ذَرْنِى وَمَنْ خَلَقْتُ وَحِيدًۭا
ayahs.sahih: Leave Me with the one I created alone
ayahs.clear: Leave Me to him whom I created alone.
ayahs.kemenag: Biarkanlah Aku bertindak terhadap orang yang Aku telah menciptakannya sendirian.

ayahs.arabic: وَجَعَلْتُ لَهُۥ مَالًۭا مَّمْدُودًۭا
ayahs.sahih: And to whom I granted extensive wealth
ayahs.clear: And gave him vast wealth.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan Aku jadikan baginya harta benda yang banyak,

ayahs.arabic: وَبَنِينَ شُهُودًۭا
ayahs.sahih: And children present [with him]
ayahs.clear: And children as witnesses.
ayahs.kemenag: dan anak-anak yang selalu bersama dia,

ayahs.arabic: وَمَهَّدتُّ لَهُۥ تَمْهِيدًۭا
ayahs.sahih: And spread [everything] before him, easing [his life].
ayahs.clear: And smoothed things for him.
ayahs.kemenag: dan Ku-lapangkan baginya (rezeki dan kekuasaan) dengan selapang-lapangnya,

ayahs.arabic: ثُمَّ يَطْمَعُ أَنْ أَزِيدَ
ayahs.sahih: Then he desires that I should add more.
ayahs.clear: Then he wants Me to add yet more!
ayahs.kemenag: kemudian dia ingin sekali supaya Aku menambahnya.

ayahs.arabic: كَلَّآ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ لِءَايَٰتِنَا عَنِيدًۭا
ayahs.sahih: No! Indeed, he has been toward Our verses obstinate.
ayahs.clear: By no means! He was stubborn towards Our revelations.
ayahs.kemenag: Sekali-kali tidak (akan Aku tambah), karena sesungguhnya dia menentang ayat-ayat Kami (Al Quran).

ayahs.arabic: سَأُرْهِقُهُۥ صَعُودًا
ayahs.sahih: I will cover him with arduous torment.
ayahs.clear: I will exhaust him increasingly.
ayahs.kemenag: Aku akan membebaninya mendaki pendakian yang memayahkan.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّهُۥ فَكَّرَ وَقَدَّرَ
ayahs.sahih: Indeed, he thought and deliberated.
ayahs.clear: He thought and analyzed.
ayahs.kemenag: Sesungguhnya dia telah memikirkan dan menetapkan (apa yang ditetapkannya),

ayahs.arabic: فَقُتِلَ كَيْفَ قَدَّرَ
ayahs.sahih: So may he be destroyed [for] how he deliberated.
ayahs.clear: May he perish, how he analyzed.
ayahs.kemenag: maka celakalah dia! Bagaimana dia menetapkan?,

ayahs.arabic: ثُمَّ قُتِلَ كَيْفَ قَدَّرَ
ayahs.sahih: Then may he be destroyed [for] how he deliberated.
ayahs.clear: Again: may he perish, how he analyzed.
ayahs.kemenag: kemudian celakalah dia! Bagaimanakah dia menetapkan?,

ayahs.arabic: ثُمَّ نَظَرَ
ayahs.sahih: Then he considered [again];
ayahs.clear: Then he looked.
ayahs.kemenag: kemudian dia memikirkan,

ayahs.arabic: ثُمَّ عَبَسَ وَبَسَرَ
ayahs.sahih: Then he frowned and scowled;
ayahs.clear: Then he frowned and whined.
ayahs.kemenag: sesudah itu dia bermasam muka dan merengut,

ayahs.arabic: ثُمَّ أَدْبَرَ وَٱسْتَكْبَرَ
ayahs.sahih: Then he turned back and was arrogant
ayahs.clear: Then he turned back and was proud.
ayahs.kemenag: kemudian dia berpaling (dari kebenaran) dan menyombongkan diri,

ayahs.arabic: فَقَالَ إِنْ هَٰذَآ إِلَّا سِحْرٌۭ يُؤْثَرُ
ayahs.sahih: And said, "This is not but magic imitated [from others].
ayahs.clear: And said, “This is nothing but magic from the past.
ayahs.kemenag: lalu dia berkata: "(Al Quran) ini tidak lain hanyalah sihir yang dipelajari (dari orang-orang dahulu),

ayahs.arabic: إِنْ هَٰذَآ إِلَّا قَوْلُ ٱلْبَشَرِ
ayahs.sahih: This is not but the word of a human being."
ayahs.clear: This is nothing but the word of a mortal.”
ayahs.kemenag: ini tidak lain hanyalah perkataan manusia".

ayahs.arabic: سَأُصْلِيهِ سَقَرَ
ayahs.sahih: I will drive him into Saqar.
ayahs.clear: I will roast him in Saqar.
ayahs.kemenag: Aku akan memasukkannya ke dalam (neraka) Saqar.

ayahs.arabic: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا سَقَرُ
ayahs.sahih: And what can make you know what is Saqar?
ayahs.clear: But what will explain to you what Saqar is?
ayahs.kemenag: Tahukah kamu apakah (neraka) Saqar itu?

ayahs.arabic: لَا تُبْقِى وَلَا تَذَرُ
ayahs.sahih: It lets nothing remain and leaves nothing [unburned],
ayahs.clear: It neither leaves, nor spares.
ayahs.kemenag: Saqar itu tidak meninggalkan dan tidak membiarkan.

ayahs.arabic: لَوَّاحَةٌۭ لِّلْبَشَرِ
ayahs.sahih: Blackening the skins.
ayahs.clear: It scorches the flesh.
ayahs.kemenag: (Neraka Saqar) adalah pembakar kulit manusia.

ayahs.arabic: عَلَيْهَا تِسْعَةَ عَشَرَ
ayahs.sahih: Over it are nineteen [angels].
ayahs.clear: Over it are Nineteen.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan di atasnya ada sembilan belas (malaikat penjaga).

ayahs.arabic: وَمَا جَعَلْنَآ أَصْحَٰبَ ٱلنَّارِ إِلَّا مَلَٰٓئِكَةًۭ ۙ وَمَا جَعَلْنَا عِدَّتَهُمْ إِلَّا فِتْنَةًۭ لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لِيَسْتَيْقِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ وَيَزْدَادَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ إِيمَٰنًۭا ۙ وَلَا يَرْتَابَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ وَٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ ۙ وَلِيَقُولَ ٱلَّذِينَ فِى قُلُوبِهِم مَّرَضٌۭ وَٱلْكَٰفِرُونَ مَاذَآ أَرَادَ ٱللَّهُ بِهَٰذَا مَثَلًۭا ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ يُضِلُّ ٱللَّهُ مَن يَشَآءُ وَيَهْدِى مَن يَشَآءُ ۚ وَمَا يَعْلَمُ جُنُودَ رَبِّكَ إِلَّا هُوَ ۚ وَمَا هِىَ إِلَّا ذِكْرَىٰ لِلْبَشَرِ
ayahs.sahih: And We have not made the keepers of the Fire except angels. And We have not made their number except as a trial for those who disbelieve - that those who were given the Scripture will be convinced and those who have believed will increase in faith and those who were given the Scripture and the believers will not doubt and that those in whose hearts is hypocrisy and the disbelievers will say, "What does Allah intend by this as an example?" Thus does Allah leave astray whom He wills and guides whom He wills. And none knows the soldiers of your Lord except Him. And mention of the Fire is not but a reminder to humanity.
ayahs.clear: We have appointed only angels to be wardens of the Fire, and caused their number to be a stumbling block for those who disbelieve; so that those given the Scripture may attain certainty; and those who believe may increase in faith; and those given the Scripture and the believers may not doubt; and those in whose hearts is sickness and the unbelievers may say, “What did God intend by this parable?” Thus God leads astray whom He wills, and guides whom He wills. None knows the soldiers of your Lord except He. This is nothing but a reminder for the mortals.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan tiada Kami jadikan penjaga neraka itu melainkan dari malaikat: dan tidaklah Kami menjadikan bilangan mereka itu melainkan untuk jadi cobaan bagi orang-orang kafir, supaya orang-orang yang diberi Al-Kitab menjadi yakin dan supaya orang yang beriman bertambah imannya dan supaya orang-orang yang diberi Al Kitab dan orng-orang mukmin itu tidak ragu-ragu dan supaya orang-orang yang di dalam hatinya ada penyakit dan orang-orang kafir (mengatakan): "Apakah yang dikehendaki Allah dengan bilangan ini sebagai suatu perumpamaan?" Demikianlah Allah membiarkan sesat orang-orang yang dikehendaki-Nya dan memberi petunjuk kepada siapa yang dikehendaki-Nya. Dan tidak ada yang mengetahui tentara Tuhanmu melainkan Dia sendiri. Dan Saqar itu tiada lain hanyalah peringatan bagi manusia.

ayahs.arabic: كَلَّا وَٱلْقَمَرِ
ayahs.sahih: No! By the moon
ayahs.clear: Nay! By the moon.
ayahs.kemenag: Sekali-kali tidak, demi bulan,

ayahs.arabic: وَٱلَّيْلِ إِذْ أَدْبَرَ
ayahs.sahih: And [by] the night when it departs
ayahs.clear: And the night as it retreats.
ayahs.kemenag: dan malam ketika telah berlalu,

ayahs.arabic: وَٱلصُّبْحِ إِذَآ أَسْفَرَ
ayahs.sahih: And [by] the morning when it brightens,
ayahs.clear: And the morning as it lights up.
ayahs.kemenag: dan subuh apabila mulai terang.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّهَا لَإِحْدَى ٱلْكُبَرِ
ayahs.sahih: Indeed, the Fire is of the greatest [afflictions]
ayahs.clear: It is one of the greatest.
ayahs.kemenag: Sesungguhnya Saqar itu adalah salah satu bencana yang amat besar,

ayahs.arabic: نَذِيرًۭا لِّلْبَشَرِ
ayahs.sahih: As a warning to humanity -
ayahs.clear: A warning to the mortals.
ayahs.kemenag: sebagai ancaman bagi manusia.

ayahs.arabic: لِمَن شَآءَ مِنكُمْ أَن يَتَقَدَّمَ أَوْ يَتَأَخَّرَ
ayahs.sahih: To whoever wills among you to proceed or stay behind.
ayahs.clear: To whomever among you wishes to advance, or regress.
ayahs.kemenag: (Yaitu) bagi siapa di antaramu yang berkehendak akan maju atau mundur.

ayahs.arabic: كُلُّ نَفْسٍۭ بِمَا كَسَبَتْ رَهِينَةٌ
ayahs.sahih: Every soul, for what it has earned, will be retained
ayahs.clear: Every soul is hostage to what it has earned.
ayahs.kemenag: Tiap-tiap diri bertanggung jawab atas apa yang telah diperbuatnya,

ayahs.arabic: إِلَّآ أَصْحَٰبَ ٱلْيَمِينِ
ayahs.sahih: Except the companions of the right,
ayahs.clear: Except for those on the Right.
ayahs.kemenag: kecuali golongan kanan,

ayahs.arabic: فِى جَنَّٰتٍۢ يَتَسَآءَلُونَ
ayahs.sahih: [Who will be] in gardens, questioning each other
ayahs.clear: In Gardens, inquiring.
ayahs.kemenag: berada di dalam surga, mereka tanya menanya,

ayahs.arabic: عَنِ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ
ayahs.sahih: About the criminals,
ayahs.clear: About the guilty.
ayahs.kemenag: tentang (keadaan) orang-orang yang berdosa,

ayahs.arabic: مَا سَلَكَكُمْ فِى سَقَرَ
ayahs.sahih: [And asking them], "What put you into Saqar?"
ayahs.clear: “What drove you into Saqar?”
ayahs.kemenag: "Apakah yang memasukkan kamu ke dalam Saqar (neraka)?"

ayahs.arabic: قَالُوا۟ لَمْ نَكُ مِنَ ٱلْمُصَلِّينَ
ayahs.sahih: They will say, "We were not of those who prayed,
ayahs.clear: They will say, “We were not of those who prayed.
ayahs.kemenag: Mereka menjawab: "Kami dahulu tidak termasuk orang-orang yang mengerjakan shalat,

ayahs.arabic: وَلَمْ نَكُ نُطْعِمُ ٱلْمِسْكِينَ
ayahs.sahih: Nor did we used to feed the poor.
ayahs.clear: Nor did we feed the destitute.
ayahs.kemenag: dan kami tidak (pula) memberi makan orang miskin,

ayahs.arabic: وَكُنَّا نَخُوضُ مَعَ ٱلْخَآئِضِينَ
ayahs.sahih: And we used to enter into vain discourse with those who engaged [in it],
ayahs.clear: And we used to indulge with those who indulge.
ayahs.kemenag: dan adalah kami membicarakan yang bathil, bersama dengan orang-orang yang membicarakannya,

ayahs.arabic: وَكُنَّا نُكَذِّبُ بِيَوْمِ ٱلدِّينِ
ayahs.sahih: And we used to deny the Day of Recompense
ayahs.clear: And we used to deny the Day of Judgment.
ayahs.kemenag: dan adalah kami mendustakan hari pembalasan,

ayahs.arabic: حَتَّىٰٓ أَتَىٰنَا ٱلْيَقِينُ
ayahs.sahih: Until there came to us the certainty."
ayahs.clear: Until the Inevitable came upon us.”
ayahs.kemenag: hingga datang kepada kami kematian".

ayahs.arabic: فَمَا تَنفَعُهُمْ شَفَٰعَةُ ٱلشَّٰفِعِينَ
ayahs.sahih: So there will not benefit them the intercession of [any] intercessors.
ayahs.clear: But the intercession of intercessors will not help them.
ayahs.kemenag: Maka tidak berguna lagi bagi mereka syafa'at dari orang-orang yang memberikan syafa'at.

ayahs.arabic: فَمَا لَهُمْ عَنِ ٱلتَّذْكِرَةِ مُعْرِضِينَ
ayahs.sahih: Then what is [the matter] with them that they are, from the reminder, turning away
ayahs.clear: Why are they turning away from the Reminder?
ayahs.kemenag: Maka mengapa mereka (orang-orang kafir) berpaling dari peringatan (Allah)?,

ayahs.arabic: كَأَنَّهُمْ حُمُرٌۭ مُّسْتَنفِرَةٌۭ
ayahs.sahih: As if they were alarmed donkeys
ayahs.clear: As though they were panicked donkeys.
ayahs.kemenag: seakan-akan mereka itu keledai liar yang lari terkejut,

ayahs.arabic: فَرَّتْ مِن قَسْوَرَةٍۭ
ayahs.sahih: Fleeing from a lion?
ayahs.clear: Fleeing from a lion?
ayahs.kemenag: lari daripada singa.

ayahs.arabic: بَلْ يُرِيدُ كُلُّ ٱمْرِئٍۢ مِّنْهُمْ أَن يُؤْتَىٰ صُحُفًۭا مُّنَشَّرَةًۭ
ayahs.sahih: Rather, every person among them desires that he would be given scriptures spread about.
ayahs.clear: Yet every one of them desires to be given scrolls unrolled.
ayahs.kemenag: Bahkan tiap-tiap orang dari mereka berkehendak supaya diberikan kepadanya lembaran-lembaran yang terbuka.

ayahs.arabic: كَلَّا ۖ بَل لَّا يَخَافُونَ ٱلْءَاخِرَةَ
ayahs.sahih: No! But they do not fear the Hereafter.
ayahs.clear: No indeed! But they do not fear the Hereafter.
ayahs.kemenag: Sekali-kali tidak. Sebenarnya mereka tidak takut kepada negeri akhirat.

ayahs.arabic: كَلَّآ إِنَّهُۥ تَذْكِرَةٌۭ
ayahs.sahih: No! Indeed, the Qur'an is a reminder
ayahs.clear: Nevertheless, it is a reminder.
ayahs.kemenag: Sekali-kali tidak demikian halnya. Sesungguhnya Al Quran itu adalah peringatan.

ayahs.arabic: فَمَن شَآءَ ذَكَرَهُۥ
ayahs.sahih: Then whoever wills will remember it.
ayahs.clear: So whoever wills, shall remember it.
ayahs.kemenag: Maka barangsiapa menghendaki, niscaya dia mengambil pelajaran daripadanya (Al Quran).

ayahs.arabic: وَمَا يَذْكُرُونَ إِلَّآ أَن يَشَآءَ ٱللَّهُ ۚ هُوَ أَهْلُ ٱلتَّقْوَىٰ وَأَهْلُ ٱلْمَغْفِرَةِ
ayahs.sahih: And they will not remember except that Allah wills. He is worthy of fear and adequate for [granting] forgiveness.
ayahs.clear: But they will not remember, unless God wills. He is the Source of Righteousness, and the Source of Forgiveness.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan mereka tidak akan mengambil pelajaran daripadanya kecuali (jika) Allah menghendakinya. Dia (Allah) adalah Tuhan Yang patut (kita) bertakwa kepada-Nya dan berhak memberi ampun.

ayahs.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ لَآ أُقْسِمُ بِيَوْمِ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ
ayahs.sahih: I swear by the Day of Resurrection
ayahs.clear: I swear by the Day of Resurrection.
ayahs.kemenag: Aku bersumpah demi hari kiamat,

ayahs.arabic: وَلَآ أُقْسِمُ بِٱلنَّفْسِ ٱللَّوَّامَةِ
ayahs.sahih: And I swear by the reproaching soul [to the certainty of resurrection].
ayahs.clear: And I swear by the blaming soul.
ayahs.kemenag: dan aku bersumpah dengan jiwa yang amat menyesali (dirinya sendiri).

ayahs.arabic: أَيَحْسَبُ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ أَلَّن نَّجْمَعَ عِظَامَهُۥ
ayahs.sahih: Does man think that We will not assemble his bones?
ayahs.clear: Does man think that We will not reassemble his bones?
ayahs.kemenag: Apakah manusia mengira, bahwa Kami tidak akan mengumpulkan (kembali) tulang belulangnya?

ayahs.arabic: بَلَىٰ قَٰدِرِينَ عَلَىٰٓ أَن نُّسَوِّىَ بَنَانَهُۥ
ayahs.sahih: Yes. [We are] Able [even] to proportion his fingertips.
ayahs.clear: Yes indeed; We are Able to reconstruct his fingertips.
ayahs.kemenag: Bukan demikian, sebenarnya Kami kuasa menyusun (kembali) jari jemarinya dengan sempurna.

ayahs.arabic: بَلْ يُرِيدُ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ لِيَفْجُرَ أَمَامَهُۥ
ayahs.sahih: But man desires to continue in sin.
ayahs.clear: But man wants to deny what is ahead of him.
ayahs.kemenag: Bahkan manusia itu hendak membuat maksiat terus menerus.

ayahs.arabic: يَسْـَٔلُ أَيَّانَ يَوْمُ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ
ayahs.sahih: He asks, "When is the Day of Resurrection?"
ayahs.clear: He asks, “When is the Day of Resurrection?”
ayahs.kemenag: Ia berkata: "Bilakah hari kiamat itu?"

ayahs.arabic: فَإِذَا بَرِقَ ٱلْبَصَرُ
ayahs.sahih: So when vision is dazzled
ayahs.clear: When vision is dazzled.
ayahs.kemenag: Maka apabila mata terbelalak (ketakutan),

ayahs.arabic: وَخَسَفَ ٱلْقَمَرُ
ayahs.sahih: And the moon darkens
ayahs.clear: And the moon is eclipsed.
ayahs.kemenag: dan apabila bulan telah hilang cahayanya,

ayahs.arabic: وَجُمِعَ ٱلشَّمْسُ وَٱلْقَمَرُ
ayahs.sahih: And the sun and the moon are joined,
ayahs.clear: And the sun and the moon are joined together.
ayahs.kemenag: dan matahari dan bulan dikumpulkan,

ayahs.arabic: يَقُولُ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ يَوْمَئِذٍ أَيْنَ ٱلْمَفَرُّ
ayahs.sahih: Man will say on that Day, "Where is the [place of] escape?"
ayahs.clear: On that Day, man will say, “Where is the escape?”
ayahs.kemenag: pada hari itu manusia berkata: "Ke mana tempat berlari?"

ayahs.arabic: كَلَّا لَا وَزَرَ
ayahs.sahih: No! There is no refuge.
ayahs.clear: No indeed! There is no refuge.
ayahs.kemenag: sekali-kali tidak! Tidak ada tempat berlindung!

ayahs.arabic: إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ يَوْمَئِذٍ ٱلْمُسْتَقَرُّ
ayahs.sahih: To your Lord, that Day, is the [place of] permanence.
ayahs.clear: To your Lord on that Day is the settlement.
ayahs.kemenag: Hanya kepada Tuhanmu sajalah pada hari itu tempat kembali.

ayahs.arabic: يُنَبَّؤُا۟ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ يَوْمَئِذٍۭ بِمَا قَدَّمَ وَأَخَّرَ
ayahs.sahih: Man will be informed that Day of what he sent ahead and kept back.
ayahs.clear: On that Day man will be informed of everything he put forward, and everything he left behind.
ayahs.kemenag: Pada hari itu diberitakan kepada manusia apa yang telah dikerjakannya dan apa yang dilalaikannya.

ayahs.arabic: بَلِ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ عَلَىٰ نَفْسِهِۦ بَصِيرَةٌۭ
ayahs.sahih: Rather, man, against himself, will be a witness,
ayahs.clear: And man will be evidence against himself.
ayahs.kemenag: Bahkan manusia itu menjadi saksi atas dirinya sendiri,

ayahs.arabic: وَلَوْ أَلْقَىٰ مَعَاذِيرَهُۥ
ayahs.sahih: Even if he presents his excuses.
ayahs.clear: Even as he presents his excuses.
ayahs.kemenag: meskipun dia mengemukakan alasan-alasannya.

ayahs.arabic: لَا تُحَرِّكْ بِهِۦ لِسَانَكَ لِتَعْجَلَ بِهِۦٓ
ayahs.sahih: Move not your tongue with it, [O Muhammad], to hasten with recitation of the Qur'an.
ayahs.clear: Do not wag your tongue with it, to hurry on with it.
ayahs.kemenag: Janganlah kamu gerakkan lidahmu untuk (membaca) Al Quran karena hendak cepat-cepat (menguasai)nya.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ عَلَيْنَا جَمْعَهُۥ وَقُرْءَانَهُۥ
ayahs.sahih: Indeed, upon Us is its collection [in your heart] and [to make possible] its recitation.
ayahs.clear: Upon Us is its collection and its recitation.
ayahs.kemenag: Sesungguhnya atas tanggungan Kamilah mengumpulkannya (di dadamu) dan (membuatmu pandai) membacanya.

ayahs.arabic: فَإِذَا قَرَأْنَٰهُ فَٱتَّبِعْ قُرْءَانَهُۥ
ayahs.sahih: So when We have recited it [through Gabriel], then follow its recitation.
ayahs.clear: Then, when We have recited it, follow its recitation.
ayahs.kemenag: Apabila Kami telah selesai membacakannya maka ikutilah bacaannya itu.

ayahs.arabic: ثُمَّ إِنَّ عَلَيْنَا بَيَانَهُۥ
ayahs.sahih: Then upon Us is its clarification [to you].
ayahs.clear: Then upon Us is its explanation.
ayahs.kemenag: Kemudian, sesungguhnya atas tanggungan Kamilah penjelasannya.

ayahs.arabic: كَلَّا بَلْ تُحِبُّونَ ٱلْعَاجِلَةَ
ayahs.sahih: No! But you love the immediate
ayahs.clear: Alas, you love the fleeting life.
ayahs.kemenag: Sekali-kali janganlah demikian. Sebenarnya kamu (hai manusia) mencintai kehidupan dunia,

ayahs.arabic: وَتَذَرُونَ ٱلْءَاخِرَةَ
ayahs.sahih: And leave the Hereafter.
ayahs.clear: And you disregard the Hereafter.
ayahs.kemenag: dan meninggalkan (kehidupan) akhirat.

ayahs.arabic: وُجُوهٌۭ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ نَّاضِرَةٌ
ayahs.sahih: [Some] faces, that Day, will be radiant,
ayahs.clear: Faces on that Day will be radiant.
ayahs.kemenag: Wajah-wajah (orang-orang mukmin) pada hari itu berseri-seri.

ayahs.arabic: إِلَىٰ رَبِّهَا نَاظِرَةٌۭ
ayahs.sahih: Looking at their Lord.
ayahs.clear: Looking towards their Lord.
ayahs.kemenag: Kepada Tuhannyalah mereka melihat.

ayahs.arabic: وَوُجُوهٌۭ يَوْمَئِذٍۭ بَاسِرَةٌۭ
ayahs.sahih: And [some] faces, that Day, will be contorted,
ayahs.clear: And faces on that Day will be gloomy.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan wajah-wajah (orang kafir) pada hari itu muram,

ayahs.arabic: تَظُنُّ أَن يُفْعَلَ بِهَا فَاقِرَةٌۭ
ayahs.sahih: Expecting that there will be done to them [something] backbreaking.
ayahs.clear: Realizing that a back-breaker has befallen them.
ayahs.kemenag: mereka yakin bahwa akan ditimpakan kepadanya malapetaka yang amat dahsyat.

ayahs.arabic: كَلَّآ إِذَا بَلَغَتِ ٱلتَّرَاقِىَ
ayahs.sahih: No! When the soul has reached the collar bones
ayahs.clear: Indeed, when it has reached the breast-bones.
ayahs.kemenag: Sekali-kali jangan. Apabila nafas (seseorang) telah (mendesak) sampai ke kerongkongan,

ayahs.arabic: وَقِيلَ مَنْ ۜ رَاقٍۢ
ayahs.sahih: And it is said, "Who will cure [him]?"
ayahs.clear: And it is said, “Who is the healer?”
ayahs.kemenag: dan dikatakan (kepadanya): "Siapakah yang dapat menyembuhkan?",

ayahs.arabic: وَظَنَّ أَنَّهُ ٱلْفِرَاقُ
ayahs.sahih: And the dying one is certain that it is the [time of] separation
ayahs.clear: And He realizes that it is the parting.
ayahs.kemenag: dan dia yakin bahwa sesungguhnya itulah waktu perpisahan (dengan dunia),

ayahs.arabic: وَٱلْتَفَّتِ ٱلسَّاقُ بِٱلسَّاقِ
ayahs.sahih: And the leg is wound about the leg,
ayahs.clear: And leg is entwined with leg.
ayahs.kemenag: dan bertaut betis (kiri) dan betis (kanan),

ayahs.arabic: إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ يَوْمَئِذٍ ٱلْمَسَاقُ
ayahs.sahih: To your Lord, that Day, will be the procession.
ayahs.clear: To your Lord on that Day is the drive.
ayahs.kemenag: kepada Tuhanmulah pada hari itu kamu dihalau.

ayahs.arabic: فَلَا صَدَّقَ وَلَا صَلَّىٰ
ayahs.sahih: And the disbeliever had not believed, nor had he prayed.
ayahs.clear: He neither believed nor prayed.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan ia tidak mau membenarkan (Rasul dan Al Quran) dan tidak mau mengerjakan shalat,

ayahs.arabic: وَلَٰكِن كَذَّبَ وَتَوَلَّىٰ
ayahs.sahih: But [instead], he denied and turned away.
ayahs.clear: But he denied and turned away.
ayahs.kemenag: tetapi ia mendustakan (Rasul) dam berpaling (dari kebenaran),

ayahs.arabic: ثُمَّ ذَهَبَ إِلَىٰٓ أَهْلِهِۦ يَتَمَطَّىٰٓ
ayahs.sahih: And then he went to his people, swaggering [in pride].
ayahs.clear: Then he went to his family, full of pride.
ayahs.kemenag: kemudian ia pergi kepada ahlinya dengan berlagak (sombong).

ayahs.arabic: أَوْلَىٰ لَكَ فَأَوْلَىٰ
ayahs.sahih: Woe to you, and woe!
ayahs.clear: Woe to you; and woe.
ayahs.kemenag: Kecelakaanlah bagimu (hai orang kafir) dan kecelakaanlah bagimu,

ayahs.arabic: ثُمَّ أَوْلَىٰ لَكَ فَأَوْلَىٰٓ
ayahs.sahih: Then woe to you, and woe!
ayahs.clear: Then again: Woe to you; and woe.
ayahs.kemenag: kemudian kecelakaanlah bagimu (hai orang kafir) dan kecelakaanlah bagimu.

ayahs.arabic: أَيَحْسَبُ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ أَن يُتْرَكَ سُدًى
ayahs.sahih: Does man think that he will be left neglected?
ayahs.clear: Does man think that he will be left without purpose?
ayahs.kemenag: Apakah manusia mengira, bahwa ia akan dibiarkan begitu saja (tanpa pertanggung jawaban)?

ayahs.arabic: أَلَمْ يَكُ نُطْفَةًۭ مِّن مَّنِىٍّۢ يُمْنَىٰ
ayahs.sahih: Had he not been a sperm from semen emitted?
ayahs.clear: Was he not a drop of ejaculated semen?
ayahs.kemenag: Bukankah dia dahulu setetes mani yang ditumpahkan (ke dalam rahim),

ayahs.arabic: ثُمَّ كَانَ عَلَقَةًۭ فَخَلَقَ فَسَوَّىٰ
ayahs.sahih: Then he was a clinging clot, and [Allah] created [his form] and proportioned [him]
ayahs.clear: Then he became a clot. And He created and proportioned?
ayahs.kemenag: kemudian mani itu menjadi segumpal darah, lalu Allah menciptakannya, dan menyempurnakannya,

ayahs.arabic: فَجَعَلَ مِنْهُ ٱلزَّوْجَيْنِ ٱلذَّكَرَ وَٱلْأُنثَىٰٓ
ayahs.sahih: And made of him two mates, the male and the female.
ayahs.clear: And made of him the two sexes, the male and the female?
ayahs.kemenag: lalu Allah menjadikan daripadanya sepasang: laki-laki dan perempuan.

ayahs.arabic: أَلَيْسَ ذَٰلِكَ بِقَٰدِرٍ عَلَىٰٓ أَن يُحْۦِىَ ٱلْمَوْتَىٰ
ayahs.sahih: Is not that [Creator] Able to give life to the dead?
ayahs.clear: Is He not Able to revive the dead?
ayahs.kemenag: Bukankah (Allah yang berbuat) demikian berkuasa (pula) menghidupkan orang mati?

ayahs.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ هَلْ أَتَىٰ عَلَى ٱلْإِنسَٰنِ حِينٌۭ مِّنَ ٱلدَّهْرِ لَمْ يَكُن شَيْـًۭٔا مَّذْكُورًا
ayahs.sahih: Has there [not] come upon man a period of time when he was not a thing [even] mentioned?
ayahs.clear: Has there come upon man a period of time when he was nothing to be mentioned?
ayahs.kemenag: Bukankah telah datang atas manusia satu waktu dari masa, sedang dia ketika itu belum merupakan sesuatu yang dapat disebut?

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّا خَلَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ مِن نُّطْفَةٍ أَمْشَاجٍۢ نَّبْتَلِيهِ فَجَعَلْنَٰهُ سَمِيعًۢا بَصِيرًا
ayahs.sahih: Indeed, We created man from a sperm-drop mixture that We may try him; and We made him hearing and seeing.
ayahs.clear: We created man from a liquid mixture, to test him; and We made him hearing and seeing.
ayahs.kemenag: Sesungguhnya Kami telah menciptakan manusia dari setetes mani yang bercampur yang Kami hendak mengujinya (dengan perintah dan larangan), karena itu Kami jadikan dia mendengar dan melihat.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّا هَدَيْنَٰهُ ٱلسَّبِيلَ إِمَّا شَاكِرًۭا وَإِمَّا كَفُورًا
ayahs.sahih: Indeed, We guided him to the way, be he grateful or be he ungrateful.
ayahs.clear: We guided him to the way, be he appreciative or unappreciative.
ayahs.kemenag: Sesungguhnya Kami telah menunjukinya jalan yang lurus; ada yang bersyukur dan ada pula yang kafir.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّآ أَعْتَدْنَا لِلْكَٰفِرِينَ سَلَٰسِلَا۟ وَأَغْلَٰلًۭا وَسَعِيرًا
ayahs.sahih: Indeed, We have prepared for the disbelievers chains and shackles and a blaze.
ayahs.clear: We have prepared for the faithless chains, and yokes, and a Searing Fire.
ayahs.kemenag: Sesungguhnya Kami menyediakan bagi orang-orang kafir rantai, belenggu dan neraka yang menyala-nyala.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلْأَبْرَارَ يَشْرَبُونَ مِن كَأْسٍۢ كَانَ مِزَاجُهَا كَافُورًا
ayahs.sahih: Indeed, the righteous will drink from a cup [of wine] whose mixture is of Kafur,
ayahs.clear: But the righteous will drink from a cup whose mixture is aroma.
ayahs.kemenag: Sesungguhnya orang-orang yang berbuat kebajikan minum dari gelas (berisi minuman) yang campurannya adalah air kafur,

ayahs.arabic: عَيْنًۭا يَشْرَبُ بِهَا عِبَادُ ٱللَّهِ يُفَجِّرُونَهَا تَفْجِيرًۭا
ayahs.sahih: A spring of which the [righteous] servants of Allah will drink; they will make it gush forth in force [and abundance].
ayahs.clear: A spring from which the servants of God will drink, making it gush abundantly.
ayahs.kemenag: (yaitu) mata air (dalam surga) yang daripadanya hamba-hamba Allah minum, yang mereka dapat mengalirkannya dengan sebaik-baiknya.

ayahs.arabic: يُوفُونَ بِٱلنَّذْرِ وَيَخَافُونَ يَوْمًۭا كَانَ شَرُّهُۥ مُسْتَطِيرًۭا
ayahs.sahih: They [are those who] fulfill [their] vows and fear a Day whose evil will be widespread.
ayahs.clear: They fulfill their vows, and dread a Day whose ill is widespread.
ayahs.kemenag: Mereka menunaikan nazar dan takut akan suatu hari yang azabnya merata di mana-mana.

ayahs.arabic: وَيُطْعِمُونَ ٱلطَّعَامَ عَلَىٰ حُبِّهِۦ مِسْكِينًۭا وَيَتِيمًۭا وَأَسِيرًا
ayahs.sahih: And they give food in spite of love for it to the needy, the orphan, and the captive,
ayahs.clear: And they feed, for the love of Him, the poor, and the orphan, and the captive.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan mereka memberikan makanan yang disukainya kepada orang miskin, anak yatim dan orang yang ditawan.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّمَا نُطْعِمُكُمْ لِوَجْهِ ٱللَّهِ لَا نُرِيدُ مِنكُمْ جَزَآءًۭ وَلَا شُكُورًا
ayahs.sahih: [Saying], "We feed you only for the countenance of Allah. We wish not from you reward or gratitude.
ayahs.clear: “We only feed you for the sake of God. We want from you neither compensation, nor gratitude.
ayahs.kemenag: Sesungguhnya kami memberi makanan kepadamu hanyalah untuk mengharapkan keridhaan Allah, kami tidak menghendaki balasan dari kamu dan tidak pula (ucapan) terima kasih.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّا نَخَافُ مِن رَّبِّنَا يَوْمًا عَبُوسًۭا قَمْطَرِيرًۭا
ayahs.sahih: Indeed, We fear from our Lord a Day austere and distressful."
ayahs.clear: We dread from our Lord a frowning grim Day.”
ayahs.kemenag: Sesungguhnya kami takut akan (azab) Tuhan kami pada suatu hari yang (di hari itu) orang-orang bermuka masam penuh kesulitan.

ayahs.arabic: فَوَقَىٰهُمُ ٱللَّهُ شَرَّ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْيَوْمِ وَلَقَّىٰهُمْ نَضْرَةًۭ وَسُرُورًۭا
ayahs.sahih: So Allah will protect them from the evil of that Day and give them radiance and happiness
ayahs.clear: So God will protect them from the ills of that Day, and will grant them radiance and joy.
ayahs.kemenag: Maka Tuhan memelihara mereka dari kesusahan hari itu, dan memberikan kepada mereka kejernihan (wajah) dan kegembiraan hati.

ayahs.arabic: وَجَزَىٰهُم بِمَا صَبَرُوا۟ جَنَّةًۭ وَحَرِيرًۭا
ayahs.sahih: And will reward them for what they patiently endured [with] a garden [in Paradise] and silk [garments].
ayahs.clear: And will reward them for their patience with a Garden and silk.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan Dia memberi balasan kepada mereka karena kesabaran mereka (dengan) surga dan (pakaian) sutera,

ayahs.arabic: مُّتَّكِـِٔينَ فِيهَا عَلَى ٱلْأَرَآئِكِ ۖ لَا يَرَوْنَ فِيهَا شَمْسًۭا وَلَا زَمْهَرِيرًۭا
ayahs.sahih: [They will be] reclining therein on adorned couches. They will not see therein any [burning] sun or [freezing] cold.
ayahs.clear: Reclining therein on the thrones; experiencing therein neither sun, nor frost.
ayahs.kemenag: di dalamnya mereka duduk bertelakan di atas dipan, mereka tidak merasakan di dalamnya (teriknya) matahari dan tidak pula dingin yang bersangatan.

ayahs.arabic: وَدَانِيَةً عَلَيْهِمْ ظِلَٰلُهَا وَذُلِّلَتْ قُطُوفُهَا تَذْلِيلًۭا
ayahs.sahih: And near above them are its shades, and its [fruit] to be picked will be lowered in compliance.
ayahs.clear: Its shade hovering over them, and its fruit brought low within reach.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan naungan (pohon-pohon surga itu) dekat di atas mereka dan buahnya dimudahkan memetiknya semudah-mudahnya.

ayahs.arabic: وَيُطَافُ عَلَيْهِم بِـَٔانِيَةٍۢ مِّن فِضَّةٍۢ وَأَكْوَابٍۢ كَانَتْ قَوَارِيرَا۠
ayahs.sahih: And there will be circulated among them vessels of silver and cups having been [created] clear [as glass],
ayahs.clear: Passing around them are vessels of silver, and cups of crystal.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan diedarkan kepada mereka bejana-bejana dari perak dan piala-piala yang bening laksana kaca,

ayahs.arabic: قَوَارِيرَا۟ مِن فِضَّةٍۢ قَدَّرُوهَا تَقْدِيرًۭا
ayahs.sahih: Clear glasses [made] from silver of which they have determined the measure.
ayahs.clear: Crystal of silver—they measured them exactly.
ayahs.kemenag: (yaitu) kaca-kaca (yang terbuat) dari perak yang telah diukur mereka dengan sebaik-baiknya.

ayahs.arabic: وَيُسْقَوْنَ فِيهَا كَأْسًۭا كَانَ مِزَاجُهَا زَنجَبِيلًا
ayahs.sahih: And they will be given to drink a cup [of wine] whose mixture is of ginger
ayahs.clear: They will be served therein with a cup whose flavor is Zanjabeel.
ayahs.kemenag: Di dalam surga itu mereka diberi minum segelas (minuman) yang campurannya adalah jahe.

ayahs.arabic: عَيْنًۭا فِيهَا تُسَمَّىٰ سَلْسَبِيلًۭا
ayahs.sahih: [From] a fountain within Paradise named Salsabeel.
ayahs.clear: A spring therein named Salsabeel.
ayahs.kemenag: (Yang didatangkan dari) sebuah mata air surga yang dinamakan salsabil.

ayahs.arabic: ۞ وَيَطُوفُ عَلَيْهِمْ وِلْدَٰنٌۭ مُّخَلَّدُونَ إِذَا رَأَيْتَهُمْ حَسِبْتَهُمْ لُؤْلُؤًۭا مَّنثُورًۭا
ayahs.sahih: There will circulate among them young boys made eternal. When you see them, you would think them [as beautiful as] scattered pearls.
ayahs.clear: Passing among them are eternalized youths. If you see them, you would think them sprinkled pearls.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan mereka dikelilingi oleh pelayan-pelayan muda yang tetap muda. Apabila kamu melihat mereka, kamu akan mengira mereka, mutiara yang bertaburan.

ayahs.arabic: وَإِذَا رَأَيْتَ ثَمَّ رَأَيْتَ نَعِيمًۭا وَمُلْكًۭا كَبِيرًا
ayahs.sahih: And when you look there [in Paradise], you will see pleasure and great dominion.
ayahs.clear: Wherever you look, you see bliss, and a vast kingdom.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan apabila kamu melihat di sana (surga), niscaya kamu akan melihat berbagai macam kenikmatan dan kerajaan yang besar.

ayahs.arabic: عَٰلِيَهُمْ ثِيَابُ سُندُسٍ خُضْرٌۭ وَإِسْتَبْرَقٌۭ ۖ وَحُلُّوٓا۟ أَسَاوِرَ مِن فِضَّةٍۢ وَسَقَىٰهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ شَرَابًۭا طَهُورًا
ayahs.sahih: Upon the inhabitants will be green garments of fine silk and brocade. And they will be adorned with bracelets of silver, and their Lord will give them a purifying drink.
ayahs.clear: Upon them are garments of green silk, and satin. And they will be adorned with bracelets of silver. And their Lord will offer them a pure drink.
ayahs.kemenag: Mereka memakai pakaian sutera halus yang hijau dan sutera tebal dan dipakaikan kepada mereka gelang terbuat dari perak, dan Tuhan memberikan kepada mereka minuman yang bersih.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ هَٰذَا كَانَ لَكُمْ جَزَآءًۭ وَكَانَ سَعْيُكُم مَّشْكُورًا
ayahs.sahih: [And it will be said], "Indeed, this is for you a reward, and your effort has been appreciated."
ayahs.clear: “This is a reward for you. Your efforts are well appreciated.”
ayahs.kemenag: Sesungguhnya ini adalah balasan untukmu, dan usahamu adalah disyukuri (diberi balasan).

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّا نَحْنُ نَزَّلْنَا عَلَيْكَ ٱلْقُرْءَانَ تَنزِيلًۭا
ayahs.sahih: Indeed, it is We who have sent down to you, [O Muhammad], the Qur'an progressively.
ayahs.clear: It is We who sent down the Quran upon you—a gradual revelation.
ayahs.kemenag: Sesungguhnya Kami telah menurunkan Al Quran kepadamu (hai Muhammad) dengan berangsur-angsur.

ayahs.arabic: فَٱصْبِرْ لِحُكْمِ رَبِّكَ وَلَا تُطِعْ مِنْهُمْ ءَاثِمًا أَوْ كَفُورًۭا
ayahs.sahih: So be patient for the decision of your Lord and do not obey from among them a sinner or ungrateful [disbeliever].
ayahs.clear: So be patient for the decision of your Lord, and do not obey the sinner or the blasphemer among them.
ayahs.kemenag: Maka bersabarlah kamu untuk (melaksanakan) ketetapan Tuhanmu, dan janganlah kamu ikuti orang yang berdosa dan orang yang kafir di antar mereka.

ayahs.arabic: وَٱذْكُرِ ٱسْمَ رَبِّكَ بُكْرَةًۭ وَأَصِيلًۭا
ayahs.sahih: And mention the name of your Lord [in prayer] morning and evening
ayahs.clear: And mention the Name of your Lord, morning and evening.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan sebutlah nama Tuhanmu pada (waktu) pagi dan petang.

ayahs.arabic: وَمِنَ ٱلَّيْلِ فَٱسْجُدْ لَهُۥ وَسَبِّحْهُ لَيْلًۭا طَوِيلًا
ayahs.sahih: And during the night prostrate to Him and exalt Him a long [part of the] night.
ayahs.clear: And for part of the night, prostrate yourself to Him, and glorify Him long into the night.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan pada sebagian dari malam, maka sujudlah kepada-Nya dan bertasbihlah kepada-Nya pada bagian yang panjang dimalam hari.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ يُحِبُّونَ ٱلْعَاجِلَةَ وَيَذَرُونَ وَرَآءَهُمْ يَوْمًۭا ثَقِيلًۭا
ayahs.sahih: Indeed, these [disbelievers] love the immediate and leave behind them a grave Day.
ayahs.clear: As for these: they love the fleeting life, and leave behind a Heavy Day.
ayahs.kemenag: Sesungguhnya mereka (orang kafir) menyukai kehidupan dunia dan mereka tidak memperdulikan kesudahan mereka, pada hari yang berat (hari akhirat).

ayahs.arabic: نَّحْنُ خَلَقْنَٰهُمْ وَشَدَدْنَآ أَسْرَهُمْ ۖ وَإِذَا شِئْنَا بَدَّلْنَآ أَمْثَٰلَهُمْ تَبْدِيلًا
ayahs.sahih: We have created them and strengthened their forms, and when We will, We can change their likenesses with [complete] alteration.
ayahs.clear: We created them, and strengthened their frame; and whenever We will, We can replace them with others like them.
ayahs.kemenag: Kami telah menciptakan mereka dan menguatkan persendian tubuh mereka, apabila Kami menghendaki, Kami sungguh-sungguh mengganti (mereka) dengan orang-orang yang serupa dengan mereka.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ هَٰذِهِۦ تَذْكِرَةٌۭ ۖ فَمَن شَآءَ ٱتَّخَذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ سَبِيلًۭا
ayahs.sahih: Indeed, this is a reminder, so he who wills may take to his Lord a way.
ayahs.clear: This is a reminder; so whoever wills, let him take a path to his Lord.
ayahs.kemenag: Sesungguhnya (ayat-ayat) ini adalah suatu peringatan, maka barangsiapa menghendaki (kebaikan bagi dirinya) niscaya dia mengambil jalan kepada Tuhannya.

ayahs.arabic: وَمَا تَشَآءُونَ إِلَّآ أَن يَشَآءَ ٱللَّهُ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ كَانَ عَلِيمًا حَكِيمًۭا
ayahs.sahih: And you do not will except that Allah wills. Indeed, Allah is ever Knowing and Wise.
ayahs.clear: Yet you cannot will, unless God wills. God is Knowing and Wise.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan kamu tidak mampu (menempuh jalan itu), kecuali bila dikehendaki Allah. Sesungguhnya Allah adalah Maha Mengetahui lagi Maha Bijaksana.

ayahs.arabic: يُدْخِلُ مَن يَشَآءُ فِى رَحْمَتِهِۦ ۚ وَٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ أَعَدَّ لَهُمْ عَذَابًا أَلِيمًۢا
ayahs.sahih: He admits whom He wills into His mercy; but the wrongdoers - He has prepared for them a painful punishment.
ayahs.clear: He admits into His mercy whomever He wills. But as for the wrongdoers, He has prepared for them a painful punishment.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan memasukkan siapa yang dikehendaki-Nya ke dalam rahmat-Nya (surga). Dan bagi orang-orang zalim disediakan-Nya azab yang pedih.

ayahs.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ وَٱلْمُرْسَلَٰتِ عُرْفًۭا
ayahs.sahih: By those [winds] sent forth in gusts
ayahs.clear: By those unleashed in succession.
ayahs.kemenag: Demi malaikat-malaikat yang diutus untuk membawa kebaikan,

ayahs.arabic: فَٱلْعَٰصِفَٰتِ عَصْفًۭا
ayahs.sahih: And the winds that blow violently
ayahs.clear: Storming turbulently.
ayahs.kemenag: dan (malaikat-malaikat) yang terbang dengan kencangnya,

ayahs.arabic: وَٱلنَّٰشِرَٰتِ نَشْرًۭا
ayahs.sahih: And [by] the winds that spread [clouds]
ayahs.clear: Scattering far and wide.
ayahs.kemenag: dan (malaikat-malaikat) yang menyebarkan (rahmat Tuhannya) dengan seluas-luasnya,

ayahs.arabic: فَٱلْفَٰرِقَٰتِ فَرْقًۭا
ayahs.sahih: And those [angels] who bring criterion
ayahs.clear: Separating decisively.
ayahs.kemenag: dan (malaikat-malaikat) yang membedakan (antara yang hak dan yang bathil) dengan sejelas-jelasnya,

ayahs.arabic: فَٱلْمُلْقِيَٰتِ ذِكْرًا
ayahs.sahih: And those [angels] who deliver a message
ayahs.clear: Delivering a message.
ayahs.kemenag: dan (malaikat-malaikat) yang menyampaikan wahyu,

ayahs.arabic: عُذْرًا أَوْ نُذْرًا
ayahs.sahih: As justification or warning,
ayahs.clear: Excusing or warning.
ayahs.kemenag: untuk menolak alasan-alasan atau memberi peringatan,

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّمَا تُوعَدُونَ لَوَٰقِعٌۭ
ayahs.sahih: Indeed, what you are promised is to occur.
ayahs.clear: Surely what you are promised will happen.
ayahs.kemenag: sesungguhnya apa yang dijanjikan kepadamu itu pasti terjadi.

ayahs.arabic: فَإِذَا ٱلنُّجُومُ طُمِسَتْ
ayahs.sahih: So when the stars are obliterated
ayahs.clear: When the stars are obliterated.
ayahs.kemenag: Maka apabila bintang-bintang telah dihapuskan,

ayahs.arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلسَّمَآءُ فُرِجَتْ
ayahs.sahih: And when the heaven is opened
ayahs.clear: And the sky is fractured.
ayahs.kemenag: dan apabila langit telah dibelah,

ayahs.arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلْجِبَالُ نُسِفَتْ
ayahs.sahih: And when the mountains are blown away
ayahs.clear: And the mountains are blown away.
ayahs.kemenag: dan apabila gunung-gunung telah dihancurkan menjadi debu,

ayahs.arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلرُّسُلُ أُقِّتَتْ
ayahs.sahih: And when the messengers' time has come...
ayahs.clear: And the messengers are alerted.
ayahs.kemenag: dan apabila rasul-rasul telah ditetapkan waktu (mereka).

ayahs.arabic: لِأَىِّ يَوْمٍ أُجِّلَتْ
ayahs.sahih: For what Day was it postponed?
ayahs.clear: Until which day is it deferred?
ayahs.kemenag: (Niscaya dikatakan kepada mereka:) "Sampai hari apakah ditangguhkan (mengazab orang-orang kafir itu)?"

ayahs.arabic: لِيَوْمِ ٱلْفَصْلِ
ayahs.sahih: For the Day of Judgement.
ayahs.clear: Until the Day of Decision.
ayahs.kemenag: Sampai hari keputusan.

ayahs.arabic: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا يَوْمُ ٱلْفَصْلِ
ayahs.sahih: And what can make you know what is the Day of Judgement?
ayahs.clear: And what will teach you what the Day of Decision is?
ayahs.kemenag: Dan tahukah kamu apakah hari keputusan itu?

ayahs.arabic: وَيْلٌۭ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
ayahs.sahih: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.
ayahs.clear: Woe on that Day to the liars.
ayahs.kemenag: Kecelakaan yang besarlah pada hari itu bagi orang-orang yang mendustakan.

ayahs.arabic: أَلَمْ نُهْلِكِ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
ayahs.sahih: Did We not destroy the former peoples?
ayahs.clear: Did We not destroy the ancients?
ayahs.kemenag: Bukankah Kami telah membinasakan orang-orang yang dahulu?

ayahs.arabic: ثُمَّ نُتْبِعُهُمُ ٱلْءَاخِرِينَ
ayahs.sahih: Then We will follow them with the later ones.
ayahs.clear: Then succeeded them with the others?
ayahs.kemenag: Lalu Kami iringkan (azab Kami terhadap) mereka dengan (mengazab) orang-orang yang datang kemudian.

ayahs.arabic: كَذَٰلِكَ نَفْعَلُ بِٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ
ayahs.sahih: Thus do We deal with the criminals.
ayahs.clear: This is how We deal with the guilty.
ayahs.kemenag: Demikianlah Kami berbuat terhadap orang-orang yang berdosa.

ayahs.arabic: وَيْلٌۭ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
ayahs.sahih: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.
ayahs.clear: Woe on that Day to the rejecters.
ayahs.kemenag: Kecelakaan yang besarlah pada hari itu bagi orang-orang yang mendustakan.

ayahs.arabic: أَلَمْ نَخْلُقكُّم مِّن مَّآءٍۢ مَّهِينٍۢ
ayahs.sahih: Did We not create you from a liquid disdained?
ayahs.clear: Did We not create you from an insignificant fluid?
ayahs.kemenag: Bukankah Kami menciptakan kamu dari air yang hina?

ayahs.arabic: فَجَعَلْنَٰهُ فِى قَرَارٍۢ مَّكِينٍ
ayahs.sahih: And We placed it in a firm lodging
ayahs.clear: Then lodged it in a secure place?
ayahs.kemenag: kemudian Kami letakkan dia dalam tempat yang kokoh (rahim),

ayahs.arabic: إِلَىٰ قَدَرٍۢ مَّعْلُومٍۢ
ayahs.sahih: For a known extent.
ayahs.clear: For a known term?
ayahs.kemenag: sampai waktu yang ditentukan,

ayahs.arabic: فَقَدَرْنَا فَنِعْمَ ٱلْقَٰدِرُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And We determined [it], and excellent [are We] to determine.
ayahs.clear: We measured precisely. We are the best to measure.
ayahs.kemenag: lalu Kami tentukan (bentuknya), maka Kami-lah sebaik-baik yang menentukan.

ayahs.arabic: وَيْلٌۭ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
ayahs.sahih: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.
ayahs.clear: Woe on that Day to the falsifiers.
ayahs.kemenag: Kecelakaan yang besarlah pada hari itu bagi orang-orang yang mendustakan.

ayahs.arabic: أَلَمْ نَجْعَلِ ٱلْأَرْضَ كِفَاتًا
ayahs.sahih: Have We not made the earth a container
ayahs.clear: Did We not make the earth a homestead?
ayahs.kemenag: Bukankah Kami menjadikan bumi (tempat) berkumpul,

ayahs.arabic: أَحْيَآءًۭ وَأَمْوَٰتًۭا
ayahs.sahih: Of the living and the dead?
ayahs.clear: For the living and the dead?
ayahs.kemenag: orang-orang hidup dan orang-orang mati?

ayahs.arabic: وَجَعَلْنَا فِيهَا رَوَٰسِىَ شَٰمِخَٰتٍۢ وَأَسْقَيْنَٰكُم مَّآءًۭ فُرَاتًۭا
ayahs.sahih: And We placed therein lofty, firmly set mountains and have given you to drink sweet water.
ayahs.clear: And set on it lofty mountains, and given you pure water to drink?
ayahs.kemenag: dan Kami jadikan padanya gunung-gunung yang tinggi, dan Kami beri minum kamu dengan air tawar?

ayahs.arabic: وَيْلٌۭ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
ayahs.sahih: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.
ayahs.clear: Woe on that Day to the deniers.
ayahs.kemenag: Kecelakaan yang besarlah pada hari itu bagi orang-orang yang mendustakan.

ayahs.arabic: ٱنطَلِقُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰ مَا كُنتُم بِهِۦ تُكَذِّبُونَ
ayahs.sahih: [They will be told], "Proceed to that which you used to deny.
ayahs.clear: “Proceed to what you used to deny.”
ayahs.kemenag: (Dikatakan kepada mereka pada hari kiamat): "Pergilah kamu mendapatkan azab yang dahulunya kamu mendustakannya.

ayahs.arabic: ٱنطَلِقُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰ ظِلٍّۢ ذِى ثَلَٰثِ شُعَبٍۢ
ayahs.sahih: Proceed to a shadow [of smoke] having three columns
ayahs.clear: “Proceed to a shadow of three different masses.”
ayahs.kemenag: Pergilah kamu mendapatkan naungan yang mempunyai tiga cabang,

ayahs.arabic: لَّا ظَلِيلٍۢ وَلَا يُغْنِى مِنَ ٱللَّهَبِ
ayahs.sahih: [But having] no cool shade and availing not against the flame."
ayahs.clear: Offering no shade, and unavailing against the flames.
ayahs.kemenag: yang tidak melindungi dan tidak pula menolak nyala api neraka".

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّهَا تَرْمِى بِشَرَرٍۢ كَٱلْقَصْرِ
ayahs.sahih: Indeed, it throws sparks [as huge] as a fortress,
ayahs.clear: It shoots sparks as castles.
ayahs.kemenag: Sesungguhnya neraka itu melontarkan bunga api sebesar dan setinggi istana.

ayahs.arabic: كَأَنَّهُۥ جِمَٰلَتٌۭ صُفْرٌۭ
ayahs.sahih: As if they were yellowish [black] camels.
ayahs.clear: As if they were yellow camels.
ayahs.kemenag: Seolah-olah ia iringan unta yang kuning.

ayahs.arabic: وَيْلٌۭ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
ayahs.sahih: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.
ayahs.clear: Woe on that Day to the liars.
ayahs.kemenag: Kecelakaan yang besarlah pada hari itu bagi orang-orang yang mendustakan.

ayahs.arabic: هَٰذَا يَوْمُ لَا يَنطِقُونَ
ayahs.sahih: This is a Day they will not speak,
ayahs.clear: This is a Day when they will not speak.
ayahs.kemenag: Ini adalah hari, yang mereka tidak dapat berbicara (pada hari itu),

ayahs.arabic: وَلَا يُؤْذَنُ لَهُمْ فَيَعْتَذِرُونَ
ayahs.sahih: Nor will it be permitted for them to make an excuse.
ayahs.clear: And they will not be allowed to apologize.
ayahs.kemenag: dan tidak diizinkan kepada mereka minta uzur sehingga mereka (dapat) minta uzur.

ayahs.arabic: وَيْلٌۭ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
ayahs.sahih: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.
ayahs.clear: Woe on that Day to the rejecters.
ayahs.kemenag: Kecelakaan yang besarlah pada hari itu bagi orang-orang yang mendustakan.

ayahs.arabic: هَٰذَا يَوْمُ ٱلْفَصْلِ ۖ جَمَعْنَٰكُمْ وَٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
ayahs.sahih: This is the Day of Judgement; We will have assembled you and the former peoples.
ayahs.clear: This is the Day of Separation; We have gathered you, together with the ancients.
ayahs.kemenag: Ini adalah hari keputusan; (pada hari ini) Kami mengumpulkan kamu dan orang-orang terdahulu.

ayahs.arabic: فَإِن كَانَ لَكُمْ كَيْدٌۭ فَكِيدُونِ
ayahs.sahih: So if you have a plan, then plan against Me.
ayahs.clear: So if you have a strategy, use it against Me.
ayahs.kemenag: Jika kamu mempunyai tipu daya, maka lakukanlah tipu dayamu itu terhadap-Ku.

ayahs.arabic: وَيْلٌۭ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
ayahs.sahih: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.
ayahs.clear: Woe on that Day to the falsifiers.
ayahs.kemenag: Kecelakaan yang besarlah pada hari itu bagi orang-orang yang mendustakan.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِى ظِلَٰلٍۢ وَعُيُونٍۢ
ayahs.sahih: Indeed, the righteous will be among shades and springs
ayahs.clear: The righteous will be amidst shades and fountains.
ayahs.kemenag: Sesungguhnya orang-orang yang bertakwa berada dalam naungan (yang teduh) dan (di sekitar) mata-mata air.

ayahs.arabic: وَفَوَٰكِهَ مِمَّا يَشْتَهُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And fruits from whatever they desire,
ayahs.clear: And fruits as they desire.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan (mendapat) buah-buahan dari (macam-macam) yang mereka ingini.

ayahs.arabic: كُلُوا۟ وَٱشْرَبُوا۟ هَنِيٓـًٔۢا بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
ayahs.sahih: [Being told], "Eat and drink in satisfaction for what you used to do."
ayahs.clear: “Eat and drink pleasantly, for what you used to do.”
ayahs.kemenag: (Dikatakan kepada mereka): "Makan dan minumlah kamu dengan enak karena apa yang telah kamu kerjakan".

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
ayahs.sahih: Indeed, We thus reward the doers of good.
ayahs.clear: This is how We reward the doers of good.
ayahs.kemenag: Sesungguhnya demikianlah Kami memberi balasan kepada orang-orang yang berbuat baik.

ayahs.arabic: وَيْلٌۭ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
ayahs.sahih: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.
ayahs.clear: Woe on that Day to the deniers.
ayahs.kemenag: Kecelakaan yang besarlah pada hari itu bagi orang-orang yang mendustakan.

ayahs.arabic: كُلُوا۟ وَتَمَتَّعُوا۟ قَلِيلًا إِنَّكُم مُّجْرِمُونَ
ayahs.sahih: [O disbelievers], eat and enjoy yourselves a little; indeed, you are criminals.
ayahs.clear: “Eat and enjoy yourselves a little; you are indeed criminals.”
ayahs.kemenag: (Dikatakan kepada orang-orang kafir): "Makanlah dan bersenang-senanglah kamu (di dunia dalam waktu) yang pendek; sesungguhnya kamu adalah orang-orang yang berdosa".

ayahs.arabic: وَيْلٌۭ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
ayahs.sahih: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.
ayahs.clear: Woe on that Day to the liars.
ayahs.kemenag: Kecelakaan yang besarlah pada hari itu bagi orang-orang yang mendustakan.

ayahs.arabic: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمُ ٱرْكَعُوا۟ لَا يَرْكَعُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And when it is said to them, "Bow [in prayer]," they do not bow.
ayahs.clear: And when it is said to them, “Kneel”, they do not kneel.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan apabila dikatakan kepada mereka: "Rukuklah, niscaya mereka tidak mau ruku'.

ayahs.arabic: وَيْلٌۭ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
ayahs.sahih: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.
ayahs.clear: Woe on that Day to the rejecters.
ayahs.kemenag: Kecelakaan yang besarlah pada hari itu bagi orang-orang yang mendustakan.

ayahs.arabic: فَبِأَىِّ حَدِيثٍۭ بَعْدَهُۥ يُؤْمِنُونَ
ayahs.sahih: Then in what statement after the Qur'an will they believe?
ayahs.clear: In what message, beyond this, will they believe?
ayahs.kemenag: Maka kepada perkataan apakah selain Al Quran ini mereka akan beriman?

ayahs.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ عَمَّ يَتَسَآءَلُونَ
ayahs.sahih: About what are they asking one another?
ayahs.clear: What are they asking one another about?
ayahs.kemenag: Tentang apakah mereka saling bertanya-tanya?

ayahs.arabic: عَنِ ٱلنَّبَإِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
ayahs.sahih: About the great news -
ayahs.clear: About the Great Event.
ayahs.kemenag: Tentang berita yang besar,

ayahs.arabic: ٱلَّذِى هُمْ فِيهِ مُخْتَلِفُونَ
ayahs.sahih: That over which they are in disagreement.
ayahs.clear: About which they disagree.
ayahs.kemenag: yang mereka perselisihkan tentang ini.

ayahs.arabic: كَلَّا سَيَعْلَمُونَ
ayahs.sahih: No! They are going to know.
ayahs.clear: Surely, they will find out.
ayahs.kemenag: Sekali-kali tidak; kelak mereka akan mengetahui,

ayahs.arabic: ثُمَّ كَلَّا سَيَعْلَمُونَ
ayahs.sahih: Then, no! They are going to know.
ayahs.clear: Most certainly, they will find out.
ayahs.kemenag: kemudian sekali-kali tidak; kelak mereka mengetahui.

ayahs.arabic: أَلَمْ نَجْعَلِ ٱلْأَرْضَ مِهَٰدًۭا
ayahs.sahih: Have We not made the earth a resting place?
ayahs.clear: Did We not make the earth a cradle?
ayahs.kemenag: Bukankah Kami telah menjadikan bumi itu sebagai hamparan?,

ayahs.arabic: وَٱلْجِبَالَ أَوْتَادًۭا
ayahs.sahih: And the mountains as stakes?
ayahs.clear: And the mountains pegs?
ayahs.kemenag: dan gunung-gunung sebagai pasak?,

ayahs.arabic: وَخَلَقْنَٰكُمْ أَزْوَٰجًۭا
ayahs.sahih: And We created you in pairs
ayahs.clear: And created you in pairs?
ayahs.kemenag: dan Kami jadikan kamu berpasang-pasangan,

ayahs.arabic: وَجَعَلْنَا نَوْمَكُمْ سُبَاتًۭا
ayahs.sahih: And made your sleep [a means for] rest
ayahs.clear: And made your sleep for rest?
ayahs.kemenag: dan Kami jadikan tidurmu untuk istirahat,

ayahs.arabic: وَجَعَلْنَا ٱلَّيْلَ لِبَاسًۭا
ayahs.sahih: And made the night as clothing
ayahs.clear: And made the night a cover?
ayahs.kemenag: dan Kami jadikan malam sebagai pakaian,

ayahs.arabic: وَجَعَلْنَا ٱلنَّهَارَ مَعَاشًۭا
ayahs.sahih: And made the day for livelihood
ayahs.clear: And made the day for livelihood?
ayahs.kemenag: dan Kami jadikan siang untuk mencari penghidupan,

ayahs.arabic: وَبَنَيْنَا فَوْقَكُمْ سَبْعًۭا شِدَادًۭا
ayahs.sahih: And constructed above you seven strong [heavens]
ayahs.clear: And built above you seven strong ones?
ayahs.kemenag: dan Kami bina di atas kamu tujuh buah (langit) yang kokoh,

ayahs.arabic: وَجَعَلْنَا سِرَاجًۭا وَهَّاجًۭا
ayahs.sahih: And made [therein] a burning lamp
ayahs.clear: And placed a blazing lamp?
ayahs.kemenag: dan Kami jadikan pelita yang amat terang (matahari),

ayahs.arabic: وَأَنزَلْنَا مِنَ ٱلْمُعْصِرَٰتِ مَآءًۭ ثَجَّاجًۭا
ayahs.sahih: And sent down, from the rain clouds, pouring water
ayahs.clear: And brought down from the clouds pouring water?
ayahs.kemenag: dan Kami turunkan dari awan air yang banyak tercurah,

ayahs.arabic: لِّنُخْرِجَ بِهِۦ حَبًّۭا وَنَبَاتًۭا
ayahs.sahih: That We may bring forth thereby grain and vegetation
ayahs.clear: To produce with it grains and vegetation?
ayahs.kemenag: supaya Kami tumbuhkan dengan air itu biji-bijian dan tumbuh-tumbuhan,

ayahs.arabic: وَجَنَّٰتٍ أَلْفَافًا
ayahs.sahih: And gardens of entwined growth.
ayahs.clear: And luxuriant gardens?
ayahs.kemenag: dan kebun-kebun yang lebat?

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ يَوْمَ ٱلْفَصْلِ كَانَ مِيقَٰتًۭا
ayahs.sahih: Indeed, the Day of Judgement is an appointed time -
ayahs.clear: The Day of Sorting has been appointed.
ayahs.kemenag: Sesungguhnya Hari Keputusan adalah suatu waktu yang ditetapkan,

ayahs.arabic: يَوْمَ يُنفَخُ فِى ٱلصُّورِ فَتَأْتُونَ أَفْوَاجًۭا
ayahs.sahih: The Day the Horn is blown and you will come forth in multitudes
ayahs.clear: The Day when the Trumpet is blown, and you will come in droves.
ayahs.kemenag: yaitu hari (yang pada waktu itu) ditiup sangkakala lalu kamu datang berkelompok-kelompok,

ayahs.arabic: وَفُتِحَتِ ٱلسَّمَآءُ فَكَانَتْ أَبْوَٰبًۭا
ayahs.sahih: And the heaven is opened and will become gateways
ayahs.clear: And the sky is opened up, and becomes gateways.
ayahs.kemenag: dan dibukalah langit, maka terdapatlah beberapa pintu,

ayahs.arabic: وَسُيِّرَتِ ٱلْجِبَالُ فَكَانَتْ سَرَابًا
ayahs.sahih: And the mountains are removed and will be [but] a mirage.
ayahs.clear: And the mountains are set in motion, and become a mirage.
ayahs.kemenag: dan dijalankanlah gunung-gunung maka menjadi fatamorganalah ia.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ جَهَنَّمَ كَانَتْ مِرْصَادًۭا
ayahs.sahih: Indeed, Hell has been lying in wait
ayahs.clear: Hell is lying in ambush.
ayahs.kemenag: Sesungguhnya neraka Jahannam itu (padanya) ada tempat pengintai,

ayahs.arabic: لِّلطَّٰغِينَ مَـَٔابًۭا
ayahs.sahih: For the transgressors, a place of return,
ayahs.clear: For the oppressors, a destination.
ayahs.kemenag: lagi menjadi tempat kembali bagi orang-orang yang melampaui batas,

ayahs.arabic: لَّٰبِثِينَ فِيهَآ أَحْقَابًۭا
ayahs.sahih: In which they will remain for ages [unending].
ayahs.clear: Where they will remain for eons.
ayahs.kemenag: mereka tinggal di dalamnya berabad-abad lamanya,

ayahs.arabic: لَّا يَذُوقُونَ فِيهَا بَرْدًۭا وَلَا شَرَابًا
ayahs.sahih: They will not taste therein [any] coolness or drink
ayahs.clear: They will taste therein neither coolness, nor drink.
ayahs.kemenag: mereka tidak merasakan kesejukan di dalamnya dan tidak (pula mendapat) minuman,

ayahs.arabic: إِلَّا حَمِيمًۭا وَغَسَّاقًۭا
ayahs.sahih: Except scalding water and [foul] purulence -
ayahs.clear: Except boiling water, and freezing hail.
ayahs.kemenag: selain air yang mendidih dan nanah,

ayahs.arabic: جَزَآءًۭ وِفَاقًا
ayahs.sahih: An appropriate recompense.
ayahs.clear: A fitting requital.
ayahs.kemenag: sebagai pambalasan yang setimpal.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ لَا يَرْجُونَ حِسَابًۭا
ayahs.sahih: Indeed, they were not expecting an account
ayahs.clear: For they were not anticipating any reckoning.
ayahs.kemenag: Sesungguhnya mereka tidak berharap (takut) kepada hisab,

ayahs.arabic: وَكَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا كِذَّابًۭا
ayahs.sahih: And denied Our verses with [emphatic] denial.
ayahs.clear: And they denied Our signs utterly.
ayahs.kemenag: dan mereka mendustakan ayat-ayat Kami dengan sesungguh-sungguhnya.

ayahs.arabic: وَكُلَّ شَىْءٍ أَحْصَيْنَٰهُ كِتَٰبًۭا
ayahs.sahih: But all things We have enumerated in writing.
ayahs.clear: But We have enumerated everything in writing.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan segala sesuatu telah Kami catat dalam suatu kitab.

ayahs.arabic: فَذُوقُوا۟ فَلَن نَّزِيدَكُمْ إِلَّا عَذَابًا
ayahs.sahih: "So taste [the penalty], and never will We increase you except in torment."
ayahs.clear: So taste! We will increase you only in suffering.
ayahs.kemenag: Karena itu rasakanlah. Dan Kami sekali-kali tidak akan menambah kepada kamu selain daripada azab.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ مَفَازًا
ayahs.sahih: Indeed, for the righteous is attainment -
ayahs.clear: But for the righteous there is triumph.
ayahs.kemenag: Sesungguhnya orang-orang yang bertakwa mendapat kemenangan,

ayahs.arabic: حَدَآئِقَ وَأَعْنَٰبًۭا
ayahs.sahih: Gardens and grapevines
ayahs.clear: Gardens and vineyards.
ayahs.kemenag: (yaitu) kebun-kebun dan buah anggur,

ayahs.arabic: وَكَوَاعِبَ أَتْرَابًۭا
ayahs.sahih: And full-breasted [companions] of equal age
ayahs.clear: And splendid spouses, well matched.
ayahs.kemenag: dan gadis-gadis remaja yang sebaya,

ayahs.arabic: وَكَأْسًۭا دِهَاقًۭا
ayahs.sahih: And a full cup.
ayahs.clear: And delicious drinks.
ayahs.kemenag: dan gelas-gelas yang penuh (berisi minuman).

ayahs.arabic: لَّا يَسْمَعُونَ فِيهَا لَغْوًۭا وَلَا كِذَّٰبًۭا
ayahs.sahih: No ill speech will they hear therein or any falsehood -
ayahs.clear: They will hear therein neither gossip, nor lies.
ayahs.kemenag: Di dalamnya mereka tidak mendengar perkataan yang sia-sia dan tidak (pula) perkataan dusta.

ayahs.arabic: جَزَآءًۭ مِّن رَّبِّكَ عَطَآءً حِسَابًۭا
ayahs.sahih: [As] reward from your Lord, [a generous] gift [made due by] account,
ayahs.clear: A reward from your Lord, a fitting gift.
ayahs.kemenag: Sebagai pembalasan dari Tuhanmu dan pemberian yang cukup banyak,

ayahs.arabic: رَّبِّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ۖ لَا يَمْلِكُونَ مِنْهُ خِطَابًۭا
ayahs.sahih: [From] the Lord of the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them, the Most Merciful. They possess not from Him [authority for] speech.
ayahs.clear: Lord of the heavens and the earth, and everything between them—The Most Merciful—none can argue with Him.
ayahs.kemenag: Tuhan Yang memelihara langit dan bumi dan apa yang ada di antara keduanya; Yang Maha Pemurah. Mereka tidak dapat berbicara dengan Dia.

ayahs.arabic: يَوْمَ يَقُومُ ٱلرُّوحُ وَٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ صَفًّۭا ۖ لَّا يَتَكَلَّمُونَ إِلَّا مَنْ أَذِنَ لَهُ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ وَقَالَ صَوَابًۭا
ayahs.sahih: The Day that the Spirit and the angels will stand in rows, they will not speak except for one whom the Most Merciful permits, and he will say what is correct.
ayahs.clear: On the Day when the Spirit and the angels stand in row. They will not speak, unless it be one permitted by the Most Merciful, and he will say what is right.
