ayahs.kemenag: Pada hari, ketika ruh dan para malaikat berdiri bershaf-shaf, mereka tidak berkata-kata, kecuali siapa yang telah diberi izin kepadanya oleh Tuhan Yang Maha Pemurah; dan ia mengucapkan kata yang benar.

ayahs.arabic: ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْيَوْمُ ٱلْحَقُّ ۖ فَمَن شَآءَ ٱتَّخَذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ مَـَٔابًا
ayahs.sahih: That is the True Day; so he who wills may take to his Lord a [way of] return.
ayahs.clear: That is the Day of Reality. So whoever wills, let him take a way back to his Lord.
ayahs.kemenag: Itulah hari yang pasti terjadi. Maka barangsiapa yang menghendaki, niscaya ia menempuh jalan kembali kepada Tuhannya.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّآ أَنذَرْنَٰكُمْ عَذَابًۭا قَرِيبًۭا يَوْمَ يَنظُرُ ٱلْمَرْءُ مَا قَدَّمَتْ يَدَاهُ وَيَقُولُ ٱلْكَافِرُ يَٰلَيْتَنِى كُنتُ تُرَٰبًۢا
ayahs.sahih: Indeed, We have warned you of a near punishment on the Day when a man will observe what his hands have put forth and the disbeliever will say, "Oh, I wish that I were dust!"
ayahs.clear: We have warned you of a near punishment—the Day when a person will observe what his hands have produced, and the faithless will say, “O, I wish I were dust.”
ayahs.kemenag: Sesungguhnya Kami telah memperingatkan kepadamu (hai orang kafir) siksa yang dekat, pada hari manusia melihat apa yang telah diperbuat oleh kedua tangannya; dan orang kafir berkata: "Alangkah baiknya sekiranya aku dahulu adalah tanah".

ayahs.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ وَٱلنَّٰزِعَٰتِ غَرْقًۭا
ayahs.sahih: By those [angels] who extract with violence
ayahs.clear: By those who snatch violently.
ayahs.kemenag: Demi (malaikat-malaikat) yang mencabut (nyawa) dengan keras,

ayahs.arabic: وَٱلنَّٰشِطَٰتِ نَشْطًۭا
ayahs.sahih: And [by] those who remove with ease
ayahs.clear: And those who remove gently.
ayahs.kemenag: dan (malaikat-malaikat) yang mencabut (nyawa) dengan lemah-lembut,

ayahs.arabic: وَٱلسَّٰبِحَٰتِ سَبْحًۭا
ayahs.sahih: And [by] those who glide [as if] swimming
ayahs.clear: And those who glide smoothly.
ayahs.kemenag: dan (malaikat-malaikat) yang turun dari langit dengan cepat,

ayahs.arabic: فَٱلسَّٰبِقَٰتِ سَبْقًۭا
ayahs.sahih: And those who race each other in a race
ayahs.clear: And those who race swiftly.
ayahs.kemenag: dan (malaikat-malaikat) yang mendahului dengan kencang,

ayahs.arabic: فَٱلْمُدَبِّرَٰتِ أَمْرًۭا
ayahs.sahih: And those who arrange [each] matter,
ayahs.clear: And those who regulate events.
ayahs.kemenag: dan (malaikat-malaikat) yang mengatur urusan (dunia).

ayahs.arabic: يَوْمَ تَرْجُفُ ٱلرَّاجِفَةُ
ayahs.sahih: On the Day the blast [of the Horn] will convulse [creation],
ayahs.clear: On the Day when the Quake quakes.
ayahs.kemenag: (Sesungguhnya kamu akan dibangkitkan) pada hari ketika tiupan pertama menggoncang alam,

ayahs.arabic: تَتْبَعُهَا ٱلرَّادِفَةُ
ayahs.sahih: There will follow it the subsequent [one].
ayahs.clear: And is followed by the Successor.
ayahs.kemenag: tiupan pertama itu diiringi oleh tiupan kedua.

ayahs.arabic: قُلُوبٌۭ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ وَاجِفَةٌ
ayahs.sahih: Hearts, that Day, will tremble,
ayahs.clear: Hearts on that Day will be pounding.
ayahs.kemenag: Hati manusia pada waktu itu sangat takut,

ayahs.arabic: أَبْصَٰرُهَا خَٰشِعَةٌۭ
ayahs.sahih: Their eyes humbled.
ayahs.clear: Their sights downcast.
ayahs.kemenag: Pandangannya tunduk.

ayahs.arabic: يَقُولُونَ أَءِنَّا لَمَرْدُودُونَ فِى ٱلْحَافِرَةِ
ayahs.sahih: They are [presently] saying, "Will we indeed be returned to [our] former state [of life]?
ayahs.clear: They say, “Are we to be restored to the original condition?
ayahs.kemenag: (Orang-orang kafir) berkata: "Apakah sesungguhnya kami benar-benar dikembalikan kepada kehidupan semula?

ayahs.arabic: أَءِذَا كُنَّا عِظَٰمًۭا نَّخِرَةًۭ
ayahs.sahih: Even if we should be decayed bones?
ayahs.clear: When we have become hollow bones?”
ayahs.kemenag: Apakah (akan dibangkitkan juga) apabila kami telah menjadi tulang belulang yang hancur lumat?"

ayahs.arabic: قَالُوا۟ تِلْكَ إِذًۭا كَرَّةٌ خَاسِرَةٌۭ
ayahs.sahih: They say, "That, then, would be a losing return."
ayahs.clear: They say, “This is a losing proposition.”
ayahs.kemenag: Mereka berkata: "Kalau demikian, itu adalah suatu pengembalian yang merugikan".

ayahs.arabic: فَإِنَّمَا هِىَ زَجْرَةٌۭ وَٰحِدَةٌۭ
ayahs.sahih: Indeed, it will be but one shout,
ayahs.clear: But it will be only a single nudge.
ayahs.kemenag: Sesungguhnya pengembalian itu hanyalah satu kali tiupan saja,

ayahs.arabic: فَإِذَا هُم بِٱلسَّاهِرَةِ
ayahs.sahih: And suddenly they will be [alert] upon the earth's surface.
ayahs.clear: And they will be awake.
ayahs.kemenag: maka dengan serta merta mereka hidup kembali di permukaan bumi.

ayahs.arabic: هَلْ أَتَىٰكَ حَدِيثُ مُوسَىٰٓ
ayahs.sahih: Has there reached you the story of Moses? -
ayahs.clear: Has the story of Moses reached you?
ayahs.kemenag: Sudah sampaikah kepadamu (ya Muhammad) kisah Musa.

ayahs.arabic: إِذْ نَادَىٰهُ رَبُّهُۥ بِٱلْوَادِ ٱلْمُقَدَّسِ طُوًى
ayahs.sahih: When his Lord called to him in the sacred valley of Tuwa,
ayahs.clear: When His Lord called out to him in the sacred valley of Tuwa.
ayahs.kemenag: Tatkala Tuhannya memanggilnya di lembah suci ialah Lembah Thuwa;

ayahs.arabic: ٱذْهَبْ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ إِنَّهُۥ طَغَىٰ
ayahs.sahih: "Go to Pharaoh. Indeed, he has transgressed.
ayahs.clear: “Go to Pharaoh—he has transgressed.”
ayahs.kemenag: "Pergilah kamu kepada Fir'aun, sesungguhnya dia telah melampaui batas,

ayahs.arabic: فَقُلْ هَل لَّكَ إِلَىٰٓ أَن تَزَكَّىٰ
ayahs.sahih: And say to him, 'Would you [be willing to] purify yourself
ayahs.clear: And say, “Do you care to be cleansed?
ayahs.kemenag: dan katakanlah (kepada Fir'aun): "Adakah keinginan bagimu untuk membersihkan diri (dari kesesatan)".

ayahs.arabic: وَأَهْدِيَكَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ فَتَخْشَىٰ
ayahs.sahih: And let me guide you to your Lord so you would fear [Him]?'"
ayahs.clear: And I will guide you to your Lord, and you will turn reverent.”
ayahs.kemenag: Dan kamu akan kupimpin ke jalan Tuhanmu agar supaya kamu takut kepada-Nya?"

ayahs.arabic: فَأَرَىٰهُ ٱلْءَايَةَ ٱلْكُبْرَىٰ
ayahs.sahih: And he showed him the greatest sign,
ayahs.clear: He showed him the Greatest Miracle.
ayahs.kemenag: Lalu Musa memperlihatkan kepadanya mukjizat yang besar.

ayahs.arabic: فَكَذَّبَ وَعَصَىٰ
ayahs.sahih: But Pharaoh denied and disobeyed.
ayahs.clear: But he denied and defied.
ayahs.kemenag: Tetapi Fir'aun mendustakan dan mendurhakai.

ayahs.arabic: ثُمَّ أَدْبَرَ يَسْعَىٰ
ayahs.sahih: Then he turned his back, striving.
ayahs.clear: Then turned his back, and tried.
ayahs.kemenag: Kemudian dia berpaling seraya berusaha menantang (Musa).

ayahs.arabic: فَحَشَرَ فَنَادَىٰ
ayahs.sahih: And he gathered [his people] and called out
ayahs.clear: And gathered and proclaimed.
ayahs.kemenag: Maka dia mengumpulkan (pembesar-pembesarnya) lalu berseru memanggil kaumnya.

ayahs.arabic: فَقَالَ أَنَا۠ رَبُّكُمُ ٱلْأَعْلَىٰ
ayahs.sahih: And said, "I am your most exalted lord."
ayahs.clear: He said, “I am your Lord, the most high.”
ayahs.kemenag: (Seraya) berkata: "Akulah tuhanmu yang paling tinggi".

ayahs.arabic: فَأَخَذَهُ ٱللَّهُ نَكَالَ ٱلْءَاخِرَةِ وَٱلْأُولَىٰٓ
ayahs.sahih: So Allah seized him in exemplary punishment for the last and the first [transgression].
ayahs.clear: So God seized him with an exemplary punishment, in the last and in the first.
ayahs.kemenag: Maka Allah mengazabnya dengan azab di akhirat dan azab di dunia.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَعِبْرَةًۭ لِّمَن يَخْشَىٰٓ
ayahs.sahih: Indeed in that is a warning for whoever would fear [Allah].
ayahs.clear: In this is a lesson for whoever fears.
ayahs.kemenag: Sesungguhnya pada yang demikian itu terdapat pelajaran bagi orang yang takut (kepada Tuhannya).

ayahs.arabic: ءَأَنتُمْ أَشَدُّ خَلْقًا أَمِ ٱلسَّمَآءُ ۚ بَنَىٰهَا
ayahs.sahih: Are you a more difficult creation or is the heaven? Allah constructed it.
ayahs.clear: Are you more difficult to create, or the heaven? He constructed it.
ayahs.kemenag: Apakah kamu lebih sulit penciptaanya ataukah langit? Allah telah membinanya,

ayahs.arabic: رَفَعَ سَمْكَهَا فَسَوَّىٰهَا
ayahs.sahih: He raised its ceiling and proportioned it.
ayahs.clear: He raised its masses, and proportioned it.
ayahs.kemenag: Dia meninggikan bangunannya lalu menyempurnakannya,

ayahs.arabic: وَأَغْطَشَ لَيْلَهَا وَأَخْرَجَ ضُحَىٰهَا
ayahs.sahih: And He darkened its night and extracted its brightness.
ayahs.clear: And He dimmed its night, and brought out its daylight.
ayahs.kemenag: dan Dia menjadikan malamnya gelap gulita, dan menjadikan siangnya terang benderang.

ayahs.arabic: وَٱلْأَرْضَ بَعْدَ ذَٰلِكَ دَحَىٰهَآ
ayahs.sahih: And after that He spread the earth.
ayahs.clear: And the earth after that He spread.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan bumi sesudah itu dihamparkan-Nya.

ayahs.arabic: أَخْرَجَ مِنْهَا مَآءَهَا وَمَرْعَىٰهَا
ayahs.sahih: He extracted from it its water and its pasture,
ayahs.clear: And from it, He produced its water and its pasture.
ayahs.kemenag: Ia memancarkan daripadanya mata airnya, dan (menumbuhkan) tumbuh-tumbuhannya.

ayahs.arabic: وَٱلْجِبَالَ أَرْسَىٰهَا
ayahs.sahih: And the mountains He set firmly
ayahs.clear: And the mountains, He anchored.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan gunung-gunung dipancangkan-Nya dengan teguh,

ayahs.arabic: مَتَٰعًۭا لَّكُمْ وَلِأَنْعَٰمِكُمْ
ayahs.sahih: As provision for you and your grazing livestock.
ayahs.clear: A source of enjoyment for you and for your animals.
ayahs.kemenag: (semua itu) untuk kesenanganmu dan untuk binatang-binatang ternakmu.

ayahs.arabic: فَإِذَا جَآءَتِ ٱلطَّآمَّةُ ٱلْكُبْرَىٰ
ayahs.sahih: But when there comes the greatest Overwhelming Calamity -
ayahs.clear: But when the Great Cataclysm arrives.
ayahs.kemenag: Maka apabila malapetaka yang sangat besar (hari kiamat) telah datang.

ayahs.arabic: يَوْمَ يَتَذَكَّرُ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ مَا سَعَىٰ
ayahs.sahih: The Day when man will remember that for which he strove,
ayahs.clear: A Day when man will remember what he has endeavored.
ayahs.kemenag: Pada hari (ketika) manusia teringat akan apa yang telah dikerjakannya,

ayahs.arabic: وَبُرِّزَتِ ٱلْجَحِيمُ لِمَن يَرَىٰ
ayahs.sahih: And Hellfire will be exposed for [all] those who see -
ayahs.clear: And Hell will be displayed to whoever sees.
ayahs.kemenag: dan diperlihatkan neraka dengan jelas kepada setiap orang yang melihat.

ayahs.arabic: فَأَمَّا مَن طَغَىٰ
ayahs.sahih: So as for he who transgressed
ayahs.clear: As for him who was defiant.
ayahs.kemenag: Adapun orang yang melampaui batas,

ayahs.arabic: وَءَاثَرَ ٱلْحَيَوٰةَ ٱلدُّنْيَا
ayahs.sahih: And preferred the life of the world,
ayahs.clear: And preferred the life of this world.
ayahs.kemenag: dan lebih mengutamakan kehidupan dunia,

ayahs.arabic: فَإِنَّ ٱلْجَحِيمَ هِىَ ٱلْمَأْوَىٰ
ayahs.sahih: Then indeed, Hellfire will be [his] refuge.
ayahs.clear: Then Hell is the shelter.
ayahs.kemenag: maka sesungguhnya nerakalah tempat tinggal(nya).

ayahs.arabic: وَأَمَّا مَنْ خَافَ مَقَامَ رَبِّهِۦ وَنَهَى ٱلنَّفْسَ عَنِ ٱلْهَوَىٰ
ayahs.sahih: But as for he who feared the position of his Lord and prevented the soul from [unlawful] inclination,
ayahs.clear: But as for him who feared the Standing of his Lord, and restrained the self from desires.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan adapun orang-orang yang takut kepada kebesaran Tuhannya dan menahan diri dari keinginan hawa nafsunya,

ayahs.arabic: فَإِنَّ ٱلْجَنَّةَ هِىَ ٱلْمَأْوَىٰ
ayahs.sahih: Then indeed, Paradise will be [his] refuge.
ayahs.clear: Then Paradise is the shelter.
ayahs.kemenag: maka sesungguhnya surgalah tempat tinggal(nya).

ayahs.arabic: يَسْـَٔلُونَكَ عَنِ ٱلسَّاعَةِ أَيَّانَ مُرْسَىٰهَا
ayahs.sahih: They ask you, [O Muhammad], about the Hour: when is its arrival?
ayahs.clear: They ask you about the Hour, “When will it take place?”
ayahs.kemenag: (Orang-orang kafir) bertanya kepadamu (Muhammad) tentang hari kebangkitan, kapankah terjadinya?

ayahs.arabic: فِيمَ أَنتَ مِن ذِكْرَىٰهَآ
ayahs.sahih: In what [position] are you that you should mention it?
ayahs.clear: You have no knowledge of it.
ayahs.kemenag: Siapakah kamu (maka) dapat menyebutkan (waktunya)?

ayahs.arabic: إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ مُنتَهَىٰهَآ
ayahs.sahih: To your Lord is its finality.
ayahs.clear: To your Lord is its finality.
ayahs.kemenag: Kepada Tuhanmulah dikembalikan kesudahannya (ketentuan waktunya).

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّمَآ أَنتَ مُنذِرُ مَن يَخْشَىٰهَا
ayahs.sahih: You are only a warner for those who fear it.
ayahs.clear: You are just a warner for whoever dreads it.
ayahs.kemenag: Kamu hanyalah pemberi peringatan bagi siapa yang takut kepadanya (hari berbangkit)

ayahs.arabic: كَأَنَّهُمْ يَوْمَ يَرَوْنَهَا لَمْ يَلْبَثُوٓا۟ إِلَّا عَشِيَّةً أَوْ ضُحَىٰهَا
ayahs.sahih: It will be, on the Day they see it, as though they had not remained [in the world] except for an afternoon or a morning thereof.
ayahs.clear: On the Day when they witness it—as though they only stayed an evening, or its morning.
ayahs.kemenag: Pada hari mereka melihat hari berbangkit itu, mereka merasa seakan-akan tidak tinggal (di dunia) melainkan (sebentar saja) di waktu sore atau pagi hari.

ayahs.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ عَبَسَ وَتَوَلَّىٰٓ
ayahs.sahih: The Prophet frowned and turned away
ayahs.clear: He frowned and turned away.
ayahs.kemenag: Dia (Muhammad) bermuka masam dan berpaling,

ayahs.arabic: أَن جَآءَهُ ٱلْأَعْمَىٰ
ayahs.sahih: Because there came to him the blind man, [interrupting].
ayahs.clear: When the blind man approached him.
ayahs.kemenag: karena telah datang seorang buta kepadanya.

ayahs.arabic: وَمَا يُدْرِيكَ لَعَلَّهُۥ يَزَّكَّىٰٓ
ayahs.sahih: But what would make you perceive, [O Muhammad], that perhaps he might be purified
ayahs.clear: But how do you know? Perhaps he was seeking to purify himself.
ayahs.kemenag: Tahukah kamu barangkali ia ingin membersihkan dirinya (dari dosa),

ayahs.arabic: أَوْ يَذَّكَّرُ فَتَنفَعَهُ ٱلذِّكْرَىٰٓ
ayahs.sahih: Or be reminded and the remembrance would benefit him?
ayahs.clear: Or be reminded, and the message would benefit him.
ayahs.kemenag: atau dia (ingin) mendapatkan pengajaran, lalu pengajaran itu memberi manfaat kepadanya?

ayahs.arabic: أَمَّا مَنِ ٱسْتَغْنَىٰ
ayahs.sahih: As for he who thinks himself without need,
ayahs.clear: But as for him who was indifferent.
ayahs.kemenag: Adapun orang yang merasa dirinya serba cukup,

ayahs.arabic: فَأَنتَ لَهُۥ تَصَدَّىٰ
ayahs.sahih: To him you give attention.
ayahs.clear: You gave him your attention.
ayahs.kemenag: maka kamu melayaninya.

ayahs.arabic: وَمَا عَلَيْكَ أَلَّا يَزَّكَّىٰ
ayahs.sahih: And not upon you [is any blame] if he will not be purified.
ayahs.clear: Though you are not liable if he does not purify himself.
ayahs.kemenag: Padahal tidak ada (celaan) atasmu kalau dia tidak membersihkan diri (beriman).

ayahs.arabic: وَأَمَّا مَن جَآءَكَ يَسْعَىٰ
ayahs.sahih: But as for he who came to you striving [for knowledge]
ayahs.clear: But as for him who came to you seeking.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan adapun orang yang datang kepadamu dengan bersegera (untuk mendapatkan pengajaran),

ayahs.arabic: وَهُوَ يَخْشَىٰ
ayahs.sahih: While he fears [Allah],
ayahs.clear: In awe.
ayahs.kemenag: sedang ia takut kepada (Allah),

ayahs.arabic: فَأَنتَ عَنْهُ تَلَهَّىٰ
ayahs.sahih: From him you are distracted.
ayahs.clear: To him you were inattentive.
ayahs.kemenag: maka kamu mengabaikannya.

ayahs.arabic: كَلَّآ إِنَّهَا تَذْكِرَةٌۭ
ayahs.sahih: No! Indeed, these verses are a reminder;
ayahs.clear: Do not. This is a Lesson.
ayahs.kemenag: Sekali-kali jangan (demikian)! Sesungguhnya ajaran-ajaran Tuhan itu adalah suatu peringatan,

ayahs.arabic: فَمَن شَآءَ ذَكَرَهُۥ
ayahs.sahih: So whoever wills may remember it.
ayahs.clear: Whoever wills, shall remember it.
ayahs.kemenag: maka barangsiapa yang menghendaki, tentulah ia memperhatikannya,

ayahs.arabic: فِى صُحُفٍۢ مُّكَرَّمَةٍۢ
ayahs.sahih: [It is recorded] in honored sheets,
ayahs.clear: On honorable pages.
ayahs.kemenag: di dalam kitab-kitab yang dimuliakan,

ayahs.arabic: مَّرْفُوعَةٍۢ مُّطَهَّرَةٍۭ
ayahs.sahih: Exalted and purified,
ayahs.clear: Exalted and purified.
ayahs.kemenag: yang ditinggikan lagi disucikan,

ayahs.arabic: بِأَيْدِى سَفَرَةٍۢ
ayahs.sahih: [Carried] by the hands of messenger-angels,
ayahs.clear: By the hands of scribes.
ayahs.kemenag: di tangan para penulis (malaikat),

ayahs.arabic: كِرَامٍۭ بَرَرَةٍۢ
ayahs.sahih: Noble and dutiful.
ayahs.clear: Noble and devoted.
ayahs.kemenag: yang mulia lagi berbakti.

ayahs.arabic: قُتِلَ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ مَآ أَكْفَرَهُۥ
ayahs.sahih: Cursed is man; how disbelieving is he.
ayahs.clear: Perish man! How thankless he is!
ayahs.kemenag: Binasalah manusia; alangkah amat sangat kekafirannya?

ayahs.arabic: مِنْ أَىِّ شَىْءٍ خَلَقَهُۥ
ayahs.sahih: From what substance did He create him?
ayahs.clear: From what did He create him?
ayahs.kemenag: Dari apakah Allah menciptakannya?

ayahs.arabic: مِن نُّطْفَةٍ خَلَقَهُۥ فَقَدَّرَهُۥ
ayahs.sahih: From a sperm-drop He created him and destined for him;
ayahs.clear: From a sperm drop He created him, and enabled him.
ayahs.kemenag: Dari setetes mani, Allah menciptakannya lalu menentukannya.

ayahs.arabic: ثُمَّ ٱلسَّبِيلَ يَسَّرَهُۥ
ayahs.sahih: Then He eased the way for him;
ayahs.clear: Then He eased the way for him.
ayahs.kemenag: Kemudian Dia memudahkan jalannya.

ayahs.arabic: ثُمَّ أَمَاتَهُۥ فَأَقْبَرَهُۥ
ayahs.sahih: Then He causes his death and provides a grave for him.
ayahs.clear: Then He puts him to death, and buries him.
ayahs.kemenag: kemudian Dia mematikannya dan memasukkannya ke dalam kubur,

ayahs.arabic: ثُمَّ إِذَا شَآءَ أَنشَرَهُۥ
ayahs.sahih: Then when He wills, He will resurrect him.
ayahs.clear: Then, when He wills, He will resurrect him.
ayahs.kemenag: kemudian bila Dia menghendaki, Dia membangkitkannya kembali.

ayahs.arabic: كَلَّا لَمَّا يَقْضِ مَآ أَمَرَهُۥ
ayahs.sahih: No! Man has not yet accomplished what He commanded him.
ayahs.clear: But no, he did not fulfill what He has commanded him.
ayahs.kemenag: Sekali-kali jangan; manusia itu belum melaksanakan apa yang diperintahkan Allah kepadanya,

ayahs.arabic: فَلْيَنظُرِ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ إِلَىٰ طَعَامِهِۦٓ
ayahs.sahih: Then let mankind look at his food -
ayahs.clear: Let man consider his food.
ayahs.kemenag: maka hendaklah manusia itu memperhatikan makanannya.

ayahs.arabic: أَنَّا صَبَبْنَا ٱلْمَآءَ صَبًّۭا
ayahs.sahih: How We poured down water in torrents,
ayahs.clear: We pour down water in abundance.
ayahs.kemenag: Sesungguhnya Kami benar-benar telah mencurahkan air (dari langit),

ayahs.arabic: ثُمَّ شَقَقْنَا ٱلْأَرْضَ شَقًّۭا
ayahs.sahih: Then We broke open the earth, splitting [it with sprouts],
ayahs.clear: Then crack the soil open.
ayahs.kemenag: kemudian Kami belah bumi dengan sebaik-baiknya,

ayahs.arabic: فَأَنۢبَتْنَا فِيهَا حَبًّۭا
ayahs.sahih: And caused to grow within it grain
ayahs.clear: And grow in it grains.
ayahs.kemenag: lalu Kami tumbuhkan biji-bijian di bumi itu,

ayahs.arabic: وَعِنَبًۭا وَقَضْبًۭا
ayahs.sahih: And grapes and herbage
ayahs.clear: And grapes and herbs.
ayahs.kemenag: anggur dan sayur-sayuran,

ayahs.arabic: وَزَيْتُونًۭا وَنَخْلًۭا
ayahs.sahih: And olive and palm trees
ayahs.clear: And olives and dates.
ayahs.kemenag: zaitun dan kurma,

ayahs.arabic: وَحَدَآئِقَ غُلْبًۭا
ayahs.sahih: And gardens of dense shrubbery
ayahs.clear: And luscious gardens.
ayahs.kemenag: kebun-kebun (yang) lebat,

ayahs.arabic: وَفَٰكِهَةًۭ وَأَبًّۭا
ayahs.sahih: And fruit and grass -
ayahs.clear: And fruits and vegetables.
ayahs.kemenag: dan buah-buahan serta rumput-rumputan,

ayahs.arabic: مَّتَٰعًۭا لَّكُمْ وَلِأَنْعَٰمِكُمْ
ayahs.sahih: [As] enjoyment for you and your grazing livestock.
ayahs.clear: Enjoyment for you, and for your livestock.
ayahs.kemenag: untuk kesenanganmu dan untuk binatang-binatang ternakmu.

ayahs.arabic: فَإِذَا جَآءَتِ ٱلصَّآخَّةُ
ayahs.sahih: But when there comes the Deafening Blast
ayahs.clear: But when the Deafening Noise comes to pass.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan apabila datang suara yang memekakkan (tiupan sangkakala yang kedua),

ayahs.arabic: يَوْمَ يَفِرُّ ٱلْمَرْءُ مِنْ أَخِيهِ
ayahs.sahih: On the Day a man will flee from his brother
ayahs.clear: The Day when a person will flee from his brother.
ayahs.kemenag: pada hari ketika manusia lari dari saudaranya,

ayahs.arabic: وَأُمِّهِۦ وَأَبِيهِ
ayahs.sahih: And his mother and his father
ayahs.clear: And his mother and his father.
ayahs.kemenag: dari ibu dan bapaknya,

ayahs.arabic: وَصَٰحِبَتِهِۦ وَبَنِيهِ
ayahs.sahih: And his wife and his children,
ayahs.clear: And his consort and his children.
ayahs.kemenag: dari istri dan anak-anaknya.

ayahs.arabic: لِكُلِّ ٱمْرِئٍۢ مِّنْهُمْ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ شَأْنٌۭ يُغْنِيهِ
ayahs.sahih: For every man, that Day, will be a matter adequate for him.
ayahs.clear: Every one of them, on that Day, will have enough to preoccupy him.
ayahs.kemenag: Setiap orang dari mereka pada hari itu mempunyai urusan yang cukup menyibukkannya.

ayahs.arabic: وُجُوهٌۭ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ مُّسْفِرَةٌۭ
ayahs.sahih: [Some] faces, that Day, will be bright -
ayahs.clear: Faces on that Day will be radiant.
ayahs.kemenag: Banyak muka pada hari itu berseri-seri,

ayahs.arabic: ضَاحِكَةٌۭ مُّسْتَبْشِرَةٌۭ
ayahs.sahih: Laughing, rejoicing at good news.
ayahs.clear: Laughing and rejoicing.
ayahs.kemenag: tertawa dan bergembira ria,

ayahs.arabic: وَوُجُوهٌۭ يَوْمَئِذٍ عَلَيْهَا غَبَرَةٌۭ
ayahs.sahih: And [other] faces, that Day, will have upon them dust.
ayahs.clear: And Faces on that Day will be covered with misery.
ayahs.kemenag: dan banyak (pula) muka pada hari itu tertutup debu,

ayahs.arabic: تَرْهَقُهَا قَتَرَةٌ
ayahs.sahih: Blackness will cover them.
ayahs.clear: Overwhelmed by remorse.
ayahs.kemenag: dan ditutup lagi oleh kegelapan.

ayahs.arabic: أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْكَفَرَةُ ٱلْفَجَرَةُ
ayahs.sahih: Those are the disbelievers, the wicked ones.
ayahs.clear: These are the faithless, the vicious.
ayahs.kemenag: Mereka itulah orang-orang kafir lagi durhaka.

ayahs.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ إِذَا ٱلشَّمْسُ كُوِّرَتْ
ayahs.sahih: When the sun is wrapped up [in darkness]
ayahs.clear: When the sun is rolled up.
ayahs.kemenag: Apabila matahari digulung,

ayahs.arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلنُّجُومُ ٱنكَدَرَتْ
ayahs.sahih: And when the stars fall, dispersing,
ayahs.clear: When the stars are dimmed.
ayahs.kemenag: dan apabila bintang-bintang berjatuhan,

ayahs.arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلْجِبَالُ سُيِّرَتْ
ayahs.sahih: And when the mountains are removed
ayahs.clear: When the mountains are set in motion.
ayahs.kemenag: dan apabila gunung-gunung dihancurkan,

ayahs.arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلْعِشَارُ عُطِّلَتْ
ayahs.sahih: And when full-term she-camels are neglected
ayahs.clear: When the relationships are suspended.
ayahs.kemenag: dan apabila unta-unta yang bunting ditinggalkan (tidak diperdulikan)

ayahs.arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلْوُحُوشُ حُشِرَتْ
ayahs.sahih: And when the wild beasts are gathered
ayahs.clear: When the beasts are gathered.
ayahs.kemenag: dan apabila binatang-binatang liar dikumpulkan,

ayahs.arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلْبِحَارُ سُجِّرَتْ
ayahs.sahih: And when the seas are filled with flame
ayahs.clear: When the oceans are set aflame.
ayahs.kemenag: dan apabila lautan dijadikan meluap

ayahs.arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلنُّفُوسُ زُوِّجَتْ
ayahs.sahih: And when the souls are paired
ayahs.clear: When the souls are paired.
ayahs.kemenag: dan apabila ruh-ruh dipertemukan (dengan tubuh)

ayahs.arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلْمَوْءُۥدَةُ سُئِلَتْ
ayahs.sahih: And when the girl [who was] buried alive is asked
ayahs.clear: When the girl, buried alive, is asked:
ayahs.kemenag: dan apabila bayi-bayi perempuan yang dikubur hidup-hidup ditanya,

ayahs.arabic: بِأَىِّ ذَنۢبٍۢ قُتِلَتْ
ayahs.sahih: For what sin she was killed
ayahs.clear: For what crime was she killed?
ayahs.kemenag: karena dosa apakah dia dibunuh,

ayahs.arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلصُّحُفُ نُشِرَتْ
ayahs.sahih: And when the pages are made public
ayahs.clear: When the records are made public.
ayahs.kemenag: dan apabila catatan-catatan (amal perbuatan manusia) dibuka,

ayahs.arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلسَّمَآءُ كُشِطَتْ
ayahs.sahih: And when the sky is stripped away
ayahs.clear: When the sky is peeled away.
ayahs.kemenag: dan apabila langit dilenyapkan,

ayahs.arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلْجَحِيمُ سُعِّرَتْ
ayahs.sahih: And when Hellfire is set ablaze
ayahs.clear: When the Fire is set ablaze.
ayahs.kemenag: dan apabila neraka Jahim dinyalakan,

ayahs.arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلْجَنَّةُ أُزْلِفَتْ
ayahs.sahih: And when Paradise is brought near,
ayahs.clear: When Paradise is brought near.
ayahs.kemenag: dan apabila surga didekatkan,

ayahs.arabic: عَلِمَتْ نَفْسٌۭ مَّآ أَحْضَرَتْ
ayahs.sahih: A soul will [then] know what it has brought [with it].
ayahs.clear: Each soul will know what it has readied.
ayahs.kemenag: maka tiap-tiap jiwa akan mengetahui apa yang telah dikerjakannya.

ayahs.arabic: فَلَآ أُقْسِمُ بِٱلْخُنَّسِ
ayahs.sahih: So I swear by the retreating stars -
ayahs.clear: I swear by the galaxies.
ayahs.kemenag: Sungguh, Aku bersumpah dengan bintang-bintang,

ayahs.arabic: ٱلْجَوَارِ ٱلْكُنَّسِ
ayahs.sahih: Those that run [their courses] and disappear -
ayahs.clear: Precisely running their courses.
ayahs.kemenag: yang beredar dan terbenam,

ayahs.arabic: وَٱلَّيْلِ إِذَا عَسْعَسَ
ayahs.sahih: And by the night as it closes in
ayahs.clear: And by the night as it recedes.
ayahs.kemenag: demi malam apabila telah hampir meninggalkan gelapnya,

ayahs.arabic: وَٱلصُّبْحِ إِذَا تَنَفَّسَ
ayahs.sahih: And by the dawn when it breathes
ayahs.clear: And by the morn as it breathes.
ayahs.kemenag: dan demi subuh apabila fajarnya mulai menyingsing,

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّهُۥ لَقَوْلُ رَسُولٍۢ كَرِيمٍۢ
ayahs.sahih: [That] indeed, the Qur'an is a word [conveyed by] a noble messenger
ayahs.clear: This is the speech of a noble messenger.
ayahs.kemenag: sesungguhnya Al Quran itu benar-benar firman (Allah yang dibawa oleh) utusan yang mulia (Jibril),

ayahs.arabic: ذِى قُوَّةٍ عِندَ ذِى ٱلْعَرْشِ مَكِينٍۢ
ayahs.sahih: [Who is] possessed of power and with the Owner of the Throne, secure [in position],
ayahs.clear: Endowed with power, eminent with the Lord of the Throne.
ayahs.kemenag: yang mempunyai kekuatan, yang mempunyai kedudukan tinggi di sisi Allah yang mempunyai 'Arsy,

ayahs.arabic: مُّطَاعٍۢ ثَمَّ أَمِينٍۢ
ayahs.sahih: Obeyed there [in the heavens] and trustworthy.
ayahs.clear: Obeyed and honest.
ayahs.kemenag: yang ditaati di sana (di alam malaikat) lagi dipercaya.

ayahs.arabic: وَمَا صَاحِبُكُم بِمَجْنُونٍۢ
ayahs.sahih: And your companion is not [at all] mad.
ayahs.clear: Your friend is not possessed.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan temanmu (Muhammad) itu bukanlah sekali-kali orang yang gila.

ayahs.arabic: وَلَقَدْ رَءَاهُ بِٱلْأُفُقِ ٱلْمُبِينِ
ayahs.sahih: And he has already seen Gabriel in the clear horizon.
ayahs.clear: He saw him on the luminous horizon.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan sesungguhnya Muhammad itu melihat Jibril di ufuk yang terang.

ayahs.arabic: وَمَا هُوَ عَلَى ٱلْغَيْبِ بِضَنِينٍۢ
ayahs.sahih: And Muhammad is not a withholder of [knowledge of] the unseen.
ayahs.clear: And He does not withhold knowledge of the Unseen.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan dia (Muhammad) bukanlah orang yang bakhil untuk menerangkan yang ghaib.

ayahs.arabic: وَمَا هُوَ بِقَوْلِ شَيْطَٰنٍۢ رَّجِيمٍۢ
ayahs.sahih: And the Qur'an is not the word of a devil, expelled [from the heavens].
ayahs.clear: And it is not the word of an accursed devil.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan Al Quran itu bukanlah perkataan syaitan yang terkutuk,

ayahs.arabic: فَأَيْنَ تَذْهَبُونَ
ayahs.sahih: So where are you going?
ayahs.clear: So where are you heading?
ayahs.kemenag: maka ke manakah kamu akan pergi?

ayahs.arabic: إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا ذِكْرٌۭ لِّلْعَٰلَمِينَ
ayahs.sahih: It is not except a reminder to the worlds
ayahs.clear: It is only a Reminder to all mankind.
ayahs.kemenag: Al Quran itu tiada lain hanyalah peringatan bagi semesta alam,

ayahs.arabic: لِمَن شَآءَ مِنكُمْ أَن يَسْتَقِيمَ
ayahs.sahih: For whoever wills among you to take a right course.
ayahs.clear: To whoever of you wills to go straight.
ayahs.kemenag: (yaitu) bagi siapa di antara kamu yang mau menempuh jalan yang lurus.

ayahs.arabic: وَمَا تَشَآءُونَ إِلَّآ أَن يَشَآءَ ٱللَّهُ رَبُّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
ayahs.sahih: And you do not will except that Allah wills - Lord of the worlds.
ayahs.clear: But you cannot will, unless God wills—The Lord of the Worlds.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan kamu tidak dapat menghendaki (menempuh jalan itu) kecuali apabila dikehendaki Allah, Tuhan semesta alam.

ayahs.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ إِذَا ٱلسَّمَآءُ ٱنفَطَرَتْ
ayahs.sahih: When the sky breaks apart
ayahs.clear: When the sky breaks apart.
ayahs.kemenag: Apabila langit terbelah,

ayahs.arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلْكَوَاكِبُ ٱنتَثَرَتْ
ayahs.sahih: And when the stars fall, scattering,
ayahs.clear: When the planets are scattered.
ayahs.kemenag: dan apabila bintang-bintang jatuh berserakan,

ayahs.arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلْبِحَارُ فُجِّرَتْ
ayahs.sahih: And when the seas are erupted
ayahs.clear: When the oceans are exploded.
ayahs.kemenag: dan apabila lautan menjadikan meluap,

ayahs.arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلْقُبُورُ بُعْثِرَتْ
ayahs.sahih: And when the [contents of] graves are scattered,
ayahs.clear: When the tombs are strewn around.
ayahs.kemenag: dan apabila kuburan-kuburan dibongkar,

ayahs.arabic: عَلِمَتْ نَفْسٌۭ مَّا قَدَّمَتْ وَأَخَّرَتْ
ayahs.sahih: A soul will [then] know what it has put forth and kept back.
ayahs.clear: Each soul will know what it has advanced, and what it has deferred.
ayahs.kemenag: maka tiap-tiap jiwa akan mengetahui apa yang telah dikerjakan dan yang dilalaikannya.

ayahs.arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ مَا غَرَّكَ بِرَبِّكَ ٱلْكَرِيمِ
ayahs.sahih: O mankind, what has deceived you concerning your Lord, the Generous,
ayahs.clear: O man! What deluded you concerning your Lord, the Most Generous?
ayahs.kemenag: Hai manusia, apakah yang telah memperdayakan kamu (berbuat durhaka) terhadap Tuhanmu Yang Maha Pemurah.

ayahs.arabic: ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَكَ فَسَوَّىٰكَ فَعَدَلَكَ
ayahs.sahih: Who created you, proportioned you, and balanced you?
ayahs.clear: He Who created you, and formed you, and proportioned you?
ayahs.kemenag: Yang telah menciptakan kamu lalu menyempurnakan kejadianmu dan menjadikan (susunan tubuh)mu seimbang,

ayahs.arabic: فِىٓ أَىِّ صُورَةٍۢ مَّا شَآءَ رَكَّبَكَ
ayahs.sahih: In whatever form He willed has He assembled you.
ayahs.clear: In whatever shape He willed, He assembled you.
ayahs.kemenag: dalam bentuk apa saja yang Dia kehendaki, Dia menyusun tubuhmu.

ayahs.arabic: كَلَّا بَلْ تُكَذِّبُونَ بِٱلدِّينِ
ayahs.sahih: No! But you deny the Recompense.
ayahs.clear: But you reject the religion.
ayahs.kemenag: Bukan hanya durhaka saja, bahkan kamu mendustakan hari pembalasan.

ayahs.arabic: وَإِنَّ عَلَيْكُمْ لَحَٰفِظِينَ
ayahs.sahih: And indeed, [appointed] over you are keepers,
ayahs.clear: Though over you are watchers.
ayahs.kemenag: Padahal sesungguhnya bagi kamu ada (malaikat-malaikat) yang mengawasi (pekerjaanmu),

ayahs.arabic: كِرَامًۭا كَٰتِبِينَ
ayahs.sahih: Noble and recording;
ayahs.clear: Honest recorders.
ayahs.kemenag: yang mulia (di sisi Allah) dan mencatat (pekerjaan-pekerjaanmu itu),

ayahs.arabic: يَعْلَمُونَ مَا تَفْعَلُونَ
ayahs.sahih: They know whatever you do.
ayahs.clear: They know everything you do.
ayahs.kemenag: mereka mengetahui apa yang kamu kerjakan.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلْأَبْرَارَ لَفِى نَعِيمٍۢ
ayahs.sahih: Indeed, the righteous will be in pleasure,
ayahs.clear: The virtuous will be in bliss.
ayahs.kemenag: Sesungguhnya orang-orang yang banyak berbakti benar-benar berada dalam surga yang penuh kenikmatan,

ayahs.arabic: وَإِنَّ ٱلْفُجَّارَ لَفِى جَحِيمٍۢ
ayahs.sahih: And indeed, the wicked will be in Hellfire.
ayahs.clear: While the wicked will be in Hell.
ayahs.kemenag: dan sesungguhnya orang-orang yang durhaka benar-benar berada dalam neraka.

ayahs.arabic: يَصْلَوْنَهَا يَوْمَ ٱلدِّينِ
ayahs.sahih: They will [enter to] burn therein on the Day of Recompense,
ayahs.clear: They will enter it on the Day of Justice.
ayahs.kemenag: Mereka masuk ke dalamnya pada hari pembalasan.

ayahs.arabic: وَمَا هُمْ عَنْهَا بِغَآئِبِينَ
ayahs.sahih: And never therefrom will they be absent.
ayahs.clear: And they will not be absent from it.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan mereka sekali-kali tidak dapat keluar dari neraka itu.

ayahs.arabic: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا يَوْمُ ٱلدِّينِ
ayahs.sahih: And what can make you know what is the Day of Recompense?
ayahs.clear: But what will convey to you what the Day of Justice is?
ayahs.kemenag: Tahukah kamu apakah hari pembalasan itu?

ayahs.arabic: ثُمَّ مَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا يَوْمُ ٱلدِّينِ
ayahs.sahih: Then, what can make you know what is the Day of Recompense?
ayahs.clear: Then again, what will convey to you what the Day of Justice is?
ayahs.kemenag: Sekali lagi, tahukah kamu apakah hari pembalasan itu?

ayahs.arabic: يَوْمَ لَا تَمْلِكُ نَفْسٌۭ لِّنَفْسٍۢ شَيْـًۭٔا ۖ وَٱلْأَمْرُ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ لِّلَّهِ
ayahs.sahih: It is the Day when a soul will not possess for another soul [power to do] a thing; and the command, that Day, is [entirely] with Allah.
ayahs.clear: The Day when no soul will avail another soul anything; and the decision on that Day is God’s.
ayahs.kemenag: (Yaitu) hari (ketika) seseorang tidak berdaya sedikitpun untuk menolong orang lain. Dan segala urusan pada hari itu dalam kekuasaan Allah.

ayahs.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ وَيْلٌۭ لِّلْمُطَفِّفِينَ
ayahs.sahih: Woe to those who give less [than due],
ayahs.clear: Woe to the defrauders.
ayahs.kemenag: Kecelakaan besarlah bagi orang-orang yang curang

ayahs.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ إِذَا ٱكْتَالُوا۟ عَلَى ٱلنَّاسِ يَسْتَوْفُونَ
ayahs.sahih: Who, when they take a measure from people, take in full.
ayahs.clear: Those who, when they take a measure from people, they take in full.
ayahs.kemenag: (yaitu) orang-orang yang apabila menerima takaran dari orang lain mereka minta dipenuhi,

ayahs.arabic: وَإِذَا كَالُوهُمْ أَو وَّزَنُوهُمْ يُخْسِرُونَ
ayahs.sahih: But if they give by measure or by weight to them, they cause loss.
ayahs.clear: But when they measure or weigh to others, they cheat.
ayahs.kemenag: dan apabila mereka menakar atau menimbang untuk orang lain, mereka mengurangi.

ayahs.arabic: أَلَا يَظُنُّ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ أَنَّهُم مَّبْعُوثُونَ
ayahs.sahih: Do they not think that they will be resurrected
ayahs.clear: Do these not know that they will be resurrected?
ayahs.kemenag: Tidaklah orang-orang itu menyangka, bahwa sesungguhnya mereka akan dibangkitkan,

ayahs.arabic: لِيَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍۢ
ayahs.sahih: For a tremendous Day -
ayahs.clear: For a Great Day?
ayahs.kemenag: pada suatu hari yang besar,

ayahs.arabic: يَوْمَ يَقُومُ ٱلنَّاسُ لِرَبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
ayahs.sahih: The Day when mankind will stand before the Lord of the worlds?
ayahs.clear: The Day when mankind will stand before the Lord of the Worlds?
ayahs.kemenag: (yaitu) hari (ketika) manusia berdiri menghadap Tuhan semesta alam?

ayahs.arabic: كَلَّآ إِنَّ كِتَٰبَ ٱلْفُجَّارِ لَفِى سِجِّينٍۢ
ayahs.sahih: No! Indeed, the record of the wicked is in sijjeen.
ayahs.clear: Not at all. The record of the wicked is in Sijjeen.
ayahs.kemenag: Sekali-kali jangan curang, karena sesungguhnya kitab orang yang durhaka tersimpan dalam sijjin.

ayahs.arabic: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا سِجِّينٌۭ
ayahs.sahih: And what can make you know what is sijjeen?
ayahs.clear: But how can you know what Sijjeen is?
ayahs.kemenag: Tahukah kamu apakah sijjin itu?

ayahs.arabic: كِتَٰبٌۭ مَّرْقُومٌۭ
ayahs.sahih: It is [their destination recorded in] a register inscribed.
ayahs.clear: A numerical book.
ayahs.kemenag: (Ialah) kitab yang bertulis.

ayahs.arabic: وَيْلٌۭ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
ayahs.sahih: Woe, that Day, to the deniers,
ayahs.clear: Woe on that Day to the deniers.
ayahs.kemenag: Kecelakaan yang besarlah pada hari itu bagi orang-orang yang mendustakan,

ayahs.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ يُكَذِّبُونَ بِيَوْمِ ٱلدِّينِ
ayahs.sahih: Who deny the Day of Recompense.
ayahs.clear: Those who deny the Day of Reckoning.
ayahs.kemenag: (yaitu) orang-orang yang mendustakan hari pembalasan.

ayahs.arabic: وَمَا يُكَذِّبُ بِهِۦٓ إِلَّا كُلُّ مُعْتَدٍ أَثِيمٍ
ayahs.sahih: And none deny it except every sinful transgressor.
ayahs.clear: But none denies it except the sinful aggressor.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan tidak ada yang mendustakan hari pembalasan itu melainkan setiap orang yang melampaui batas lagi berdosa,

ayahs.arabic: إِذَا تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِ ءَايَٰتُنَا قَالَ أَسَٰطِيرُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
ayahs.sahih: When Our verses are recited to him, he says, "Legends of the former peoples."
ayahs.clear: When Our revelations are recited to him, he says, “Legends of the ancients.”
ayahs.kemenag: yang apabila dibacakan kepadanya ayat-ayat Kami, ia berkata: "Itu adalah dongengan orang-orang yang dahulu"

ayahs.arabic: كَلَّا ۖ بَلْ ۜ رَانَ عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِهِم مَّا كَانُوا۟ يَكْسِبُونَ
ayahs.sahih: No! Rather, the stain has covered their hearts of that which they were earning.
ayahs.clear: Not at all. Their hearts have become corroded by what they used to earn.
ayahs.kemenag: Sekali-kali tidak (demikian), sebenarnya apa yang selalu mereka usahakan itu menutupi hati mereka.

ayahs.arabic: كَلَّآ إِنَّهُمْ عَن رَّبِّهِمْ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ لَّمَحْجُوبُونَ
ayahs.sahih: No! Indeed, from their Lord, that Day, they will be partitioned.
ayahs.clear: Not at all. On that Day, they will be screened from their Lord.
ayahs.kemenag: Sekali-kali tidak, sesungguhnya mereka pada hari itu benar-benar tertutup dari (rahmat) Tuhan mereka.

ayahs.arabic: ثُمَّ إِنَّهُمْ لَصَالُوا۟ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
ayahs.sahih: Then indeed, they will [enter and] burn in Hellfire.
ayahs.clear: Then they will roast in Hell.
ayahs.kemenag: Kemudian, sesungguhnya mereka benar-benar masuk neraka.

ayahs.arabic: ثُمَّ يُقَالُ هَٰذَا ٱلَّذِى كُنتُم بِهِۦ تُكَذِّبُونَ
ayahs.sahih: Then it will be said [to them], "This is what you used to deny."
ayahs.clear: Then it will be said, “This is what you used to deny.”
ayahs.kemenag: Kemudian, dikatakan (kepada mereka): "Inilah azab yang dahulu selalu kamu dustakan".

ayahs.arabic: كَلَّآ إِنَّ كِتَٰبَ ٱلْأَبْرَارِ لَفِى عِلِّيِّينَ
ayahs.sahih: No! Indeed, the record of the righteous is in 'illiyyun.
ayahs.clear: No indeed; the record of the righteous is in Elliyyeen.
ayahs.kemenag: Sekali-kali tidak, sesungguhnya kitab orang-orang yang berbakti itu (tersimpan) dalam 'Illiyyin.

ayahs.arabic: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا عِلِّيُّونَ
ayahs.sahih: And what can make you know what is 'illiyyun?
ayahs.clear: But how can you know what Elliyyoon is?
ayahs.kemenag: Tahukah kamu apakah 'Illiyyin itu?

ayahs.arabic: كِتَٰبٌۭ مَّرْقُومٌۭ
ayahs.sahih: It is [their destination recorded in] a register inscribed
ayahs.clear: A numerical book.
ayahs.kemenag: (Yaitu) kitab yang bertulis,

ayahs.arabic: يَشْهَدُهُ ٱلْمُقَرَّبُونَ
ayahs.sahih: Which is witnessed by those brought near [to Allah].
ayahs.clear: Witnessed by those brought near.
ayahs.kemenag: yang disaksikan oleh malaikat-malaikat yang didekatkan (kepada Allah).

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلْأَبْرَارَ لَفِى نَعِيمٍ
ayahs.sahih: Indeed, the righteous will be in pleasure
ayahs.clear: Indeed, the righteous will be amid bliss.
ayahs.kemenag: Sesungguhnya orang yang berbakti itu benar-benar berada dalam kenikmatan yang besar (surga),

ayahs.arabic: عَلَى ٱلْأَرَآئِكِ يَنظُرُونَ
ayahs.sahih: On adorned couches, observing.
ayahs.clear: On thrones, looking on.
ayahs.kemenag: mereka (duduk) di atas dipan-dipan sambil memandang.

ayahs.arabic: تَعْرِفُ فِى وُجُوهِهِمْ نَضْرَةَ ٱلنَّعِيمِ
ayahs.sahih: You will recognize in their faces the radiance of pleasure.
ayahs.clear: You will recognize on their faces the radiance of bliss.
ayahs.kemenag: Kamu dapat mengetahui dari wajah mereka kesenangan mereka yang penuh kenikmatan.

ayahs.arabic: يُسْقَوْنَ مِن رَّحِيقٍۢ مَّخْتُومٍ
ayahs.sahih: They will be given to drink [pure] wine [which was] sealed.
ayahs.clear: They will be given to drink a sealed wine.
ayahs.kemenag: Mereka diberi minum dari khamar murni yang dilak (tempatnya),

ayahs.arabic: خِتَٰمُهُۥ مِسْكٌۭ ۚ وَفِى ذَٰلِكَ فَلْيَتَنَافَسِ ٱلْمُتَنَٰفِسُونَ
ayahs.sahih: The last of it is musk. So for this let the competitors compete.
ayahs.clear: Whose seal is musk—this is what competitors should compete for.
ayahs.kemenag: laknya adalah kesturi; dan untuk yang demikian itu hendaknya orang berlomba-lomba.

ayahs.arabic: وَمِزَاجُهُۥ مِن تَسْنِيمٍ
ayahs.sahih: And its mixture is of Tasneem,
ayahs.clear: Its mixture is of Tasneem.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan campuran khamar murni itu adalah dari tasnim,

ayahs.arabic: عَيْنًۭا يَشْرَبُ بِهَا ٱلْمُقَرَّبُونَ
ayahs.sahih: A spring from which those near [to Allah] drink.
ayahs.clear: A spring from which those brought near drink.
ayahs.kemenag: (yaitu) mata air yang minum daripadanya orang-orang yang didekatkan kepada Allah.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ أَجْرَمُوا۟ كَانُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ يَضْحَكُونَ
ayahs.sahih: Indeed, those who committed crimes used to laugh at those who believed.
ayahs.clear: Those who committed crimes used to laugh at those who believed.
ayahs.kemenag: Sesungguhnya orang-orang yang berdosa, adalah mereka yang menertawakan orang-orang yang beriman.

ayahs.arabic: وَإِذَا مَرُّوا۟ بِهِمْ يَتَغَامَزُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And when they passed by them, they would exchange derisive glances.
ayahs.clear: And when they passed by them, they would wink at one another.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan apabila orang-orang yang beriman lalu di hadapan mereka, mereka saling mengedip-ngedipkan matanya.

ayahs.arabic: وَإِذَا ٱنقَلَبُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰٓ أَهْلِهِمُ ٱنقَلَبُوا۟ فَكِهِينَ
ayahs.sahih: And when they returned to their people, they would return jesting.
ayahs.clear: And when they went back to their families, they would go back exulting.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan apabila orang-orang yang berdosa itu kembali kepada kaumnya, mereka kembali dengan gembira.

ayahs.arabic: وَإِذَا رَأَوْهُمْ قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ لَضَآلُّونَ
ayahs.sahih: And when they saw them, they would say, "Indeed, those are truly lost."
ayahs.clear: And if they saw them, they would say, “These people are lost.”
ayahs.kemenag: Dan apabila mereka melihat orang-orang mukmin, mereka mengatakan: "Sesungguhnya mereka itu benar-benar orang-orang yang sesat",

ayahs.arabic: وَمَآ أُرْسِلُوا۟ عَلَيْهِمْ حَٰفِظِينَ
ayahs.sahih: But they had not been sent as guardians over them.
ayahs.clear: Yet they were not sent as guardians over them.
ayahs.kemenag: padahal orang-orang yang berdosa itu tidak dikirim untuk penjaga bagi orang-orang mukmin.

ayahs.arabic: فَٱلْيَوْمَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلْكُفَّارِ يَضْحَكُونَ
ayahs.sahih: So Today those who believed are laughing at the disbelievers,
ayahs.clear: But on that Day, those who believed will laugh at the unbelievers.
ayahs.kemenag: Maka pada hari ini, orang-orang yang beriman menertawakan orang-orang kafir,

ayahs.arabic: عَلَى ٱلْأَرَآئِكِ يَنظُرُونَ
ayahs.sahih: On adorned couches, observing.
ayahs.clear: On luxurious furnishings, looking on.
ayahs.kemenag: mereka (duduk) di atas dipan-dipan sambil memandang.

ayahs.arabic: هَلْ ثُوِّبَ ٱلْكُفَّارُ مَا كَانُوا۟ يَفْعَلُونَ
ayahs.sahih: Have the disbelievers [not] been rewarded [this Day] for what they used to do?
ayahs.clear: Have the unbelievers been repaid for what they used to do?
ayahs.kemenag: Sesungguhnya orang-orang kafir telah diberi ganjaran terhadap apa yang dahulu mereka kerjakan.

ayahs.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ إِذَا ٱلسَّمَآءُ ٱنشَقَّتْ
ayahs.sahih: When the sky has split [open]
ayahs.clear: When the sky is ruptured.
ayahs.kemenag: Apabila langit terbelah,

ayahs.arabic: وَأَذِنَتْ لِرَبِّهَا وَحُقَّتْ
ayahs.sahih: And has responded to its Lord and was obligated [to do so]
ayahs.clear: And hearkens to its Lord, as it must.
ayahs.kemenag: dan patuh kepada Tuhannya, dan sudah semestinya langit itu patuh,

ayahs.arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلْأَرْضُ مُدَّتْ
ayahs.sahih: And when the earth has been extended
ayahs.clear: And when the earth is leveled out.
ayahs.kemenag: dan apabila bumi diratakan,

ayahs.arabic: وَأَلْقَتْ مَا فِيهَا وَتَخَلَّتْ
ayahs.sahih: And has cast out that within it and relinquished [it]
ayahs.clear: And casts out what is in it, and becomes empty.
ayahs.kemenag: dan dilemparkan apa yang ada di dalamnya dan menjadi kosong,

ayahs.arabic: وَأَذِنَتْ لِرَبِّهَا وَحُقَّتْ
ayahs.sahih: And has responded to its Lord and was obligated [to do so] -
ayahs.clear: And hearkens to its Lord, as it must.
ayahs.kemenag: dan patuh kepada Tuhannya, dan sudah semestinya bumi itu patuh, (pada waktu itu manusia akan mengetahui akibat perbuatannya).

ayahs.arabic: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ إِنَّكَ كَادِحٌ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ كَدْحًۭا فَمُلَٰقِيهِ
ayahs.sahih: O mankind, indeed you are laboring toward your Lord with [great] exertion and will meet it.
ayahs.clear: O man! You are laboring towards your Lord, and you will meet Him.
ayahs.kemenag: Hai manusia, sesungguhnya kamu telah bekerja dengan sungguh-sungguh menuju Tuhanmu, maka pasti kamu akan menemui-Nya.

ayahs.arabic: فَأَمَّا مَنْ أُوتِىَ كِتَٰبَهُۥ بِيَمِينِهِۦ
ayahs.sahih: Then as for he who is given his record in his right hand,
ayahs.clear: As for him who is given his book in his right hand.
ayahs.kemenag: Adapun orang yang diberikan kitabnya dari sebelah kanannya,

ayahs.arabic: فَسَوْفَ يُحَاسَبُ حِسَابًۭا يَسِيرًۭا
ayahs.sahih: He will be judged with an easy account
ayahs.clear: He will have an easy settlement.
ayahs.kemenag: maka dia akan diperiksa dengan pemeriksaan yang mudah,

ayahs.arabic: وَيَنقَلِبُ إِلَىٰٓ أَهْلِهِۦ مَسْرُورًۭا
ayahs.sahih: And return to his people in happiness.
ayahs.clear: And will return to his family delighted.
ayahs.kemenag: dan dia akan kembali kepada kaumnya (yang sama-sama beriman) dengan gembira.

ayahs.arabic: وَأَمَّا مَنْ أُوتِىَ كِتَٰبَهُۥ وَرَآءَ ظَهْرِهِۦ
ayahs.sahih: But as for he who is given his record behind his back,
ayahs.clear: But as for him who is given his book behind his back.
ayahs.kemenag: Adapun orang-orang yang diberikan kitabnya dari belakang,

ayahs.arabic: فَسَوْفَ يَدْعُوا۟ ثُبُورًۭا
ayahs.sahih: He will cry out for destruction
ayahs.clear: He will call for death.
ayahs.kemenag: maka dia akan berteriak: "Celakalah aku".

ayahs.arabic: وَيَصْلَىٰ سَعِيرًا
ayahs.sahih: And [enter to] burn in a Blaze.
ayahs.clear: And will enter the Blaze.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan dia akan masuk ke dalam api yang menyala-nyala (neraka).

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ فِىٓ أَهْلِهِۦ مَسْرُورًا
ayahs.sahih: Indeed, he had [once] been among his people in happiness;
ayahs.clear: He used to be happy among his family.
ayahs.kemenag: Sesungguhnya dia dahulu (di dunia) bergembira di kalangan kaumnya (yang sama-sama kafir).

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّهُۥ ظَنَّ أَن لَّن يَحُورَ
ayahs.sahih: Indeed, he had thought he would never return [to Allah].
ayahs.clear: He thought he would never return.
ayahs.kemenag: Sesungguhnya dia menyangka bahwa dia sekali-kali tidak akan kembali (kepada Tuhannya).

ayahs.arabic: بَلَىٰٓ إِنَّ رَبَّهُۥ كَانَ بِهِۦ بَصِيرًۭا
ayahs.sahih: But yes! Indeed, his Lord was ever of him, Seeing.
ayahs.clear: In fact, his Lord was watching him.
ayahs.kemenag: (Bukan demikian), yang benar, sesungguhnya Tuhannya selalu melihatnya.

ayahs.arabic: فَلَآ أُقْسِمُ بِٱلشَّفَقِ
ayahs.sahih: So I swear by the twilight glow
ayahs.clear: I swear by the twilight.
ayahs.kemenag: Maka sesungguhnya Aku bersumpah dengan cahaya merah di waktu senja,

ayahs.arabic: وَٱلَّيْلِ وَمَا وَسَقَ
ayahs.sahih: And [by] the night and what it envelops
ayahs.clear: And by the night, and what it covers.
ayahs.kemenag: dan dengan malam dan apa yang diselubunginya,

ayahs.arabic: وَٱلْقَمَرِ إِذَا ٱتَّسَقَ
ayahs.sahih: And [by] the moon when it becomes full
ayahs.clear: And by the moon, as it grows full.
ayahs.kemenag: dan dengan bulan apabila jadi purnama,

ayahs.arabic: لَتَرْكَبُنَّ طَبَقًا عَن طَبَقٍۢ
ayahs.sahih: [That] you will surely experience state after state.
ayahs.clear: You will mount stage by stage.
ayahs.kemenag: sesungguhnya kamu melalui tingkat demi tingkat (dalam kehidupan),

ayahs.arabic: فَمَا لَهُمْ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ
ayahs.sahih: So what is [the matter] with them [that] they do not believe,
ayahs.clear: What is the matter with them that they do not believe?
ayahs.kemenag: Mengapa mereka tidak mau beriman?

ayahs.arabic: وَإِذَا قُرِئَ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلْقُرْءَانُ لَا يَسْجُدُونَ ۩
ayahs.sahih: And when the Qur'an is recited to them, they do not prostrate [to Allah]?
ayahs.clear: And when the Quran is read to them, they do not bow down?
ayahs.kemenag: dan apabila Al Quran dibacakan kepada mereka, mereka tidak bersujud,

ayahs.arabic: بَلِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ يُكَذِّبُونَ
ayahs.sahih: But those who have disbelieved deny,
ayahs.clear: In fact, those who disbelieve are in denial.
ayahs.kemenag: bahkan orang-orang kafir itu mendustakan(nya).

ayahs.arabic: وَٱللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا يُوعُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And Allah is most knowing of what they keep within themselves.
ayahs.clear: But God knows what they hide inside.
ayahs.kemenag: Padahal Allah mengetahui apa yang mereka sembunyikan (dalam hati mereka).

ayahs.arabic: فَبَشِّرْهُم بِعَذَابٍ أَلِيمٍ
ayahs.sahih: So give them tidings of a painful punishment,
ayahs.clear: So inform them of a painful punishment.
ayahs.kemenag: Maka beri kabar gembiralah mereka dengan azab yang pedih,

ayahs.arabic: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ لَهُمْ أَجْرٌ غَيْرُ مَمْنُونٍۭ
ayahs.sahih: Except for those who believe and do righteous deeds. For them is a reward uninterrupted.
ayahs.clear: Except those who believe and do good deeds; they will have an undiminished reward.
ayahs.kemenag: tetapi orang-orang yang beriman dan beramal saleh, bagi mereka pahala yang tidak putus-putusnya.

ayahs.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ وَٱلسَّمَآءِ ذَاتِ ٱلْبُرُوجِ
ayahs.sahih: By the sky containing great stars
ayahs.clear: By the sky with the constellations.
ayahs.kemenag: Demi langit yang mempunyai gugusan bintang,

ayahs.arabic: وَٱلْيَوْمِ ٱلْمَوْعُودِ
ayahs.sahih: And [by] the promised Day
ayahs.clear: And by the Promised Day.
ayahs.kemenag: dan hari yang dijanjikan,

ayahs.arabic: وَشَاهِدٍۢ وَمَشْهُودٍۢ
ayahs.sahih: And [by] the witness and what is witnessed,
ayahs.clear: And by the witness and the witnessed.
ayahs.kemenag: dan yang menyaksikan dan yang disaksikan.

ayahs.arabic: قُتِلَ أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلْأُخْدُودِ
ayahs.sahih: Cursed were the companions of the trench
ayahs.clear: Destroyed were the People of the Trench.
ayahs.kemenag: Binasa dan terlaknatlah orang-orang yang membuat parit,

ayahs.arabic: ٱلنَّارِ ذَاتِ ٱلْوَقُودِ
ayahs.sahih: [Containing] the fire full of fuel,
ayahs.clear: The fire supplied with fuel.
ayahs.kemenag: yang berapi (dinyalakan dengan) kayu bakar,

ayahs.arabic: إِذْ هُمْ عَلَيْهَا قُعُودٌۭ
ayahs.sahih: When they were sitting near it
ayahs.clear: While they sat around it.
ayahs.kemenag: ketika mereka duduk di sekitarnya,

ayahs.arabic: وَهُمْ عَلَىٰ مَا يَفْعَلُونَ بِٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ شُهُودٌۭ
ayahs.sahih: And they, to what they were doing against the believers, were witnesses.
ayahs.clear: And were witnessing what they did to the believers.
ayahs.kemenag: sedang mereka menyaksikan apa yang mereka perbuat terhadap orang-orang yang beriman.

ayahs.arabic: وَمَا نَقَمُوا۟ مِنْهُمْ إِلَّآ أَن يُؤْمِنُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْحَمِيدِ
ayahs.sahih: And they resented them not except because they believed in Allah, the Exalted in Might, the Praiseworthy,
ayahs.clear: They begrudged them only because they believed in God the Almighty, the Praiseworthy.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan mereka tidak menyiksa orang-orang mukmin itu melainkan karena orang-orang mukmin itu beriman kepada Allah Yang Maha Perkasa lagi Maha Terpuji,

ayahs.arabic: ٱلَّذِى لَهُۥ مُلْكُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍۢ شَهِيدٌ
ayahs.sahih: To whom belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth. And Allah, over all things, is Witness.
ayahs.clear: To Whom belongs the sovereignty of the heavens and the earth. God is witness over everything.
ayahs.kemenag: Yang mempunyai kerajaan langit dan bumi; dan Allah Maha Menyaksikan segala sesuatu.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ فَتَنُوا۟ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَٱلْمُؤْمِنَٰتِ ثُمَّ لَمْ يَتُوبُوا۟ فَلَهُمْ عَذَابُ جَهَنَّمَ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابُ ٱلْحَرِيقِ
ayahs.sahih: Indeed, those who have tortured the believing men and believing women and then have not repented will have the punishment of Hell, and they will have the punishment of the Burning Fire.
ayahs.clear: Those who tempt the believers, men and women, then do not repent; for them is the punishment of Hell; for them is the punishment of Burning.
ayahs.kemenag: Sesungguhnya orang-orang yang mendatangkan cobaan kepada orang-orang yang mukmin laki-laki dan perempuan kemudian mereka tidak bertaubat, maka bagi mereka azab Jahannam dan bagi mereka azab (neraka) yang membakar.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ لَهُمْ جَنَّٰتٌۭ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَٰرُ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْفَوْزُ ٱلْكَبِيرُ
ayahs.sahih: Indeed, those who have believed and done righteous deeds will have gardens beneath which rivers flow. That is the great attainment.
ayahs.clear: Those who believe and do righteous deeds will have Gardens beneath which rivers flow. That is the great triumph.
ayahs.kemenag: Sesungguhnya orang-orang yang beriman dan mengerjakan amal-amal yang saleh bagi mereka surga yang mengalir di bawahnya sungai-sungai; itulah keberuntungan yang besar.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ بَطْشَ رَبِّكَ لَشَدِيدٌ
ayahs.sahih: Indeed, the vengeance of your Lord is severe.
ayahs.clear: The onslaught of your Lord is severe.
ayahs.kemenag: Sesungguhnya azab Tuhanmu benar-benar keras.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ يُبْدِئُ وَيُعِيدُ
ayahs.sahih: Indeed, it is He who originates [creation] and repeats.
ayahs.clear: It is He who begins and repeats.
ayahs.kemenag: Sesungguhnya Dialah Yang menciptakan (makhluk) dari permulaan dan menghidupkannya (kembali).

ayahs.arabic: وَهُوَ ٱلْغَفُورُ ٱلْوَدُودُ
ayahs.sahih: And He is the Forgiving, the Affectionate,
ayahs.clear: And He is the Forgiving, the Loving.
ayahs.kemenag: Dialah Yang Maha Pengampun lagi Maha Pengasih,

ayahs.arabic: ذُو ٱلْعَرْشِ ٱلْمَجِيدُ
ayahs.sahih: Honorable Owner of the Throne,
ayahs.clear: Possessor of the Glorious Throne.
ayahs.kemenag: yang mempunyai 'Arsy, lagi Maha Mulia,

ayahs.arabic: فَعَّالٌۭ لِّمَا يُرِيدُ
ayahs.sahih: Effecter of what He intends.
ayahs.clear: Doer of whatever He wills.
ayahs.kemenag: Maha Kuasa berbuat apa yang dikehendaki-Nya.

ayahs.arabic: هَلْ أَتَىٰكَ حَدِيثُ ٱلْجُنُودِ
ayahs.sahih: Has there reached you the story of the soldiers -
ayahs.clear: Has there come to you the story of the legions?
ayahs.kemenag: Sudahkah datang kepadamu berita kaum-kaum penentang,

ayahs.arabic: فِرْعَوْنَ وَثَمُودَ
ayahs.sahih: [Those of] Pharaoh and Thamud?
ayahs.clear: Of Pharaoh and Thamood?
ayahs.kemenag: (yaitu kaum) Fir'aun dan (kaum) Tsamud?

ayahs.arabic: بَلِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ فِى تَكْذِيبٍۢ
ayahs.sahih: But they who disbelieve are in [persistent] denial,
ayahs.clear: In fact, those who disbelieve are in denial.
ayahs.kemenag: Sesungguhnya orang-orang kafir selalu mendustakan,

ayahs.arabic: وَٱللَّهُ مِن وَرَآئِهِم مُّحِيطٌۢ
ayahs.sahih: While Allah encompasses them from behind.
ayahs.clear: And God encloses them from beyond.
ayahs.kemenag: padahal Allah mengepung mereka dari belakang mereka.

ayahs.arabic: بَلْ هُوَ قُرْءَانٌۭ مَّجِيدٌۭ
ayahs.sahih: But this is an honored Qur'an
ayahs.clear: In fact, it is a Glorious Quran.
ayahs.kemenag: Bahkan yang didustakan mereka itu ialah Al Quran yang mulia,

ayahs.arabic: فِى لَوْحٍۢ مَّحْفُوظٍۭ
ayahs.sahih: [Inscribed] in a Preserved Slate.
ayahs.clear: In a Preserved Tablet.
ayahs.kemenag: yang (tersimpan) dalam Lauh Mahfuzh.

ayahs.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ وَٱلسَّمَآءِ وَٱلطَّارِقِ
ayahs.sahih: By the sky and the night comer -
ayahs.clear: By the sky and at-Tariq.
ayahs.kemenag: Demi langit dan yang datang pada malam hari,

ayahs.arabic: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا ٱلطَّارِقُ
ayahs.sahih: And what can make you know what is the night comer?
ayahs.clear: But what will let you know what at-Tariq is?
ayahs.kemenag: tahukah kamu apakah yang datang pada malam hari itu?

ayahs.arabic: ٱلنَّجْمُ ٱلثَّاقِبُ
ayahs.sahih: It is the piercing star -
ayahs.clear: The Piercing Star.
ayahs.kemenag: (yaitu) bintang yang cahayanya menembus,

ayahs.arabic: إِن كُلُّ نَفْسٍۢ لَّمَّا عَلَيْهَا حَافِظٌۭ
ayahs.sahih: There is no soul but that it has over it a protector.
ayahs.clear: There is no soul without a Protector over it.
ayahs.kemenag: tidak ada suatu jiwapun (diri) melainkan ada penjaganya.

ayahs.arabic: فَلْيَنظُرِ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ مِمَّ خُلِقَ
ayahs.sahih: So let man observe from what he was created.
ayahs.clear: Let man consider what he was created from.
ayahs.kemenag: Maka hendaklah manusia memperhatikan dari apakah dia diciptakan?

ayahs.arabic: خُلِقَ مِن مَّآءٍۢ دَافِقٍۢ
ayahs.sahih: He was created from a fluid, ejected,
ayahs.clear: He was created from gushing liquid.
ayahs.kemenag: Dia diciptakan dari air yang dipancarkan,

ayahs.arabic: يَخْرُجُ مِنۢ بَيْنِ ٱلصُّلْبِ وَٱلتَّرَآئِبِ
ayahs.sahih: Emerging from between the backbone and the ribs.
ayahs.clear: Issuing from between the backbone and the breastbones.
ayahs.kemenag: yang keluar dari antara tulang sulbi laki-laki dan tulang dada perempuan.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّهُۥ عَلَىٰ رَجْعِهِۦ لَقَادِرٌۭ
ayahs.sahih: Indeed, Allah, to return him [to life], is Able.
ayahs.clear: He is certainly able to return him.
ayahs.kemenag: Sesungguhnya Allah benar-benar kuasa untuk mengembalikannya (hidup sesudah mati).

ayahs.arabic: يَوْمَ تُبْلَى ٱلسَّرَآئِرُ
ayahs.sahih: The Day when secrets will be put on trial,
ayahs.clear: On the Day when the secrets are disclosed.
ayahs.kemenag: Pada hari dinampakkan segala rahasia,

ayahs.arabic: فَمَا لَهُۥ مِن قُوَّةٍۢ وَلَا نَاصِرٍۢ
ayahs.sahih: Then man will have no power or any helper.
ayahs.clear: He will have no strength, and no supporter.
ayahs.kemenag: maka sekali-kali tidak ada bagi manusia itu suatu kekuatanpun dan tidak (pula) seorang penolong.

ayahs.arabic: وَٱلسَّمَآءِ ذَاتِ ٱلرَّجْعِ
ayahs.sahih: By the sky which returns [rain]
ayahs.clear: By the sky that returns.
ayahs.kemenag: Demi langit yang mengandung hujan

ayahs.arabic: وَٱلْأَرْضِ ذَاتِ ٱلصَّدْعِ
ayahs.sahih: And [by] the earth which cracks open,
ayahs.clear: And the earth that cracks open.
ayahs.kemenag: dan bumi yang mempunyai tumbuh-tumbuhan,

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّهُۥ لَقَوْلٌۭ فَصْلٌۭ
ayahs.sahih: Indeed, the Qur'an is a decisive statement,
ayahs.clear: It is a Decisive Word.
ayahs.kemenag: sesungguhnya Al Quran itu benar-benar firman yang memisahkan antara yang hak dan yang bathil.

ayahs.arabic: وَمَا هُوَ بِٱلْهَزْلِ
ayahs.sahih: And it is not amusement.
ayahs.clear: It is no joke.
ayahs.kemenag: dan sekali-kali bukanlah dia senda gurau.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّهُمْ يَكِيدُونَ كَيْدًۭا
ayahs.sahih: Indeed, they are planning a plan,
ayahs.clear: They plot and scheme.
ayahs.kemenag: Sesungguhnya orang kafir itu merencanakan tipu daya yang jahat dengan sebenar-benarnya.

ayahs.arabic: وَأَكِيدُ كَيْدًۭا
ayahs.sahih: But I am planning a plan.
ayahs.clear: But I plot and scheme.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan Akupun membuat rencana (pula) dengan sebenar-benarnya.

ayahs.arabic: فَمَهِّلِ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ أَمْهِلْهُمْ رُوَيْدًۢا
ayahs.sahih: So allow time for the disbelievers. Leave them awhile.
ayahs.clear: Therefore, give the blasphemers respite, a brief respite.
ayahs.kemenag: Karena itu beri tangguhlah orang-orang kafir itu yaitu beri tangguhlah mereka itu barang sebentar.

ayahs.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ سَبِّحِ ٱسْمَ رَبِّكَ ٱلْأَعْلَى
ayahs.sahih: Exalt the name of your Lord, the Most High,
ayahs.clear: Praise the Name of your Lord, the Most High.
ayahs.kemenag: Sucikanlah nama Tuhanmu Yang Maha Tingi,

ayahs.arabic: ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ فَسَوَّىٰ
ayahs.sahih: Who created and proportioned
ayahs.clear: He who creates and regulates.
ayahs.kemenag: yang menciptakan, dan menyempurnakan (penciptaan-Nya),

ayahs.arabic: وَٱلَّذِى قَدَّرَ فَهَدَىٰ
ayahs.sahih: And who destined and [then] guided
ayahs.clear: He who measures and guides.
ayahs.kemenag: dan yang menentukan kadar (masing-masing) dan memberi petunjuk,

ayahs.arabic: وَٱلَّذِىٓ أَخْرَجَ ٱلْمَرْعَىٰ
ayahs.sahih: And who brings out the pasture
ayahs.clear: He who produces the pasture.
ayahs.kemenag: dan yang menumbuhkan rumput-rumputan,

ayahs.arabic: فَجَعَلَهُۥ غُثَآءً أَحْوَىٰ
ayahs.sahih: And [then] makes it black stubble.
ayahs.clear: And then turns it into light debris.
ayahs.kemenag: lalu dijadikan-Nya rumput-rumput itu kering kehitam-hitaman.

ayahs.arabic: سَنُقْرِئُكَ فَلَا تَنسَىٰٓ
ayahs.sahih: We will make you recite, [O Muhammad], and you will not forget,
ayahs.clear: We will make you read, so do not forget.
ayahs.kemenag: Kami akan membacakan (Al Quran) kepadamu (Muhammad) maka kamu tidak akan lupa,

ayahs.arabic: إِلَّا مَا شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ يَعْلَمُ ٱلْجَهْرَ وَمَا يَخْفَىٰ
ayahs.sahih: Except what Allah should will. Indeed, He knows what is declared and what is hidden.
ayahs.clear: Except what God wills. He knows what is declared, and what is hidden.
ayahs.kemenag: kecuali kalau Allah menghendaki. Sesungguhnya Dia mengetahui yang terang dan yang tersembunyi.

ayahs.arabic: وَنُيَسِّرُكَ لِلْيُسْرَىٰ
ayahs.sahih: And We will ease you toward ease.
ayahs.clear: We will ease you into the Easy Way.
ayahs.kemenag: dan Kami akan memberi kamu taufik ke jalan yang mudah,

ayahs.arabic: فَذَكِّرْ إِن نَّفَعَتِ ٱلذِّكْرَىٰ
ayahs.sahih: So remind, if the reminder should benefit;
ayahs.clear: So remind, if reminding helps.
ayahs.kemenag: oleh sebab itu berikanlah peringatan karena peringatan itu bermanfaat,

ayahs.arabic: سَيَذَّكَّرُ مَن يَخْشَىٰ
ayahs.sahih: He who fears [Allah] will be reminded.
ayahs.clear: The reverent will remember.
ayahs.kemenag: orang yang takut (kepada Allah) akan mendapat pelajaran,

ayahs.arabic: وَيَتَجَنَّبُهَا ٱلْأَشْقَى
ayahs.sahih: But the wretched one will avoid it -
ayahs.clear: But the wretched will avoid it.
ayahs.kemenag: dan orang-orang yang celaka (kafir) akan menjauhinya.

ayahs.arabic: ٱلَّذِى يَصْلَى ٱلنَّارَ ٱلْكُبْرَىٰ
ayahs.sahih: [He] who will [enter and] burn in the greatest Fire,
ayahs.clear: He who will enter the Gigantic Fire.
ayahs.kemenag: (Yaitu) orang yang akan memasuki api yang besar (neraka).

ayahs.arabic: ثُمَّ لَا يَمُوتُ فِيهَا وَلَا يَحْيَىٰ
ayahs.sahih: Neither dying therein nor living.
ayahs.clear: Where he will neither die, nor live.
ayahs.kemenag: Kemudian dia tidak akan mati di dalamnya dan tidak (pula) hidup.

ayahs.arabic: قَدْ أَفْلَحَ مَن تَزَكَّىٰ
ayahs.sahih: He has certainly succeeded who purifies himself
ayahs.clear: Successful is he who purifies himself.
ayahs.kemenag: Sesungguhnya beruntunglah orang yang membersihkan diri (dengan beriman),

ayahs.arabic: وَذَكَرَ ٱسْمَ رَبِّهِۦ فَصَلَّىٰ
ayahs.sahih: And mentions the name of his Lord and prays.
ayahs.clear: And mentions the name of his Lord, and prays.
ayahs.kemenag: dan dia ingat nama Tuhannya, lalu dia sembahyang.

ayahs.arabic: بَلْ تُؤْثِرُونَ ٱلْحَيَوٰةَ ٱلدُّنْيَا
ayahs.sahih: But you prefer the worldly life,
ayahs.clear: But you prefer the present life.
ayahs.kemenag: Tetapi kamu (orang-orang kafir) memilih kehidupan duniawi.

ayahs.arabic: وَٱلْءَاخِرَةُ خَيْرٌۭ وَأَبْقَىٰٓ
ayahs.sahih: While the Hereafter is better and more enduring.
ayahs.clear: Though the Hereafter is better, and more lasting.
ayahs.kemenag: Sedang kehidupan akhirat adalah lebih baik dan lebih kekal.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَفِى ٱلصُّحُفِ ٱلْأُولَىٰ
ayahs.sahih: Indeed, this is in the former scriptures,
ayahs.clear: This is in the former scriptures.
ayahs.kemenag: Sesungguhnya ini benar-benar terdapat dalam kitab-kitab yang dahulu,

ayahs.arabic: صُحُفِ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ وَمُوسَىٰ
ayahs.sahih: The scriptures of Abraham and Moses.
ayahs.clear: The Scriptures of Abraham and Moses.
ayahs.kemenag: (yaitu) Kitab-kitab Ibrahim dan Musa

ayahs.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ هَلْ أَتَىٰكَ حَدِيثُ ٱلْغَٰشِيَةِ
ayahs.sahih: Has there reached you the report of the Overwhelming [event]?
ayahs.clear: Has there come to you the news of the overwhelming?
ayahs.kemenag: Sudah datangkah kepadamu berita (tentang) hari pembalasan?

ayahs.arabic: وُجُوهٌۭ يَوْمَئِذٍ خَٰشِعَةٌ
ayahs.sahih: [Some] faces, that Day, will be humbled,
ayahs.clear: Faces on that Day will be shamed.
ayahs.kemenag: Banyak muka pada hari itu tunduk terhina,

ayahs.arabic: عَامِلَةٌۭ نَّاصِبَةٌۭ
ayahs.sahih: Working [hard] and exhausted.
ayahs.clear: Laboring and exhausted.
ayahs.kemenag: bekerja keras lagi kepayahan,

ayahs.arabic: تَصْلَىٰ نَارًا حَامِيَةًۭ
ayahs.sahih: They will [enter to] burn in an intensely hot Fire.
ayahs.clear: Roasting in a scorching Fire.
ayahs.kemenag: memasuki api yang sangat panas (neraka),

ayahs.arabic: تُسْقَىٰ مِنْ عَيْنٍ ءَانِيَةٍۢ
ayahs.sahih: They will be given drink from a boiling spring.
ayahs.clear: Given to drink from a flaming spring.
ayahs.kemenag: diberi minum (dengan air) dari sumber yang sangat panas.

ayahs.arabic: لَّيْسَ لَهُمْ طَعَامٌ إِلَّا مِن ضَرِيعٍۢ
ayahs.sahih: For them there will be no food except from a poisonous, thorny plant
ayahs.clear: They will have no food except thorns.
ayahs.kemenag: Mereka tiada memperoleh makanan selain dari pohon yang berduri,

ayahs.arabic: لَّا يُسْمِنُ وَلَا يُغْنِى مِن جُوعٍۢ
ayahs.sahih: Which neither nourishes nor avails against hunger.
ayahs.clear: That neither nourishes, nor satisfies hunger.
ayahs.kemenag: yang tidak menggemukkan dan tidak pula menghilangkan lapar.

ayahs.arabic: وُجُوهٌۭ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ نَّاعِمَةٌۭ
ayahs.sahih: [Other] faces, that Day, will show pleasure.
ayahs.clear: Faces on that Day will be joyful.
ayahs.kemenag: Banyak muka pada hari itu berseri-seri,

ayahs.arabic: لِّسَعْيِهَا رَاضِيَةٌۭ
ayahs.sahih: With their effort [they are] satisfied
ayahs.clear: Satisfied with their endeavor.
ayahs.kemenag: merasa senang karena usahanya,

ayahs.arabic: فِى جَنَّةٍ عَالِيَةٍۢ
ayahs.sahih: In an elevated garden,
ayahs.clear: In a lofty Garden.
ayahs.kemenag: dalam surga yang tinggi,

ayahs.arabic: لَّا تَسْمَعُ فِيهَا لَٰغِيَةًۭ
ayahs.sahih: Wherein they will hear no unsuitable speech.
ayahs.clear: In it you will hear no nonsense.
ayahs.kemenag: tidak kamu dengar di dalamnya perkataan yang tidak berguna.

ayahs.arabic: فِيهَا عَيْنٌۭ جَارِيَةٌۭ
ayahs.sahih: Within it is a flowing spring.
ayahs.clear: In it is a flowing spring.
ayahs.kemenag: Di dalamnya ada mata air yang mengalir.

ayahs.arabic: فِيهَا سُرُرٌۭ مَّرْفُوعَةٌۭ
ayahs.sahih: Within it are couches raised high
ayahs.clear: In it are raised beds.
ayahs.kemenag: Di dalamnya ada takhta-takhta yang ditinggikan,

ayahs.arabic: وَأَكْوَابٌۭ مَّوْضُوعَةٌۭ
ayahs.sahih: And cups put in place
ayahs.clear: And cups set in place.
ayahs.kemenag: dan gelas-gelas yang terletak (di dekatnya),

ayahs.arabic: وَنَمَارِقُ مَصْفُوفَةٌۭ
ayahs.sahih: And cushions lined up
ayahs.clear: And cushions set in rows.
ayahs.kemenag: dan bantal-bantal sandaran yang tersusun,

ayahs.arabic: وَزَرَابِىُّ مَبْثُوثَةٌ
ayahs.sahih: And carpets spread around.
ayahs.clear: And carpets spread around.
ayahs.kemenag: dan permadani-permadani yang terhampar.

ayahs.arabic: أَفَلَا يَنظُرُونَ إِلَى ٱلْإِبِلِ كَيْفَ خُلِقَتْ
ayahs.sahih: Then do they not look at the camels - how they are created?
ayahs.clear: Do they not look at the camels—how they are created?
ayahs.kemenag: Maka apakah mereka tidak memperhatikan unta bagaimana dia diciptakan,

ayahs.arabic: وَإِلَى ٱلسَّمَآءِ كَيْفَ رُفِعَتْ
ayahs.sahih: And at the sky - how it is raised?
ayahs.clear: And at the sky—how it is raised?
ayahs.kemenag: Dan langit, bagaimana ia ditinggikan?

ayahs.arabic: وَإِلَى ٱلْجِبَالِ كَيْفَ نُصِبَتْ
ayahs.sahih: And at the mountains - how they are erected?
ayahs.clear: And at the mountains—how they are installed?
ayahs.kemenag: Dan gunung-gunung bagaimana ia ditegakkan?

ayahs.arabic: وَإِلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ كَيْفَ سُطِحَتْ
ayahs.sahih: And at the earth - how it is spread out?
ayahs.clear: And at the earth—how it is spread out?
ayahs.kemenag: Dan bumi bagaimana ia dihamparkan?

ayahs.arabic: فَذَكِّرْ إِنَّمَآ أَنتَ مُذَكِّرٌۭ
ayahs.sahih: So remind, [O Muhammad]; you are only a reminder.
ayahs.clear: So remind. You are only a reminder.
ayahs.kemenag: Maka berilah peringatan, karena sesungguhnya kamu hanyalah orang yang memberi peringatan.

ayahs.arabic: لَّسْتَ عَلَيْهِم بِمُصَيْطِرٍ
ayahs.sahih: You are not over them a controller.
ayahs.clear: You have no control over them.
ayahs.kemenag: Kamu bukanlah orang yang berkuasa atas mereka,

ayahs.arabic: إِلَّا مَن تَوَلَّىٰ وَكَفَرَ
ayahs.sahih: However, he who turns away and disbelieves -
ayahs.clear: But whoever turns away and disbelieves.
ayahs.kemenag: tetapi orang yang berpaling dan kafir,

ayahs.arabic: فَيُعَذِّبُهُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْعَذَابَ ٱلْأَكْبَرَ
ayahs.sahih: Then Allah will punish him with the greatest punishment.
ayahs.clear: God will punish him with the greatest punishment.
ayahs.kemenag: maka Allah akan mengazabnya dengan azab yang besar.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ إِلَيْنَآ إِيَابَهُمْ
ayahs.sahih: Indeed, to Us is their return.
ayahs.clear: To Us is their return.
ayahs.kemenag: Sesungguhnya kepada Kami-lah kembali mereka,

ayahs.arabic: ثُمَّ إِنَّ عَلَيْنَا حِسَابَهُم
ayahs.sahih: Then indeed, upon Us is their account.
ayahs.clear: Then upon Us rests their reckoning.
ayahs.kemenag: kemudian sesungguhnya kewajiban Kami-lah menghisab mereka.

ayahs.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ وَٱلْفَجْرِ
ayahs.sahih: By the dawn
ayahs.clear: By the daybreak.
ayahs.kemenag: Demi fajar,

ayahs.arabic: وَلَيَالٍ عَشْرٍۢ
ayahs.sahih: And [by] ten nights
ayahs.clear: And ten nights.
ayahs.kemenag: dan malam yang sepuluh,

ayahs.arabic: وَٱلشَّفْعِ وَٱلْوَتْرِ
ayahs.sahih: And [by] the even [number] and the odd
ayahs.clear: And the even and the odd.
ayahs.kemenag: dan yang genap dan yang ganjil,

ayahs.arabic: وَٱلَّيْلِ إِذَا يَسْرِ
ayahs.sahih: And [by] the night when it passes,
ayahs.clear: And the night as it recedes.
ayahs.kemenag: dan malam bila berlalu.

ayahs.arabic: هَلْ فِى ذَٰلِكَ قَسَمٌۭ لِّذِى حِجْرٍ
ayahs.sahih: Is there [not] in [all] that an oath [sufficient] for one of perception?
ayahs.clear: Is there in this an oath for a rational person?
ayahs.kemenag: Pada yang demikian itu terdapat sumpah (yang dapat diterima) oleh orang-orang yang berakal.

ayahs.arabic: أَلَمْ تَرَ كَيْفَ فَعَلَ رَبُّكَ بِعَادٍ
ayahs.sahih: Have you not considered how your Lord dealt with 'Aad -
ayahs.clear: Have you not seen how your Lord dealt with Aad?
ayahs.kemenag: Apakah kamu tidak memperhatikan bagaimana Tuhanmu berbuat terhadap kaum 'Aad?

ayahs.arabic: إِرَمَ ذَاتِ ٱلْعِمَادِ
ayahs.sahih: [With] Iram - who had lofty pillars,
ayahs.clear: Erum of the pillars.
ayahs.kemenag: (yaitu) penduduk Iram yang mempunyai bangunan-bangunan yang tinggi,

ayahs.arabic: ٱلَّتِى لَمْ يُخْلَقْ مِثْلُهَا فِى ٱلْبِلَٰدِ
ayahs.sahih: The likes of whom had never been created in the land?
ayahs.clear: The like of which was never created in the land.
ayahs.kemenag: yang belum pernah dibangun (suatu kota) seperti itu, di negeri-negeri lain,

ayahs.arabic: وَثَمُودَ ٱلَّذِينَ جَابُوا۟ ٱلصَّخْرَ بِٱلْوَادِ
ayahs.sahih: And [with] Thamud, who carved out the rocks in the valley?
ayahs.clear: And Thamood—those who carved the rocks in the valley.
ayahs.kemenag: dan kaum Tsamud yang memotong batu-batu besar di lembah,

ayahs.arabic: وَفِرْعَوْنَ ذِى ٱلْأَوْتَادِ
ayahs.sahih: And [with] Pharaoh, owner of the stakes? -
ayahs.clear: And Pharaoh of the Stakes.
ayahs.kemenag: dan kaum Fir'aun yang mempunyai pasak-pasak (tentara yang banyak),

ayahs.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ طَغَوْا۟ فِى ٱلْبِلَٰدِ
ayahs.sahih: [All of] whom oppressed within the lands
ayahs.clear: Those who committed excesses in the lands.
ayahs.kemenag: yang berbuat sewenang-wenang dalam negeri,

ayahs.arabic: فَأَكْثَرُوا۟ فِيهَا ٱلْفَسَادَ
ayahs.sahih: And increased therein the corruption.
ayahs.clear: And spread much corruption therein.
ayahs.kemenag: lalu mereka berbuat banyak kerusakan dalam negeri itu,

ayahs.arabic: فَصَبَّ عَلَيْهِمْ رَبُّكَ سَوْطَ عَذَابٍ
ayahs.sahih: So your Lord poured upon them a scourge of punishment.
ayahs.clear: So your Lord poured down upon them a scourge of punishment.
ayahs.kemenag: karena itu Tuhanmu menimpakan kepada mereka cemeti azab,

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَبِٱلْمِرْصَادِ
ayahs.sahih: Indeed, your Lord is in observation.
ayahs.clear: Your Lord is on the lookout.
ayahs.kemenag: sesungguhnya Tuhanmu benar-benar mengawasi.

ayahs.arabic: فَأَمَّا ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ إِذَا مَا ٱبْتَلَىٰهُ رَبُّهُۥ فَأَكْرَمَهُۥ وَنَعَّمَهُۥ فَيَقُولُ رَبِّىٓ أَكْرَمَنِ
ayahs.sahih: And as for man, when his Lord tries him and [thus] is generous to him and favors him, he says, "My Lord has honored me."
ayahs.clear: As for man, whenever his Lord tests him, and honors him, and prospers him, he says, “My Lord has honored me.”
ayahs.kemenag: Adapun manusia apabila Tuhannya mengujinya lalu dia dimuliakan-Nya dan diberi-Nya kesenangan, maka dia akan berkata: "Tuhanku telah memuliakanku".

ayahs.arabic: وَأَمَّآ إِذَا مَا ٱبْتَلَىٰهُ فَقَدَرَ عَلَيْهِ رِزْقَهُۥ فَيَقُولُ رَبِّىٓ أَهَٰنَنِ
ayahs.sahih: But when He tries him and restricts his provision, he says, "My Lord has humiliated me."
ayahs.clear: But whenever He tests him, and restricts his livelihood for him, he says, “My Lord has insulted me.”
ayahs.kemenag: Adapun bila Tuhannya mengujinya lalu membatasi rezekinya maka dia berkata: "Tuhanku menghinakanku".

ayahs.arabic: كَلَّا ۖ بَل لَّا تُكْرِمُونَ ٱلْيَتِيمَ
ayahs.sahih: No! But you do not honor the orphan
ayahs.clear: Not at all. But you do not honor the orphan.
ayahs.kemenag: Sekali-kali tidak (demikian), sebenarnya kamu tidak memuliakan anak yatim,

ayahs.arabic: وَلَا تَحَٰٓضُّونَ عَلَىٰ طَعَامِ ٱلْمِسْكِينِ
ayahs.sahih: And you do not encourage one another to feed the poor.
ayahs.clear: And you do not urge the feeding of the poor.
ayahs.kemenag: dan kamu tidak saling mengajak memberi makan orang miskin,

ayahs.arabic: وَتَأْكُلُونَ ٱلتُّرَاثَ أَكْلًۭا لَّمًّۭا
ayahs.sahih: And you consume inheritance, devouring [it] altogether,
ayahs.clear: And you devour inheritance with all greed.
ayahs.kemenag: dan kamu memakan harta pusaka dengan cara mencampur baurkan (yang halal dan yang bathil),

ayahs.arabic: وَتُحِبُّونَ ٱلْمَالَ حُبًّۭا جَمًّۭا
ayahs.sahih: And you love wealth with immense love.
ayahs.clear: And you love wealth with immense love.
ayahs.kemenag: dan kamu mencintai harta benda dengan kecintaan yang berlebihan.

ayahs.arabic: كَلَّآ إِذَا دُكَّتِ ٱلْأَرْضُ دَكًّۭا دَكًّۭا
ayahs.sahih: No! When the earth has been leveled - pounded and crushed -
ayahs.clear: No—when the earth is leveled, pounded, and crushed.
ayahs.kemenag: Jangan (berbuat demikian). Apabila bumi digoncangkan berturut-turut,

ayahs.arabic: وَجَآءَ رَبُّكَ وَٱلْمَلَكُ صَفًّۭا صَفًّۭا
ayahs.sahih: And your Lord has come and the angels, rank upon rank,
ayahs.clear: And your Lord comes, with the angels, row after row.
ayahs.kemenag: dan datanglah Tuhanmu; sedang malaikat berbaris-baris.

ayahs.arabic: وَجِا۟ىٓءَ يَوْمَئِذٍۭ بِجَهَنَّمَ ۚ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ يَتَذَكَّرُ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ وَأَنَّىٰ لَهُ ٱلذِّكْرَىٰ
ayahs.sahih: And brought [within view], that Day, is Hell - that Day, man will remember, but what good to him will be the remembrance?
ayahs.clear: And on that Day, Hell is brought forward. On that Day, man will remember, but how will remembrance avail him?
ayahs.kemenag: Dan pada hari itu diperlihatkan neraka Jahannam; dan pada hari itu ingatlah manusia, akan tetapi tidak berguna lagi mengingat itu baginya.

ayahs.arabic: يَقُولُ يَٰلَيْتَنِى قَدَّمْتُ لِحَيَاتِى
ayahs.sahih: He will say, "Oh, I wish I had sent ahead [some good] for my life."
ayahs.clear: He will say, “If only I had forwarded for my life.”
ayahs.kemenag: Dia mengatakan: "Alangkah baiknya kiranya aku dahulu mengerjakan (amal saleh) untuk hidupku ini".

ayahs.arabic: فَيَوْمَئِذٍۢ لَّا يُعَذِّبُ عَذَابَهُۥٓ أَحَدٌۭ
ayahs.sahih: So on that Day, none will punish [as severely] as His punishment,
ayahs.clear: On that Day, none will punish as He punishes.
ayahs.kemenag: Maka pada hari itu tiada seorangpun yang menyiksa seperti siksa-Nya.

ayahs.arabic: وَلَا يُوثِقُ وَثَاقَهُۥٓ أَحَدٌۭ
ayahs.sahih: And none will bind [as severely] as His binding [of the evildoers].
ayahs.clear: And none will shackle as He shackles.
ayahs.kemenag: dan tiada seorangpun yang mengikat seperti ikatan-Nya.

ayahs.arabic: يَٰٓأَيَّتُهَا ٱلنَّفْسُ ٱلْمُطْمَئِنَّةُ
ayahs.sahih: [To the righteous it will be said], "O reassured soul,
ayahs.clear: But as for you, O tranquil soul.
ayahs.kemenag: Hai jiwa yang tenang.

ayahs.arabic: ٱرْجِعِىٓ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكِ رَاضِيَةًۭ مَّرْضِيَّةًۭ
ayahs.sahih: Return to your Lord, well-pleased and pleasing [to Him],
ayahs.clear: Return to your Lord, pleased and accepted.
ayahs.kemenag: Kembalilah kepada Tuhanmu dengan hati yang puas lagi diridhai-Nya.

ayahs.arabic: فَٱدْخُلِى فِى عِبَٰدِى
ayahs.sahih: And enter among My [righteous] servants
ayahs.clear: Enter among My servants.
ayahs.kemenag: Maka masuklah ke dalam jama'ah hamba-hamba-Ku,

ayahs.arabic: وَٱدْخُلِى جَنَّتِى
ayahs.sahih: And enter My Paradise."
ayahs.clear: Enter My Paradise.
ayahs.kemenag: masuklah ke dalam surga-Ku.

ayahs.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ لَآ أُقْسِمُ بِهَٰذَا ٱلْبَلَدِ
ayahs.sahih: I swear by this city, Makkah -
ayahs.clear: I swear by this land.
ayahs.kemenag: Aku benar-benar bersumpah dengan kota ini (Mekah),

ayahs.arabic: وَأَنتَ حِلٌّۢ بِهَٰذَا ٱلْبَلَدِ
ayahs.sahih: And you, [O Muhammad], are free of restriction in this city -
ayahs.clear: And you are a resident of this land.
ayahs.kemenag: dan kamu (Muhammad) bertempat di kota Mekah ini,

ayahs.arabic: وَوَالِدٍۢ وَمَا وَلَدَ
ayahs.sahih: And [by] the father and that which was born [of him],
ayahs.clear: And by a father and what he fathered.
ayahs.kemenag: dan demi bapak dan anaknya.

ayahs.arabic: لَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ فِى كَبَدٍ
ayahs.sahih: We have certainly created man into hardship.
ayahs.clear: We created man in distress.
ayahs.kemenag: Sesungguhnya Kami telah menciptakan manusia berada dalam susah payah.

ayahs.arabic: أَيَحْسَبُ أَن لَّن يَقْدِرَ عَلَيْهِ أَحَدٌۭ
ayahs.sahih: Does he think that never will anyone overcome him?
ayahs.clear: Does he think that no one has power over him?
ayahs.kemenag: Apakah manusia itu menyangka bahwa sekali-kali tiada seorangpun yang berkuasa atasnya?

ayahs.arabic: يَقُولُ أَهْلَكْتُ مَالًۭا لُّبَدًا
ayahs.sahih: He says, "I have spent wealth in abundance."
ayahs.clear: He says, “I have used up so much money.”
ayahs.kemenag: Dan mengatakan: "Aku telah menghabiskan harta yang banyak".

ayahs.arabic: أَيَحْسَبُ أَن لَّمْ يَرَهُۥٓ أَحَدٌ
ayahs.sahih: Does he think that no one has seen him?
ayahs.clear: Does he think that no one sees him?
ayahs.kemenag: Apakah dia menyangka bahwa tiada seorangpun yang melihatnya?

ayahs.arabic: أَلَمْ نَجْعَل لَّهُۥ عَيْنَيْنِ
ayahs.sahih: Have We not made for him two eyes?
ayahs.clear: Did We not give him two eyes?
ayahs.kemenag: Bukankah Kami telah memberikan kepadanya dua buah mata,

ayahs.arabic: وَلِسَانًۭا وَشَفَتَيْنِ
ayahs.sahih: And a tongue and two lips?
ayahs.clear: And a tongue, and two lips?
ayahs.kemenag: lidah dan dua buah bibir.

ayahs.arabic: وَهَدَيْنَٰهُ ٱلنَّجْدَيْنِ
ayahs.sahih: And have shown him the two ways?
ayahs.clear: And We showed him the two ways?
ayahs.kemenag: Dan Kami telah menunjukkan kepadanya dua jalan,

ayahs.arabic: فَلَا ٱقْتَحَمَ ٱلْعَقَبَةَ
ayahs.sahih: But he has not broken through the difficult pass.
ayahs.clear: But he did not brave the ascent.
ayahs.kemenag: Tetapi dia tiada menempuh jalan yang mendaki lagi sukar.

ayahs.arabic: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا ٱلْعَقَبَةُ
