ayahs.sahih: And what can make you know what is [breaking through] the difficult pass?
ayahs.clear: And what will explain to you what the ascent is?
ayahs.kemenag: Tahukah kamu apakah jalan yang mendaki lagi sukar itu?

ayahs.arabic: فَكُّ رَقَبَةٍ
ayahs.sahih: It is the freeing of a slave
ayahs.clear: The freeing of a slave.
ayahs.kemenag: (yaitu) melepaskan budak dari perbudakan,

ayahs.arabic: أَوْ إِطْعَٰمٌۭ فِى يَوْمٍۢ ذِى مَسْغَبَةٍۢ
ayahs.sahih: Or feeding on a day of severe hunger
ayahs.clear: Or the feeding on a day of hunger.
ayahs.kemenag: atau memberi makan pada hari kelaparan,

ayahs.arabic: يَتِيمًۭا ذَا مَقْرَبَةٍ
ayahs.sahih: An orphan of near relationship
ayahs.clear: An orphan near of kin.
ayahs.kemenag: (kepada) anak yatim yang ada hubungan kerabat,

ayahs.arabic: أَوْ مِسْكِينًۭا ذَا مَتْرَبَةٍۢ
ayahs.sahih: Or a needy person in misery
ayahs.clear: Or a destitute in the dust.
ayahs.kemenag: atau kepada orang miskin yang sangat fakir.

ayahs.arabic: ثُمَّ كَانَ مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَتَوَاصَوْا۟ بِٱلصَّبْرِ وَتَوَاصَوْا۟ بِٱلْمَرْحَمَةِ
ayahs.sahih: And then being among those who believed and advised one another to patience and advised one another to compassion.
ayahs.clear: Then he becomes of those who believe, and advise one another to patience, and advise one another to kindness.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan dia (tidak pula) termasuk orang-orang yang beriman dan saling berpesan untuk bersabar dan saling berpesan untuk berkasih sayang.

ayahs.arabic: أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلْمَيْمَنَةِ
ayahs.sahih: Those are the companions of the right.
ayahs.clear: These are the people of happiness.
ayahs.kemenag: Mereka (orang-orang yang beriman dan saling berpesan itu) adalah golongan kanan.

ayahs.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا هُمْ أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلْمَشْـَٔمَةِ
ayahs.sahih: But they who disbelieved in Our signs - those are the companions of the left.
ayahs.clear: But as for those who defy Our revelations—these are the people of misery.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan orang-orang yang kafir kepada ayat-ayat Kami, mereka itu adalah golongan kiri.

ayahs.arabic: عَلَيْهِمْ نَارٌۭ مُّؤْصَدَةٌۢ
ayahs.sahih: Over them will be fire closed in.
ayahs.clear: Upon them is a padlocked Fire.
ayahs.kemenag: Mereka berada dalam neraka yang ditutup rapat.

ayahs.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ وَٱلشَّمْسِ وَضُحَىٰهَا
ayahs.sahih: By the sun and its brightness
ayahs.clear: By the sun and its radiance.
ayahs.kemenag: Demi matahari dan cahayanya di pagi hari,

ayahs.arabic: وَٱلْقَمَرِ إِذَا تَلَىٰهَا
ayahs.sahih: And [by] the moon when it follows it
ayahs.clear: And the moon as it follows it.
ayahs.kemenag: dan bulan apabila mengiringinya,

ayahs.arabic: وَٱلنَّهَارِ إِذَا جَلَّىٰهَا
ayahs.sahih: And [by] the day when it displays it
ayahs.clear: And the day as it reveals it.
ayahs.kemenag: dan siang apabila menampakkannya,

ayahs.arabic: وَٱلَّيْلِ إِذَا يَغْشَىٰهَا
ayahs.sahih: And [by] the night when it covers it
ayahs.clear: And the night as it conceals it.
ayahs.kemenag: dan malam apabila menutupinya,

ayahs.arabic: وَٱلسَّمَآءِ وَمَا بَنَىٰهَا
ayahs.sahih: And [by] the sky and He who constructed it
ayahs.clear: And the sky and He who built it.
ayahs.kemenag: dan langit serta pembinaannya,

ayahs.arabic: وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا طَحَىٰهَا
ayahs.sahih: And [by] the earth and He who spread it
ayahs.clear: And the earth and He who spread it.
ayahs.kemenag: dan bumi serta penghamparannya,

ayahs.arabic: وَنَفْسٍۢ وَمَا سَوَّىٰهَا
ayahs.sahih: And [by] the soul and He who proportioned it
ayahs.clear: And the soul and He who proportioned it.
ayahs.kemenag: dan jiwa serta penyempurnaannya (ciptaannya),

ayahs.arabic: فَأَلْهَمَهَا فُجُورَهَا وَتَقْوَىٰهَا
ayahs.sahih: And inspired it [with discernment of] its wickedness and its righteousness,
ayahs.clear: And inspired it with its wickedness and its righteousness.
ayahs.kemenag: maka Allah mengilhamkan kepada jiwa itu (jalan) kefasikan dan ketakwaannya.

ayahs.arabic: قَدْ أَفْلَحَ مَن زَكَّىٰهَا
ayahs.sahih: He has succeeded who purifies it,
ayahs.clear: Successful is he who purifies it.
ayahs.kemenag: sesungguhnya beruntunglah orang yang mensucikan jiwa itu,

ayahs.arabic: وَقَدْ خَابَ مَن دَسَّىٰهَا
ayahs.sahih: And he has failed who instills it [with corruption].
ayahs.clear: Failing is he who corrupts it.
ayahs.kemenag: dan sesungguhnya merugilah orang yang mengotorinya.

ayahs.arabic: كَذَّبَتْ ثَمُودُ بِطَغْوَىٰهَآ
ayahs.sahih: Thamud denied [their prophet] by reason of their transgression,
ayahs.clear: Thamood denied in its pride.
ayahs.kemenag: (Kaum) Tsamud telah mendustakan (rasulnya) karena mereka melampaui batas,

ayahs.arabic: إِذِ ٱنۢبَعَثَ أَشْقَىٰهَا
ayahs.sahih: When the most wretched of them was sent forth.
ayahs.clear: When it followed its most wicked.
ayahs.kemenag: ketika bangkit orang yang paling celaka di antara mereka,

ayahs.arabic: فَقَالَ لَهُمْ رَسُولُ ٱللَّهِ نَاقَةَ ٱللَّهِ وَسُقْيَٰهَا
ayahs.sahih: And the messenger of Allah [Salih] said to them, "[Do not harm] the she-camel of Allah or [prevent her from] her drink."
ayahs.clear: The messenger of God said to them, “This is the she-camel of God, so let her drink.”
ayahs.kemenag: lalu Rasul Allah (Saleh) berkata kepada mereka: ("Biarkanlah) unta betina Allah dan minumannya".

ayahs.arabic: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَعَقَرُوهَا فَدَمْدَمَ عَلَيْهِمْ رَبُّهُم بِذَنۢبِهِمْ فَسَوَّىٰهَا
ayahs.sahih: But they denied him and hamstrung her. So their Lord brought down upon them destruction for their sin and made it equal [upon all of them].
ayahs.clear: But they called him a liar, and hamstrung her. So their Lord crushed them for their sin, and leveled it.
ayahs.kemenag: Lalu mereka mendustakannya dan menyembelih unta itu, maka Tuhan mereka membinasakan mereka disebabkan dosa mereka, lalu Allah menyama-ratakan mereka (dengan tanah),

ayahs.arabic: وَلَا يَخَافُ عُقْبَٰهَا
ayahs.sahih: And He does not fear the consequence thereof.
ayahs.clear: And He does not fear its sequel.
ayahs.kemenag: dan Allah tidak takut terhadap akibat tindakan-Nya itu.

ayahs.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ وَٱلَّيْلِ إِذَا يَغْشَىٰ
ayahs.sahih: By the night when it covers
ayahs.clear: By the night as it covers.
ayahs.kemenag: Demi malam apabila menutupi (cahaya siang),

ayahs.arabic: وَٱلنَّهَارِ إِذَا تَجَلَّىٰ
ayahs.sahih: And [by] the day when it appears
ayahs.clear: And the day as it reveals.
ayahs.kemenag: dan siang apabila terang benderang,

ayahs.arabic: وَمَا خَلَقَ ٱلذَّكَرَ وَٱلْأُنثَىٰٓ
ayahs.sahih: And [by] He who created the male and female,
ayahs.clear: And He who created the male and the female.
ayahs.kemenag: dan penciptaan laki-laki dan perempuan,

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ سَعْيَكُمْ لَشَتَّىٰ
ayahs.sahih: Indeed, your efforts are diverse.
ayahs.clear: Your endeavors are indeed diverse.
ayahs.kemenag: sesungguhnya usaha kamu memang berbeda-beda.

ayahs.arabic: فَأَمَّا مَنْ أَعْطَىٰ وَٱتَّقَىٰ
ayahs.sahih: As for he who gives and fears Allah
ayahs.clear: As for him who gives and is righteous.
ayahs.kemenag: Adapun orang yang memberikan (hartanya di jalan Allah) dan bertakwa,

ayahs.arabic: وَصَدَّقَ بِٱلْحُسْنَىٰ
ayahs.sahih: And believes in the best [reward],
ayahs.clear: And confirms goodness.
ayahs.kemenag: dan membenarkan adanya pahala yang terbaik (surga),

ayahs.arabic: فَسَنُيَسِّرُهُۥ لِلْيُسْرَىٰ
ayahs.sahih: We will ease him toward ease.
ayahs.clear: We will ease his way towards ease.
ayahs.kemenag: maka Kami kelak akan menyiapkan baginya jalan yang mudah.

ayahs.arabic: وَأَمَّا مَنۢ بَخِلَ وَٱسْتَغْنَىٰ
ayahs.sahih: But as for he who withholds and considers himself free of need
ayahs.clear: But as for him who is stingy and complacent.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan adapun orang-orang yang bakhil dan merasa dirinya cukup,

ayahs.arabic: وَكَذَّبَ بِٱلْحُسْنَىٰ
ayahs.sahih: And denies the best [reward],
ayahs.clear: And denies goodness.
ayahs.kemenag: serta mendustakan pahala terbaik,

ayahs.arabic: فَسَنُيَسِّرُهُۥ لِلْعُسْرَىٰ
ayahs.sahih: We will ease him toward difficulty.
ayahs.clear: We will ease his way towards difficulty.
ayahs.kemenag: maka kelak Kami akan menyiapkan baginya (jalan) yang sukar.

ayahs.arabic: وَمَا يُغْنِى عَنْهُ مَالُهُۥٓ إِذَا تَرَدَّىٰٓ
ayahs.sahih: And what will his wealth avail him when he falls?
ayahs.clear: And his money will not avail him when he plummets.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan hartanya tidak bermanfaat baginya apabila ia telah binasa.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ عَلَيْنَا لَلْهُدَىٰ
ayahs.sahih: Indeed, [incumbent] upon Us is guidance.
ayahs.clear: It is upon Us to guide.
ayahs.kemenag: Sesungguhnya kewajiban Kamilah memberi petunjuk,

ayahs.arabic: وَإِنَّ لَنَا لَلْءَاخِرَةَ وَٱلْأُولَىٰ
ayahs.sahih: And indeed, to Us belongs the Hereafter and the first [life].
ayahs.clear: And to Us belong the Last and the First.
ayahs.kemenag: dan sesungguhnya kepunyaan Kamilah akhirat dan dunia.

ayahs.arabic: فَأَنذَرْتُكُمْ نَارًۭا تَلَظَّىٰ
ayahs.sahih: So I have warned you of a Fire which is blazing.
ayahs.clear: I have warned you of a Fierce Blaze.
ayahs.kemenag: Maka, kami memperingatkan kamu dengan neraka yang menyala-nyala.

ayahs.arabic: لَا يَصْلَىٰهَآ إِلَّا ٱلْأَشْقَى
ayahs.sahih: None will [enter to] burn therein except the most wretched one.
ayahs.clear: None will burn in it except the very wicked.
ayahs.kemenag: Tidak ada yang masuk ke dalamnya kecuali orang yang paling celaka,

ayahs.arabic: ٱلَّذِى كَذَّبَ وَتَوَلَّىٰ
ayahs.sahih: Who had denied and turned away.
ayahs.clear: He who denies and turns away.
ayahs.kemenag: yang mendustakan (kebenaran) dan berpaling (dari iman).

ayahs.arabic: وَسَيُجَنَّبُهَا ٱلْأَتْقَى
ayahs.sahih: But the righteous one will avoid it -
ayahs.clear: But the devout will avoid it.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan kelak akan dijauhkan orang yang paling takwa dari neraka itu,

ayahs.arabic: ٱلَّذِى يُؤْتِى مَالَهُۥ يَتَزَكَّىٰ
ayahs.sahih: [He] who gives [from] his wealth to purify himself
ayahs.clear: He who gives his money to become pure.
ayahs.kemenag: yang menafkahkan hartanya (di jalan Allah) untuk membersihkannya,

ayahs.arabic: وَمَا لِأَحَدٍ عِندَهُۥ مِن نِّعْمَةٍۢ تُجْزَىٰٓ
ayahs.sahih: And not [giving] for anyone who has [done him] a favor to be rewarded
ayahs.clear: Seeking no favor in return.
ayahs.kemenag: padahal tidak ada seseorangpun memberikan suatu nikmat kepadanya yang harus dibalasnya,

ayahs.arabic: إِلَّا ٱبْتِغَآءَ وَجْهِ رَبِّهِ ٱلْأَعْلَىٰ
ayahs.sahih: But only seeking the countenance of his Lord, Most High.
ayahs.clear: Only seeking the acceptance of his Lord, the Most High.
ayahs.kemenag: tetapi (dia memberikan itu semata-mata) karena mencari keridhaan Tuhannya yang Maha Tinggi.

ayahs.arabic: وَلَسَوْفَ يَرْضَىٰ
ayahs.sahih: And he is going to be satisfied.
ayahs.clear: And he will be satisfied.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan kelak dia benar-benar mendapat kepuasan.

ayahs.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ وَٱلضُّحَىٰ
ayahs.sahih: By the morning brightness
ayahs.clear: By the morning light.
ayahs.kemenag: Demi waktu matahari sepenggalahan naik,

ayahs.arabic: وَٱلَّيْلِ إِذَا سَجَىٰ
ayahs.sahih: And [by] the night when it covers with darkness,
ayahs.clear: And the night as it settles.
ayahs.kemenag: dan demi malam apabila telah sunyi (gelap),

ayahs.arabic: مَا وَدَّعَكَ رَبُّكَ وَمَا قَلَىٰ
ayahs.sahih: Your Lord has not taken leave of you, [O Muhammad], nor has He detested [you].
ayahs.clear: Your Lord did not abandon you, nor did He forget.
ayahs.kemenag: Tuhanmu tiada meninggalkan kamu dan tiada (pula) benci kepadamu.

ayahs.arabic: وَلَلْءَاخِرَةُ خَيْرٌۭ لَّكَ مِنَ ٱلْأُولَىٰ
ayahs.sahih: And the Hereafter is better for you than the first [life].
ayahs.clear: The Hereafter is better for you than the First.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan sesungguhnya hari kemudian itu lebih baik bagimu daripada yang sekarang (permulaan).

ayahs.arabic: وَلَسَوْفَ يُعْطِيكَ رَبُّكَ فَتَرْضَىٰٓ
ayahs.sahih: And your Lord is going to give you, and you will be satisfied.
ayahs.clear: And your Lord will give you, and you will be satisfied.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan kelak Tuhanmu pasti memberikan karunia-Nya kepadamu, lalu (hati) kamu menjadi puas.

ayahs.arabic: أَلَمْ يَجِدْكَ يَتِيمًۭا فَـَٔاوَىٰ
ayahs.sahih: Did He not find you an orphan and give [you] refuge?
ayahs.clear: Did He not find you orphaned, and sheltered you?
ayahs.kemenag: Bukankah Dia mendapatimu sebagai seorang yatim, lalu Dia melindungimu?

ayahs.arabic: وَوَجَدَكَ ضَآلًّۭا فَهَدَىٰ
ayahs.sahih: And He found you lost and guided [you],
ayahs.clear: And found you wandering, and guided you.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan Dia mendapatimu sebagai seorang yang bingung, lalu Dia memberikan petunjuk.

ayahs.arabic: وَوَجَدَكَ عَآئِلًۭا فَأَغْنَىٰ
ayahs.sahih: And He found you poor and made [you] self-sufficient.
ayahs.clear: And found you in need, and enriched you?
ayahs.kemenag: Dan Dia mendapatimu sebagai seorang yang kekurangan, lalu Dia memberikan kecukupan.

ayahs.arabic: فَأَمَّا ٱلْيَتِيمَ فَلَا تَقْهَرْ
ayahs.sahih: So as for the orphan, do not oppress [him].
ayahs.clear: Therefore, do not mistreat the orphan.
ayahs.kemenag: Sebab itu, terhadap anak yatim janganlah kamu berlaku sewenang-wenang.

ayahs.arabic: وَأَمَّا ٱلسَّآئِلَ فَلَا تَنْهَرْ
ayahs.sahih: And as for the petitioner, do not repel [him].
ayahs.clear: Nor rebuff the seeker.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan terhadap orang yang minta-minta, janganlah kamu menghardiknya.

ayahs.arabic: وَأَمَّا بِنِعْمَةِ رَبِّكَ فَحَدِّثْ
ayahs.sahih: But as for the favor of your Lord, report [it].
ayahs.clear: But proclaim the blessings of your Lord.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan terhadap nikmat Tuhanmu, maka hendaklah kamu siarkan.

ayahs.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ أَلَمْ نَشْرَحْ لَكَ صَدْرَكَ
ayahs.sahih: Did We not expand for you, [O Muhammad], your breast?
ayahs.clear: Did We not soothe your heart?
ayahs.kemenag: Bukankah Kami telah melapangkan untukmu dadamu?,

ayahs.arabic: وَوَضَعْنَا عَنكَ وِزْرَكَ
ayahs.sahih: And We removed from you your burden
ayahs.clear: And lift from you your burden.
ayahs.kemenag: dan Kami telah menghilangkan daripadamu bebanmu,

ayahs.arabic: ٱلَّذِىٓ أَنقَضَ ظَهْرَكَ
ayahs.sahih: Which had weighed upon your back
ayahs.clear: Which weighed down your back?
ayahs.kemenag: yang memberatkan punggungmu?

ayahs.arabic: وَرَفَعْنَا لَكَ ذِكْرَكَ
ayahs.sahih: And raised high for you your repute.
ayahs.clear: And raised for you your reputation?
ayahs.kemenag: Dan Kami tinggikan bagimu sebutan (nama)mu,

ayahs.arabic: فَإِنَّ مَعَ ٱلْعُسْرِ يُسْرًا
ayahs.sahih: For indeed, with hardship [will be] ease.
ayahs.clear: With hardship comes ease.
ayahs.kemenag: Karena sesungguhnya sesudah kesulitan itu ada kemudahan,

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ مَعَ ٱلْعُسْرِ يُسْرًۭا
ayahs.sahih: Indeed, with hardship [will be] ease.
ayahs.clear: With hardship comes ease.
ayahs.kemenag: sesungguhnya sesudah kesulitan itu ada kemudahan.

ayahs.arabic: فَإِذَا فَرَغْتَ فَٱنصَبْ
ayahs.sahih: So when you have finished [your duties], then stand up [for worship].
ayahs.clear: When your work is done, turn to devotion.
ayahs.kemenag: Maka apabila kamu telah selesai (dari sesuatu urusan), kerjakanlah dengan sungguh-sungguh (urusan) yang lain,

ayahs.arabic: وَإِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ فَٱرْغَب
ayahs.sahih: And to your Lord direct [your] longing.
ayahs.clear: And to your Lord turn for everything.
ayahs.kemenag: dan hanya kepada Tuhanmulah hendaknya kamu berharap.

ayahs.arabic: بِّسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ وَٱلتِّينِ وَٱلزَّيْتُونِ
ayahs.sahih: By the fig and the olive
ayahs.clear: By the fig and the olive.
ayahs.kemenag: Demi (buah) Tin dan (buah) Zaitun,

ayahs.arabic: وَطُورِ سِينِينَ
ayahs.sahih: And [by] Mount Sinai
ayahs.clear: And Mount Sinai.
ayahs.kemenag: dan demi bukit Sinai,

ayahs.arabic: وَهَٰذَا ٱلْبَلَدِ ٱلْأَمِينِ
ayahs.sahih: And [by] this secure city [Makkah],
ayahs.clear: And this safe land.
ayahs.kemenag: dan demi kota (Mekah) ini yang aman,

ayahs.arabic: لَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ فِىٓ أَحْسَنِ تَقْوِيمٍۢ
ayahs.sahih: We have certainly created man in the best of stature;
ayahs.clear: We created man in the best design.
ayahs.kemenag: sesungguhnya Kami telah menciptakan manusia dalam bentuk yang sebaik-baiknya.

ayahs.arabic: ثُمَّ رَدَدْنَٰهُ أَسْفَلَ سَٰفِلِينَ
ayahs.sahih: Then We return him to the lowest of the low,
ayahs.clear: Then reduced him to the lowest of the low.
ayahs.kemenag: Kemudian Kami kembalikan dia ke tempat yang serendah-rendahnya (neraka),

ayahs.arabic: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ فَلَهُمْ أَجْرٌ غَيْرُ مَمْنُونٍۢ
ayahs.sahih: Except for those who believe and do righteous deeds, for they will have a reward uninterrupted.
ayahs.clear: Except those who believe and do righteous deeds; for them is a reward without end.
ayahs.kemenag: kecuali orang-orang yang beriman dan mengerjakan amal saleh; maka bagi mereka pahala yang tiada putus-putusnya.

ayahs.arabic: فَمَا يُكَذِّبُكَ بَعْدُ بِٱلدِّينِ
ayahs.sahih: So what yet causes you to deny the Recompense?
ayahs.clear: So why do you still reject the religion?
ayahs.kemenag: Maka apakah yang menyebabkan kamu mendustakan (hari) pembalasan sesudah (adanya keterangan-keterangan) itu?

ayahs.arabic: أَلَيْسَ ٱللَّهُ بِأَحْكَمِ ٱلْحَٰكِمِينَ
ayahs.sahih: Is not Allah the most just of judges?
ayahs.clear: Is God not the Wisest of the wise?
ayahs.kemenag: Bukankah Allah Hakim yang seadil-adilnya?

ayahs.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ ٱقْرَأْ بِٱسْمِ رَبِّكَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ
ayahs.sahih: Recite in the name of your Lord who created -
ayahs.clear: Read: In the Name of your Lord who created.
ayahs.kemenag: Bacalah dengan (menyebut) nama Tuhanmu Yang menciptakan,

ayahs.arabic: خَلَقَ ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ مِنْ عَلَقٍ
ayahs.sahih: Created man from a clinging substance.
ayahs.clear: Created man from a clot.
ayahs.kemenag: Dia telah menciptakan manusia dari segumpal darah.

ayahs.arabic: ٱقْرَأْ وَرَبُّكَ ٱلْأَكْرَمُ
ayahs.sahih: Recite, and your Lord is the most Generous -
ayahs.clear: Read: And your Lord is the Most Generous.
ayahs.kemenag: Bacalah, dan Tuhanmulah Yang Maha Pemurah,

ayahs.arabic: ٱلَّذِى عَلَّمَ بِٱلْقَلَمِ
ayahs.sahih: Who taught by the pen -
ayahs.clear: He who taught by the pen.
ayahs.kemenag: Yang mengajar (manusia) dengan perantaran kalam,

ayahs.arabic: عَلَّمَ ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ مَا لَمْ يَعْلَمْ
ayahs.sahih: Taught man that which he knew not.
ayahs.clear: Taught man what he never knew.
ayahs.kemenag: Dia mengajar kepada manusia apa yang tidak diketahuinya.

ayahs.arabic: كَلَّآ إِنَّ ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ لَيَطْغَىٰٓ
ayahs.sahih: No! [But] indeed, man transgresses
ayahs.clear: In fact, man oversteps all bounds.
ayahs.kemenag: Ketahuilah! Sesungguhnya manusia benar-benar melampaui batas,

ayahs.arabic: أَن رَّءَاهُ ٱسْتَغْنَىٰٓ
ayahs.sahih: Because he sees himself self-sufficient.
ayahs.clear: When he considers himself exempt.
ayahs.kemenag: karena dia melihat dirinya serba cukup.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ ٱلرُّجْعَىٰٓ
ayahs.sahih: Indeed, to your Lord is the return.
ayahs.clear: But to your Lord is the return.
ayahs.kemenag: Sesungguhnya hanya kepada Tuhanmulah kembali(mu).

ayahs.arabic: أَرَءَيْتَ ٱلَّذِى يَنْهَىٰ
ayahs.sahih: Have you seen the one who forbids
ayahs.clear: Have you seen him who prevents?
ayahs.kemenag: Bagaimana pendapatmu tentang orang yang melarang,

ayahs.arabic: عَبْدًا إِذَا صَلَّىٰٓ
ayahs.sahih: A servant when he prays?
ayahs.clear: A servant when he prays?
ayahs.kemenag: seorang hamba ketika mengerjakan shalat,

ayahs.arabic: أَرَءَيْتَ إِن كَانَ عَلَى ٱلْهُدَىٰٓ
ayahs.sahih: Have you seen if he is upon guidance
ayahs.clear: Do you think he is upon guidance?
ayahs.kemenag: bagaimana pendapatmu jika orang yang melarang itu berada di atas kebenaran,

ayahs.arabic: أَوْ أَمَرَ بِٱلتَّقْوَىٰٓ
ayahs.sahih: Or enjoins righteousness?
ayahs.clear: Or advocates righteousness?
ayahs.kemenag: atau dia menyuruh bertakwa (kepada Allah)?

ayahs.arabic: أَرَءَيْتَ إِن كَذَّبَ وَتَوَلَّىٰٓ
ayahs.sahih: Have you seen if he denies and turns away -
ayahs.clear: Do you see how he disbelieved and turned away?
ayahs.kemenag: Bagaimana pendapatmu jika orang yang melarang itu mendustakan dan berpaling?

ayahs.arabic: أَلَمْ يَعْلَم بِأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَرَىٰ
ayahs.sahih: Does he not know that Allah sees?
ayahs.clear: Does he not know that God sees?
ayahs.kemenag: Tidaklah dia mengetahui bahwa sesungguhnya Allah melihat segala perbuatannya?

ayahs.arabic: كَلَّا لَئِن لَّمْ يَنتَهِ لَنَسْفَعًۢا بِٱلنَّاصِيَةِ
ayahs.sahih: No! If he does not desist, We will surely drag him by the forelock -
ayahs.clear: No. If he does not desist, We will drag him by the forelock.
ayahs.kemenag: Ketahuilah, sungguh jika dia tidak berhenti (berbuat demikian) niscaya Kami tarik ubun-ubunnya,

ayahs.arabic: نَاصِيَةٍۢ كَٰذِبَةٍ خَاطِئَةٍۢ
ayahs.sahih: A lying, sinning forelock.
ayahs.clear: A deceitful, sinful forelock.
ayahs.kemenag: (yaitu) ubun-ubun orang yang mendustakan lagi durhaka.

ayahs.arabic: فَلْيَدْعُ نَادِيَهُۥ
ayahs.sahih: Then let him call his associates;
ayahs.clear: Let him call on his gang.
ayahs.kemenag: Maka biarlah dia memanggil golongannya (untuk menolongnya),

ayahs.arabic: سَنَدْعُ ٱلزَّبَانِيَةَ
ayahs.sahih: We will call the angels of Hell.
ayahs.clear: We will call the Guards.
ayahs.kemenag: kelak Kami akan memanggil malaikat Zabaniyah,

ayahs.arabic: كَلَّا لَا تُطِعْهُ وَٱسْجُدْ وَٱقْتَرِب ۩
ayahs.sahih: No! Do not obey him. But prostrate and draw near [to Allah].
ayahs.clear: No, do not obey him; but kneel down, and come near.
ayahs.kemenag: sekali-kali jangan, janganlah kamu patuh kepadanya; dan sujudlah dan dekatkanlah (dirimu kepada Tuhan).

ayahs.arabic: بِّسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ إِنَّآ أَنزَلْنَٰهُ فِى لَيْلَةِ ٱلْقَدْرِ
ayahs.sahih: Indeed, We sent the Qur'an down during the Night of Decree.
ayahs.clear: We sent it down on the Night of Decree.
ayahs.kemenag: Sesungguhnya Kami telah menurunkannya (Al Quran) pada malam kemuliaan.

ayahs.arabic: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا لَيْلَةُ ٱلْقَدْرِ
ayahs.sahih: And what can make you know what is the Night of Decree?
ayahs.clear: But what will convey to you what the Night of Decree is?
ayahs.kemenag: Dan tahukah kamu apakah malam kemuliaan itu?

ayahs.arabic: لَيْلَةُ ٱلْقَدْرِ خَيْرٌۭ مِّنْ أَلْفِ شَهْرٍۢ
ayahs.sahih: The Night of Decree is better than a thousand months.
ayahs.clear: The Night of Decree is better than a thousand months.
ayahs.kemenag: Malam kemuliaan itu lebih baik dari seribu bulan.

ayahs.arabic: تَنَزَّلُ ٱلْمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ وَٱلرُّوحُ فِيهَا بِإِذْنِ رَبِّهِم مِّن كُلِّ أَمْرٍۢ
ayahs.sahih: The angels and the Spirit descend therein by permission of their Lord for every matter.
ayahs.clear: In it descend the angels and the Spirit, by the leave of their Lord, with every command.
ayahs.kemenag: Pada malam itu turun malaikat-malaikat dan malaikat Jibril dengan izin Tuhannya untuk mengatur segala urusan.

ayahs.arabic: سَلَٰمٌ هِىَ حَتَّىٰ مَطْلَعِ ٱلْفَجْرِ
ayahs.sahih: Peace it is until the emergence of dawn.
ayahs.clear: Peace it is; until the rise of dawn.
ayahs.kemenag: Malam itu (penuh) kesejahteraan sampai terbit fajar.

ayahs.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ لَمْ يَكُنِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِنْ أَهْلِ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ وَٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ مُنفَكِّينَ حَتَّىٰ تَأْتِيَهُمُ ٱلْبَيِّنَةُ
ayahs.sahih: Those who disbelieved among the People of the Scripture and the polytheists were not to be parted [from misbelief] until there came to them clear evidence -
ayahs.clear: Those who disbelieved among the People of the Scripture, and the Polytheists, were not apart, until the Clear Evidence came to them.
ayahs.kemenag: Orang-orang kafir yakni ahli Kitab dan orang-orang musyrik (mengatakan bahwa mereka) tidak akan meninggalkan (agamanya) sebelum datang kepada mereka bukti yang nyata,

ayahs.arabic: رَسُولٌۭ مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ يَتْلُوا۟ صُحُفًۭا مُّطَهَّرَةًۭ
ayahs.sahih: A Messenger from Allah, reciting purified scriptures
ayahs.clear: A messenger from God reciting purified scripts.
ayahs.kemenag: (yaitu) seorang Rasul dari Allah (Muhammad) yang membacakan lembaran-lembaran yang disucikan (Al Quran),

ayahs.arabic: فِيهَا كُتُبٌۭ قَيِّمَةٌۭ
ayahs.sahih: Within which are correct writings.
ayahs.clear: In them are valuable writings.
ayahs.kemenag: di dalamnya terdapat (isi) Kitab-kitab yang lurus.

ayahs.arabic: وَمَا تَفَرَّقَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ إِلَّا مِنۢ بَعْدِ مَا جَآءَتْهُمُ ٱلْبَيِّنَةُ
ayahs.sahih: Nor did those who were given the Scripture become divided until after there had come to them clear evidence.
ayahs.clear: Those who were given the Scripture did not splinter, except after the Clear Evidence came to them.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan tidaklah berpecah belah orang-orang yang didatangkan Al Kitab (kepada mereka) melainkan sesudah datang kepada mereka bukti yang nyata.

ayahs.arabic: وَمَآ أُمِرُوٓا۟ إِلَّا لِيَعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ مُخْلِصِينَ لَهُ ٱلدِّينَ حُنَفَآءَ وَيُقِيمُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَيُؤْتُوا۟ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ ۚ وَذَٰلِكَ دِينُ ٱلْقَيِّمَةِ
ayahs.sahih: And they were not commanded except to worship Allah, [being] sincere to Him in religion, inclining to truth, and to establish prayer and to give zakah. And that is the correct religion.
ayahs.clear: They were commanded only to worship God, devoting their faith to Him alone, and to practice regular prayer, and to give alms. That is the upright religion.
ayahs.kemenag: Padahal mereka tidak disuruh kecuali supaya menyembah Allah dengan memurnikan ketaatan kepada-Nya dalam (menjalankan) agama yang lurus, dan supaya mereka mendirikan shalat dan menunaikan zakat; dan yang demikian itulah agama yang lurus.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِنْ أَهْلِ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ وَٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ فِى نَارِ جَهَنَّمَ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَآ ۚ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمْ شَرُّ ٱلْبَرِيَّةِ
ayahs.sahih: Indeed, they who disbelieved among the People of the Scripture and the polytheists will be in the fire of Hell, abiding eternally therein. Those are the worst of creatures.
ayahs.clear: Those who disbelieve among the People of the Scripture, and the Polytheists, will be in the Fire of Hell, where they will abide forever. These are the worst of creatures.
ayahs.kemenag: Sesungguhnya orang-orang yang kafir yakni ahli Kitab dan orang-orang yang musyrik (akan masuk) ke neraka Jahannam; mereka kekal di dalamnya. Mereka itu adalah seburuk-buruk makhluk.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمْ خَيْرُ ٱلْبَرِيَّةِ
ayahs.sahih: Indeed, they who have believed and done righteous deeds - those are the best of creatures.
ayahs.clear: As for those who believe and lead a righteous life—these are the best of creatures.
ayahs.kemenag: Sesungguhnya orang-orang yang beriman dan mengerjakan amal saleh, mereka itu adalah sebaik-baik makhluk.

ayahs.arabic: جَزَآؤُهُمْ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ جَنَّٰتُ عَدْنٍۢ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَٰرُ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَآ أَبَدًۭا ۖ رَّضِىَ ٱللَّهُ عَنْهُمْ وَرَضُوا۟ عَنْهُ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ لِمَنْ خَشِىَ رَبَّهُۥ
ayahs.sahih: Their reward with Allah will be gardens of perpetual residence beneath which rivers flow, wherein they will abide forever, Allah being pleased with them and they with Him. That is for whoever has feared his Lord.
ayahs.clear: Their reward is with their Lord: Gardens of Eternity beneath which rivers flow, where they will abide forever. God is pleased with them, and they are pleased with Him. That is for whoever fears His Lord.
ayahs.kemenag: Balasan mereka di sisi Tuhan mereka ialah surga 'Adn yang mengalir di bawahnya sungai-sungai; mereka kekal di dalamnya selama-lamanya. Allah ridha terhadap mereka dan merekapun ridha kepada-Nya. Yang demikian itu adalah (balasan) bagi orang yang takut kepada Tuhannya.

ayahs.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ إِذَا زُلْزِلَتِ ٱلْأَرْضُ زِلْزَالَهَا
ayahs.sahih: When the earth is shaken with its [final] earthquake
ayahs.clear: When the earth is shaken with its quake.
ayahs.kemenag: Apabila bumi digoncangkan dengan goncangan (yang dahsyat),

ayahs.arabic: وَأَخْرَجَتِ ٱلْأَرْضُ أَثْقَالَهَا
ayahs.sahih: And the earth discharges its burdens
ayahs.clear: And the earth brings out its loads.
ayahs.kemenag: dan bumi telah mengeluarkan beban-beban berat (yang dikandung)nya,

ayahs.arabic: وَقَالَ ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ مَا لَهَا
ayahs.sahih: And man says, "What is [wrong] with it?" -
ayahs.clear: And man says, “What is the matter with it?”
ayahs.kemenag: dan manusia bertanya: "Mengapa bumi (menjadi begini)?",

ayahs.arabic: يَوْمَئِذٍۢ تُحَدِّثُ أَخْبَارَهَا
ayahs.sahih: That Day, it will report its news
ayahs.clear: On that Day, it will tell its tales.
ayahs.kemenag: pada hari itu bumi menceritakan beritanya,

ayahs.arabic: بِأَنَّ رَبَّكَ أَوْحَىٰ لَهَا
ayahs.sahih: Because your Lord has commanded it.
ayahs.clear: For your Lord will have inspired it.
ayahs.kemenag: karena sesungguhnya Tuhanmu telah memerintahkan (yang sedemikian itu) kepadanya.

ayahs.arabic: يَوْمَئِذٍۢ يَصْدُرُ ٱلنَّاسُ أَشْتَاتًۭا لِّيُرَوْا۟ أَعْمَٰلَهُمْ
ayahs.sahih: That Day, the people will depart separated [into categories] to be shown [the result of] their deeds.
ayahs.clear: On that Day, the people will emerge in droves, to be shown their works.
ayahs.kemenag: Pada hari itu manusia ke luar dari kuburnya dalam keadaan bermacam-macam, supaya diperlihatkan kepada mereka (balasan) pekerjaan mereka,

ayahs.arabic: فَمَن يَعْمَلْ مِثْقَالَ ذَرَّةٍ خَيْرًۭا يَرَهُۥ
ayahs.sahih: So whoever does an atom's weight of good will see it,
ayahs.clear: Whoever has done an atom's weight of good will see it.
ayahs.kemenag: Barangsiapa yang mengerjakan kebaikan seberat dzarrahpun, niscaya dia akan melihat (balasan)nya.

ayahs.arabic: وَمَن يَعْمَلْ مِثْقَالَ ذَرَّةٍۢ شَرًّۭا يَرَهُۥ
ayahs.sahih: And whoever does an atom's weight of evil will see it.
ayahs.clear: And whoever has done an atom's weight of evil will see it.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan barangsiapa yang mengerjakan kejahatan sebesar dzarrahpun, niscaya dia akan melihat (balasan)nya pula.

ayahs.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ وَٱلْعَٰدِيَٰتِ ضَبْحًۭا
ayahs.sahih: By the racers, panting,
ayahs.clear: By the racers panting.
ayahs.kemenag: Demi kuda perang yang berlari kencang dengan terengah-engah,

ayahs.arabic: فَٱلْمُورِيَٰتِ قَدْحًۭا
ayahs.sahih: And the producers of sparks [when] striking
ayahs.clear: Igniting sparks.
ayahs.kemenag: dan kuda yang mencetuskan api dengan pukulan (kuku kakinya),

ayahs.arabic: فَٱلْمُغِيرَٰتِ صُبْحًۭا
ayahs.sahih: And the chargers at dawn,
ayahs.clear: Raiding at dawn.
ayahs.kemenag: dan kuda yang menyerang dengan tiba-tiba di waktu pagi,

ayahs.arabic: فَأَثَرْنَ بِهِۦ نَقْعًۭا
ayahs.sahih: Stirring up thereby [clouds of] dust,
ayahs.clear: Raising clouds of dust.
ayahs.kemenag: maka ia menerbangkan debu,

ayahs.arabic: فَوَسَطْنَ بِهِۦ جَمْعًا
ayahs.sahih: Arriving thereby in the center collectively,
ayahs.clear: Storming into the midst.
ayahs.kemenag: dan menyerbu ke tengah-tengah kumpulan musuh,

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ لِرَبِّهِۦ لَكَنُودٌۭ
ayahs.sahih: Indeed mankind, to his Lord, is ungrateful.
ayahs.clear: Indeed, the human being is ungrateful to his Lord.
ayahs.kemenag: sesungguhnya manusia itu sangat ingkar, tidak berterima kasih kepada Tuhannya,

ayahs.arabic: وَإِنَّهُۥ عَلَىٰ ذَٰلِكَ لَشَهِيدٌۭ
ayahs.sahih: And indeed, he is to that a witness.
ayahs.clear: And he bears witness to that.
ayahs.kemenag: dan sesungguhnya manusia itu menyaksikan (sendiri) keingkarannya,

ayahs.arabic: وَإِنَّهُۥ لِحُبِّ ٱلْخَيْرِ لَشَدِيدٌ
ayahs.sahih: And indeed he is, in love of wealth, intense.
ayahs.clear: And he is fierce in his love of wealth.
ayahs.kemenag: dan sesungguhnya dia sangat bakhil karena cintanya kepada harta.

ayahs.arabic: ۞ أَفَلَا يَعْلَمُ إِذَا بُعْثِرَ مَا فِى ٱلْقُبُورِ
ayahs.sahih: But does he not know that when the contents of the graves are scattered
ayahs.clear: Does he not know? When the contents of the graves are scattered around.
ayahs.kemenag: Maka apakah dia tidak mengetahui apabila dibangkitkan apa yang ada di dalam kubur,

ayahs.arabic: وَحُصِّلَ مَا فِى ٱلصُّدُورِ
ayahs.sahih: And that within the breasts is obtained,
ayahs.clear: And the contents of the hearts are obtained.
ayahs.kemenag: dan dilahirkan apa yang ada di dalam dada,

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ رَبَّهُم بِهِمْ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ لَّخَبِيرٌۢ
ayahs.sahih: Indeed, their Lord with them, that Day, is [fully] Acquainted.
ayahs.clear: Their Lord, on that Day, is fully informed of them.
ayahs.kemenag: sesungguhnya Tuhan mereka pada hari itu Maha Mengetahui keadaan mereka.

ayahs.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ ٱلْقَارِعَةُ
ayahs.sahih: The Striking Calamity -
ayahs.clear: The Shocker.
ayahs.kemenag: Hari Kiamat,

ayahs.arabic: مَا ٱلْقَارِعَةُ
ayahs.sahih: What is the Striking Calamity?
ayahs.clear: What is the Shocker?
ayahs.kemenag: apakah hari Kiamat itu?

ayahs.arabic: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا ٱلْقَارِعَةُ
ayahs.sahih: And what can make you know what is the Striking Calamity?
ayahs.clear: What will explain to you what the Shocker is?
ayahs.kemenag: Tahukah kamu apakah hari Kiamat itu?

ayahs.arabic: يَوْمَ يَكُونُ ٱلنَّاسُ كَٱلْفَرَاشِ ٱلْمَبْثُوثِ
ayahs.sahih: It is the Day when people will be like moths, dispersed,
ayahs.clear: The Day when the people will be like scattered moths.
ayahs.kemenag: Pada hari itu manusia adalah seperti anai-anai yang bertebaran,

ayahs.arabic: وَتَكُونُ ٱلْجِبَالُ كَٱلْعِهْنِ ٱلْمَنفُوشِ
ayahs.sahih: And the mountains will be like wool, fluffed up.
ayahs.clear: And the mountains will be like tufted wool.
ayahs.kemenag: dan gunung-gunung adalah seperti bulu yang dihambur-hamburkan.

ayahs.arabic: فَأَمَّا مَن ثَقُلَتْ مَوَٰزِينُهُۥ
ayahs.sahih: Then as for one whose scales are heavy [with good deeds],
ayahs.clear: As for he whose scales are heavy.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan adapun orang-orang yang berat timbangan (kebaikan)nya,

ayahs.arabic: فَهُوَ فِى عِيشَةٍۢ رَّاضِيَةٍۢ
ayahs.sahih: He will be in a pleasant life.
ayahs.clear: He will be in a pleasant life.
ayahs.kemenag: maka dia berada dalam kehidupan yang memuaskan.

ayahs.arabic: وَأَمَّا مَنْ خَفَّتْ مَوَٰزِينُهُۥ
ayahs.sahih: But as for one whose scales are light,
ayahs.clear: But as for he whose scales are light.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan adapun orang-orang yang ringan timbangan (kebaikan)nya,

ayahs.arabic: فَأُمُّهُۥ هَاوِيَةٌۭ
ayahs.sahih: His refuge will be an abyss.
ayahs.clear: His home is the Abyss.
ayahs.kemenag: maka tempat kembalinya adalah neraka Hawiyah.

ayahs.arabic: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا هِيَهْ
ayahs.sahih: And what can make you know what that is?
ayahs.clear: Do you know what it is?
ayahs.kemenag: Tahukah kamu apakah neraka Hawiyah itu?

ayahs.arabic: نَارٌ حَامِيَةٌۢ
ayahs.sahih: It is a Fire, intensely hot.
ayahs.clear: A Raging Fire.
ayahs.kemenag: (Yaitu) api yang sangat panas.

ayahs.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ أَلْهَىٰكُمُ ٱلتَّكَاثُرُ
ayahs.sahih: Competition in [worldly] increase diverts you
ayahs.clear: Abundance distracts you.
ayahs.kemenag: Bermegah-megahan telah melalaikan kamu,

ayahs.arabic: حَتَّىٰ زُرْتُمُ ٱلْمَقَابِرَ
ayahs.sahih: Until you visit the graveyards.
ayahs.clear: Until you visit the graveyards.
ayahs.kemenag: sampai kamu masuk ke dalam kubur.

ayahs.arabic: كَلَّا سَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ
ayahs.sahih: No! You are going to know.
ayahs.clear: Indeed, you will know.
ayahs.kemenag: Janganlah begitu, kelak kamu akan mengetahui (akibat perbuatanmu itu),

ayahs.arabic: ثُمَّ كَلَّا سَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ
ayahs.sahih: Then no! You are going to know.
ayahs.clear: Certainly, you will know.
ayahs.kemenag: dan janganlah begitu, kelak kamu akan mengetahui.

ayahs.arabic: كَلَّا لَوْ تَعْلَمُونَ عِلْمَ ٱلْيَقِينِ
ayahs.sahih: No! If you only knew with knowledge of certainty...
ayahs.clear: If you knew with knowledge of certainty.
ayahs.kemenag: Janganlah begitu, jika kamu mengetahui dengan pengetahuan yang yakin,

ayahs.arabic: لَتَرَوُنَّ ٱلْجَحِيمَ
ayahs.sahih: You will surely see the Hellfire.
ayahs.clear: You would see the Inferno.
ayahs.kemenag: niscaya kamu benar-benar akan melihat neraka Jahiim,

ayahs.arabic: ثُمَّ لَتَرَوُنَّهَا عَيْنَ ٱلْيَقِينِ
ayahs.sahih: Then you will surely see it with the eye of certainty.
ayahs.clear: Then you will see it with the eye of certainty.
ayahs.kemenag: dan sesungguhnya kamu benar-benar akan melihatnya dengan 'ainul yaqin.

ayahs.arabic: ثُمَّ لَتُسْـَٔلُنَّ يَوْمَئِذٍ عَنِ ٱلنَّعِيمِ
ayahs.sahih: Then you will surely be asked that Day about pleasure.
ayahs.clear: Then, on that Day, you will be questioned about the Bliss.
ayahs.kemenag: kemudian kamu pasti akan ditanyai pada hari itu tentang kenikmatan (yang kamu megah-megahkan di dunia itu).

ayahs.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ وَٱلْعَصْرِ
ayahs.sahih: By time,
ayahs.clear: By time.
ayahs.kemenag: Demi masa.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ لَفِى خُسْرٍ
ayahs.sahih: Indeed, mankind is in loss,
ayahs.clear: The human being is in loss.
ayahs.kemenag: Sesungguhnya manusia itu benar-benar dalam kerugian,

ayahs.arabic: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ وَتَوَاصَوْا۟ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَتَوَاصَوْا۟ بِٱلصَّبْرِ
ayahs.sahih: Except for those who have believed and done righteous deeds and advised each other to truth and advised each other to patience.
ayahs.clear: Except those who believe, and do good works, and encourage truth, and recommend patience.
ayahs.kemenag: kecuali orang-orang yang beriman dan mengerjakan amal saleh dan nasehat menasehati supaya mentaati kebenaran dan nasehat menasehati supaya menetapi kesabaran.

ayahs.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ وَيْلٌۭ لِّكُلِّ هُمَزَةٍۢ لُّمَزَةٍ
ayahs.sahih: Woe to every scorner and mocker
ayahs.clear: Woe to every slanderer backbiter.
ayahs.kemenag: Kecelakaanlah bagi setiap pengumpat lagi pencela,

ayahs.arabic: ٱلَّذِى جَمَعَ مَالًۭا وَعَدَّدَهُۥ
ayahs.sahih: Who collects wealth and [continuously] counts it.
ayahs.clear: Who gathers wealth and counts it over.
ayahs.kemenag: yang mengumpulkan harta dan menghitung-hitung,

ayahs.arabic: يَحْسَبُ أَنَّ مَالَهُۥٓ أَخْلَدَهُۥ
ayahs.sahih: He thinks that his wealth will make him immortal.
ayahs.clear: Thinking that his wealth has made him immortal.
ayahs.kemenag: dia mengira bahwa hartanya itu dapat mengkekalkannya,

ayahs.arabic: كَلَّا ۖ لَيُنۢبَذَنَّ فِى ٱلْحُطَمَةِ
ayahs.sahih: No! He will surely be thrown into the Crusher.
ayahs.clear: By no means. He will be thrown into the Crusher.
ayahs.kemenag: sekali-kali tidak! Sesungguhnya dia benar-benar akan dilemparkan ke dalam Huthamah.

ayahs.arabic: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا ٱلْحُطَمَةُ
ayahs.sahih: And what can make you know what is the Crusher?
ayahs.clear: And what will make you realize what the Crusher is?
ayahs.kemenag: Dan tahukah kamu apa Huthamah itu?

ayahs.arabic: نَارُ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْمُوقَدَةُ
ayahs.sahih: It is the fire of Allah, [eternally] fueled,
ayahs.clear: God's kindled Fire.
ayahs.kemenag: (yaitu) api (yang disediakan) Allah yang dinyalakan,

ayahs.arabic: ٱلَّتِى تَطَّلِعُ عَلَى ٱلْأَفْـِٔدَةِ
ayahs.sahih: Which mounts directed at the hearts.
ayahs.clear: That laps to the hearts.
ayahs.kemenag: yang (membakar) sampai ke hati.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّهَا عَلَيْهِم مُّؤْصَدَةٌۭ
ayahs.sahih: Indeed, Hellfire will be closed down upon them
ayahs.clear: It closes in on them.
ayahs.kemenag: Sesungguhnya api itu ditutup rapat atas mereka,

ayahs.arabic: فِى عَمَدٍۢ مُّمَدَّدَةٍۭ
ayahs.sahih: In extended columns.
ayahs.clear: In extended columns.
ayahs.kemenag: (sedang mereka itu) diikat pada tiang-tiang yang panjang.

ayahs.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ أَلَمْ تَرَ كَيْفَ فَعَلَ رَبُّكَ بِأَصْحَٰبِ ٱلْفِيلِ
ayahs.sahih: Have you not considered, [O Muhammad], how your Lord dealt with the companions of the elephant?
ayahs.clear: Have you not considered how your Lord dealt with the People of the Elephant?
ayahs.kemenag: Apakah kamu tidak memperhatikan bagaimana Tuhanmu telah bertindak terhadap tentara bergajah?

ayahs.arabic: أَلَمْ يَجْعَلْ كَيْدَهُمْ فِى تَضْلِيلٍۢ
ayahs.sahih: Did He not make their plan into misguidance?
ayahs.clear: Did He not make their plan go wrong?
ayahs.kemenag: Bukankah Dia telah menjadikan tipu daya mereka (untuk menghancurkan Ka'bah) itu sia-sia?

ayahs.arabic: وَأَرْسَلَ عَلَيْهِمْ طَيْرًا أَبَابِيلَ
ayahs.sahih: And He sent against them birds in flocks,
ayahs.clear: He sent against them swarms of birds.
ayahs.kemenag: dan Dia mengirimkan kapada mereka burung yang berbondong-bondong,

ayahs.arabic: تَرْمِيهِم بِحِجَارَةٍۢ مِّن سِجِّيلٍۢ
ayahs.sahih: Striking them with stones of hard clay,
ayahs.clear: Throwing at them rocks of baked clay.
ayahs.kemenag: yang melempari mereka dengan batu (berasal) dari tanah yang terbakar,

ayahs.arabic: فَجَعَلَهُمْ كَعَصْفٍۢ مَّأْكُولٍۭ
ayahs.sahih: And He made them like eaten straw.
ayahs.clear: Leaving them like chewed-up leaves.
ayahs.kemenag: lalu Dia menjadikan mereka seperti daun-daun yang dimakan (ulat).

ayahs.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ لِإِيلَٰفِ قُرَيْشٍ
ayahs.sahih: For the accustomed security of the Quraysh -
ayahs.clear: For the security of Quraish.
ayahs.kemenag: Karena kebiasaan orang-orang Quraisy,

ayahs.arabic: إِۦلَٰفِهِمْ رِحْلَةَ ٱلشِّتَآءِ وَٱلصَّيْفِ
ayahs.sahih: Their accustomed security [in] the caravan of winter and summer -
ayahs.clear: Their security during winter and summer journeys.
ayahs.kemenag: (yaitu) kebiasaan mereka bepergian pada musim dingin dan musim panas.

ayahs.arabic: فَلْيَعْبُدُوا۟ رَبَّ هَٰذَا ٱلْبَيْتِ
ayahs.sahih: Let them worship the Lord of this House,
ayahs.clear: Let them worship the Lord of this House.
ayahs.kemenag: Maka hendaklah mereka menyembah Tuhan Pemilik rumah ini (Ka'bah).

ayahs.arabic: ٱلَّذِىٓ أَطْعَمَهُم مِّن جُوعٍۢ وَءَامَنَهُم مِّنْ خَوْفٍۭ
ayahs.sahih: Who has fed them, [saving them] from hunger and made them safe, [saving them] from fear.
ayahs.clear: Who has fed them against hunger, and has secured them against fear.
ayahs.kemenag: Yang telah memberi makanan kepada mereka untuk menghilangkan lapar dan mengamankan mereka dari ketakutan.

ayahs.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ أَرَءَيْتَ ٱلَّذِى يُكَذِّبُ بِٱلدِّينِ
ayahs.sahih: Have you seen the one who denies the Recompense?
ayahs.clear: Have you considered him who denies the religion?
ayahs.kemenag: Tahukah kamu (orang) yang mendustakan agama?

ayahs.arabic: فَذَٰلِكَ ٱلَّذِى يَدُعُّ ٱلْيَتِيمَ
ayahs.sahih: For that is the one who drives away the orphan
ayahs.clear: It is he who mistreats the orphan.
ayahs.kemenag: Itulah orang yang menghardik anak yatim,

ayahs.arabic: وَلَا يَحُضُّ عَلَىٰ طَعَامِ ٱلْمِسْكِينِ
ayahs.sahih: And does not encourage the feeding of the poor.
ayahs.clear: And does not encourage the feeding of the poor.
ayahs.kemenag: dan tidak menganjurkan memberi makan orang miskin.

ayahs.arabic: فَوَيْلٌۭ لِّلْمُصَلِّينَ
ayahs.sahih: So woe to those who pray
ayahs.clear: So woe to those who pray.
ayahs.kemenag: Maka kecelakaanlah bagi orang-orang yang shalat,

ayahs.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ عَن صَلَاتِهِمْ سَاهُونَ
ayahs.sahih: [But] who are heedless of their prayer -
ayahs.clear: Those who are heedless of their prayers.
ayahs.kemenag: (yaitu) orang-orang yang lalai dari shalatnya,

ayahs.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ يُرَآءُونَ
ayahs.sahih: Those who make show [of their deeds]
ayahs.clear: Those who put on the appearance.
ayahs.kemenag: orang-orang yang berbuat riya,

ayahs.arabic: وَيَمْنَعُونَ ٱلْمَاعُونَ
ayahs.sahih: And withhold [simple] assistance.
ayahs.clear: And withhold the assistance.
ayahs.kemenag: dan enggan (menolong dengan) barang berguna.

ayahs.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ إِنَّآ أَعْطَيْنَٰكَ ٱلْكَوْثَرَ
ayahs.sahih: Indeed, We have granted you, [O Muhammad], al-Kawthar.
ayahs.clear: We have given you plenty.
ayahs.kemenag: Sesungguhnya Kami telah memberikan kepadamu nikmat yang banyak.

ayahs.arabic: فَصَلِّ لِرَبِّكَ وَٱنْحَرْ
ayahs.sahih: So pray to your Lord and sacrifice [to Him alone].
ayahs.clear: So pray to your Lord and sacrifice.
ayahs.kemenag: Maka dirikanlah shalat karena Tuhanmu; dan berkorbanlah.

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ شَانِئَكَ هُوَ ٱلْأَبْتَرُ
ayahs.sahih: Indeed, your enemy is the one cut off.
ayahs.clear: He who hates you is the loser.
ayahs.kemenag: Sesungguhnya orang-orang yang membenci kamu dialah yang terputus.

ayahs.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ قُلْ يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْكَٰفِرُونَ
ayahs.sahih: Say, "O disbelievers,
ayahs.clear: Say, “O disbelievers.
ayahs.kemenag: Katakanlah: "Hai orang-orang kafir,

ayahs.arabic: لَآ أَعْبُدُ مَا تَعْبُدُونَ
ayahs.sahih: I do not worship what you worship.
ayahs.clear: I do not worship what you worship.
ayahs.kemenag: Aku tidak akan menyembah apa yang kamu sembah.

ayahs.arabic: وَلَآ أَنتُمْ عَٰبِدُونَ مَآ أَعْبُدُ
ayahs.sahih: Nor are you worshippers of what I worship.
ayahs.clear: Nor do you worship what I worship.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan kamu bukan penyembah Tuhan yang aku sembah.

ayahs.arabic: وَلَآ أَنَا۠ عَابِدٌۭ مَّا عَبَدتُّمْ
ayahs.sahih: Nor will I be a worshipper of what you worship.
ayahs.clear: Nor do I serve what you serve.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan aku tidak pernah menjadi penyembah apa yang kamu sembah,

ayahs.arabic: وَلَآ أَنتُمْ عَٰبِدُونَ مَآ أَعْبُدُ
ayahs.sahih: Nor will you be worshippers of what I worship.
ayahs.clear: Nor do you serve what I serve.
ayahs.kemenag: dan kamu tidak pernah (pula) menjadi penyembah Tuhan yang aku sembah.

ayahs.arabic: لَكُمْ دِينُكُمْ وَلِىَ دِينِ
ayahs.sahih: For you is your religion, and for me is my religion."
ayahs.clear: You have your way, and I have my way.”
ayahs.kemenag: Untukmu agamamu, dan untukkulah, agamaku".

ayahs.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ إِذَا جَآءَ نَصْرُ ٱللَّهِ وَٱلْفَتْحُ
ayahs.sahih: When the victory of Allah has come and the conquest,
ayahs.clear: When there comes God’s victory, and conquest.
ayahs.kemenag: Apabila telah datang pertolongan Allah dan kemenangan,

ayahs.arabic: وَرَأَيْتَ ٱلنَّاسَ يَدْخُلُونَ فِى دِينِ ٱللَّهِ أَفْوَاجًۭا
ayahs.sahih: And you see the people entering into the religion of Allah in multitudes,
ayahs.clear: And you see the people entering God’s religion in multitudes.
ayahs.kemenag: dan kamu lihat manusia masuk agama Allah dengan berbondong-bondong,

ayahs.arabic: فَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ وَٱسْتَغْفِرْهُ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ تَوَّابًۢا
ayahs.sahih: Then exalt [Him] with praise of your Lord and ask forgiveness of Him. Indeed, He is ever Accepting of repentance.
ayahs.clear: Then celebrate the praise of your Lord, and seek His forgiveness. He is the Accepter of Repentance.
ayahs.kemenag: maka bertasbihlah dengan memuji Tuhanmu dan mohonlah ampun kepada-Nya. Sesungguhnya Dia adalah Maha Penerima taubat.

ayahs.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ تَبَّتْ يَدَآ أَبِى لَهَبٍۢ وَتَبَّ
ayahs.sahih: May the hands of Abu Lahab be ruined, and ruined is he.
ayahs.clear: Condemned are the hands of Abee Lahab, and he is condemned.
ayahs.kemenag: Binasalah kedua tangan Abu Lahab dan sesungguhnya dia akan binasa.

ayahs.arabic: مَآ أَغْنَىٰ عَنْهُ مَالُهُۥ وَمَا كَسَبَ
ayahs.sahih: His wealth will not avail him or that which he gained.
ayahs.clear: His wealth did not avail him, nor did what he acquired.
ayahs.kemenag: Tidaklah berfaedah kepadanya harta bendanya dan apa yang ia usahakan.

ayahs.arabic: سَيَصْلَىٰ نَارًۭا ذَاتَ لَهَبٍۢ
ayahs.sahih: He will [enter to] burn in a Fire of [blazing] flame
ayahs.clear: He will burn in a Flaming Fire.
ayahs.kemenag: Kelak dia akan masuk ke dalam api yang bergejolak.

ayahs.arabic: وَٱمْرَأَتُهُۥ حَمَّالَةَ ٱلْحَطَبِ
ayahs.sahih: And his wife [as well] - the carrier of firewood.
ayahs.clear: And his wife—the firewood carrier.
ayahs.kemenag: Dan (begitu pula) istrinya, pembawa kayu bakar.

ayahs.arabic: فِى جِيدِهَا حَبْلٌۭ مِّن مَّسَدٍۭ
ayahs.sahih: Around her neck is a rope of [twisted] fiber.
ayahs.clear: Around her neck is a rope of thorns.
ayahs.kemenag: Yang di lehernya ada tali dari sabut.

ayahs.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ قُلْ هُوَ ٱللَّهُ أَحَدٌ
ayahs.sahih: Say, "He is Allah, [who is] One,
ayahs.clear: Say, “He is God, the One.
ayahs.kemenag: Katakanlah: "Dialah Allah, Yang Maha Esa.

ayahs.arabic: ٱللَّهُ ٱلصَّمَدُ
ayahs.sahih: Allah, the Eternal Refuge.
ayahs.clear: God, the Absolute.
ayahs.kemenag: Allah adalah Tuhan yang bergantung kepada-Nya segala sesuatu.

ayahs.arabic: لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ
ayahs.sahih: He neither begets nor is born,
ayahs.clear: He begets not, nor was He begotten.
ayahs.kemenag: Dia tiada beranak dan tidak pula diperanakkan,

ayahs.arabic: وَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُۥ كُفُوًا أَحَدٌۢ
ayahs.sahih: Nor is there to Him any equivalent."
ayahs.clear: And there is nothing comparable to Him.”
ayahs.kemenag: dan tidak ada seorangpun yang setara dengan Dia".

ayahs.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ ٱلْفَلَقِ
ayahs.sahih: Say, "I seek refuge in the Lord of daybreak
ayahs.clear: Say, “I take refuge with the Lord of Daybreak.
ayahs.kemenag: Katakanlah: "Aku berlindung kepada Tuhan Yang Menguasai subuh,

ayahs.arabic: مِن شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ
ayahs.sahih: From the evil of that which He created
ayahs.clear: From the evil of what He created.
ayahs.kemenag: dari kejahatan makhluk-Nya,

ayahs.arabic: وَمِن شَرِّ غَاسِقٍ إِذَا وَقَبَ
ayahs.sahih: And from the evil of darkness when it settles
ayahs.clear: And from the evil of the darkness as it gathers.
ayahs.kemenag: dan dari kejahatan malam apabila telah gelap gulita,

ayahs.arabic: وَمِن شَرِّ ٱلنَّفَّٰثَٰتِ فِى ٱلْعُقَدِ
ayahs.sahih: And from the evil of the blowers in knots
ayahs.clear: And from the evil of those who practice sorcery.
ayahs.kemenag: dan dari kejahatan wanita-wanita tukang sihir yang menghembus pada buhul-buhul,

ayahs.arabic: وَمِن شَرِّ حَاسِدٍ إِذَا حَسَدَ
ayahs.sahih: And from the evil of an envier when he envies."
ayahs.clear: And from the evil of an envious when he envies.”
ayahs.kemenag: dan dari kejahatan pendengki bila ia dengki".

ayahs.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ ٱلنَّاسِ
ayahs.sahih: Say, "I seek refuge in the Lord of mankind,
ayahs.clear: Say, “I seek refuge in the Lord of mankind.
ayahs.kemenag: Katakanlah: "Aku berlindung kepada Tuhan (yang memelihara dan menguasai) manusia.

ayahs.arabic: مَلِكِ ٱلنَّاسِ
ayahs.sahih: The Sovereign of mankind.
ayahs.clear: The King of mankind.
ayahs.kemenag: Raja manusia.

ayahs.arabic: إِلَٰهِ ٱلنَّاسِ
ayahs.sahih: The God of mankind,
ayahs.clear: The God of mankind.
ayahs.kemenag: Sembahan manusia.

ayahs.arabic: مِن شَرِّ ٱلْوَسْوَاسِ ٱلْخَنَّاسِ
ayahs.sahih: From the evil of the retreating whisperer -
ayahs.clear: From the evil of the sneaky whisperer.
ayahs.kemenag: Dari kejahatan (bisikan) syaitan yang biasa bersembunyi,

ayahs.arabic: ٱلَّذِى يُوَسْوِسُ فِى صُدُورِ ٱلنَّاسِ
ayahs.sahih: Who whispers [evil] into the breasts of mankind -
ayahs.clear: Who whispers into the hearts of people.
ayahs.kemenag: yang membisikkan (kejahatan) ke dalam dada manusia,

ayahs.arabic: مِنَ ٱلْجِنَّةِ وَٱلنَّاسِ
ayahs.sahih: From among the jinn and mankind."
ayahs.clear: From among jinn and among people.”
ayahs.kemenag: dari (golongan) jin dan manusia.
